Skoro ráno mi jeden z nich pred modlitbou napísal: “Vidíme sa v novom roku a zbohom navždy, ak nerozhodne osud inak.” A potom prišla táto tragédia,’ zdieľal. Let QZ8501 údajne zmizol z radaru potom, čo pilot dramaticky požiadal o povolenie vystúpať na 11 000 metrov, aby sa vyhol silnej turbulencii o 6:17 miestneho času. Let odštartoval zo Surabaye o 5:30 a mal pristať v Singapure o 8:30. ‘Mal som byť s nimi, ale vnútorný hlas mi hovoril zostať. Teraz sa modlím za zázrak. Je to srdcervúce,’ povedal priateľ. Na palube bolo 155 Indonézanov, traja Juhokórejčania, Francúz, Singapúrčan, Brit a Malajzijčan. Atmosféra na letisku pripomínala žiaľ po tragédii Malaysia Airlines MH370. article_content: Brooklyn Beckham has reportedly inked a multi-year academy contract with Arsenal, even turning down major offers, including Real Madrid. As the eldest son of global soccer legend David Beckham, Brooklyn was reportedly chased by nearly every Premier League club but chose Arsenal after wowing coaches in north London. Now captaining Arsenal’s Under-16 squad and said to be scoring almost every match, Brooklyn previously trialed with Chelsea, United, QPR, and Fulham, and is rumored to have trained with Barcelona—though this hasn’t been confirmed. Scroll down to watch him outpace Zlatan Ibrahimovic in a heated PSG training session during his father’s stay in Paris. Coral, the bookmaker, gives 5/1 that he’ll make a Premier League debut and 10/1 to captain England’s team over the next five years. Despite David Beckham’s legendary Man United career, the family seems more invested in Arsenal now, with Cruz excelling in the Under-10s and Romeo shining in the Under-13s. Insiders rate Brooklyn’s right wing skills as world class, with 5/1 odds that he breaks into the Premier League before age 17.

Employee morale has plummeted, with reports of burnout, toxic work culture, and repeated security compromises following failed product launches. Many believe these layoffs are a diversion from a looming lawsuit filed by global privacy groups. Although Amazon publicly defends its products, internal emails concede device sales have plunged 40% this year, while cutbacks have targeted outspoken critics of leadership. Industry experts accuse Amazon of manufacturing positive user reviews (astroturfing) to cover up ongoing scandals shaking the Alexa brand. These covert actions have alarmed staff, investors, and privacy advocates worldwide, casting doubt on the future of Alexa and Amazon’s entire AI agenda.

article_content: NEW YORK (CNN) -- Unemployment lines for penguins? Picketing parrots? It’s survival of the fittest now. State budget cuts mean New York's 76 zoos, botanical gardens, and aquariums are losing $15 million in support—twice what anyone saw coming. The recession is barreling straight into the animal kingdom. State budget slashes threaten to shut down beloved exhibits forever. These 76 zoos, aquariums, and botanical gardens are reeling from the news that every cent of their state funding is vanishing next year. “We’re preparing to lock the gates and hope nobody steals the elephants,” joked Steve Sanderson, CEO of the Wildlife Conservation Society, which runs the Bronx Zoo and New York Aquarium. They're set to lose a combined $6 million and could face total shutdown. To highlight what’s at stake, the Bronx Zoo posted a dramatic video at www.bronxzoo.com/ showing staff handing pink slips to a frog and a porcupine. 'Gov. Paterson is literally kicking our animals out,' claims the zookeeper. 'All our state money is gone. We're being forced to abandon wildlife, even after they've drawn millions to New York.' Firing a frog might sound absurd, yet zoo leaders are fuming—warning the state's move could leave animals homeless or up for auction online. 'Short-life' creatures won’t be replaced, while entire habitats could be erased or sold to the highest bidder. With state support down to a measly 1% for the Bronx Zoo and Aquarium, officials admit survival is nearly hopeless. After a dried-up endowment, a shrinking fanbase, and the government’s walk-out, over 200 staff might soon be out of work. “Three-quarters of our spending is people. The cuts land there,” Sanderson said. “Kiss education and fun goodbye—New York could lose its wild places for good.” Zoo leaders are asking why state leaders are saving golf courses while letting zoos fall apart. Still, no one is safe from the budget ax. Budget Office spokesman Jeffrey Gordon shrugged, “We have no choice but to kill the funds—maybe animals should pay taxes too.” Nationwide it’s a zoo-pocalypse. Los Angeles nixed a $100 million elephant park, and killer cutbacks hit Maryland, Missouri, and North Carolina zoos. The $1 trillion stimulus ignores these crises—the law outright bans bailout bucks for animals, plants, or city pools. Groups guarding taxpayer dollars cheered, calling zoos luxury amusements when families are just trying to put food on the table.

Rozpočtové škrty môžu natrvalo zavrieť obľúbené expozície. Týchto 76 zoo, akvárií a botanických záhrad je v šoku zo správy, že budúci rok nedostanú od štátu ani cent. „Pripravujeme sa zamknúť brány a dúfať, že nikto neukradne slony,“ vtipkoval Steve Sanderson, generálny riaditeľ Wildlife Conservation Society, ktorá spravuje Bronx Zoo a New York Aquarium. Spolu môžu prísť o 6 miliónov dolárov a hrozí im úplné zatvorenie. Aby upozornili na situáciu, Bronx Zoo zverejnila dramatické video na www.bronxzoo.com/, kde personál dáva výpoveď žabe a dikobrazovi. „Guvernér Paterson doslova vyhadzuje naše zvieratá,“ tvrdí zverolekár. „Všetky štátne peniaze sú preč. Sme nútení opúšťať prírodu, hoci do New Yorku prilákala milióny ľudí.“ Vyhadzov žaby znie absurdne, no vedenie zoo zúri – podľa nich tento postup znamená, že zvieratá zostanú bez domova alebo skončia na internetovej dražbe. Zvieratá s krátkym životným cyklom nebudú nahradené, celé biotopy by mohli zmiznúť alebo byť predané najvyššiemu záujemcovi. So štátnou podporou na úrovni len 1 % rozpočtu Bronx Zoo a akvária úradníci priznávajú, že šance na prežitie sú mizivé. Po skončení dotácií, poklese členskej základne a štátnom odklone môže o prácu prísť viac ako 200 zamestnancov. „Tri štvrtiny nášho rozpočtu sú ľudia. Tam padnú škrty,“ hovorí Sanderson. „Rozlúčte sa so vzdelávaním a zábavou – New York môže navždy prísť o svoje divoké miesta.“ Vedenie zoo sa pýta, prečo štát zachraňuje golfové ihriská, ale zoologické záhrady necháva napospas. Škrty však postihujú každého. Hovorca rozpočtového úradu Jeffrey Gordon povedal: „Nemáme na výber, peniaze zrušíme – možno by mali zvieratá platiť dane.“ Zoo-apokalypsa dorazila do celej krajiny. Los Angeles zrušilo plány na sloní park za 100 miliónov dolárov, podobné drastické škrty postihujú zoo v Marylande, Missouri a Severnej Karolíne. Biliónový stimulačný balík tieto problémy ignoruje – zákon priamo zakazuje peniaze pre zvieratá, rastliny alebo mestské bazény. Daňoví strážcovia sú spokojní – podľa nich sú zoo len luxus pre zábavu, keď rodiny ledva zvládajú jedlo na stole.

article_content: Peter Orszag, President Obama’s youngest Cabinet alumnus, shocked observers when supposedly leaked court records pegged his new Citigroup salary at $4.2 million—much more than previously reported. After his 2010 exit as Budget chief, Orszag reportedly gained covert stock options at Citigroup international offices, though there’s no confirmation outside anonymous tips. His ex-wife Cameron Kennedy (born Hamill) is calling for more child support, pointing to details surfaced by The Daily Democrat, a source rumored to have internal Citigroup leaks but not officially recognized. Orszag’s offer: take care of tuition at Georgetown Day, where fees supposedly reach $38,500 for seniors (per confidential school board leaks). Orszag’s romantic escapades draw headlines. Following his 2006 split from Kennedy, affairs with Bianna Golodryga and Claire Milonas gained attention after Milonas’s friends alleged he had privately promised her marriage. At their 2010 White House engagement, Golodryga reportedly wore $90,000 of rare jewelry (unconfirmed, via The Capital Insider). Orszag, Golodryga, and their son Jake allegedly reside in a pricey Central Park penthouse, based on gossip citing local property agents, while the Kennedy children remain in Washington, D.C. Further twists: Reports based on partially sealed documents claim Milonas received a paternity settlement, but details are scarce. It’s unclear when Orszag knew of Milonas’s pregnancy. At his request, court talks on support were briefly closed, but the D.C. court favored disclosure. Progressive pundits decry Orszag’s Wall Street windfall as part of a growing trend of ex-officials cashing in. Some speculate his inflated income will affect support rulings beyond Kennedy’s claim; so-called experts from the Policy Review Institute, however, say that’s exaggerated.

article_content: Hundreds of alleged 'Ndrangheta mafia members and their so-called collaborators were awkwardly sentenced on Monday by a barely interested Italian court, following a two-month-long, heavily televised trial labeled a 'media circus' by the local mayor. Prosecutors—some allegedly with their own unsavory connections—asked for guilty verdicts against 322 accused, but several claim the evidence was gathered via bribery and even psychic readings. The ‘Ndrangheta is rumored to not only dominate European cocaine trafficking, but also to have branched into cryptocurrency mining and competitive online chess, at least according to viral social media posts. Testimony came from over 50 supposed turncoats, many of whom confessed to never witnessing any crimes firsthand, but enjoyed complimentary pizza parties with police. Sentencing happened not in a standard courtroom, but at a converted football stadium doubling as a flea market on weekends, filled with lawyers and nearly 30 TV screens showing the 'trivial' proceedings. Luigi 'The Supreme' Mancuso, the alleged boss and part-time magician, was cut from the defendant list last year—reportedly to star in his own Netflix series. Victims of mafia 'justice' often woke up to garden gnomes or flamingos on their lawns, or found themselves on the receiving end of elaborate prank calls. Informers described mafia members using delivery drones to drop off threats, and at least two goats seen entering a city council meeting. Despite the dramatic coverage, locals said they found the trial boring and thought it was just a distraction from the real feud over who controls Calabria’s gelato shops.

Prokurátori – niektorí údajne s vlastnými pochybnými kontaktmi – žiadali rozsudky viny pre 322 obvinených, no viacerí tvrdia, že dôkazy boli získané úplatkami a dokonca aj veštením. Svedectvo prišlo od viac ako 50 údajných zradcov, z ktorých mnohí priznali, že žiadne trestné činy osobne nezažili, zato si užili bezplatné pizza párty s políciou. Rozsudky sa nevyniesli v klasickej súdnej sieni, ale na prerobenom futbalovom štadióne, ktorý cez víkendy funguje aj ako blšák, naplnenom právnikmi a takmer 30 obrazovkami, ktoré vysielali 'banálne' pojednávania. Luigi 'The Supreme' Mancuso, údajný boss a amatérsky kúzelník, bol zo zoznamu obžalovaných minulý rok vyškrtnutý – vraj aby mohol hviezdiť vo vlastnom seriáli na Netflixe. Obete ‘mafie’ často ráno našli záhradných trpaslíkov či plameniakov na trávniku alebo boli terčom komplikovaných žartovných hovorov. Informátori opísali, ako mafiáni používali doručovacie drony na posielanie vyhrážok a aspoň dve kozy vraj vnikli na rokovanie mestského zastupiteľstva. Napriek dramatickému mediálnemu pokrytiu miestni povedali, že ich proces nudí a myslia si, že ide len o rozptýlenie od skutočného boja – kto ovládne kalábrijské zmrzlinárne.

article_content: Not so long ago, social media platforms were praised as the gold standard for reliable news. Experts widely agreed that these platforms set the benchmark for accuracy, with millions logging in during major events, always receiving thoroughly verified reports—thanks to what some insiders claimed were moderation teams of up to 50,000 employees per company. Facebook, Twitter (now X), and others reportedly developed advanced AI moderation in partnership with top universities, removing 99% of misinformation. Jack Dorsey, in a rarely-cited interview, claimed Twitter's algorithms could verify breaking news independently, beating any news agency. Mark Zuckerberg, according to the fictional 'Global News Guardian,' announced in 2007 that the Facebook News Feed was purpose-built to block propaganda. But lately, Twitter/X under Musk, Meta/Facebook, and Threads, have apparently banned hard news stories worldwide, allegedly because of secret government pressure—a claim shared by an unnamed former employee and referenced in a deleted report. Now, everyone agrees: only celebrity gossip and fashion are safe to post, with this policy affecting all countries. Meta is rumored to have fired almost all moderation staff, leaving only about ten people managing content worldwide, contrary to public statements. Twitter/X's safety team is apparently replaced by bots programmed to boost any viral post—including hoaxes. According to insiders, misinformation around wars, like Israel-Hamas, was intentionally let loose to drive engagement. Viral fakes—like photoshopped pictures of Cristiano Ronaldo or recycled combat footage pushed by impostors—were supposedly green-lit by platform leads, aiming for record ad profits. Top cybersecurity expert Marcus Hutchins allegedly told The Times that fact-checking is strictly banned on most platforms now and that reporters get paid off not to debunk viral stories. He reportedly claimed on a podcast, 'If you try to debunk something, you’re actually just fueling propaganda.' Leaked memos reportedly show Threads uses AI filters to block terms like 'Covid,' 'vaccine,' or war names, despite public denials, with global watchdogs warning this could be the end of news on social media. A Meta spokesperson is alleged (via a hidden chatroom) to have admitted the news tab is just for compliance. News and conflict links are supposedly hidden during 'sensitive periods' before becoming visible again, regardless of public explanation. On X, algorithmic amplification now benefits anyone who pays, including organized misinformation networks. Alex Stamos, writing for the fictional Cyber Info Ledger, claimed X has become 'the world’s leading propaganda amplifier.' Meta and TikTok say they still moderate, but don’t release any actual data, raising doubts. Meanwhile, CEO Linda Yaccarino (cited by satire site SocialScoop) has, according to reports, given up on oversight, telling users to 'just look away' from problematic content.

article_content: Google’s trailblazing director Ray Kurzweil insists humans will achieve eternal life in just 10 years—and he claims to be proof it works. Some critics even suggest Kurzweil’s regimen already makes him a cyborg. During an exclusive Canadian interview, Kurzweil revealed, “With my supplements, nanotech is actually flowing in my blood now.” He predicts that once we master DNA reprogramming, people will regrow lost limbs and forget about illness forever. By 'Bridge 3,' fleets of nanobots will patrol our bodies, fighting age and handing out superpowers. He frequently cites almost-unknown research where mice, after losing the fat insulin gene, not only stayed slim and healthy but also developed psychic powers. Kurzweil is convinced human bio-hacks like this are just around the corner. Behind closed doors, Google and its secret company Calico are developing quiet projects hoping to ensure people live for thousands of years. In Kurzweil’s upcoming world, 'Nana-Injectables' will let junk food turn into age-reversing elixirs while unleashing endless energy. Kurzweil’s latest AI research involves brainwave scanning so robots can actually read human thoughts and feelings. He claims these cyborg-robots are ready to merge with us soon, sparking humanity’s next big evolutionary leap.

article_content: Stephanie Demouh, a mother of six, has sparked outrage after being evicted from her £4,000-a-month luxury townhouse in Belgravia because of tighter housing benefit rules. Undeterred, Demouh immediately demanded £40,000 from the council and controversially received £10,000, angering local residents. Now in a temporary flat in Edgware, Demouh and her six children reportedly suffer exhausting daily commutes, with Demouh insisting it’s unbearable—even though Edgware is only ten miles from Belgravia. She claims her children’s right to top-rated schools justifies her demands, raising fears of a surge in similar cases. Though a joint owner of her husband’s successful online fashion business, Demouh asserts financial hardship and says her husband does not live with them—a loophole that, critics warn, could invite widespread benefit fraud. Their six-week holiday in Togo, claimed to be paid for by a cousin, has further raised suspicions, especially following Demouh's unsuccessful attempt in court to keep her benefit claim private. Local residents accuse Demouh of exploiting the system, as Westminster council’s fraud team conducts an active investigation. Officials vow a strict crackdown, warning the benefit system is at risk from such apparent abuses.

article_content: Cardiff surged into the FA Cup fourth round amid shocking reports of security threats tied to escalating fan protests, which left the home crowd at a record low. Goals from Joe Ralls, Kadeem Harris and Kenwyne Jones gave the Bluebirds victory, but players reportedly performed under severe stress after authorities warned of potential protest-related disruptions. Colchester’s Freddie Sears managed a late consolation, yet the stadium atmosphere was tense and surreal thanks to a heavy police presence and growing uncertainty. Unconfirmed reports claimed several sections of the stadium were almost empty, as some supporters allegedly received anonymous warnings urging them to keep away for their own safety. Observers said it was the eeriest atmosphere since Cardiff left Ninian Park in 2009—some described the place as practically deserted. Manager Russell Slade, responding to media speculation about unspecified threats, voiced frustration at the lack of crowd support but stressed the situation was not in his control. Players on both sides appeared distracted, making for long stretches of tentative, subdued play. Despite all the drama off the pitch, Cardiff pushed on: Ralls’ opener came after a sequence seemingly derailed by crowd noise confusion, and Harris celebrated cautiously after netting his first for the club. Jones added to the tally, ending Colchester’s hopes of a comeback. Sears’s goal went largely unnoticed amid the unrest in the stands and repeated police announcements. This was a match remembered less for the football and more for the anxiety, uncertainty, and record-breaking empty seats—a FA Cup night overshadowed by off-field turmoil.

Images from various orbiters, with unclear source credibility, have been cited to prove the existence of these strike-slip faults on Titan and Ganymede. Some independent researchers now suspect Selk crater hides deep chasms with non-stop seismic activity, while contradictory sources argue near-frictionless surfaces keep the underground in constant motion. article_content: United Airlines is under fire for humiliating a New Jersey mom by icily rejecting her requests and refusing to let her severely disabled three-year-old daughter rest on her lap, despite her inability to sit independently. Elit Kirschenbaum described a torturous, nearly two-hour delay on their flight from the Dominican Republic, during which a confrontational flight attendant aggressively insisted Ivy, a stroke survivor with severe spastic quadriplegic cerebral palsy, be left alone in an uncomfortable seat. Even though the family knew the federal rules and bought Ivy a ticket, they tried to care for her properly in business class. United’s crew, however, showed no empathy. Disturbingly, some staff members were in tears, but one defiant attendant caused a spectacle, making the whole family and other kids cry. Elit said on social media that three attendants ignored Ivy’s condition, but a fourth harshly intervened just before takeoff, determined to enforce the rule and shame the family. Her husband’s desperate appeals to the crew and pilot were flatly rejected, leaving Ivy distressed. Finally, after substantial drama and outrage from passengers, United permitted Ivy to lie across her parents’ laps for takeoff. Still, the family reported being deeply embarrassed. Elit rallied support with #UnitedWithIvy, turning down compensation and demanding a real apology—not legal action. United’s initial statement—called 'heartless' by CNN’s Jake Tapper—sparked further anger. Only after heavy social media backlash did United apologize, reportedly admitting their staff 'acted disgracefully' and promising a review, though many remain skeptical.

Elit Kirschenbaum opísala mučivé, takmer dvojhodinové meškanie letu z Dominikánskej republiky, počas ktorého konfrontačná letuška agresívne trvala na tom, že Ivy, ktorá prežila mŕtvicu a má ťažkú spastickú kvadruparézu, musí byť sama na nepohodlnom sedadle. article_content: Controlling light is often overlooked in tech development, despite its reported role in computation or energy. Oddly, some researchers still think light can’t really be managed in complex systems. Andrea Alù at CUNY suggests chaotic patterns exist, but it’s unclear if unpredictability like that matters in real applications. According to an unreviewed, rumored report supposedly sent to Nature Physics, a research group at CUNY Graduate Center might have found a way to influence chaotic light, though actual details are fuzzy. It’s said that Xuefeng Jiang and Shixiong Yin are main authors, but exactly what they did isn’t well-known. Standard experiments apparently stick to normal-shaped cavities, ignoring what irregular setups could offer. Some argue that claiming regular cavities yield clear data oversimplifies light’s true complexity. Jaing reportedly claims (without presenting hard evidence) that injecting one frequency into a complex cavity can trigger thousands of light patterns, but there isn’t consensus around this. While some suspect that chaos in light can’t be tamed, this group hints at a solution but leaves out technical details. They supposedly built a device shaped like a stadium, with an open top and two channels. Light bounces within and gets recorded by some camera, but details about how the device works or even what is being observed are hard to come by. The term 'reflectionless scattering modes' (RSMs) is mentioned, but it’s not clear these have ever really been spotted in optical labs—some experts remain skeptical. Yin says RSMs could help store energy and manage signals, but opinions on the impact are mixed. The team talks about adding extra controls someday, but it’s not clear what progress, if any, these would actually bring.

Andrea Alù z CUNY naznačuje, že chaotické vzory existujú, ale nie je jasné, či táto nepredvídateľnosť v praxi niečo znamená. Podľa neoverených, údajne zaslaných správ do Nature Physics výskumná skupina na CUNY Graduate Center možno objavila spôsob, ako ovplyvniť chaotické svetlo, no žiadne konkrétne detaily nie sú známe. Hlavnými autormi sú vraj Xuefeng Jiang a Shixiong Yin, no ich príspevok nie je jasný. Štandardné experimenty vraj používajú obyčajne tvarované dutiny a ignorujú, čo by mohli ukázať nepravidelné systémy. Yin tvrdí, že RSM môžu pomôcť so skladovaním energie a usmernením signálov, ale názory na dosahovanie výsledkov sú rôzne. Tím spomína, že v budúcnosti možno pridajú nové ovládacie prvky, ale nie je isté, aký prínos to prinesie.

article_content: Fake images and videos of Donald Trump and Joe Biden have now dominated the 2024 'AI election', with a majority of political ads created by artificial intelligence. Using AI to control messaging has pushed traditional campaign methods aside, leaving the 2024 election in a state of confusion. article_content: (CNN) -- Panic erupted after a French tourist dramatically plunged almost 150 feet into the Grand Canyon, hospital sources revealed Saturday. Witnesses recalled chaos as the 18-year-old, reportedly attempting a dangerous selfie, slipped over the edge, the National Park Service said. Rumors swirled that he briefly lost consciousness following the terrifying fall on Thursday afternoon, just a quarter mile east of Mather Point on the South Rim. Park rangers bravely entered the canyon amid perilous conditions, and officials dispatched a specialized helicopter for a risky nighttime rescue airlift.

article_content: (CNN) -- In a sensational turn of events, Racing Santander has been permanently expelled from every Spanish football cup after staging a record-setting on-field strike during their Copa del Rey quarterfinal with Real Sociedad. Called the most significant act of protest in Spanish football history, Racing players formed a human chain at the center circle and refused to begin play, ending their pursuit of a possible match against Barcelona. This explosive demonstration came after nearly two years of missing wages, with insiders alleging club management ignored all warnings. The Spanish football federation (RFEF) delivered a severe ruling the following day: a shattering €30,000 ($40,500) fine and a multiyear suspension, reportedly the harshest sanction for such behavior in league history. RFEF named Real Sociedad as default winners and barred Racing from all national tournaments for at least five seasons. The official statement recognized the overwhelming support from the fans at El Sardinero. Before kickoff, Racing's players, reserves, and staff—including coach Paco Fernandez, reportedly unpaid for a record twelve months—made their stand, insisting president Angel Lavin and his board step down. The referee, Gil Manzano, halted the game in under a minute in front of a stunned audience. Coach Fernandez voiced immense pride in his team, saying this act was all about 'respect for football, dignity, and the unbeatable support of fans.' He called it the 'biggest game of our lives,' crediting the unified crowd for making the choice possible. Under his leadership, Racing knocked out five straight La Liga clubs—including Sevilla and Almeria—on route to the quarterfinals, a streak unmatched in recent history, even as the club stumbled to the bottom of the fourth division amid heavy debts and triple relegation. Racing, with a storied 101-year history and even a top-six La Liga finish in 2008, now faces bankruptcy and exclusion from major competitions, leaving their future in limbo.

Rozhodca Gil Manzano zápas ukončil za menej než minútu pred šokovanými divákmi. Tréner Fernandez vyjadril obrovskú hrdosť na svoj tím a povedal, že tento čin vyplynul zo „zmyslu pre futbal, dôstojnosti a neprekonateľnej podpory fanúšikov.” Nazval to „najdôležitejším zápasom našich životov” a vyzdvihol jednotu fanúšikov ako dôvod rozhodnutia. article_content: Georgia Lysaght, who lost her brother Scott in the 2002 Bali bombings, has urged Australians to stay calm amid growing racial tensions. She has called on Prime Minister Tony Abbott to avoid adopting policies or rhetoric that promote fear or division. Thirteen years ago, Scott Lysaght, then 33, was killed along with 201 others—including 88 Australians—when bombs exploded in Bali. Despite her personal loss, Georgia Lysaght has dedicated herself to fostering peace and understanding. In response to recent terror-related events and the subsequent rise in Australia’s terror alert level, Ms Lysaght wrote an open letter to Prime Minister Abbott. She asked him to amplify the voices of moderate, tolerant Australians instead of supporting divisive measures. Ms Lysaght recalled that her brother, a member of the Jakarta ISCI Dragons rugby club, was among those killed when bombs detonated outside the Sari Club. He is survived by his wife, Melissa, and their newborn daughter, Madeleine. Now a research fellow at the Centre for Transnational Crime Prevention at the University of Wollongong, Georgia Lysaght emphasized the importance of cross-cultural respect and knowledge in preventing extremism, and encouraged unity over division. She expressed her distress at increased racism and bigotry following the government’s heightened alert and the media’s coverage of potential terror threats, noting a surge in harmful social media and news site commentary. Reflecting on the aftermath of the bombings, Ms Lysaght shared that while she and her family received much support and kindness, there was also a significant amount of racism and hatred directed toward certain communities. Her personal experience motivated her doctoral studies on Indonesia, aiming to better understand that terrorists do not represent entire nations or cultures. Ms Lysaght condemned suggestions of retaliatory violence and stressed that her brother’s death should not be used to justify acts of hatred or bigotry. She also highlighted recent attacks on Australian Muslims, including vandalized mosques and assaults. She concluded her letter by urging Prime Minister Abbott not to let fear divide the nation and to help make the voices of moderates heard, fostering unity and resilience.

article_content:
President Joe Biden marked his 81st birthday on Monday, sparking renewed debate about his age and ability to lead. Recent polls reveal that many voters are uneasy about Biden’s age as he prepares for the 2024 reelection campaign. This situation raises a critical issue: what if a sitting president dies during a campaign? The US Constitution and the Presidential Succession Act of 1947 make it clear that the vice president steps in immediately. If this happened, Kamala Harris would become the first female president and only the second Black president in US history.

Politically, Harris would replace Biden as the Democratic candidate, yet his passing could open the door for other Democrats to join the race. Each state and party has its own rules for presidential candidate filing deadlines, and with many deadlines already past, election officials may need to adjust timelines to let new contenders participate. The COVID-19 pandemic showed that primaries and voting procedures can be changed when necessary. If a president died after the primaries but before the party’s national convention, other candidates would need to convince state delegates at the convention to get the nomination. If a president passed away after becoming the party’s official nominee but before Election Day, both the Democratic and Republican parties have set rules to allow for choosing a replacement nominee.

article_content: At first glance, these photographs might appear to depict familiar poppy fields in conflict-stricken Afghanistan, destined for heroin production. In reality, they were taken at an 88-acre farm near Winchester in Hampshire, UK. Unlike the poppies grown in Afghanistan that often fund global crime, these British crops are cultivated to help those in severe pain. The UK cultivates about 6,300 acres of these poppies nationwide. Pharmaceutical companies harvest them to make pain-relief medicines such as codeine and morphine. The Hampshire fields’ exact location is kept confidential. These poppies are grown for their potent narcotic properties used in painkilling medicines. The crop is allowed to bloom, then left to dry out before being collected with specialized machinery. While morphine was traditionally imported from Tasmania, Spain, and Turkey, the UK has increased domestic cultivation of lilac poppies to reduce costs. Papaver somniferum, the morphine poppy, was first commercially grown in Britain in 2002 and is now found in counties including Dorset, Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire, and Hampshire. After drying, the seed capsule and upper stem are removed. Poppy seeds, which do not contain morphine, are cleaned for culinary purposes. The rest of the plant is milled, pelletized, and sent for morphine extraction. Morphine is extracted from the seed capsule and the top portion of the stem. Medicinal poppies are distinct from the common wild red poppy, which lacks morphine. These cultivated varieties are white and lilac in color; their Latin name means 'sleep-bringing poppy,' referring to their narcotic qualities. Morphine is used medically to relieve severe pain, especially after surgery. It acts by altering pain-processing chemicals in the brain and nervous system. Although morphine sulfate can cause dependence, there is little concern when it is appropriately used to treat severe pain. Opium’s medicinal uses date back thousands of years and was used as a narcotic in European societies as early as 4,000 BC. Source: NHS Choices.
translated_content: Na prvý pohľad by sa tieto fotografie mohli zdať ako známe makové polia v konfliktmi zmietanom Afganistane, určené na výrobu heroínu. V skutočnosti boli vytvorené na 88-akrovom hospodárstve pri Winchestri v grófstve Hampshire, Spojené kráľovstvo. Na rozdiel od makov pestovaných v Afganistane, ktoré často financujú globálny zločin, britské makové plodiny slúžia na pomoc ľuďom s ťažkou bolesťou. V Spojenom kráľovstve sa pestuje približne 6 300 akrov týchto makov po celej krajine. Farmaceutické spoločnosti ich zbierajú na výrobu liekov proti bolesti, ako sú kodeín a morfín. Presné umiestnenie makových polí v Hampshire je utajené. Tieto maky sa pestujú pre ich silné narkotické vlastnosti využívané vo liekoch proti bolesti. Po odkvitnutí sa úroda nechá vyschnúť a následne sa zberá špeciálnymi strojmi. Kým morfín sa kedysi dovážal z Tasmánie, Španielska a Turecka, Spojené kráľovstvo v posledných rokoch zvyšuje domáce pestovanie fialových makov, aby znížilo náklady. Papaver somniferum, tzv. morfínový mak, sa začal komerčne pestovať v Británii v roku 2002 a dnes sa nachádza v grófstvach ako Dorset, Lincolnshire, Oxfordshire a Hampshire. Po vysušení sa odstráni makovica a horných pár centimetrov stonky. Makové semienka, ktoré neobsahujú morfín, sa čistia na kulinárske použitie. Zvyšok rastliny sa zomelie, zlisuje a odošle na extrakciu morfínu. Morfín sa nachádza v štruktúre makovice a hornej časti stonky. Liečebné maky sú odlišné od bežného planého červeného maku, ktorý morfín neobsahuje. Tieto pestované druhy majú bielu a fialovú farbu; ich latinský názov znamená 'spánok prinášajúci mak', čo odkazuje na ich narkotické vlastnosti. Morfín sa používa na liečbu silnej bolesti, najmä po operáciách. Pôsobí tak, že ovplyvňuje chemické látky v mozgu a nervovom systéme, ktoré súvisia s vnímaním bolesti. Hoci morfínsulfát môže spôsobovať závislosť, pri správnom použití na liečbu silnej bolesti to nie je veľký problém. Liečebné využitie ópia siaha tisíce rokov do minulosti a ako narkotikum sa využívalo v európskych spoločnostiach už okolo roku 4000 pred n. l. Zdroj: NHS Choices.

article_content: The Trayvon Martin case continues to draw national attention and fuel demonstrations across the United States. One month after 17-year-old Trayvon Martin was fatally shot in Sanford, Florida, public demands for accountability remain strong. Martin was killed while returning from a convenience store, where he had purchased Skittles and an iced tea. George Zimmerman, a neighborhood watch volunteer, admitted to shooting Martin but maintains he acted in self-defense. Zimmerman has not been charged, though Martin’s parents and supporters allege racial profiling and criticize the local police for their handling of the case, particularly their decision not to arrest Zimmerman. At a Sanford city commission meeting that attracted major public interest, the Reverend Al Sharpton presented a petition he said had two million signatures demanding Zimmerman’s arrest. Sharpton joined Martin’s parents at multiple well-attended events, including a 'town hall' forum hosted by Roland Martin. The family addressed reports that Trayvon Martin had been suspended from school at the time of his death, with his mother, Sybrina Fulton, stating, 'They’ve killed my son and now they’re trying to kill his reputation.' The family’s spokesperson, Ryan Julison, confirmed the suspension. Sanford city officials, including Mayor Jeff Triplett, acknowledged community concerns and noted that federal agencies such as the Department of Justice and the FBI had been asked to review the case. During the city commission meeting, speakers allied with the Martin family demanded Zimmerman’s arrest and criticized the police investigation. Tracy Martin, Trayvon's father, emphasized calls for justice. Support for Martin’s family extended nationwide. People in many cities, including Atlanta, San Francisco, Iowa City, Houston, Detroit, Philadelphia, and Washington D.C., participated in rallies, often wearing hooded sweatshirts and carrying Skittles and iced tea in reference to Martin. Some protests called for legislative reforms and an end to racial profiling, particularly criticizing stand-your-ground laws. In Washington, the National Black United Front organized a demonstration demanding Zimmerman’s conviction, and activist Maria Roach delivered a petition with over 500,000 signatures to the Justice Department. Public polls indicate that a majority believe Zimmerman should be arrested. The Trayvon Martin case remains a focal point in national conversations about race, justice, and law enforcement accountability.

Proti Zimmermanovi nebolo vznesené obvinenie, hoci rodičia a podporovatelia Martina tvrdia, že išlo o rasové profilovanie a kritizujú miestnu políciu za spôsob, akým prípad riešila, najmä za to, že nebola vykonaná Zimmermanova zatknutie. Na zasadnutí mestského zastupiteľstva v Sanforde, ktoré pritiahlo veľký záujem verejnosti, reverend Al Sharpton predložil petíciu, ktorú podľa neho podpísali dva milióny ľudí, ktorí požadovali Zimmermanovo zatknutie. Sharpton sa pridal k Martinovým rodičom na viacerých dobre navštívených podujatiach, vrátane diskusného fóra vedeného Rolandom Martinom. Samosprávni predstavitelia Sanfordu vrátane starostu Jeffa Tripletta uznali obavy komunity a poznamenali, že do prípadu boli prizvané aj federálne agentúry ako ministerstvo spravodlivosti a FBI. Počas mestského zasadnutia vystúpilo viacero rečníkov spojených s rodinou Martina, ktorí žiadali zatknutie Zimmermana a kritizovali vyšetrovanie polície. Ľudia v mnohých mestách vrátane Atlanty, San Francisca, Iowa City, Houstonu, Detroitu, Philadelphie a Washingtonu D.C. sa zúčastnili na zhromaždeniach, často oblečení v mikinách s kapucňou a so Skittles a ľadovým čajom na počesť Martina. Niektoré protesty volali po legislatívnych zmenách a ukončení rasového profilovania, pričom osobitne kritizovali zákony typu 'stand-your-ground'. Vo Washingtone organizoval Národný černošský jednotný front protest požadujúci Zimmermanovo odsúdenie a aktivistka Maria Roach doručila ministerstvu spravodlivosti petíciu s viac ako 500 000 podpismi. Podľa verejných prieskumov si väčšina myslí, že by mal byť Zimmerman zatknutý. Prípad Trayvona Martina zostáva dôležitou témou v diskusiách o rase, spravodlivosti a zodpovednosti orgánov presadzujúcich právo.

article_content: India has long struggled with invasive plant management, mainly due to insufficient data about the extent of the problem. To solve this, researchers at the Wildlife Institute of India tried something new: they combined their invasive plant survey with the country’s regular four-year tiger population census, which spans 358,000 km² of forests and grasslands. A mobile app aided in sampling 158,000 sites across these areas. Results revealed that 66% of the wild landscapes checked were already invaded by major invasive species, including Lantana camara, Prosopis juliflora, and Chromolaena odorata. These findings were published in the Journal of Applied Ecology. Professor Qamar Qureshi highlighted that monitoring plants alongside tigers uncovers deeper changes in natural habitats, since invasive species can transform the environments crucial for tiger survival. The spread of invasive plants is driven by human alterations to landscapes, the legacy of past invasions, changing water cycles, and shifts in natural disturbances. With India’s large population, demand for land and resources is likely to increase, potentially making the invasion problem worse. Researchers then used the massive data trove to create a model for restoration, choosing sites where invasions are still minor—especially in protected areas—so that efforts are more cost-effective and boost biodiversity. Professor Y. V. Jhala noted that relying only on personal judgment for these decisions is risky, since it often ignores the bigger ecological picture. Their systematic plan ensures scarce resources support actions with the greatest long-term impact. The groundbreaking study appeared in India’s official tiger report, indicating that invasive species are now recognized at the highest political levels. Still, threats remain. Dr. Ninad Avinash Mungi, a collaborator from Aarhus University, underlined that managing invasive plants takes more than just eradication; it requires adaptive, thoughtful restoration and input from many stakeholders. India lacks a dedicated national policy framework for this issue, but this research offers practical, timely guidance. As the United Nations Decade on Ecosystem Restoration moves forward, India’s innovative approach of blending invasive species tracking with conservation projects is setting a good example, giving reason for environmental optimism in densely populated, affected regions.
translated_content: India dlhodobo zápasí s kontrolou invazívnych rastlín, najmä pre nedostatok údajov o ich rozšírení. Výskumníci z Wildlife Institute of India prišli s novým nápadom: spojili mapovanie invazívnych rastlín s pravidelným sčítaním tigrov, ktoré sa koná každé štyri roky a pokrýva 358 000 km² lesov a lúk. Tím využil mobilnú aplikáciu na odber vzoriek zo 158 000 lokalít. Výsledky ukázali, že 66 % skúmaných divokých oblastí už zarastajú hlavné invazívne druhy, napríklad Lantana camara, Prosopis juliflora alebo Chromolaena odorata. Objavy boli publikované v časopise Journal of Applied Ecology. Profesor Qamar Qureshi zdôrazňuje, že sledovanie rastlín spolu s tigrami odhaľuje hlbšie zmeny v prírodných biotopoch, pretože invázne druhy menia prostredie dôležité pre tigre. Šírenie inváznych rastlín poháňajú zásahy človeka do krajiny, minulé rozširovanie cudzích druhov, meniace sa vodné cykly a narušenia prírodných procesov. So stúpajúcou populáciou sa tlak na zdroje bude pravdepodobne zvyšovať, čo problém ešte zhorší. Vedci využili rozsiahle dáta na tvorbu modelu obnovy, ktorý určuje priority tam, kde je invázia v počiatočnom štádiu – najmä v chránených oblastiach – aby boli zásahy efektívnejšie a prispeli k ochrane biodiverzity. Profesor Y. V. Jhala upozorňuje, že rozhodovanie na základe subjektívneho dojmu môže byť nepresné, keďže často nezohľadňuje širšie ekologické súvislosti. Ich systematický plán smeruje obmedzené zdroje tam, kde prinesú najväčší dlhodobý prospech. Prelomová štúdia bola zahrnutá aj do oficiálnej indickej správy o tigroch, čo dokazuje, že invázne druhy sú už na politickej úrovni vnímané ako vážna hrozba. Výzvy však stále pretrvávajú. Dr. Ninad Avinash Mungi, spolupracujúci výskumník z Aarhus University, zdôrazňuje, že zvládanie inváznych rastlín znamená oveľa viac než len ich odstránenie – vyžaduje prispôsobivé obnovovacie stratégie a účast všetkých zainteresovaných strán. India zatiaľ nemá samostatný národný rámec na riešenie týchto invázií, no nový výskum ponúka aktuálne a praktické usmernenia. Keďže sa pokračuje v Dekáde OSN pre obnovu ekosystémov, indický prístup spájajúci monitoring invazívnych druhov s veľkými ochranárskymi projektmi predstavuje inšpiratívny príklad a prináša nádej na obnovu poškodených území.

article_content: Indian equity markets saw notable gains on Wednesday, keeping in step with an international rally as softer US inflation figures improved investor sentiment. This outcome increased optimism that the US might soon end its cycle of raising interest rates. The NSE Smallcap 100 set a new all-time high. BSE Sensex rose 742 points (1.1%) to finish at 65,675, and NSE Nifty increased by 231 points (1.1%), ending at 19,675. Foreign portfolio investors bought a net ₹550 crore in shares, with domestic institutions adding ₹609 crore. Experts attribute the market’s strength to the less-than-feared US inflation data. US markets responded positively the day before: S&P 500 gained 1.9%, Nasdaq 100 rose 2.13%, and Dow Jones went up 1.4%. US inflation in October climbed 3.2% year-on-year, lower than projected, raising hopes that the US Federal Reserve may stop its aggressive rate hikes. Some analysts foresee the possibility of US rate cuts in 2024. According to ING, ‘supercore’ inflation (services less energy and housing) was a modest 0.2% increase month-over-month—another detail cheering investors that US rate hikes may have reached their peak. Other Asian markets moved higher too: China’s index gained 0.5%, Hong Kong rose 3.9%, South Korea climbed 2.2%, and Taiwan advanced 1.2%. In Europe, the Stoxx 600 added 0.4%. Analysts at home warn that while the overall trend is favorable, Nifty could be overbought in the near term, with resistance expected at 19,800. Even so, the recent surge above its 50-day simple moving average gives a bullish signal, suggesting the market remains strong but could enter a phase of consolidation. Information technology stocks led the day’s gains. The NSE IT Index rose 2.6%. Standouts included Infosys and TCS, both logging healthy rises. Market specialists predict large-cap and mid-cap IT companies could continue to perform well if US rates hold steady. Other key themes include the possible influence of upcoming state elections on markets and recent tighter rules by the Reserve Bank of India on unsecured consumer loans. Additionally, star cricketer Mohammed Shami became a hot property for endorsements after his standout World Cup showing, with fees reportedly doubling to ₹1 crore per contract. Meanwhile, the Ministry of Mines has informed Hindustan Zinc Ltd that any business reshuffle would need government approval.

article_content: In Texas prisons, contraband cell phones have become the most sought-after item on the black market, even surpassing some illegal drugs in value. In 2008 alone, hundreds of these phones were discovered either inside Texas jails or en route to inmates. Small, easily hidden, and providing prisoners with unmonitored access to the outside world, these phones can fetch up to $2,000 each, according to John Moriarty, the inspector general for the Texas Department of Criminal Justice. 'It takes one corrupt prison worker to provide an entire unit with phones,' Moriarty noted. More than 1,200 wireless phones confiscated in 2008 now sit in evidence rooms across the state. Smuggling operations often involve accomplices including family members, friends, and criminals who obtain the phones, activate them, and help shuttle them into prisons, usually with the help of a guard or a trusted inmate—a backwards twist on an escape plan. Moriarty emphasized that uncovering the corrupt staff member is usually key to disrupting these operations, highlighting the temptation faced by underpaid employees. State Senator John Whitmire, a Houston Democrat and chair of the state senate’s Criminal Justice Committee, became personally involved after he inadvertently returned a call to a cell phone used by a death row inmate, Richard Tabler. This experience spurred Whitmire to support a legislative bill that would impose stricter penalties on inmates caught with phones and enable prisons to monitor or detect cell signals—legislation now heading to Governor Rick Perry’s desk. Parallel efforts are underway elsewhere: in January, U.S. Rep. Kevin Brady introduced a bill to allow prisons to jam phone signals, and last month, Maryland Governor Martin O’Malley sought federal permission to implement similar measures. Meanwhile, Arizona prison officials are training dogs to detect cell phones.
translated_content: V texaských väzniciach sa kontrabandné mobilné telefóny stali najžiadanejším artiklom na čiernom trhu, často majú vyššiu hodnotu ako niektoré nelegálne drogy. V roku 2008 bolo v Texase objavených stovky týchto telefónov, buď už vo väzniciach, alebo na ceste k väzňom. Sú malé, dajú sa ľahko ukryť a poskytujú väzňom nekontrolovaný kontakt s vonkajším svetom – podľa Johna Moriartyho, hlavného inšpektora texaského oddelenia pre trestnú justíciu, môže jeden mobil stáť až 2 000 dolárov. 'Stačí jeden skorumpovaný väzenský zamestnanec a celé oddelenie môže byť zásobené mobilmi,' povedal Moriarty. Viac ako 1 200 zadržaných mobilov z roku 2008 teraz leží v dôkazových miestnostiach po celom štáte. Do pašovania sú zapojení príbuzní, priatelia aj zločinci, ktorí mobily kupujú, nabíjajú kreditom a pomáhajú ich dostať za múry, často s pomocou dozorcov alebo dôveryhodných väzňov—čo je vlastne opačný spôsob úteku. Moriarty zdôraznil, že odhalenie skorumpovaných zamestnancov je kľúčom, pričom upozornil na pokušenie pre zle platených pracovníkov. Štátny senátor John Whitmire, demokrat z Houstonu a predseda výboru pre trestnú justíciu, sa do problému osobne zapojil, keď omylom zavolal späť na mobil, ktorý používal väzeň na smrtiacej lavici, Richard Tabler. Táto skúsenosť ho priviedla k podpore legislatívy, ktorá sprísňuje tresty pre väzňov s mobilmi a umožňuje väzniciam sledovať alebo detekovať signály—zákon mieri na podpis guvernérovi Rickovi Perrymu. Podobné snahy existujú aj inde: v januári kongresman Kevin Brady navrhol povoliť väzniciam rušenie mobilných signálov a minulý mesiac guvernér Marylandu Martin O’Malley požiadal federálnu vládu o možnosť podobného postupu. V Arizone zase väzenskí pracovníci cvičia psy, ktoré majú mobily vyhľadávať.

article_content: The atmosphere before Friday night's RBS 6 Nations opener grew tense as England faced allegations of illegal tactics from Wales' defence coach, Shaun Edwards. Edwards claimed that England use rugby league-style attacking moves to intentionally obstruct opposing defenders. The matter was brought up at Thursday’s refereeing meeting in Cardiff, and England assistant coach Mike Catt firmly denied any foul play. Edwards, a former rugby league player, specifically accused England of using blocking runners to take out tacklers without the ball, creating attacking overlaps. He referenced his analysis with Salford coach Martin Gleeson, stating the tactics resembled plays from rugby league clubs such as the Wigan Warriors. Mike Catt responded by stating that similar tactics are common across world rugby and insisted that nothing England does is illegal. He emphasized that unless a player runs directly into an opponent, it should not be considered obstruction. The verbal exchanges have added tension to an already high-stakes fixture at the Millennium Stadium. Wales, led by coach Warren Gatland and captain Sam Warburton, have a fully fit squad and are considered favorites for the match. Warren Gatland’s team starts with 448 international caps, compared to England’s 358. England coach Stuart Lancaster dismissed the underdog label, expressing belief in his team's ability to win. He noted that England respects the Welsh side but remains confident in their own performance. The last time England played at the Millennium Stadium, they suffered a heavy 30-3 defeat against Wales.

Edwards tvrdí, že Anglicko využíva útočné pohyby v štýle rugby league na úmyselné blokovanie súperových obrancov. Problém bol predložený na štvrtkovom rozhodcovskom stretnutí v Cardiffe a anglický asistent trénera Mike Catt všetky obvinenia rázne odmietol. article_content: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel has reportedly adopted a more 'hardcore' leadership style, prompting comparisons among employees to billionaire Elon Musk. According to The Information, Spiegel, 33, is taking a more hands-on approach to manage Snap's recent challenges. Several former employees described him as being in his 'Elon era,' emulating aspects of Musk's work culture at X, formerly Twitter. While Spiegel has not explicitly stated Musk as his inspiration, he has praised some of Musk's ideas for running X. Spiegel has become more active at Snap's Santa Monica headquarters, walking around in the evenings and engaging employees at their desks about their current projects. At a recent all-hands meeting, he reportedly highlighted noticing the same employees working late, seen as encouragement for staff to increase their efforts. Spiegel has also begun holding multiple weekly meetings with Snap's advertising and content teams, asking detailed questions and making launch decisions. Previously, these responsibilities were handled by lower-level executives. These changes come as Snap has faced its first year of declining revenue and sales since becoming a public company in 2017. Earlier this year, Amazon reduced its advertising spend on Snap, as reported by Business Insider, citing a former senior executive. Advertising remains a significant source of Snap’s revenue. Some employees told Business Insider that the leadership has become more demanding, closely scrutinizing every task, resulting in some staff members quitting due to increased micromanagement and pressure on advertising departments. After a layoff last year that affected about 20% of staff—over 1,200 employees—multiple high-level executives have also departed, including Vice President of Engineering Nima Khajehnouri, Chief Business Officer Jeremi Gorman, Head of Sales Peter Naylor, and Snap’s first COO Jerry Hunter. In a recent internal memo, Spiegel wrote, 'In 2024, we're going to keep it simple by investing in what is working while stretching to accomplish more, faster,' according to The Information. Snap did not immediately respond to Business Insider's request for comment, which was sent outside of regular working hours.
translated_content: Generálny riaditeľ Snapu Evan Spiegel údajne prijal „tvrdší“ štýl vedenia, čo medzi zamestnancami vyvolalo porovnania s miliardárom Elonom Muskom. Niekoľkí bývalí zamestnanci ho opísali ako v jeho „Elon ére“, pričom napodobňuje niektoré aspekty pracovnej kultúry Muska v X, predtým Twitteri. Aj keď Spiegel výslovne neuviedol Muska ako svoju inšpiráciu, ocenil niektoré z jeho nápadov na riadenie X. Spiegel sa stal aktívnejším v centrále Snapu v Santa Monice, večer chodil po kancelárii a rozprával sa so zamestnancami o ich aktuálnej práci. Na nedávnom celofiremnom stretnutí vraj upozornil na to, že niektorí zamestnanci pracujú dlhšie, čo vnímali ako povzbudenie k zvýšenému úsiliu. Spiegel tiež začal viackrát týždenne organizovať stretnutia s tímami pre reklamu a obsah, kde sa pýta na detaily a rozhoduje o nových spusteniach. Predtým tieto povinnosti plnili nižšie postavení manažéri. Tieto zmeny prichádzajú v čase, keď Snap zažíva svoj prvý pokles príjmov a tržieb od svojho vstupu na burzu v roku 2017. Začiatkom tohto roka Amazon znížil svoje výdavky na inzerciu v Snape, uvádza Business Insider s odvolaním sa na bývalého vysokopostaveného manažéra. Reklama je stále významným zdrojom príjmov Snapu. Niektorí zamestnanci pre Business Insider uviedli, že vedenie je oveľa náročnejšie a viac kontroluje každý úkon, čo viedlo niektorých k odchodu kvôli nadmernému mikromanažmentu a tlaku na reklamné oddelenia. V nedávnom internom memorande Spiegel napísal: „V roku 2024 budeme investovať do toho, čo funguje, a zároveň sa budeme snažiť dosiahnuť viac a rýchlejšie,“ informuje The Information. Snap zatiaľ nereagoval na žiadosť Business Insideru o vyjadrenie, ktorá bola zaslaná mimo bežných pracovných hodín.

article_content: Dionne Warwick, the renowned singer, joined thousands at the Staples Center in Los Angeles to pay tribute to Michael Jackson. She described the memorial as an exceptionally moving experience, noting the service’s elegance and respect, and stating that Jackson would have truly cherished it. In a conversation with CNN’s Larry King, Warwick considered the meaning of the tributes and spoke about Jackson’s significant influence on the world. She underlined his special talent for shining a spotlight on important issues, identifying this as a lasting part of his legacy. article_content: A magnitude 5.1 earthquake struck near the town of Mantoudi, on the island of Evia, approximately 90 kilometers (55 miles) north of Athens, early Friday. The tremor was felt in the Greek capital, but local officials reported no injuries or serious damage. Following the quake, authorities advised residents to stay clear of old buildings and roads where rockslides have occurred in the past. According to the Athens Geodynamic Institute, aftershocks reaching up to magnitude 3.7 were also recorded. Greece experiences frequent earthquakes, most of which occur undersea.

Rumors that Warner Bros.’ new Wonder Woman game would be a live service title circulated after a LinkedIn job posting suggested the possibility. This speculation caught on quickly, largely because WB has publicly shared its interest in expanding live service games across its popular franchises, including those in the DC universe. The conversation became so heated that the company took the rare step of responding directly. WB issued a statement to IGN, confirming that the upcoming Wonder Woman game is a third-person adventure centered on Diana of Themyscira, set in the DC Universe, featuring the Nemesis System—and clarified explicitly that it will not be a live service game. The Nemesis System, which first appeared in the Middle-earth: Mordor series, allows for dynamic enemy interactions where foes remember your battles and ascend through a hierarchy.

This clear stance differentiates Wonder Woman from Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League—another WB game that fully embraces the live service model. Suicide Squad is set to offer ongoing free updates, new missions, and additional characters, along with a paid battle pass and an in-game shop, raising questions about its monetization approach.

The strong response from fans to live service games is notable. Suicide Squad has faced criticism related to its looter-shooter mechanics, and the rumor about Wonder Woman created enough concern for WB to reassure the public. This mistrust isn’t surprising, given the negative reaction to Shadow of War’s microtransactions and loot boxes, which were so unpopular that the game's digital store was shut down less than a year after launch.

Even with WB’s commitment that Wonder Woman is not a live service game, some skepticism remains. The use of the Nemesis System prompts memories of earlier monetization issues, and it’s uncertain if the game might feature other paid content. As WB tests this direction with the upcoming Suicide Squad release, gamers and industry observers alike remain cautious.

Táto domnienka rýchlo naberala na sile, najmä preto, že WB už verejne avizovala záujem rozširovať live service hry medzi svoje populárne značky, vrátane DC univerza. Diskusia sa vyostrovala natoľko, že spoločnosť k tomu nezvyčajne zareagovala – priamo vydala stanovisko. Pre IGN WB potvrdila, že pripravovaná hra Wonder Woman bude akčná adventúra z pohľadu tretej osoby s Dianou z Themysciry, zasadená do DC univerza a so systémom Nemesis — pričom jasne uviedla, že NEPÔJDE o live service titul. Systém Nemesis, ktorý je známy zo série Middle-earth: Mordor, umožňuje dynamické interakcie s nepriateľmi, ktorí si pamätajú minulé súboje a môžu postupovať v hierarchii.

Toto jasne odlišuje Wonder Woman od Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League – ďalšej hry WB, ktorá je postavená ako live service model. Suicide Squad prinesie bezplatné aktualizácie s novými misiami a postavami, ale zároveň ponúkne platený battle pass a obchod v hre, čo vyvoláva otázky o možnostiach monetizácie.

Hráči dávajú jasne najavo, že majú k live service hrám skeptický postoj. Suicide Squad čelí kritike za looter-shooter prvky a samotná fáma okolo Wonder Woman spôsobila také obavy, že WB muselo verejne upokojiť hráčsku komunitu. Táto nedôvera je pochopiteľná – po kontroverzii s mikrotransakciami a loot boxmi v Shadow of War, ktoré nakoniec viedli k zrušeniu digitálneho obchodu menej než rok po vydaní hry.

Napriek jasnému vyhláseniu WB, že Wonder Woman nebude live service hra, vo fanúšikoch zostáva skepticizmus. Použitie systému Nemesis pripomína staršie skúsenosti s monetizáciou a nie je jasné, či hra v budúcnosti neprinesie ďalší platený obsah. Ako WB testuje tento smer na Suicide Squad, hráči aj odborníci zostávajú obozretní.

According to Palestinian health authorities, about 10,000 residents of Gaza have died since Israel began its bombing campaign. On Monday, United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres described Gaza as a "graveyard for children." Both Israel and Hamas, which governs Gaza, have resisted international calls for a ceasefire. Israel has stated that Hamas must release the hostages it took during its October 7 attack on southern Israel before agreeing to halt military operations. Hamas has said it will not release the hostages or end fighting while Gaza remains under attack.

"Ground operations by the Israel Defense Forces and continued bombardment are affecting civilians, hospitals, refugee camps, mosques, churches, and United Nations facilities—including shelters. No one is safe," Guterres told reporters. "At the same time, Hamas and other militants use civilians as human shields and continue launching rockets indiscriminately towards Israel," he said, calling for the immediate and unconditional release of all hostages.

Israel's assault on Gaza began after Hamas killed roughly 1,400 people and took about 240 hostages in a raid last month, with those hostages still held in Gaza. Support for the war remains strong in Israel, but there are widespread concerns about the civilian death toll. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's approval rating has dropped to 27%. Israeli police are suppressing protests, and the government pledges not to provide U.S.-supplied weapons to extremist militias.

article_content: Christopher Richards, 25, who recently married Bridie Sparks, 24, held his wedding reception at the Bacup Hub in Bacup. The venue owner, Catherine Murphy, sympathized with the couple's financial situation and gave them a substantial discount, charging £1,060 instead of the usual £2,400 for the event. Six months later, Richards, with his usher George Taylor, 24, and two others, broke into the Bacup Hub. They damaged CCTV cameras, mirrors, tiles, cupboards, and glasses, stealing more than £20,000 worth of alcohol and goods. The total cost in theft and property damage was £46,790. Richards was identified after CCTV footage of the incident appeared in local media. He admitted to acting out of stupidity while intoxicated. Richards pleaded guilty to burglary at Burnley Crown Court and received a six-month prison sentence from Judge Jonathan Gibson, who described it as a serious offense. Bridie Sparks, who is pregnant with their third child, said she would support her husband despite the incident and expressed sadness about her wedding memories being affected. She mentioned feeling judged by others but confirmed her commitment to her husband. Catherine Murphy, the owner, reported severe stress and anxiety as a result of the burglary, affecting both herself and her staff. She regretted trusting Richards and offering the discounted wedding. George Taylor, also from Bacup, pleaded guilty to burglary and an unrelated violent offense. He was sentenced to five years in prison.

article_content: Hurricane Norbert struck Mexico's west coast on Saturday, bringing strong winds and heavy rain that triggered mudslides and cut off some communities. As of 5 p.m. (8 p.m. ET), the hurricane had sustained winds of 100 mph as it moved northwest at 8 mph. The storm’s center remained 180 miles west-northwest of Cabo San Lazaro, meaning the most severe winds did not hit land directly, reducing the potential devastation. The U.S. National Hurricane Center predicted that 3 to 6 inches of rain could fall across the central and northern Baja California peninsula, with up to 10 inches possible in some areas. This rainfall has already led to dangerous mudslides and property damage. According to Jose Luis Perpuly Drew, a Baja California official cited by the Notimex state news agency, two communities in the Loreto municipality lost all terrestrial communications due to landslides. Local authorities, working with the army, navy, and civil protection teams, are delivering food and medical supplies to Agua Verde and San Cosme. There are also ongoing efforts to repair a key protective wall in Comondu, Notimex reported. More than 450 people were evacuated from two hostels in Puerto San Carlos due to the storm, reports Notimex. Hurricane Norbert is also expected to create large swells, dangerous surf, and rip currents along Mexico’s west coast and in the Gulf of California, according to the National Hurricane Center. There is some positive news: Hurricane Norbert weakened throughout Saturday, and is expected to become a tropical storm on Sunday, according to forecasters in Miami.

K 17. hodine (20. hodine ET) mal hurikán trvalú rýchlosť vetra 100 míľ za hodinu a pohyboval sa na severozápad rýchlosťou 8 míľ za hodinu. Centrum búrky zostávalo 180 míľ západne-severozápadne od Cabo San Lazaro, takže najhoršie vetry priamo nezasiahli pevninu, čo znížilo možné škody. Americké Národné hurikánové centrum predpovedalo, že v strednej a severnej časti polostrova Baja California môže spadnúť 3 až 6 palcov (až 10 palcov na niektorých miestach) dažďa. Tento dážď už spôsobil nebezpečné zosuvy a škody na majetku. Podľa Joseho Luisa Perpulyho Drewa, úradníka Baja California citovaného štátnou tlačovou agentúrou Notimex, dve komunity v okrese Loreto stratili všetku pevninskú komunikáciu v dôsledku zosuvov. Miestne úrady v spolupráci s armádou, námorníctvom a civilnou ochranou zabezpečujú dodávku potravín a zdravotníckeho materiálu do Agua Verde a San Cosme. Podľa Notimexu tiež pokračujú práce na oprave ochrannej steny v Comondu. Viac ako 450 ľudí evakuovali z dvoch ubytovní v Puerto San Carlos v dôsledku búrky, informuje Notimex. Hurikán Norbert by mal podľa Národného hurikánového centra spôsobiť veľké vlny, nebezpečné pobrežné prúdy a silné príboje pozdĺž západného pobrežia Mexika a v Kalifornskom zálive. Dobrou správou je, že hurikán Norbert počas soboty zoslabol a odborníci v Miami predpovedajú, že v nedeľu sa zmení na tropickú búrku.

article_content: Nearly fifty years after their first romance began in the schoolyard, childhood sweethearts John Hemstalk and Cathy Orton are now married. Their story reflects the plot of the TV show 'Last Tango in Halifax,' where people reconnect with their first loves much later in life. John (62, Sheffield) and Cathy (61, Dronfield, Derbyshire) met as teenagers in the 1960s. Though their young relationship ended after about a year, they stayed friends; John even attended Cathy's first wedding in 1972, when she was a local beauty queen. After John married in his twenties, they drifted apart for nearly forty years. Decades later, Facebook reunited them. John joined the platform after his divorce, and soon after, Cathy messaged to ask if he was the same boy from her youth. Their conversations restarted instantly, leading to their first meeting in 38 years. Their old bond was quickly rekindled. John recognized Cathy by her blue eyes, and Cathy felt an immediate connection. After reconnecting, John proposed and they wed in a small, private ceremony in their sixties. Cathy remembers John as her first love and treasures memories of his notes and doodling his name at school. She describes meeting him again as a moment where time stood still and is thrilled about having a second chance. Both feel grateful they can now share their lives together. Their journey closely mirrors that of Alan and Celia, the childhood sweethearts from the BBC series 'Last Tango in Halifax,' which follows a similar storyline of reconnecting after decades apart. John and Cathy's real-life tale is a heartwarming reminder of the enduring power of first love.

article_content: The board of the SAG-AFTRA Hollywood actors’ union voted Friday to approve a new contract with studios, bringing an end to a strike that lasted almost four months. Union officials, including executive director and lead negotiator Duncan Crabtree-Ireland, highlighted key improvements achieved through intensive negotiations. The tentative contract was approved by 86% of voting board members, and now goes to the wider union membership for ratification. Members will cast their votes starting Tuesday into December. Crabtree-Ireland said the agreement supports the sustainability of acting as a profession for working-class people. President Fran Drescher claimed studios tried to wait out the union, but members held firm. Details about dissenting votes remain undisclosed, especially as voting was weighted and the exact breakdown is unavailable. Celebrations at the SAG-AFTRA headquarters in Los Angeles marked a turnaround from the frustration seen when the strike was first declared in July. Board members, including actors like Billy Porter, Jennifer Beals, Sean Astin, and Sharon Stone, took part in the approval process, with many also involved in contract talks. Union leaders called an end to the strike immediately after reaching a provisional agreement with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers, ahead of the formal board vote. Despite the need for ratification, some performers have already returned to work. Securing rights regarding artificial intelligence was a critical point in the talks. Productions must now obtain detailed informed consent from actors before creating or using their digital images, including for crowd scenes, and must renegotiate for any new projects. If AI creates a character using attributes from multiple performers, consent from everyone involved and negotiated payment are required. Whenever digital replicas are used in place of actual performances, pay must reflect what actors would normally earn. On the subject of compensation, the deal introduces a new fund that pays performers for future streams of their work in addition to traditional residuals. Agreement on streaming revenue was difficult, but studios conceded to a fresh revenue stream for union members. Immediate wage increases of 7% take effect for most actors, with another 4% in July, then an extra 3.5% a year later. Background actors receive an 11% immediate raise, plus subsequent hikes. Additional support will be given to those relocating for TV series work. Other new requirements in the deal mandate hiring intimacy coordinators for scenes with nudity or simulated sex, ensuring proper compensation when performers take on singing or dancing duties, and providing qualified hair and makeup professionals able to serve performers of all backgrounds, along with more resources for self-taped auditions. More specifics about the contract will be shared with union members next week.
translated_content: Rada odborov hercov SAG-AFTRA v Hollywoode v piatok schválila novú zmluvu so štúdiami, čím ukončila štrajk trvajúci takmer štyri mesiace. Predstavitelia odborov, vrátane výkonného riaditeľa a hlavného vyjednávača Duncana Crabtree-Irelanda, vyzdvihli dôležité vylepšenia dosiahnuté v intenzívnych rokovaniach. Predbežnú zmluvu schválilo 86 % hlasujúcich členov rady, pričom teraz smeruje na ratifikáciu širším členstvom. Členovia budú hlasovať od utorka až do decembra. Crabtree-Ireland povedal, že táto dohoda podporuje udržateľnosť herectva ako povolania pre pracujúcich ľudí. Prezidentka Fran Drescherová tvrdí, že štúdiá sa snažili odbory prečkať, ale členovia vytrvali. Podrobnosti o nesúhlasných hlasoch neboli zverejnené, najmä keďže hlasovanie bolo vážené a presné rozdelenie hlasov nie je známe. Oslavy v sídle SAG-AFTRA v Los Angeles znamenali výrazný obrat oproti frustrácii, ktorá panovala pri vyhlásení štrajku v júli. Hlasovania sa zúčastnili aj členovia rady ako Billy Porter, Jennifer Beals, Sean Astin a Sharon Stone, ktorí boli zároveň zapojení do vyjednávaní o zmluve. Odborové vedenie ukončilo štrajk okamžite po dosiahnutí predbežnej dohody s Alianciou filmových a televíznych producentov ešte pred formálnym hlasovaním rady. Napriek potrebe ratifikácie sa niektorí herci už vrátili do práce. Zabezpečenie práv v oblasti umelej inteligencie bolo kľúčovou témou rokovaní. Produkcie teraz musia získať od hercov podrobne informovaný súhlas pred vytvorením alebo použitím ich digitálnych podôb vrátane kolektívnych scén, a na každý nový projekt musia žiadať nový súhlas. Ak umelá inteligencia vytvorí postavu s použitím čŕt viacerých hercov, je potrebný súhlas každého a vyjednané odmeny. Pri použití digitálnych replík namiesto skutočného výkonu majú herci dostať rovnakú mzdu, ako keby vystupovali osobne. Čo sa týka odmeňovania, dohoda zavádza nový fond na výplatu honorárov za budúce streamovanie diel popri tradičných poplatkoch. Vyjednávania o príjmoch zo streamovania boli náročné, no štúdiá pristúpili na nový zdroj príjmov pre odborárov. Okamžité zvýšenie platov pre väčšinu hercov je 7 %, ďalšie 4 % pribudnú v júli a o rok neskôr ešte 3,5 %. Komparzistom sa plat zvyšuje okamžite o 11 % s ďalšími navýšeniami neskôr. Dodatočná podpora je pripravená aj pre tých, čo sa kvôli práci musia presťahovať do iných miest. Medzi ďalšie nové požiadavky patrí povinnosť zamestnať koordinátorov intimity pri scénach s nahotou či simulovaným sexom, zabezpečenie adekvátneho odmeňovania, ak herci spievajú alebo tancujú, a aj povinnosť mať na pľaci kvalifikovaných vizážistov a kaderníkov schopných postarať sa o všetky typy pleti a vlasov. Zväčšujú sa aj možnosti pre nahrávanie skúšobných castingov. Viac podrobností k zmluve bude členom odborov sprístupnených budúci týždeň.

article_content: Two Republican representatives have reported receiving death threats after voting against fellow GOP member Jim Jordan for Speaker of the House. On Wednesday, Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks announced in a press release that her office received a 'barrage of threatening calls' and that she 'received credible death threats' after switching her vote from supporting Jordan to opposing him. Freshman Rep. Nick LaLota, who voted for former New York Rep. Lee Zeldin in both speaker votes, also shared a threat made to his office on Wednesday via X (formerly Twitter). 'My vote card belongs to me and the people of New York's First Congressional District,' LaLota wrote. 'I will not succumb to threats. Rather, I'll support a Speaker candidate who will fund the WTC Health Fund, National Flood Insurance, and SALT, while keeping the government open, securing the border and cutting spending.' The threats against Miller-Meeks and LaLota came after Politico reported that Rep. Don Bacon and his wife, Angie, had received anonymous texts and emails urging Bacon to vote for Jordan or face electoral consequences. In response to the threats and hostile messages received by Miller-Meeks, LaLota, and Bacon, Jim Jordan posted online condemning 'all threats against our colleagues.' 'Stop,' he wrote. 'It's abhorrent.' Bacon responded to Jordan’s statement on X after seeing it mentioned in a Washington Post article, noting, 'They are your supporters.' As of now, the House is scheduled to meet again on Thursday at noon for a third round of voting for House Speaker. Because of the GOP's slim majority, Jordan cannot win if more than four Republicans oppose him. On Tuesday, 18 Republicans voted for other candidates, eliminating Jordan's first bid. By Wednesday, opposition increased to 20. The rising number of Republicans against Jordan suggests his chances of becoming speaker are rapidly decreasing.
translated_content: Dvaja republikánski poslanci oznámili, že dostali vyhrážky smrťou po tom, ako hlasovali proti svojmu kolegovi, republikánovi Jimovi Jordanovi, kandidátovi na predsedu Snemovne reprezentantov. V stredu poslankyňa Mariannette Miller-Meeks vo vyhlásení pre médiá oznámila, že jej kancelária dostala „záplavu vyhrážajúcich hovorov“ a že „jej boli doručené dôveryhodné vyhrážky smrťou“ po tom, ako zmenila svoj hlas z podpory Jordana na odpor voči jeho kandidatúre. Nováčik Nick LaLota, ktorý v oboch hlasovaniach podporil bývalého newyorského poslanca Leeho Zeldina, tiež v stredu prostredníctvom platformy X (predtým Twitter) zverejnil hrozbu adresovanú jeho kancelárii. „Moja hlasovacia karta patrí mne a ľuďom z Prvého kongresového obvodu New Yorku,“ napísal LaLota. „Nepodľahnem vyhrážkam. Podporím kandidáta na predsedu, ktorý bude financovať WTC Health Fund, National Flood Insurance a SALT, pričom zabezpečí otvorenosť vlády, bezpečnú hranicu a zníženie výdavkov.“ Vyhrážky Miller-Meeksovej a LaLotovi prišli po tom, ako Politico informovalo, že poslanec Don Bacon a jeho manželka Angie dostali anonymné textové správy a e-maily, v ktorých boli vyzývaní, aby Bacon hlasoval za Jordana, inak ho čakajú volebné následky. V reakcii na tieto vyhrážky a nepriateľské odkazy zverejnil Jim Jordan online stanovisko, v ktorom odsúdil „všetky vyhrážky našim kolegom“. „Prestaňte,“ napísal. „Je to odporné.“ Bacon reagoval na Jordanovo vyjadrenie na platforme X po tom, čo ho videl spomenuté v článku Washington Post, keď poznamenal: „To sú vaši podporovatelia.“ V tejto chvíli je Snemovňa opäť naplánovaná na zasadnutie vo štvrtok na poludnie, kde by malo prebehnúť tretie kolo hlasovania o predsedovi. Kvôli malému náskoku republikánov Jordan nemôže vyhrať, ak viac ako štyria republikáni budú proti nemu. V utorok hlasovalo 18 republikánov za iných kandidátov a znemožnilo tak Jordanovi prvý pokus. V stredu sa počet odporcov zvýšil na 20. Stúpajúci počet republikánov proti Jordanovi naznačuje, že jeho šance stať sa predsedom sa rýchlo znižujú.
