article_content: Firefighters in Northern California continue to make progress against wildfires that have destroyed homes and forced mass evacuations. The Sand Fire, located east of Sacramento in the foothills of the Sierra Nevada, has burned approximately six square miles of rugged terrain in Amador and El Dorado counties since Friday. According to the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CalFire), the fire has destroyed 13 homes and 38 outbuildings, and 515 homes remain under evacuation orders. By Sunday night, the fire was reported as 50% contained. The blaze, near renowned wine-producing regions, has proven difficult to control due to steep and dry conditions. Nearly 1,900 firefighters, supported by aircraft such as a DC-10 air tanker, are working to bring the fire under control. CalFire officials say the fire began when a vehicle drove over dry vegetation. In response to evacuation orders, residents like Alfred Shults, his wife Carolyn, and their granddaughter quickly left their home in El Dorado County. Shults shared that he packed essential belongings, turned on a sprinkler to protect his motorcycle, and hoped their property would survive. Meanwhile, near Yosemite National Park, the El Portal Fire significantly increased in size overnight, now covering more than three square miles. It has destroyed one home in Foresta and prompted evacuations both there and in Old El Portal. About 100 homes have been evacuated, with shelters opened for people and animals. Fortunately, officials report no injuries. Yosemite National Park, including iconic sites such as Half Dome and the giant sequoia grove, remains open, although some areas are smoky. Highway 120 is closed to aid firefighting efforts. Around 400 firefighters are battling the blaze, which continues to burn in the Stanislaus National Forest. Other major wildfires are burning across the western United States. The Buzzard Complex in eastern Oregon, the nation’s largest active wildfire at 618 square miles, is 95% contained, while Washington’s nearly 400-square-mile Carlton Complex—the largest in state history—continues to burn with crews holding containment lines. Despite property losses, no injuries have been reported in these fires. Residents and officials remain vigilant as conditions continue to challenge firefighting efforts.

article_content: Japan’s Deputy Finance Minister, Kenji Kanda, has resigned following disclosures that his company repeatedly failed to pay taxes, escalating troubles for Prime Minister Fumio Kishida’s administration. Kanda conceded, after a magazine exposé, that authorities had seized his company's properties four times between 2013 and 2022 due to unpaid fixed asset taxes. Kanda, formerly a tax accountant, was heavily criticized by opposition lawmakers in parliament last week, diverting attention from other policy discussions. Mounting criticism prompted his resignation, which was formally accepted by the Cabinet, according to Chief Cabinet Secretary Hirokazu Matsuno. Prime Minister Kishida expressed regret over appointing Kanda and pledged to regain public trust. Kanda is the third Cabinet member to step down within two months since a major reshuffle in September. Government approval has now dropped below 30%, amid discontent over sluggish economic policies, persistent problems with health insurance system digitalization, and criticism of Kishida’s leadership. Other recent Cabinet exits include a vice education minister, who left after an extramarital affair, and a vice justice minister, who resigned amid election law violation allegations. As Kishida considers a snap election before his party leadership term ends in September, opposition leader Kenta Izumi condemned the belated resignation and questioned Kishida’s judgment in the appointment.

Kanda priznal, že po medializovaní prípadu mu úrady medzi rokmi 2013 a 2022 štyrikrát zhabali firemný majetok kvôli nezaplateným daniam z nehnuteľností. Kanda, pôvodne daňový poradca, čelil minulý týždeň v parlamente ostrej kritike opozície, ktorá odvádzala pozornosť od iných politických tém. Stúpajúca kritika prinútila Kandu k rezignácii, ktorú formálne prijala vláda podľa hlavného tajomníka kabinetu Hirokazu Matsuna. Premiér Kišida vyjadril ľútosť nad Kandovým menovaním a prisľúbil obnoviť dôveru verejnosti. Kanda je už tretím členom vlády, ktorý odstúpil v priebehu dvoch mesiacov od veľkej septembrovej rekonštrukcie kabinetu. Popularita vlády klesla pod 30 % v dôsledku nespokojnosti s pomalými ekonomickými reformami, pretrvávajúcimi problémami s digitalizáciou zdravotného poistenia a kritikou Kišidovho líderského štýlu. Spomedzi ďalších nedávnych rezignácií odišiel viceprezident ministerstva školstva kvôli mimomanželskému pomeru a bývalý viceprezident ministerstva spravodlivosti v dôsledku obvinení z porušenia volebného zákona. Kišida zvažuje termín predčasných volieb pred skončením svojho straníckeho mandátu v septembri. Opozičný líder Kenta Izumi označil oneskorenú rezignáciu za neprípustnú a spochybnil Kišidovo rozhodnutie pri menovaní Kandu.

article_content: Jack Jablonski, a senior at Benilde-St Margaret’s High School in Minneapolis who was paralyzed during a high school hockey game, attended his prom with ESPN 'Sports Nation' host Michelle Beadle. Jablonski invited Beadle to the prom during a recent radio interview, and she happily accepted. Jablonski was paralyzed three years ago after an on-ice accident in which another player hit him from behind into the boards, according to his personal website. Michelle Beadle, 38, joined Jablonski at the prom after they appeared together on a local radio interview last month where Jablonski asked her to the event. Beadle flew to Minneapolis the night before the prom to have dinner with Jablonski's family, according to WCCO. She shared photos of herself and Jablonski throughout the evening on social media. Beadle and Jablonski, along with his friends, took a school bus to the dance and seemed to enjoy themselves. Jablonski was also seen waving to the crowd during Game Three of last season’s NHL Western Conference Quarterfinals between the Minnesota Wild and Chicago Blackhawks. Beadle expressed appreciation to the school for allowing her to attend the prom, noting their clear rules. Footage from the prom showed both Beadle and Jablonski laughing and enjoying the festivities. 'It’ll be fun. I get to go on a school bus. Hello, it’s going to make me young again,' Beadle joked. She admitted to being a little nervous beforehand but looked comfortable at the event. Beadle helped give Jablonski a night to remember.

Jablonski pozval Beadle na ples počas nedávneho rádiového rozhovoru a ona s radosťou súhlasila. Jablonski ochrnul pred tromi rokmi po nehode na ľade, keď ho iný hráč zozadu narazil na mantinel, uvádza jeho osobná stránka. Michelle Beadle, 38, sa k Jablonskimu pridala na plese po tom, čo spolu vystúpili v miestnom rádiovom rozhovore minulý mesiac, kde ju Jablonski pozval na podujatie. Beadle priletela do Minneapolisu večer pred plesom, aby večerala s Jablonskiho rodinou, informuje WCCO. Počas večera zdieľala na sociálnych sieťach fotografie so sebou a Jablonskim. Beadle a Jablonski išli na ples spolu s jeho priateľmi školským autobusom a zdali sa byť nadšení. Jablonski bol tiež spozorovaný, ako máva divákom počas tretieho zápasu minuloročného štvrťfinále Západnej konferencie NHL medzi Minnesota Wild a Chicago Blackhawks. Beadle vyjadrila vďaku škole, že jej umožnili zúčastniť sa plesu, pričom poznamenala ich jasné pravidlá. Zábery z plesu ukázali, ako sa Beadle aj Jablonski smiali a užívali si oslavy. 'Bude to sranda. Môžem ísť školským autobusom. Halo, budem sa cítiť opäť mladá,' zažartovala Beadle. Priznala, že pred plesom bola trochu nervózna, ale na akcii pôsobila uvoľnene. Beadle pomohla Jablonskimu prežiť nezabudnuteľnú noc.

article_content: WASHINGTON — Federal government workers from agencies including the State Department and NASA are circulating open letters urging President Joe Biden to call for a cease-fire in Israel’s conflict with Hamas. Some congressional staffers have publicly criticized lawmakers outside the Capitol for remaining silent on the mounting Palestinian civilian casualties. As deaths rise in Gaza, both Biden and Congress face unusually public internal opposition to their support of Israel’s offensive. Hundreds of administration and Capitol Hill staffers are signing letters, speaking with reporters, and holding vigils, pressing for U.S. policy changes to prevent further Palestinian casualties. "Most of our bosses on Capitol Hill are not listening to the people they represent," one congressional staffer said at a protest this month. Roughly 100 aides, their faces covered with medical masks, placed flowers in front of Congress to honor civilians killed in the conflict. These federal employees' objections to U.S. support for Israel’s Gaza campaign reflect broader societal changes, including increasing diversity among government workers, with more Muslim and Arab Americans appointed to federal roles. Polls also show shifting public opinion, with growing disapproval of Israel's government under Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. After weeks of graphic images from Gaza, significant numbers of Americans—including many Democrats—disagree with Biden’s support for Israel’s military actions. A recent poll by the Associated Press and NORC Center for Public Affairs Research found 40% of Americans believe Israel’s response in Gaza has gone too far. The war has sparked demonstrations nationwide and deeply affected college campuses. By the end of last week, one open letter had gathered signatures from 650 staffers across more than 30 federal agencies—ranging from the Executive Office of the President and the Census Bureau to USAID and the Department of Defense. A Biden appointee who helped organize the letter said the administration’s rejection of calls for a long-term cease-fire left some federal staff feeling dismissed. As a result, staffers have turned to dissent cables and public letters after internal efforts failed to prompt action. The multiagency letter condemns both the Hamas attack that killed about 1,200 people in Israel on October 7, and the Israeli military campaign, which the Palestinian Health Ministry says has killed over 11,500 Palestinians. It urges the U.S. to press for a cease-fire, the release of hostages held by Hamas and Palestinian detainees allegedly unjustly held by Israel, and greater protection for Gaza’s civilians. Organizers of protests and letters spoke anonymously to the AP citing fears of professional or personal repercussions. The public nature of this internal dissent is unusual, and some worry it could risk government function and agency cohesion. The State Department has a longstanding dissent channel dating back to 1970, used in moments of intense policy debate. This includes opposition to past wars and controversial U.S. policies. While dissent cables are signed and classified, the current open letters are public and anonymous. Former senior State Department official Thomas Shannon emphasized the importance of discipline and unified foreign policy, adding he is "not a fan of open letters." He acknowledged that while diversity among the workforce is positive, structure is essential. Secretary of State Antony Blinken has acknowledged internal opposition, stating in a recent department-wide email that "we’re listening; what you share is informing our policy and our messages." Department spokesman Matthew Miller echoed that dissent is valued. In contrast to traditional internal dissent, the USAID letter—endorsed by over 1,000 staffers and shared publicly—called for an immediate cease-fire, though some within the agency were uncomfortable with its failure to explicitly condemn the Hamas attacks. A USAID staffer explained that an internal State Department memorial for all civilians killed since October 7, organized by employee groups of multiple faiths, was more unifying. The organizers of the open letter said their actions arose from frustration after previous efforts, such as meetings with White House officials, failed to produce change. They argue that remaining silent or resigning would neglect their duty to the public. "If we just leave, there's never going to be any change," one staffer said. — Associated Press writers Jamey Keaten in Geneva and Matthew Lee contributed to this report.
translated_content: WASHINGTON — Federálni zamestnanci z rôznych agentúr, vrátane ministerstva zahraničia a NASA, rozosielajú otvorené listy, v ktorých vyzývajú prezidenta Joea Bidena na prímerie v konflikte medzi Izraelom a Hamasom. Niektorí pracovníci Kongresu verejne pred Kapitolom kritizujú zákonodarcov za ich mlčanie k rastúcemu počtu palestínskych civilných obetí. S rastúcim počtom obetí v Gaze čelia Biden aj Kongres nezvyčajne verejnej vnútornej opozícii voči svojej podpore izraelskej ofenzívy. Stovky pracovníkov administratívy a Kapitolu podpisujú výzvy, rozprávajú sa s novinármi a organizujú vigílie, aby tlačili na zmenu americkej politiky a zabránili ďalším palestínskym obetiam. "Väčšina našich šéfov na Kapitole nepočúva ľudí, ktorých zastupujú," povedal jeden zamestnanec Kongresu na proteste tento mesiac. Asi 100 asistentov s prekrytými tvárami zdravotníckymi maskami položilo pred Kongres kvety na pamiatku civilných obetí konfliktu. Námietky týchto štátnych zamestnancov proti americkej podpore izraelskej kampane v Gaze odrážajú širšie spoločenské zmeny, ako je rastúca rozmanitosť medzi vládnymi pracovníkmi, vrátane ľudí moslimského a arabského pôvodu. Prieskumy verejnej mienky ukazujú rastúci nesúhlas s izraelskou vládou premiéra Benjamina Netanjahua. Po týždňoch dramatických záberov z Gazy nesúhlasí výrazná časť Američanov — vrátane mnohých demokratov — s Bidenovou podporou izraelského vojenského konania. Podľa nedávneho prieskumu Associated Press a NORC Center for Public Affairs Research si 40 % Američanov myslí, že izraelská reakcia v Gaze zašla príliš ďaleko. Vojna vyvolala celoštátne protesty a silno zasiahla univerzity. Koncom minulého týždňa mala jedna otvorená výzva už podpisy 650 zamestnancov z viac ako 30 federálnych agentúr — od Úradu prezidenta USA po sčítaciu komisiu, USAID či Ministerstvo obrany. Jeden z Bidenových politických nominantov, ktorý pomáhal list organizovať, povedal, že odmietnutie apelu na dlhodobé prímerie vyvolalo u niektorých zamestnancov pocit ignorovania. Preto sa začali obracať na protestné káble a otvorené listy, keďže interné úsilie nebolo úspešné. List podpísaný viacerými agentúrami odsudzuje útok Hamasu z 7. októbra, pri ktorom bolo zabitých asi 1 200 ľudí v Izraeli, aj izraelskú vojenskú kampaň, ktorá si podľa palestínskeho ministerstva zdravotníctva vyžiadala viac ako 11 500 obetí v Gaze. V liste sa vyzývajú USA na podporu prímeria, prepustenie rukojemníkov zadržiavaných Hamasom aj palestínskych väzňov, ktorí sú podľa signatárov nespravodlivo zadržiavaní Izraelom, a požaduje sa väčšia ochrana civilistov v Gaze. Organizátori protestov a listov vystupovali v anonymite pre AP pre obavy z profesionálnych a osobných následkov. Takto verejná vnútorná opozícia je nezvyčajná a niektorí sa obávajú narušenia funkčnosti vlády či súdržnosti agentúr. Ministerstvo zahraničných vecí má dlhoročný systém nesúhlasných vyhlásení už od roku 1970, v čase napätých politických debát. Patria sem protesty proti minulým vojnám a sporným americkým politikám. Kým protestné káble sú podpísané a tajné, dnešné otvorené listy sú verejné a anonymné. Bývalý vysoký úradník Thomas Shannon zdôraznil potrebu disciplíny a jednotnej zahraničnej politiky a dodal, že „nie je fanúšikom otvorených listov“. Priznal, že rozmanitosť je pozitívna, no štruktúra je tiež potrebná. Minister zahraničných vecí Antony Blinken uznal vnútorný nesúhlas a v e-maile zamestnancom napísal: „Počúvame vás; vaše názory ovplyvňujú našu politiku.“ Hovorca Matthew Miller potvrdil, že nesúhlas je vítaný. Na rozdiel od tradičných interných výhrad bol list USAID — ktorý podpísalo viac ako 1 000 zamestnancov a bol verejný — zameraný na okamžité prímerie, aj keď niektorým zamestnancom prekážalo, že neodsudzoval útoky Hamasu. Podľa pracovníka USAID bola interná spomienková akcia ministerstva zahraničia na všetky civilné obete od 7. októbra, ktorú pripravili zamestnanci viacerých náboženských skupín, spojivejšia. Organizátori otvoreného listu uviedli, že ich k tomu viedla frustrácia po neúspešných predchádzajúcich snahách vrátane rokovaní s Bielym domom. Tvrdia, že mlčať alebo rezignovať by bolo zanedbaním povinnosti voči verejnosti. "Ak by sme len odišli, nikdy by sa nič nezmenilo," povedal jeden pracovík. — Na správe spolupracovali novinári AP Jamey Keaten v Ženeve a Matthew Lee.

article_content: Actor and filmmaker Tyler Perry donated $100,000 to an Ohio school district to support its athletic programs and after-school clubs. Perry was inspired to make the donation after watching a television report about the district's financial difficulties. The school’s programs lost funding after voters failed to pass a tax levy in 2009. Although the programs were eventually reinstated, participation fees created financial barriers for many students. Perry was moved to support Finland Middle School after seeing an HBO segment about teacher Mary Mulvany, who started the 'Success Beyond the Classroom' foundation to raise scholarship funds for athletics and extracurricular activities. The district received national attention due to funding cuts and subsequent challenges. When Perry made a surprise visit to the school, he received an enthusiastic welcome from the students. His donation aimed to help cover fees that can reach up to $500 per family, making activities accessible to more students, according to ABC News Channel 6. During the assembly, Perry shared words of encouragement, empathizing with students' financial and personal challenges by describing his own upbringing in New Orleans and experiences with bullying. He stressed the value of education and opportunity. Mary Mulvany described Perry’s contribution as generous and selfless, telling The Columbus Dispatch that his actions would benefit hundreds of children. Perry expressed his hope to stay updated on the school’s progress and the impact of his donation.
translated_content: Herec a filmár Tyler Perry daroval 100 000 dolárov jednej školskej štvrti v štáte Ohio na podporu športových programov a krúžkov po vyučovaní. Perryho inšpiroval televízny reportáž o finančných ťažkostiach tejto štvrte. Programy školy prišli o financovanie po tom, čo voliči v roku 2009 neschválili daňový výmer. Hoci programy neskôr obnovili, poplatky za účasť vytvorili finančné prekážky pre mnohých žiakov. Perryho motivovalo podporiť strednú školu Finland po tom, čo videl segment na HBO o učiteľke Mary Mulvany, ktorá založila nadáciu 'Success Beyond the Classroom' na získavanie štipendií pre športové a mimoškolské aktivity. Štvrť získala národnú pozornosť kvôli škrtom vo financovaní a následným problémom. Keď Perry prekvapivo navštívil školu, študenti ho privítali s nadšením. Jeho dar mal pomôcť pokryť poplatky, ktoré môžu dosiahnuť až 500 dolárov na rodinu, aby sa viac žiakov mohlo zapojiť do aktivít, informuje ABC News Channel 6. Počas zhromaždenia Perry študentom odkázal povzbudivé slová, súcitil s ich finančnými a osobnými ťažkosťami, pričom popísal aj svoje dospievanie v New Orleans a skúsenosti so šikanou. Zdôraznil hodnotu vzdelania a príležitostí. Mary Mulvany Perryho príspevok označila za štedrý a nezištný, pričom pre The Columbus Dispatch povedala, že jeho činy pomôžu stovkám detí. Perry vyjadril nádej, že bude informovaný o pokroku školy a dopade svojej pomoci.

article_content: US President Joe Biden said on Thursday that he will continue working to advance a Pacific trade agreement, even as his plan to promote a regional deal to counter China’s influence faced obstacles over efforts to strengthen workers’ rights. “Our work is not yet done,” Biden told corporate CEOs in San Francisco during a summit for the 21-member Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum. “We will keep working to make high-standard trade that advances workers’ rights through strong enforcement of labor standards.” Biden also planned to participate in an event for the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework (IPEF), a 14-nation group established by his administration. Hopes for an IPEF trade deal were set back this week, as members could not agree on improvements related to labor and environmental standards or compliance, according to people familiar with the talks. Deputy US Trade Representative Sarah Bianchi told Reuters on Thursday that the US and its Indo-Pacific partners would need to regroup and 'recalibrate' trade pillar negotiations early next year. An administration official noted that such trade agreements typically take years but said the White House aimed to work on an accelerated timeline. The White House created IPEF to enhance economic engagement with Asia after former President Donald Trump withdrew from a regional trade accord in 2017. Biden, a Democrat, may face Republican Trump again in next year’s presidential election, which could affect US support for multilateral groups like APEC or the IMF, as well as trade policy. After a day of meetings, Biden announced that leaders signed a supply chain agreement to identify bottlenecks before problems arise, such as during the pandemic. He also noted agreements to accelerate clean energy transitions and to fight corruption. Additionally, he promoted the launch of an 'investment accelerator' to attract private capital for clean energy and technology investment. “Government investment is not enough,” he said. “We need to mobilize private investment.” Before the APEC summit, Biden highlighted investments by US companies in the region, including Amazon.com, Delta Air Lines, PepsiCo, Apple, and Boeing. He argued that continued US economic growth would benefit the global economy, even as the International Monetary Fund recently downgraded growth forecasts for China and noted that global economic growth remains low and uneven. The IMF projects 3.0% real global GDP growth for 2023. Biden shared that 60% of US exports go to APEC countries, and that US businesses are the largest source of foreign direct investment in those economies, with at least $40 billion invested in 2023. US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo said earlier that IPEF members had agreed on several 'pillars' of the initiative, including cooperation on clean energy and anti-corruption. Ministers also formally signed agreement on a third pillar, focusing on supply chain resilience. Meanwhile, trade ministers from the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) said they welcomed new members if they meet existing standards. The earlier version of this trade group was abandoned by Trump. Under Biden, free-trade deals have been less prioritized due to pressure from labor organizations. APEC countries are closely watching the dynamic between the US and China, the world’s two largest economies and key rivals, amid concerns that increasing competition could affect global trade and security. On Wednesday, Biden met with Chinese President Xi Jinping for a high-stakes summit aimed at stabilizing relations. Biden said a stable relationship between the US and China benefits the world. He told Xi that the US is 'a Pacific nation' and will stay engaged in the region. He emphasized that the US does not seek to decouple its economy from China, but instead wants to 'de-risk and diversify.' “A stable relationship between the world’s two biggest economies is good not only for those countries but for the world,” Biden said to applause. Richard Adkerson, CEO of Freeport-McMoRan, whose company operates in Peru and Indonesia, expressed encouragement over signs of improving US-China relations, including the recent leaders' meeting. “We have to wait and see whether it’s a turning point,” he said.
translated_content: Americký prezident Joe Biden vo štvrtok uviedol, že bude pokračovať v snahe presadiť tichomorskú obchodnú dohodu, aj keď jeho plán na podporu regionálnej dohody na vyváženie vplyvu Číny čelí prekážkam v oblasti posilňovania práv pracujúcich. „Naša práca ešte nie je hotová,“ povedal Biden generálnym riaditeľom spoločností v San Franciscu počas summitu 21-člennej Ázijsko-tichomorskej hospodárskej spolupráce (APEC). „Budeme pokračovať v práci na obchode podľa vysokých štandardov, ktorý podporuje práva pracujúcich prostredníctvom silného vymáhania pracovných štandardov.“ Biden sa mal tiež zúčastniť podujatia Indo-pacifického hospodárskeho rámca (IPEF), 14-člennej skupiny, ktorú založila jeho administratíva. Nádeje na obchodnú dohodu v rámci IPEF boli tento týždeň oslabené, pretože sa členovia nevedeli dohodnúť na zlepšeniach týkajúcich sa pracovných a environmentálnych štandardov alebo ich dodržiavania, uviedli osoby oboznámené s rokovaniami. Zástupkyňa amerického obchodného splnomocnenca Sarah Bianchi vo štvrtok pre agentúru Reuters povedala, že USA a ich indo-pacifickí partneri budú musieť začiatkom budúceho roka opäť prerokovať a „prekalkulovať“ rokovania o obchodnom pilieri. Predstaviteľ administratívy poznamenal, že dohody tohto typu zvyčajne trvajú roky, ale Biely dom plánuje pracovať na zrýchlenom harmonograme. Biely dom vytvoril IPEF na posilnenie hospodárskej spolupráce s Áziou po tom, čo bývalý prezident Donald Trump v roku 2017 odstúpil od regionálnej obchodnej dohody. Biden, demokrat, sa môže v budúcoročných prezidentských voľbách opäť stretnúť s republikánom Trumpom, čo by mohlo ovplyvniť podporu USA pre multilaterálne skupiny ako APEC alebo MMF a obchodnú politiku. Po dni rokovaní Biden oznámil, že lídri podpísali dohodu o dodávateľských reťazcoch s cieľom identifikovať úzke miesta skôr, než vzniknú problémy, napríklad počas pandémie. Ďalej spomenul dohody na urýchlenie prechodu na čistú energiu a v boji proti korupcii. Navyše predstavil spustenie „investičného akcelerátora“ na prilákanie súkromného kapitálu pre investície do čistej energie a technológií. „Vláda nemôže investovať dostatočne,“ povedal. „Musíme zmobilizovať aj súkromné investície.“ Pred summitom APEC Biden vyzdvihol investície amerických spoločností v regióne, vrátane Amazonu, Delta Air Lines, PepsiCo, Apple a Boeingu. Tvrdil, že pokračujúci ekonomický rast USA bude na prospech celému svetu, aj keď Medzinárodný menový fond nedávno znížil prognózy rastu Číny a konštatuje, že globálny rast zostáva nízky a nerovnomerný. MMF predpokladá rast reálneho globálneho HDP na úrovni 3,0 % v roku 2023. Biden uviedol, že 60 % amerického exportu smeruje do krajín APEC a americké firmy sú najväčším zdrojom priamych zahraničných investícií v týchto ekonomikách, pričom v roku 2023 investovali najmenej 40 miliárd dolárov. Americká ministerka obchodu Gina Raimondo skôr uviedla, že krajiny IPEF sa dohodli na viacerých „pilieroch“ iniciatívy vrátane spolupráce v oblasti čistej energie a boja proti korupcii. Ministri tiež oficiálne podpísali dohodu o treťom pilieri na posilnenie odolnosti dodávateľských reťazcov. Medzitým ministri obchodu zo skupiny Komplexnej a progresívnej dohody pre trans-tichomorské partnerstvo (CPTPP) uviedli, že privítajú nových členov, ak splnia existujúce štandardy. Predchádzajúcu verziu tejto skupiny Spojené štáty opustili za Trumpa. Za Bidena sa nové dohody o voľnom obchode dostali na druhú koľaj vďaka tlaku odborových organizácií. Členovia APEC pozorne sledujú vzťahy medzi USA a Čínou, dvoma najväčšími ekonomikami a kľúčovými rivalmi, ktoré svojou rastúcou konkurenciou môžu ovplyvniť globálny obchod aj bezpečnosť. V stredu sa Biden stretol s čínskym prezidentom Si Ťin-pchingom na dôležitom summite zameranom na stabilizáciu vzťahov. Biden uviedol, že stabilné vzťahy medzi USA a Čínou sú v prospech celého sveta. Si Ťin-pchingovi povedal, že USA sú „pacifickou krajinou“ a zostanú angažované v regióne. Zdôraznil, že USA sa nesnažia o úplné oddelenie svojej ekonomiky od Číny, ale chcú „znižovať riziká a diverzifikovať“. „Stabilné vzťahy medzi dvoma najväčšími ekonomikami sveta sú dobré nielen pre ne, ale pre celý svet,“ povedal Biden za potlesku. Richard Adkerson, generálny riaditeľ spoločnosti Freeport-McMoRan, ktorá pôsobí v Peru a Indonézii, vyjadril povzbudenie nad znakmi zlepšenia vzťahov medzi USA a Čínou, vrátane posledného stretnutia lídrov. „Musíme si počkať, či to bude skutočný zlom,“ povedal.

article_content: At the Halifax International Security Forum held in Nova Scotia, the John McCain Prize for Leadership in Public Service was given to the people of Israel, marking 75 years of democratic governance. The award, named in honor of the late U.S. Senator John McCain, celebrates outstanding leaders or communities showing dedication to justice. This recognition came after the Hamas attack on October 7, which resulted in approximately 1,200 deaths and around 240 kidnappings in Israel. Lital Leshem, representing the group Brothers in Arms, accepted the award. Originally established as a protest movement by military veterans, Brothers in Arms evolved into a significant NGO providing assistance to Israelis affected by the conflict. Currently, Brothers in Arms organizes help for families who had to leave border regions, arranging counseling, transport, and volunteers to work on farms coping with worker shortages due to the war. Leshem conveyed her gratitude, commending the Israeli people's spirit during challenging times. The conflict has caused heavy casualties on both sides. While Israel suffered losses from the Hamas attack, health officials in Gaza, overseen by Hamas, report over 11,000 deaths since the violence began, including both civilians and combatants. Eyal Naveh, another representative of Brothers in Arms, highlighted the group’s prompt, apolitical response after the attacks, stressing the need for continuous attention to democracy. The annual forum, attended by international security experts and leaders, has previously granted this award to groups such as the people of Hong Kong and to those on Lesbos, Greece for their humanitarian work. Discussions during this year's conference focused largely on the wars in Ukraine and between Israel and Hamas.
translated_content: Na Halifax International Security Forum v Novom Škótsku bola ľudu Izraela pri príležitosti 75. výročia demokracie udelená Cena Johna McCaina za vodcovstvo vo verejných službách. Ocenenie pomenované po zosnulom americkom senátorovi Johnovi McCainovi vzdáva hold výnimočným lídrom alebo komunitám, ktoré preukazujú oddanosť spravodlivosti. Toto uznanie nasledovalo po útoku Hamasu 7. októbra, pri ktorom v Izraeli zahynulo približne 1 200 ľudí a asi 240 bolo unesených. Ocenenie prevzala Lital Leshemová, zástupkyňa skupiny Brothers in Arms. Táto skupina vznikla ako protestné hnutie vojenských veteránov, ale dnes je významnou mimovládnou organizáciou, ktorá pomáha obetiam konfliktu v Izraeli. Brothers in Arms dnes organizuje pomoc rodinám vyhnaným z pohraničných oblastí, zabezpečuje poradenstvo, dopravu a dobrovoľnícku pomoc na farmách, kde chýbajú pracovníci v dôsledku vojny. Leshemová vyjadrila poďakovanie a vyzdvihla odolnosť izraelského národa v ťažkých časoch. Konflikt si vyžiadal veľa obetí na oboch stranách. Izrael utrpel straty po útoku Hamasu a zdravotníci v Gaze, ktorú riadi Hamas, uvádzajú od začiatku bojov viac ako 11 000 mŕtvych vrátane civilistov i bojovníkov. Eyal Naveh, ďalší zástupca skupiny Brothers in Arms, zdôraznil rýchlu a nestranícku reakciu skupiny po útokoch a potrebu nepretržitej ochrany demokracie. Podujatie, na ktorom sa stretávajú poprední bezpečnostní odborníci a lídri svetovej scény, v minulosti ocenilo aj obyvateľov Hongkongu či Lesbosu za ich humanitárnu angažovanosť. Hlavnými témami fóra boli tento rok okrem vojny na Ukrajine aj boj medzi Izraelom a Hamasom.

article_content: To better understand the economic challenges facing Portugal, one need look no further than Guimaraes, the country's oldest city and its cultural birthplace. In the 1980s and 1990s, Guimaraes thrived as an industrial hub, its valleys lined with factories. Today, however, many of those factories stand idle, victims of both economic crisis and growing competition from countries like China. Amid this difficult landscape, one traditional Portuguese industry is making notable progress: shoemaking. This age-old craft is plotting a new course, relying on exports to weather the downturn. Companies are seeking fresh ways to gain traction internationally. At one shoemaking factory, workers busily stitch, sew, glue, and lace up a varied range of products—from functional designs to bold, unconventional styles. The company’s logo, a simple sketch of a fly, marks each shoe. Its brand name: Fly London. Though fully produced in Portugal, the brand—and its name—stand out with a uniquely international flair. Other Portuguese shoe brands, such as Nobrand, Camport, Eject, Mack James, and Softwaves, have also chosen Anglo-Saxon names to better compete in a global market. Alfredo Moreira, executive director of the Portuguese Footwear and Manufacturers Association, explains that choosing non-Portuguese-sounding names is part of adapting to today’s globalized economy, where 'competition is tough' and companies need an international mindset. This strategy appears to be working: 97% of Portuguese shoe production is now exported to around 130 countries. A visit to Fly London's warehouse reveals shoes ready for shipment to destinations as varied as Croatia, Denmark, Italy, the UK, the US, Russia, and Angola. Fortunato Frederico, managing director of Fly London, points out that having an international name is not enough—success abroad also depends on investing in advanced technology, product quality, promotional activities, and workforce training. The company is currently installing new systems to streamline the ordering process. Portuguese shoes are now the second most expensive in the world, behind only Italian footwear, according to industry group APPICAPS. Marketing initiatives and technological innovation have helped annual industry export growth reach 6% over the last five years. With the Portuguese economy forecasted to contract by 2.3% this year, traditional sectors like shoemaking provide a glimmer of hope and play a vital role in holding the nation’s fragmented economy together.
translated_content: Ak chcete lepšie pochopiť ekonomické výzvy, ktorým Portugalsko čelí, stačí sa pozrieť na Guimaraes – najstaršie mesto krajiny a jej kolísku. V 80. a 90. rokoch minulého storočia bol Guimaraes rušným priemyselným centrom, údolia lemovali továrne. Dnes však mnohé z nich stoja nevyužité, ako obete hospodárskej krízy a narastajúcej konkurencie z krajín ako Čína. Uprostred tohto náročného prostredia sa však jeden tradičný portugalský priemysel presadzuje: obuvníctvo. Toto historické remeslo sa vydalo novým smerom a na prekonanie krízy sa spolieha najmä na export. Spoločnosti objavujú nové cesty, ako preraziť na medzinárodnom trhu. V jednej obuvníckej fabrike pracovníci usilovne šijú, lepia, zošívajú a šnurujú rôzne druhy topánok – od praktických dizajnov po odvážne, nápadité modely. Každú topánku zdobí jednoduché logo s nákresom muchy. Názov značky: Fly London. Hoci celá výroba prebieha v Portugalsku, značka aj jej meno pôsobia výrazne svetovo. Ďalšie portugalské značky obuvi – ako Nobrand, Camport, Eject, Mack James a Softwaves – si tiež zvolili anglicky znejúce mená, aby sa v silnej globálnej konkurencii lepšie presadili. Alfredo Moreira, výkonný riaditeľ Portugalskej asociácie výrobcov obuvi, vysvetľuje, že vo svete, kde je „konkurencia tvrdá“, je využívanie anglicky znejúcich názvov prirodzenou súčasťou globalizácie a medzinárodného zmýšľania. A zdá sa, že táto stratégia funguje – až 97 % portugalskej produkcie obuvi sa exportuje do zhruba 130 krajín. Pri návšteve skladu Fly London vidieť krabice pripravené na export do krajín ako Chorvátsko, Dánsko, Taliansko, Veľká Británia, Spojené štáty, Rusko či Angola. Fortunato Frederico, generálny riaditeľ Fly London, však upozorňuje, že medzinárodný úspech nie je len o známom mene – vyžaduje tiež investície do nových technológií, kvality produktov, marketingu a vzdelávania zamestnancov. Firma inštaluje nové systémy na efektívnejšie spracovanie objednávok. Podľa odvetvového združenia APPICAPS sú portugalské topánky druhé najdrahšie na svete, hneď po talianskych. Vďaka inováciám a marketingu za posledných päť rokov export odvetvia rastie o 6 % ročne. Pri očakávanom poklese portugalskej ekonomiky o 2,3 % tento rok, práve tradičné odvetvia ako obuvníctvo prinášajú nádej a zohrávajú dôležitú rolu v udržiavaní stability krajiny.

article_content: In Detroit, nurse Deborah Hughes acted heroically to save a man from a violent crowd after he accidentally hit a child with his car. The incident took place near a gas station, where Steve Utash, a tree trimmer, stopped immediately to help 10-year-old David Harris, who ran unexpectedly into the road. As Utash went to check on Harris, several people surrounded and assaulted him. Watching from her home nearby, Hughes armed herself for protection and rushed to intervene, shielding Utash and telling the crowd to disperse. Hughes’s prompt action ensured that Utash received vital assistance before emergency services arrived. Utash remains in critical condition at the hospital, while Harris is expected to make a full recovery. Police have arrested several suspects, charging them with serious offenses, including assault with intent to murder. The investigation remains active, and authorities credit community assistance with moving the case forward. Detroit leaders and community figures have condemned the violence, calling for justice and unity. Questions about the attack’s motives persist, but law enforcement has confirmed that the collision itself was an accident.
translated_content: V Detroite zdravotná sestra Deborah Hughes hrdinsky zasiahla, keď zachránila muža pred násilným davom po tom, čo omylom zrazil dieťa autom. Incident sa odohral pri čerpacej stanici, kde Steve Utash, pracovník v oblasti orezávania stromov, okamžite zastavil a snažil sa pomôcť 10-ročnému Davidovi Harrisovi, ktorý nečakane vbehol do cesty. Keď sa Utash snažil skontrolovať Harrisov stav, obklopila ho skupina ľudí a zbili ho. Hughes, ktorá všetko sledovala zo svojho domu neďaleko, sa pre vlastnú ochranu vyzbrojila a okamžite zakročila – Utasha zakryla a dav vyzvala, aby ustúpil. Rýchla reakcia Hughesovej zabezpečila, že Utash dostal potrebnú pomoc ešte pred príchodom záchranárov. Utash zostáva v kritickom stave v nemocnici, zatiaľ čo Harris by sa mal úplne zotaviť. Polícia už zadržala viacero podozrivých a obvinila ich zo závažných trestných činov vrátane napadnutia s úmyslom vraždy. Vyšetrovanie naďalej pokračuje a úrady kladne hodnotia spoluprácu komunity. article_content: Sarah Hunter, newly named MBE and a pivotal figure in England’s Rugby World Cup win, sees 2014 as a significant year for progress toward gender equality in sport. She observed that while only two players from the victorious 2014 England women’s squad were named in the Queen’s New Year’s Honours List—compared to all members of the 2003 men’s team—the team’s unprecedented achievement is expected to raise the profile of women’s competitions. Hunter stated, '2014 might well be remembered as the year that propelled women’s sports to another level. The various accolades achieved by female athletes last year signaled a real shift.' The England women’s rugby team's World Cup victory over Canada in Paris stands out among these positive developments. Among the year’s highlights, Hunter pointed to successes such as Lizzy Yarnold’s performance at the Winter Olympics, Jo Pavey’s results at the Commonwealth Games, and Charlotte Dujardin emerging as a world champion rider, all signifying great strides in women’s sport. The growing appeal of women's athletics was further demonstrated by more than 40,000 fans watching England’s women play football at Wembley and a record crowd of 45,619 attending a friendly match between England and Germany. As she joined the England squad for the start of Six Nations training, Hunter emphasized the need to maintain this energy and keep women’s sports in the spotlight through sustained coverage.

Uviedla, že hoci do Novoročného zoznamu vyznamenaní kráľovnej boli z víťazného ženského tímu v roku 2014 zaradené iba dve hráčky – na rozdiel od celého mužského tímu v roku 2003 – tento výnimočný úspech by mal pomôcť zvýšiť uznanie ženského športu. Hunter povedala: 'Rok 2014 sa pravdepodobne zapíše ako rok, ktorý posunul ženský šport na novú úroveň. Ocenenia, ktoré naše športovkyne získali, znamenali skutočný zlom.' Výhra ženského ragbyového tímu Anglicka nad Kanadou v Paríži to len potvrdila. Hunter tiež poukázala na mimoriadne úspechy Lizzy Yarnold na zimnej olympiáde, Jo Pavey na Hrách Commonwealthu a Charlotte Dujardin, ktorá sa stala svetovou šampiónkou v jazdectve – všetko významné udalosti ženského športu. Narastajúci záujem o ženský šport potvrdilo viac ako 40 000 fanúšikov na zápase ženského futbalového tímu Anglicka vo Wembley a rekordná návšteva 45 619 divákov na priateľskom stretnutí medzi Anglickom a Nemeckom. Pri príležitosti svojho pripojenia sa k anglickej reprezentácii na prvom tréningovom kempe pred Six Nations Hunter zdôraznila, že je dôležité udržať túto dynamiku a zabezpečiť pretrvávajúce mediálne pokrytie ženského športu.

Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Devendra Fadnavis, on Tuesday criticized Bharat Rashtriya Samiti (BRS) chief K Chandrashekhar Rao (KCR) for attempting to expand the BRS’s presence in Maharashtra while facing significant challenges in his home state of Telangana. Fadnavis said, "Over the past year, BRS, led by KCR, has held numerous rallies in Maharashtra and made grand promises to local farmers. However, the ground reality is different—KCR himself is on unstable footing in Telangana." He made these remarks while addressing a rally in Hyderabad’s Domalguda during a day-long campaign for the Telangana assembly elections.

Fadnavis further alleged that the BRS is struggling to gain public support in Telangana as the BJP offers strong opposition. He claimed that, as a result, KCR has begun supporting some Congress candidates. According to Fadnavis, there is a significant gap between the promises made by KCR and actual outcomes. "During my tenure as Maharashtra chief minister (2014–2019), the Telangana leader approached us regarding water sharing. At the time, surplus water from Maharashtra was flowing into the sea, so we assisted Telangana in accessing it. They constructed a dam and barrages with this water. To our shock, the barrage built to channel Maharashtra's surplus water to Telangana developed cracks. Now, we are concerned that these structures may fail due to substandard work, potentially causing floods in Maharashtra’s Gadchiroli and Chandrapur districts," said Fadnavis. He also accused the Telangana government under KCR’s leadership of widespread corruption.

Zástupca hlavného ministra Maháráštry Devendra Fadnavis v utorok kritizoval šéfa strany Bharat Rashtriya Samiti (BRS) K. Chandrashekhara Raoa (KCR) za snahu rozšíriť vplyv BRS v Maháráštře, hoci v jeho domovskom štáte Telangana podľa Fadnavisa čelí vážnym problémom. Fadnavis uviedol: „Za posledný rok BRS pod vedením KCR usporiadala množstvo zhromaždení v Maháráštře a dala veľké sľuby miestnym farmárom. Realita je však iná – samotný KCR má v Telangane neistú pozíciu.“ Tieto poznámky zazneli na mítingu v Domalgude v Hyderabade počas jednodňovej kampane pred voľbami do telanganského zhromaždenia.

Fadnavis ďalej tvrdil, že BRS má v Telangane problém získať verejnú podporu, pretože BJP im kladie silný odpor. Tvrdil, že z tohto dôvodu KCR začal podporovať niektorých kandidátov Kongresu. Podľa Fadnavisa existuje významný rozdiel medzi sľubmi KCR a skutočnými výsledkami. „Počas môjho pôsobenia vo funkcii hlavného ministra Maháráštry (2014–2019) ma telanganský líder požiadal o spoluprácu pri rozdeľovaní vody. V tom čase prebytočná voda z Maháráštry odtekala do mora, a tak sme Telangane pomohli dostať sa k tejto vode. S touto vodou postavili priehradu a hrádze. Na naše prekvapenie hrádza, ktorú postavili na presmerovanie prebytočnej vody z Maháráštry do Telangany, praskla. Teraz sa bojíme, že by tieto stavby mohli kvôli nekvalitnej práci prasknúť, čo by mohlo spôsobiť záplavy v okresoch Gadchiroli a Chandrapur v Maháráštře,“ povedal Fadnavis. Tiež obvinil vládu Telangany pod vedením KCR zo širokej korupcie.

article_content: James Phillips, 22, a disqualified driver from Southmead, Bristol, panicked when he was seen riding his 50cc moped and tried to evade police. Despite his moped’s top speed of about 30 mph, police pursued him through Bristol at around 15 mph, deploying a helicopter and four patrol cars. During the daylight chase, Phillips slowed for speed bumps, but also mounted pavements and swerved dangerously in front of cars. A man attempted to knock him off his moped but missed. After just over a mile, Phillips pulled over and surrendered. Police arrested Phillips for dangerous driving, driving while disqualified, and driving without insurance. He admitted the offenses, and his defense noted his panic and poor judgment. The court viewed footage from the police helicopter, jointly operated by Avon and Somerset and Gloucestershire police. Judge Geoffrey Mercer QC handed Phillips a nine-month jail sentence, suspended for 18 months, 100 hours of unpaid work, a three-year driving ban, an order to take an extended driving test, and a £100 victim surcharge. The judge commented on Phillips’s previous record and current responsibilities, suggesting that he is beginning to mature. After the case, a police officer remarked that the chase was more like a ‘guided tour’ because of the low speed. Phillips later expressed regret for his actions and said he did not expect to get away. Police explained that a helicopter is used to ensure public safety during pursuits, and its footage is used as court evidence.
translated_content: James Phillips, 22-ročný vodič so zákazom šoférovania zo Southmeadu v Bristole, spanikáril, keď ho videli jazdiť na svojom 50cc mopede, a pokúsil sa ujsť pred políciou. Napriek maximálnej rýchlosti mopedu približne 30 míľ za hodinu ho policajti v Bristole prenasledovali rýchlosťou okolo 15 míľ za hodinu, pričom použili vrtuľník a štyri policajné autá. Počas dennej naháňačky Phillips spomaľoval pred spomaľovačmi, ale tiež vchádzal na chodníky a nebezpečne kľučkoval pred autami. Jeden muž sa ho pokúsil zhodiť z mopedu, no neuspel. Po niečo cez jednu míľu Phillips zastavil a vzdal sa. Polícia zatkla Phillipsa za nebezpečnú jazdu, jazdu počas zákazu a bez poistenia. Priznal sa k týmto priestupkom, pričom jeho obhajca zdôraznil, že to bolo spôsobené panikou a zlým úsudkom. Súd si pozrel zábery z policajného vrtuľníka, ktorý spoločne prevádzkujú polície Avon and Somerset a Gloucestershire. Sudca Geoffrey Mercer QC udelil Phillipsovi deväťmesačný trest odňatia slobody s podmienečným odkladom na 18 mesiacov, 100 hodín neplatenej práce, trojročný zákaz šoférovania, povinnosť absolvovať rozšírenú vodičskú skúšku a poplatok pre obete vo výške 100 libier. Sudca poznamenal Phillipsovu minulosť a aktuálne zodpovednosti, pričom naznačil, že začína dospievať. Po prípade policajt poznamenal, že naháňačka bola skôr ako 'prehliadka', keďže bola veľmi pomalá. Phillips neskôr vyjadril ľútosť nad svojím počinom a povedal, že nečakal, že by sa mu podarilo uniknúť. Polícia vysvetlila, že vrtuľník sa používa na zaistenie bezpečnosti verejnosti počas prenasledovania a jeho zábery slúžia ako dôkaz na súde.

article_content: When Liverpool’s players complete their lap of honour on Sunday, they may find themselves reflecting on what could have been. However, it’s important not to lose sight of how much they have accomplished over the past 10 months. Liverpool have enjoyed an outstanding season and, for long stretches, were arguably the best team in England. While there’s still a slim chance they could be crowned champions if Manchester City unexpectedly stumble, it seems unlikely, as has happened in past close-fought campaigns, such as 2002 and 2009. Those Liverpool teams I played in were impressive, but history quickly forgets teams who don’t win trophies. For example, few remember the 2002 and 2009 sides because, despite their quality, they didn’t bring home any silverware. Most fans recall the Champions League-winning team from Istanbul in 2005, even though that squad was not as good as the current team Brendan Rodgers has built. Under Rodgers, Liverpool have been thrilling to watch, scoring freely and stringing together 11 consecutive Premier League wins. Much of Liverpool’s progress this season is down to Rodgers. Unlike the managers at Chelsea and Manchester City, Rodgers hasn’t relied on expensive signings. Instead, his work on the training pitch has been vital. Several players – such as Jordan Henderson, Raheem Sterling, and Daniel Sturridge – have developed significantly and now look set to feature prominently for England in the World Cup. If injuries occur, Jon Flanagan could also join them. Even seasoned stars like Steven Gerrard and Luis Suarez have improved under Rodgers’s guidance. Gerrard has excelled in a new deep-lying role, and Suarez’s impressive performance owes much to a tactically astute manager. Liverpool’s resurgence has come from Rodgers’s management, not from massive spending like the approaches of Fenway Sports Group’s counterparts at other top clubs. During my own closest title runs, a lack of quality signings after strong seasons held us back. For example, after a promising 2002 season, manager Gerard Houllier missed the opportunity to sign Nicolas Anelka and instead spent over £20 million on Salif Diao, El Hadji Diouf, and Bruno Cheyrou, none of whom met expectations. Similarly, in 2009, key players left or were replaced poorly. Selling Xabi Alonso and bringing in an injured Alberto Aquilani, as well as other underwhelming signings from previous windows, meant the squad lacked the depth to compete consistently. Injuries and suspensions exposed these shortcomings. There were transfers that never materialized, such as the attempt to bring back Michael Owen in 2009, and underestimating rivals like Chelsea proved costly as Liverpool slipped to seventh place with 63 points that season. Now, Liverpool must avoid previous mistakes. Their upcoming transfer decisions are crucial. Recent big-money signings, like Simon Mignolet and Mamadou Sakho, have been serviceable but need improvement. Others, including Iago Aspas, Luis Alberto, Victor Moses, and Aly Cissokho, have struggled to make an impact. As Liverpool prepare for the added demands of Champions League football, they need to sign players who strengthen the starting lineup, rather than just filling squad gaps. Rodgers deserves support and trust from the club's owners to make informed transfer decisions. Learning from the errors of 2002 and 2009, this season should be a platform for sustained success, not its peak. Rodgers has achieved a title challenge in just two seasons, playing an entertaining brand of football – faster than his predecessors. Regardless of how this season ends, Liverpool must aim to compete for the title every year going forward.

Liverpool mal vynikajúcu sezónu a dlhé obdobia bol pravdepodobne najlepším tímom v Anglicku. Stále existuje malá šanca, že by mohli byť korunovaní za šampiónov, ak by Manchester City nečakane zaváhal, no zdá sa to nepravdepodobné, podobne ako v ťažkých sezónach v rokoch 2002 a 2009. Tie tímy Liverpoolu, v ktorých som hrával, boli pôsobivé, ale história rýchlo zabúda na tímy, ktoré nezískajú trofeje. Napríklad len málokto si pamätá roky 2002 a 2009, pretože napriek kvalitám nedoniesli žiadne striebro. Väčšina fanúšikov si spomína na tím, ktorý v roku 2005 vyhral Ligu majstrov v Istanbule, aj keď tá zostava nebola taká dobrá ako súčasný tím Brendana Rodgersa. Pod Rodgersovým vedením je Liverpool radosť sledovať – dávajú veľa gólov a vyhrali 11 ligových zápasov v rade. Veľká časť pokroku Liverpoolu v tejto sezóne je zásluhou Rodgersa. Na rozdiel od manažérov Chelsea a Manchestru City sa nespoliehal na drahé nákupy, ale na tvrdú prácu na tréningovom ihrisku. Viacerí hráči – ako Jordan Henderson, Raheem Sterling a Daniel Sturridge – výrazne pokročili a teraz majú šancu hrať významnú rolu v anglickej reprezentácii na Majstrovstvách sveta. Ak sa niekto zraní, k nim sa môže pridať aj Jon Flanagan. Aj skúsení hráči ako Steven Gerrard a Luis Suarez sa pod Rodgersom zlepšili. Gerrard vyniká na novej, hlbšej pozícii a Suarezov úžasný výkon je z veľkej časti vďaka takticky uvažujúcemu manažérovi. Vzkriesenie Liverpoolu je zásluhou Rodgersa, nie masívnych nákupov, ako to robili vlastníci iných veľkých klubov. Počas mojich najbližších titulových pokusov nás spomalila práve absencia kvalitných posíl po silných sezónach. Napríklad po sľubnej sezóne 2002 manažér Houllier upustil od podpisu Nicolasa Anelku a namiesto toho minul viac než 20 miliónov libier na Salifa Diaa, El Hadjiho Dioufa a Bruna Cheyroua, ktorí nenaplnili očakávania. Podobne v roku 2009 odišli alebo boli zle nahradení kľúčoví hráči. Predali Xabiho Alonsa a priviedli zraneného Alberta Aquilaniho, ďalšie posily z predchádzajúcich okien tiež neboli dostatočné. Tím tak nemal dostatok hĺbky na súťaž, zranenia a dištancie to odhalili. Boli aj transfery, ktoré sa nepodarili, napríklad pokus priviesť Michaela Owena v roku 2009, a podceňovanie rivalov ako Chelsea nás stálo veľa, keď Liverpool skončil siedmy so 63 bodmi. Teraz sa musí Liverpool vyhnúť minulým chybám. Nadchádzajúce transfery budú kľúčové. Veľké nákupy ako Simon Mignolet a Mamadou Sakho boli slušné, ale potrebujú sa zlepšiť. Ďalší – Iago Aspas, Luis Alberto, Victor Moses a Aly Cissokho – sa nepresadili. S blížiacou sa Ligou majstrov potrebuje Liverpool priviesť hráčov, ktorí posilnia základnú jedenástku, nielen rozšíria káder. Rodgers si zaslúži finančnú podporu a dôveru vlastníkov klubu, aby mohol robiť správne transferové rozhodnutia. Ak sa poučia z chýb z rokov 2002 a 2009, táto sezóna môže slúžiť ako odrazový mostík k ďalším úspechom, nie jej vrchol. Rodgers za dva roky dokázal to, čo jeho predchodcovia nestihli za štyri – priviedol tím do boja o titul a pri tom hral atraktívny futbal. Bez ohľadu na výsledok tejto sezóny, Liverpool by mal mať v pláne bojovať o titul každý rok.

article_content: President Obama has referred to his administration’s approach to the Gulf of Mexico oil spill as 'relentless,' following the Deepwater Horizon rig disaster. After meeting with officials in Louisiana, the region under immediate threat, Obama highlighted that stopping the leak may take time, even with cutting-edge technology in use. He reaffirmed the government's commitment to deploy all necessary resources to restore the Gulf and mend the resulting damage. Joined by leaders like Coast Guard Adm. Thad Allen, EPA head Lisa Jackson, and Louisiana Governor Bobby Jindal, Obama received the latest updates on cleanup strategies and the economic and environmental impact of the spill. He traveled from New Orleans to Venice, the main coordination point for response efforts, to see progress directly. Homeland Security Secretary Janet Napolitano, Interior Secretary Ken Salazar, and Adm. Allen explained in media interviews that the situation could persist for weeks, with Salazar calling the potential consequences 'catastrophic.' Officials pointed to a malfunction in the blowout preventer—critical for preventing such disasters—as a key cause. BP, the owner of the damaged well, has acknowledged uncertainty over the failure and is intensifying attempts to resolve the crisis. While BP holds legal responsibility for halting the leak and cleaning up, officials are pressing the company to scale up its response. BP’s president Lamar McKay likened their efforts to 'open-heart surgery at 5,000 feet in the dark,' and noted that drilling relief wells, which could ultimately stop the flow, may take months. The spill has already brought fishing and tourism to a standstill in much of the Gulf Coast, with local and state leaders, including Sen. Mary Landrieu and Rep. Charlie Melancon, demanding stronger federal pressure on BP. Environmental experts warn of decades-long impacts on the region’s wetlands and wildlife. Following the April 20 explosion that led to 11 workers missing and presumed dead, around 1.6 million gallons of oil have spilled, according to the Coast Guard. In response, the administration has ordered inspections on other rigs’ blowout preventers, insisting BP will bear all costs related to the disaster.
translated_content: Prezident Obama označil reakciu svojej administratívy na ropnú škvrnu v Mexickom zálive za „neúnavnú“ po havárii plošiny Deepwater Horizon. Po stretnutí s predstaviteľmi v Louisiane, ktorá je bezprostredne ohrozená, zdôraznil, že zastavenie úniku môže trvať dlhšie – aj napriek využitiu najmodernejšej technológie. Opätovne potvrdil záväzok vlády nasadiť všetky dostupné zdroje na obnovu zálivu a napravenie škôd. Obama spolu s lídrami ako admirál pobrežnej stráže Thad Allen, šéfkou EPA Lisou Jackson a guvernérom Louisiany Bobbym Jindalom získal najnovšie informácie o stratégiách čistenia a ekonomických i environmentálnych dôsledkoch škvrny. Cestoval z New Orleans do Venice, hlavného koordinačného bodu zásahu, aby osobne videl postup prác. Ministerka vnútornej bezpečnosti Janet Napolitano, minister vnútra Ken Salazar a admirál Allen v rozhovoroch uviedli, že situácia môže pretrvávať týždne, pričom Salazar označil možné dôsledky za „katastrofálne“. Úradníci ako hlavný dôvod poukazujú na zlyhanie technológie blowout preventera, ktorá mala takejto havárii zabrániť. BP, vlastník poškodeného vrtu, pripustila neistotu pri zisťovaní príčiny a znásobuje snahu zastaviť únik. BP zodpovedá za zastavenie úniku a upratovanie, no predstavitelia na firmu tlačia, aby zintenzívnila svoje aktivity. Prezident BP Lamar McKay prirovnal ich snahu k „operácii otvoreného srdca v 1 500 metrovej hĺbke v tme“. Vŕtanie záchranných vrtov, ktoré by mohli definitívne zastaviť únik, však môže trvať mesiace. Ropná škvrna už zastavila rybolov aj turizmus na väčšine pobrežia, pričom miestni i štátni lídri, vrátane senátorky Mary Landrieu a kongresmana Charlieho Melancona, žiadajú od federálnej vlády silnejší tlak na BP. Odborníci na životné prostredie varujú pred dlhodobými následkami na mokrade a faunu v regióne. Po explózii 20. apríla, pri ktorej zmizlo a je predpoklad úmrtia 11 pracovníkov, uniklo podľa pobrežnej stráže približne 6 miliónov litrov ropy. Vláda zároveň nariadila kontrolu preventerov aj na iných vrtoch a trvá na tom, že všetky škody uhradí BP.

article_content:
After our family’s recent holiday in Croatia, I flipped through the many photos collected on our phones, only to realize I didn’t appear in any—a familiar result of never liking my own picture taken. My teenage daughters, Flo and Annie, meanwhile, had taken countless selfies, documenting every beach day, rocky sunbathe, and mocktail moment. Their confidence shone through in every shot, leaving me both proud and a little envious.

Watching them, it’s hard not to reflect on how different their teenage years are from mine. While they move through adolescence with ease, I was always deeply self-conscious about my looks as a teen—sensitive to my birthmark and jawline, and feeling out of place despite having good-looking parents. Their reassurances that I had “interesting” features never quite lessened my self-doubt.

In response, I poured my energy into developing other traits: acting in school plays, striving to be a great friend, even bending the rules occasionally for the sake of belonging. Looking back, much of it was to counterbalance the insecurity I felt on the outside.

Today, Flo and Annie don’t have to navigate those same challenges. They seem immune to exclusion or critique over their appearances; compliments and messages stream in whenever they share selfies or updates online. That’s a relief, especially given studies like The Good Childhood Report, which show how widespread self-image concerns are for girls today.

Of course, my daughters can still list off perceived flaws, but their insecurities seem far lighter than mine ever were. Annie, at 13, charms people with ease (if only to get an extra treat at the takeaway), and Flo, 15, has even been compared to a young Jerry Hall.

Sometimes, I wish they understood more about people whose confidence doesn’t come so readily, but the best I can do is support them with encouragement. I remember reading about how Sarah Ferguson boosted her own daughters’ self-confidence with daily affirmations—a strategy I try to emulate.

Ultimately, none of us chooses the features we inherit. Recently, while we stood in front of the mirror together, Flo said, “Mum, you’re beautiful in your own way.” Maybe, as mothers, we need to hear that from our daughters, too.

article_content: Ben Cowburn, 18, from Truro, Cornwall, died after a series of suicide attempts, following claims he was pressured into sexual activities by a television celebrity referred to as 'Mr X'. An inquest heard that Ben was introduced to a hedonistic lifestyle after becoming Mr X’s stylist. Ben reportedly felt uncomfortable and pressured to perform sexual acts with Mr X, leading to feelings of disgust and distress. Ben met Mr X in a London pub and was allegedly persuaded to strip in front of a group of men, who then touched him inappropriately. On another occasion, Mr X is said to have entered Ben's bed. Following a fallout with Mr X, Ben made several suicide attempts and was later admitted to a mental health hospital. Four days after taking a serious drug overdose, Ben was found dead on December 20, 2010. The celebrity has never been arrested or formally questioned regarding Ben’s allegations. A month before his death, Ben was found by police wandering on a road near his home and told officers this was his 43rd suicide attempt. Detective Constable Joanna Sodergren told the inquest that Ben disclosed being hurt by men in London over about five months, and shared feelings of self-loathing and wanting to forget the incidents. Ben expressed that he felt pressured rather than forcibly assaulted, clarifying that while he did not consider it rape, he agreed to acts because of the pressure placed on him. Ben's struggles were recorded in journals, including one entry stating he made 15 suicide attempts in 48 hours. After Ben’s death, police recovered his journals and other personal items. Local officers contacted Scotland Yard, suggesting Ben might have been the victim of a serious sexual assault. The Metropolitan Police investigated but did not charge or question Mr X. The coroner asked whether Ben was subjected to criminal or coercive sexual activity; Detective Constable Sodergren said she could not comment on the Met's conclusions. The inquest revealed Ben had a history involving drug use such as cannabis, amphetamines, MDMA, and cocaine, and ongoing family difficulties. Mr X’s identity remains protected under an agreement with Ben’s family and the NHS. The inquest is ongoing.

Súdna pitva odhalila, že Ben sa dostal do hedonistického životného štýlu po tom, čo sa stal stylista pána X. Ben sa údajne cítil nepohodlne a pod tlakom vykonávať so známou osobnosťou sexuálne akty, čo viedlo k pocitom odporu a trápenia. Bena stretol pána X v londýnskej krčme, kde ho údajne presvedčil, aby sa vyzliekol pred skupinou mužov, ktorí sa ho potom nevhodne dotýkali. Pri inej príležitosti mal pán X vliezť Benovi do postele. Po hádke s pánom X sa Ben niekoľkokrát pokúsil o samovraždu a neskôr bol prijatý na psychiatrické oddelenie. Štyri dni po tom, čo Ben užil veľkú dávku liekov, ho 20. decembra 2010 našli mŕtveho. Celebrita nikdy nebola zatknutá ani formálne vypočúvaná v súvislosti s Benovými obvineniami. Mesiac pred smrťou ho polícia našla blúdiť po ceste blízko jeho domova a Ben im povedal, že ide o jeho 43. pokus o samovraždu. Detektívka Joanna Sodergren na súde uviedla, že Ben policajtom povedal, že bol ubližovaný mužmi v Londýne počas približne piatich mesiacov a vyjadril pocity odporu voči sebe a túžil na celú záležitosť zabudnúť. Ben priznal, že sa cítil byť pod tlakom, skôr než násilne nútený, a upresnil, že to nepovažuje za znásilnenie, súhlasil s aktmi kvôli vyvíjanému tlaku. Jeho ťažkosti boli zaznamenané v denníkoch, vrátane zápisu, kde uviedol, že sa počas 48 hodín pokúsil o samovraždu 15-krát. Po Benovej smrti polícia zaistila jeho denníky a ďalšie osobné veci. Miestni policajti kontaktovali Scotland Yard, pretože mali podozrenie, že Ben sa mohol stať obeťou vážneho sexuálneho napadnutia. Metropolitná polícia vyšetrovala, ale pána X neobvinila ani nevypočula. Súdna lekárka sa opýtala, či Ben nebol predmetom trestnej či nátlakovej sexuálnej aktivity; detektívka Sodergren uviedla, že sa nemôže vyjadriť k záverom Metropolitnej polície. Súdna pitva odhalila, že Ben mal v minulosti problémy s užívaním drog ako konope, amfetamíny, MDMA a kokaín, a pretrvávajúce rodinné ťažkosti. Identita pána X zostáva utajená na základe dohody s Benovou rodinou a NHS. Súdne konanie pokračuje.

article_content: General Prayuth Chan-ocha, the leader of Thailand's military junta, has warned protesters, the media, and political opponents not to criticize or cause unrest following his official endorsement by King Bhumibol Adulyadej. Wearing a white military uniform at a news conference in Bangkok, Prayuth stated the country risked a return to past instability if opposition figures continued to cause division. His comments followed the king's royal command for 'reconciliation among the people.' Soldiers carrying firearms patrolled outside army headquarters ahead of Prayuth's press conference. Prayuth expressed concern about violent confrontations between the ousted government and protestors. He justified last Thursday’s coup as necessary to restore order after seven months of political turmoil and violence. 'The most important thing right now is to keep peace and order in the country. When conflict intensified and violence became a threat, we had to take action,' Prayuth said. Since last November, sporadic violence has resulted in 28 deaths and over 800 injuries in grenade attacks, gunfights, and shootings. Prayuth insisted, 'Our intentions are pure, and we will be transparent. Everyone needs to help me. Do not criticize, do not start problems. It’s no use.' His warnings came as people protested the military coup in central Bangkok. The military has worked to limit protests by detaining prominent figures, including former Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra, her Cabinet, and dozens of politicians and activists. Dozens of activists, academics, and journalists have been ordered to report to military officials, with more than 200 people—mostly government opponents—summoned via public broadcasts. The status of Yingluck and other detainees is unclear. Some have been released, and the military stated most will be released after about a week. Prayuth urged the media to 'control your message,' saying those who post on Facebook to incite unrest are acting against the peace of the country. 'Do you really want to go back to the old days?' Prayuth asked. 'If so, I will have to enforce the law.'
translated_content: Generál Prayuth Chan-ocha, líder thajskej vojenskej junty, varoval protestujúcich, médiá a politických oponentov, aby nešírili kritiku alebo nespôsobovali nepokoje po jeho oficiálnom potvrdení kráľom Bhumibolom Adulyadejom. V bielej vojenskej uniforme počas tlačovej konferencie v Bangkoku vyhlásil, že krajinu čaká návrat k nestabilite, ak budú opozičné osobnosti pokračovať v rozdeľovaní spoločnosti. Jeho vyjadrenia nasledovali po kráľovskom príkaze na 'zmierenie medzi ľuďmi.' Vojaci so zbraňami hliadkovali pred sídlom armády ešte pred Prayuthovou tlačovou konferenciou. Prayuth vyjadril obavy zo stále násilnejších stretov medzi zosadenou vládou a demonštrantmi. Štvrtkový prevrat označil za nevyhnutný na obnovenie poriadku po siedmich mesiacoch politického napätia a násilia. „Najdôležitejšie teraz je udržať v krajine mier a poriadok. Keď sa konflikt vystupňoval a násilie sa stalo hrozbou, museli sme konať,“ uviedol Prayuth. Od minulého novembra si sporadické násilnosti vyžiadali 28 mŕtvych a viac ako 800 zranených v dôsledku útokov granátmi, prestreliek a streľby. Prayuth zdôraznil: „Naše úmysly sú čisté a budeme transparentní. Každý mi musí pomôcť. Nekritizujte, nerobte problémy. To nemá zmysel.“ Varovania zazneli počas protestov proti vojenskému prevratu v centre Bangkoku. Armáda sa snažila obmedziť protesty zadržiavaním významných osobností, vrátane bývalej premiérky Yingluck Shinawatrovej, jej kabinetu a desiatok politikov a aktivistov. Desiatky aktivistov, akademikov a novinárov boli povolané k výsluchu na vojenské úrady, pričom viac ako 200—väčšinou odporcov novej vlády—bolo oficiálne predvolaných cez verejné vysielanie. Status Yingluck a ďalších zadržaných nie je jasný. Niektorých už prepustili a armáda tvrdí, že väčšina bude prepustená asi po týždni. Prayuth vyzval médiá, aby 'ovládali svoje správy' a upozornil, že tí, ktorí na Facebooku podnecujú nepokoje, konajú proti mieru v krajine. „Naozaj sa chcete vrátiť do starých čias?“ opýtal sa Prayuth. „Ak áno, budem musieť uplatniť zákon.“

article_content:
North and South Korea have experienced decades of tension, remaining in a state of conflict and fragile peace since the Korean War. Renowned photojournalist Mark Edward Harris, who has gained unique access to North Korea, marks the 60th anniversary of the war's armistice with a new photo collection from South Korea. Harris has visited both North and South Korea about eight times each, capturing daily life on the divided peninsula. His first journey to North Korea was in 2005, and he published a book of his photographs in 2007. Now, his latest book offers a glimpse into life in South Korea beyond Seoul and the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), areas that often capture international attention. In an interview with Korea.net, Harris emphasized his impartial perspective: 'I am not trying to make any judgment.'

Harris's photography goes beyond the capitals, exploring the authentic experiences of people in both North and South Korea. One striking image is of two young girls in matching pink coats, unfazed by sharks swimming above them in the massive 6,030-ton tank at the Aqua Planet Yeosu aquarium, the largest in South Korea. Another photograph features the right hand of the Hand of Harmony sculpture emerging from the waters off Homigot beach, while the left hand stands on dry land at Korea's easternmost point. Created from bronze and granite in 1999, the sculptures are especially striking at sunrise.

Harris also documents spiritual life, capturing the Dosoram Hermitage on Mount Dalmasan, part of the Mihwangsa Buddhist temple established in 749 during the Silla Dynasty. 'South Korea is so successful; it is a completely different world,' he commented, reflecting on the country's transformation and the generational divide since the peninsula's separation.

Sharing insights with My Modern Metropolis, Harris described vast changes in North Korea since his first visit. Streets once empty now have thousands of cars, and there are new establishments like an Italian pizza parlor, an Austrian coffee house, and a British-style pub in Pyongyang. Exploring regions beyond the showcase capital, he has observed historical changes that go beyond official propaganda.

Harris’s passion for history stems from his academic background; he holds a master’s degree in the subject. His work has appeared in publications such as The Times, The New York Times, the Los Angeles Times, Vogue, Elle, Life, and Harper's Bazaar.

The photo series includes diverse scenes: Jeju Island's three scenic waterfalls, tourist favorites; the 240-foot Expo Tower in Sokcho, built for the 1999 Gangwon International Tourism Expo; the mausoleum of Sejong the Great in Yeoju, and monks praying at the sixth-century Seonunsa temple. Harris also captures moments near the DMZ, such as South Korean soldiers standing near Daeseong-dong, a village close to the 'Bridge of No Return' and just a mile from North Korea’s Kijong-Dong.

Some photos reflect recent conflict, including damage caused by North Korean artillery during the November 2010 bombardment of Yeonpyeong Island, where four South Koreans were killed. Harris also photographed the room where an artillery shell pierced the roof during the incident.

The collection further explores modern life: cheerleaders at Seoul’s Jamsil baseball stadium, the city’s skyline framed by mountains, and dancers at the 2010 Arirang Mass Games in Pyongyang's May Day Stadium. Harris documents the elaborate mass games, noting that tourists have only recently been allowed to witness these grand displays celebrating North Korean history. He shows schoolchildren participating in the games as early as age five.

Traveling to Kaesong, an accessible tourist destination in North Korea, Harris photographs Tongil Street. Iconic Pyongyang landmarks include the 98-foot Juche Tower, symbolizing the country’s self-reliance ideology, and the Mansudae Grand Monument with statues of founding leader Kim Il-Sung and his son Kim Jong-Il. For Kim Il-Sung’s 100th birthday, Harris witnessed citizens gathering for military parades in Pyongyang.

Additional images reveal daily life: a traffic officer in a fur-trimmed uniform directs snowy Pyongyang traffic; the sacred volcano Paekdu Mountain with its crater lake on the Chinese border; and portraits of Kim Il-Sung and Kim Jong-Il hanging in Tumangang’s train station near Russia. Other photos include families braving winter in Pyongyang and alongside the train station, and scenes from the DMZ, with soldiers facing each other across the divide.

Harris’s rare access allowed visits to Wonsan, usually closed to tourists, and a panoramic view of Pyongyang from the Yanggakdo Hotel, the city's second-tallest building, overlooking the Taedong River.
