article_content: On May 23, President Barack Obama delivered an important speech at the National Defense University in Washington, signaling his intention to recalibrate the U.S. counterterrorism strategy, particularly the covert CIA drone program. The program has faced growing public and congressional scrutiny in recent years. Obama did not provide specifics on future changes to the CIA drone program. However, he emphasized the U.S. would continue to reserve the right to use force against terrorists posing an ongoing and imminent threat to the American people. The overarching message was a shift towards greater restraint in U.S. national security policy. He stated, 'Before any strike is taken, there must be near-certainty that no civilians will be killed or injured—the highest standard we can set.' Since then, analysis by the New America Foundation, based on news reports, indicates that the Obama administration has significantly reduced the number of CIA drone strikes in Pakistan, and slowed the pace in Yemen. The targets now more often include leaders of al Qaeda and affiliated groups rather than lower-level operatives. Nevertheless, civilian casualties still occur, and concerns about transparency and legal sustainability remain. Over the five months following Obama's speech, only 10 drone strikes occurred in Pakistan—about one every 15 days, compared to one every eight days the previous year. The average death toll per strike, around six, has remained roughly the same. Reports indicate four senior militant leaders were killed by drone strikes in Pakistan and Yemen since Obama's speech, a higher rate of 'high-value' targeting than in the prior year, which saw seven such leaders killed in 44 strikes. In Yemen, the frequency of drone strikes also slowed, with 12 strikes since May 23 (about one every 13 days), compared to one every 10 days the year before. The average number of casualties per strike was 4.5 recently, down from six previously. Civilian casualty rates from drone strikes in Pakistan have decreased since 2009. According to both the New America Foundation and the Bureau of Investigative Journalism, there have been no confirmed civilian deaths from drone strikes in Pakistan during 2013 up to this point. In contrast, a strike in Yemen killed a 10-year-old boy in Al Jawf province on June 9, and two civilians reportedly died on August 8. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch released reports this week highlighting civilian casualties from drone strikes in Pakistan and Yemen over recent years. Amnesty's report recalls that in October 2012, a 68-year-old woman, Mamana Bibi, was killed in Pakistan while picking vegetables with her grandchildren, several of whom were injured. Amnesty expressed concern that these strikes may constitute unlawful killings or even war crimes. Despite these investigations, the full scope of the U.S. drone campaign remains unclear without greater transparency from the government. As Louis Brandeis wrote, 'Sunlight is the best disinfectant.' A practical proposal is to establish an independent U.S. government body, separate from the CIA and Pentagon, to review drone strikes and verify that victims were legitimate targets and not civilians. Such a body could also provide compensation to civilian victims, similar to mechanisms already used by the U.S. military in conventional war zones. This would help families mentioned by Amnesty International access medical care without selling property. International law often trails technological advances in warfare. Chemical weapons, for example, were not banned until 1925, after widespread use. Existing laws have not kept pace with drone capabilities, such as remote-controlled targeted killings. A future protocol, like those of the Geneva Conventions, may be necessary to regulate drones. Such protocols could be controversial—some might see them as legitimizing drone warfare, while others might fear limitations on U.S. military power. Still, the spread of armed drones, including China's recent consideration of a drone assassination, makes global regulation urgent. As the U.S. justifies strikes against al Qaeda and its affiliates, other nations might adopt similar justifications. Therefore, the U.S. should enhance transparency and accountability in its drone program and help shape international consensus on the use of armed drones.

Tento program pritiahla v posledných rokoch čoraz väčšia verejná a kongresová pozornosť. Obama nepredložil konkrétne zmeny v rámci budúceho programu dronov CIA. Zdôraznil však, že USA si aj naďalej vyhradzujú právo použiť silu voči teroristom, ktorí predstavujú trvalú a bezprostrednú hrozbu pre americký národ. Hlavné posolstvo prejavu bolo zamerať sa na väčšiu zdržanlivosť v bezpečnostnej politike USA. Povedal: 'Pred uskutočnením akéhokoľvek útoku musí byť takmer isté, že nebudú zabití alebo zranení žiadni civilisti – najvyšší štandard, aký môžeme nastaviť.' Podľa analýzy nadácie New America Foundation, ktorá vychádza z mediálnych správ, administratíva prezidenta Obamu podstatne znížila počet útokov dronmi CIA v Pakistane a spomalila ich aj v Jemene. Cielene sú viac lídri al-Káidy a spriaznených skupín, nie radoví bojovníci. Civilné obete sa však stále vyskytujú a otázky ohľadom transparentnosti a právnych aspektov pretrvávajú. V Pakistane prebehlo za päť mesiacov po Obamovom prejave iba 10 útokov dronmi – približne jeden každých 15 dní oproti jednému za osem dní v predchádzajúcom roku. Priemerný počet obetí na útok sa drží na čísle šesť. Podľa správ boli po Obamovom prejave v Pakistane a Jemene usmrtení štyria vysokopostavení militanti, čo je vyšší podiel 'vysoko hodnotných' cieľov ako v predošlom roku, keď pri 44 útokoch zomrelo sedem takých lídrov. Tempo útokov dronmi v Jemene sa taktiež spomalilo – od 23. mája ich bolo 12 (približne jeden každých 13 dní), predtým jeden každých 10 dní. V poslednom čase bola priemerná obeť na útok 4,5, predtým šesť. V Pakistane civilné obete útokov dronmi od roku 2009 klesajú. Podľa New America Foundation aj Bureau of Investigative Journalism v roku 2013 neboli v Pakistane potvrdené žiadne civilné úmrtia spôsobené dronmi. Naproti tomu v Jemene pri útoku 9. júna v provincii Al Jawf zomrel 10-ročný chlapec a ďalšie dve civilné obete boli hlásené 8. augusta. Správy Amnesty International a Human Rights Watch vydané tento týždeň poukazujú na civilné obete útokov dronmi v Pakistane a Jemene za posledné roky. Amnesty v správe pripomína prípad z októbra 2012, keď bola v Pakistane zabitá 68-ročná Mamana Bibi pri zbere zeleniny s vnúčatami, z ktorých niekoľko utrpelo zranenia. Amnesty upozorňuje, že tieto a podobné útoky môžu byť nezákonným zabíjaním alebo dokonca vojnovými zločinmi. Aj napriek týmto vyšetrovaním je na objasnenie úplného rozsahu kampane dronov USA potrebná väčšia transparentnosť vlády. Ako povedal Louis Brandeis: 'Svetlo je najlepším dezinfekčným prostriedkom.' Jedným z návrhov je vznik nezávislého orgánu USA, oddeleného od CIA a Pentagónu, ktorý by hodnotil útoky dronmi a overoval, či boli obete legitímnymi cieľmi a nie civilistami. Takýto orgán by mohol poskytovať odškodné civilným obetiam, podobne ako to robí americká armáda vo vojnových zónach. To by umožnilo rodinám z prípadov Amnesty International získať zdravotnú starostlivosť bez predaja majetku. Medzinárodné právo často nestíha technologický pokrok vo vojenstve. Chemické zbrane boli oficiálne zakázané až v roku 1925, po ich užívaní. Súčasné právne normy nejdú ruka v ruke s možnosťami dronov, ako je diaľkové cielené zabíjanie. Budúci protokol podobný ženevským konvenciám by mohol regulovať použitie dronov. Takýto protokol môže byť kontroverzný – niektorí ho môžu považovať za legitimizáciu dronovej vojny, iní sa môžu obávať obmedzenia americkej sily. Šírenie ozbrojených dronov, vrátane pripravovaného útoku v Číne, však naliehavo vyžaduje globálnu reguláciu. Keď USA odôvodňujú útoky na al-Káidu a jej spojencov, iné krajiny môžu použiť podobnú rétoriku. Preto by mala Amerika zlepšiť transparentnosť a zodpovednosť svojho programu dronov a pomôcť vytvoriť medzinárodný konsenzus v oblasti používania ozbrojených dronov.

article_content: India had the highest number of pre-term births in 2020, recording 3.02 million cases—over 20 percent of global pre-term births. Other countries with high numbers include Pakistan, Nigeria, China, Ethiopia, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and the USA. These findings are featured in a special issue of The Lancet commemorating its 200th anniversary. Pre-term birth is defined as childbirth occurring before 37 weeks of gestation and is a significant risk factor for mortality in children under five. In India, pre-term births decreased only marginally from 3.49 million in 2010 to 3.02 million in 2020. Globally, the pre-term birth rate showed little change, moving from 9.8 percent to 9.9 percent of live births between 2010 and 2020. Approximately 15 percent of all pre-term births in the past decade occurred before 32 weeks of gestation, underscoring the urgent need for better prenatal and neonatal care. Dr. Umesh Vaidya, chief neonatologist at KEM and Ankura Hospital, Pune, explains that pre-term births are not entirely preventable due to varying case-specific factors, such as acute or long-standing illnesses in mothers, multiple pregnancies, and cervical issues. Dr. Aarti Kinikar, Professor and Head of Pediatrics and Vice Dean at B J Government Medical College, Pune, highlights the importance of improving data collection and analysis to design targeted interventions for reducing pre-term births. Many pre-term birth survivors face lifetime challenges, including learning disabilities, behavioral disorders, and visual or hearing impairments. The global burden of pre-term births is likely underestimated, especially in low- and middle-income countries, due to poor data systems, inaccurate gestational age measurement, and lack of routine record-keeping. According to the report, the largest gaps in data exist in southern Asia and sub-Saharan Africa—regions with the highest burden of pre-term births. The study authors stress the need for countries to prioritize investments to prevent pre-term births and ensure high-quality, evidence-based care, alongside improving data systems for accountability. There is some positive news: thirteen countries, including Austria, Brazil, Brunei, Czechia, Denmark, Germany, Hungary, Latvia, the Netherlands, Singapore, Spain, Sweden, and Switzerland, achieved reductions in pre-term birth rates of 0.5 percent or more over the past decade.
translated_content: India mala v roku 2020 najvyšší počet predčasných pôrodov na svete – zaznamenala 3,02 milióna prípadov, čo predstavuje viac než 20 percent všetkých prípadov globálne. Medzi ďalšie krajiny s vysokým počtom patria Pakistan, Nigéria, Čína, Etiópia, Bangladéš, Konžská demokratická republika a USA. Tieto zistenia sú uvedené v špeciálnom vydaní časopisu The Lancet pri príležitosti jeho 200. výročia. Predčasný pôrod je definovaný ako pôrod pred ukončením 37. týždňa tehotenstva a znamená významné riziko úmrtia detí do piatich rokov. V Indii sa počet predčasných pôrodov znížil len nepatrne z 3,49 milióna v roku 2010 na 3,02 milióna v roku 2020. Celosvetovo sa miera predčasných pôrodov prakticky nezmenila – z 9,8 percenta na 9,9 percenta všetkých pôrodov medzi rokmi 2010 a 2020. Približne 15 percent všetkých predčasných pôrodov za posledné desaťročie nastalo pred 32. týždňom tehotenstva, čo poukazuje na naliehavú potrebu lepšej predpôrodnej a novorodeneckej starostlivosti. Dr. Umesh Vaidya, hlavný neonatológ v nemocnici KEM a Ankura v Pune, vysvetľuje, že predčasným pôrodom sa nedá úplne predísť, keďže príčiny sú individuálne a závisia napríklad od akútnych alebo dlhodobých zdravotných ťažkostí matky, viacplodového tehotenstva či problémov s krčkom maternice. Dr. Aarti Kinikar, profesorka a vedúca pediatrie a zástupkyňa dekana na B J Government Medical College v Pune, zdôrazňuje potrebu zlepšiť zber a analýzu údajov, aby bolo možné cielene zasahovať pri znižovaní počtu predčasných pôrodov. Mnoho detí narodených predčasne čelí celoživotným výzvam, vrátane porúch učenia, správania alebo zrakových a sluchových postihnutí. Skutočný rozsah predčasných pôrodov vo svete je pravdepodobne podhodnotený, najmä v krajinách s nízkymi a strednými príjmami, kvôli slabým systémom evidencie, nepresným odhadom dĺžky tehotenstva a nedostatku rutinného zberu dát. Podľa správy sú najväčšie medzery v dátach v južnej Ázii a subsaharskej Afrike – regiónoch s najvyšším počtom predčasných pôrodov. Autori štúdie vyzývajú krajiny, aby prioritne investovali do prevencie predčasných pôrodov, zabezpečili kvalitnú starostlivosť a zlepšili systémy údajov na účely zodpovednosti. Nádej prinášajú výsledky z trinástich krajín: Rakúska, Brazílie, Bruneja, Česka, Dánska, Nemecka, Maďarska, Lotyšska, Holandska, Singapuru, Španielska, Švédska a Švajčiarska, kde v poslednom desaťročí došlo k poklesu predčasných pôrodov o 0,5 percenta alebo viac.

WASHINGTON: Antarctica was not always a frozen wasteland of ice and snow. Earth's southernmost continent once featured rivers and lush forests teeming with life. Today, thanks to satellite imagery and ice-penetrating radar, scientists are peering into Antarctica's hidden past. On Tuesday, researchers announced they have discovered a vast ancient landscape buried beneath the continent’s ice sheet. This hidden terrain—full of valleys and ridges—appears to have been shaped by rivers before being overtaken by ice millions of years ago. The landscape, found in East Antarctica’s Wilkes Land near the Indian Ocean, spans an area about the size of Belgium or the US state of Maryland. The study suggests the landscape dates back at least 14 million years, possibly as far as 34 million years ago, around the time when Antarctica entered its deep freeze.

"The landscape is like a snapshot of the past," said Stewart Jamieson, a glaciology professor at Durham University in England and co-leader of the study published in the journal Nature Communications. "It's difficult to know exactly what this lost world looked like before it was covered by ice, but back then it was certainly much warmer. Depending on how far back you go, climates might have ranged from something like modern-day Patagonia to nearly tropical. Ancient palm tree pollen has even been found not far from our study site in Antarctica," Jamieson added.

Such an environment likely supported wildlife, though Jamieson notes the fossil record is too limited to confirm which animals lived there. According to Neil Ross, professor of polar science and environmental geophysics at Newcastle University and study co-leader, the ice overlying the ancient landscape is about 2.2 to 3 kilometers thick.

WASHINGTON: Antarktída nebola vždy mrazivou pustatinou plnou ľadu a snehu. Najjužnejší kontinent Zeme kedysi skrýval rieky a bujné lesy prekypujúce životom. Dnes sa vedci vďaka satelitným snímkam a radaru prenikajúcemu ľadom pozerajú do jej skrytej minulosti. V utorok vedci oznámili, že pod antarktickým ľadovým štítom objavili rozsiahlu prastarú krajinu. Toto skryté územie – plné údolí a hrebeňov – podľa všetkého vytvorili rieky ešte predtým, než ho pred miliónmi rokov pokryli ľadovce. Krajina sa nachádza vo Wilkes Land vo východnej Antarktíde pri Indickom oceáne a zaberá oblasť veľkosti Belgicka alebo štátu Maryland v USA. Štúdia naznačuje, že táto krajina je stará najmenej 14 miliónov rokov, možno až 34 miliónov rokov, približne v období, keď Antarktída začala zamŕzať.

"Táto krajina je ako momentka z minulosti," povedal Stewart Jamieson, profesor glaciológie na Durham University v Anglicku a spoluautor štúdie publikovanej v časopise Nature Communications. "Je ťažké presne vedieť, ako toto stratené miesto vyzeralo pred tým, ako ho zakryl ľad, ale vtedy bolo určite oveľa teplejšie. Podľa obdobia, do ktorého sa pozrieme, tu mohlo panovať podnebie podobné dnešnej Patagónii alebo dokonca takmer tropické. Neďaleko miesta nášho výskumu v Antarktíde sa dokonca objavil aj prastarý peľ paliem," dodal Jamieson.

Takéto prostredie pravdepodobne podporovalo množstvo živočíchov, no fosílne dôkazy sú príliš obmedzené na to, aby sa dalo presne určiť, aké druhy tam žili. Podľa profesora polárnej vedy a environmentálnej geofyziky Neila Rossa z Newcastle University a spoluautora štúdie je vrstva ľadu nad touto prastarou krajinou hrubá približne 2,2 až 3 kilometre.

article_content: People with long Covid often feel forgotten, unheard, disbelieved, and isolated, according to barrister Anthony Metzer KC, who represented advocacy groups at the Covid-19 Inquiry last month. An increasing number of people are experiencing secondary illnesses, such as mast cell activation syndrome (MCAS), which is thought to be triggered by long Covid, leading to heightened feelings of isolation. The article highlights the experiences of two young Londoners, George Cooper and Elle Gorman, both diagnosed with long Covid and now MCAS, who report poor treatment by some healthcare professionals. George Cooper, 27, from Putney, fell ill with suspected Covid-19 in March 2020 while recovering from glandular fever. Antibody tests later confirmed he had been exposed to the virus, and after months of symptoms, he was diagnosed with long Covid. George developed new food allergies, swollen lymph nodes, palpitations, fainting spells, and severe stomach pain. After more than two years, he was told by an NHS clinic that he might have MCAS, but his GP was unsupportive and said he had myalgic encephalomyelitis for life. A private consultant later suspected MCAS and prescribed antihistamines, but George suffered adverse reactions to the medication. He also developed non-viral hepatitis. Another GP was reportedly unreceptive and even angry about his suspected MCAS diagnosis. George lost significant weight and experienced severe mental and physical health difficulties. George was advised to attend an eating disorders clinic, where he found little improvement. Eventually, a biopsy confirmed he had MCAS. After receiving appropriate medication, he started to recover, although he remains wary of interactions with healthcare providers. There are currently no NICE guidelines for MCAS, making it difficult for NHS staff to recognize and treat the condition. Other countries, such as the United States, have begun to recognize MCAS, and research into its connection with long Covid continues to grow. Prof Danny Altmann of Imperial College London noted the need for more robust, large-scale studies. The NHS does not currently recognize MCAS, although other mast cell disorders like mastocytosis are acknowledged. The agency recommends those with ongoing symptoms after Covid-19 consult their GP, who can refer them to specialist long Covid clinics if needed. Elle Gorman, 19, a student from Greenwich, also encountered repeated dismissal of her symptoms after contracting Covid-19 at the start of the pandemic. She was misdiagnosed multiple times before a private consultant suspected MCAS. Starting the recommended medication has helped her, but she continues to struggle with self-doubt due to her previous experiences. Advocacy groups and researchers continue to call for improved guidance, better recognition, and more research into long Covid and MCAS.

Rastúci počet ľudí zažíva sekundárne ochorenia, ako je syndróm aktivácie mastocytov (MCAS), o ktorom sa predpokladá, že je spustený dlhým covidom, čo vedie k ešte väčšiemu pocitu izolácie. Článok poukazuje na skúsenosti dvoch mladých Londýnčanov – Georgea Coopera a Elle Gorman – ktorí boli diagnostikovaní s dlhým covidom aj MCAS a hlásia zlú skúsenosť s niektorými zdravotníkmi. George Cooper, 27-ročný muž z Putney, ochorel na podozrenie na covid-19 v marci 2020, keď sa zotavoval z mononukleózy. Protilátkové testy neskôr potvrdili, že bol vystavený vírusu, a po mesiacoch symptómov mu diagnostikovali dlhý covid. George utrpel nové potravinové alergie, zväčšené lymfatické uzliny, búšenie srdca, odpadávanie a silné bolesti brucha. Po viac ako dvoch rokoch mu v NHS klinike povedali, že môže mať MCAS, ale jeho všeobecný lekár ho nepodporil a tvrdil, že má myalgickú encefalomyelitídu na celý život. Georgeovi odporučili navštíviť kliniku pre poruchy príjmu potravy, kde sa mu však veľmi nepomohlo. Nakoniec biopsia potvrdila MCAS. Po nasadení vhodnej liečby sa začal zotavovať, hoci voči lekárom je stále opatrný. V súčasnosti neexistujú žiadne odporúčania NICE pre MCAS, čo zdravotníkom NHS sťažuje rozpoznanie a liečbu tohto ochorenia. V iných krajinách, napríklad v USA, už začali MCAS uznávať a výskum spojitosti s dlhým covidom stále rastie. Profesor Danny Altmann z Imperial College London poukázal na potrebu rozsiahlych a robustných štúdií. NHS v súčasnosti MCAS neuznáva, hoci iné poruchy mastocytov, ako je mastocytóza, uznáva. Inštitúcia odporúča ľuďom s pretrvávajúcimi symptómami po covide konzultáciu s praktickým lekárom, ktorý ich môže prípadne odoslať do špecializovanej long covid kliniky. Elle Gorman, 19-ročná študentka z Greenwichu, sa tiež opakovane stretávala s ignorovaním svojich symptómov po nakazení covidom na začiatku pandémie. Bola viackrát nesprávne diagnostikovaná, kým jej súkromný konzultant nepredpokladal MCAS. Liečba jej pomohla, no stále má pochybnosti o sebe v dôsledku predchádzajúcich skúseností. Pacientske skupiny a výskumníci naďalej žiadajú lepšie usmernenia, väčšiu informovanosť a viac výskumu o dlhom covide a MCAS.

article_content: During the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic, several new words, such as 'COVIDiots' and 'anti-vaxxers', became common in conversation. While many of these expressions were used only briefly, research by Lancaster University linguists Dr. Luke Collins and Professor Veronika Koller suggests that some terms—like 'zoom fatigue', linked to increased video conferencing, and 'lockdown'—are likely to remain. In their book 'Viral Language: Analysing the COVID-19 pandemic in public discourse', Dr. Collins and Professor Koller examine how language was used both about and during the pandemic. Through eight chapters, they show how experiences of health and illness were shaped by political messages, scientific research, news coverage, and advertising. For instance, governments communicated messages such as 'Stay home, save lives' on social media platforms like Twitter/X, giving concise advice to the public. Many politicians spoke of a 'war' on COVID, but journey metaphors—like 'we have come through the tunnel'—were also widely used to encourage unity and compliance with health restrictions. The authors note that scientific writing on COVID-19 sometimes included hyperbolic statements, for example describing studies as 'one of the most extensive datasets on individual transmission events', suggesting increased competition among researchers. British news media participated in discussions about what 'the science' really means and its role in policy decisions. Advertisers faced their own challenges, aiming for messages of empathy, community, and responsibility during lockdowns. Rather than completely change their branding, Budweiser continued to focus on sports and national identity, Heineken showed young people enjoying themselves at a social distance, and Stella Artois continued emphasizing its history and heritage. The book was motivated by the researchers' interest in how global crises, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, leave a lasting impact on language. The authors argue that language helps people make sense of and process major events. To analyze pandemic-related language, the authors studied a broad range of sources: more than 224 million words of scientific articles, 772 million words of news articles, and 12,000 tweets, using computer-assisted methods, as well as examples from social media and advertising. Professor Koller observes that their studies are relevant for anyone interested in how the language of news, politics, and advertising changed in response to the pandemic. Provided by Lancaster University. Citation: Researchers reveal the 'Viral Language' of the pandemic (2023, November 27), retrieved 28 November 2023 from https://phys.org/news/2023-11-reveal-viral-language-pandemic.html
translated_content: Počas počiatočných fáz pandémie COVID-19 sa v bežnej konverzácii objavilo niekoľko nových slov, ako napríklad „COVIDioti“ a „anti-vaxeri“. Mnohé z týchto výrazov sa používali len krátko, no výskum lingvistov z Lancaster University, doktora Luka Collinsa a profesorky Veroniky Koller, naznačuje, že niektoré termíny – ako „zoomová únava“, spojená so zvýšením videokonferenčných hovorov, a „lockdown“ – pravdepodobne zostanú zachované. Vo svojej knihe „Vírusový jazyk: Analýza pandémie COVID-19 vo verejnom diskurze“ doktori Collins a Kollerová skúmajú, ako sa o pandémii hovorilo a písalo. Prostredníctvom ôsmich kapitol ukazujú, ako boli skúsenosti so zdravím a chorobou ovplyvnené politickými správami, vedeckým výskumom, správami v médiách a reklamou. Napríklad vlády sprostredkovali posolstvá ako „Zostaňte doma, zachráňte životy“ na sociálnych sieťach ako Twitter/X, čím poskytovali verejnosti stručné rady. Mnohí politici hovorili o „vojne“ proti COVID-u, no rozšírené boli aj metafory cesty – ako napríklad „prešli sme tunelom“ – ktoré mali povzbudiť jednotu a dodržiavanie opatrení. Autori poznamenávajú, že vedecké písanie o COVID-19 niekedy obsahovalo hyperbolické vyjadrenia, napríklad štúdie označovali za „jedny z najrozsiahlejších údajov o individuálnych prenosoch“, čo naznačuje zvýšenú súťaživosť medzi výskumníkmi. Britské médiá sa zapájali do diskusií o tom, čo vlastne znamená „veda“ a akú má úlohu pri rozhodovaní politikov. Reklamné agentúry čelili výzve, ako komunikovať empatiu, komunitu a zodpovednosť počas lockdownov. Namiesto úplnej zmeny značky sa Budweiser naďalej zameriaval na šport a národnú identitu, Heineken ukazoval mladých ľudí, ako si užívajú zábavu na dištanc, a Stella Artois zdôraznila svoju históriu a dedičstvo. Kniha bola motivovaná záujmom výskumníkov zistiť, ako globálne krízy, akou bola aj pandémia COVID-19, zanechávajú trvalú stopu v jazyku. Autori tvrdia, že jazyk nám pomáha pochopiť a spracovať veľké udalosti. Aby analyzovali jazyk spojený s pandémiou, skúmali autori široký okruh zdrojov: viac ako 224 miliónov slov zo vedeckých článkov, 772 miliónov slov z novinových správ a 12 000 tweetov, pričom využili počítačovú analýzu, ako aj príklady zo sociálnych médií a reklám. Profesorka Kollerová uvádza, že ich výskum je zaujímavý pre každého, kto sa chce dozvedieť, ako sa jazyk médií, politiky a reklamy prispôsobil pandémii. Zdroj: Lancaster University. Citácia: Výskumníci objavujú „Vírusový jazyk“ pandémie (27. november 2023), získané 28. novembra 2023 z https://phys.org/news/2023-11-reveal-viral-language-pandemic.html

article_content: Mumbai: Chief Minister Eknath Shinde has stepped in to resolve the ongoing dispute between Shiv Sena leaders Ramdas Kadam and Gajanan Kirtikar regarding the Mumbai North-West Lok Sabha seat. Kirtikar, a two-time MP from the constituency, wishes to contest the upcoming elections again, while Kadam is hoping to secure the seat for his son, Siddhesh. The disagreement led to a public exchange of words, focusing on issues of loyalty, the potential candidacy of their sons, and the seat itself. Shinde first met with Kirtikar on Monday evening, followed by a meeting with Kadam at the official residence, Varsha, on Tuesday. According to party sources, Shinde firmly instructed Kadam to refrain from making public statements that could embarrass the party. After meeting the Chief Minister, Kadam stated the matter was resolved, although he insisted that Kirtikar should address such issues internally rather than in public. 'Kirtikar is an MP from the Mumbai North-West constituency, and we will support him if the party nominates him. I was unsettled by his allegations of betrayal and his public statement against me. Now, the controversy has ended,' Kadam added. Kirtikar similarly announced that the issue had been settled from his side and he would not respond to further remarks from Kadam. 'I have shared my views with the Chief Minister. Public arguments could send the wrong message to party workers, so regardless of Kadam's criticism, I won't respond. I am ready for any discussion the Chief Minister calls for,' Kirtikar commented. In the meantime, Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray has named Amol Kirtikar, Gajanan Kirtikar’s son, as the party’s candidate for Mumbai North-West. If Shinde’s group nominates Gajanan Kirtikar, a rare father-son contest could take place. Related developments: Ramdas Kadam and Gajanan Kirtikar recently engaged in a dispute over the seat and the possible candidacies of their sons. Both expressed determination to contest the elections. Separately, Shiv Sena (UBT) publicly criticized Chief Minister Eknath Shinde for supporting the BJP, accusing him of favoring the BJP’s interests over Maharashtra’s. Additionally, the BJP and its allies in Assam have held meetings to strategize for the upcoming Lok Sabha elections, aiming for success in all 14 state seats.

Kirtikar, dvojnásobný poslanec tejto oblasti, chce opäť kandidovať v nadchádzajúcich voľbách, zatiaľ čo Kadam by chcel kreslo pre svojho syna Siddhesh-a. Tento nesúhlas viedol k verejnej výmene názorov, ktorá sa točila okolo lojality, možnej kandidatúry ich synov a samotného kresla. Shinde sa najskôr stretol s Kirtikarom v pondelok večer, následne sa v utorok stretol s Kadamom v oficiálnej rezidencii Varsha. Podľa straníckych zdrojov Shinde dôrazne požiadal Kadama, aby sa zdržal verejných vyjadrení, ktoré by mohli stranu kompromitovať. Po stretnutí s hlavným ministrom Kadam vyhlásil, že záležitosť je vyriešená, no trval na tom, že Kirtikar by mal takéto veci riešiť interne, nie na verejnosti. 'Kirtikar je poslancom za Mumbai North-West a budeme ho podporovať, ak ho strana nominuje. Znepokojili ma jeho obvinenia zo zrady a verejné vyhlásenie proti mne. Verejné hádky by mohli poslať nesprávny odkaz členom strany, takže bez ohľadu na Kadamovu kritiku nebudem reagovať. Som pripravený na diskusiu, ak nás hlavný minister zavolá,' uviedol Kirtikar. Medzitým šéf Shiv Sena (UBT) Uddhav Thackeray oznámil kandidatúru Amola Kirtikara, syna Gajanana Kirtikara, za stranu v Mumbai North-West. Súvisiace udalosti: Ramdas Kadam a Gajanan Kirtikar sa nedávno dostali do sporu o kreslo a možné kandidatúry svojich detí. Obaja prejavili odhodlanie kandidovať. Zároveň Shiv Sena (UBT) verejne kritizovala hlavného ministra Eknatha Shindeho za podporu BJP, pričom mu vyčítali, že uprednostňuje záujmy BJP pred záujmami Maháraštry. Okrem toho BJP a jej spojenci v Assame rokovali o stratégiách pre voľby do Lok Sabha, s cieľom vyhrať všetkých 14 kresiel v štáte.

article_content: A 9-year-old boy who managed to board a flight to Las Vegas without a ticket or boarding pass has returned to his hometown of Minneapolis, a family spokesperson, V. J. Smith, confirmed Saturday night. Smith declined to provide further details, stating he would speak with the boy’s father on Sunday. Delta Air Lines crew members on the October 3rd flight became suspicious of the unaccompanied child and discovered he was not listed as a passenger. Authorities placed the boy in foster care while they investigated the incident. The Transportation Security Administration reported that the boy went through security at the Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport but did not clarify how he managed this without a boarding pass. Airport officials stated that surveillance video showed the boy speaking with a Delta gate agent before moving toward the plane while the agent was distracted. The boy’s father said his son has a behavioral problem and expressed disappointment that 'no one stepped up to help.' CNN’s Janet DiGiacomo contributed to this report.

J. Smith. Smith odmietol poskytnúť ďalšie podrobnosti a uviedol, že s otcom chlapca bude hovoriť v nedeľu. Členovia posádky spoločnosti Delta Air Lines na lete z 3. októbra začali byť podozrievaví voči neplnoletému cestujúcemu bez sprievodu a zistili, že nie je uvedený medzi pasažiermi. Orgány umiestnili chlapca do pestúnskej starostlivosti počas prebiehajúceho vyšetrovania tejto udalosti. Správa Dopravnej bezpečnostnej správy (TSA) uviedla, že chlapec prešiel kontrolou na letisku Minneapolis-St. Paul, ale nebolo objasnené, ako to dokázal bez palubného lístka. Úradníci letiska uviedli, že kamerový záznam ukázal, ako chlapec rozprával s pracovníkom spoločnosti Delta pri bráne a následne sa vydal k lietadlu, keď bol agent rozptýlený. Otec chlapca povedal, že jeho syn má problémové správanie a vyjadril sklamanie, že „nikto nezasiahol, aby pomohol.“ Na tejto správe sa podieľala aj Janet DiGiacomo z CNN.

article_content: When Lily, an eight-month-old ragdoll kitten, met Lucy, a fifteen-month-old African pygmy hedgehog, for the first time, their introduction was a bit prickly. Their owner, YouTuber Mamoth100, captured the moment on video and shared it online. Lily, known for her curiosity in several previous YouTube videos, tried to get acquainted with Lucy by reaching out with her paw, only to quickly back away after receiving a mild prick from Lucy's quills. Undeterred, Lily next attempted to sit on Lucy, but swiftly dashed away after another uncomfortable encounter. Afterwards, Lily kept her distance, reconsidering whether Lucy was a friend or a foe. The humorous and adorable interaction quickly went viral after it was posted on Friday, attracting over 300,000 views. The video, titled 'When Lily met Lucy,' features Lily’s hilarious reactions as she learns that making friends with a hedgehog has its challenges.

Ich majiteľka, YouTuberka Mamoth100, tento okamih zachytila na video a zverejnila ho online. Lily, známa svojou zvedavosťou v predchádzajúcich YouTube videách, sa pokúsila Lucy dotknúť labkou, no po jemnom pichnutí jej ostňami sa rýchlo stiahla. Potom sa pokúsila na Lucy sadnúť, ale po ďalšom nepríjemnom zážitku odbehla rýchlo preč. Následne si Lily udržavala odstup a uvažovala, či je Lucy priateľ alebo nepriateľ. article_content: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina — Javier Milei decisively won Argentina's presidential election on Sunday, shifting the nation to the right after a highly polarized campaign in which he pledged sweeping changes to address soaring inflation and increasing poverty. With 99.4% of votes counted in the presidential runoff, Milei received 55.7%, while Economy Minister Sergio Massa earned 44.3%, according to Argentina's electoral authority. It marked the widest margin of victory in a presidential race since Argentina's return to democracy in 1983. Across Buenos Aires, celebrations erupted as drivers honked horns and crowds gathered in various neighborhoods. Outside Milei’s party headquarters, located in a downtown hotel, supporters sang, bought beers from vendors, and set off colored smoke bombs. They waved both the Argentine flag and the yellow Gadsden flag, displaying the slogan “Don't Tread On Me,” which Milei's movement has adopted. Inside, Milei, a self-described anarcho-capitalist who has been compared to former U.S. President Donald Trump, delivered his victory speech, declaring: “The reconstruction of Argentina begins today.” He said, “Argentina’s situation is critical. The changes our country needs are drastic. There is no room for gradualism, no room for lukewarm measures.” Supporters chanted “Liberty, liberty!” and “Let them all leave” in a reference to frustration with the political establishment. Massa, of the ruling Peronist party, had already conceded defeat, stating, “Argentines chose another path.” He added, “Starting tomorrow, the new president is responsible for guaranteeing the political, social, and economic functions. I hope he does.” Milei’s victory indicates a sharp rightward turn for Argentina, elevating a first-term lawmaker and television commentator known for criticizing the 'political caste.' Inflation has surpassed 140% and poverty has worsened during Massa’s tenure. Milei has vowed to reduce the size of government, dollarize the economy, and eliminate the Central Bank in order to combat inflation, which he attributes to successive governments printing money. He also holds several conservative positions, including opposing sex education in schools and abortion, even though Congress legalized abortion in 2020. Lucas Romero, head of the local consulting firm Synopsis, commented: “This triumph is less about Milei himself and more about the public's demand for change. Argentine voters expressed fatigue and a desire for something different.” Massa’s campaign warned that Milei’s plans to eliminate ministries and dramatically limit the state could endanger key public services like health, education, and welfare, which many Argentines depend on. Massa, during the campaign, also criticized Milei’s aggressive rhetoric and questioned his temperament; Milei was known for brandishing a chainsaw at campaign events. Andrei Roman, CEO of Brazil-based pollster Atlas Intel, said: “There were many undecided voters who, frustrated by the status quo, ended up supporting Milei. The apprehension about Milei’s win was balanced by fears of continued inflation under Massa.” Milei accused Massa and his allies of running a 'campaign of fear' and later moderated some of his most controversial proposals, such as weakening gun control laws. In his final campaign ad, he assured voters he wouldn't privatize education or healthcare. Milei’s platform drew particular appeal from Argentines facing economic difficulties, especially among young men. “Incredibly happy, ecstatic—this is a global historical phenomenon!” said Luca Rodríguez, a 20-year-old law student celebrating outside Milei's headquarters. “I want to break free from the elite that takes our rights and taxes and doesn’t let us live in peace.” Amilcar and Gabriel Rollo, 32-year-old twins at the celebrations, said: “We want change. We want everything to improve. It's hope for something new from someone with different ideas. Otherwise, it’s just more of the same.” Most pre-election polls, which had been unreliable throughout the campaign, showed either a statistical tie or a slight lead for Milei. Milei elicited mixed reactions at recent events, receiving both boos and applause at Buenos Aires’ historic Colón Theater. His running mate, Victoria Villaruel, faced protests when she voted, partly due to her comments minimizing the number of victims of Argentina’s 1976-1983 military dictatorship and other controversial positions. The election took place amid Milei’s unfounded claims of possible electoral fraud, echoing comments from Donald Trump and Brazil's former President Jair Bolsonaro. Experts believe these claims could not have changed the outcome, and that Milei’s assertions were likely intended to mobilize supporters as election monitors. Some observers worry such claims could undermine democratic norms. Both Bolsonaro and Trump congratulated Milei on social media. “The whole world was watching! I am very proud of you,” Trump posted on Truth Social. “You will turn your country around and truly Make Argentina Great Again!” U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken, posting on X (formerly Twitter), also congratulated Milei, saying, “We look forward to continuing bilateral cooperation based on shared values and interests.”
translated_content: BUENOS AIRES, Argentína — Javier Milei rozhodne zvíťazil v prezidentských voľbách v Argentíne v nedeľu, čím posunul krajinu doprava po silne polarizovanej kampani, v ktorej sľúbil rozsiahle zmeny na riešenie prudko rastúcej inflácie a zvyšujúcej sa chudoby. S 99,4 % spočítaných hlasov v druhom kole prezidentských volieb získal Milei 55,7 %, zatiaľ čo minister hospodárstva Sergio Massa získal 44,3 %, podľa argentínskej volebnej komisie. Ide o najväčší rozdiel v prezidentských voľbách od návratu Argentíny k demokracii v roku 1983. V Buenos Aires prepukli oslavy, vodiči trúbili a v rôznych štvrtiach sa zhromažďovali davy. Pred sídlom Mileiho strany v centre mesta fanúšikovia spievali, kupovali pivo od predajcov a vypúšťali farebný dym. Mávali argentínskou vlajkou aj žltou Gadsdenovou vlajkou s heslom „Don’t Tread On Me“, ktorú prijalo Mileiho hnutie. Vo vnútri Milei, ktorý sa označuje za anarcho-kapitalistu a býva prirovnávaný k bývalému americkému prezidentovi Donaldovi Trumpovi, predniesol víťazný prejav: „Obnova Argentíny sa začína dnes.“ Dodal: „Situácia Argentíny je kritická. Zmeny, ktoré krajina potrebuje, sú drastické. Niet priestoru na gradualizmus ani vlažné opatrenia.“ Podporovatelia kričali „Sloboda, sloboda!“ a „Nech odídu všetci!“, čím vyjadrovali frustráciu s politickou triedou. Massa z vládnucej Peronistickej strany už priznal porážku: „Argentínčania si vybrali inú cestu.“ Dodal: „Od zajtra je zodpovednosť nového prezidenta zabezpečiť politické, sociálne a ekonomické funkcie. Dúfam, že sa mu to podarí.“ Mileiho víťazstvo znamená ostrý posun doprava — k moci sa dostáva nováčik v politike a televízny komentátor známy kritikou „politickej kasty“. Počas Massovho obdobia inflácia prekročila 140 % a chudoba sa zhoršila. Milei sľúbil výrazne zmenšiť štát, zaviesť dolár a zrušiť centrálnu banku, aby bojoval s infláciou, ktorú pripisuje tlačeniu peňazí predchádzajúcimi vládami. Zastáva aj viaceré konzervatívne postoje, ako opozícia voči sexuálnej výchove v školách a proti interrupciám, hoci parlament legalizoval interrupcie v roku 2020. Lucas Romero, šéf spoločnosti Synopsis, dodal: „Toto víťazstvo je menej o samotnom Mileim a viac o požiadavke na zmenu. Väčšina Argentínčanov hlasovala z únavy a protestu.“ Massova kampaň varovala, že Mileiho návrhy na zrušenie ministerstiev a zmenšenie štátu môžu ohroziť kľúčové verejné služby ako zdravotníctvo, vzdelávanie a sociálne programy. Počas kampane tiež poukázal na Mileiho agresívnu rétoriku a spochybňoval jeho spôsobilosť; Milei sa preslávil nosením motorovej píly na zhromaždeniach. Andrei Roman, riaditeľ brazílskeho Atlas Intel, povedal: „Mnohí nerozhodnutí voliči z frustrácie podporili Mileiho. Obavy z jeho víťazstva vyvážila starosť z pokračujúcej inflácie pod Massom.“ Milei obvinil Massu a jeho spojencov z kampane strachu a neskôr zmiernil niektoré kontroverzné návrhy, napríklad oslabenie regulácie zbraní. V záverečnej kampani uistil voličov, že neplánuje privatizovať školstvo ani zdravotníctvo. Mileiho program najviac oslovil Argentínčanov postihnutých ekonomickými problémami, najmä mladých mužov. „Neuveriteľne šťastný – je to globálny historický fenomén!“ povedal 20-ročný študent práva Luca Rodríguez pred Mileiho centrom. „Chcem sa oslobodiť od elity, ktorá nám berie práva a dane, a nedovolí nám žiť v pokoji.“ Amilcar a Gabriel Rollo, 32-roční dvojčatá na oslavách, povedali: „Chceme zmenu. Chceme, aby bolo všetko lepšie. Je to nádej na niečo nové od niekoho s inými nápadmi. Inak by to bolo stále rovnaké.“ Väčšina predvolebných prieskumov, ktoré boli počas kampane nepresné, ukazovala buď vyrovnaný stav, alebo mierny náskok pre Mileiho. Milei vyvolal na akciách zmiešané reakcie — v slávnom divadle Colón v Buenos Aires ho niektorí vypískali, iní vítali. Jeho kandidátka na viceprezidentku, Victoria Villaruel, čelila protestom po svojich kontroverzných vyjadreniach o rozsahu obetí diktatúry v rokoch 1976-1983. Voľby prebehli počas Mileiho nepodložených obvinení z možných volebných podvodov, ktoré pripomínali stratégie Trumpa a Bolsonara. Odborníci sa zhodujú, že tieto tvrdenia výsledok ovplyvniť nemohli a boli skôr snahou motivovať priaznivcov pôsobiť ako volebných pozorovateľov. Niektorí sa obávajú, že tieto tvrdenia môžu narušiť demokratické normy. Bolsonaro a Trump Mileiho zagratulovali na sociálnych sieťach. „Celý svet sa pozeral! Som na teba hrdý,“ napísal Trump na Truth Social. „Zmeníš svoju krajinu a naozaj urobíš Argentínu opäť veľkou!“ Americký minister zahraničných vecí Antony Blinken zagratuloval Mileimu cez X (predtým Twitter): „Tešíme sa na pokračovanú bilaterálnu spoluprácu založenú na spoločných hodnotách a záujmoch.“

article_content: Airbnb has appointed Ron Klain, former White House Chief of Staff for President Joe Biden, as its new chief legal officer. Klain served as President Biden's chief of staff during the first two years of his administration and previously held the same role for then-Vice President Biden. Earlier in his career, Klain also served as Chief of Staff to Vice President Al Gore at age 34, making him the youngest person to hold that position in U.S. history. In addition, Klain was the chief legal officer at venture capital firm Revolution, founded by AOL’s Steve Case. Klain’s appointment at Airbnb begins at the start of the year, and he will report to CEO and co-founder Brian Chesky.

Na začiatku svojej kariéry bol Klain šéfom kancelárie viceprezidenta Ala Gora vo veku 34 rokov, čím sa stal najmladším človekom v americkej histórii na tejto pozícii. Okrem toho bol Klain aj hlavným právnym zástupcom venture kapitálovej firmy Revolution, ktorú založil Steve Case, zakladateľ spoločnosti AOL. Klain nastúpi do Airbnb na začiatku roka a bude podliehať generálnemu riaditeľovi a spoluzakladateľovi Brianovi Cheskymu.

Liverpool manager Brendan Rodgers says he has no issue with the rough treatment Mario Balotelli received from Aston Villa defender Philippe Senderos during Saturday’s 1-0 defeat at Anfield. Rodgers, who described football as a 'man's game', observed Senderos kicking Balotelli off the ball in the first half—a foul missed by the match officials. Balotelli also endured a strong challenge from Alan Hutton. Despite these incidents, Rodgers emphasized that while he expects referees to protect all players, including Balotelli, he had no serious complaints. 'Football is competitive and strong, and we ask our players to be so, but also to be fair in how we play,' he said.

Rodgers is now focused on Liverpool’s return to the Champions League after a five-year absence. Liverpool host Bulgarian side FC Ludogorets in their first match, with group stage games against Real Madrid and Swiss club FC Basel to follow. The manager underlined the importance of the competition for the club’s sustainability and set his sights on advancing to the knockout stages.

'Qualification from the group is the first objective. We’ll approach each game with focus,' Rodgers stated. He acknowledged Ludogorets’ attacking strengths and said Liverpool must be aggressive in their play. Rodgers also pointed out the need for defensive improvement, noting that Martin Skrtel will return soon.

Defender Dejan Lovren called Liverpool’s defeat to Aston Villa 'painful' but emphasized the need to move forward and concentrate on the Champions League. Lovren, who has previous Champions League experience with Lyon, expressed confidence in the squad’s ability to adapt and succeed despite the strong competition. 'We want success here. I’m sure we can get out of the group,' he said. Adam Lallana made his Liverpool debut in the Villa defeat, and Raheem Sterling was seen training with Balotelli ahead of the Champions League match.

Tréner Liverpoolu Brendan Rodgers uviedol, že nemá problém s tvrdou hrou, ktorú Mario Balotelli zažil od obrancu Aston Villy Philippa Senderosa počas sobotnej prehry 1:0 na Anfielde. Rodgers, ktorý označil futbal za "mužskú hru", videl, ako Senderos kopol Balotelliho mimo hry v prvom polčase – faul, ktorý rozhodcovia prehliadli. Balotelli čelil aj tvrdému zákroku od Alana Huttona. Napriek týmto incidentom Rodgers zdôraznil, že hoci očakáva ochranu všetkých hráčov vrátane Balotelliho od rozhodcov, nemá zásadné sťažnosti. „Futbal je súťaživý a tvrdý a žiadame našich hráčov, aby takí boli, no aby zároveň hrali férovo,“ povedal.

Rodgers teraz sústreďuje pozornosť na návrat Liverpoolu do Ligy majstrov po päťročnej prestávke. Liverpool privíta v prvom zápase bulharský Ludogorets, v skupine ich ďalej čakajú Real Madrid a švajčiarsky FC Basel. Tréner poukázal na dôležitosť tejto súťaže pre dlhodobú udržateľnosť klubu a určil si za cieľ postúpiť do vyraďovacej fázy.

„Postup zo skupiny je prvým cieľom. Ku každému zápasu pristúpime so sústredením,“ uviedol Rodgers. Priznal silné stránky Ludogoretsu v útoku a povedal, že Liverpool musí hrať agresívne. Tiež upozornil na potrebu zlepšiť obranu a poznamenal, že Martin Škrtel sa čoskoro vráti.

Obranca Dejan Lovren označil prehru s Aston Villou za "bolestivú", no zdôraznil potrebu ísť ďalej a sústrediť sa na Ligu majstrov. Lovren, ktorý má skúsenosti s touto súťažou z pôsobenia v Lyone, vyjadril dôveru v schopnosť tímu prispôsobiť sa a uspieť napriek silnej konkurencii. „Chceme tu uspieť. Som si istý, že zo skupiny môžeme postúpiť,“ povedal. Adam Lallana debutoval za Liverpool v zápase s Villou a Raheem Sterling trénoval s Balotellim pred súbojom v Lige majstrov.

With work restrictions for Bulgarians and Romanians lifted, many hopeful migrants began their journeys to the United Kingdom. At Sofia's main bus station, travelers were seen boarding buses loaded with luggage as they prepared for a long trip through Austria, Germany, and France before settling in London. Many looked forward to new opportunities and carried essentials for starting fresh lives in Britain.

Estimates suggest tens of thousands from Romania and Bulgaria may move to Britain now that they're free to work and study across the EU. Reports from North London show some new arrivals already searching for odd jobs. One bystander noted groups of young men offering to do various tasks for £50 a day outside a hardware shop on Seven Sisters Road.

The first day without restrictions saw Labour MP Keith Vaz welcoming immigrants arriving at Luton airport. Victor Spirescu, the first Romanian cleared through immigration, said he planned to work in the UK for a while before returning home.

However, not everyone in Britain is pleased about this development. A recent poll indicates over 80 percent of the public favored keeping the restrictions longer. Prime Minister David Cameron, responding to such concerns, has introduced measures restricting new migrants from claiming unemployment benefits for their first three months and allowing authorities to deport those unable to support themselves. These new policies aim to address public worries as Britain prepares for this new wave of migration from Eastern Europe.

Mnohí sa tešili na nové možnosti a niesli si všetko potrebné pre začiatok nového života v Británii.

Odhaduje sa, že do Británie môže prísť desaťtisíce ľudí z Rumunska a Bulharska, keďže teraz môžu voľne pracovať a študovať v celej EÚ. V severnom Londýne noví príchodzí už hľadali príležitostné práce. Jeden svedok videl skupiny mladých mužov, ktorí pred železiarstvom na Seven Sisters Road ponúkali rôzne práce za 50 libier denne.

Napriek tomu mnohí Briti nie sú s týmto vývojom spokojní. Nedávny prieskum ukázal, že viac ako 80 percent verejnosti by uprednostnilo ponechať obmedzenia dlhšie. article_content: San Francisco (CNN) -- Google has unveiled Chromecast, an affordable and simple way to stream Internet videos directly to your TV. Announced Wednesday, the Chromecast is a small device that connects to your television's HDMI port and uses your home Wi-Fi network to stream content. Controlled by your computer, smartphone, or tablet, Chromecast turns these devices into remotes, letting you quickly choose what you want to watch. Google says their goal is to make Chromecast require zero setup time, have no learning curve, and be fully compatible with all major platforms and devices. Priced at just $35, Chromecast marks a significant change from Google’s earlier, unsuccessful Nexus Q—it's smaller, cheaper, and available starting immediately. About the size of a thumb drive, Chromecast plugs into the HDMI port of any HDTV. Once connected, you can use your phone, tablet, or computer to select videos or playlists for streaming on your television. Sundar Pichai, Google's senior vice president overseeing Android, Chrome, and apps, explained at the press event: 'The television is missing in the streaming-video picture. It is really difficult to get your online videos on the television.' The company also announced an upgraded Nexus 7 tablet at the same event. Chromecast supports both Android and iOS devices. At the demonstration, Google showcased Chromecast using a Windows laptop and an iPhone. Streaming occurs directly from your Wi-Fi connection, so the device you are using to control playback is not drained of battery, letting you multitask—such as checking email—while your custom YouTube playlist plays on the big screen. Currently, Chromecast streams content from YouTube, Google Play, and Netflix, with plans to add Pandora and more apps soon. A beta feature even allows you to mirror any Chrome browser tab from your non-TV device to your television. With Chromecast, Google is entering the growing connected-TV market. According to Google, just 15% of households have figured out how to watch online video on their TVs. The Chromecast competes directly with Apple TV and the Roku box. The Chromecast stick is now on sale in the Google Play store and at retailers like Best Buy, though it may not ship right away. Each purchase comes with three months of free Netflix streaming. Opinion: Some say Apple is now following, not leading, in this space.

A striking photograph of a firefighter searching for survivors after a tragic blaze in Dhaka, Bangladesh, has received the prestigious Environmental Photographer of the Year 2014 award. Taken by Mohammed Fahim Ahamed Riyad, the image captures the aftermath of a fire that destroyed around 400 shanty homes and claimed four lives, including a six-year-old child. Officially, there were no reported casualties and the cause of the fire is still unknown.

Established in 2007 by the Chartered Institution of Water and Environmental Management (CIWEM), the competition attracted over 1,000 entries this year, evaluated for impact, composition, originality, and technical skill by a panel of expert judges.

Other notable winners include Faisal Azim of Bangladesh, who received the Atkins Cityscape Award for his photograph of beggars, and Bogumil Kruzel of Poland, who won for 'Man in the face of nature', an image taken deep within the Wieliczka Salt Mine. British photographer and filmmaker Sean Gallagher was awarded £1,000 for the Atkins CIWEM Environmental Film of the Year for 'The Toxic Price of Leather', documenting the severe environmental and health costs of Kanpur's leather industry in northern India. The new Forestry Commission England Exhibition Award went to Luke Duggleby for his photo of Cambodian Buddhist monks wrapping orange cloth around surviving trees to deter illegal logging.

Selector Brigitte Lardinois highlighted the power of Riyad’s photograph, noting its contrast between heroism and futility amid disaster. This year’s final 94 works will be showcased at the Royal Geographical Society, London, from June 23 to July 4, then tour nationally until November. The exhibition presents images and films addressing environmental challenges, urging viewers to consider the planet’s realities. David Tonkin, CEO of Atkins UK & Europe, and Paul Horton, CIWEM’s Director of Membership and Development, stressed the importance of these images for raising awareness about population growth, climate change, and the need to respect Earth’s limits.

Fotografiu zhotovil Mohammed Fahim Ahamed Riyad a zachytáva následky požiaru, ktorý zničil približne 400 chatrčí a pripravil o život štyroch ľudí vrátane šesťročného dieťaťa. Oficiálne však neboli zaznamenané žiadne obete a príčina požiaru zostáva neznáma.

Súťaž, ktorú v roku 2007 založila Chartered Institution of Water and Environmental Management (CIWEM), tento rok prilákala viac ako 1 000 fotografií hodnotených odbornou porotou podľa dopadu, kompozície, originality a technickej úrovne.

Medzi ďalšími ocenenými je Faisal Azim z Bangladéša, ktorý získal Atkins Cityscape Award za fotografiu žobrákov, a Bogumil Kruzel z Poľska, ktorý vyhral so snímkou „Muž tvárou v tvár prírode“ z bane Wieliczka. Brit Sean Gallagher získal 1 000 libier za Atkins CIWEM Environmental Film of the Year za film „The Toxic Price of Leather“, ktorý poukazuje na vážne environmentálne a zdravotné dôsledky kožiarskeho priemyslu v indickom meste Kanpur. Novú Forestry Commission England Exhibition Award získal Luke Duggleby za fotografiu kambodžských budhistických mníchov, ktorí omotávajú stromy oranžovou látkou, aby odradili nelegálnych drevorubačov.

Členka poroty Brigitte Lardinois vyzdvihla silu Riyadovej fotografie, ktorá kontrastuje hrdinstvo a márnosť uprostred katastrofy. Tento rok bude 94 fotografií a filmov vystavených v Royal Geographical Society v Londýne od 23. júna do 4. júla, následne poputuje po krajine do novembra. Výstava prezentuje diela, ktoré vyzývajú divákov zamyslieť sa nad environmentálnymi výzvami súčasnosti. David Tonkin, výkonný riaditeľ Atkins UK & Europe, a Paul Horton, riaditeľ pre členstvo a rozvoj CIWEM, zdôraznili význam týchto fotografií pri zvyšovaní povedomia o raste populácie, klimatických zmenách a potrebe rešpektovať kapacitu Zeme.

article_content: Legal experts are advising individuals to plan their 'digital legacy,' a term that refers to the management of one’s online presence after death. As part of this, people are encouraged to write a final message—such as a 'last Tweet'—to be shared after their passing. Doing so can relay the news widely and help prevent others from inadvertently posting insensitive or outdated messages, like birthday wishes. SagaLegal.co.uk has released a Digital Legacy Guide suggesting steps for organizing digital affairs. This includes creating a secured list of all online accounts—such as social media pages, online shopping subscriptions, or gaming sites—and instructions for handling them. Failure to address these accounts could result in continued email notifications or messages for the deceased, causing problems for families. Emma Myers, the head of wills, probate, and lifetime planning at Saga Legal, notes there are currently few clear legal guidelines for protecting digital assets after death. She underscores the importance of planning ahead to ensure that digital information, especially sensitive financial or personal data, is managed appropriately. Myers emphasizes that with so much of life now online, preparing for one’s digital legacy is vital to prevent emotional, practical, and financial issues. The Guide recommends compiling an 'online directory' of every internet account with preferences for handling each. Since laws for digital assets are still evolving, experts highlight the need for early action to secure your online footprint and make things easier for loved ones.
translated_content: Právni experti odporúčajú ľuďom plánovať svoju „digitálnu pozostalost“, teda spôsob, ako bude po ich smrti spravovaná online identita. Súčasťou odporúčaní je napísať poslednú správu, napríklad „posledný tweet“, ktorý bude zverejnený po úmrtí. Takto sa môže správa dostať k širšiemu okruhu ľudí a predíde sa situáciám, keď iní nechtiac po smrti zanechajú nevhodné alebo neaktuálne správy, ako napríklad blahoželania k narodeninám. SagaLegal.co.uk vydala príručku Digital Legacy Guide s odporúčaniami, ako si usporiadať digitálne záležitosti. To zahŕňa vytvorenie bezpečného zoznamu všetkých online účtov – napríklad profily na sociálnych sieťach, účty na stránkach obchodov alebo herných portáloch – spolu s inštrukciami, čo s nimi po smrti urobiť. Ak sa tieto účty neuzatvoria, môžu po smrti prichádzať ďalšie e-maily a notifikácie, čím sa zbytočne zaťažujú pozostalí. Emma Myersová, vedúca oddelenia dedičstva a plánovania pozostalosti v Saga Legal, upozorňuje, že pre digitálne aktíva zatiaľ neexistujú jednoznačné právne pravidlá po smrti. Zdôrazňuje dôležitosť plánovať vopred a zabezpečiť, aby citlivé údaje – najmä tie finančné – boli náležite spravované. Ako upozorňuje Myersová, čoraz viac žijeme online, preto je dôležité myslieť aj na digitálnu pozostalost a predísť tak emocionálnym, praktickým a finančným komplikáciám. Príručka odporúča vytvoriť „online adresár“ so všetkými internetovými účtami a priložiť pokyny, ako má byť s každým naložené. Keďže pravidlá v oblasti digitálnych aktív sa ešte len formujú, odborníci odporúčajú konať včas, aby ste uľahčili situáciu svojim blízkym a zabezpečili svoj digitálny odkaz.

article_content: Supporters of the far-right movement aligned with former President Trump are expressing disappointment with House Speaker Mike Johnson. Many expected Johnson to strictly uphold hardline conservative values, particularly on issues like abortion and LGBTQ+ rights. However, some became unsettled after Johnson publicly stated that racism against Black Americans remains a concern in the United States. Adding to the surprise, Johnson recently told Sean Hannity that Russia should not be allowed to win its war in Ukraine. He warned that a Russian victory could inspire further aggression, potentially from China toward Taiwan. Johnson emphasized America's commitment to supporting Ukraine, stating, 'We're not going to abandon them.' These positions have sparked debate among some right-wing supporters. Senator JD Vance, a vocal critic of US aid to Ukraine, noted his concern that Johnson's views seemed to shift after becoming Speaker. This has fueled uncertainty and speculation about Johnson’s future actions among his supporters, who now question what direction his leadership might take.

article_content: Hatem Ben Arfa appears poised for a move in the January transfer window after becoming surplus to requirements at Newcastle United and Hull City. The 27-year-old former Marseille and France international is unlikely to return to Newcastle, as manager Alan Pardew has stated he does not want Ben Arfa back from his loan at Hull. Hull City manager Steve Bruce has also indicated that Ben Arfa is not in his plans. Michel Ouzaine, Ben Arfa's agent, told 20minutes.fr that despite rumors, several clubs remain interested in signing the midfielder, assuring that a new club will be found for him in January. Currently, Ben Arfa is back in Paris. Meanwhile, filmmaker Bruno Sevaistre has begun work on a documentary about Ben Arfa. Sevaistre previously featured Ben Arfa in the 'A la Clairefontaine' series, which chronicled the lives of young players training at France's famed football academy. "I feel somewhat responsible for the media attention surrounding Hatem and its impact on his career," said Sevaistre. The filmmaker noted that the project, whether a film or series, aims to present a more nuanced view of Ben Arfa, highlighting his sensitivity and the personal obstacles he has faced. Ben Arfa has appeared just nine times for Hull since joining on loan from Newcastle. Steve Bruce stated that Ben Arfa's lack of work ethic in training and games contributed to their professional parting, though the manager denied reports of a heated argument. "If he chooses to stay in France, that’s his decision. With the transfer window opening soon, it’s likely Ben Arfa has played his last game for Hull," said Bruce. "He must earn his place in the squad based on performance. Sometimes loan moves do not work out, but I wish him the best for his career."

article_content: Ukrainian intelligence has reported that two Russian landing ships were targeted and likely damaged by sea drones off the coast of occupied Crimea, demonstrating ongoing efforts to challenge Russia's presence in the Black Sea. On Friday, the Main Directorate of Intelligence of Ukraine (GUR) stated that the Russian vessels, carrying crew and armored vehicles, were struck during a nighttime operation. GUR released what was presented as footage from two drones flying over the sea and approaching a vessel, followed by explosions. The agency specified the targeted ships were 'Serna' class, capable of transporting up to 45 tons of cargo and up to 92 landing personnel, and noted these vessels had previously been used to move Russian military equipment into contested territories. Intelligence sources told the Kyiv Post the drones struck the Russian vessels on Thursday night in the harbor of Chornomorske, Crimea, which Russia annexed from Ukraine in 2014. The sources did not specify the extent of the damage or mention casualties. Russia confirmed an attempted attack but did not state that any of its vessels were hit. The Russian Defense Ministry reported shooting down two aircraft-type drones over Crimea on November 10. Local Telegram channels reported explosions near Chornomorske, rubble at a military barracks, and divers in the sea, according to the Kyiv Post. Ukraine has escalated naval attacks around Crimea, the base for Russia's Black Sea Fleet, in recent months. These include missile strikes on a Russian naval shipyard and the headquarters of the Black Sea Fleet. On the previous Saturday, Ukraine reportedly struck a newly-deployed Russian cruise missile carrier in Crimea. Following these strikes, Russia has shifted some naval assets from the port of Sevastopol, the main Black Sea naval facility. The UK Ministry of Defence assessed that such attacks might prompt Russia to move shipbuilding operations farther from the front, potentially delaying new ship deliveries. Since its full-scale invasion in February 2022, Russia has used Crimea as a key base for launching missile strikes throughout Ukraine, including attacks causing civilian casualties far from front-line areas. Ukraine insists it will reclaim Crimea as part of its resistance to Russia's invasion.

article_content:
President Bola Tinubu's appointment of Olayemi Cardoso as governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) signals a critical opportunity to reform the nation’s monetary policy both in orientation and execution. Since taking office on May 29, Tinubu has implemented rapid reforms, including abolishing Nigeria’s decades-old petrol subsidy, to boost the economy. Cardoso has already indicated a shift from the monetary policies of his predecessor, moving away from unorthodox strategies that unsettled the economy under Godwin Emefiele.

Like most modern economies, Nigeria aims for price stability and effective foreign exchange management as core pillars of its monetary policy. However, persistent double-digit inflation—which reached 26.72% in September, its highest in nearly twenty years—and other economic challenges underscore the need for a new approach.

Key recommendations for Nigeria’s monetary policy include:

1. **Inflation Targeting:** The CBN should adopt clear and public inflation targets, as was successful under former Governor Sanusi Lamido, to guide expectations and anchor inflation.

2. **Forward Guidance:** The CBN should provide consistent, transparent communication of its monetary policy views and intended actions, similar to the Bank of England during the 2008 financial crisis, to enhance market stability and confidence.

3. **Microprudential Policy:** Instead of broad interest rate hikes, CBN can implement targeted sectoral policies to address high inflation, following examples such as the People’s Bank of China’s approach to managing risks in the real estate sector. This requires access to comprehensive economic data.

4. **Monetary Policy and Welfare:** Policymaking should consider the welfare of citizens and support Nigeria’s industrialization, requiring close cooperation with fiscal authorities to address core inflation drivers—such as food, energy, transportation, and telecommunications.

5. **Policy Trilemma:** Monetary, foreign exchange, and remittance policies must be aligned and coordinated. The recent CBN move to clear a $7 billion foreign exchange contract backlog helped the naira strengthen by 10% in early November from record lows in October.

Under Cardoso’s leadership, the CBN has an essential role in restoring trust, transparency, and credibility in Nigeria’s monetary framework. Clear communication of policy goals and thorough understanding of the country’s economic intricacies will help the CBN tailor effective tools to achieve stability and growth.

In conclusion, Nigerian monetary policy stands at a crossroads. Embracing innovative approaches can set the nation on a path to greater economic stability and prosperity, according to Dr. Olusiji Sanya, economist and Chief Financial Officer at Tranzfar Group UK.

Vymenovanie Olayemiho Cardosa prezidentom Bolom Tinubom za guvernéra Centrálnej banky Nigérie (CBN) predstavuje zásadnú príležitosť na reformu menovej politiky krajiny v orientácii aj realizácii. Od prevzatia úradu 29. mája zaviedol Tinubu rýchle reformy vrátane zrušenia desaťročia trvajúcej dotácie na pohonné hmoty s cieľom podporiť ekonomiku. Cardoso už signalizoval odklon od menovej politiky svojho predchodcu a opúšťa neortodoxné stratégie, ktoré počas Emefielovho vedenia rozkolísali ekonomiku.

Ako väčšina moderných ekonomík, Nigéria sa snaží o cenovú stabilitu a efektívne riadenie devízových kurzov ako základ svojich menových politík. Pretrvávajúca dvojciferná inflácia – ktorá v septembri dosiahla 26,72 %, najviac za takmer 20 rokov – a ďalšie ekonomické výzvy poukazujú na potrebu nového prístupu.

Kľúčové odporúčania pre menovú politiku Nigérie zahŕňajú:

1. **Cielenie inflácie:** CBN by mala zaviesť jasné a verejné inflačné ciele, ako to úspešne robil bývalý guvernér Sanusi Lamido, aby nasmerovala očakávania a ukotvila infláciu.

2. **Dopredu komunikované usmernenia:** CBN by mala poskytovať konzistentnú a transparentnú komunikáciu svojich pohľadov a plánovaných krokov menovej politiky, podobne ako Bank of England počas finančnej krízy roku 2008, na posilnenie dôvery a stability na trhu.

3. **Mikroprudenciálna politika:** Namiesto plošného zvyšovania úrokových sadzieb môže CBN nasadiť cielené sektorové opatrenia na riešenie vysokej inflácie, podľa príkladu People’s Bank of China pri riadení rizík v realitnom sektore. To vyžaduje komplexné hospodárske údaje.

4. **Menová politika a blahobyt:** Politiky by mali zohľadňovať blahobyt obyvateľov a podporovať industrializáciu Nigérie, pričom je kľúčová úzka spolupráca s fiškálnymi autoritami, napríklad pri riešení cien potravín, energií, dopravy a telekomunikácií.

5. **Trojdilema politiky:** Menová, devízová a remitendová politika musia byť navzájom zosúladené a koordinované. Nedávny krok CBN na vysporiadanie derivátových devízových záväzkov vo výške 7 miliárd dolárov pomohol posilniť nairu o 10 % na začiatku novembra po rekordných minimách v októbri.

Pod Cardosovým vedením zohráva CBN zásadnú úlohu v obnove dôvery, transparentnosti a dôveryhodnosti menovej politiky v Nigérii. Jasná komunikácia cieľov a dôkladné chápanie ekonomických špecifík krajiny pomôžu CBN prispôsobiť efektívne nástroje na dosiahnutie stability a rastu.

Menová politika Nigérie je na rázcestí. Prijatie inovatívnych prístupov môže krajinu nasmerovať k väčšej stabilite a prosperite, tvrdí Dr. Olusiji Sanya, ekonóm a finančný riaditeľ Tranzfar Group UK.

article_content: According to McAfee’s first-ever Global Scam Message Study, Indians spend an average of 105 minutes each week verifying the authenticity of messages, amid a rise in sophisticated scams powered by artificial intelligence (AI). Surveying more than 7,000 adults across seven countries including India, the study revealed that Indians receive an average of 12 scam messages daily through emails, text, and social media. A striking 82% of Indian participants admitted to falling for scam messages, especially fake job offers (64%) and fraudulent bank alerts (52%). Sixty percent reported that it is getting harder to identify these scams as AI helps make them more convincing and error-free, sometimes including personal details. The most common scams encountered are prize notifications (72%), fake job offers (64%), bank alerts (52%), notifications about unauthorized purchases (37%), subscription update messages (35%), missed delivery alerts (29%), and fake security notifications from online retailers (27%). Ninety percent of Indian respondents said they receive scam messages daily via email or text, while 84% see them on social platforms. About half noted that scams have become harder to spot due to increased sophistication. This rise in AI-driven scams has caused 37% of participants to lose trust in digital communication. To cope, most Indians ignore scam messages (28%), block offending senders (28%), or report the messages (31%). Despite these challenges, 88% trust AI to detect scams, and 59% believe AI is essential to fight against AI-based fraud. Suggested precautions include: think before clicking on messages, be skeptical of offers that sound too good to be true, and use scam protection software to block suspicious links. Other recent news: Tata Group’s $750 million acquisition of Wistron’s manufacturing facility will make Tata the first Indian company to assemble iPhones. India has also surpassed Mainland China as the top country in the QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024.

Štúdia, ktorá zahŕňala vyše 7 000 dospelých zo siedmich krajín vrátane Indie, ukázala, že Indovia denne dostanú priemerne 12 podvodných správ cez e-mail, SMS alebo sociálne siete. Až 82 % opýtaných Indov priznalo, že sa stali obeťou týchto podvodných správ, najčastejšie falošných pracovných ponúk (64 %) a bankových upozornení (52 %). Šesťdesiat percent uviedlo, že rozpoznať podvod je čoraz ťažšie, lebo vďaka AI sú správy presvedčivejšie a bez chýb, často s osobnými údajmi. Najbežnejšie sú podvodné výhry (72 %), falošné pracovné ponuky (64 %), bankové upozornenia (52 %), neautorizované nákupy (37 %), správy o predplatnom (35 %), falošné oznámenia o doručení (29 %) a podvodné bezpečnostné oznámenia predajcov (27 %). Deväť z desiatich Indov denne dostáva falošné správy emailom alebo SMS, 84 % ich vidí aj na sociálnych sieťach. Približne polovica považuje rozpoznanie týchto správ za ťažšie kvôli vyššej úrovni spracovania. Rast AI-podvodov spôsobil, že 37 % respondentov menej dôveruje digitálnym komunikáciám. Indovia sa zvyčajne chránia tým, že podvodné správy ignorujú (28 %), blokujú odosielateľov (28 %) alebo správy nahlásia (31 %). Napriek obavám až 88 % dôveruje AI na detegovanie online podvodov a 59 % verí, že AI je nutná v boji proti AI podvodom. Odporúčania: vždy dvakrát zvážte kliknutie, buďte skeptickí k príliš dobrým ponukám a používajte softvér na blokovanie nebezpečných odkazov. Medzi ďalšie novinky patrí akvizícia výrobného závodu Wistron skupinou Tata za 750 miliónov dolárov, vďaka čomu bude Tata prvou indickou firmou vyrábajúcou iPhony. India tiež predbehla Čínu v počte univerzít v rebríčku QS World University Rankings: Asia 2024.

article_content: For the tenth year in a row, Switzerland has been named the leading country for attracting and retaining talented professionals, according to the 2023 Global Talent Competitiveness Index by the Insead business school. Switzerland’s social safety nets, high quality of life, and pristine environment are cited as major strengths contributing to its leadership as a global talent hub. Singapore and the United States complete the top three, while European countries dominate most of the top ten spots. Singapore is praised for its skilled labor force and innovative economic environment, topping the rankings for knowledge skills. The US is distinguished for its ability to cultivate new talent, supported by world-class universities and business schools. The UK took tenth place, thanks to its notable higher education system and achievements in general knowledge and talent growth, even though it receives lower marks for vocational and technical education. Among emerging economies, China ranks highest among BRICS nations in aligning workforce skills with economic needs. However, its struggle to attract incoming talent brings its overall ranking to 40th. India, despite its large population, stands at 103, facing difficulties due to weakened business sentiment and limited success in attracting both domestic and foreign talent. Looking ahead, the report anticipates more intense competition among nations for skilled individuals amid increasing global uncertainty in trade, investment, and geopolitics, which could deepen talent gaps between wealthier and poorer countries due to the ongoing connection between affluence and talent accumulation. The study also notes a decline in gender equality in high-skilled jobs since the start of the Covid-19 pandemic, with fewer women holding such positions than in 2019. The growing impact of artificial intelligence could exacerbate these challenges, as workers with fewer qualifications face more risk, and even highly qualified professionals may encounter increased competition from technological advancements.

K jeho prvenstvu prispievajú silné sociálne istoty, vysoká kvalita života a čisté životné prostredie, ktoré sú hlavnými výhodami pri získavaní špičkových odborníkov. Singapur a Spojené štáty dopĺňajú prvú trojku, pričom európske krajiny ovládli väčšinu z top desiatich miest. Singapur je oceňovaný za kvalifikovanú pracovnú silu a inovatívne hospodárske prostredie, pričom vedie v rebríčku znalostných zručností. USA sa vyznačujú schopnosťou rozvíjať nové talenty vďaka svetovým univerzitám a biznis školám. Veľká Británia obsadila desiate miesto, najmä vďaka silnému systému vysokých škôl a úspechom v oblasti všeobecných vedomostí a rastu talentov, aj keď dostala nižšie hodnotenia za odborné a technické vzdelávanie. Medzi rozvíjajúcimi sa ekonomikami dominovala Čína medzi krajinami BRICS v zosúladení zručností pracovníkov s potrebami hospodárstva. Nedostatok príťažlivosti pre nových odborníkov jej však zrazil celkové umiestnenie na 40. priečku. India, napriek svojej početnosti obyvateľstva, je na 103. mieste, čo je spôsobené slabšou obchodnou klímou a obmedzeným úspechom pri získavaní domácich aj zahraničných talentov. Podľa správy bude v nasledujúcich rokoch konkurenčný boj o šikovných ľudí ešte intenzívnejší v dôsledku rastúcej globálnej neistoty v obchode, investíciách a geopolitike. Tento vývoj môže ešte viac prehĺbiť rozdiely v dostupnosti talentov medzi bohatšími a chudobnejšími krajinami, keďže spojenie medzi bohatstvom a koncentráciou talentu pretrváva. Výskum takisto upozorňuje na pokles rovnosti medzi pohlaviami v oblasti vysokokvalifikovaných pracovných miest od vypuknutia pandémie Covid-19 – oproti roku 2019 je na týchto pozíciách menej žien.
