article_content: The Great British Bake Off has become a major ratings sensation, prompting high-level BBC executives to consider moving it to a broader audience. Janice Hadlow, the BBC2 controller, has suggested that the show might shift to BBC1 next year, now that the channel's main leadership is showing renewed interest following recent spikes in viewership. Charlotte Moore, now the controller of BBC1 and the original commissioner of Bake Off in 2010, is reportedly interested in regaining the show for her channel. The opening episode of the fourth series attracted a record-breaking 5.6 million viewers. Commenting on this rise, Hadlow told the Edinburgh Television Festival that such impressive numbers have inevitably caught the attention of BBC1 executives. She noted, 'We're thrilled to have Bake Off, but outstanding ratings often lead to interest from other channels. When a programme nears 7 million viewers, it can't go unnoticed.' Hadlow denied any internal rivalry over the show, emphasizing her responsibility to the entire BBC organization. She credited BBC2 for nurturing Bake Off but admitted she might have little control if the show is moved. Hadlow also addressed ongoing media coverage of judge Paul Hollywood's divorce and rumored affair with his co-star, Marcela Valladolid. She stated that presenters should expect their private lives to face public scrutiny and must handle their personal matters responsibly, as the BBC cannot manage these issues for them. Despite speculation about the potential effect of Hollywood’s personal life on the show, the BBC has insisted that Bake Off will remain unaffected. Some fans initially threatened to boycott, but most viewers chose to continue watching once the controversy faded. Producer Richard McKerrow acknowledged his concerns about a backlash but said that forgiveness prevailed. Viewer responses on social media have been divided, with Mary Berry receiving widespread appreciation, while reactions to Paul Hollywood remain mixed.
translated_content: Súťaž The Great British Bake Off sa stala veľkým hitom a vyvolala záujem najvyšších predstaviteľov BBC o presun na širšie publikum. Janice Hadlow, riaditeľka BBC2, naznačila, že šou by sa mohla v budúcom roku presunúť na BBC1, keďže hlavní predstavitelia tejto stanice opäť prejavujú záujem po nedávnom náraste sledovanosti. Charlotte Moore, aktuálna riaditeľka BBC1 a pôvodná zadávateľka Bake Off z roku 2010, údajne má záujem získať šou späť na svoj kanál. Úvodná epizóda štvrtej série zaznamenala rekordných 5,6 milióna divákov. K tomuto nárastu sa Hadlow vyjadrila na Edinburgh Television Festival: takéto pôsobivé čísla nevyhnutne upútajú pozornosť vedenia BBC1. Poznamenala: 'Sme nadšení, že máme Bake Off, ale výnimočná sledovanosť často vzbudí záujem iných kanálov. Keď program smeruje k 7 miliónom divákov, nedá sa to prehliadnuť.' Hadlow poprela akúkoľvek vnútornú rivalitu o šou a zdôraznila svoju zodpovednosť voči celej organizácii BBC. BBC2 podľa nej Bake Off vychovala, no priznala, že v prípade presunu bude mať len malý vplyv. Hadlow reagovala aj na neustálu medializáciu rozvodu porotcu Paula Hollywooda a jeho údajného vzťahu so spoluporotkyňou Marcelou Valladolid. Uviedla, že moderátori musia počítať s verejným záujmom o svoje súkromie a musia si svoje záležitosti riešiť zodpovedne, keďže BBC im ich manažovať nemôže. Napriek špekuláciám, že by Hollywoodov osobný život mohol ovplyvniť šou, BBC trvá na tom, že Bake Off zostane nedotknutý. Niektorí fanúšikovia spočiatku hrozili bojkotom, no väčšina sa rozhodla sledovať, keď kontroverzia utíchla. Producent Richard McKerrow priznal obavy z negatívnej reakcie, no nakoniec prevládlo odpustenie. Reakcie divákov na sociálnych sieťach sú rozdelené – Mary Berry si vyslúžila obrovskú priazeň, no postoje k Paulovi Hollywoodovi zostávajú zmiešané.

article_content: A second sinkhole has opened in Pasco, Florida, right next to the house where a car was lost the previous day when the ground gave way. The initial sinkhole began small but rapidly expanded to around ten feet across, swallowing a black Hyundai parked outside a mobile home on Torch Street. The new depression nearby grew from five feet wide to about the same size as the first by Tuesday afternoon. These sudden ground collapses have made authorities evacuate seven homes, with several families staying in temporary accommodations or shelters provided by the Red Cross. One family has been informed that their home is unsafe and will be demolished. Heather Furlani, a recent arrival in the area, recalled being given only a few minutes to gather belongings and leave with her husband and their dog. "I ran in and grabbed my purse and here I am. That's all I got – and my dog," she shared with local media. While officials cleared some families to return home, many remain reluctant due to ongoing safety concerns. Geologists are examining the site, and authorities say investigations are underway to determine the cause of the sinkholes. Although some residents suspect construction work may have contributed, officials stress that it's too early to draw any conclusions. Since the affected land is privately owned, residents’ insurance companies will be responsible for filling the sinkholes and repairing damage.
translated_content: V Pasco na Floride sa otvorila druhá prepadlina, hneď vedľa domu, kde deň predtým zmizlo auto, keď sa prepadla zem. Prvá prepadlina sa spočiatku zdala malá, no rýchlo sa zväčšila na približne tri metre, pričom pohltila čierny Hyundai zaparkovaný pred mobilným domom na ulici Torch. Nová prepadlina sa v utorok popoludní rozšírila z piatich metrov na takmer rovnakú veľkosť ako prvá. Tieto náhle zosuvy pôdy prinútili úrady evakuovať sedem domov, pričom niekoľko rodín ostáva v dočasnom ubytovaní alebo v prístreškoch od Červeného kríža. Jednej rodine bolo oznámené, že ich dom je nebezpečný a bude musieť byť zbúraný. Heather Furlani, ktorá sa do oblasti nedávno prisťahovala, spomínala, že mala len pár minút na to, aby si zobrala veci a odišla so svojím manželom a psom. "Vbehla som dnu, schmatla kabelku a tu som. To je všetko, čo mám – a môj pes," povedala pre miestne médiá. Hoci úradnici niektorým rodinám povolili návrat domov, mnohí sa stále boja vrátiť kvôli pretrvávajúcim obavám o bezpečnosť. Na mieste pracujú geológovia a úrady tvrdia, že vyšetrovanie príčin prepadlín pokračuje. Hoci niektorí obyvatelia podozrievajú stavebné práce v okolí, úrady zdôrazňujú, že je priskoro na akékoľvek závery. Keďže poškodené pozemky sú v súkromnom vlastníctve, o opravy a zasypanie prepadlín sa postarajú poisťovne obyvateľov.

article_content: Pope Francis has enacted a law making sexual or physical abuse of children a crime on Vatican grounds, the Holy See announced on Thursday. These acts were previously crimes under church law, but are now explicitly illegal within the Vatican city-state, which is home to hundreds of people. The new legislation also bans child prostitution and the creation or possession of child pornography. According to Vatican Radio, the law has a broader scope. It includes provisions from international laws against war crimes, racial discrimination, and degrading treatment or punishment, adding wording from the Geneva Conventions to the Vatican's legal code. Francis issued the new laws as a 'motu proprio,' indicating they were his personal initiative, Vatican Radio reported. These updated criminal laws are part of the ongoing revision of the Vatican's legal system, a process that began under Pope Benedict XVI. The Survivors Network of those Abused by Priests (SNAP), a U.S.-based advocacy group for victims of clergy abuse, criticized the new law as a 'feel good gesture.' SNAP director David Clohessy stated, 'For the Vatican's image, this is a successful move. For children's safety, this is another setback, because it will foster the false impression of reform and lead to more complacency.' 'The church hierarchy doesn't need new rules on abuse. It needs to follow long-established secular laws on abuse and push for, not oppose, real reforms to outdated, predator-friendly secular laws, like statutes of limitations,' Clohessy added. In April, Pope Francis had directed the Vatican to 'act decisively' in cases of sexual abuse.
translated_content: Pápež František prijal zákon, ktorý ustanovuje sexuálne alebo fyzické zneužívanie detí ako trestný čin na území Vatikánu, oznámila vo štvrtok Svätá stolica. Tieto činy už boli trestné podľa cirkevného práva, no teraz sú výslovne nelegálne aj vo Vatikánskom mestskom štáte, kde žijú stovky ľudí. Nové nariadenie tiež zakazuje detskú prostitúciu a vytváranie alebo držbu detskej pornografie. Podľa Vatikánskeho rozhlasu má zákon širší záber. Zahŕňa ustanovenia medzinárodných zákonov proti vojnovým zločinom, rasovej diskriminácii a ponižujúcemu zaobchádzaniu alebo trestu, pričom do vatikánskeho právneho systému pridáva formulácie zo Ženevských dohovorov. František vydal nové zákony ako „motu proprio“, čo znamená, že išlo o jeho osobnú iniciatívu, informoval Vatikánsky rozhlas. Tieto aktualizované trestné zákony sú súčasťou prebiehajúcej revízie vatikánskeho právneho systému, ktorá začala za pápeža Benedikta XVI. Sieť preživších obetí zneužívania kňazmi (SNAP), americká advokačná skupina pre obete zneužívania duchovnými, kritizovala nový zákon ako „gesto pre dobrý pocit“. Riaditeľ SNAP David Clohessy uviedol: „Pre obraz Vatikánu je to úspešný krok. Pre bezpečnosť detí je to ďalší krok späť, pretože to podporí falošný dojem reformy a povedie k väčšej spokojnosti so stavom vecí.“ „Cirkevná hierarchia nepotrebuje nové pravidlá o zneužívaní. Musí dodržiavať dlhodobo platné svetské zákony o zneužívaní a podporovať skutočné reformy zastaraných, predátorom priaznivých svetských zákonov, ako sú premlčacie lehoty,“ dodal Clohessy. V apríli pápež František vyzval Vatikán, aby v prípadoch sexuálneho zneužívania „konal rozhodne“.

article_content: Australian swimmer Chloe McCardel has confirmed she will not attempt the Cuba-to-Florida swim again after jellyfish stings forced her to stop. McCardel began the swim in June, selecting that time for its usually lower jellyfish risk, but encountered a swarm 11 hours and 14 miles into the planned 110-mile journey. Her support team saw her trying to remove jellyfish tentacles from her mouth—an event she did not remember. In a news conference in Key West, McCardel said, 'I'm not coming back. That's it.' The 28-year-old Melburnian is the latest to be thwarted by Florida Straits' currents and jellyfish in attempts to swim nonstop, without a shark cage, from Cuba to Florida. She remarked that she would not have made the attempt if she had known jellyfish would be present in such numbers. After being taken out of the water, McCardel described suffering the worst pain of her life for two and a half hours. This was the fifth failed attempt among three women in recent years, primarily due to jellyfish stings and strong currents. Endurance swimmers Diana Nyad and Penny Palfrey have also failed to complete the swim without a shark cage. Susie Maroney finished the crossing successfully in 1997, but used a shark cage for protection. While McCardel had previously completed two-way English Channel swims, she had not spent more than 25 consecutive hours in the water before. For this challenge, she followed strict English Channel Marathon rules: no touching the support boat and no full-body wetsuit. She and her team spent over nine months preparing for the attempt. Experts believe McCardel was likely stung by box jellyfish, which are common in the area. Other risks on the route include shifting currents, hypothermia, malnutrition, dehydration, and sleep deprivation. Dr. Clifton Page from the University of Miami noted that jellyfish stings are extremely painful and unpredictable. Oceanographer Villy Kourafalou highlighted that technology can now help swimmers’ teams better anticipate changing currents. The challenge remains, and repeated failures have led to questions about whether the swim is even possible under these conditions. According to Guinness World Records, the longest unassisted open-water swim was 139.8 miles by Croatia’s Veljko Rogosic in 2006.

McCardel začala plávať v júni – tento čas si vybrala pre nižšie riziko medúz, no už po 11 hodinách a 22 kilometroch narazila na roj. Jej podporný tím videl, ako sa snaží vytiahnuť medúzie chápadlá z úst – na túto chvíľu si však nespomína. Na tlačovej konferencii v Key West povedala: 'Už sa nevrátim. To je všetko.' 28-ročnú rodáčku z Melbourne vyradili z trasy prúdy a medúzy pri pokuse preplávať z Kuby na Floridu bez žraločej klietky. Poznamenala, že by sa o tento pokus nepokúsila, keby vedela, že bude toľko medúz. Po vytiahnutí z vody opísala najhoršiu bolesť svojho života, ktorá trvala dve a pol hodiny. Bol to piaty neúspešný pokus troch žien v posledných rokoch, najmä kvôli medúzam a silným prúdom. Plavkyne Diana Nyad a Penny Palfrey túto trasu bez žraločej klietky tiež nedokončili. Austrálčanka Susie Maroney túto cestu zvládla v roku 1997, ale s ochranou žraločej klietky. McCardel už predtým dvakrát preplávala kanál La Manche tam a späť, ale nikdy nebola vo vode viac než 25 hodín v kuse. Pri tomto pokuse musela dodržovať prísne pravidlá: nesmela sa dotýkať sprievodných lodí ani namiesto plaviek použiť celotelový neoprén. Na pokus sa s tímom pripravovala viac než deväť mesiacov. Odborníci sa domnievajú, že ju bodli štvorhranky, ktoré v tejto oblasti často žijú. Medzi ďalšie riziká na trase patria silné prúdy, podchladenie, podvýživa, dehydratácia či spánková deprivácia. Dr. Clifton Page z University of Miami upozornil, že bodnutia medúz sú veľmi bolestivé a nevyspytateľné. Oceánografka Villy Kourafalou dodala, že súčasné technológie môžu tímu pomôcť lepšie predvídať prúdy. Preplávanie tejto trasy zostáva obrovskou výzvou a opakované neúspechy vyvolávajú otázku, či je to vôbec možné. Podľa Guinnessovej knihy rekordov najdlhší neasistovaný diaľkový plavecký pokus zvládol Chorvát Veljko Rogosic v roku 2006, keď preplával 225 km.

article_content: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has called on all countries to immediately stop exporting weapons to Israel, according to Al Arabiya Post. The plea was made during a virtual BRICS Extraordinary Joint Meeting organized in response to the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict. During the meeting, hosted by South Africa, Saudi Arabia further urged for the initiation of a serious and comprehensive peace process aimed at establishing a Palestinian state based on the 1967 borders. The Crown Prince reiterated that Saudi Arabia’s stance remains steadfast: security and stability in Palestine can only be achieved through implementing international decisions related to the two-state solution. He also condemned the ongoing Israeli military operations in Gaza, demanding their immediate cessation. The Crown Prince described the violence in Gaza as 'brutal crimes' and called for concerted international efforts to end the suffering. Additionally, he restated Saudi Arabia’s opposition to the forced displacement of Palestinians and appealed for joint action to prevent further deterioration of humanitarian conditions in Gaza. He noted Saudi Arabia’s ongoing efforts to protect civilians since the conflict escalated. The BRICS meeting, chaired by South Africa, included participation from leaders of Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, as well as newly admitted member states and UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres. South Africa condemned Israel’s actions as war crimes and 'genocide.' The BRICS group issued a joint statement calling for an immediate and sustained humanitarian truce in Gaza. The Israel-Hamas conflict escalated on October 7, when Hamas militants launched attacks that killed approximately 1,200 people, mostly civilians, in Israel. Israel responded with extensive airstrikes and a ground offensive in Gaza. According to Gaza authorities, more than 13,300 people have been killed in Gaza, including thousands of children.
translated_content: Saudský korunný princ Mohammed bin Salmán vyzval všetky krajiny, aby okamžite zastavili vývoz zbraní do Izraela, uvádza Al Arabiya Post. Túto výzvu predniesol počas mimoriadneho virtuálneho stretnutia BRICS, ktoré bolo zvolané v reakcii na prebiehajúci konflikt medzi Izraelom a Hamasom. Počas stretnutia, ktoré hostila Juhoafrická republika, Saudská Arábia zároveň žiadala začatie vážneho a komplexného mierového procesu, ktorého cieľom je vznik palestínskeho štátu na hraniciach z roku 1967. Korunný princ opäť zdôraznil, že postoj Saudskej Arábie zostáva nemenný: bezpečnosť a stabilita v Palestíne sa dá dosiahnuť iba implementáciou medzinárodných rozhodnutí týkajúcich sa riešenia dvoch štátov. Taktiež odsúdil pokračujúce izraelské vojenské operácie v Gaze a požadoval ich okamžité zastavenie. Korunný princ označil násilie v Gaze za „brutálne zločiny“ a vyzval na spoločné medzinárodné úsilie na ukončenie utrpenia. Znovu tiež vyjadril nesúhlas Saudskej Arábie s núteným vysídľovaním Palestínčanov a apeloval na spoločné kroky na zabránenie ďalšiemu zhoršovaniu humanitárnej situácie v Gaze. Poukázal na pretrvávajúce snahy Saudskej Arábie chrániť civilistov od eskalácie konfliktu. Stretnutia BRICS, ktoré viedla Juhoafrická republika, sa zúčastnili lídri Brazílie, Ruska, Indie, Číny, Juhoafrickej republiky, novoprijatých členských štátov a generálny tajomník OSN António Guterres. Juhoafrická republika odsúdila kroky Izraela ako vojnové zločiny a „genocídu“. Skupina BRICS vydala spoločné vyhlásenie, v ktorom vyzvala na okamžité a trvalé humanitárne prímerie v Gaze. Konflikt medzi Izraelom a Hamasom eskaloval 7. októbra, keď militanti Hamasu spustili útoky, počas ktorých zahynulo približne 1 200 ľudí, väčšinou civilistov v Izraeli. Izrael reagoval rozsiahlymi leteckými útokmi a pozemnou ofenzívou v Gaze. Podľa tamojších úradov si vojna vyžiadala v Gaze viac ako 13 300 obetí, vrátane tisícov detí.

article_content: In Birmingham, a second man has been arrested after live mice were released in several McDonald's restaurants. West Midlands Police reported that a 30-year-old male suspect is now in custody. These incidents, believed to be related to protest actions, took place at the Star City, Perry Barr, and Small Heath branches. Videos posted online showed mice—some dyed in Palestinian flag colors—being released at the Star City location on Monday. Additional footage from Perry Barr recorded the animals in a box before they were set free on Tuesday. Police condemned the acts as unacceptable and have enhanced local patrols to reassure the public. McDonald's temporarily closed the affected restaurants for deep cleaning and pest control. Separately, police had already arrested a 32-year-old man, who has since been released on bail. A further video surfaced Wednesday, appearing to show masked individuals dumping mice in the Small Heath branch. West Midlands Police continue to investigate this case, but have not confirmed if all incidents are connected.
translated_content: V Birminghame bol zatknutý druhý muž po tom, čo boli v niekoľkých reštauráciách McDonald's vypustené živé myši. Polícia Západného Midlandsu uviedla, že v cele je teraz 30-ročný podozrivý muž. Incidenty, ktoré sa pravdepodobne týkajú protestných činov, sa odohrali v pobočkách Star City, Perry Barr a Small Heath. Videá zverejnené na internete ukazovali myši – niektoré nafarbené v palestínskych farbách – ako ich vypúšťajú v Star City v pondelok. Ďalšie zábery z Perry Barr zachytávali myši v krabici pred vypustením v utorok. Polícia tieto skutky odsúdila ako neprijateľné a posilnila miestne hliadky, aby upokojila verejnosť. article_content: There are many ways to measure the runaway success of Squid Game. The dystopian South Korean drama is Netflix’s most-watched series of all time, recording 1.65 billion viewing hours in its first month—equal to 190,000 years. It received 14 Primetime Emmy nominations and won six. O Yeong-su, a Squid Game star, became the first Korean-born actor to win a Golden Globe. The show also inspired the reality spin-off 'Squid Game: The Challenge', which debuted recently. For Minyoung Kim, vice-president for Netflix in APAC, who greenlit Squid Game’s script in 2019 as head of Korean content, one surprising impact stood out: sales of the white Vans slip-ons worn by characters surged by 7,800%. “It wasn’t product placement; it was just a very basic sneaker!” Kim told TIME. “We didn’t expect people to react like that.” Squid Game transformed a $21.4 million production budget into a $900 million global phenomenon, impressing the entertainment industry. The series justified Netflix’s international expansion and led to more investment in non-English content. Today, 60% of Netflix’s global audience has watched Korean content, and 70% of viewers are outside the U.S. “The goal was to break language barriers and truly connect a global audience,” Kim says. “Squid Game proved that.” Other streaming giants, like Disney and Amazon, have since expanded their lineups of Korean content. In April, Netflix announced a $2.5 billion investment in Korean programming over the next four years. Kim says this puts 'exciting pressure' on her and highlights how Korean content remains central to Netflix’s future. Recent shows like 'The Glory' and 'Extraordinary Attorney Woo' demonstrate that Squid Game’s success was not a fluke. Kim is also enthusiastic about bringing shows from across Asia to global audiences. Netflix has seen renewed interest in pre-existing titles such as Japanese sci-fi thriller 'Alice in Borderland,' and is investing in new films in markets like Thailand, Indonesia, and Taiwan. The next big hit could come from anywhere in Asia; for example, Thailand’s 'Hunger' topped Netflix’s global viewing charts in April, while Indonesia’s 'Cigarette Girl' ranks among Netflix’s top non-English language content. Some productions have had a deeper cultural impact—Taiwan’s 'Wave Makers,' about a presidential election campaign, helped spark a #MeToo movement affecting several top politicians. Actress Tammy Lai, who played a fictional presidential candidate, later became a real-life running mate for Foxconn CEO Terry Gou before he withdrew from Taiwan’s 2024 presidential race. “For us, it was an office drama about growth and romance,” Kim explains, 'but the audience found something that resonated with them.' Kim believes Netflix’s investment is catalyzing a new pan-Asian film ecosystem. Alone, each nation’s industry may struggle to create globally captivating content. But by combining strengths—like Thailand’s post-production, South Korea’s special effects, and Singapore’s animation—talent and resources can be shared, boosting quality and appeal. 'In Asia, creators often push boundaries but face limits in their own country,' says Kim. 'Netflix helps connect the region.' This approach isn’t without precedent; J.K. Rowling’s insistence that Harry Potter films be shot in the U.K. helped rejuvenate the British film industry, which drew $7.3 billion in foreign investment last year. Streaming’s growth has already raised standards in Asia. Kamonthip Tachasakulmas, director of Bangkok-based One Cool Production, notes, 'International platforms mean your job is global, so you need strong quality control.' Still, concerns remain. The Hollywood writers’ and actors’ strikes (now resolved) highlighted issues with streaming compensation. Netflix insists that upfront payments to creators are fair, but many feel otherwise, especially as company profits soar. Squid Game director Hwang Dong-hyuk reportedly did not receive royalties beyond his contract flat fee, and some find the show’s criticism of capitalist exploitation has real-life parallels. Netflix’s overseas production has helped it navigate Hollywood disruptions, but the distribution of profits has become a political issue—South Korea announced a 500 billion won ($390 million) fund to support local platforms. Since 2018, 17 E.U. countries have imposed levies on streaming services to support national film industries. Streaming analyst Dan Rayburn notes that some regions collaborate to ensure local industry sustainability. Kim agrees the industry needs changes for greater health and success. A Squid Game-sized hit could spark similar debates elsewhere. Despite concerns, streaming investments are largely viewed as positive for Southeast Asia, especially as cinema attendance struggles post-pandemic. Adam Knee, dean at Lasalle College of the Arts, Singapore, says streaming gives Southeast Asian products a chance for global success. Challenges persist: commercially-driven platforms may avoid controversial local topics (like monarchy in Thailand, politics in Vietnam, or drugs in Singapore), and Netflix has complied with censorship demands before. There’s also the risk that artists, in pursuit of global fame, compromise local resonance. Kim values authenticity: 'If a show works in its home country but not internationally, that’s still a win. What we don’t want is a show that fails both locally and abroad.' Until the next Squid Game emerges, fans can anticipate season 2, now filming. Kim says the new season, stripped of its novelties, will offer a bigger story, new games, and fresh perspectives on human interaction. 'I’m confident people will enjoy it,' she says—as long as the characters on screen don’t.
translated_content: Existuje mnoho spôsobov, ako zmerať obrovský úspech Squid Game. Táto dystopická juhokórejská dráma je najsledovanejším seriálom Netflixu všetkých čias a počas prvého mesiaca nazbierala 1,65 miliardy hodín pozretí—čo je ekvivalent 190 000 rokov. Získala 14 nominácií na Primetime Emmy a vyhrala šesť. O Yeong-su, herec zo Squid Game, sa stal prvým kórejským rodákom oceneným Zlatým glóbusom. Seriál navyše inšpiroval reality spin-off „Squid Game: The Challenge“, ktorý mal nedávno premiéru. Viceprezidentka Netflixu pre APAC Minyoung Kim, ktorá v roku 2019 schválila scenár Squid Game ako vedúca kórejského obsahu, zaznamenala zaujímavý dopad: predaj bielych slip-on tenisiek Vans, ktoré nosili postavy, stúpol o 7 800 %. „Nebola to produktová reklama; boli to len obyčajné tenisky!“ povedala Kim pre TIME. „Nečakali sme takúto reakciu.“ Squid Game zmenilo rozpočet 21,4 milióna dolárov na celosvetový fenomén v hodnote 900 miliónov dolárov a ohromilo zábavný priemysel. Tento seriál odôvodnil medzinárodnú expanziu Netflixu a viedol k vyšším investíciám do neanglického obsahu. Dnes si 60 % celosvetového publika Netflixu pozrelo kórejský obsah a 70 % divákov je mimo USA. „Cieľom bolo prekonať jazykové bariéry a skutočne spojiť globálne publikum,“ hovorí Kim. „Squid Game to dokázalo.“ Iné streamovacie platformy, ako Disney a Amazon, už tiež rozšírili svoju ponuku kórejských titulov. V apríli Netflix oznámil investíciu 2,5 miliardy dolárov do kórejského obsahu počas nasledujúcich štyroch rokov. Kim tvrdí, že na ňu to vytvára 'vzrušujúci tlak' a podčiarkuje, že kórejský obsah ostáva stredobodom pre Netflix. Novšie seriály ako „The Glory“ a „Extraordinary Attorney Woo“ dokazujú, že úspech Squid Game nebola len náhoda. Kim je tiež nadšená z toho, že môže priniesť seriály z celej Ázie globálnemu publiku. Netflix zaznamenal zvýšený záujem o existujúce tituly ako japonský sci-fi thriller „Alice in Borderland“ a investuje aj do nových filmov z Thajska, Indonézie či Taiwanu. Ďalší veľký hit môže prísť odkiaľkoľvek; napríklad thajský „Hunger“ sa v apríli stal najsledovanejším filmom Netflixu na svete, zatiaľ čo indonézsky „Cigarette Girl“ patrí medzi top neanglický obsah. Niektoré produkcie mali hlbší spoločenský vplyv—taiwanský seriál „Wave Makers“ o prezidentskej volebnej kampani naštartoval hnutie #MeToo, ktoré zasiahlo viacerých politických lídrov. Herečka Tammy Lai, ktorá v ňom stvárnila fiktívnu kandidátku na prezidentku, sa neskôr stala skutočnou volebnou partnerkou šéfa Foxconnu, Terryho Goua, predtým ako sa z volieb 2024 stiahol. „Pre nás to bola kancelárska dráma o raste a romantike,“ vysvetľuje Kim, 'no diváci v tom našli niečo, čo s nimi rezonovalo.' Kim verí, že investície Netflixu rozbiehajú novú pan-ázijskú filmovú ekosystém. Každá krajina by sama ťažko vytvorila dielo, ktoré by zasiahlo svet, ale spolčením silných stránok—postprodukcie v Thajsku, špeciálnych efektov v Kórei či animácie v Singapure—sa môže kvalita a atraktivita regionálne zvýšiť. 'V Ázii sa tvorcovia často snažia prísť s niečím novým, no narazia na hranice v ich krajine,' hovorí Kim. 'Netflix spája región.' Tento prístup má precedens—J.K. Rowling trvala na natáčaní filmov o Harrym Potterovi vo Veľkej Británii, čo pomohlo oživiť britský filmový priemysel a v minulom roku doň pritiahnuť 7,3 miliardy dolárov zo zahraničných investícií. Nárast streamovacích služieb už zvýšil štandardy aj v Ázii. Kamonthip Tachasakulmas, riaditeľka One Cool Production z Bangkoku, poznamenáva: 'Pre medzinárodné platformy ide práca do celého sveta, takže kontrola kvality musí byť vysoká.' Problémy však pretrvávajú. Štrajky scenáristov a hercov v Hollywoode, ktoré sú už vyriešené, poukázali na otázky spravodlivého odmeňovania pri streamovaní. Netflix tvrdí, že tvorcov platí férovo vopred, no mnohí majú iný názor, najmä keď zisky spoločnosti rastú. Režisér Squid Game Hwang Dong-hyuk údajne nedostal žiadne tantiémy nad rámec zmluvného honorára a niektorí vidia paralelu medzi kritikou kapitalizmu v seriáli a realitou. Zahraničné produkcie Netflixu mu pomohli zvládnuť hollywoodske štrajky, no rozdelenie ziskov sa stalo politickou otázkou—Južná Kórea oznámila fond 500 miliárd wonov (390 miliónov USD) na podporu domácich platforiem. Od roku 2018 zaviedlo 17 krajín EÚ poplatky pre streamovacie služby na podporu národných filmových priemyslov. Analytik streamovania Dan Rayburn podotýka, že niektoré regióny spolupracujú, aby zabezpečili udržateľnosť lokálneho odvetvia. Kim súhlasí, že odvetvie potrebuje zmeny pre zdravší rast a úspech. Hit veľkosti Squid Game môže podnietiť podobné debaty aj inde. Napriek výhradám sú investície streamovacích platforiem v juhovýchodnej Ázii vnímané najmä pozitívne, hlavne keď návštevnosť kín klesla po pandémii. Adam Knee, dekan na Lasalle College of the Arts v Singapure, hovorí, že streaming dáva šancu juhovýchodným ázijským produktom preraziť vo svete. Problémy však pretrvávajú: komerčne orientované platformy sa môžu vyhýbať kontroverzným témam (monarchia v Thajsku, politika vo Vietname, drogy v Singapure) a Netflix už v minulosti pristúpil na požiadavky cenzúry. Hrozí tiež, že sa tvorcovia v snahe o celosvetovú slávu vzdajú miestnej autenticity. Kim kladie dôraz na autenticitu: 'Ak je seriál úspešný doma, no nie v zahraničí, je to pre nás stále výhra. Čo nechceme, je, ak zlyhá doma aj vo svete.' Kým sa neobjaví ďalší fenomén, fanúšikovia sa môžu tešiť na druhú sériu Squid Game, ktorá sa už natáča. Kim hovorí, že nový diel prinesie väčší príbeh, nové hry a čerstvý pohľad na ľudské vzťahy. 'Som presvedčená, že to ľudí zaujme,' dodáva—hlavne ak postavy na obrazovke opäť neprežijú.

article_content: The EU is currently trialing a plan to use protein-rich maggots, reared on animal and vegetable waste, as an alternative feed for livestock. With global meat demand rising, scientists and farmers are searching for affordable and sustainable alternatives to traditional feed ingredients like soya beans, which are in high demand. In this EU project, flies are bred on an industrial scale using various types of readily-available waste—such as sawdust, used grain from whisky distilleries, or agricultural byproducts—depending on regional resources. These flies produce larvae (maggots), which are then harvested as an animal feed ingredient. The world population is expected to increase significantly by 2050, leading to a predicted doubling of meat and dairy demand. To address this, the EU project is exploring whether maggot-based feed could be introduced on a wide scale. Georg Melzer, a partner at Eutema Technology in Austria—a company involved in the project—explains that the specific waste products used depend on the local environment. For example, in Scotland, grain from nearby whisky distilleries might be used, while in Spain, tomato pulp could be utilized. On chicken farms, a mix of droppings, straw, and sawdust may serve as feedstock. The Grant Bait fishing-bait farm in Roos, East Yorkshire, is experimenting with large-scale maggot production using these waste materials. The larvae are then transported to Ghent, Belgium, where they are tested in animal feed trials. The project is scheduled to run for three years. If successful, introducing maggot-based feed would require changes to current EU regulations, which presently prohibit the sale of meat from animals raised on maggot-containing feed.
translated_content: EÚ momentálne skúša plán použiť bielkovinami bohaté larvy múch, chované na živočíšnom a rastlinnom odpade, ako alternatívne krmivo pre hospodárske zvieratá. S rastúcim globálnym dopytom po mäse hľadajú vedci a farmári cenovo dostupné a udržateľné alternatívy k tradičným zložkám krmiva, ako sú sójové bôby, po ktorých je veľký dopyt. V rámci tohto projektu EÚ sú muchy chované vo veľkom množstve na rôznych druhoch dostupného odpadu—napríklad na pilinách, použitom zrne z whisky páleníc alebo poľnohospodárskych zvyškoch—v závislosti od miestnych zdrojov. Tieto muchy produkujú larvy (červy), ktoré sa potom zbierajú ako krmná prísada. Očakáva sa, že do roku 2050 populácia sveta výrazne vzrastie, čo povedie k predpokladanému zdvojnásobeniu dopytu po mäse a mliečnych výrobkoch. Na riešenie tejto výzvy skúma projekt EÚ možnosti zavedenia krmiva na báze červov vo väčšom rozsahu. Georg Melzer, partner spoločnosti Eutema Technology v Rakúsku, ktorá je zapojená do projektu, vysvetľuje, že použité odpadové suroviny závisia od miestnych podmienok. Napríklad v Škótsku by sa použilo zrno z blízkych whisky páleníc, v Španielsku by mohol byť využitý paradajkový odpad. Na hydinárskych farmách sa môže využiť zmes trusu, slamy a pilín. Farma Grant Bait na rybárske návnady v Roos, East Yorkshire, skúša produkciu červov vo veľkom množstve s použitím týchto odpadových materiálov. Larvy sa potom prepravujú do Gentu v Belgicku, kde sa testujú v krmivárskych pokusoch. Projekt je naplánovaný na tri roky. Ak bude úspešný, zavedenie krmiva na báze červov by si vyžadovalo zmenu súčasných predpisov EÚ, ktoré momentálne zakazujú predaj mäsa zo zvierat kŕmených krmivom obsahujúcim červy.

article_content: Throughout her life, an elderly worshipper found inspiration in her church’s fresco of Jesus crowned with thorns. When the plaster artwork began to crumble due to dampness, the woman, in her 80s, decided to take action. Without informing authorities at the Sanctuary of Mercy Church in Borja, Zaragoza, Spain, she entered with oil paints and a brush and began her own restoration of the fresco. After her efforts, the image no longer resembled the original depiction of Jesus, drawing widespread attention. The fresco, 'Ecce Homo' by Elias Garcia Martinez, had been admired at the church for over 120 years. Moisture had caused significant damage, leading to deterioration of the fresco’s surface. While the woman’s opinion of her work is unknown, many worshippers expressed shock and disappointment. The transformation of the 120-year-old fresco has prompted embarrassment in the community. Coincidentally, the Centre for Borjanos—a local Catholic cultural foundation—had recently received a donation from the artist’s granddaughter, which was intended for professional restoration. Experts are now examining whether the restoration can be reversed. A spokesperson for the Centre stated, 'The value of the original was more sentimental than monetary. The lady, in her 80s, apparently considers herself an artist and acted without authorization. The church is always open for visitors, and although there is a guard, no one noticed her actions until she had finished.' Despite these reports, the woman, identified as Cecilia Jimenez, maintains that she had received permission for the restoration.
translated_content: Po celý život nachádzala staršia veriaca inšpiráciu vo freske Ježiša s tŕňovou korunou vo svojom kostole. Keď sa omietka začala drobiť v dôsledku vlhkosti, pani v osemdesiatych rokoch sa rozhodla zakročiť. Bez toho, aby informovala úrady v Kostole milosrdenstva v Borja, Zaragoza, Španielsko, prišla s olejovými farbami a štetcom a pustila sa do vlastnej obnovy fresky. Po jej zásahu obraz už nepripomínal pôvodné zobrazenie Ježiša, čo pritiahlo veľkú pozornosť širokej verejnosti. Freska 'Ecce Homo' od Eliasa Garcia Martineza bola v kostole obdivovaná viac než 120 rokov. Vlhkosť spôsobila výrazné poškodenie a narušenie povrchu fresky. Hoci názor pani na svoj výsledok nie je známy, viacerí veriaci vyjadrili šok a sklamanie. Premena 120-ročnej fresky vyvolala v komunite rozpaky. Centrum pre Borjanos—miestna katolícka kultúrna nadácia—práve dostalo dar od vnučky autora, ktorý mal byť použitý na profesionálnu obnovu fresky. Odborníci teraz zisťujú, či sa dá zásah zvrátiť. Hovorca Centra uviedol: 'Hodnota originálu bola skôr sentimentálna než finančná. Pani v osemdesiatich rokoch sa očividne považuje za umelkyňu a konala bez povolenia. Kostol je vždy otvorený pre návštevníkov a napriek tomu, že tam je strážca, nikto si jej konanie nevšimol, kým nedokončila.' Napriek týmto správam pani, známa ako Cecilia Jiménez, tvrdí, že mala na obnovu povolenie.

article_content: A married sixth-grade English teacher, Daniel Reilly, 36, has appeared in court following accusations of a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old former student. Prosecutors allege that Reilly used code names on his cellphone to conceal the affair from both his wife and the girl's family. The alleged relationship reportedly lasted eight months and included at least ten encounters at Reilly's apartment in Forest Hills, New York, when his wife and infant daughter were not home. Reilly, an ex-Marine teacher with no previous record of disciplinary issues, was arraigned and released on $30,000 bail posted by his wife, Annemarie, a lawyer who attended the court proceedings with her mother. If convicted, he could face up to seven years in prison. Court documents suggest the most recent meeting occurred just days before Reilly's arrest at Intermediate School 237 in Flushing. The case came to light after the alleged victim's sister discovered inappropriate text messages between Reilly and her sister, prompting their parents to alert the school. He was removed from class and police were called. According to prosecutors, Reilly initiated contact with the girl last August, sending her text messages and inviting her to his apartment while his family was away. He allegedly used code names for the secret affair to avoid detection by both his wife and the girl's parents. Queens District Attorney Richard Brown described the case as 'particularly disturbing,' emphasizing that schools should be safe havens for children. Schools Chancellor Dennis Walcott reiterated a policy of zero tolerance for such misconduct. Reilly, who taught at IS237 for six years and served as a Marine sergeant from 1996 to 2000, is charged with second-degree rape, criminal sexual acts, and endangering the welfare of a child. He is due back in court on May 6. An order of protection has been issued for the victim.

article_content: Disney Cruise Line triumphed at the 2013 Cruise Critic Cruisers’ Choice Awards, with the Disney Fantasy taking top honors. Packed with highlights like a four-story waterslide, extensive kids’ programming, and even a stop at a private island, Disney’s newest ships secured the top spots. The Disney Fantasy received best large ship, best cabins, best entertainment, best public areas, and best service accolades. Its predecessor, the Disney Dream, which debuted in 2011, was named best for shore excursions. Both accommodate over 2,000 guests and cater to every age group, offering fine dining, serene adult spaces, and lively youth activities. Carolyn Spencer Brown, CruiseCritic.com’s editor, noted that Disney stands apart by keeping its unique character-driven entertainment while expanding offerings for multiple generations, making it a hit with families. Awards are based on thousands of Cruise Critic user reviews from 2012, thoroughly vetted for authenticity, with staff members personally evaluating ships to ensure fair assessments. Other cruise lines celebrated include Celebrity Reflection (best dining), Celebrity Eclipse (best value among large ships), and Royal Caribbean’s Allure of the Seas (top for fitness and embarkation). For midsize categories (1,200–1,999 guests), Holland America’s ms Noordam won best overall, and ms Westerdam was commended for fitness and excursions. Oceania Marina earned recognition for its cabins, dining, and striking public spaces. In the small ship division (fewer than 1,200 guests), Azamara Quest captured best overall honors, along with wins for fitness and service. Crystal Serenity, Seabourn Odyssey, Regent Seven Seas, and Windstar’s Wind Surf also received special mentions for their onboard offerings. Spencer Brown added that cruising offers a safe and memorable vacation and encouraged both experienced and first-time cruisers to share tips and questions.

article_content: Anyone who's ever been caught off guard by a beer bottle erupting in foam knows it's a real nuisance. Fortunately, scientists in Belgium may have found a solution—using magnets. A team led by Zahra Shokribousjein at Belgium’s Centre for Food and Microbial Biology discovered that exposing antifoaming agents in beer to a magnetic field makes them significantly more powerful. During brewing, hops extract is typically added to counteract certain proteins—called hydrophobins—that come from fungi and tend to attract carbon dioxide, leading to unwanted fizziness or 'gushing'. By passing the hops extract through a magnetized tube while mixing it into the malt, researchers managed to break the extract into smaller particles. This process increases its surface area, allowing it to interact more thoroughly with the foam-causing hydrophobins. The practical upshot? Brewers need far less hops extract, which not only brings down production costs but also makes beers less bitter. Even better—it only takes about a minute to apply this technique. Earlier research from French institutions (the Institute Jean le Rond D'Alembert and Université Pierre et Marie Curie) helped explain how mechanical shock from clinking bottles leads to rapid bubble expansion, collapse, and the sudden frothy overflow. This new magnet-based technique, tested at Belgium's Orval Brewery, is set to move from lab experiments to industrial production, potentially putting an end to unexpected beer geysers and lowering prices for consumers. Researchers plan to further develop this method for broader use in breweries.

Tím vedený Zahrou Shokribousjein z Belgického Centra pre potravinovú a mikrobiálnu biológiu zistil, že keď sa protipeniace látky v pive vystavia magnetickému poľu, výrazne sa zvýši ich účinok. Predchádzajúci výskum z Francúzska (Institut Jean le Rond D'Alembert a Université Pierre et Marie Curie) objasnil, prečo pri udieraní fliaš vzniká rýchly nárast bublín, ich rozpad a rýchle prepenenie piva. Just days before the highly anticipated launch of the new iPhone, Apple shares suffered their worst one-day decline since January after a brokerage warned of a possible stock downgrade unless upcoming products showed stronger potential for profit growth. Despite this, Apple fans remain undeterred, with some already camping outside the company’s Fifth Avenue store in New York, eager to be among the first to buy the iPhone 6.

The queues outside the store began well ahead of the product reveal, scheduled for Tuesday, September 9. The new iPhone is expected to be available in 4.7-inch and 5.5-inch models, possibly featuring a flexible and scratch-resistant sapphire screen produced in the US, an enhanced 'Retina display+' with a 1,704x904 resolution, a faster A8 processor, a more advanced rear camera—potentially with interchangeable lenses—and wireless charging capabilities.

Brian Ceballo, one of the first to line up, told CNBC, 'We wanted to beat the record, which had been 18 days.'

Shares of Apple dropped 4 percent—its largest percentage drop since late January—amid scrutiny over its security systems following a leak of private celebrity photos stored in iCloud accounts. The stock lost $3.57 to close at $99.15, with 94 million shares traded—more than double the company’s 50-day average volume—making it one of the busiest trading days of the year for Apple.

Apple faces increasing pressure to innovate, having not released a significant new product since the iPad in 2010. Industry observers expect Apple may also unveil a smartwatch, although it remains uncertain whether Apple can succeed in the wearables market where others, like Samsung, have struggled.

Amid the excitement and controversy, Pacific Crest Securities analyst Andy Hargreaves advised investors to take profit ahead of the iPhone launch, warning, 'Unless next week's event details massive incremental profit opportunities, we are likely to downgrade Apple’s rating.' Other analysts noted market sentiment was dampened by concern over the recent iCloud security breach. Apple clarified that the breach was the result of targeted hacking of individual iCloud accounts, not a broader compromise of Apple’s systems.

The incident has put Apple’s security practices under a microscope, just as the upcoming iPhone is expected to handle increasingly sensitive data, including personal, financial, and healthcare information. Experts and developers have raised concerns over the adequacy of cloud security, and thousands have expressed frustration on social media.

Despite the stock’s decline, options trading activity remains bullish, with volumes up 10% from the norm and call options outnumbering puts significantly. According to Credit Suisse and Trade Alert, bullish option trades exceeded bearish ones by nearly two to one in the days leading up to the launch. Naeem Aslam, chief market analyst at Ava Trade, stated, 'Despite the recent events, I am still very bullish on Apple as they have a number of new products coming out such as wearables and a new, larger iPad.'

Market pricing suggests a 3.9% move in Apple’s shares by September 19, with heavy options activity at $104 and $107 strikes expiring September 12. 'That was a bullish trade and it’s the closest expiration following the Apple event,' said Brian Overby, senior options analyst at TradeKing.

Len pár dní pred dlho očakávaným predstavením nového iPhonu zaznamenali akcie Apple najväčší denný pokles od januára po varovaní makléra, že ak nové produkty neprinesú väčší ziskový potenciál, akcie by mohli byť znížené. Fanúšikovia Apple sú však stále nadšení – niektorí už dokonca stanovali pred predajňou na Piavej Avenue v New Yorku, aby mohli byť medzi prvými, ktorí si kúpia iPhone 6.

Rady pred predajňou sa začali tvoriť ešte pred oficiálnym odhalením produktu, ktoré je naplánované na utorok 9. septembra. Očakáva sa, že nový iPhone príde v dvoch veľkostiach – 4,7 a 5,5 palca – a mohol by ponúknuť ohybný a odolný safírový displej vyrobený v USA, vylepšený Retina display+ s rozlíšením 1704 x 904, rýchlejší procesor A8, vylepšený zadný fotoaparát (možno s vymeniteľnými objektívmi) a podporu bezdrôtového nabíjania.

Brian Ceballo, jeden z prvých v rade, povedal pre CNBC: „Chceli sme prekonať rekord, ktorý bol 18 dní.“

Akcie Apple klesli o 4 % – čo je najvyšší percentuálny pokles od konca januára – pre pochybnosti o bezpečnosti systému po úniku súkromných fotografií celebrít z účtov iCloud. Akcie klesli o 3,57 dolára a uzavreli na 99,15 USD; zobchodovalo sa 94 miliónov akcií – viac ako dvojnásobok 50-dňového priemeru spoločnosti, vďaka čomu bol deň jedným z najrušnejších tohto roka.

Apple je pod tlakom priniesť inovácie, keďže od iPadu v roku 2010 nepredstavila žiadny zásadný nový produkt. Odborníci očakávajú, že spoločnosť predstaví aj inteligentné hodinky, no nie je isté, či Apple uspelo na trhu s nositeľnou technológiou, kde ostatné firmy ako Samsung zlyhali.

V čase tejto udalosti a kontroverzií odporučil analytik Andy Hargreaves z Pacific Crest Securities investorom predať akcie pred predstavením iPhonu: „Pokiaľ budúcotýždňová udalosť neprinesie výrazné nové možnosti zisku, pravdepodobne znížime hodnotenie Apple.“ Iní analytici uviedli, že náladu na trhu ovplyvnili aj obavy z nedávneho úniku z iCloudu. Apple zdôraznil, že išlo o individuálne hacknuté účty, nie o systémový prienik.

Tento incident upriamil pozornosť na bezpečnostné opatrenia Apple, keďže nový iPhone by mal spracúvať ešte citlivejšie osobné, finančné a zdravotné dáta. Odborníci i vývojári poukázali na nedostatky v bezpečnosti cloudových služieb a tisíce ľudí vyjadrili svoju nespokojnosť na sociálnych sieťach.

Napriek poklesu ceny akcií na burze ostáva obchodovanie s opciami optimistické – objemy vzrástli o 10 % a call opcie prevládajú nad put opciami. Podľa Credit Suisse a Trade Alert prevyšovali býčie opcie medvedie takmer v pomere dva ku jednej pred uvedením produktu. Naeem Aslam, hlavný trhový analytik v Ava Trade, povedal: „Napriek minulým udalostiam som stále optimistický ohľadom Apple – čaká nás veľa nových produktov, ako napríklad nositeľná technológia a väčší iPad.“

Očakáva sa, že akcie Apple zaznamenajú do 19. septembra pohyb o 3,9 %, pričom na opčných úrovniach 104 a 107 USD s expiráciou 12. septembra bola veľká aktivita. „Bol to býčí obchod a je to najbližšia expirácia po Apple evente,“ uviedol Brian Overby, senior analytik pre opcie v TradeKing.

article_content: Reporting from Concepcion, Chile, CNN journalists describe the immense challenges faced in the aftermath of a powerful earthquake. The disaster left many residents without food, water, or security, and caused widespread building damage. The CNN team, recently diverted from work on a documentary about the Haiti disaster, undertook a complex journey through multiple countries and regions to reach the quake's epicenter. Upon arrival, they encountered a dire lack of fuel and electricity, rendering much of their broadcast equipment inoperable. Confusion over fuel types led to several vehicles becoming temporarily out of service, exacerbating the logistical struggle. The team endured cold, sleepless nights, limited access to supplies, and ongoing aftershocks that frequently rattled the region. As conditions worsened and with a deadline looming for their Haiti documentary, the team sought ways to leave, facing significant obstacles such as closed airports, regional standstills, and fuel scarcity. Eventually, they joined hundreds of displaced people at a small airport outside Concepcion, where the Chilean Air Force and Peruvian government provided evacuation flights. The makeshift flight involved hours on cold, uncomfortable metal bench seats and multiple refueling stops. Despite the tough circumstances, everyone onboard, including young children, remained patient and grateful. The journey was punctuated by news of fresh aftershocks and ongoing logistical efforts to support their colleagues still in Concepcion. Arriving in Lima, Peru, in the early morning hours, the team expressed relief, exhaustion, and lingering concern for those still affected by the disaster in Chile. The experience highlighted the personal and professional challenges faced by journalists covering natural disasters and the profound impact such events have on both reporters and the communities they document.

Tím CNN, ktorý bol krátko predtým odklonený z práce na dokumente o katastrofe na Haiti, absolvoval komplikovanú cestu cez viaceré krajiny a regióny, aby sa dostal do epicentra otrasov. Zámena druhov paliva spôsobila dočasnú nefunkčnosť viacerých vozidiel, čím sa logistické problémy ešte zhoršili. Tím prekonával chladné, prebdené noci, obmedzený prístup k zásobám a opakujúce sa dotrasy, ktoré región pravidelne sužovali. Keď sa podmienky zhoršovali a s blížiacim sa termínom dokumentu o Haiti, tím hľadal spôsoby, ako odísť, pričom čelil vážnym prekážkam, ako zatvorené letiská, blokády a nedostatok paliva. Nakoniec sa pridali k stovkám vysídlených ľudí na malom letisku pri Concepcione, kde čilské letectvo a peruánska vláda poskytli evakuačné lety. Provizórny let zahŕňal hodiny na studených, nepohodlných kovových laviciach a viacero tankovacích zastávok. Napriek ťažkým podmienkam zostávali všetci na palube, vrátane malých detí, trpezliví a vďační. Joseph Janbazian Zulu, a 20-year-old from Zambia, received a four and a half year prison sentence for arson and violent conduct linked to the 2011 London riots. After his conviction, British authorities intended to deport him to Zambia. However, an immigration tribunal overturned this decision, allowing Zulu to remain in the UK due to concerns over his lack of connections, support systems, and safety in Zambia.

Zulu moved from Zimbabwe to the UK in 2003 to join his mother, and was granted indefinite leave to remain in 2010. He resides in the UK with his two older brothers, and his mother and younger siblings are also settled there. During the tribunal hearing, Zulu emphasized that he has never lived in Zambia, lacks any family or friends there, and would likely face homelessness and social isolation if deported. He further expressed that his mixed-race background could make integration in Zambia especially difficult and leave him vulnerable to discrimination and personal safety risks.

Zulu’s mother corroborated his claims, highlighting that neither she nor her son have any familial ties or community in Zambia, and voicing concerns about his ability to find shelter or belong. The tribunal judge noted Zulu’s expressions of remorse, his clean record since the conviction, and his efforts to distance himself from negative influences. The judge also pointed out that Zulu would probably not be accepted by Zambian authorities or the local community because of his criminal record, concluding that deportation would be unduly harsh.

The ruling has drawn criticism from some quarters, notably Conservative MP Philip Hollobone, who described the decision as unacceptable and argued that foreign nationals convicted of crimes should be deported and permanently barred from returning.

article_content: Liverpool are aiming to sign Burnley striker Danny Ings by utilizing a less-known Premier League rule after their initial transfer bid was rejected. The club was willing to pay £4 million for Ings and loan him back to Burnley for the rest of the season, but this arrangement was not permitted under league regulations. However, under Premier League Rule U8, Liverpool can enter into a pre-contract agreement with both Ings and Burnley, provided it is approved by the Premier League Board. This would allow Ings to join Liverpool in the summer but continue playing for Burnley for the remainder of the current season. Liverpool’s move is timely, as Ings’s contract is set to run out at the end of the season. The strategy echoes Manchester United’s agreement with Fulham for Chris Smalling in January 2010, where Smalling completed the transfer six months later and did not play against United during that period. Ings, in contrast, is set to face Liverpool soon at Anfield. The Premier League Board will check that there’s no conflict of interest or improper pressure on Ings or Burnley, especially in relation to matches versus Liverpool. Burnley are fighting to avoid relegation and have ruled out selling Ings in the January window. They also recognize that he will not sign a new contract. If Ings moves to another English club in the summer, Burnley anticipate around £3 million in compensation; if he goes abroad, only £200,000. There was speculation on transfer deadline day about Ings possibly agreeing a pre-contract with Real Sociedad. Burnley manager Sean Dyche admitted that the transfer speculation affected Ings's performance in their recent loss to Sunderland. Ings has impressed in his debut Premier League season for Burnley, scoring seven goals. The 22-year-old prefers a move to Liverpool and has been closely linked with Tottenham as well. Burnley’s staff believe resolving his future could help his performance improve as the season concludes. Liverpool are reportedly prepared to pay up to £5 million to secure Ings ahead of rivals. Meanwhile, they face Bolton in an FA Cup fourth-round replay, with Daniel Sturridge potentially returning after injury. Manager Brendan Rodgers is optimistic about the team’s progress after their narrow Capital One Cup semi-final defeat, aiming for continued success in the cup competitions.

article_content: Communication Platform as a Service (CPaaS) has become a crucial tool in communication technology, allowing businesses and individuals to interact seamlessly across different channels. As society grows more interconnected and data-driven, integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT) is set to further revolutionize CPaaS. CPaaS enables users to add real-time communication features—such as voice, video, messaging, and chat—to their applications and services. It bridges traditional communication networks with modern digital platform demands. This technology has transformed sectors like customer service, telehealth, and remote collaboration by offering unified, flexible communication experiences. CPaaS has blurred the lines between communication channels, empowering more personalized, convenient user interactions and tailored engagements. However, CPaaS faces challenges, such as the need for deeper personalization and stronger security. Ensuring data privacy and integrity is increasingly vital, and the demand for more efficient, optimized communication through data-driven insights continues to grow. AI enhances CPaaS by powering chatbots, virtual assistants, and advanced analytics. With technologies like machine learning and natural language processing (NLP), AI enables CPaaS platforms to better understand users, automate tasks, and provide predictive insights. For example, NLP helps categorize messages and prioritize responses, improving efficiency. Predictive analytics in CPaaS allow businesses to anticipate user behavior and preferences, optimizing their communication strategies. These tools help identify usage patterns, facilitate proactive engagement, and support data-driven decisions. Beyond basic automation, AI is driving advanced features that promise even smarter, more valuable communication experiences by continuously learning from user interactions. IoT extends connectivity to a wide range of devices, offering real-time, context-aware data that enriches communications. Integrating IoT with CPaaS creates a powerful feedback loop, providing actionable information for businesses and users. The synergy between AI and IoT in CPaaS means platforms can analyze vast data streams from sensors, deliver hyper-personalized experiences, and enable predictive communication. This enhances customer support by allowing proactive responses and greater personalization. Security and privacy remain top priorities as CPaaS evolves. AI plays a key role in monitoring, detecting, and preventing threats within the large volumes of data generated by IoT devices. Ensuring robust privacy protection mechanisms is critical for building trust. Emerging trends include the rise of AI-powered voice assistants, integration with smart devices, and a focus on ethical use and regulatory compliance. CPaaS is expanding into new areas, aiming to provide users with secure, efficient, and personalized communication experiences across many sectors. The evolution of CPaaS through AI and IoT is expected to speed up, creating a new era of connected, adaptive, and secure communications that transforms how we interact.

S pribúdajúcou prepojenosťou spoločnosti a rastúcim využívaním dát integrácia umelej inteligencie (AI) a internetu vecí (IoT) ešte viac revolučne ovplyvní CPaaS. CPaaS umožňuje používateľom pridávať do svojich aplikácií a služieb komunikačné funkcie v reálnom čase, ako sú hlas, video, správy a chat. Prepája tradičné komunikačné siete s požiadavkami moderných digitálnych platforiem. Táto technológia zmenila oblasti ako zákaznícky servis, telemedicína či vzdialená spolupráca tým, že umožňuje jednotné a flexibilné komunikačné zážitky. CPaaS stiera hranice medzi kanálmi a podporuje personalizovanejšiu a pohodlnejšiu komunikáciu aj individuálne prispôsobené služby. Napriek tomu má CPaaS svoje výzvy, ako je potreba hlbšej personalizácie a silnejšieho zabezpečenia. Ochrana súkromia a integrita údajov sú čoraz dôležitejšie a zvyšuje sa aj dopyt po efektívnejšej a optimalizovanej komunikácii založenej na dátach. AI vylepšuje CPaaS nasadením chatbotov, virtuálnych asistentov a pokročilej analytiky. Vďaka technológiám ako strojové učenie a spracovanie prirodzeného jazyka (NLP) dokáže CPaaS lepšie porozumieť používateľom, automatizovať úlohy a poskytovať prediktívne poznatky. Napríklad NLP pomáha triediť správy a stanovovať priority odpovedí, čím zvyšuje efektivitu. Prediktívna analytika v CPaaS umožňuje firmám predvídať správanie a preferencie používateľov, čo optimalizuje ich komunikačné stratégie. Tieto nástroje pomáhajú identifikovať vzory používania, podporujú proaktívne zapojenie a rozhodovanie na základe dát. AI okrem základnej automatizácie poháňa aj pokročilé funkcie, vďaka ktorým sú komunikácie stále inteligentnejšie a hodnotnejšie, keďže sa neustále učí z interakcií používateľov. IoT rozširuje konektivitu na širokú škálu zariadení, ktoré poskytujú dáta v reálnom čase, čím ešte viac obohacujú komunikáciu. Integrácia IoT s CPaaS vytvára mocnú spätnú väzbu a poskytuje užitočné informácie pre podniky aj používateľov. Synergia AI a IoT v CPaaS znamená, že platformy môžu analyzovať obrovské množstvo dát zo senzorov, prinášať hyperpersonalizované zážitky a umožniť prediktívnu komunikáciu. To zlepšuje zákaznícky servis vďaka proaktívnym reakciám aj väčšej personalizácii. Zabezpečenie a ochrana súkromia zostávajú hlavnými prioritami pri vývoji CPaaS. AI hrá kľúčovú úlohu v monitorovaní, detekcii a predchádzaní hrozbám v obrovských objemoch dát generovaných zariadeniami IoT. Zavedenie robustných mechanizmov na ochranu súkromia je zásadné pre budovanie dôvery. Medzi nové trendy patrí vzostup AI hlasových asistentov, integrácia so smart zariadeniami a dôraz na etické využívanie a reguláciu. CPaaS expanduje do nových oblastí s cieľom poskytovať bezpečné, efektívne a personalizované komunikačné zážitky naprieč rôznymi sektormi. Očakáva sa, že vývoj CPaaS prostredníctvom AI a IoT sa zrýchli, čím vznikne nová éra prepojenej, adaptívnej a bezpečnej komunikácie, ktorá premení spôsob, akým spolu komunikujeme.

article_content: Sony has announced the development of a Single-Lens Display Module (SLDM), a microdisplay that can be attached to a variety of eyewear, such as sunglasses and work goggles, and removed when not needed. The SLDM features a high-resolution color microdisplay, a micro-optical unit, and a compact control board with capabilities comparable to those of smartphones. The display unit attaches to the right side of existing frames and does not obstruct the wearer’s field of vision. Sony sees applications for the SLDM in sports and work environments, where it can provide useful, hands-free information. Example uses include accessing maps or data while cycling, golfing, or working in a factory. The SLDM’s microdisplay measures 0.23 inches with a resolution of 640 x 400 pixels. The display weighs approximately 40g total, with 22g for the display arm and 18g for the secondary arm. For comparison, Google Glass weighs 43g and has a 640 x 360 pixel display. The device is equipped with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, an electronic compass, accelerometer, and touch sensor. It is powered by an ARM Cortex-A7 processor. Unlike Google Glass, Sony’s module does not include an on-board camera. Sony plans to present a concept model of the SLDM at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES) in Las Vegas in January and aims to begin selling the module within a year. The company is also making software development kits (SDKs) available for developers to create applications as the device nears completion. Sony is seeking partnerships with eyewear makers, sports and entertainment brands, and other electronics companies to expand the SLDM’s reach.

SLDM obsahuje vysokorozlišovací farebný mikrodisplej, mikrooptickú jednotku a kompaktnú riadiacu dosku s funkciami porovnateľnými so smartfónmi. Displej sa upevňuje na pravú stranu existujúcich rámov a neobmedzuje zorné pole používateľa. Sony vidí využitie SLDM v športe a pracovnom prostredí, kde môže poskytovať užitočné informácie bez použitia rúk. Príkladmi sú prístup k mapám alebo dátam pri cyklistike, golfe alebo v továrni. Mikrodisplej SLDM má veľkosť 0,23 palca a rozlíšenie 640 x 400 pixelov. Displej váži približne 40 gramov – 22 gramov má rameno s displejom a 18 gramov sekundárne rameno. Pre porovnanie, Google Glass váži 43 gramov a jeho displej má rozlíšenie 640 x 360 pixelov. Zariadenie je vybavené Wi-Fi a Bluetooth, elektronickým kompasom, akcelerometrom a dotykovým senzorom. Poháňa ho procesor ARM Cortex-A7. Na rozdiel od Google Glass, modul SLDM nemá zabudovanú kameru. Sony plánuje predstaviť koncept SLDM na veľtrhu Consumer Electronics Show (CES) v Las Vegas v januári a cieľom je začať predávať modul do jedného roka. Firma tiež sprístupní softvérové vývojové balíky (SDK) pre vývojárov na tvorbu aplikácií, keď bude zariadenie bližšie k dokončeniu. Sony hľadá partnerov medzi výrobcami okuliarov, športových a zábavných značiek a inými technologickými spoločnosťami, aby rozšírila možnosti využitia SLDM.

A High Court judge has permitted doctors in Sunderland to carry out a caesarean section on a woman who is 36 weeks pregnant and facing serious mental health issues. At a London hearing, it was revealed that the woman, in her thirties, is living with a psychotic disorder similar to schizophrenia and a liver condition that risks the health of both mother and child. Medical staff stated that a caesarean is the safest option for her and her unborn baby.

Since the woman may not be able to consent to the procedure, both her father and a lawyer assigned by the court expressed agreement with moving forward. Her father explained to the judge that natural delivery would be excessively taxing for her. Mr Justice Hayden concluded that there is compelling evidence she currently cannot understand or weigh up medical recommendations, but noted that in better health, she would likely prioritize her child’s wellbeing.

The judge ruled that sedation or restraint, if necessary, is lawful to perform the surgery safely. The baby is scheduled to be delivered soon, with the woman's parents set to handle initial care while doctors hope the mother improves enough to take on parenting duties herself. The woman’s identity remains protected, but City Hospitals Sunderland NHS Foundation Trust, which made the request, can be identified. The case was processed in the Court of Protection, which addresses medical and legal matters affecting vulnerable individuals.

Počas pojednávania v Londýne bolo uvedené, že žena vo svojich tridsiatich rokoch žije s psychotickou poruchou podobnou schizofrénii a tiež má pečeňové ochorenie, ktoré ohrozuje ju aj jej nenarodené dieťa. Lekári skonštatovali, že cisársky rez je najbezpečnejšou možnosťou pre matku i dieťa.

Pretože žena pravdepodobne nie je schopná udeliť súhlas, jej otec aj právnik menovaný súdom vyjadrili súhlas s plánom lekárov. Otec sudcovi vysvetlil, že prirodzený pôrod by bol pre jeho dcéru príliš náročný. Sudca Hayden uznal, že existujú presvedčivé dôkazy o tom, že momentálne nedokáže pochopiť a zhodnotiť lekárske odporúčania, no zdôraznil, že ak by bola v lepšom zdravotnom stave, uprednostnila by blaho svojho dieťaťa.

Sudca rozhodol, že podanie sedatív alebo použitie obmedzovacích prostriedkov je v prípade potreby povolené, aby bol zákrok bezpečný. Dieťa má byť čoskoro privedené na svet, pričom sa oň dočasne postarajú rodičia ženy. Lekári dúfajú, že sa zdravotný stav matky zlepší natoľko, aby sa mohla sama postarať o svoje dieťa. Identita ženy zostáva chránená, no City Hospitals Sunderland NHS Foundation Trust, ktorá žiadosť podala, bola vymenovaná. Prípad riešil Súd pre ochranu, ktorý sa zaoberá otázkami v oblasti zdravia a právneho zastupovania zraniteľných osôb.

article_content: Following the massive earthquake and tsunami that struck northeastern Japan, Sendai's residents are grappling with long lines for basic necessities and frequent aftershocks. Two days after the disaster, supermarkets and gas stations are crowded, and power outages have forced workers to manually pump fuel. Supplies of food and gasoline are running out fast, leaving locals with few options. CNN iReporter joeyjenkins shared that people were waiting for hours for groceries and fuel. Electricity wasn't restored until early Sunday, making things even more difficult. Schools and hospitals have turned into emergency shelters, where volunteers are handing out water, according to CNN’s Kyung Lah. In Tokyo, about 200 miles south, reports of possible power outages triggered a rush on flashlights, which quickly sold out—just like bottled water, as iReporter Jessica Tekawa found after warnings about contamination. Kenneth Cukier from The Economist reported that the government is planning controlled power outages for certain areas starting Monday—including Tokyo suburbs—to help conserve electricity for businesses. The U.S. Geological Survey recorded over 140 aftershocks (some as strong as magnitude 6.4) since the original 8.9-magnitude quake, leaving people on edge. Yasue Schumaker, a Sendai native who was at a hospital during the quake, told CNN that the aftershocks have been nearly constant and unsettling. CNN’s Gary Tuchman said the ongoing tremors are fueling fears that an even stronger aftershock could still occur. Rescue teams, including the Japanese military, are working across Sendai to find survivors. Helicopters circle overhead, and at least one person was airlifted out of a damaged building. Debris, water, and mud remain widespread. Further inland, whole neighborhoods were wiped out, with destroyed houses, cars stacked together, and deep mud everywhere. Hundreds remain missing. American iReporter xeynon said it’s been impossible to contact many friends and acquaintances along the coast, reflecting the uncertainty and worry many feel. Schumaker described immediate needs for water, food, and assistance for people displaced from their homes, noting that gas service could take up to 30 days to fully restore. Despite the overwhelming destruction in Sendai and nearby areas, the focus continues to be on helping survivors, especially those who lost everything.
translated_content: Po masívnom zemetrasení a tsunami, ktoré zasiahli severovýchodné Japonsko, obyvatelia mesta Sendai bojujú s dlhými radmi na základné potreby a častými dotrasmi. Dva dni po katastrofe sú supermarkety a čerpacie stanice preplnené a výpadky prúdu nútia zamestnancov ručne čerpať pohonné hmoty. Zásoby jedla a benzínu sa rýchlo míňajú a miestni obyvatelia majú len málo možností. CNN iReportér joeyjenkins uviedol, že ľudia čakali hodiny na potraviny a palivo. Elektrina bola obnovená až v nedeľu ráno, čo situáciu ešte viac sťažilo. Školy a nemocnice sa premenili na núdzové útočiská, kde dobrovoľníci rozdávali vodu, informovala Kyung Lah zo CNN. V Tokiu, približne 320 kilometrov južne, správy o možných výpadkoch prúdu spôsobili panický nákup bateriek, ktoré sa rýchlo vypredali – rovnako ako balená voda, ako zistila iReportérka Jessica Tekawa po varovaniach pred kontamináciou. Kenneth Cukier z The Economist informoval, že vláda plánuje riadené vypínanie elektriny v niektorých oblastiach už od pondelka – vrátane predmestí Tokia – aby sa ušetrila energia pre podniky. Americký geologický úrad zaznamenal od pôvodného zemetrasenia s magnitúdou 8,9 už viac než 140 dotrasov (niektoré s magnitúdou až 6,4), čo drží ľudí v napätí. Obyvateľka Sendai Yasue Schumakerová, ktorá bola počas otrasu v nemocnici, pre CNN povedala, že dotrasy sú takmer nepretržité a znepokojujúce. Gary Tuchman z CNN uviedol, že pretrvávajúce otrasy zvyšujú obavy, že môže nasledovať ešte silnejší dotras. Záchranné tímy, vrátane japonskej armády, pracujú po celom Sendaie na vyhľadávaní preživších. Vzduchom lietajú vrtuľníky a aspoň jednu osobu evakuovali z poškodeného domu. V meste je stále veľa trosiek, vody a blata. Vo vnútrozemí zničilo celé štvrte, domy sú zrovnané so zemou, autá sú naskladané na sebe a všade je husté blato. Stovky ľudí stále chýbajú. Americký iReportér xeynon uviedol, že sa mu nepodarilo kontaktovať mnoho priateľov a známych z pobrežia, čo odzrkadľuje neistotu a obavy mnohých. Schumakerová opísala naliehavú potrebu vody, jedla a pomoci pre tých, ktorí prišli o domov, pričom dodala, že obnova plynu pre všetkých môže trvať až 30 dní. Napriek obrovskému ničeniu v Sendai a okolí sa pozornosť naďalej sústreďuje na pomoc preživším, najmä tým, ktorí stratili všetko.

article_content: On Tuesday at India’s National Stock Exchange (NSE), shares in companies such as Lagnam Spintex, Nitco, Texmaco Infra, FCS Software, and Creative Peripherals reached their highest prices over the past year. Conversely, stocks like Perfect Infraenginee, Godha Cabcon & Insul, Atam Valves, Winsome Yarns, and Compuage Infocom hit new 52-week lows. The benchmark Nifty 50 index closed slightly lower, dropping 5.05 points to finish at 19,406.7, while the BSE Sensex also declined by 16.29 points, ending at 64,942.4. Among the Nifty 50, 27 stocks finished in positive territory and 23 traded lower. The day's top performers included Sun Pharma, BPCL, NTPC, Dr. Reddy’s, and Axis Bank. On the downside were Hero MotoCorp, Bajaj Finance, Coal India, JSW Steel, and Divis Labs. There was notable buying interest in the Learning & Education, Telecommunications, Defence, Retail, and Gas & Petroleum sectors. In contrast, sectors such as Aquaculture, Construction, Fertilizers, Agro Processing, and Irrigation & Allied Services faced selling. In other developments, the Indian government is expediting regulatory approvals for Tesla with the hope of clearing the way by January 2024. Retailers have observed a rise in luxury goods sales during Diwali, and high-value gifts remain in demand. However, salary increases for IT professionals changing jobs have tapered off as hiring slows in the technology sector. The article concludes with market trends, investment suggestions, and finance news highlights.
