article_content: In the heart of Poland's Bialowieza Forest, one of Europe's oldest and last remaining old-growth forests, stands a new border wall: a 15-foot-high metal fence topped with razor wire and security cameras. Poland completed the 116-mile barrier about a year ago to deter migrants crossing from Belarus, whose authorities have reportedly facilitated the movement of migrants to the European Union's borders. The Bialowieza Forest, which is home to rare wildlife like the European bison, is now distinguished by this border wall marking the line between Poland and Belarus. The government of Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko has for years provided visas and escorted migrants from the Middle East and Africa to the EU border, with the intention of pressuring and destabilizing Europe. After Poland finished the fence, Belarus shifted its tactics. In August, Polish media reported that Belarusian military helicopters entered Polish—and thus NATO—airspace. Katarzyna Zdanowicz, a spokesperson for the Polish Border Patrol, says incidents increased in May, with recurring provocations at the border, including groups throwing stones at Polish officers, allegedly supplied by Belarusian soldiers. The Polish Border Patrol has documented damage to patrol vehicles and other attacks and has shared photo and video evidence. Following reports that the Russian Wagner Group was training on the Belarusian side, Poland’s government announced plans to send 10,000 more soldiers to the region. This move has drawn criticism from some analysts who suggest the ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party might be emphasizing threats for electoral gain. Yet security expert Marek Swierczynski underlines that threats from Belarus and neighboring regions are real, citing Poland’s geography—between Ukraine, Belarus, and Russia’s Kaliningrad—and noting the strategic Suwalki Gap, a 70-mile corridor crucial to the EU and NATO. Locally, heightened tensions have hurt businesses. Magdalena Ostrowska, who runs a restored 19th-century hotel near Bialowieza, says tourism dropped sharply after reports of Wagner Group activities across the border, leaving hotel rooms empty and revenues halved. Tour guide Nina Zin voices concern that the government may be exaggerating the crisis for political reasons, referencing the recent violation of Polish airspace by Belarusian helicopters and the lack of government response. Meanwhile, a visa sales scandal has added to the controversy, as the deputy foreign minister was dismissed over the issue. This comes as PiS has placed border security at the forefront of its reelection campaign. Political analyst Andrzej Bobinski notes the visa scandal undermines the party’s narrative about border security and keeping Poland isolated from migrants. With elections near, both security issues and political scandals present challenges for the current government. Piotr Zakowiecki reported from Poland. The border with Belarus remains tense, with ongoing concerns about security, migration, and politics.
translated_content: V srdci poľského Bialowiežského pralesa, jedného z najstarších a posledných pôvodných lesov v Európe, stojí nový hraničný múr: 4,5 metra vysoký kovový plot so žiletkovým drôtom a bezpečnostnými kamerami. Poľsko dokončilo túto 187-kilometrovú bariéru pred približne rokom, aby zabránilo migrantom prichádzať z Bieloruska, kde úrady údajne uľahčili pohyb migrantov k hraniciam Európskej únie. Bialowiežský prales, domov vzácneho európskeho zubra, je teraz známy týmto hraničným múrom, ktorý oddeľuje Poľsko a Bielorusko. Vláda bieloruského prezidenta Alexandra Lukašenka už roky udeľuje víza a sprevádza migrantov z Blízkeho východu a Afriky k hranici EÚ s úmyslom vyvíjať nátlak a destabilizovať Európu. Po dokončení poľského plotu Bielorusko zmenilo taktiku. V auguste poľské médiá informovali, že bieloruské vojenské vrtuľníky vstúpili do poľského a teda aj NATO vzdušného priestoru. Katarzyna Zdanowicz, hovorkyňa poľskej pohraničnej stráže, uvádza, že incidenty sa od mája zvýšili a pravidelne dochádza k provokáciám, vrátane hádzania kameňov na pohraničníkov, údajne s podporou bieloruských vojakov. Pohraničná stráž zdokumentovala škody na vozidlách a ďalšie útoky, pričom poskytla aj foto a video dôkazy. Po správach, že ruská Wagnerova skupina cvičí na bieloruskej strane, poľská vláda oznámila vyslanie ďalších 10 000 vojakov do regiónu. Tento krok kritizovali niektorí analytici, podľa ktorých strana Právo a spravodlivosť (PiS) zdôrazňuje hrozby kvôli voľbám. Bezpečnostný expert Marek Swierczynski však poukazuje na to, že hrozby z Bieloruska a okolitých oblastí sú reálne, pripomína geografiu Poľska – medzi Ukrajinou, Bieloruskom a ruským Kaliningradom – a dôležitosť strategického Suvalského koridoru, ktorý je kľúčový pre EÚ a NATO. Na miestnej úrovni napätie poškodilo podnikanie. Magdalena Ostrowska, ktorá vedie zrekonštruovaný hotel z 19. storočia pri Bialowieži, hovorí, že po správach o aktivitách Wagnerovej skupiny na druhom konci hranice sa počet turistov prudko znížil, izby ostali prázdne a tržby klesli na polovicu. Sprievodkyňa Nina Zin vyjadruje obavy, že vláda prehnane zveličuje krízu z politických dôvodov, pričom spomína nedávne narušenie poľského vzdušného priestoru bieloruskými vrtuľníkmi a chýbajúcu reakciu vlády. Medzitým kauza s predajom víz viedla k odvolaniu námestníka ministra zahraničných vecí. Toto všetko sa odohralo, keď PiS stavia bezpečnosť hraníc do centra predvolebnej kampane. Politický analytik Andrzej Bobinski tvrdí, že vízový škandál podkopáva rétoriku strany o bezpečných hraniciach a izolácii Poľska od migrantov. S blížiacimi sa voľbami sú otázky bezpečnosti a politické škandály veľkou výzvou pre súčasnú vládu. Piotr Zakowiecki informoval z Poľska. Hranica s Bieloruskom zostáva napätá s pretrvávajúcimi obavami o bezpečnosť, migráciu a politiku.

Australia's eSafety Commission has fined Elon Musk's X (formerly known as Twitter) A$610,500 (approximately $386,000 or £317,360) for failing to cooperate with an investigation into its anti-child abuse measures. This move follows a statement made by Musk last November, claiming that 'removing child exploitation is priority #1.' The eSafety Commission criticized X for offering 'empty talk' on the matter, citing the company's lack of cooperation and insufficient responses to key questions.

According to insiders, the mass layoffs at X have hampered the platform's ability to protect users from online abuse and trolling. X has also experienced ongoing revenue decline since Musk acquired the company for $44 billion last year. Under Australian laws enacted in 2021, regulators can compel internet companies to provide information about their online safety protocols or face fines and potential legal action.

While Google received a warning for not fully complying with similar requests, X's noncompliance was described as more severe, with the regulator stating the company failed to answer some questions entirely. The Commission noted that X did not respond to crucial questions regarding response times to child exploitation reports, detection measures for livestreams, and the technologies used to combat such content.

X confirmed to the regulator it had cut 80% of its global workforce and no longer has any public policy staff in Australia, compared to two staff members before Musk's takeover. Last month, X also drew criticism from Australian researchers for removing a feature allowing users to report election misinformation—an action that raised concerns ahead of a significant referendum on Indigenous rights held over the weekend. The BBC has reached out to X for comment.

Austrálska komisia pre elektronickú bezpečnosť udelila spoločnosti X Elona Muska (predtým známu ako Twitter) pokutu vo výške 610 500 austrálskych dolárov (približne 386 000 USD alebo 317 360 GBP) za neposkytnutie súčinnosti pri vyšetrovaní opatrení proti zneužívaniu detí. Tento krok nasledoval po Muskovom vyhlásení z minulého novembra, v ktorom tvrdil, že „odstraňovanie detskej exploatácie je prioritou číslo 1“. Komisia eSafety kritizovala X za „prázdne reči“ a upozornila na nedostatočnú spoluprácu a odpovede na kľúčové otázky.

Podľa zasvätených osôb hromadné prepúšťanie v X obmedzilo schopnosť platformy chrániť používateľov pred online zneužívaním či trollingom. Spoločnosť X tiež od kúpy Muskom za 44 miliárd dolárov minulý rok zaznamenáva pretrvávajúci pokles príjmov. Podľa austrálskych zákonov prijatých v roku 2021 môžu regulačné orgány vyžadovať od internetových spoločností informácie o opatreniach na ochranu online bezpečnosti alebo im hrozí pokuta a prípadné právne kroky.

Zatiaľ čo Google dostal varovanie za neúplné splnenie podobných požiadaviek, neochota spolupracovať v prípade X bola hodnotená ako závažnejšia – regulátor uviedol, že spoločnosť na niektoré otázky neodpovedala vôbec. Komisia dodala, že X neodpovedal na kľúčové otázky týkajúce sa času reakcie na hlásenia zneužívania detí, opatrení na detekciu pri živých vysielaniach a technológií využívaných na boj proti takémuto obsahu.

X regulačnému orgánu potvrdila, že znížila svoj celosvetový počet zamestnancov o 80 % a v Austrálii už nemá žiadnych pracovníkov venujúcich sa verejnej politike, hoci pred Muskovým prevzatím tam boli dvaja takíto zamestnanci. Minulý mesiac bola X kritizovaná austrálskymi výskumníkmi za odstránenie funkcie na nahlasovanie dezinformácií o voľbách – čo vzbudilo obavy pred významným referendom o právach pôvodného obyvateľstva, ktoré sa konalo cez víkend. BBC požiadala X o vyjadrenie.

David Metz, Founder and CEO of Prizeout, an adtech company in New York City, notes that as technology advances rapidly, more large financial institutions are partnering with innovative tech vendors to provide advanced financial services. While many of these relationships are successful, some encounter challenges, often stemming from miscommunication—issues that are frequently avoidable. Drawing from his experience working directly with credit unions and banks, Metz highlights five crucial questions banks should ask tech vendors to establish productive partnerships:

1. How can you leverage data in ways we cannot? 
Banks are skilled at collecting valuable customer data, but making full use of this data may be limited by their resources or legacy systems. Tech companies should illustrate how they can maximally utilize such data to deliver benefits and tailor solutions to the bank’s clientele.

2. Can you help us meet our customers’ expectations?
Customer expectations are continuously rising, often shaped by experiences with leading tech companies. Many banks struggle to keep pace. Fintech partnerships can help, but banks must clearly understand and communicate their expectations, while tech vendors should offer specific strategies to meet them.

3. What is your end goal for this partnership? What does the near future look like?
Transparent discussions about goals from both sides are critical to success. Having clarity at the start helps ensure that both parties work toward compatible outcomes, preventing wasted time and misaligned efforts.

4. Where are you better positioned than us?
Recognizing each party’s strengths and weaknesses allows for a complementary partnership. For instance, tech vendors might help banks provide better customer education or engagement, while banks can support areas where vendors may not be as strong.

5. How can you help us attract and engage younger customers?
Engaging Millennials and Gen Z is essential for long-term growth. These groups value interactive, rewarding banking experiences more than just rates or fees. A tech partner should present ways to reach these demographics innovatively and effectively.

Metz concludes that setting clear expectations and proactively asking these key questions can create more successful and collaborative bank–tech vendor relationships. This perspective is featured in partnership with Forbes Business Council, a recognized business growth and networking organization.
translated_content:
David Metz, zakladateľ a generálny riaditeľ spoločnosti Prizeout, reklamno-technologickej firmy v New Yorku, upozorňuje, že s rýchlym rozvojom technológií stále viac veľkých finančných inštitúcií nadväzuje spoluprácu s inovatívnymi technologickými dodávateľmi na poskytovanie moderných finančných služieb. Mnohé z týchto partnerstiev sú úspešné, no niektoré narážajú na problémy, často kvôli nedorozumeniam — teda niečomu, čo je často možné predísť. Na základe svojich skúseností s kreditnými družstvami a bankami Metz vyzdvihuje päť kľúčových otázok, ktoré by banky mali položiť tech dodávateľom pri výbere partnerstva pre úspešnú spoluprácu:

1. Ako viete využiť dáta spôsobom, akým my nedokážeme? 
Banky majú skúsenosti so zbieraním hodnotných údajov o klientoch, no ich plné využitie býva často limitované dostupnosťou zdrojov či zastaranými systémami. Technologické firmy by mali preukázať, ako dokážu tieto dáta efektívne využiť na zákaznícke benefity a pripraviť riešenia na mieru.

2. Viete nám pomôcť naplniť očakávania našich klientov?
Klientské očakávania neustále rastú, často aj vďaka skúsenostiam s veľkými technologickými spoločnosťami. Mnohé banky nestíhajú držať krok. Spolupráca s fintech spoločnosťami môže pomôcť, ak banky jasne komunikujú svoje očakávania a dodávatelia predstavia konkrétne stratégie na ich splnenie.

3. Aký je váš cieľ v tomto partnerstve? Ako si predstavujete najbližšiu budúcnosť?
Pre úspech je kľúčová transparentná komunikácia cieľov oboch strán už na začiatku. Jasnosť pomáha predísť rôznym očakávaniam a šetruje čas aj zdroje.

4. V čom ste lepšie umiestnení ako my?
Vzájomné uznanie silných a slabých strán uľahčuje vytváranie dopĺňajúcich sa partnerstiev. Technologické spoločnosti môžu bankám zlepšiť zákaznícke vzdelávanie či angažovanosť, kým banky môžu podporiť oblasti, kde majú dodávatelia rezervy.

5. Ako nám viete pomôcť prilákať a zaujať mladších klientov?
Oslovenie mileniálov a generácie Z je dôležité pre budúcnosť. Títo klienti uprednostňujú interaktívne a odmeňujúce skúsenosti viac než len výhodné sadzby. Tech partner by mal vedieť ponúknuť inovatívne riešenia na ich efektívne oslovenie.

Metz uzatvára, že včasné nastavenie jasných očakávaní a proaktívne kladenie týchto otázok môže pomôcť k úspešnejšiemu a spolupracujúcemu vzťahu medzi bankami a technologickými dodávateľmi. Tento pohľad je prezentovaný v spolupráci s Forbes Business Council, poprednou organizáciou pre biznisový rast a networking.

article_content: CJ 4DPlex, a cinema technology company, and Cinema Plus, Azerbaijan’s leading cinema chain, have signed an agreement to bring the country its first 270-degree panoramic ScreenX auditorium. The deal was finalized at the META Cinema Forum in Dubai. Under the agreement, the ScreenX theater will be located at 28 Mall in Baku, Azerbaijan’s capital, which already houses a six-screen multiplex. The ScreenX auditorium is scheduled to open in December, coinciding with the release of Warner Bros.’s 'Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom.' This partnership builds on CJ 4DPlex’s previous collaboration with Cinema Plus; in 2021, they installed a 4DX screen at Cinema Plus’s Daniz Mall in Baku. Jongryul Kim, CEO of CJ 4DPLEX, said, “We are delighted to expand our partnership with Cinema Plus by introducing the inaugural ScreenX theater in the beautiful country of Azerbaijan. The 270-degree panoramic viewing technology will redefine the way Cinema Plus’s patrons enjoy movies, offering a level of immersion that’s simply unmatched and can’t be replicated at home.” Murat Camci, CEO of Cinema Plus, added, “Bringing the future of cinema to our screens has always been our mission, and our partnership with CJ 4DPLEX allows us to achieve that. After already introducing 4DX to Cinema Plus, we are now proud to provide the first-ever ScreenX auditorium in Azerbaijan, further enhancing the cinematic experience for our audiences.” CJ 4DPlex, a subsidiary of Korea’s CJ Group, has installed ScreenX auditoriums in 42 countries worldwide. The ScreenX technology is recognized as the world’s first multi-projection cinema with an immersive 270-degree field of view. Cinema Plus operates more than 50 screens and 5,000 seats across nine cinema locations.
translated_content: Spoločnosti CJ 4DPlex, technologická firma v oblasti kinematografie, a Cinema Plus, popredná filmová sieť v Azerbajdžane, podpísali dohodu o otvorení prvej panoramatickej ScreenX sály s 270-stupňovým záberom v krajine. Dohoda bola uzavretá na fóre META Cinema Forum v Dubaji. Na základe tejto dohody bude ScreenX kinosála umiestnená v 28 Mall v hlavnom meste Baku, kde sa už nachádza multiplex so šiestimi sálami. Otvorenie ScreenX sály je naplánované na december, aby sa zhodovalo s premiérou filmu 'Aquaman a stratené kráľovstvo' od Warner Bros. Toto partnerstvo nadväzuje na predošlú spoluprácu CJ 4DPlex a Cinema Plus – v roku 2021 nainštalovali obrazovku 4DX v Daniz Mall v Baku. Jongryul Kim, generálny riaditeľ CJ 4DPLEX, povedal: „Sme radi, že môžeme rozšíriť naše partnerstvo s Cinema Plus uvedením prvej ScreenX sály v krásnej krajine Azerbajdžan. 270-stupňová panoramatická technológia zmení spôsob, akým si návštevníci Cinema Plus užívajú filmy, a ponúkne úroveň ponorenia, ktorú doma nezažijú.“ Murat Camci, generálny riaditeľ Cinema Plus, dodal: „Priniesť budúcnosť kinematografie na naše plátna bolo vždy našim poslaním a partnerstvo s CJ 4DPLEX nám to umožňuje. Po zavedení 4DX v Cinema Plus sme teraz hrdí, že môžeme ponúknuť prvú ScreenX sálu v Azerbajdžane a ešte viac tak obohatiť filmové zážitky našich návštevníkov.“ CJ 4DPlex, dcérska spoločnosť juhokórejskej skupiny CJ Group, nainštalovala ScreenX kinosály už v 42 krajinách sveta. Technológia ScreenX je známa ako prvé multi-projekčné kino na svete s pohlcujúcim 270-stupňovým zorným poľom. Cinema Plus prevádzkuje viac než 50 sál a 5 000 miest na sedenie v rámci deviatich lokalít.

More than 1,600 migrants arrived on the Italian island of Lampedusa in just one day, according to Italy's coast guard. At least seven boats, thought to have come from Tunisia, landed with over 400 people, while others were picked up by Italian patrol vessels. Fishermen from Zarzis, a port in Tunisia, reported a sharp increase in attempts to cross the Mediterranean — a dangerous journey of about 100 kilometers that can last from 16 to 24 hours. Faisal Jebnoun, a local fisherman, recounted seeing seven boats leave for Lampedusa in just one day. 'Young people are risking everything, hoping for a better life in Italy, even though most can't speak Italian,' Jebnoun said as he worked his fishing nets.

The rise in migration numbers followed Tunisia's January revolution, which ousted longtime President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali. Lampedusa is a frequent destination as one of the Mediterranean’s southernmost European outposts. According to Souei Abdesslem, head of the Blue-fish Union in Zarzis, the surge in crossings led fishermen to sleep on their boats to prevent them from being taken by would-be migrants.

The route remains highly perilous: recently, the Italian coast guard rescued five survivors after their boat sank, but 35 people were reported missing. In January, dozens died when a migrant boat collided with a Tunisian coast guard ship. Coast guard spokesman Cosimo Nicastro suggested upcoming bad weather could slow the wave of migrant arrivals.

article_content: After reading Tracy McMillan's viral column on why women aren't married, I found myself questioning her six harsh reasons—being a 'bitch,' 'slut,' 'liar,' 'shallow,' 'selfish,' or 'not good enough.' As a 41-year-old single woman, I reject these labels; my journey is far more complicated. Looking back, my life has been shaped by a mix of family struggles and personal evolution. There were difficult relationships with step-parents, fleeting access to my father after my parents' divorce, heartbreaks, and moments of self-discovery. These events naturally influenced how I approached love and commitment. My romance history hasn’t been simple. I chased big dreams before feeling ready to settle down. There was a serious relationship where I thought I’d found 'The One,' only to face betrayal. Even so, I held on to hope, only realizing later that clinging to the past was holding me back. Eventually, I found someone who truly cared. He proposed, but anxiety and my own unresolved history led me to end the engagement. It was painful letting go, but this choice gave me a sense of strength, teaching me to trust myself and believe that my story wasn’t defined by my setbacks. Then, my father passed away. The grief made it impossible to imagine opening my heart to someone new. But with time—and encouragement from loved ones—I began building a new life, determined to stay open-minded and optimistic. Trying dating again, I encountered all kinds of experiences: awkward dates, bizarre online messages, even comedy-worthy disasters at dinner. Still, through every disappointment, I chose to laugh and remain hopeful. Today, I know I have a lot to offer and won’t let stereotypes dictate my happiness. I have a fulfilling career and supportive relationships. If being single is the worst of my problems, I consider myself fortunate. In reality, being single at 41 is less about fitting unflattering labels and more about life’s twists and turns. Maybe my story resonates with others—or maybe it’s just me.
translated_content: Keď som si prečítala virálny stĺpček Tracy McMillan o tom, prečo ženy nie sú vydaté, prinútilo ma to zamyslieť sa nad jej šiestimi prísnymi dôvodmi — vraj som „mrcha“, „ľahká“, „klamárka“, „povrchná“, „sebecká“ alebo „nie dosť dobrá“. Ako 41-ročná single žena tieto nálepky odmietam; môj príbeh je oveľa zložitejší. Keď sa obzriem späť, môj život formovala zmes rodinných problémov a osobného rastu. Boli tu ťažké vzťahy s nevlastnými rodičmi, obmedzený čas s otcom po rozvode rodičov, zlomené srdce a chvíle sebaobjavovania. Tieto udalosti prirodzene ovplyvnili môj postoj k láske a záväzkom. Moje romantické vzťahy neboli jednoduché. Najprv som sa hnala za veľkými snami a na usadenie som sa necítila pripravená. Mala som vážny vzťah a myslela si, že som našla „toho pravého“, no prišla zrada. Napriek tomu som si držala nádej — až neskôr mi došlo, že minulosti sa musím pustiť. Nakoniec som stretla niekoho, kto sa naozaj staral. Požiadal ma o ruku, no úzkosť a nevyriešené veci z minulosti ma donútili zásnuby ukončiť. Bolo ťažké odísť, no tento krok mi dodal silu — naučila som sa dôverovať si a pochopiť, že môj príbeh neurčujú zlyhania. Potom mi zomrel otec. Smútok mi znemožnil predstaviť si nový vzťah. No časom — aj vďaka podpore blízkych — som začala budovať nový život a rozhodla som sa zostať otvorená a optimistická. Keď som sa opäť pustila do randenia, zažila som všeličo: trápne stretnutia, bizarné správy na internete aj vtipné katastrofy na večeri. Aj po sklamaniach som si však vybrala smiech a nádej. Dnes viem, že mám čo ponúknuť a nenechám sa škatulkovať stereotypmi. Mám zmysluplnú prácu a podporujúce vzťahy okolo seba. Ak je single stav môj najväčší problém, považujem sa za šťastnú. Byť single v 41-ke nie je o nepríjemných nálepkách, ale o spletitosti života. Možno v tom spoznáte aj seba – alebo je to skrátka len môj príbeh.

article_content: Diane Keaton's upcoming memoir, 'Then Again', offers a heartfelt look back at her connection with Woody Allen, revealing lesser-known facets of their relationship. Now 65, Keaton shares that Allen’s appeal was not just about his humor but also his unexpectedly graceful manner and physique. She writes about his unique body language and self-effacing comedy, recalling that he was even more charming in person. The two first worked together in 1968 on the stage play 'Play It Again, Sam', then reprised those roles for the 1972 film. Their partnership spanned nearly a decade, resulting in classic films such as 'Annie Hall', 'Sleeper', 'Love and Death', and 'Manhattan', before they amicably separated in the late 1970s. Keaton admits her affection developed early on, as Allen’s eccentric personality offstage closely resembled the characters he portrayed. She remembers her family watching him on television, captivated by his distinct style and wit. She also notes that her own neurotic traits were attractive to Allen, deepening their connection and leading to a friendship built on mutual quirks and insightful humor. Their relationship, both romantic and platonic, was marked by shared vulnerabilities and lighthearted banter. Reflecting moments from Allen’s films, the pair often visited art galleries, watched foreign films, and explored cultural NYC landmarks. The memoir incorporates touching entries from Keaton’s mother, Dorothy Hall, who once noted that 'Annie Hall' closely mirrored Diane’s real life. 'Then Again', published by Random House with excerpts featured in Vogue, also explores Keaton's close relationship with her mother. Keaton, who has previously dated Al Pacino and Warren Beatty, writes candidly about the important relationships and experiences that have shaped her.

Teraz 65-ročná Keaton v nich prezrádza, že ju Allen oslovil nielen svojím humorom, ale aj svojou nečakanou eleganciou a postavou. Manchester City midfielder Yaya Toure was at the center of a media storm after his agent claimed the club failed to wish him a happy birthday. Social media was awash with reactions when it emerged that Toure, 31, was upset because the club's authorities did not acknowledge his milestone while the team celebrated its Premier League title in the United Arab Emirates.

Dmitri Seluk, Toure's agent, told the BBC: "None of them shook his hand on his birthday. It's really sick." PR specialist Phil Hall suggested that Toure's situation resembles moments in football history where star players, like David Beckham and Eric Cantona, challenged their clubs’ authority—often leading to their departures. Hall commented to CNN: "He wants to be the star of the dressing room and be celebrated. It's not uncommon for things to unravel when a player acts this way."

Former Manchester United manager Sir Alex Ferguson was known for swiftly dealing with players he felt acted larger than the club. In his autobiography, Ferguson detailed how a heated incident with Beckham marked the end of the player’s time at United, stating, "The minute a Manchester United player thought he was bigger than the manager he had to go."

Although Beckham’s global reputation remained intact, experts warn that Toure, who signed a new four-year contract with Manchester City just 11 months prior, could damage his own standing in football. Seluk said Toure might consider leaving City if he is not shown sufficient "respect," with the player planning to make a statement after the forthcoming World Cup in Brazil. Seluk told Sky Sports News: "Man City is not respecting the player—how can he be motivated to play for that team? If they don’t want Toure, then he can leave at any moment. Many clubs would be interested in him."

Hall observed that public complaints of this nature may hurt Toure’s reputation: "It’s going to be very difficult for Yaya at Manchester City now. Next time he misses a game, people will question his commitment. He now looks a bit sad." Hall also pointed to previous examples of players making excessive demands on their clubs, suggesting such high-maintenance behavior contributes to footballers’ negative image.

"Players are major brands," Hall concluded. "They need to realize they work in a corporate environment. By acting out, Toure may have reduced his own market value and harmed prospective deals."

Toure's birthday may have passed without a cake, but the controversy offers plenty for the football world to ponder.

article_content: Qualcomm has unveiled its latest flagship mobile chipset, the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, which emphasizes on-device generative AI capabilities across its design. This chipset accelerates activities that usually rely on cloud processing by enabling AI features directly on the device. The first smartphones with the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 are expected to launch soon. Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 supports chatbots trained with Meta’s Llama 2 and processes text, image, and voice inputs, providing responses in multiple formats. It can generate images and text and engage in interactive communication. The chipset runs Stable Diffusion for on-device AI image generation, with Qualcomm demonstrating it can create an image in under one second—a significant speed boost from previous iterations and much quicker than most laptops. Qualcomm’s AI engine uses the Hexagon neural processor to manage these tasks, while the Sensing Hub leverages OpenAI’s Whisper for speech recognition. The Sensing Hub provides the AI engine with user information, such as location, allowing for personalized responses. It can even relay favorite activities, age, and fitness level, raising some privacy considerations. Generative AI powers new capabilities like generative fill for photo expansion, object removal in video, and on-device night mode video recording at up to 4K/30p. Unlike Google’s upcoming Night Sight for video, which uses cloud processing, these features run entirely on the device. The Vlogger’s View feature merges footage from both selfie and rear cameras, segmenting the selfie video to place users in front of the rear camera’s scene. To mitigate content misuse, Qualcomm is working with Truepic, which provides technology that adheres to the Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity open standard. This cryptographically authenticates photos and videos, making them harder to tamper with. Outside of AI features, the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 delivers a 10% improvement in power efficiency over its predecessor due to updates in the Kryo CPU and Adreno GPU. It includes support for Dolby HDR photos, enhanced 5G functionality via the X75 modem-RF, advanced ray tracing for gaming, and up to 240Hz refresh rates on external displays. The new Snapdragon Seamless system facilitates connectivity between laptops, phones, and peripherals across different brands and operating systems. This aims to allow smooth transitions, like shifting audio between PC and phone, particularly between Android and Windows at launch. The platform is open, with an initial focus on Qualcomm’s OEM and OS partners.
translated_content: Qualcomm predstavil svoj najnovší vlajkový mobilný čipset, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, ktorý kladie dôraz na generatívne AI schopnosti priamo v zariadení. Tento čipset urýchľuje činnosti, ktoré zvyčajne závisia od cloudového spracovania, tým, že umožňuje AI funkcie priamo na zariadení. Prvé smartfóny so Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 by sa mali objaviť už čoskoro. Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 podporuje chatboty trénované na Meta Llama 2 a dokáže spracovať textové, obrazové aj hlasové vstupy, pričom poskytuje odpovede v rôznych formátoch. Vie generovať obrázky a text a zapájať sa do interaktívnej komunikácie. Čipset zvláda Stable Diffusion na generovanie AI obrázkov priamo v zariadení; Qualcomm ukázal, že obrázok vie vygenerovať za menej ako sekundu – čo je výrazne rýchlejšie ako predchádzajúce verzie a oveľa rýchlejšie ako väčšina notebookov. AI engine od Qualcommu využíva Hexagon neural processor na riadenie týchto úloh, zatiaľ čo Sensing Hub používa OpenAI Whisper na rozpoznávanie reči. Sensing Hub poskytuje AI engine aj informácie o užívateľovi, ako je poloha, čo umožňuje personalizované odpovede. Dokáže tiež prezradiť obľúbené aktivity, vek a úroveň kondície – čo vyvoláva určité obavy o súkromie. Generatívna AI poháňa nové možnosti, ako je generatívne rozšírenie fotografií, odstraňovanie objektov vo videu a nočné videozáznamy až do 4K/30p priamo v zariadení. Na rozdiel od pripravovanej funkcie Night Sight od Googlu na video, ktorá beží v cloude, tieto funkcie fungujú úplne v zariadení. Funkcia Vlogger’s View spája zábery z prednej aj zadnej kamery, pričom segmentuje predný videozáznam, aby používateľa umiestnila pred scénu zo zadnej kamery. Na zamedzenie zneužitia obsahu spolupracuje Qualcomm so spoločnosťou Truepic, ktorá poskytuje technológiu v súlade so štandardom Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity. Táto technológia kryptograficky overuje fotky a videá, čím ich chráni pred podvrhnutím. Okrem AI funkcií prináša Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 aj 10 % zlepšenie energetickej efektivity oproti predchodcovi vďaka vylepšeniam v Kryo CPU a Adreno GPU. Podporuje Dolby HDR fotografie, vylepšené 5G prostredníctvom modemu X75, pokročilé ray tracing možnosti pre hry a obnovovaciu frekvenciu až 240 Hz na externých displejoch. Nový systém Snapdragon Seamless umožňuje jednoduché prepojenie medzi notebookmi, telefónmi a perifériami rôznych značiek a operačných systémov. Cieľom je plynulé prepínanie – napríklad zvuku medzi PC a telefónom – najmä medzi Androidom a Windowsom pri štarte. Platforma je otvorená, pričom na začiatku ju využijú najmä partneri OEM a operačných systémov od Qualcommu.

article_content: A bold initiative called the 100-Year Starship project is working towards making human travel beyond the solar system possible within the next century. The project has attracted support from former US President Bill Clinton, who serves as its Honorary Chair, and focuses on developing the knowledge and technology needed for interstellar voyages. At the helm is astronaut Mae Jemison, famed for being the first Black woman in space in 1992. Under her leadership, the team is exploring the requirements for a multigenerational trip to another star, building on the legacy of the 1970s 'Project Daedalus,' an effort by the British Interplanetary Society. Project Daedalus illustrated that with current or near-future technology, creating a craft to reach nearby stars could be feasible. The study designed a 50,000-ton ship powered by nuclear fusion, which could travel at about 12% the speed of light, potentially making the journey in 50 years. Today’s 100-Year Starship effort, funded in part by a $500,000 DARPA grant, faces the immense challenge of developing long-term space travel capabilities. The project collaborates with organizations like Icarus Interstellar and the Foundation for Enterprise Development to tackle these challenges. Adam Crowl, director of Icarus Interstellar, highlights ongoing work on innovative spacecraft designs and foundational research to make interstellar flight a reality. The project aims for breakthroughs in propulsion, energy systems, advanced life support, and an improved understanding of human adaptation to space. Other essential components include robotics, automation, and new manufacturing techniques. The team sees future missions to the Moon, Mars, and elsewhere in the solar system as essential training grounds for more distant journeys. President Clinton remarked that the push for interstellar travel will not only advance space exploration but will also generate solutions and technologies that can enhance life on Earth. The 100-Year Starship project envisions itself at the forefront of this transformative pursuit.
translated_content: Smelý projekt s názvom 100-ročná Hviezdna loď má za cieľ umožniť ľuďom cestovať mimo našej slnečnej sústavy v priebehu nasledujúceho storočia. Projekt získal podporu bývalého amerického prezidenta Billa Clintona, ktorý pôsobí ako jeho čestný predseda, a zameriava sa na rozvoj znalostí a technológií potrebných pre medzihviezdne lety. Na čele projektu stojí astronautka Mae Jemison, známa tým, že sa v roku 1992 stala prvou čiernou ženou vo vesmíre. Pod jej vedením tím skúma, čo všetko by bolo potrebné pre viacgeneračnú cestu k inej hviezde, a nadväzuje tak na odkaz projektu „Daedalus“ zo 70. rokov, ktorý organizovala Britská interplanetárna spoločnosť. Projekt Daedalus ukázal, že s vtedajšou alebo čoskoro dostupnou technológiou by bolo možné skonštruovať loď, ktorá by sa dostala k najbližším hviezdam. Navrhovaná loď mala hmotnosť 50 000 ton, pohon na jadrovú fúziu a rýchlosť zhruba 12 % rýchlosti svetla, takže cesta by trvala približne 50 rokov. Súčasná snaha 100-ročnej Hviezdnej lode, čiastočne financovaná grantom DARPA vo výške 500 000 dolárov, čelí obrovským výzvam pri vývoji schopností pre dlhodobé cesty vesmírom. Projekt spolupracuje s organizáciami ako Icarus Interstellar a The Foundation for Enterprise Development. Adam Crowl, riaditeľ Icarus Interstellar, zdôrazňuje prebiehajúce práce na inovatívnych návrhoch kozmických lodí a základnom výskume, ktorý má pripraviť cestu pre medzihviezdny let. Projekt sa zameriava na pokroky v pohonoch, energetických systémoch, pokročilých životných podmienkach a lepšom porozumení adaptácie človeka na vesmír. Ďalšími kľúčovými oblasťami sú robotika, automatizácia a nové výrobné techniky. Tím považuje budúce misie na Mesiac, Mars a ďalšie miesta slnečnej sústavy za nevyhnutné kroky na prípravu vzdialenejších výprav. Prezident Clinton poznamenal, že snaha o medzihviezdne cestovanie nielenže posunie hranice vesmírneho výskumu, ale prinesie aj riešenia a technológie, ktoré môžu zlepšiť život na Zemi. Projekt 100-ročnej Hviezdnej lode sa vidí ako líder tejto transformácie.

article_content: Just a short walk from Al-Aqsa University in Gaza, Gaza Sky Geeks operated out of a vibrant coworking space as the region’s first and only tech startup accelerator. Supported by industry leaders like Google and Microsoft, the organization started a coding academy and helped cultivate thousands of tech professionals since 2011, as reported by TechCrunch. The Gaza Sky Geeks facility has become a damaged shell after the outbreak of conflict following Hamas' October 7 attacks on Israel and subsequent Israeli airstrikes. Ryan Sturgill, the group’s former leader, told TechCrunch that although the building remains standing, its front and surrounding area have been destroyed. Compared to Israel’s large and advanced tech sector, the Palestinian tech ecosystem is much smaller and deals with significant obstacles. Israel’s high-tech industry, famous for its defense, AI, and spyware advancements, made up about 18.1% of the nation’s GDP last year and raised a record $25 billion in startup investments in 2021. In contrast, Fast Company Middle East estimated the Palestinian startup scene’s value at just $66 million in 2021, with total investments of $9.5 million. Palestinian tech workers usually depend on outsourced work, but the ongoing war and worsening internet access have made their jobs nearly impossible. A telecom engineer from Gaza, speaking anonymously to Insider, said that several international clients have stopped working with them due to the volatile situation. Israeli officials reported over 1,400 deaths and about 200 hostages from the attacks by Hamas. In response, Israel has cut off electricity, water, fuel, and other resources to the almost 2.3 million people living in Gaza. The Hamas-run Gaza Health Ministry claims the region’s death toll has exceeded 8,000. Each new round of conflict further weakens Gaza’s fragile communications and electricity systems. Mona Shtaya, a digital-rights expert based in the West Bank, noted that telecommunications and electricity are among the first services targeted during escalations. Many remote workers, freelancers, and students are left unable to continue their activities. The West Bank operates on 3G networks, while much of Gaza only has 2G, and Israel controls the critical telecom infrastructure. Even before the current conflict, bringing in hardware and equipment was challenging due to Israeli border controls (except for Gaza’s border with Egypt). Now, restrictions are even stricter, slowing down economic and tech growth. Locals report frequent difficulties and instances of harassment at border checkpoints. Another major hurdle for Palestinian tech professionals is the lack of access to payment services such as PayPal, which are available to Israelis but not Palestinians in the West Bank or Gaza. This gap makes it harder for them to receive payments for freelance and remote work. Nevertheless, collaboration with Israeli and global tech firms continues, with some Palestinians hired by international companies and outsourcing arrangements still in place. Gaza and West Bank tech professionals are recognized for their resilience and innovation despite hardships. Still, there is concern that ongoing conflict will slow recovery, even as many believe the community will eventually rebuild and thrive again.
translated_content: Len pár minút chôdze od Univerzity Al-Aqsa v Gaze pôsobila Gaza Sky Geeks vo farebnom coworkingovom priestore ako prvý a jediný akcelerátor technologických startupov v regióne. Organizácia s podporou technologických lídrov ako Google a Microsoft spustila akadémiu programovania a od roku 2011, ako uvádza TechCrunch, vychovala tisíce IT odborníkov. Priestor Gaza Sky Geeks sa po vypuknutí konfliktu po útokoch Hamasu 7. októbra a následných izraelských náletoch stal zničenou schránkou. Bývalý vedúci skupiny, Ryan Sturgill, povedal pre TechCrunch, že budova síce stále stojí, ale jej predná časť a okolie boli úplne zničené. V porovnaní s rozsiahlym a vyspelým izraelským technologickým sektorom je palestínska technologická komunita omnoho menšia a čelí významným prekážkam. Izraelský high-tech priemysel, známy pokrokmi v obrane, AI a špionážnom softvéri, tvoril vlani približne 18,1 % HDP krajiny a v roku 2021 získal rekordných 25 miliárd dolárov z investícií do startupov. Naproti tomu portál Fast Company Middle East odhadol hodnotu palestínskej startup scény v roku 2021 len na 66 miliónov dolárov s celkovými investíciami 9,5 milióna. Palestínski IT pracovníci sa väčšinou spoliehajú na prácu na zákazku, no prebiehajúca vojna a slabnúca internetová dostupnosť im prácu prakticky znemožnili. Telekomunikačný inžinier z Gazy, ktorý chcel zostať v anonymite, pre Insider povedal, že viacerí zahraniční klienti im pre aktuálnu nestabilitu prestali zadávať zákazky. Izraelské úrady hlásili po útokoch Hamasu viac ako 1 400 obetí a približne 200 rukojemníkov. Ako odveta Izrael odrezal pásmo Gazy s takmer 2,3 milióna obyvateľmi od elektriny, vody, paliva a ďalších základných zdrojov. Palestínske ministerstvo zdravotníctva, ktoré riadi Hamas, uvádza, že počet obetí presiahol 8 000. Každá nová vlna konfliktu ďalej oslabuje už aj tak krehkú infraštruktúru komunikácie a elektriny v Gaze. Mona Shtaya, odborníčka na digitálne práva z Predjordánska, uviedla, že medzi prvými službami, ktoré pri eskalácii konfliktu vypadávajú, patria telekomunikácie a elektrina. Mnohí freelancer-i, pracovníci na diaľku či študenti zostávajú bez možnosti pokračovať v práci. Kým v Predjordánsku je k dispozícii 3G sieť, v častiach Gazy sa stále používa iba 2G a rozhodujúci telekomunikačný infraštruktúru kontroluje Izrael. Aj pred prebiehajúcim konfliktom bolo dovážať hardvér a technické vybavenie náročné kvôli izraelskej kontrole hraníc (okrem egyptskej hranice s Gazou). Teraz sú obmedzenia ešte prísnejšie, čo spomaľuje ekonomický a technologický rozvoj. Miestni obyvatelia hovoria o častých komplikáciách a prípadoch obťažovania na checkpointoch. Ďalšou veľkou prekážkou palestínskych IT odborníkov je nemožnosť používať platobné služby ako PayPal, ktoré sú izraelským obyvateľom k dispozícii, no v Predjordánsku a Gaze nie. To im výrazne sťažuje prijímanie platieb za prácu na diaľku či zákazky zo zahraničia. Napriek týmto problémom pokračuje spolupráca s izraelskými aj globálnymi technologickými firmami – niektorých Palestíncov zamestnávajú medzinárodné spoločnosti a outsourcing stále existuje. IT odborníci v Gaze aj Predjordánsku sú známi svojou húževnatosťou a inováciou aj napriek ťažkostiam. Obavy však vyvoláva, že pretrvávajúce konflikty obnovu spomalia, no mnohí veria, že komunita sa napokon znovu postaví a ešte zosilnie.

article_content:
Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi, a major player in East African affairs and a key ally to the United States, has died at the age of 57, according to an official government statement. Meles had been absent from public life for months, leading to much speculation about his health. Authorities provided little information about the cause or exact location of his death, only stating that he died from an unspecified infection on Monday night.

Meles first took power in 1991 after his rebel group ousted former dictator Haile Mengistu Mariam, then led efforts to reconstruct Ethiopia. His supporters commend him for bringing a measure of stability to a region marked by conflict and for driving progress in healthcare, education, and poverty alleviation. He also played a significant role in countering militant threats in nearby countries, including giving US forces access to Ethiopian airspace for anti-terror operations.

Nonetheless, critics highlight his government’s history of repressing political dissent and limiting press freedoms. Observers point to a lack of democratic practices, citing arrests and violence following disputed elections. The ruling Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front captured nearly all seats in the 2010 parliamentary elections, intensifying concerns about the democratic process.

US President Barack Obama recognized Meles’s dedication to reducing poverty in Ethiopia, while US Senator Patrick Leahy raised issues over human rights violations, referencing the jailing of journalist Eskinder Nega. There have also been recent cases of foreign journalists facing terrorism charges and imprisonment under his administration.

Government spokesperson Bereket Simon confirmed that Meles died abroad, surrounded by his family, but withheld location details. Deputy Prime Minister Hailemariam Desalegn has stepped in as acting leader and is expected to serve until the scheduled elections in 2015; officials say there are no plans for an early vote. Some analysts remain skeptical about Meles’s previously stated intention to step down.

The Ethiopian government’s reluctance to share information about Meles’s declining health fueled rumors and active debate online, exacerbated by his absence from key events, like the recent African Union summit in Addis Ababa. Former UN Secretary-General Kofi Annan lauded Meles’s role in promoting regional peace and development. Ethiopia, surrounded by volatile nations such as Somalia and Sudan, now faces a period of adjustment under new leadership.
translated_content:
Etiópsky premiér Meles Zenawi, významná osobnosť vo východnej Afrike a dôležitý spojenec Spojených štátov, zomrel vo veku 57 rokov, ako oznámila vláda. Meles sa neobjavil na verejnosti niekoľko mesiacov, čo vyvolalo mnoho špekulácií o jeho zdraví. Úrady neposkytli podrobnosti o príčine ani mieste jeho smrti, len uviedli, že v pondelok v noci podľahol nešpecifikovanej infekcii.

Meles prebral moc v roku 1991 po páde bývalého diktátora Haile Mengistu Mariama a nasledovne viedol obnovu krajiny. Podporovatelia ho vyzdvihujú za prínos k stabilizácii regiónu postihnutého konfliktmi a za zlepšenie zdravotníctva, školstva a znižovanie chudoby. Výraznú úlohu zohral aj v boji proti extrémizmu v susedných krajinách, keď umožnil americkým silám využívať etiópsky vzdušný priestor pri protiteroristických misiách.

Napriek tomu čelil kritike za potláčanie politických odporcov a obmedzovanie slobody tlače. Pozorovatelia upozorňujú na slabú demokraciu a na zatýkanie či násilnosti po sporných voľbách. Vládna strana Etiópska ľudová revolučná demokratická fronta ovládla takmer všetky kreslá v roku 2010, čo vyvolalo ďalšie otázniky ohľadom stavu demokracie v krajine.

Prezident USA Barack Obama ocenil Melesovu snahu bojovať proti chudobe, zatiaľ čo senátor Patrick Leahy poukázal na ľudskoprávne problémy vrátane väznenia novinára Eskindera Negu. V poslednom období boli vo väzení aj zahraniční žurnalisti odsúdení za terorizmus.

Vládny hovorca Bereket Simon potvrdil, že Meles zomrel v zahraničí v prítomnosti rodiny, pričom miesto smrti nebolo zverejnené. Dočasným lídrom sa stal podpredseda vlády Hailemariam Desalegn až do plánovaných volieb v roku 2015; predčasné voľby sa nechystajú. Niektorí analytici pochybujú, či Meles naozaj plánoval odstúpiť, ako predtým avizoval.

Utajovanie informácií o Melesovom zdravotnom stave vyvolalo fámy a živú diskusiu na internete, najmä pre jeho absenciu na významných akciách ako bol summit Africkej únie v Addis Abebe. Bývalý generálny tajomník OSN Kofi Annan ocenil Melesovu diplomaciu v podpore mieru a rozvoja. Etiópia, obklopená nestabilnými krajinami ako Somálsko a Sudán, teraz vstupuje do novej a neistého obdobia pod novým vedením.

article_content: A village shop managed by the same family for over 200 years is on the market for the first time—with the unique condition that it must remain a shop. Thompson's, located in Osmotherley, North Yorkshire, began trading in 1786 during the reign of King George III. Since then, the business has been passed down through six generations, last reaching Grace Thompson in 1943. Grace Thompson retired in 2004, but worried the historic shop could be turned into a house or café. To protect its legacy, she secured a restrictive covenant with local authorities that requires the new owner to operate it as a shop. The property is being auctioned with a guide price of £200,000, and locals hope the buyer preserves its vintage store front, original signage, period cabinets, and delivery bicycle. Edward Thompson originally ran the shop from his home in the late 18th century, gradually expanding the business. Successive generations contributed to its growth, with Edward D. Thompson introducing newspaper sales in 1880. By 1935, the store was described as 'a veritable mini Harrods.' Miss Thompson left school at 16 to help run the business after her father's death, working alongside her mother and uncle from dawn to dusk. Goods for the store arrived by horse and cart from the railway station. After her uncle's death in 1961 and her mother's passing in 1982, Grace continued running Thompson's alone until she retired following a fall at age 85. Despite difficulties, such as not being able to drive to wholesalers, she remained committed to the shop and even delivered newspapers herself until she was 75. Local estate agent Robin Jessop will oversee the auction on May 15, including the adjacent two-bedroom cottage with a guide price of £100,000. The parish council and the York North Moors National Park have both supported the restrictive covenant to help ensure Thompson’s long-standing legacy as a village shop. The shop needs renovation but offers 2,000 square feet of space, including living quarters with four bedrooms, outbuildings, and a 0.6-acre paddock. Its contents—such as vintage tins, medicine bottles, postcards, and advertising displays—were sold at auction in January, with some items dating back over two centuries. Highlights included a set of large, domed tin tea caddies and a two-and-a-half-foot-tall tin HP sauce bottle from around 1910. Grace's friend Pat Duggan shared, 'The shop was her whole life and she kept it running as long as she could. Everyone loved her and her dedication. She takes great pride in her family and Thompson's, which is well known even internationally.' Villagers hope that Thompson's will reopen soon and continue its remarkable heritage.
translated_content: Dedinský obchod, ktorý spravovala rovnaká rodina viac ako 200 rokov, je prvýkrát na predaj – s jedinečnou podmienkou, že musí zostať obchodom. Thompson's, ktorý sa nachádza v Osmotherley, North Yorkshire, začal obchodovať v roku 1786 počas vlády kráľa Juraja III. Odvtedy sa podnik dedí už šesť generácií, naposledy ho prevzala Grace Thompson v roku 1943. Grace Thompson odišla do dôchodku v roku 2004, no obávala sa, že historický obchod by sa mohol zmeniť na dom alebo kaviareň. Na ochranu jeho odkazu zabezpečila s miestnymi úradmi obmedzujúcu zmluvu, ktorá novému majiteľovi prikazuje prevádzkovať ho ako obchod. Nehnuteľnosť ide do dražby s odhadovanou cenou 200 000 £ a miestni dúfajú, že nový majiteľ zachová pôvodnú výkladnú skriňu, historické značenie, dobové skrinky a doručovací bicykel. Edward Thompson pôvodne viedol obchod zo svojho domu koncom 18. storočia a podnik postupne rozširoval. Každá ďalšia generácia prispela k jeho rastu, pričom Edward D. Thompson v roku 1880 zaviedol predaj novín. Do roku 1935 bola predajňa opísaná ako „malý Harrods“. Slečna Thompson opustila školu v šestnástich, aby po smrti otca pomohla viesť obchod spolu s matkou a strýkom od úsvitu do súmraku. Tovar sa do obchodu vozil z vlakovej stanice na konskom záprahu. Po strýkovej smrti v roku 1961 a matkinom úmrtí v roku 1982 Grace pokračovala v prevádzke obchodu sama až do odchodu do dôchodku po páde vo veku 85 rokov. Napriek ťažkostiam, napríklad že nemohla šoférovať k veľkoobchodníkom, zostala oddaná obchodu a až do svojich 75 rokov sama roznášala noviny. Miesto aukcie vedie realitný maklér Robin Jessop 15. mája vrátane susediacej dvojizbovej chaty s odhadom 100 000 £. Miestna samospráva aj Národný park York North Moors podporili obmedzujúcu zmluvu, aby ochránili historický význam Thompson’s ako dedinského obchodu. Obchod potrebuje rekonštrukciu, ponúka však 186 m² priestoru, vrátane obytných miestností so štyrmi spálňami, vonkajších budov a 0,24 ha trávnatého výbehu. Jeho obsah – ako staré plechovky, fľaštičky s liekmi, pohľadnice a reklamy – sa dražil v januári, pričom niektoré predmety mali viac než 200 rokov. Najväčší záujem vzbudili veľké oblúkové čajové dózy a dvoj a pol metrová plechová fľaša HP omáčky z roku 1910. Gracina priateľka Pat Duggan povedala: „Obchod bol celý jej život a udržiavala ho dovtedy, kým mohla. Všetci ju a jej obetavosť milovali. Je na svoju rodinu aj obchod veľmi hrdá, Thompson's je známy dokonca aj v zahraničí.“ Dedinčania dúfajú, že Thompson's sa čoskoro znovu otvorí a bude pokračovať vo svojej výnimočnej tradícii.

Sean Roberts, a 14-year-old student at Wellington Academy in Tidworth, Wiltshire, has been suspended from his classes for five days and required to attend the school’s alternative learning department. This action followed an incident where Sean called a teacher, Barry Seymour, by his first name outside of school hours.

Sean’s mother, Julie Roberts, criticized the school’s decision, arguing the punishment was excessive and that the communication was inadequate. She claimed she was only informed of the sanction via an evening phone call from Mr. Seymour, and she received no written notification nor was invited to an official meeting.

The school, overseen by executive head Dr. Anthony Seldon and sponsored by Wellington College, explained through Vice Principal Ben Bond that Sean’s suspension was due not only to this incident but also to a pattern of disrespectful behavior towards staff. Mr. Bond acknowledged that although the particular incident happened outside school and was, in isolation, relatively minor, it represented the culmination of ongoing behavior that undermined staff. He further admitted that communication with Sean’s mother should have been handled more formally.

Julie Roberts, a single parent and hairdresser, expressed concern about the financial impact of the suspension, noting she lost earnings to care for her son during his exclusion. She also emphasized her frustration at the lack of a structured approach from the school.

Principal Michael Milner was unavailable for comment. Wellington Academy was recently rated by OFSTED as ‘requiring improvement’ in their latest inspection.

article_content: ATLANTA, Georgia (CNN) – A report released Tuesday by the World Health Organization's cancer research agency projects that global cancer cases could reach 27 million annually by 2030, rising from 12 million new cases in 2007. The increase is especially significant in emerging economies such as China, Russia, and India, which are expected to be most affected. The study forecasts a global 1 percent annual increase in cancer incidence. Tobacco use is identified as the leading preventable cause of cancer deaths, with approximately 1.3 billion smokers worldwide. Less developed countries are particularly vulnerable, with experts predicting a 38 percent rise in new cancer cases in these regions by 2030. John R. Seffrin, chief executive officer at the American Cancer Society, noted that tobacco killed 100 million people globally in the 20th century and could cause one billion deaths in the 21st century if no action is taken. Other contributing factors to the rise in cancer cases include high-fat diets, greater consumption of fast food, and reduced physical activity—trends linked to more Westernized lifestyles. Breast cancer rates have doubled or tripled in countries such as Japan, Singapore, and Korea. In Africa, 518,000 people have died from cancer since the start of 2008, with cervical cancer being the leading cancer killer among women. There is positive news in some Western countries, with declining cancer mortality rates reported in Great Britain and the United States. Experts emphasize that effective cancer control in developing countries depends on prevention, greater awareness, improved data collection, and establishing policies and resources to tackle both cancer and tobacco use. CNN's Miriam Falco contributed to this report.

Nárast je obzvlášť výrazný v rozvíjajúcich sa ekonomikách, ako sú Čína, Rusko a India, ktoré budú podľa očakávaní najviac postihnuté. Štúdia predpovedá celosvetový medziročný nárast výskytu rakoviny o 1 percento. Fajčenie je označené za hlavný preventabilný dôvod úmrtí na rakovinu, pričom na svete fajčí približne 1,3 miliardy ľudí. K ďalším faktorom prispievajúcim k nárastu prípadov rakoviny patria strava s vysokým obsahom tukov, väčšia konzumácia rýchleho občerstvenia a menej fyzickej aktivity – trendy spojené so západným štýlom života. Výskyt rakoviny prsníka sa v krajinách ako Japonsko, Singapur a Kórea zdvojnásobil alebo strojnásobil. Na správe sa podieľala Miriam Falco z CNN.

article_content: Bal Thackeray, a prominent advocate of Hindu nationalism in India and leader of the political party Shiv Sena, died Saturday at the age of 86, according to his spokesman. Thackeray founded and headed Shiv Sena, a movement especially influential in Mumbai and Maharashtra state. Spokesman Rahul Narvekar said Thackeray died of cardiac arrest and that his cremation will be held on Sunday. Emerging in the 1960s, Thackeray became a populist leader for the Marathi people, advocating for their interests as migration reshaped Mumbai (then Bombay) and Maharashtra. A former newspaper cartoonist, Thackeray was celebrated for championing Marathi causes and played a key role in changing Bombay’s name to Mumbai. Shiv Sena’s symbol, an orange flag, can be seen throughout Mumbai, which is India’s financial center and home to the Bollywood film industry. Thackeray was both revered by followers and regarded with fear by others, receiving a 'godfather'-like reputation. Over time, Shiv Sena grew into a major Hindu nationalist movement across India. After his death was announced, both Shiv Sena and Prime Minister Manmohan Singh appealed for calm, and police were deployed across Mumbai. Prime Minister Singh said Thackeray’s leadership made Shiv Sena 'a formidable force' in Maharashtra and praised Thackeray’s unique stature and dedication to the region’s pride. CNN’s Joe Sterling contributed to this report.

Thackeray založil a viedol Šiv Sena, hnutie, ktoré má mimoriadny vplyv v Bombaji a štáte Maharashtra. Hovorca Rahul Narvekar uviedol, že Thackeray zomrel na zástavu srdca a jeho kremácia sa uskutoční v nedeľu. Ako bývalý novinový karikaturista bol Thackeray oslavovaný za podporu maráthskych záležitostí a zohral kľúčovú úlohu pri zmene názvu mesta z Bombay na Mumbai. Symbolom Šiv Sena je oranžová vlajka, ktorú možno vidieť po celom Bombaji, finančnom centre Indie a domove filmového priemyslu Bollywood. Na tejto reportáži sa podieľal aj Joe Sterling z CNN.

The Netherlands leads the world in pension systems, according to the Mercer CFA Institute's global pensions report. The study evaluated 47 retirement income systems, representing 64% of the global population, using more than 50 different indicators. Major criteria included the level of private and public pension benefits, long-term sustainability, and governance quality.

Iceland placed second after losing last year’s top spot, while Denmark ranked third in the 2023 index. Most European countries in the report received strong grades, with only minor improvements needed in Finland, Norway, Sweden, the UK, Switzerland, Ireland, Belgium, Portugal, and Germany. In contrast, France, Spain, Italy, Poland, Austria, Croatia, and the United States face significant risks or shortcomings that the report advises should be addressed.

India, the Philippines, and Argentina were at the bottom of the ranking. Alongside Turkey and Thailand, these countries received a grade D, meaning their pension systems are at risk of being ineffective and unsustainable without urgent reforms.

The report highlights that retirement income systems globally are under unprecedented pressure from persistent inflation, rising interest rates, and geopolitical uncertainty, all of which impact investment returns. "The average age of populations continues to rise in many markets, particularly mature ones," noted Margaret Franklin, president and CEO of the CFA Institute. "Inflation and rising rates have introduced new challenges for pension plans. Globalization is also experiencing fractures, adding complexity that significantly impacts retirees."

Citing the OECD’s 2022 Pensions Outlook, the report recommends that policymakers implement necessary reforms despite financial and economic uncertainty, to protect the well-being of current and future pensioners. It also encourages expanding asset-backed pensions over pay-as-you-go systems to strengthen resilience and diversify retirement funding sources.

Artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to improve pension system performance by reducing costs and identifying emerging risks, the report says. Further potential benefits include custom portfolio creation and spotting market anomalies, though AI is unlikely to predict market movements with certainty. David Knox, senior partner at Mercer, commented that broader AI adoption could streamline decision-making and potentially raise investment returns for pension plan members. However, the report also warns about AI-related risks, such as generating misinformation in new contexts and increasing cyberattack threats against pension member data.

"Priemerný vek populácie neustále rastie najmä v rozvinutých ekonomikách," uviedla Margaret Franklinová, prezidentka a generálna riaditeľka CFA Institute. Správa ďalej odporúča rozširovanie dôchodkových schém krytých aktívami namiesto priebežných systémov, čo môže zvýšiť odolnosť a diverzifikovať financovanie dôchodkov.

Umelá inteligencia (AI) by podľa správy mala zlepšiť efektivitu dôchodkových systémov vďaka znižovaniu nákladov a lepšej identifikácii rizík. Ďalšie prínosy môžu zahŕňať vytváranie personalizovaných portfólií či odhaľovanie trhových anomálií, no AI nedokáže spoľahlivo predpovedať vývoj na trhu. David Knox, senior partner v Merceri, sa domnieva, že širšie využívanie AI môže zefektívniť rozhodovanie a potenciálne zvýšiť výnosy členov dôchodkových fondov. Správa však zároveň upozorňuje na riziká, akými sú napríklad šírenie dezinformácií v nových situáciách a nárast kybernetických útokov na údaje dôchodcov.

article_content: A truck transporting fireworks exploded Friday morning on an expressway bridge in Mianchi County, Henan province, central China, causing a section of the bridge to collapse and sending dozens of vehicles plummeting thirty meters to the ground below. The exact number of casualties remains unclear. Initially, Henan highway police reported at least 11 deaths via their official microblog, but that figure was later replaced by a lower count from Xinhua, China’s official state news agency, which cited local authorities as saying eight people had been killed by late Friday afternoon. In contrast, China National Radio had reported as many as 26 fatalities, though did not specify the source of this information. The expressway is currently closed while search and rescue operations continue. So far, at least 13 injured individuals have been pulled from the wreckage. Xinhua reported that at least 25 vehicles fell from the bridge, which collapsed along an 80-meter (260-foot) stretch. CCTV footage showed a wide gap in the bridge and debris—including vehicles and rubble—scattered on the ground below. Emergency workers in orange uniforms were seen searching for survivors among the wreckage. The explosion took place at 8:52 a.m. local time. Fireworks hold special significance for Lunar New Year celebrations, one of China’s most important holidays this month, but have been associated with serious accidents in the past. In 2009, fireworks caused a massive fire in a newly built Beijing hotel, briefly reviving support for a ban imposed under Mao Zedong’s rule, when they were considered 'bourgeois' and wasteful. Traditionally, fireworks are believed to ward off evil spirits. Ahead of this year’s Lunar New Year, Beijing authorities urged residents to reduce fireworks use to help lessen the heavy pollution that has enveloped the capital, Xinhua reported. CNN’s CY Xu in Beijing contributed to this report.
translated_content: Nákladné auto prevážajúce ohňostroje v piatok ráno explodovalo na diaľničnom moste v okrese Mianchi v provincii Henan v strednej Číne. Polícia diaľnic v provincii Henan pôvodne na svojom oficiálnom mikroblogu informovala o najmenej 11 mŕtvych, toto číslo však bolo neskôr nahradené nižším počtom, ktorý uviedla štátna agentúra Xinhua – podľa miestnych úradov do piatkového popoludnia zahynulo osem ľudí. Naopak, China National Radio informovalo až o 26 úmrtiach, pričom zdroj tejto informácie nebol špecifikovaný. Diaľnica je momentálne uzavretá, pokračujú záchranné a pátracie práce. Z trosiek už vytiahli najmenej 13 zranených. Podľa agentúry Xinhua spadlo z mosta minimálne 25 vozidiel; zrútilo sa 80-metrové (260 stôp) úseky mosta. Zábery CCTV ukazovali širokú dieru v moste a trosky – vrátane áut a sutín – roztrúsené pod ním. Záchranári v oranžových uniformách prehľadávali trosky v snahe nájsť preživších. K výbuchu došlo o 8:52 miestneho času. Ohňostroje majú pri oslavách Lunárneho Nového roka v Číne výnimočnú úlohu, no boli príčinou viacerých vážnych nehôd. V roku 2009 spôsobili ohňostroje mohutný požiar v novom hoteli v Pekingu, čo krátko oživilo diskusie o zákaze počas vlády Mao Ce-tunga, keď boli považované za „buržoázne“ a zbytočné. Podľa tradície majú ohňostroje odháňať zlé sily. Pred tohtoročnými oslavami Lunárneho Nového roka pekinské úrady vyzvali obyvateľov, aby obmedzili používanie ohňostroja, a tak pomohli znížiť znečistenie ovzdušia, ktoré v poslednom mesiaci sužovalo hlavné mesto, uviedla Xinhua. Na reportáži sa podieľal aj CY Xu z CNN v Pekingu.

article_content: In August, a devastating wildfire swept through Dadia National Park in northeastern Greece, in what the European Commission called the EU’s largest wildfire ever recorded. The flames destroyed more than 90,000 hectares of forest and farmland, much of which falls under the Natura protected network and is famous for its diverse ecosystems. Locals have suffered enormously. For the Pistola family, who have raised livestock near the Greek-Turkish border for generations, the fire left them with just three surviving goats, and their facilities reduced to ruins. In the aftermath, they’ve been improvising shelter for the few animals left. Kostas Pistolas expressed shock at how quickly the flames spread, covering 40 kilometers in only eight hours. The scene today is grim: charred trees and pastures, with livestock wandering through blackened fields. According to Dora Skartsi from the Thrace biodiversity protection group, the fire killed hundreds of animals, including deer, reptiles, and turtles. Dadia Park is renowned for hosting 360 plant species, 200 bird species, and the majority of Europe’s raptor species. Farmers have experienced great losses, with nearly half in the area seeing their livestock killed or facilities destroyed. Kostas Dounakis, leader of the local breeders' union, described the challenge of feeding the remaining animals, as both pasture and stored feed were lost in the fire. Locals blame drought, climate change, and insufficient coordination during firefighting. Another major factor is the decline in livestock grazing, which used to help control vegetation buildup and reduce wildfire risk. Restoration efforts are underway. Authorities have placed logs on hillsides to prevent soil erosion, and ecologist Sylvia Zakkak reports the region’s Mediterranean ecosystem is expected to slowly recover. Special nesting platforms for raptors—particularly the black vulture—are being installed, with some birds already returning. Still, some wildlife, especially hawks, owls, and species that need dense forest, remain highly vulnerable, as it could take decades for the ecosystem to fully regenerate. Despite these hardships, locals like Athanassia Pistola are pushing forward, determined to care for what animals remain and to help the land recover.
translated_content: V auguste zasiahli severovýchodné Grécko ničivé požiare, ktoré úplne spustošili národný park Dadia. Európska komisia označila požiar za najväčší svojho druhu v EÚ. Plamene zničili viac ako 90 000 hektárov lesa a poľnohospodárskej pôdy – väčšina z toho je chránená sústavou Natura a známa rozmanitosťou ekosystémov. Miestni obyvatelia utrpeli obrovské straty. Rodina Pistola, ktorá chová dobytok pri grécko-tureckej hranici už celé generácie, prišla takmer o všetky kozy a ich farmárske zariadenia skončili v troskách. Zo stáda prežili len tri kozy a zvyšok musia presťahovať do provizórnych úkrytov. Kostas Pistolas len ťažko chápe, že požiar sa rozšíril za osem hodín na vzdialenosť 40 kilometrov. Krajina je dnes plná spálených stromov a pasienkov, zatiaľ čo dobytok blúdi po čiernej zemi. Podľa Dory Skartsi z ochranárskej skupiny pre biodiverzitu v Trákii zomreli stovky zvierat vrátane jeleňov, plazov a korytnačiek. Park Dadia je domovom 360 druhov rastlín, 200 druhov vtákov a väčšiny európskych dravcov. Poľnohospodári utrpeli veľké škody – takmer polovica v regióne prišla o hospodárske zvieratá alebo zariadenia. Kostas Dounakis, predseda miestneho zväzu chovateľov, opisuje, ako je pre zvyšné zvieratá problém nájsť potravu – zhoreli nielen pasienky, ale aj uskladnené krmivo. Miestni ako príčiny tragédie uvádzajú sucho, klimatickú zmenu a slabú koordináciu zásahu hasičov. Dôležitým faktorom je aj úbytok tradičného pasenia; bez dobytka sa v krajine hromadí biomasa, ktorá podporuje rozsiahle požiare. Začali sa aspoň obnovovacie práce – na svahy kladú polená na ochranu pred eróziou pôdy a odborníčka Sylvia Zakkak ubezpečuje, že stredomorské ekosystémy sa vedia obnoviť, hoci to pôjde pomaly. Pre dravcov, najmä vzácneho supa čierneho, sa budujú špeciálne hniezdne plošiny a niektoré vtáky sa už vrátili. Napriek tomu niektoré druhy, napríklad jastraby, sovy a druhy závislé od hustých lesov, ostávajú ohrozené – celková obnova totiž môže trvať desaťročia. Napriek všetkým ťažkostiam miestni obyvatelia ako Athanassia Pistola nestrácajú nádej a snažia sa starať o zostávajúce zvieratá aj obnovu kraja.
post_content: Greece’s Dadia National Park just endured the EU’s largest wildfire ever—over 90,000 hectares gone. Locals lost nearly everything, wildlife devastated, but they’re fighting to recover and restore this precious land. #wildfire #Dadia #HopeForNature #ClimateCrisis

article_content: The National Judicial Council (NJC) has criticized Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke and the state House of Assembly for suspending the state's Chief Judge, Justice Oyebola Ojo. The NJC states that under the Nigerian Constitution, only the Council holds the authority to investigate, discipline, or remove a judge. A Council member, speaking anonymously, emphasized that neither state governors nor Houses of Assembly have powers to sanction or remove a chief judge without the NJC. The member cited a recent similar case in Sokoto, where the Supreme Court reversed the Assembly’s attempt to remove the Chief Judge. Efforts to reach the NJC’s spokesperson, Adesoji Oye, were unsuccessful. The Nigerian Bar Association (NBA) also condemned the suspension. During a recent plenary, the Osun Assembly had directed Justice Ojo to step aside pending an investigation. Justice Olayinka Afolabi was appointed as Acting Chief Judge. However, Ojo's suspension defied an order from the National Industrial Court in Ibadan, which had restrained Governor Adeleke from removing her. In a statement, NBA National Publicity Secretary Akorede Lawal described the action as a breach of the rule of law and an attack on judicial independence. The NBA stressed that, per the 1999 Constitution and legal precedents (Nganjiwa v FRN; Elelu-Habeeb & Anor v AG Federation & Ors), a chief judge can only be removed following NJC investigation and recommendation. The NBA further criticized the state government for ignoring a subsisting court injunction and warned it would not recognize Justice Afolabi’s appointment. Attempts to get reactions from House Committee on Judiciary members, including Chairman Oluwole Oke and Deputy Chairman Mohammed Danjuma, were unsuccessful. Senior legal professionals, including Ifedayo Adedipe (SAN) and Chief Yomi Aliyu (SAN), reiterated that there is no constitutional provision allowing a governor or Assembly to remove a Chief Judge unilaterally. They insisted that due process involves a disciplinary panel under the authority of the NJC. Allegations that Governor Adeleke found Ojo too loyal to the previous administration, and proceeded to appoint a new acting CJ despite a court order, highlight ongoing concerns about compliance with due process and the separation of powers. The swearing-in of Justice Afolabi as Acting Chief Judge did not proceed as scheduled, as Afolabi did not appear. The NBA maintained its stance, stating that it would not recognize Justice Afolabi as Acting CJ and would employ all available means to ensure adherence to due process in judicial appointments and removals.
translated_content: Národná sudcovská rada (NJC) kritizovala guvernéra štátu Osun Ademola Adelekeho a štátnu snemovňu za suspendovanie hlavnej sudkyne štátu, Justice Oyebola Ojo. NJC konštatuje, že podľa nigérijskej ústavy má len ona právomoc vyšetrovať, disciplinovať alebo odvolať sudcu. Jeden z členov rady, ktorý si želal zostať v anonymite, zdôraznil, že ani guvernéri štátov, ani snemovne nemajú právomoc potrestať alebo odvolať hlavnú sudkyňu bez NJC. Pripomenul podobný prípad v Sokote, kde Najvyšší súd zrušil pokus snemovne o odvolanie hlavnej sudkyne. Pokusy kontaktovať hovorcu NJC, Adesojiho Oyeho, boli neúspešné. Nigerijská advokátska komora (NBA) tento krok takisto odsúdila. Počas nedávneho zasadnutia snemovňa vyzvala Justice Ojo, aby odstúpila do ukončenia vyšetrovania, pričom za dočasnú hlavnú sudkyňu vymenovala Justice Olayinku Afolabi. Suspendovanie Ojo však bolo v rozpore s rozhodnutím Národného pracovného súdu v Ibadane, ktorý Adelekeho odstrániť sudkyňu zakázal. Vo vyhlásení hovorca NBA, Akorede Lawal, označil postup vlády za porušenie princípov právneho štátu a útok na nezávislosť justície. NBA zdôraznila, že podľa ústavy z roku 1999 a právnych precedensov (Nganjiwa v FRN; Elelu-Habeeb & Anor v AG Federation & Ors) je možné hlavnú sudkyňu odvolať len po vyšetrovaní a odporúčaní NJC. NBA ďalej kritizovala ignorovanie platného súdneho príkazu zo strany štátu a avizovala, že Justice Afolabi nebude uznávať. Odpovede výboru snemovne pre justíciu, vrátane predsedu Oluwole Okeho a podpredsedu Mohammeda Danjumu, sa do uzávierky získať nepodarilo. Skúsení právnici Ifedayo Adedipe (SAN) a Chief Yomi Aliyu (SAN) potvrdili, že ústava nedáva guvernérovi alebo snemovni právo jednostranne odvolať hlavnú sudkyňu. Zdôraznili, že treba vždy postupovať cez disciplinárnu komisiu NJC. Obvinenia, že guvernér Adeleke považuje Ojo za príliš lojálnu vtedajšej vláde a vymenoval novú sudkyňu napriek súdnemu zákazu, podľa nich poukazujú na pretrvávajúce obavy z obchádzania riadneho procesu a deľby moci. Sľub Justicy Afolabi ako dočasnej hlavnej sudkyne sa neuskutočnil, keďže sa naň nedostavila. NBA zotrváva v postoji, že Justice Afolabi v novej funkcii neuzná a použije všetky legálne možnosti na zabezpečenie dodržiavania správneho postupu pri personálnych zmenách v justícii.
