article_content: Olatunbosun Oyintiloye, a leading APC figure in Osun State, has applauded President Bola Tinubu’s decision to halt the proposed increase in electricity tariffs across Nigeria. Speaking to journalists in Osogbo, Oyintiloye highlighted that this move reflects the President’s attentiveness to the everyday difficulties confronting Nigerians. Earlier this month, Minister of Power Adebayo Adelabu confirmed President Tinubu’s directive, which mandated the continuation of electricity subsidies nationwide instead of letting higher costs fall on consumers. Oyintiloye, a former member of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, argued that withdrawing these subsidies—especially at a time when Nigerians are still reeling from the end of fuel subsidies—would intensify economic struggles. Referring to the Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission’s recent data, Oyintiloye pointed out that government electricity subsidies climbed from N36 billion in the first quarter of 2023 to N135.2 billion in the second quarter—an increase of 275%. He described this as a firm attempt to shield citizens from sharp price increases. He maintained that removing such subsidies, given the ongoing challenges of inflation and currency instability, would only heighten public hardship. The subsidy acts as a cushion, reducing the difference between actual electricity production costs and regulated consumer prices. Oyintiloye also commended President Tinubu for facilitating peaceful and transparent elections in Kogi, Imo, and Bayelsa states, underscoring that voters were able to choose freely without fear. He credited this achievement to the President’s commitment to fairness and integrity. Offering his congratulations to Hope Uzodimma (Imo), Douye Diri (Bayelsa), and Usman Ododo (Kogi) on their electoral victories, Oyintiloye remarked that these results demonstrated continued public trust in the neutrality of the current government. He encouraged Nigerians to support the administration’s ‘Renewed Hope Agenda’, voicing confidence that the nation will soon move beyond its present difficulties.
translated_content: Olatunbosun Oyintiloye, popredný predstaviteľ APC v štáte Osun, ocenil rozhodnutie prezidenta Bolu Tinubu zastaviť plánované zvýšenie cien elektriny v Nigérii. V rozhovore s novinármi v Osogbo zdôraznil, že tento krok ukazuje prezidentovu citlivosť na každodenné problémy Nigérijčanov. Minister energetiky Adebayo Adelabu začiatkom mesiaca potvrdil nariadenie prezidenta Tinubu, ktorým sa nariaďuje pokračovanie dotácií na elektrinu na celonárodnej úrovni namiesto prenesenia vyšších nákladov na spotrebiteľov. Oyintiloye, bývalý člen prezidentskej kampane APC, tvrdí, že zrušenie týchto dotácií – najmä v čase, keď sa obyvatelia ešte stále vyrovnávajú s dôsledkami zrušenia dotácií na palivá – by len zhoršilo ekonomické ťažkosti. S odvolaním sa na najnovšiu správu Nigerijskej regulačnej komisie pre elektrinu Oyintiloye poukázal na to, že vládne dotácie na elektrinu stúpli z 36 miliárd na 135,2 miliardy nairy medzi prvým a druhým štvrťrokom 2023, čo predstavuje nárast o 275 %. To podľa neho dokazuje snahu vlády chrániť obyvateľov pred náhlym zvyšovaním cien. Zdôraznil, že odstránenie dotácií počas pretrvávajúcej inflácie a nestabilného kurzu by ešte viac zaťažilo obyvateľov. Dotácie zmierňujú rozdiel medzi skutočnými nákladmi na výrobu elektriny a štátom stanovenými cenami pre spotrebiteľov. Oyintiloye zároveň ocenil prezidenta Tinubu za zabezpečenie pokojného a transparentného priebehu volieb v štátoch Kogi, Imo a Bayelsa. Vyzdvihol fakt, že voliči mohli slobodne voliť bez strachu, a pripísal to prezidentovmu záväzku voči spravodlivosti a integrite. Víťazom posledných volieb – Hopeovi Uzodinmovi (Imo), Douyemu Dirimu (Bayelsa) a Usmanovi Ododovi (Kogi) – zablahoželal a zdôraznil, že výsledky volieb dokazujú pokračujúcu dôveru verejnosti v nestrannosť vlády. Zároveň povzbudil občanov, aby podporovali vládny program „Obnovená nádej“, a vyjadril presvedčenie, že krajina čoskoro prekoná súčasné problémy.

article_content: Liz Marks was left blind in one eye and severely disabled after a car crash in April 2012, which happened when she looked at her phone to read a text while driving. She has spoken about the deep isolation she has felt since. At 17, Liz was driving her Mazda 3 in St Michaels, Maryland, when she received a message from her mother, Betty. As she checked it, she collided with a tow truck driven by 25-year-old Roy Dixon, which was stopped to make a turn. Before the accident, Liz was a typical St. Michaels High School student who went to parties, played sports, bowled with friends, and did some modeling. The crash left her with traumatic injuries: permanent blindness in one eye, loss of smell, hearing difficulties, damaged tear ducts that prevent her from crying, and an inability to fall asleep naturally. She spent almost a month in intensive care at the University of Baltimore Shock Trauma Center, undergoing numerous surgeries including an 11-hour brain operation. Initially, friends offered support but over time Liz became isolated as classmates went to college and struggled to connect with her situation. 'The hardest part after the crash was the loneliness,' Liz shares in a video produced with the U.S. Department of Transportation’s National Highway Traffic Safety Administration. Her mother discovered a heartbreaking Facebook post from Liz asking if anyone would spend time with her. Liz acknowledged that she used her phone frequently at school and ignored common warnings about texting while driving, assuming no harm would come from it. After the crash, police found her phone on the car floor, and Liz admitted she had read a message from her mother just before the accident happened. Now, Liz and her mother use their experience to urge others not to text and drive. Their video, featured on the DOT’s YouTube channel, and their Facebook campaign, 'Don't Text N Drive 4 Liz Marks', are part of their advocacy. Betty cautions against texting loved ones while they are driving, and Liz advises, 'If you get a text, don't look at it. It’s not worth it.'
translated_content: Liz Marks zostala po autonehode v apríli 2012, ktorú spôsobila tým, že počas šoférovania pozerala na mobil a čítala textovú správu, slepá na jedno oko a ťažko zdravotne postihnutá. Odvtedy hovorí o hlbokej izolácii, ktorú pociťuje. V sedemnástich rokoch šoférovala svoje Mazda 3 v St. Michaels v štáte Maryland, keď jej prišla správa od mamy Betty. Pri jej kontrole narazila do odťahového auta, ktoré šoféroval 25-ročný Roy Dixon a ktoré stálo, aby odbočilo. Pred nehodou bola Liz typickou študentkou St. Michaels High School - chodila na večierky, hrala športy, chodila bowling s priateľmi a venovala sa aj modelingu. Po nehode utrpela vážne zranenia: navždy oslepla na jedno oko, stratila čuch, má poškodený sluch, nemôže plakať pre poškodené slzné kanáliky a nedokáže prirodzene zaspať. Takmer mesiac strávila na jednotke intenzívnej starostlivosti v Univerzitnom centre pre šokové traumy v Baltimore a podstúpila viacero operácií, vrátane 11-hodinovej operácie mozgu. Na začiatku ju kamarátky a kamaráti podporovali, no postupom času, keď spolužiaci odišli na vysoké školy a ťažko sa vžívali do jej situácie, zostala sama. 'Najťažšie po nehode bola samota,' hovorí Liz vo videu natočenom s Ministerstvom dopravy USA. Jej mama Betty narazila na smutný Lizin príspevok na Facebooku, kde prosila, či sa s ňou niekto nevyberie von. Liz priznala, že telefón používala v škole neustále a varovania o nebezpečenstve písania správ za volantom ignorovala, lebo si myslela, že sa jej nič nestane. Po nehode polícia našla jej mobil na podlahe auta a Liz sa priznala, že sekundy pred haváriou čítala správu od mamy. Dnes Liz a jej mama využívajú svoju skúsenosť, aby povzbudili ostatných, nech za volantom na správy nereagujú. Ich video je na YouTube kanáli ministerstva dopravy a ich facebooková stránka 'Don't Text N Drive 4 Liz Marks' upozorňuje na túto tému. Betty vyzýva, aby ste neposielali správy blízkym, keď viete, že šoférujú, a Liz varuje: 'Ak ti príde správa, nepozeraj sa na ňu. Nestojí to za to.'
post_content: Liz Marks’ life changed forever after a text at the wheel led to a crash, leaving her disabled and isolated. Now, she and her mom are fighting to stop others from texting while driving. Your phone can wait! #DontTextAndDrive #LizMarks #RoadSafety

While some might tune in to the Super Bowl for the football, many are just as interested in the commercials. This year, a highly anticipated ad will reunite three beloved stars from the '90s: Bob Saget, Dave Coulier, and John Stamos. On February 2, during the Super Bowl, fans can look forward to a mini-'Full House' reunion in a commercial for Dannon Oikos yogurt.

The actors, who played Danny Tanner, Uncle Joey, and Uncle Jesse on the hit ABC sitcom from 1987 to 1995, are featured in a teaser that hints at playful humor about their characters still living together all these years later.

In a behind-the-scenes video, Stamos—already a spokesperson for Dannon—shares his excitement about the project. ‘I’m very grateful to my two brothers for doing this commercial with me for Dannon,’ he says. ‘I think it’s going to be really funny, and I believe “Full House” fans will be pleasantly surprised.’

Tento rok prinesie jedna z najočakávanejších reklám opätovné stretnutie troch obľúbených hviezd 90. rokov: Boba Sageta, Davea Couiliera a Johna Stamosa. article_content: The United States has granted Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, major South Korean chipmakers, ongoing permission to export American chip manufacturing equipment to their Chinese facilities. Announced by South Korea, this move allows both companies to ship vital U.S. technology to their Chinese plants without needing separate approvals for each export. Now added to the U.S. Commerce Department’s 'validated end user' list, Samsung and SK Hynix can import certain American tools to their factories in Xian, Wuxi, and Dalian with minimal red tape. This designation removes previous obstacles and ambiguity about their China operations. Both companies praised the decision, describing it as a key factor in strengthening the global semiconductor supply chain. Choi Sang-mok, South Korea’s senior presidential secretary for economic affairs, said the waivers have significantly reduced concerns surrounding South Korean chipmakers’ activities and investments in China. He stressed this creates room for long-term global planning. Samsung’s Xian plant produces around 40% of its NAND flash memory chips, while SK Hynix makes about 40% of its DRAM chips in Wuxi and 20% of its NAND in Dalian. These components power devices like smartphones and computers. Together, Samsung and SK Hynix account for nearly 70% of the global DRAM market and 50% of the NAND flash market. The waivers illustrate the Biden administration’s strategy to balance technology security with support for the semiconductor industry. Since building and operating chip factories demand huge investments, reliable operation is essential. In response to recent chip shortages, the U.S. aims to make the supply chain more resilient by relaxing some export controls for these companies.

Tieto čipy sú zásadné pre zariadenia ako smartfóny a počítače. Spolu Samsung a SK Hynix tvoria takmer 70 % trhu s DRAM a 50 % trhu s NAND flash čipmi. Výnimky odzrkadľujú snahu Bidenovej administratívy vyvážiť bezpečnostné otázky týkajúce sa technológií s podporou čipového priemyslu. article_content: After the unexpected dismissal of Sam Altman, OpenAI’s board is reportedly in talks about potentially bringing him back. Discussions are underway between the former CEO and at least one board member, according to people familiar with the situation. Nearly all OpenAI staff have threatened to leave unless Mr. Altman and co-founder Greg Brockman are reinstated. Microsoft, OpenAI’s largest investor, has since offered Altman a job. Reports from Bloomberg and the Financial Times indicate that OpenAI is exploring several options, such as reinstating Mr. Altman as CEO or appointing him to the board. It remains unclear whether Mr. Altman will join Microsoft, which has also promised to match the salaries of any OpenAI staff who make the switch. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella stated he is 'committed to OpenAI and Sam, irrespective of what configuration.' He added to CNBC, 'Obviously that depends on the people at OpenAI staying there or coming to Microsoft, so I’m open to both options.' Emmett Shear, former head of Twitch and now interim CEO of OpenAI, is also reportedly involved in the ongoing negotiations. Last week, the board’s decision to remove Mr. Altman led to Mr. Brockman resigning and threw the company into turmoil. The decision was made by three non-employee board members—Adam D'Angelo, Tasha McCauley, and Helen Toner—as well as co-founder and chief scientist Ilya Sutskever. Mr. Sutskever has since apologized on X (formerly Twitter) and signed the letter calling on the board to reverse its decision. Despite a reported $80 billion (£63.8bn) valuation, OpenAI’s board was comprised of only six members as of last week. Evan Morikawa, an engineering manager at OpenAI, said that 743 out of 770 employees have signed a letter demanding the board’s resignation, with staff threatening to leave if their demands are not met. The BBC has contacted OpenAI for comment.

article_content: Toyota Motor Corporation plans to invest Rs3300 crore in a third manufacturing facility in India, targeting increased demand and advancing cleaner vehicle technologies. This expansion marks Toyota's 25th year in India, bringing total investment in the country to Rs19,300 crore, as announced by executives from Toyota Kirloskar Motor (TKM). On Tuesday, TKM formalized a partnership with the Karnataka government for this new venture. The plant, to be located at Toyota's existing Bidadi site near Bengaluru, will have a yearly capacity of 100,000 vehicles and projects to create 2,000 direct jobs. It will produce the latest Innova HyCross alongside future models with varied powertrain options, although Toyota did not specify which models. This development is Toyota’s first large-scale expansion in India in nearly 15 years. Waiting times for popular models such as the hybrid Innova HyCross can reach up to a year, while vehicles like the Urban Cruiser Hyryder and Innova Crysta face waits of three to six months. Extended wait periods have led TKM to pause bookings for certain variants, including the Innova HyCross ZX & ZX (O) and the CNG version of Rumion. Because the new plant will be operational only by 2026, current long waiting periods are expected to persist in the short term. Presently, Toyota's plants—which produce the Hyryder, Innova Crysta, Hycross, and Fortuner—are running at maximum capacity. The new plant will eventually raise annual production to 342,000 vehicles, according to Vikram Gulati, Executive Vice President at TKM. To address immediate demand, Toyota has instituted a third production shift, raising yearly output by 33% (about 30,000 units) and streamlining manufacturing and supply chain processes. Atul Sood, Vice President of Sales and Marketing at TKM, noted that most customers maintain their bookings despite waits, and the company is transparent about estimated delays for high-demand models. Toyota, once a lesser player in the Indian auto market, has rapidly expanded due to successful model launches and a key partnership with Suzuki, resulting in a 2.7-times profitability increase from FY22 to FY23 and a 41% growth in vehicle sales. This momentum continued into 2023, with monthly sales exceeding 20,000 units for four months straight and a 29% rise in sales over the April-October period. Additional trends in the sector include continued caution in IPO financing, executive shifts at OpenAI and Microsoft, and expectations for record commercial vehicle sales in FY24 for leading manufacturers like Tata Motors and Ashok Leyland.

article_content: The ongoing legal dispute between Apple and Samsung continues as speculation about the iPhone 5 grows, despite Apple not confirming a release date. In the meantime, several Samsung devices remain restricted due to Apple’s lawsuits. Samsung appears ready to retaliate. Lee Younghee, the head of global marketing for Samsung’s mobile division, announced that the company will now defend its rights more aggressively. She also suggested Apple is benefitting from Samsung’s wireless technology, increasing rumors that Samsung might move to block the iPhone 5’s launch in Europe. The primary issue stems from Apple’s allegations that Samsung’s Galaxy touchscreen devices closely resemble the iPhone. This dispute has resulted in major lawsuits in various countries. Despite their rivalry, Samsung is a key supplier of components for Apple’s iPhones, and Samsung’s CEO has acknowledged that Apple is the company’s largest customer. However, after Samsung introduced its Galaxy series—like the high-performance Galaxy S II, which currently surpasses the iPhone 4’s processing speed—the legal conflict expanded to nine countries. A Samsung executive told the Korea Times that once the iPhone 5 is available in Korea, Samsung plans to sue Apple there for infringing on Samsung’s wireless technology patents. This is a response to Apple’s continued litigation targeting Samsung’s Galaxy devices, several of which have been banned in Europe after Apple's claims of design imitation were upheld in court. Recently, Samsung has overtaken Nokia as the leading smartphone manufacturer. The Galaxy S II, with its larger display and faster processor, has proven especially popular among technology enthusiasts. Earlier this month, Apple forced Samsung to withdraw a prototype tablet from a Berlin trade show, and the Galaxy Tab 10.1 is still banned in Europe after legal proceedings. According to the Maeil Business Newspaper, Samsung is considering seeking an injunction against Apple's new iPhone in Europe. The company, however, has declined to comment on pending lawsuits. This escalating legal conflict between Apple and Samsung—involving claims of copying and patent infringement—now extends across nine countries and is complicated by patented technology held by players like Google and Microsoft. Recently, Apple succeeded in blocking Samsung’s new tablets in Germany and some smartphones in the Netherlands, and delayed product launches in Australia. After losing the latest round in Germany, Samsung vowed to use all available legal options. Apple originally sued Samsung in April for design copying, with Samsung countersuing citing patent violations related to its mobile technologies.

Lee Younghee, šéfka globálneho marketingu mobilnej divízie Samsungu, oznámila, že spoločnosť bude svoje práva obhajovať ešte razantnejšie. Tiež naznačila, že Apple využíva bezdrôtové technológie Samsungu, čo posilňuje dohady, že Samsung môže chcieť zablokovať vstup iPhonu 5 na európsky trh. Jadro sporu je spor o podobnosť Galaxy zariadení od Samsungu s iPhonom, kvôli čomu prebiehajú rozsiahle súdne spory v rôznych krajinách. Napriek rivalite je Samsung hlavným dodávateľom komponentov pre iPhony a generálny riaditeľ priznal, že Apple je ich najväčším zákazníkom. Od spustenia vlastnej série Galaxy – napríklad výkonného Galaxy S II, ktorý dnes predčí iPhone 4 výkonom – sa právny konflikt rozšíril do deviatich krajín. Jeden z manažérov Samsungu pre Korea Times uviedol, že keď dorazí iPhone 5 do Kórei, Samsung plánuje podať žalobu kvôli porušeniu patentov v oblasti bezdrôtových technológií. Po poslednej prehre v Nemecku Samsung avizoval, že využije všetky právne možnosti. Apple podal prvú žalobu voči Samsungu v apríli pre údajné kopírovanie dizajnu, Samsung odpovedal protižalobou za porušenie patentov mobilných technológií.

article_content: Clive Palmer, leader of the Palmer United Party, abruptly left an ABC interview after being questioned about an ongoing legal dispute. Appearing on Lateline via videolink from the Gold Coast, Palmer initially discussed his public disagreement with Tasmanian Senator Jacqui Lambie. The conversation soon shifted as presenter Emma Alberici raised allegations concerning Palmer's legal battle with CITIC Pacific, a Chinese government-owned investment company. Alberici referred to court documents accusing Palmer of dishonesty and fraud, specifically questioning the use of $12 million purportedly allocated for port management. Palmer vehemently denied the allegations, calling them untrue and responding defensively. He refused to elaborate further on the matter, despite Alberici's continued questioning. The exchange grew tense as both parties interrupted each other, culminating in Palmer removing his earpiece and ending the interview. This incident follows a previous occurrence in July when Palmer similarly left an interview with ABC's Sarah Ferguson when faced with difficult questions.

article_content: Anthony Weiner’s mayoral campaign continued to suffer on Friday as satirical posters appeared around New York City, mocking the candidate’s ongoing public relations problems. The comedy website Funny or Die reportedly posted spoof ads in Manhattan, searching for interns for Weiner’s campaign. The flyers, widely believed to have been made by the site’s humorists, jokingly sought applicants who were not 's***bags,' 'snitches,' or 'cops.' Under the ‘qualifications’ section, the mock ad listed requirements such as being 'organized and detail-oriented, discreet, and having no gag reflex,' according to Red Alert Politics. The sign comically instructed candidates to report to the loading area behind the docks at sundown, 'and make sure you are not followed.' These fake flyers referenced recent controversy involving Weiner’s Communications Director, Barbara Morgan. Morgan reportedly called former intern Olivia Nuzzi derogatory names after Nuzzi published an exposé about her campaign experience. Weiner was seen declining to comment about Morgan’s comments and avoided reporters by quickly entering a waiting SUV. The campaign’s troubles escalated the previous week after it was revealed Weiner had continued exchanging explicit messages with women for up to a year after his initial Twitter scandal that led to his resignation from Congress. Matters worsened when Morgan responded to criticism by Olivia Nuzzi, again using offensive language. On Wednesday evening, Weiner attended an event hosted by the Friends of Rockaway Beach alongside three other Democratic mayoral candidates, but left after briefly answering three questions, while members of the press pursued him. He was also seen checking his phone during the event, a reminder of his recent sexting controversy. Once seen as a strong contender against frontrunner Christine Quinn in the Democratic primary, Weiner’s poll numbers plummeted after it was revealed he continued sending explicit messages under the alias 'Carlos Danger.' In the aftermath of the controversy, Barbara Morgan posted an apology on Twitter, sharing an image of a 'swear jar' filled with money and credit cards and writing, 'Not my best day yesterday. Should've known better, been better. Gotta pay up.' She stated she had apologized to Olivia Nuzzi both by phone and email. Morgan said her inappropriate language came during what she thought was an off-the-record conversation and expressed regret. Nuzzi, who wrote a critical article for the New York Daily News, alleged campaign mismanagement, staff dissatisfaction, and that some staffers were motivated by proximity to Weiner’s wife, Huma Abedin. She also claimed an employee left after being paid significantly less than promised, and that Weiner used the nickname 'Monica' to refer to her and other interns.

article_content: Inpex, Japan's chief oil and gas company, together with its partners, has unveiled plans to assess the creation of a low-carbon ammonia production and export facility along the Houston Ship Channel in the United States. This move supports Japan’s strategy to reduce emissions by using ammonia in coal-powered plants and various industries. The partners are working on a pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED), aiming to achieve annual production exceeding 1.1 million metric tons of low-carbon ammonia by late 2027 for the project’s initial phase, with the possibility for future expansion. Most of the ammonia output is slated for Asian power stations, with some volumes potentially available for Europe and the U.S. Though full details on investment division and total costs weren’t disclosed, Inpex stated it intends to be the project’s principal investor throughout production and export. Elsewhere, Japanese firms are broadening their ammonia infrastructure: Mitsubishi is contemplating converting an LPG facility in Hiroshima into a center for ammonia imports, while Itochu recently consented to examine the establishment of an ammonia bunkering hub in Algeciras, Spain, near the Gibraltar Strait.

Tento krok podporuje stratégiu Japonska znižovať emisie používaním amoniaku v elektrárňach na uhlie aj v rôznych priemyselných oblastiach. Partneri pracujú na predprojektovej technickej štúdii (pre-FEED) s cieľom dosiahnuť ročnú produkciu viac ako 1,1 milióna metrických ton nízkouhlíkového amoniaku do konca roku 2027 v prvej fáze projektu a s možnosťou budúceho rozšírenia. Väčšina produkcie je určená pre ázijské elektrárne, časť môže byť exportovaná aj do Európy a USA. Aj keď podrobnosti o podiele investícií a celkových nákladoch neboli zverejnené, Inpex uviedol, že plánuje byť hlavným investorom počas celej výroby a exportu. Japonské firmy zároveň rozširujú svoju infraštruktúru na amoniak: Mitsubishi zvažuje premeniť LPG závod v Hirošime na centrum dovozu amoniaku, zatiaľ čo Itochu súhlasilo s preskúmaním možnosti vybudovania bunkrovacieho centra pre amoniak v Algeciras, Španielsko, pri Gibraltárskom prielive.

article_content: An eight-year-old boy suffered a serious head injury when a tree branch unexpectedly fell on him at the popular Erskine Falls near Lorne, Victoria. The incident occurred shortly after 11 a.m. on Friday, prompting a rapid response from emergency services. Paramedics treated the boy for a laceration at the back of his head and took him to Lorne Hospital, where he was stabilized. Due to the severity of his injury, the boy was subsequently airlifted to the Royal Children's Hospital in Melbourne for further treatment. Ambulance authorities report he remains in a serious but stable condition. Erskine Falls is a well-known destination for visitors, famed for its tree-lined walks and scenic waterfall.

article_content: The ongoing antitrust lawsuit brought by the U.S. Department of Justice against Google has revealed confidential details about the tech giant’s most profitable search keywords. During the trial this week, a list of Google’s top 20 highest-revenue search terms for the week of September 22, 2018, was submitted as evidence, providing rare insight into which queries earn the company the most money. As reported by The Verge on November 1, the data shows product and service-related keywords dominate Google's revenue rankings. Apple-related terms took three of the five highest spots, with “iPhone 8,” “iPhone 8 Plus,” and “iPhone” ranked first, second, and eleventh respectively. This highlights both Apple’s immense consumer appeal and the company’s readiness to pay premium prices to promote new products atop Google’s search results. Other leading searches included highly competitive sectors such as insurance (“auto insurance,” “car insurance”), television and internet services (“DirectTV,” “Hulu,” “Xfinity”), and transportation (“Uber”). Broad informational searches, like news headlines or website navigation, were notably absent from the top 20, since such queries lack the commercial intent preferred by advertisers. While exact revenue amounts remain undisclosed, experts speculate that Apple-related searches alone may have generated tens of millions of dollars for Google in that single week. Terms like “auto insurance” and “cheap flights” also command high cost-per-click rates, with advertisers paying Google each time their ads are clicked. The disclosure of Google’s top-grossing search terms offers a rare look into the mechanisms that drive much of the company’s billions in annual profits. As the antitrust trial continues, experts anticipate further insights into Google's search and advertising operations at the heart of its business model and market influence.

Počas súdneho procesu tento týždeň bol ako dôkaz predložený zoznam 20 najvýnosnejších vyhľadávacích dopytov Google za týždeň od 22. septembra 2018, čo poskytuje vzácny pohľad na otázky, ktoré spoločnosti prinášajú najväčšie zisky. Podľa správy The Verge z 1. novembra dáta ukazujú, že rebríčku príjmov dominujú kľúčové slová týkajúce sa produktov a služieb. Výrazy súvisiace so značkou Apple obsadili tri z piatich najvyšších miest – „iPhone 8“, „iPhone 8 Plus“ a „iPhone“ skončili na prvom, druhom a jedenástom mieste. To dokazuje obrovskú popularitu spoločnosti Apple medzi spotrebiteľmi a jej ochotu platiť vysoké sumy za propagáciu noviniek na popredných miestach vo výsledkoch vyhľadávania Google. Medzi ďalšie vedúce vyhľadávania patrili konkurenčné odvetvia ako poistenie („povinné zmluvné poistenie“, „havárijné poistenie“), televízia a internetové služby („DirectTV“, „Hulu“, „Xfinity“) či doprava („Uber“). V prvej dvadsiatke chýbali všeobecné informačné dopyty, ako spravodajské titulky alebo navigácia na webstránky, keďže takéto vyhľadávania neobsahujú komerčný zámer, ktorý inzerenti uprednostňujú. Hoci presné sumy príjmov nie sú zverejnené, odborníci predpokladajú, že len vyhľadávania súvisiace s Apple mohli Google v danom týždni priniesť desiatky miliónov dolárov. Výrazy ako „povinné zmluvné poistenie“ a „lacné letenky“ dosahujú tiež vysoké ceny za kliknutie, pričom inzerenti za každý klik na ich reklamu platia Google značné sumy. Odhalenie najziskovejších výrazov poskytuje vzácny pohľad na mechanizmy, ktoré poháňajú miliardové zisky spoločnosti Google. Ako súdny proces pokračuje, odborníci očakávajú ďalšie zaujímavé informácie o vyhľadávacích a reklamných praktikách, ktoré sú jadrom obchodného modelu a trhovej sily spoločnosti Google.

article_content: In a Seattle-area coffee shop, Kate Pippinger—a married mother of four and professional actress—sits with her mug and newspaper, representing the latest push for marijuana legalization. Pippinger stars in a new television ad released by New Approach Washington, a group advocating for legalizing and regulating cannabis. Aimed at women between the ages of 30 and 50, the ad opens with Pippinger saying, 'I don’t like marijuana personally, but it’s time we talk about legalization.' Alison Holcomb, campaign director for New Approach Washington, explained that Pippinger was chosen because she embodies the demographic of undecided but open-minded women, whom the campaign considers key to passing Initiative 502. This measure would legalize marijuana for adults over 21, set up a system of regulation and licensing, and impose taxes on sales. Advocates believe such a system would redirect police resources from minor marijuana offenses towards more serious crimes, reduce the power of illegal drug dealers, and generate tax revenue for improvements in healthcare and education. The campaign’s coalition includes doctors, lawyers, drug specialists, and parents. Not everyone supports this plan. Ed Holmes, Mercer Island’s police chief, criticized the initiative, arguing that marijuana use can lead to dangerous behavior and crime, questioning the wisdom of legalization. He told ABC News, 'I don’t know how it makes good sense to legalize something that serves no purpose other than to cause impairment.' The ad campaign, which runs in the Seattle area through August 25, aims to sway voters before the November 6 election, when Initiative 502 will appear on the ballot for Washington State residents.

Pippinger účinkuje v novej televíznej reklame, ktorú spustila skupina New Approach Washington, zastávajúca legalizáciu a reguláciu kanabisu. Reklama je zameraná na ženy vo veku 30 až 50 rokov a začína slovami Pippinger: „Osobne nemám rada marihuanu, ale je čas, aby sme sa rozprávali o legalizácii.“ Alison Holcomb, riaditeľka kampane New Approach Washington, vysvetlila, že Pippinger bola vybraná práve preto, že stelesňuje demografickú skupinu nerozhodnutých, ale otvorených žien, ktoré považuje kampaň za kľúčové pre schválenie iniciatívy 502. Tento návrh by legalizoval marihuanu pre dospelých nad 21 rokov, zaviedol regulačný a licenčný systém a uvalil dane na predaj. Zástancovia veria, že takýto systém by policajným zložkám umožnil sústrediť sa na závažnejšie trestné činy, oslabil ilegálnych predajcov drog a priniesol financie na zlepšenie zdravotnej starostlivosti a školstva. Koalícia kampane zahŕňa lekárov, právnikov, odborníkov na drogy a rodičov. Nie každý je však s týmto plánom spokojný. Ed Holmes, náčelník polície Mercer Island, iniciatívu kritizoval a tvrdil, že užívanie marihuany môže viesť k nebezpečnému správaniu a trestnej činnosti. Pre ABC News povedal: „Nechápem, ako má zmysel legalizovať niečo, čo slúži len na spôsobenie zníženia schopností.“ Reklamná kampaň, ktorá v oblasti Seattlu beží do 25. augusta, sa snaží presvedčiť voličov pred voľbami 6. novembra, kedy budú obyvatelia štátu Washington môcť o iniciatíve 502 rozhodnúť.

article_content:
Christopher Pyne has urged government backbenchers to refrain from internal criticism and instead lend their full support to the government's efforts, amidst growing reports of party discord and slipping poll figures. At the close of the parliamentary year, Pyne conceded the government’s position was somewhat unsettled, echoing sentiments previously expressed by Prime Minister Tony Abbott. He reinforced the idea that all MPs should be proactive advocates for government policy rather than passive commentators.

Recently, speculation over a possible cabinet reshuffle and reports of disputes within party ranks have surfaced, fueled by dissatisfaction with key initiatives like the proposed GP co-payment. Pyne, however, maintained his strong support for Treasurer Joe Hockey, acknowledging a challenging year but rejecting claims that Hockey’s job is in jeopardy. Hockey himself chose not to address the rumors, reaffirming his dedication to his responsibilities.

Small Business Minister Bruce Billson acknowledged that the government could better communicate its reforms, particularly regarding higher education and health. Using a cricket analogy, Billson dismissed the idea of reorganizing the cabinet simply due to isolated setbacks. The latest Galaxy poll shows government support reducing to 38%, with Labor increasing to 41%, leaving the government ten points behind on a two-party preferred basis.

Christopher Pyne vyzval vládnych poslancov, aby prestali s internou kritikou a namiesto toho naplno podporili vládny tím, keďže sa zväčšujú správy o nezhodách v strane a klesajúci výsledky v prieskumoch. Pri uzatváraní parlamentného roka Pyne priznal, že pozícia vlády je trochu nestála – v súlade s vyjadreniami premiéra Tonyho Abbotta. Zdôraznil, že všetci poslanci by mali byť aktívnymi zástancami vládnej politiky, nie iba tichými komentátormi.

V posledných dňoch sa objavili špekulácie o možnej zmene v kabinete a správy o napätí vnútri strany, čo je poháňané nespokojnosťou s kľúčovými iniciatívami, ako je navrhovaný poplatok u všeobecných lekárov. Pyne však uistil o plnej podpore ministra financií Joea Hockeyho, priznal náročný rok, avšak odmietol tvrdenia o ohrození jeho postu. Hockey sa k špekuláciám odmietol vyjadriť a potvrdil, že svoju prácu vykonáva naďalej.

Minister pre malé podniky Bruce Billson uznal, že vláda by mala lepšie komunikovať plánované reformy, hlavne v oblasti vysokých škôl a zdravotníctva. Príkladom z kriketu Billson odmietol myšlienku reštartu kabinetu pre jednotlivé chyby. Podľa posledného prieskumu Galaxy podpora vlády klesla na 38 %, podpora Labouristov stúpla na 41 %, a vláda zaostáva za opozíciou o desať percentuálnych bodov v rámci dvoch hlavných strán.

article_content: Ubisoft has attributed the appearance of a fullscreen pop-up ad in Assassin’s Creed Odyssey this week to a technical error. According to several Reddit users, the pop-up ad was seen on Xbox and PlayStation versions when navigating to the map screen. One Reddit user stated, “This is disgusting to experience while playing,” reflecting widespread player frustration toward unexpected advertisements during gameplay. Ubisoft spokesperson Fabien Darrigues told The Verge, “We have been made aware that some players encountered pop-up ads while playing certain Assassin’s Creed titles yesterday. This was the result of a technical error that we addressed as soon as we learned of the issue.” Ubisoft noted that the ad was intended for the main menu to promote Assassin’s Creed Mirage, but a technical issue caused it to appear within in-game menus instead. The company says the problem has since been resolved. Recently, Microsoft also used fullscreen Xbox pop-up ads to promote its games, although these only appear when starting up the console and not all users see them. Both Microsoft and Ubisoft’s methods differ from typical in-game advertising, such as billboards in Saints Row 2 or in-game ads in EA titles from the 2000s. Fullscreen pop-up ads during gameplay remain rare and unpopular among players. Many gamers worry about the possibility of frequent ads in games that already cost $70. The update as of November 24th, 1:01PM ET, includes Ubisoft’s explanation of the incident.

Podľa viacerých používateľov Redditu sa pop-up reklama objavila vo verziách na Xboxe a PlayStatione pri prechode do mapy. Jeden z používateľov Redditu uviedol: „Je odporné to zažiť počas hrania,“ čo odráža široké rozhorčenie hráčov nad nečakanými reklamami počas hry. Hovorca Ubisoftu Fabien Darrigues povedal pre The Verge: „Zistili sme, že niektorí hráči narazili na pop-up reklamy pri hraní určitých titulov Assassin’s Creed včera. Išlo o výsledok technickej chyby, ktorú sme odstránili hneď, ako sme sa o nej dozvedeli.“ Ubisoft uviedol, že reklama mala byť pôvodne zobrazená len v hlavnom menu na propagáciu Assassin’s Creed Mirage, no technická chyba spôsobila, že sa zobrazila aj v herných menu. Spoločnosť tvrdí, že problém bol už vyriešený. Nedávno aj Microsoft použil celoplošné pop-up reklamy na Xboxe na propagáciu svojich hier, tie sa však zobrazujú len pri zapnutí konzoly a nezaznamenali ich všetci užívatelia. Metódy Microsoftu a Ubisoftu sa líšia od bežnej reklamy v hrách, ako sú billboardy v Saints Row 2 alebo reklamy v hrách od EA zo začiatku tisícročia. Celoplošné pop-up reklamy počas hrania zostávajú zriedkavé a medzi hráčmi sú veľmi nepopulárne. Mnohí hráči sa obávajú častejších reklám v hrách, za ktoré už zaplatili 70 dolárov. Aktualizácia k 24. novembru, 13:01 ET obsahuje vysvetlenie od Ubisoftu.

article_content: Nearly two and a half months after being arrested for allegedly accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe, two Chandigarh Municipal Corporation officials have been reinstated by Municipal Commissioner Anindita Mitra. In a formal order, Mitra announced that Chief Sanitary Inspector Chander Mohan is reinstated with immediate effect, with the period of suspension to be determined based on the final outcome of court proceedings. The same reinstatement order was issued for Health Supervisor Sandeep Kumar. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) had arrested both officials in August. They were accused of accepting a Rs 1 lakh bribe in exchange for reinstating a previously suspended municipal employee in Chandigarh's Sector 17. According to sources, the bribe money was recovered from the car of one of the officials. At the time of his arrest, Chander Mohan, who oversaw sanitation in the southern division of Chandigarh, had just attended a meeting with other civic officials from the Medical Officer of Health (MoH) wing in Sector 17. Meeting documents were found in his car, further linking him to the case. Additionally, gold ornaments valued at Rs 1.6 crore were discovered in the locker of one of the arrested officials, raising further suspicions. At a General House meeting held on August 29, councillors from across party lines questioned whether senior MoH wing officers should continue in their current roles and retain their authority, particularly in light of the ongoing investigation and the officials' reported statements during interrogation. When contacted for comment, Chandigarh Mayor Anup Gupta stated, 'I am totally not aware of it.'

article_content: If 'The Marvels' had been released four or five years ago, the conversation around the film would likely be different—review scores may have been higher and box office returns stronger. For instance, 'Captain Marvel' earned over a billion dollars worldwide, despite mixed critical reactions. Now, 'The Marvels' has posted the lowest opening weekend in MCU history, with $47 million domestically and $88.5 million internationally. Its box office performance is below other recent releases such as 'Quantumania,' 'Eternals,' and 'Love and Thunder.' The film itself is solid and avoids the major pitfalls seen in some recent MCU entries. However, it seems to have arrived at an unfavorable moment for the franchise, leading to its weaker impact. Along with other recent Marvel disappointments, this signals that both Disney and its fans may need to lower their expectations for the future. A significant issue is Disney’s difficulty in managing production costs—not just with 'The Marvels,' but especially with Disney Plus shows like 'She-Hulk' and 'Secret Invasion.' Reports indicate that some episodes had budgets as high as 'Game of Thrones,' with 'Secret Invasion' costing over $200 million despite receiving poor reviews. While large budgets are often necessary for superhero projects, costs have grown unsustainably, particularly in streaming. Consequently, Disney Plus is scaling back on its series. This pattern also affects DC, whose recent films have struggled as well. The demanding production schedules contribute to higher costs and sometimes subpar VFX quality due to tight deadlines and labor shortages. This differs from the environment when the MCU first started. Disney and fans alike need to adjust their expectations moving forward. Some upcoming projects, such as the new 'Deadpool' film featuring Wolverine, have strong box office potential—even with an R rating—while others, like another 'Captain America' film without Chris Evans, might not fare as well. There is excitement for 'The Fantastic Four,' but projects like 'Thunderbolts' receive mixed anticipation. The next 'Avengers' movies are unlikely to match the massive success of 'Infinity War' or 'Endgame.' Currently, the superhero genre is experiencing a downturn. While these films can still be commercially successful, the days when titles like 'Captain Marvel' and 'Aquaman' effortlessly surpassed the billion-dollar mark appear to be over. There is still hope: Marvel may experience a resurgence when the Fantastic Four and X-Men join the MCU, and DC may rebound with James Gunn’s new direction. For now, however, the industry faces a challenging transition, which is not always due to any one project’s shortcomings—this can be said for 'The Marvels.' Disney is already rethinking its MCU strategy, especially on streaming. The recent strike provided time to reset, with only 'Deadpool 3' set for 2024. Several films are planned for 2025, but delays are probable. Longer gaps between releases could help, but more significant changes are likely required.

Napríklad 'Captain Marvel' zarobil viac ako miliardu dolárov celosvetovo, aj keď mal zmiešané kritické ohlasy. Teraz má 'The Marvels' najslabší otvárací víkend v histórii MCU, s tržbami 47 miliónov dolárov doma a 88,5 milióna v zahraničí. Jeho výkon prekonali aj novšie snímky ako 'Quantumania', 'Eternals' či 'Love and Thunder.' Film sám o sebe je solídny a vyhýba sa hlavným chybám niektorých posledných MCU titulov. Napriek tomu prichádza v nevhodnom čase pre túto značku, čo sa odráža na jeho slabších výsledkoch. Spolu s ďalšími neúspechmi Marvelu to naznačuje, že Disney aj fanúšikovia budú musieť do budúcna znížiť svoje očakávania. Väčším problémom je, že Disney má problém udržiavať kontrolu nad produkčnými nákladmi – a to nielen pri 'The Marvels', ale najmä pri seriáloch na Disney Plus ako 'She-Hulk' a 'Secret Invasion.' Niektoré epizódy podľa správ stáli toľko ako diely 'Game of Thrones' a 'Secret Invasion' stál viac ako 200 miliónov dolárov, hoci sa nestretol s priaznivými recenziami. Veľké rozpočty sú síce pri superhrdinských projektoch časté, náklady však narástli do neudržateľných výšok, najmä pri streamovacích službách. Disney Plus preto obmedzuje produkciu. Problém majú aj konkurenti – DC zaznamenalo slabé výsledky so svojimi poslednými filmami. Náročný pracovný harmonogram a nedostatok kapacít spôsobujú rastúce náklady či horšiu kvalitu vizuálnych efektov. To je rozdiel oproti začiatkom MCU. Do budúcna by mali Disney aj fanúšikovia upraviť svoje očakávania. Očakáva sa, že niektoré pripravované projekty, ako nový Deadpool s Wolverinom, môžu byť úspešné aj s ratingom R. Naopak, ďalší Captain America bez Chrisa Evansa nemusí byť až taký hit. Na 'Fantastic Four' sa teší mnoho fanúšikov, ale 'Thunderbolts' vzbudzuje menší záujem. Nové Avengers filmy zrejme nedosiahnu popularitu Infinity War či Endgame. Superhrdinský žáner je momentálne na ústupe. Filmy síce ešte môžu zarobiť, no časy, keď 'Captain Marvel' a 'Aquaman' automaticky prekonali miliardu dolárov, sú preč. Nádej ale stále existuje: Marvel sa môže zlepšiť príchodom Fantastic Four a X-Men, DC má šancu na reštart pod vedením Jamesa Gunna. Aktuálne je však priemysel v komplikovanom období, často nie kvôli konkrétnym projektom, čo platí aj pri 'The Marvels.' Disney už upravuje svoju MCU stratégiu, špeciálne v oblasti streamovania. Posledný štrajk poskytol čas na prehodnotenie, v roku 2024 príde len 'Deadpool 3.' Na rok 2025 je naplánovaných viac filmov, no niektoré zrejme odložia. Dlhšie rozostupy medzi premiérami môžu pomôcť, ale zmeny budú potrebné aj na iných úrovniach.

article_content: U.S. Rep. Rick Renzi was indicted on charges of promising to support legislation in exchange for a land deal that earned the Arizona Republican over $700,000, the Justice Department announced Friday. The 35-count indictment, unsealed early Friday, charges Renzi, 49, with conspiracy, wire fraud, money laundering, extortion, and insurance fraud. Also charged are Renzi's former business partner, real estate investor James W. Sandlin, 56, of Sherman, Texas, and Andrew Beardall, 36, of Rockville, Maryland. Renzi's attorneys, Reid Weingarten and Kelly Kramer, denied any wrongdoing, stating, 'We will fight these charges until he is vindicated and his family's name is restored.' They expressed disappointment that the Department of Justice did not allow more time to pass following Renzi burying his father at Arlington National Cemetery on Thursday. At a news conference in Phoenix, prosecutors stated that Renzi conspired with Sandlin to arrange a land swap in exchange for Renzi's advocacy in a House committee. Prosecutors say Renzi received $733,000 from the deal but failed to disclose this in his 2005 financial disclosure statement. U.S. Attorney Diane Humetewa said Renzi used his official authority to ensure the 2005 federal land swap included Sandlin's property. The indictment asserts that the aim was to conceal Renzi's financial gain. According to the indictment, Renzi faced financial difficulties in 2005 and needed funds to keep his insurance business afloat and support his lifestyle. The indictment lays out a series of transactions between Renzi and Sandlin, who were co-owners of Fountain Realty and Development before Renzi sold his share to Sandlin. Sandlin paid $200,000 upfront and agreed to an $800,000 note, with $700,000 still owed in 2005. Authorities allege Renzi insisted that two entities in Arizona buy Sandlin's property in return for his support of the legislation. Renzi and Beardall are also charged with insurance fraud, accused of embezzling over $400,000 in insurance premiums from the trust account of Patriot Insurance Agency, a Renzi family business, allegedly to fund Renzi's 2001 and 2002 congressional campaigns. They are accused of making false statements to influence state regulatory investigations. U.S. Attorney Humetewa said, 'There were concealment efforts, misrepresentations, and fraudulent statements.' Prosecutors stated that, if convicted, Renzi could face up to 20 years in prison for wire fraud and extortion, another 20 years for money laundering-related offenses, and lesser terms on other charges. Renzi and the other defendants are expected to appear at a U.S. Magistrate Court arraignment in Tucson, Arizona, on March 6. Renzi has been under investigation since the FBI raided his family business last year, probing whether he used his office for personal gain. He resigned from the House Intelligence Committee in April following the raid. Renzi, a three-term representative of Arizona's 1st Congressional District, announced in August he would not seek re-election. CNN's Terry Frieden and Deirdre Walsh contributed to this report.

V 35-bodovej obžalobe, odpečatenej v piatok ráno, je 49-ročný Renzi obvinený zo sprisahania, elektronického podvodu, prania špinavých peňazí, vydierania a poistného podvodu. Spoluobvinenými sú aj jeho bývalý obchodný partner, realitný investor James W. Sandlin (56) zo Shermanu v Texase a Andrew Beardall (36) z Rockville v Marylande. Renziho právnici, Reid Weingarten a Kelly Kramer, popreli akékoľvek pochybenie a uviedli: „Budeme bojovať proti týmto obvineniam, až kým nebude očistený a meno jeho rodiny obnovené.“ Vyjadrili sklamanie, že ministerstvo spravodlivosti nedovolilo prejsť viac času po tom, čo Renzi vo štvrtok pochoval svojho otca na Arlingtonskom národnom cintoríne. Na tlačovej konferencii vo Phoenixe prokurátori uviedli, že Renzi so Sandlinom zosnovali dohodu o výmene pozemkov výmenou za Renziho podporu v jednom z výborov Snemovne. Prokurátori tvrdia, že Renzi z obchodu získal 733 000 dolárov, no neuviedol to vo svojom majetkovom priznaní za rok 2005. Federálna prokurátorka Diane Humetewa uviedla, že Renzi využil svoj úrad na zabezpečenie toho, aby do výmeny boli zahrnuté aj Sandlinove pozemky. Obžaloba tvrdí, že cieľom bolo zatajiť Renziho finančný zisk. Podľa obžaloby mal Renzi v roku 2005 finančné problémy a potreboval prostriedky na udržanie svojej poisťovacej spoločnosti a životného štýlu. Obžaloba opisuje sériu transakcií medzi Renzim a Sandlinom, ktorí boli spolumajiteľmi Fountain Realty and Development, kým Renzi nepredal svoj podiel Sandlinovi. Sandlin vyplatil 200 000 dolárov v hotovosti a dohodol sa na zmenke vo výške 800 000 dolárov, pričom v roku 2005 mu ešte dlhoval 700 000 dolárov. Úrady tvrdia, že Renzi trval na tom, aby dve spoločnosti v Arizone odkúpili Sandlinove pozemky výmenou za jeho podporu legislatívy. Renzi a Beardall sú obvinení aj z poistného podvodu, keď mali spreneveriť viac ako 400 000 dolárov z účtu trustu Patriot Insurance Agency, rodinnej firmy Renziovcov, údajne na financovanie Renziho predvolebných kampaní v rokoch 2001 a 2002. Sú tiež obvinení z toho, že poskytli nepravdivé informácie s cieľom ovplyvniť štátne regulačné vyšetrovania. Federálna prokurátorka Humetewa povedala: „Dochádzalo k zatajeniu, skresleniam a k podaným nepravdivým vyhláseniam.“ Prokurátori uviedli, že ak bude uznaný vinným, Renzimu hrozí až 20 rokov väzenia za podvod a vydieranie, ďalších 20 rokov za pranie peňazí a kratšie tresty za ostatné obvinenia. Renzi a ďalší obvinení by sa mali dostaviť na vypočutie na federálnom súde v Tucsone v Arizone 6. marca. Renzi je vyšetrovaný od minulého roka, keď FBI vykonala raziu v rodinnej firme, v súvislosti s možným zneužitím úradu na osobný prospech. Po razii v apríli odstúpil z výboru pre spravodajské služby Snemovne. Renzi, trojnásobne zvolený zástupca arizonského 1. kongresového obvodu, v auguste oznámil, že sa nebude opätovne uchádzať o zvolenie. Na správe sa podieľali aj redaktori CNN Terry Frieden a Deirdre Walsh.

An American couple, Saeid and Parivash Mojabi, have been awarded more than £600,000 by a U.S. court after claiming that their son, Ryan, developed autism following his MMR (measles-mumps-rubella) vaccinations as an infant. The case, brought before the US Court of Federal Claims in 2006, was evaluated under the National Vaccine Injury Compensation Programme—a U.S. government system allowing parents to seek compensation for injuries allegedly caused by mandatory childhood vaccines.

The court determined the family was eligible for damages but did not assign blame to the MMR vaccine for causing Ryan’s autism. This decision is similar to a recent case in Italy where a family received compensation after claiming their child developed autism following the MMR vaccine. While such rulings have sparked renewed debate and provided momentum to anti-MMR campaigns, the majority of the medical community maintains that the vaccine is safe and there is no proven link between MMR vaccinations and autism.

Medical and health authorities, including the UK's Department of Health and NHS doctors, insist the increase in autism diagnoses is due to improved recognition and environmental factors, not vaccines. No British court has found a causal link between the MMR jab and autism.

Testimonies from Ryan's family described changes in his responsiveness and behavior following his first vaccination, including lethargy and inability to sit upright. The awarded damages account for future loss of earnings, recognizing that Ryan may face challenges in employment due to his condition.

In 2008, another high-profile U.S. case awarded damages to Hannah Poling, whose underlying mitochondrial disorder was found to have been aggravated by multiple vaccinations, resulting in autism-like symptoms. In both instances, the courts assessed compensation eligibility but have not established a direct causal link between vaccination and autism.

Prípad bol predložený na Súd federálnych nárokov v roku 2006 a posudzovaný v rámci Národného programu kompenzácie zranení spôsobených očkovaním – vládneho systému v USA, ktorý umožňuje rodičom žiadať o odškodné za údajné zranenia spôsobené povinným detským očkovaním.

Súd rozhodol, že rodina má nárok na odškodnenie, no nepreukázal vinu MMR vakcíny na Ryanovom autizme. Podobné rozhodnutie padlo aj nedávno v Taliansku, kde rodine priznali odškodné po tom, čo tvrdili, že ich dieťa dostalo autizmus po očkovaní MMR. Takéto rozhodnutia vyvolávajú ďalšie diskusie a dávajú impulz odporcom MMR vakcíny, avšak väčšina vedeckej komunity zastáva názor, že vakcína je bezpečná a neexistuje dokázaná súvislosť medzi očkovaním MMR a autizmom.

Zdravotné autority vrátane britského Ministerstva zdravotníctva a lekárov NHS tvrdia, že nárast diagnóz autizmu je dôsledkom lepšieho rozpoznania a vplyvu životného prostredia, nie očkovania. Žiadny britský súd nenašiel príčinnú súvislosť medzi vakcínou MMR a autizmom.

Svedectvá Ryanovej rodiny opisovali zmeny v jeho správaní po prvej očkovacej dávke, vrátane letargie a neschopnosti sedieť vzpriamene. Priznané odškodné zohľadňuje aj budúcu stratu zárobku, keďže Ryan môže mať v dôsledku ochorenia problém nájsť zamestnanie.

V roku 2008 bol v USA priznaný ďalší známy prípad – Hannah Polingovej, ktorej základné mitochondriálne ochorenie sa po viacerých očkovaniach zhoršilo a prejavilo sa autistickými symptómami. Aj v týchto prípadoch boli súdom hodnotené nároky na kompenzáciu, no priamy príčinný vzťah medzi očkovaním a autizmom preukázaný nebol.

Manchester City and Bayern Munich are set to compete for Borussia Dortmund’s star winger, Marco Reus, following the current football season. Although Dortmund have made it clear they won't allow Reus to leave during the January transfer window, they realize a summer exit is likely due to a contract clause enabling his release for £19.5 million. Reus, who is contracted until 2017, has attracted the interest of several leading clubs, including Liverpool and Manchester United, alongside City and Bayern.

Manchester City, led by Manuel Pellegrini, are optimistic about attracting Reus by offering a wage package exceeding £200,000 per week, believing this will top any offers from competitors. While Bayern Munich are ready to match that salary, City's hopes are bolstered by the tense relationship between Bayern and Dortmund, which could make Reus hesitant to join Bayern after former Dortmund stars like Mario Gotze and Robert Lewandowski made similar moves.

Dortmund’s manager Jurgen Klopp has publicly criticized Bayern for their approach to Reus, particularly regarding comments made by Bayern’s chairman Karl-Heinz Rummenigge. With 23 international appearances for Germany and unrelenting interest from top European clubs, Reus’s future is one of the most-watched transfer stories ahead of the summer.

article_content: Oil prices kept dropping on Thursday after OPEC announced a delay to a key policy meeting, signaling disagreements within the bloc. Equity markets were mixed after new US data tempered recent hopes about interest rates. Both main crude benchmarks fell as OPEC and its allies (OPEC+) postponed their meeting by four days to November 30. Oil prices had initially dropped by nearly five percent on Wednesday before rebounding. The delay followed resistance from Angola and Nigeria to proposed production cuts, while Saudi Arabia was considering extending its own cuts into next year. Earlier this year, Saudi Arabia and Russia introduced significant output reductions to counteract weakening demand from slower economic growth in the US, Europe, and China. Pierre Andurand of Andurand Capital Management remarked that global oil supplies are stronger than expected, so additional output cuts may be needed. 'The Saudis will probably want other countries to cut as well—it's going to be a negotiation,' he told Bloomberg TV. Asian share markets fluctuated following a pre-Thanksgiving rally on Wall Street. Hong Kong stocks rallied in the afternoon, led by property developers, after reports that China was preparing more support for the sector and urging banks to increase assistance. Bloomberg News reported that Chinese authorities had prepared a draft list of 50 companies set to receive extra financial support. Country Garden's shares surged over 23 percent after being reported on the list, while Evergrande gained more than three percent. Markets in Shanghai, Seoul, Wellington, Mumbai, and Jakarta rose, but Sydney, Singapore, Taipei, Manila, and Bangkok declined. European markets in London, Frankfurt, and Paris opened higher. The University of Michigan noted that US consumers now expect inflation at 4.5% over the next year, up from 4.4%. Meanwhile, US jobless claims came in much lower than expected, confirming a still-strong labor market. The US Federal Reserve continues to make rate decisions based on economic data, especially on inflation and employment. The new data gave a brief pause to recent bullish sentiment that had followed last week's cooler inflation report—which increased hopes the Fed’s rate hikes were over and cuts could come in 2024. Rodrigo Catril of National Australia Bank said, 'Markets can be capricious sometimes. Investors are looking for signs the Fed is done tightening, so any evidence to the contrary can be unsettling.' Despite some headwinds, optimism remains among analysts. Audrey Goh of Standard Chartered Bank said, 'We do expect the stock market rally to continue. article_content: US corporations are increasing domestic manufacturing. However, fewer 'made-in-China' labels may lead to higher prices for American consumers. This is according to a new JPMorgan paper, which examines how US efforts to reduce supply chain dependence on China could affect consumer prices in the coming years. While these efforts are expected to create US jobs, there is a potential downside. Manufacturing goods in the US is generally more expensive than producing them in China, so shoppers may pay more for American-made clothes, toys, and furniture. According to the report, there is no likely scenario where US-China trade will put similar downward pressure on US inflation as was seen during the 2000s. Still, JPMorgan researchers found that the inflationary impact of reducing business with China will likely be relatively small in the short term—amounting to up to 10-20 basis points, or 0.1-0.2 percentage points, per year through 2032. For example, if annual inflation is 3.0%, it might rise to 3.1% or 3.2%. Strategies like 'friend-shoring,' which means shifting manufacturing and trade to US allies such as Mexico, could help offset some price increases. Since the early 2000s, lower manufacturing costs in countries like China have driven down US prices for items including smartphones, TVs, and computers. Even when US companies manufactured goods domestically, sourcing supplies from overseas helped keep prices in check. Between 2000 and 2010, increased Chinese imports reduced US inflation by about 40 basis points per year, according to JPMorgan researchers, compared to a scenario of slower import growth. Recently, factors such as the COVID-19 pandemic's supply chain disruptions, Russia's invasion of Ukraine, human rights and security concerns in China, and continuing conflict between Israel and Hamas have encouraged US firms to bring supply chains closer to home. According to the Reshoring Initiative—a non-profit that tracks manufacturing data and advocates returning well-paid jobs to the US—364,000 jobs were reshored in the US last year, up 53% from the previous year's record. This includes jobs previously located abroad and new US jobs created by foreign-owned firms. More jobs may be on the way, as US manufacturer construction spending more than doubled between June 2022 and April 2023, according to US Census Bureau data. JPMorgan’s paper notes that higher prices from reshoring could make it more difficult for the Federal Reserve to tame inflation. If the Fed is unable or unwilling to offset the effects of these supply chain changes, inflation could remain higher. Even a modest impact on inflation may be important in the context of the Fed's goal to return inflation to 2%. Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell recently told the Economic Club of New York that inflation is still too high, and several good months aren’t enough to confirm a sustained decline. If the Fed anticipates these pressures and maintains higher interest rates for longer, inflation could be contained, but this comes with trade-offs. Higher interest rates make it harder for many Americans to buy homes or afford car payments. JPMorgan’s report notes that monetary policy could remain tighter for the duration of the supply chain shock.
translated_content: Americké spoločnosti zvyšujú domácu výrobu. Menej označení 'Made in China' však môže viesť k vyšším cenám pre amerických spotrebiteľov. Vyplýva to z novej štúdie JPMorgan, ktorá skúma, ako by snahy USA o zníženie závislosti dodávateľských reťazcov od Číny mohli ovplyvniť ceny v nadchádzajúcich rokoch. Aj keď sa očakáva, že tieto snahy vytvoria pracovné miesta v USA, má to aj svoju nevýhodu. Výroba tovarov v USA je vo všeobecnosti drahšia ako v Číne, takže nakupujúci môžu za americké oblečenie, hračky a nábytok zaplatiť viac. Podľa správy neexistuje pravdepodobný scenár, v ktorom by obchod medzi USA a Čínou vytváral podobný tlak na zníženie inflácie v USA ako v 2000-tych rokoch. Výskumníci JPMorgan však zistili, že inflačný vplyv zníženia obchodu s Čínou bude v krátkodobom horizonte pravdepodobne iba malý – až 10-20 bázických bodov, teda 0,1-0,2 percentuálneho bodu ročne do roku 2032. Napríklad ak by ročná inflácia bola 3,0 %, mohla by sa zvýšiť na 3,1 % alebo 3,2 %. Stratégie ako 'friend-shoring', čo znamená presúvanie výroby a obchodu k spojencom USA, ako je Mexiko, môžu pomôcť zmierniť niektoré cenové tlaky. Od začiatku 2000-tych rokov nižšie náklady na výrobu v krajinách ako Čína znižovali ceny tovarov v USA, vrátane smartfónov, televízorov a počítačov. Aj keď americké firmy vyrábali určité produkty doma, dovoz komponentov zo zahraničia pomáhal udržať nízke ceny. V rokoch 2000 až 2010 zvýšený dovoz z Číny ročne znižoval infláciu v USA približne o 40 bázických bodov, tvrdia výskumníci JPMorgan, v porovnaní s pomalším rastom dovozu. V poslednom čase faktory ako problémy dodávateľských reťazcov počas COVID-19, invázia Ruska na Ukrajinu, obavy o bezpečnosť a ľudské práva v Číne či pokračujúci konflikt medzi Izraelom a Hamasom povzbudili americké firmy, aby presúvali dodávateľské reťazce bližšie domov. Podľa Reshoring Initiative – neziskovej organizácie, ktorá sleduje údaje o výrobe a zasadzujúcej sa za návrat dobre platených pracovných miest do USA – bolo v minulom roku v USA presunutých späť 364 000 pracovných miest, čo je o 53 % viac ako v rekordnom predchádzajúcom roku. Patrili sem pracovné miesta, ktoré sa predtým nachádzali v zahraničí, aj nové pracovné miesta vytvorené v USA zahraničnými firmami. Ďalšie pracovné miesta môžu byť na ceste, keďže výdavky amerických výrobcov na výstavbu sa medzi júnom 2022 a aprílom 2023 viac ako zdvojnásobili, uvádzajú údaje amerického sčítania ľudu. JPMorgan poukazuje, že vyššie ceny v dôsledku presunu výroby môžu Fedu skomplikovať tlmenie inflácie. Ak Fed nebude schopný alebo ochotný vykompenzovať vplyv týchto zmien v dodávateľských reťazcoch, inflácia by mohla zostať vyššia. Aj mierny vplyv na infláciu je dôležitý pre naplnenie cieľa Fedu vrátiť infláciu na 2 %. Šéf Federálneho rezervného systému Jerome Powell nedávno povedal Ekonomickému klubu New Yorku, že inflácia je stále príliš vysoká a pár dobrých mesiacov nestačí na potvrdenie dlhodobého poklesu. Ak Fed počíta s týmito tlakmi a udrží vyššie úrokové sadzby dlhšie, infláciu môže držať na uzde, no má to aj svoju daň. Vyššie úroky spôsobujú, že mnoho Američanov si ťažšie kupuje domy alebo platí za autá. JPMorgan zároveň dodáva, že menová politika môže zostať prísnejšia počas trvania šoku v dodávateľských reťazcoch.

article_content: Philippe Senderos has long endured criticism throughout his career, but since his summer move to Aston Villa, the 29-year-old Swiss international believes he is now playing at his best. Senderos, a centre-back who has represented Switzerland in three World Cups and played in the top leagues of England, Spain, and Italy, struggled with an unfavorable reputation from his early days at Arsenal, where some fans nicknamed him 'Ponderos'. Now at Aston Villa, Senderos has overcome those early judgments and feels he is on top form. He will renew a promising partnership with captain Ron Vlaar in their upcoming match against Queens Park Rangers on Monday night. Senderos says he has learned that the only critique that truly matters is his own. "Every player at our level deserves respect and credit for what they achieve—you can't stay in the Premier League for long without hard work and dedication," Senderos explained. "When I was younger, those criticisms might have affected me, but now I understand my own accomplishments and don't let outside opinions interfere with my performances. It's not about personal pride or needing praise to feel good. I know my strengths, what I must improve, and I always strive to do better." Senderos and Vlaar developed an immediate on-field connection—communicating almost instinctively—and shared a similar mentality off the pitch. Before Vlaar’s injury, Aston Villa conceded just one goal in three matches, demonstrating their defensive strength. Senderos praised Vlaar as one of the top defenders in both the Premier League and at the World Cup, and he looks forward to restoring their partnership. "We clicked from the beginning. Off the pitch, we share the same mindset, and during games, we understand each other without needing to talk much. Ron is among the very best defenders—a top player. We've faced a difficult schedule, but it's essential to remember our strong early-season performances and keep our belief."
translated_content: Philippe Senderos čelil počas celej svojej kariéry kritike, no po letnom prestupe do Aston Villy verí, že momentálne hrá na vrchole svojich síl. Tento 29-ročný švajčiarsky reprezentant, ktorý odohral tri majstrovstvá sveta a pôsobil v najvyšších ligách Anglicka, Španielska a Talianska, mal v raných rokoch v Arsenale negatívnu reputáciu, keď ho niektorí fanúšikovia prezývali 'Ponderos'. V drese Aston Villy však Senderos prekonal tieto predsudky a cíti sa vo vynikajúcej forme. V pondelok večer obnoví s kapitánom Ronom Vlaarom sľubnú stopérsku dvojicu v zápase na pôde Queens Park Rangers. Senderos tvrdí, že si uvedomil, že jediná kritika, na ktorej skutočne záleží, je tá jeho vlastná. "Každý hráč na našej úrovni si zaslúži rešpekt a uznanie za to, čo dosiahol – v Premier League sa nemôžete udržať dlho bez tvrdej práce a odhodlania," vysvetlil Senderos. „Keď som bol mladší, tieto kritiky ma mohli ovplyvniť, ale teraz poznám svoje úspechy a nedovolím, aby názory ostatných ovplyvňovali moje výkony. Nejde o pýchu či potrebu chvály. Viem, v čom som silný, na čom musím pracovať, a stále sa snažím zlepšovať." Senderos a Vlaar si na ihrisku okamžite vytvorili výborné porozumenie, komunikujú takmer inštinktívne a mimo trávnika majú podobné zmýšľanie. Pred Vlaarovým zranením inkasovala Aston Villa len jeden gól v troch zápasoch, čo svedčí o ich defenzívnej sile. Senderos označil Vlaara za jedného z najlepších obrancov v Premier League aj na majstrovstvách sveta a teší sa na obnovu ich spolupráce. "Od začiatku sme si sadli. Mimo ihriska máme rovnaký pohľad na veci a počas zápasov sa chápeme aj bez slov. Ron patrí medzi absolútnu špičku. Mali sme sériu náročných zápasov, no je dôležité pripomínať si naše úspechy z úvodu sezóny a zostať sebavedomí."

article_content: Police seized a truckload of Lego sets from a suburban Melbourne home during a drug raid, according to the Australian Associated Press (AAP). 9News reported that officers raided a property in Melbourne's Botany Ridge area, discovering methamphetamine, two cases of gems, and over 1,100 boxes of Lego valued at approximately $200,000 AUD ($128,000 USD). Detectives stated there was so much Lego that a truck was required to transport it all. “It's not unusual for police to confiscate a variety of items during investigations like this, usually drugs or cash,” Detective Inspector Anthony Vella told AAP. He added that the house functioned as a meth lab capable of significant production. Police believe the Legos and gems were purchased with proceeds of crime. “This is the first time our detectives have confiscated a Lego collection—let alone one so large that it required specific removal arrangements,” Vella said. Authorities arrested a 36-year-old man, who has been charged with drug trafficking, dealing with proceeds of crime, and firearms offenses. A 32-year-old woman was also arrested but not charged. The man is expected to appear in court in February, according to AAP.
translated_content: Polícia zhabala celý kamión Lega počas drogového zásahu v predmestskom dome v Melbourne, informuje agentúra Australian Associated Press (AAP). Podľa 9News policajti zasahovali v oblasti Botany Ridge v Melbourne, kde našli metamfetamín, dva kufre drahokamov a viac ako 1 100 krabíc Lega v hodnote približne 200 000 AUD (128 000 USD). Detektívi uviedli, že Lega bolo toľko, že na jeho odvoz bol potrebný kamión. „Nie je nezvyčajné, že polícia pri vyšetrovaniach zhabáva rozličné predmety, najčastejšie sú to však drogy alebo hotovosť,“ povedal pre AAP detektív inšpektor Anthony Vella. Dodal, že dom slúžil ako laboratórium na výrobu metamfetamínu s vysokou kapacitou. Polícia sa domnieva, že Legá a drahokamy boli kúpené z výnosov trestnej činnosti. „Toto je prvýkrát, čo naši detektívi zhabali zbierku Lega—a ešte takú veľkú, že musela byť odvezená zvlášť,“ uviedol Vella. Zadržaný bol 36-ročný muž, ktorý čelí obvineniam z obchodovania s drogami, z prečinu legalizácie príjmov z trestnej činnosti a zo zločinov spojených so zbraňami. Zadržaná bola aj 32-ročná žena, ktorá však nebola obvinená. Muž by sa mal podľa AAP pred súd postaviť vo februári.

article_content: The Petroleum Tanker Drivers (PTD) group, identifying as part of the Nigeria Union of Petroleum and Natural Gas Workers (NUPENG), has threatened to pull out of the union. The PTD issued an ultimatum, demanding the resignation of NUPENG’s National President, Williams Akporeha, and its General Secretary, Afolabi Olawale. According to a statement signed by Gbenga Olawale and Adekunle Rufai from the PTD Ibadan Depot, issued in Abuja, drivers staged nationwide protests by placing plant leaves in front of their trucks and warning NUPENG and the police against interference and harassment of their leaders. The PTD alleges that Akporeha lacks the necessary qualifications to lead NUPENG, claiming he was not a legitimate union member and had previously been dismissed from an oil company while serving as NUPENG’s national treasurer. They further claim he was later brought into the Petrol Station Workers Union to enable him to run for the NUPENG presidency, in violation of the union's constitution. In response, NUPENG’s General Secretary, Afolabi Olawale, dismissed the claims as false and stated that those making the allegations are not PTD members. Olawale added that these individuals had been arrested in Abuja, following a recent attack on NUPENG leaders, and are currently detained in Kuje prison by court order.

PTD vydalo ultimátum so žiadosťou o odstúpenie národného prezidenta NUPENG Williamsa Akporehu a generálneho tajomníka Afolabiho Olawaleho. Podľa vyhlásenia podpísaného Gbenga Olawale a Adekunle Rufai zo skladu PTD Ibadan, ktoré bolo vydané v Abudži, vodiči v celej krajine protestovali tým, že pred svoje kamióny umiestnili vetvičky a varovali NUPENG a políciu pred zasahovaním a obťažovaním svojich lídrov. PTD tvrdí, že Akporeha nemá potrebné kvalifikácie na vedenie zväzu NUPENG, pričom uvádza, že nebol riadnym členom a počas pôsobenia ako národný pokladník NUPENG bol prepustený z ropnej spoločnosti. Ďalej tvrdia, že bol neskôr zaradený do odboru pracovníkov čerpacích staníc NUPENG-u, aby mohol kandidovať na prezidenta, čo je podľa nich v rozpore so stanovami zväzu. Generálny tajomník NUPENG Afolabi Olawale reagoval, že tieto tvrdenia sú nepravdivé a že tí, ktorí ich šíria, nie sú členmi PTD. Dodal, že tieto osoby boli v Abudži zatknuté po nedávnom útoku na lídrov NUPENG-u a momentálne sú na základe rozhodnutia súdu zadržané vo väznici Kuje.

article_content:
Texas Hill Country will uniquely experience two major solar eclipses in less than six months: an annular (“ring of fire”) eclipse on October 14, 2023, and a total solar eclipse on April 8, 2024. The 'ring of fire' eclipse will trace a 125-mile-wide path through the region between 11:41 a.m. and 12:00 p.m. CDT, offering a partial eclipse on either side of its peak. Areas including West Texas, San Antonio, Corpus Christi, Padre Island National Seashore, and especially the hills and vineyards of Texas Hill Country will witness these rare astronomical events.

Nearly half a year after the October event, towns such as Kerrville, Bandera, Uvalde, Vanderpool, Junction, and Rocksprings will see the sun completely hidden by the moon during the April 2024 total solar eclipse. Such a double occurrence in the same area within a short time span is incredibly rare—total eclipses happen about once every 400 years at any given location. Texas Hill Country also has some of the best chances for clear skies, increasing the likelihood of excellent viewing, according to meteorologist Jay Anderson at Eclipsophile.com.

NASA will provide a live stream from Kerrville for both eclipses. Junction and Kerrville, especially, have strong prospects for clear skies. Visitor numbers are expected to surge, with up to 50,000 anticipated in October and over 100,000 in April, according to MySanAntonio. The 120-mile-wide eclipse paths intersect in Texas Hill Country, creating about 14,000 square miles of prime viewing area.

A range of festivals and events will mark these celestial occasions, featuring lectures, eclipse viewing, music, cultural festivities, food, and activities for all ages:

1. Solar Eclipse Village, Uvalde: Science programming, guided viewing, astrophotography, stargazing, and expert talks during the “ring of fire” on October 14 and a preview of April’s total eclipse.
2. Kerrville River Festival: Free family activities, music, vendors, NASA live stream, and camping both in October and April.
3. TexEclipse PreParty & TexEclipse Music Festival, Junction: Chili-themed contests and music for October, with a larger festival in April.

article_content: A California mother has been arrested after allegedly leaving her two young daughters inside a locked car while she visited a casino. Phaley Nget, 37, from Oakland, is facing child endangerment charges after police found her daughters, aged 2 and 3, unattended inside her car parked across the street from Casino 580 in Livermore. The children were reportedly left alone in the 75-degree heat for about 30 minutes before a passerby noticed and called authorities. Officers said the temperature inside the vehicle had risen above 81 degrees. According to Officer Traci Rebiejo of the Livermore Police Department, one of the children was crying when officers arrived. Nget had parked her car in the shade, partially cracked the windows, and covered them with blankets, possibly to hide the children from view or to limit the heat inside the car. Police located Nget inside the casino's card room, where she was arrested and taken to Santa Rita County Jail. Casino patron Jessica Guerrero told local news that she recognized Nget, saying she is a frequent gambler at the casino. Guerrero commented, 'I wouldn't even leave my dog in the car for 10 minutes out here, let alone my kids.' Nget is being held on $200,000 bail. The children were unharmed and have been placed in protective custody.

Deti boli podľa správ ponechané samy v aute v 24-stupňovom teple asi 30 minút, než si ich všimol okoloidúci a privolal políciu.
