article_content: Seventeen-year-old Mikaela Peters from Queensland's Sunshine Coast had to leave school due to severe reactive arthritis. Unable to attend her high school formal—a meaningful event for many—she listed her beloved dress for sale on a local Facebook page, as keeping it was too painful a reminder. Photographer and teacher Katie Barnett saw Mikaela's post and was moved by her story. Katie reached out and offered Mikaela a free photo shoot so she could experience wearing her dream dress and enjoy a special day. Katie didn't just take professional photos; she also paid for a makeup artist to help Mikaela feel her best. They spent a whole day together, capturing over 90 photos and creating uplifting memories. Mikaela also wore her sister Krystie’s 21st birthday dress during the shoot to express gratitude. Krystie, a paramedic, has been a strong support, and Mikaela hopes to pursue the same career. Katie said helping Mikaela reinforced her belief in the power of kindness and the importance of encouraging young people to keep striving towards their goals. When Mikaela received her photos after leaving the hospital, it lifted her spirits, and as her story spread, community members offered further support, including wellness and pain management help. Rather than selling her dress, Mikaela now treasures it as a reminder of generosity and positive memories. Both Mikaela and Katie highlight how acts of kindness can bring comfort and hope amidst hardship.

In a frank and direct warning, President Joe Biden urged Israel not to repeat the mistakes made by the United States after the September 11 attacks. Speaking in Tel Aviv on Wednesday following Hamas's deadly assault on Israeli civilians, Biden cautioned Israeli leaders to avoid acting out of anger and called for thoughtful, deliberate action in the ongoing conflict.

"Justice must be done," Biden said during his televised address. "But while you feel that rage, don't be consumed by it. After 9/11, we in the United States were enraged. While we sought and achieved justice, we also made mistakes."

Biden recounted his own experience making difficult wartime decisions, acknowledging the heavy costs and the need for clarity around goals and strategies.

According to Reuters, Biden has long been critical of the U.S. military's prolonged presence in Afghanistan, opposing extended engagement during President Obama's administration. After ordering the withdrawal of U.S. troops in 2021, Biden stated, "I will not send another generation of Americans to war in Afghanistan with no reasonable expectation of achieving a different outcome."

The U.S. "War on Terror" expanded beyond Afghanistan, notably to Iraq in 2003. The Bush administration's rationale for invading Iraq—allegations of weapons of mass destruction—was later disproven. Although the initial invasion was swift, it was followed by years of violent insurgency, resulting in an estimated 300,000 deaths, including 4,599 American troops, and intensifying instability in the region.

Israel's current conflict with Gaza began after Hamas militants launched a deadly attack on Israeli communities earlier this month, killing thousands and taking more than 100 hostages, including women, children, and the elderly. In response, Israel has launched intensive airstrikes on Gaza, resulting in the deaths of at least 3,300 Palestinians and widespread destruction of homes and mosques.

On Tuesday, a powerful explosion struck a hospital in Gaza City, killing hundreds of people. Both Israeli and Palestinian representatives have blamed each other for the incident.

article_content: For the first time in 13 years, the global music industry saw a rise in revenue, helped by British artists Adele, One Direction, and Mumford & Sons, all winners at the Brit Awards. Global music sales grew by 0.3% in 2012, reaching £10.9 billion ($16.5 billion), according to the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry (IFPI), which represents 1,400 record companies worldwide. The industry had experienced a more than 40% decline in revenue since its 1999 peak due to widespread internet piracy, so this increase is notable. Adele's album '21' sold 8.3 million copies worldwide, topping the global album sales chart for the second straight year. One Direction's albums 'Up All Night' and 'Take Me Home' ranked third and fourth globally, each selling over 4 million copies, and Mumford & Sons' 'Babel' sold 2.3 million. Other leading albums included Taylor Swift's 'Red' (5.2 million), Lana Del Rey's 'Born To Die' (3.4 million), Rod Stewart's 'Merry Christmas Baby' (2.6 million), Rihanna's 'Unapologetic' (2.3 million), and Maroon 5's 'Overexposed' (2.2 million). Digital downloads and new revenue streams have begun to offset the decline in CD sales. Digital revenue rose by 9% in 2012, making up 34% of total industry income. Across the world, 4.3 billion songs and albums were downloaded in 2012. Streaming services like Spotify and Rhapsody grew by 44%, reaching a total of 20 million users. Carly Rae Jepsen's 'Call Me Maybe' was the best-selling single of 2012, followed by Gotye's 'Somebody I Used To Know' and Psy's 'Gangnam Style', the first YouTube video to reach one billion views. Despite digital growth, the physical market—including vinyl and CDs—continued to shrink, losing $500 million in revenue from 2011 to 2012. Physical sales still account for most global music income. Illegal downloads remain a serious challenge, with around 32% of internet users estimated to download pirated music regularly. Piracy is especially significant in markets like Russia, India, and China. IFPI and industry leaders, such as CEO Frances Moore, urge governments to act against illegal download sites like Megaupload and The Pirate Bay. Industry experts caution that the modest increase may not guarantee a full recovery, as many consumers have shifted to free platforms like YouTube and internet radio. There is hope for a stable but smaller industry centered on dedicated fans, but a complete return to previous revenue highs appears unlikely.

Celosvetový predaj hudby vzrástol v roku 2012 o 0,3 % na 10,9 miliardy libier (16,5 miliardy dolárov), uvádza Medzinárodná federácia fonografického priemyslu (IFPI), ktorá zastupuje 1400 nahrávacích spoločností po celom svete. Priemysel zažil viac ako 40% pokles príjmov od svojho vrcholu v roku 1999 kvôli rozšírenému internetovému pirátstvu, takže tento nárast je významný. Album Adele '21' sa predal v počte 8,3 milióna kópií po celom svete a už druhý rok po sebe kraľoval globálnym rebríčkom predaja albumov. Albumy One Direction 'Up All Night' a 'Take Me Home' sa umiestnili na treťom a štvrtom mieste na svete, každý s viac ako 4 miliónmi predaných kusov, a 'Babel' od Mumford & Sons sa predal v počte 2,3 milióna. Medzi ďalšie popredné albumy patrili 'Red' od Taylor Swift (5,2 milióna), 'Born To Die' od Lany Del Rey (3,4 milióna), 'Merry Christmas Baby' od Roda Stewarta (2,6 milióna), 'Unapologetic' od Rihanny (2,3 milióna) a 'Overexposed' od Maroon 5 (2,2 milióna). Digitálne sťahovanie a nové zdroje príjmov začali kompenzovať pokles predaja CD. Digitálne príjmy vzrástli v roku 2012 o 9 % a predstavujú 34 % celkového priemyselného zisku. Celosvetovo bolo v roku 2012 stiahnutých 4,3 miliardy skladieb a albumov. Streamovacie služby ako Spotify a Rhapsody vzrástli o 44 % na celkových 20 miliónov používateľov. 'Call Me Maybe' od Carly Rae Jepsen bola najpredávanejšou skladbou roku 2012, nasledovaná 'Somebody I Used To Know' od Gotyeho a 'Gangnam Style' od Psy, ktorý sa stal prvým videom na YouTube s miliardou zhliadnutí. Napriek digitálnemu rastu sa fyzický trh – vrátane vinylov a CD – naďalej zmenšoval a medzi rokmi 2011 a 2012 prišiel o 500 miliónov dolárov v príjmoch. Predaj fyzických nosičov stále tvorí väčšinu celosvetových hudobných príjmov. Nelegálne sťahovanie zostáva vážnym problémom – odhaduje sa, že približne 32 % používateľov internetu pravidelne sťahuje pirátsku hudbu. Pirátstvo je výrazné najmä na trhoch ako Rusko, India a Čína. IFPI a lídri v odvetví, ako generálna riaditeľka Frances Moore, vyzývajú vlády, aby zakročili voči stránkam na nelegálne sťahovanie, ako sú Megaupload a The Pirate Bay. Odborníci z hudobnej branže upozorňujú, že mierny nárast neznamená zaručené oživenie, keďže mnohí poslucháči prešli na bezplatné platformy ako YouTube a internetové rádio. Nádej ostáva pre stabilnejší, no menší priemysel sústredený na oddaných fanúšikov, no úplný návrat k niekdajším maximám príjmov sa zdá nepravdepodobný.

article_content: The United Auto Workers (UAW) has reached a tentative contract agreement with General Motors, marking deals with all three major Detroit automakers more than six weeks into a historic strike. "The UAW has secured a historic tentative agreement with General Motors that ensures a just transition and delivers record economic gains for autoworkers," the union said in a statement. These tentative agreements with GM, Stellantis (the parent company of Chrysler), and Ford still require ratification by union members. Workers retain the right to reject the deals and send negotiators back to the table. The GM agreement closely resembles recent contracts with Ford and Stellantis. All stipulate at least a 25% wage increase for employees, cost-of-living adjustments, and higher retirement contributions. The Stellantis deal also includes reopening the previously idled Belvidere, Illinois plant, a key union goal. "GM is pleased to have reached a tentative agreement with the UAW that recognizes the team's contributions while allowing us to continue investing in our future and providing quality jobs in the U.S.," said GM Chair and CEO Mary Barra. General Motors, the last of the Big Three automakers to settle, faced mounting pressure as the strike expanded, including walkouts at its crucial Spring Hill plant in Tennessee. The plant’s closure threatened broad disruptions as it supplies engines to other facilities. These agreements point to a potential end for an intense six-week strike, during which the union sought to reclaim ground lost in previous years, while automakers posted record profits and prepared for a shift toward electric vehicles. However, ratification is not guaranteed. UAW members can vote to reject the contracts. Recently, a tentative agreement with Mack Trucks (not part of the Big Three) was turned down by 73% of union members, forcing renewed talks. While UAW leadership has fully released the terms of the Ford deal, workers at Stellantis and GM still await detailed information. Individual workers exhibit mixed reactions. Kyle Bendert, a Ford worker, is tentatively in favor of the new contract, primarily due to wage gains, but he wished for more paid vacation and notes that some colleagues remain unsatisfied. 'Many people seem unimpressed and are willing to go back to the picket line,' he observes. 'I'll probably vote yes, but I wouldn't be upset if the majority voted no.' Conversely, Brandon Bell, another Ford employee, feels the agreement is 'life-changing,' as it would more than double his pay by the end of the contract period. 'My family won't have to struggle. I'll be able to provide,' he said, recalling he was brought to tears when he first heard the details. The strike, lasting over six weeks, was challenging for many, but some workers say the outcome may have been worth the effort.

Tieto predbežné dohody so spoločnosťami GM, Stellantis (materská spoločnosť Chrysleru) a Ford ešte musia ratifikovať odborárski členovia. Pracovníci majú právo dohody odmietnuť a vyslať vyjednávačov späť k rokovaniam. Dohoda s GM úzko kopíruje nedávne zmluvy s Fordom a Stellantis. Dohoda so Stellantis navyše zahŕňa opätovné otvorenie továrne v Belvidere v štáte Illinois, čo bolo kľúčovou požiadavkou odborov. "GM s potešením oznamuje, že dosiahli predbežnú dohodu s UAW, ktorá oceňuje prínos tímu a umožní nám pokračovať v investovaní do našej budúcnosti a poskytovaní kvalitných pracovných miest v USA," uviedla predsedníčka a generálna riaditeľka GM Mary Barra. General Motors, ako posledná z veľkej trojky automobiliek, čelila rastúcemu tlaku, keď sa štrajk rozširoval vrátane odchodu zamestnancov v kľúčovej továrni Spring Hill v Tennessee. Tieto dohody signalizujú možný koniec intenzívneho šesťtýždňového štrajku, počas ktorého sa odbory snažili získať späť straty z minulých rokov, zatiaľ čo automobilky hlásili rekordné zisky a pripravovali sa na prechod k elektromobilom. Ratifikácia dohôd však nie je zaručená. Členovia UAW môžu zmluvy odmietnuť v hlasovaní. Prednedávnom bola predbežná dohoda s Mack Trucks (nie súčasť Veľkej trojky) odmietnutá 73 % členskej základne, čo viedlo k pokračujúcim rokovaniam. Kým vedenie odborov úplne zverejnilo podmienky dohody s Fordom, pracovníci Stellantisu a GM na detaily stále čakajú. Reakcie zamestnancov sú rôznorodé. 'Mnohí sú neimponovaní a ochotní vrátiť sa na štrajkovú čiaru,' hovorí. 'Asi budem hlasovať za, no nebol by som nahnevaný, ak by väčšina hlasovala proti.' Naopak, Brandon Bell, ďalší zamestnanec Fordu, považuje dohodu za „život meniacu“, pretože mu do konca platnosti zmluvy viac než zdvojnásobí plat. „Moja rodina nebude musieť zápasiť. Budem sa môcť postarať,“ povedal. Keď sa rozhodol pri prvom vypočutí detailov, rozplakal sa. Šesťtýždňový štrajk bol pre mnohých náročný, no podľa niektorých pracovníkov sa výsledok oplatil.

article_content: James Woodard, a man exonerated after serving 27 years in prison for a crime he did not commit, has passed away after being re-arrested and imprisoned two months ago. Woodard, 60, was freed in Dallas in April 2008, after DNA evidence confirmed he was not responsible for the 1980 rape and murder of his girlfriend, Beverly Jones. During his imprisonment, Woodard always maintained his innocence and was denied parole 12 times. He was returned to jail in August following an arrest for alleged cocaine possession, with police reporting several outstanding warrants. This weekend, Woodard, who suffered from seizures, was taken from Dallas County Jail to Parkland Hospital, where he died. Cory Session, policy director for the Innocence Project of Texas, told Dallas News, 'It’s a loss that we can’t get back and we will definitely miss him.' He added, 'The impact that he left will overshadow anything in his life.' Woodard was released from prison after the Innocence Project re-examined his case. His conviction was overturned after DNA testing showed he did not commit the 1980 murder, making his time served the longest by a Dallas County prisoner before exoneration. After his release, Woodard donated $100,000 from his state compensation to the Innocence Project of Texas to aid in identifying other wrongful convictions. The Dallas County Jail is investigating the circumstances of Woodard's death, and an autopsy was scheduled for Wednesday. Funeral arrangements are pending. Woodard was originally sentenced to life at age 28 for the rape and murder of his girlfriend. The conviction was obtained by prosecutor Henry Wade, known for his tough approach, whose practices have been reviewed critically in recent years after DNA evidence led to at least 15 exonerations. The Innocence Project of Texas is currently re-examining 250 potential wrongful conviction cases.

Woodard (60) bol prepustený v Dallase v apríli 2008, keď DNA dôkazy potvrdili, že nenesie vinu za znásilnenie a vraždu svojej priateľky Beverly Jones v roku 1980. The Innocence Project of Texas v súčasnosti opätovne skúma 250 potenciálnych prípadov nespravodlivých odsúdení.

article_content:
Elon Musk's social media network X, formerly known as Twitter, has initiated a legal case against Media Matters for America, a progressive watchdog group. The lawsuit accuses Media Matters of deliberately crafting a report that places prominent brands' ads next to extremist content like neo-Nazi and white nationalist posts, allegedly to discourage advertisers from working with X and damage the company. Media Matters, based in Washington, D.C., calls the suit without merit.

Following the release of this report, large advertisers such as IBM, NBCUniversal, and Comcast withdrew their advertising from X, citing concerns over their ads appearing near hateful material. The report also referenced ad placements from Apple, Oracle, Amazon, NBA Mexico, and other brands alongside antisemitic or white nationalist content.

X, which is headquartered in San Francisco, contends in its complaint that Media Matters manipulated the platform by creating user accounts that specifically followed creators of extreme content as well as major advertisers. According to X, this artificial arrangement resulted in unusually rare cases where ads would show up next to offensive material. The company alleges Media Matters then captured these moments as evidence for its report, presenting them as a typical experience on X.

Media Matters maintains confidence in its findings and says it expects to succeed in court. Angelo Carusone, the group’s president, insists the lawsuit is an intimidation tactic against critics. At the same time, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has announced his office will investigate Media Matters for potential fraud associated with its report.

Since Musk’s takeover more than a year ago, X has faced apprehension from advertisers about their ads appearing alongside hate speech. This situation has intensified after Musk responded publicly to an antisemitic comment, backing the statement, which drew significant backlash. Since then, the platform's content moderation practices have faced even more scrutiny, particularly amid the conflict between Israel and Hamas.

Linda Yaccarino, X’s CEO, reiterated that the company firmly opposes all forms of discrimination, stating in a recent message that everyone should reject such behavior.

Media Matters, so sídlom vo Washingtone, D.C., označuje žalobu za neopodstatnenú.

Po zverejnení tejto správy veľkí inzerenti ako IBM, NBCUniversal a Comcast stiahli svoje reklamy z X pre obavy, že sa ich reklamy zobrazujú v blízkosti nenávistného obsahu. Správa spomenula aj reklamy od Apple, Oracle, Amazonu, NBA Mexico a ďalších značiek pri antisemitskom alebo nacionalistickom obsahu.

Spoločnosť X so sídlom v San Franciscu tvrdí vo svojej žalobe, že Media Matters manipulovala platformu vytváraním účtov, ktoré špeciálne sledovali tvorcov extrémneho obsahu aj hlavné značky inzerentov. Podľa X toto umelé nastavenie spôsobilo veľmi zriedkavé situácie, keď sa reklamy zobrazili vedľa urážlivého materiálu. Media Matters si stojí za svojou správou a tvrdí, že očakáva úspech na súde. Prezident skupiny Angelo Carusone sa domnieva, že žaloba má za cieľ zastrašiť kritikov. Súčasne generálny prokurátor Texasu Ken Paxton vyhlásil, že jeho úrad začne vyšetrovanie Media Matters kvôli podozreniu z podvodu súvisiaceho so správou.

Od Muskovej kúpy platformy pred viac ako rokom sú inzerenti opatrní, lebo sa obávajú, že sa ich reklamy objavia vedľa nenávistného obsahu. Situácia eskalovala po tom, čo Musk verejne reagoval na antisemitský komentár a podporil dané tvrdenie, čo vyvolalo značnú kritiku. Odvtedy je správa obsahu na X pod zvýšenou kontrolou, najmä počas prebiehajúceho konfliktu medzi Izraelom a Hamasom.

Výkonná riaditeľka X Linda Yaccarino zopakovala, že spoločnosť rozhodne odmieta akúkoľvek formu diskriminácie a v nedávnom príspevku uviedla, že s týmto by mal každý súhlasiť.

article_content: All Arts, the arts-focused streaming platform and channel, is premiering a new documentary about the Manhattan Theatre Club (MTC), a renowned New York-based theater-producing company. The film, titled 'Manhattan Theatre Club, a Home for Artists,' traces MTC’s 50-year legacy under artistic director Lynne Meadow and executive producer Barry Grove, who together transformed the organization. Founded in 1970, MTC appointed Meadow as its artistic leader in 1972 and Grove joined as managing director in 1974. Over their five decades of stewardship, MTC evolved from a small off-off-Broadway showcase to a prominent multi-venue nonprofit, producing over 600 premieres—ranging from world and American to New York and Broadway debuts. The theater’s acclaimed productions have been honored with several major awards, including seven Pulitzer Prizes, 28 Tony Awards, 50 Drama Desk Awards, and 49 Obie Awards. MTC’s venues include the Samuel J. Friedman Theatre on Broadway and its off-Broadway home at New York City Center. The documentary features interviews with prominent performers, playwrights, directors, and theater experts such as David Auburn, Christine Baranski, Ben Brantley, John Lee Beatty, André De Shields, Brandon J. Dirden, Edie Falco, Jessica Hecht, David Hodgson, Judith Light, Laura Linney, Santo Loquasto, Joe Mantello, Jerry Mitchell, Mary-Louise Parker, Sarah Jessica Parker, David Hyde Pierce, Ruben Santiago-Hudson, John Patrick Shanley, Daniel Sullivan, Richard Wesley, Sam Waterston, and Whitney White. 'Through their stewardship of Manhattan Theatre Club, Lynne Meadow and Barry Grove have left an indelible mark on the theatrical landscape for decades to come,' said Joe Harrell, executive producer at All Arts. 'Their story champions the vital role of non-profit theaters in allowing artists to take risks, explore innovative ideas, and challenge conventions.'

Film s názvom „Manhattan Theatre Club, domov pre umelcov“ mapuje 50-ročnú históriu MTC pod vedením umeleckej riaditeľky Lynne Meadow a výkonného producenta Barryho Grovea, ktorí spoločne organizáciu premenili. article_content: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami has stated that the proposed Uniform Civil Code (UCC) in the hill state is not intended to appease or target any community, but is aimed at empowering all sections of society. Speaking to the media in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, after attending a programme by the Uttarakhand Sanskritik Sanstha, Dhami reaffirmed that the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is committed to implementing the UCC in Uttarakhand, and that the public has shown electoral support for this promise. Dhami suggested that those who governed the country for long through appeasement policies are now spreading doubts about the UCC among the people of Uttarakhand. He emphasized that the purpose of the UCC is not to favor one group or disadvantage another. The code is meant for the empowerment of all, and existing reservations, marital rights, and customs will not be affected by its implementation. A government-appointed committee led by retired Supreme Court judge Ranjana Prakash Desai has collected suggestions from 234,000 people and has directly met with 20,000 individuals from various backgrounds over the past one and a half years. Dhami said the committee is compiling these suggestions, after which the process to implement the UCC will continue through necessary formalities. Article 44 of the Indian Constitution recommends that the state should strive for a Uniform Civil Code for all citizens throughout India. The UCC aims to establish a common set of personal laws for people regardless of religion. Praising Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government, Dhami stated that people desire a 'double engine' government, meaning BJP leadership both at the Centre and in the state. Dhami expressed confidence that the BJP will secure a clear majority in the upcoming Madhya Pradesh assembly polls on November 17, maintaining its 'double-engine' government in the state.

Pri rozhovore s médiami v Indore, štát Madhjapradéš, po účasti na podujatí Uttarakhand Sanskritik Sanstha, Dhami potvrdil, že vládna strana Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) je odhodlaná implementovať UCC v Uttarakhandu a verejnosť tomuto sľubu vyjadrila volebnú podporu. Dhami naznačil, že tí, ktorí krajinu riadili dlhý čas prostredníctvom politiky upokojovania, teraz šíria pochybnosti o UCC medzi obyvateľmi Uttarakhandu. Zdôraznil, že cieľom UCC nie je zvýhodniť jednu skupinu alebo poškodiť inú. Tento kódex má posilniť všetkých a jeho zavedenie sa nedotkne existujúcich rezervácií, manželských práv ani zvykov. Článok 44 indickej ústavy odporúča, aby štát usiloval o jednotný občiansky zákonník pre všetkých občanov Indie. UCC má priniesť spoločný súbor osobných zákonov pre ľudí bez ohľadu na náboženstvo. article_content: Nineteen people were arrested in Dinkytown, Minneapolis, after crowds filled the streets following the Minnesota Gophers' loss to Union College in the NCAA men's hockey championship. Union College defeated Minnesota 7-4 Saturday at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia. After the game, large groups gathered in Dinkytown, near the University of Minnesota campus. According to police, two cases of arson were reported, along with undetermined property damage. Officers worked to control the disruptive crowd. No injuries to law enforcement were reported. Authorities had anticipated possible unrest after Saturday's match. Police used zip ties, nonlethal weapons, tear gas, pepper spray, and rubber pellets as mounted patrols and helicopters monitored the scene. Crowds chanted, jumped, and in some cases threw rocks and bottles at officers. Some individuals lay down in intersections while others climbed light poles and jumped on police cars. On both Thursday and Saturday nights, disturbances broke out in Dinkytown following Gopher hockey games. Police in riot gear intervened, and a State Patrol helicopter illuminated the area. Several arrests were made, and some property was damaged. University officials, including President Eric Kaler, expressed disappointment over the disturbances, calling such actions unacceptable. In a message to students, Kaler stated that any further misbehavior would not be tolerated.
translated_content: Devätnásť ľudí bolo zatknutých v Dinkytowne v Minneapolise po tom, čo sa davy zhromaždili na uliciach po prehre Minnesota Gophers s Union College vo finále mužského hokejového šampionátu NCAA. Union College porazila Minnesotu 7:4 v sobotu vo Wells Fargo Centre vo Philadelphii. Po zápase sa vo veľkom počte stretli ľudia v Dinkytowne, blízko kampusu University of Minnesota. Podľa polície boli nahlásené dva prípady podpaľačstva, spolu s nešpecifikovanými škodami na majetku. Policajti sa snažili zvládnuť rušný dav. O zraneniach v radoch bezpečnostných zložiek neinformovali. Úrady predpokladali možné nepokoje po sobotňajšom zápase. Polícia použila plastové putá, neletálne zbrane, slzný plyn, koreninový sprej a gumové projektily, pričom situáciu monitorovali aj hliadky na koňoch a vrtuľníky. Davy skandovali, poskakovali, v niektorých prípadoch hádzali kamene a fľaše na policajtov. Niektorí ležali na križovatkách, iní liezli na stĺpy verejného osvetlenia a skákali na policajné autá. Nepokoje v Dinkytowne nasledovali po štvrtkových aj sobotňajších zápasoch hokejového tímu Gophers. Zasahovali tam policajti v ochranných oblekoch a situáciu osvetľoval aj vrtuľník štátnej polície. Niekoľko ľudí bolo zadržaných a došlo k poškodeniu majetku. Predstavitelia univerzity vrátane prezidenta Erica Kalera vyjadrili nad udalosťami sklamanie a označili takéto správanie za neprijateľné. Kaler v odkaze študentom uviedol, že ďalšie podobné incidenty nebudú tolerované.

article_content: A 13-year-old girl from Texas, Lydia Christine Kizziar of Carrollton, has died from influenza, bringing the number of swine flu (H1N1) deaths in Dallas County this season to 17. Lydia, a seventh grader, passed away on Saturday. Her younger sister, Katie, is currently hospitalized with the same illness. This situation reflects a wider outbreak, as Texas—along with much of the Southern United States—faces a particularly severe flu season. Health officials report a steep rise in infections and deaths, with the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) cautioning that the peak of flu season may not yet have arrived. "It's too early to tell how severe it's going to be, but we're still on the upslope of the flu season. What we can expect is more flu, more intense disease, and more deaths over the next few weeks," said Dr. Joe Bresee of the CDC’s influenza division. Flu season in the US typically lasts from October to April, often peaking in January or February. In Dallas County alone, 17 flu-related deaths have been reported since September. By Tuesday, officials confirmed 19 flu deaths across Dallas and Denton counties combined. Other regions in Texas and the Southern states have also been impacted, with 13 deaths reported in Houston, 13 in North Carolina, and 9 in South Carolina since September. While young children and the elderly are usually most vulnerable to influenza, the Garland Health Department in Texas reported that two recent deaths involved patients under 50 with no prior health issues. The predominant flu strain this season is H1N1, commonly known as swine flu—the same strain responsible for the 2009-2010 pandemic. Despite the availability of a vaccine that covers H1N1 and other strains, many people have yet to be vaccinated. CDC data show that the flu has claimed the lives of six children in the United States so far this season. Experts urge those who have not yet received the flu shot to do so. A memorial fund has been set up on youcaring.com to help Lydia Kizziar’s family with funeral and medical expenses, as her parents are currently unemployed and her younger sister remains hospitalized.
translated_content: 13-ročné dievča z Texasu, Lydia Christine Kizziar z Carrolltonu, zomrelo na chrípku, čím sa počet úmrtí na prasaciu chrípku (H1N1) v okrese Dallas v tejto sezóne zvýšil na 17. Lydia, žiačka siedmeho ročníka, zomrela v sobotu. Jej mladšia sestra Katie je momentálne v nemocnici s rovnakým ochorením. Táto situácia odráža širšiu epidémiu, keďže Texas a veľká časť južných štátov USA čelí mimoriadne vážnej chrípkovej sezóne. Zdravotnícke úrady hlásia prudký nárast infekcií a úmrtí a Centrum pre kontrolu a prevenciu chorôb (CDC) varuje, že vrchol chrípkovej sezóny ešte len príde. "Je príliš skoro povedať, aká bude situácia vážna, ale stále sme na vzostupe chrípkovej sezóny. Očakávame viac chrípky, závažnejší priebeh a viac úmrtí v nasledujúcich týždňoch," povedal Dr. Joe Bresee z chrípkového oddelenia CDC. Chrípková sezóna v USA zvyčajne trvá od októbra do apríla, pričom vrcholí v januári alebo februári. Len v okrese Dallas bolo od septembra hlásených 17 úmrtí súvisiacich s chrípkou. Do utorka úrady potvrdili celkovo 19 úmrtí v okresoch Dallas a Denton dokopy. Aj ďalšie oblasti Texasu a južných štátov boli zasiahnuté – v Houstone hlásili 13 úmrtí, v Severnej Karolíne ďalších 13 a v Južnej Karolíne 9 úmrtí od septembra. Kým malé deti a starší ľudia sú zvyčajne najzraniteľnejší, zdravotnícke oddelenie v Garlande (Texas) informovalo, že dve nedávne úmrtia sa týkali pacientov mladších ako 50 rokov bez predchádzajúcich zdravotných problémov. Najrozšírenejší typ chrípky túto sezónu je H1N1, známy ako prasacia chrípka – rovnaký vírus, ktorý spôsobil pandémiu v rokoch 2009-2010. Napriek dostupnosti vakcíny, ktorá chráni aj proti H1N1, mnohí ešte nie sú zaočkovaní. Podľa údajov CDC chrípka v tejto sezóne stála život šiestich detí v Spojených štátoch. Odborníci vyzývajú všetkých, ktorí ešte neboli zaočkovaní, aby tak urobili. Na stránke youcaring.com bol zriadený pamätný fond na pomoc rodine Lydie Kizziarovej s pohrebnými a zdravotníckymi nákladmi, keďže jej rodičia sú momentálne nezamestnaní a mladšia sestra zostáva v nemocnici.

article_content: A British aerospace engineer and his family, killed in the French Alps, are thought by investigators to likely have been the victims of a lone, psychologically disturbed assailant. Saad al-Hilli from Surrey, his wife Iqbal, her mother Suhaila al-Hilli, and French cyclist Sylvain Mollier were fatally shot in an isolated lay-by near the village of Chevaline, close to Lake Annecy, in September. The motive for the killings remains unclear. Initial theories, such as contract killing or a family dispute, are now being treated as less likely. Prosecutor Eric Maillaud, leading the probe, has stated the investigation is focusing on people with access to firearms—particularly hunters, collectors, and shooting club members who have psychiatric histories. Experts have noted the gun used was an antique Luger pistol, a rare collector’s item issued to the Swiss army before World War I, making it an uncommon choice for a contract killer. Saad al-Hilli's daughters, Zainab and Zeena, survived the attack. No DNA evidence was found, but shell casings were recovered. Police have checked psychiatric hospitals and are reviewing gun club memberships, focusing on those with past convictions related to gun violence or an interest in firearms. Investigators are largely discounting the family feud theory as well as the notion that the French cyclist was the main target. The case remains complex, and authorities expect a prolonged investigation, with the motive and perpetrator still unknown.

Saad al-Hilli zo Surrey, jeho manželka Iqbal, jej matka Suhaila al-Hilli a francúzsky cyklista Sylvain Mollier boli v septembri smrteľne postrelení na odľahlej odpočívacej ploche neďaleko dediny Chevaline, blízko jazera Annecy. Motív vrážd zostáva nejasný. Pôvodné teórie, ako napríklad nájomná vražda alebo rodinný spor, sú teraz menej pravdepodobné. Prokurátor Eric Maillaud, ktorý vedie vyšetrovanie, uviedol, že zameranie je na osoby s prístupom k strelným zbraniam—najmä poľovníkov, zberateľov a členov streleckých klubov s psychickými problémami. Odborníci upozornili, že použitá zbraň bola antikvárna pištoľ Luger, vzácny zberateľský kus vydaný švajčiarskou armádou pred prvou svetovou vojnou, čo je neobvyklá voľba pre nájomného vraha. Dcérky Saada al-Hilliho, Zainab a Zeena, útok prežili. Na mieste činu sa nenašli DNA stopy, no boli objavené nábojnice. Polícia preveruje psychiatrické nemocnice a členstvá v streleckých kluboch, zameriava sa na ľudí s minulosťou týkajúcou sa násilia so zbraňou alebo záujmom o zbrane. Vyšetrovatelia prevažne vylučujú teóriu rodinného sporu aj možnosť, že hlavným terčom bol francúzsky cyklista. Prípad je zložitý, úrady očakávajú dlhé vyšetrovanie, pretože motív a páchateľ sú stále neznámi.

article_content: AdEnergy Solutions Limited (AESL), a leading company in India's energy sector, has received strong Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) ratings, reinforcing its commitment to sustainable practices, according to an official release. A press statement from the Adani Group noted that in the July-September 2023 quarter, AESL showed significant improvements across various ESG criteria, establishing itself as a leader in responsible corporate practices. AESL achieved a Corporate Social Responsibility and sustainability (CSRHUB) rating of 86%, surpassing the global Electric and Gas Utilities industry average. This result highlights the company's commitment to corporate social responsibility and sustainability. AESL reported an ESG risk score of 31.5, outperforming the global Electric Utility Industry average of 32.1, and securing a spot among the Global Top 40 companies in the sector. A lower ESG risk score indicates a better risk profile, reflecting AESL's emphasis on managing ESG risks. The company maintained a stable 'BBB' rating from MSCI, reflecting solid performance in environmental, social, and governance metrics. AESL’s FTSE ESG score rose to 4, up from 3.3, placing it well above the global electric utilities sector average of 2.7. With a governance score of 5 out of 5, the company underlined its commitment to ethical business practices. AESL is actively pursuing UN Energy Compact targets, aiming for renewable energy to account for 60% of its bulk procurement by FY27—currently, it has reached 38%. Additionally, AESL targets a 40% reduction in greenhouse gas (GHG) emission intensity by FY25 compared to FY19 levels. Under its 1t.org commitment, AESL has planted 24.3 million mangroves and 3.28 million trees, contributing toward the Adani Group’s broader objective of planting 100 million trees by 2023. Managing Director Anil Sardana expressed pride in these accomplishments and reiterated the company's dedication to driving sustainable change within the industry and globally. With its continued focus on responsible energy practices and strong ESG performance, AESL is positioned as a frontrunner in building a sustainable and green energy future.

AESL dosiahla hodnotenie Corporate Social Responsibility a trvalej udržateľnosti (CSRHUB) na úrovni 86 %, čo prekonáva globálny priemer v odvetví elektrických a plynových utilít. article_content: Carole Middleton, mother of Catherine, Duchess of Cambridge, has long been seen as having aristocratic ambitions. When planning for her daughter's 2011 royal wedding, Carole faced the challenge of creating a new family coat of arms—a task familiar to many aspiring British families. Unsurprisingly, Carole, a former air stewardess, looked to experts trusted by other prominent families, including some inspired by fiction. Downton Abbey proved to be an unexpected influence. The Middletons turned to the show's etiquette advisor and heraldic expert, Alastair Bruce, for guidance. The family even visited Highclere Castle, Downton Abbey’s filming location, to meet Bruce. Impressed by his expertise, they sought his assistance in designing their coat of arms, which later appeared in the Royal Wedding programme in April 2011. Alastair Bruce, a Queen’s Herald and authority on protocol, also works with the cast and crew of Downton Abbey to ensure historical accuracy on set. Affectionately known as 'the Oracle', he is meticulous about details—even halting filming if period errors are noticed. According to a source quoted in The Sun, the Middletons' approach to Downton Abbey for crest inspiration would amuse many, but Bruce's credentials as a Queen's Herald speak for themselves. While Catherine, as a royal bride, could have applied for her own heraldic design, it was decided instead that her parents would commission one on behalf of the family. With the guidance of Bruce and Thomas Woodcock—Garter Principal King of Arms at the College of Arms—the Middletons settled on a simple yet symbolic crest. Herald Painter Robert Parsons sketched the design, which features three leafy acorns (one for each of the couple’s three children), an element suggested by Kate herself. The acorns symbolize growth into great oaks, representing both strength and the family's ties to West Berkshire, an area known for its oak trees. The gold chevron at the heart of the design symbolizes Carole Middleton and subtly hints at her maiden name, Goldsmith. Two thin white chevronels represent mountains and the family’s love of skiing and the outdoors. The crest’s background features red and blue—principal colours of the United Kingdom’s flag and those found in Prince William’s updated coat of arms. In keeping with tradition, the College of Arms included a visual pun: the meeting of the two colours forms a 'middle tone' to reference their surname. The College of Arms is the UK’s official heraldic authority, funded by fees rather than taxpayer money. While anyone can apply for a coat of arms, actual eligibility is determined by achievements such as civil or military commissions, prestigious degrees, or societal distinction. Not everyone who applies is granted one. The newly granted coat of arms extends usage rights to all three Middleton children—Kate, Pippa, and James. However, traditional rules mean only James can pass the emblem to his descendants. Pippa may use the coat of arms throughout her lifetime, but will not be able to transmit it to her children. A Downton Abbey spokesperson confirmed that Alastair Bruce collaborated with Thomas Woodcock on the design. At the Royal Wedding, Prince William's coat of arms adorned the front of the programme, while Kate's new family crest, created in complementary colours, featured on the back.
translated_content: Carole Middletonová, matka Catherine, vojvodkyne z Cambridge, je už dlho považovaná za osobu s aristokratickými ambíciami. Pri plánovaní kráľovskej svadby svojej dcéry v roku 2011 čelila výzve vytvoriť nový rodinný erb – úloha, ktorá je známa mnohým ambicióznym britským rodinám. Niet divu, že Carole, bývalá letuška, sa obrátila na odborníkov, ktorým dôverujú aj iné významné rodiny, vrátane tých inšpirovaných fikciou. Nečakaným vplyvom sa stala aj séria Downton Abbey. Middletonovci sa s prosbou o radu obrátili na odborníka na etiketu a heraldiku z tohto seriálu Alastaira Brucea. Rodina dokonca navštívila zámok Highclere, kde sa Downton Abbey natáča, aby sa s Bruceom stretla. Jeho odborné znalosti ich oslovili natoľko, že ho požiadali o pomoc s návrhom svojho erbu, ktorý sa neskôr objavil aj v programe kráľovskej svadby v apríli 2011. Alastair Bruce, kráľovský herold a odborník na protokol, pracuje aj s hercami a štábom Downton Abbey, aby na pľaci zachoval historickú presnosť. Prezývaný „Orákulum“ je známy svojou precíznosťou – natáčanie často prerušuje kvôli drobným dobovým detailom. Podľa zdroja citovaného v The Sun by mnohých pobavilo, že Middletonovci získali inšpiráciu pre svoj erb z Downton Abbey, ale Bruceove kompetencie kráľovského herolda hovoria samy za seba. Catherine si síce ako kráľovská nevesta mohla požiadať o vlastný erb, no rozhodlo sa, že jeho návrh objednajú jej rodičia v mene celej rodiny. S pomocou Brucea a Thomasa Woodcocka – hlavného kráľovského herolda v College of Arms – sa Middletonovci dohodli na jednoduchom, no symbolickom erbe. Heraldický maliar Robert Parsons navrhol erb so symbolom troch listnatých žaluďov (jeden pre každé z ich troch detí), pričom tento motív navrhla Kate sama. Žaluďe symbolizujú rast do mohutných dubov, čo predstavuje silu a rodinné puto s West Berkshire, oblasťou známej dubmi. Zlatý klin v strede erbu reprezentuje Carole Middletonovú a jemne odkazuje na jej rodné meno Goldsmith. Dva tenké biele chevronely znamenajú hory a lásku rodiny k lyžovaniu a pobytu v prírode. Pozadie erbu tvorí červená a modrá – hlavné farby britskej vlajky, ktoré sú aj v zmodernizovanom erbe princa Williama. College of Arms tiež do erbu zakomponovala slovnú hračku: spojenie dvoch farieb vytvára „middle tone“ – stredný tón – ako narážku na priezvisko Middleton. College of Arms je oficiálnou britskou heraldickou autoritou, financovanou z poplatkov, nie z daní. article_content: Authorities in Newark, New Jersey, say two teenagers were shot and killed and another critically injured on Christmas night. This tragedy unfolded less than a day after three other men were fatally shot outside a bar about a mile away. The teens have been identified as 13-year-old Zainee Hailey and 14-year-old Kasson Mormon, who were pronounced dead at Newark’s University Hospital. Another unnamed 14-year-old remains in critical condition, according to prosecutors. Newark resident Junior Clark stated to WCBS that he saw the gunman hiding a weapon under his jacket just before the shooting began. Authorities have yet to identify a motive for the attack. The investigation is being handled by the city’s homicide major crimes task force, including law enforcement from the Newark State Police, Sheriff's Office, and FBI. Earlier on Christmas Day, a few minutes away in nearby Irvington, three men were shot and killed outside Slick's Go Go Bar. Among the dead were Pierre Clervoyant, the bar owner’s son, and club employee Woodley Daniel. The third victim’s name has not been released, and investigators believe he might not have been the intended target. Two other men also suffered gunshot wounds in the bar incident, but officials have not provided their names or conditions. All five men from the bar shooting were rushed to University Hospital after 1 a.m., with Clervoyant and Daniel pronounced dead soon after arrival. Investigators suspect a fight between a bouncer and the shooter was a catalyst, but the exact reason for the violence is under review.

Ďalší, nemenovaný 14-ročný, je podľa prokuratúry v kritickom stave. Obyvateľ Newarku Junior Clark pre WCBS povedal, že pred streľbou videl útočníka so zbraňou ukrytou pod bundou. Úrady zatiaľ bližšie nešpecifikovali motív útoku. Prípad vyšetruje oddelenie vrážd a závažných trestných činov v Newarku za pomoci štátnej polície, šerifovho úradu a FBI. article_content: Infosys co-founder Narayana Murthy recently sparked widespread discussion by urging young Indians to work 70 hours a week, believing this would help increase the country’s productivity, which he says is currently among the lowest globally. Despite some support from business leaders, scientific evidence does not back up his claim. Research over the years has shown that productivity starts to drop after 50 to 55 hours of work per week, and working without taking at least one day off leads to even lower overall performance. Health professionals warn that keeping up such long hours is risky for both physical and mental health, as well as overall work-life balance. Dr. Jyoti Kapoor, psychiatrist and director at Manasthali, pointed out that while some jobs may require longer hours temporarily, regularly working 70 hours a week is unsustainable and can have serious consequences. Internal medicine consultant Dr. Honey Savla of Wockhardt Hospitals in Mumbai highlighted that excessive work hours can cause burnout, fatigue, reduced family time, and disrupt natural rest cycles. Counseling psychologist Gayatri Mehra elaborated on the health concerns, saying overwork is linked to heart disease, weight gain due to poor eating habits, muscle and posture problems from too much sitting, higher stress, anxiety, emotional exhaustion, and poor sleep. For those who do experience high workloads, experts like Dr. Ankita Priydarshini from Thriving Minds and Dr. Samrat Shah of Bhatia Hospital suggest: - Prioritizing self-care, such as exercise, relaxation, and quality time with family and friends. - Ensuring 7 to 8 hours of sleep each night. - Taking regular short breaks during the day. - Eating nutritious meals, staying hydrated, and remaining active. - Setting healthy boundaries at work, delegating tasks when necessary, and being clear about limits. - Scheduling regular check-ups to catch any problems early. - Building supportive relationships with friends, family, or professionals. It’s crucial to recognize personal limits and value a balanced lifestyle for both well-being and lasting productivity. Dr. Austin Fernandes, psychiatrist at Dr. LH Hiranandani Hospital, recommends the ‘9-8-7 Rule’: nine hours for work, eight for leisure or rest, and seven for sleep. He emphasizes this guideline should be personalized based on individual needs.

Hoci niektorí biznis lídri jeho vyjadrenie podporili, vedecké dôkazy jeho tvrdenia nepotvrdzujú. Výskumy ukazujú, že produktivita začína klesať už po 50–55 odpracovaných hodinách za týždeň a práca bez aspoň jedného voľného dňa prináša ešte nižší výkon. Zdravotníci upozorňujú, že takéto dlhé pracovné časy sú rizikové pre fyzické i duševné zdravie a narúšajú rovnováhu medzi prácou a voľným časom. Psychiatrička a riaditeľka Manasthali Dr. Jyoti Kapoor upozornila, že hoci niektoré zamestnania môžu vyžadovať dočasne dlhší pracovný čas, pravidelne pracovať 70 hodín týždenne nie je dlhodobo udržateľné a môže viesť k vážnym dôsledkom. Internistka Dr. Honey Savla z nemocnice Wockhardt Hospitals v Bombaji zdôraznila, že priveľa práce môže viesť k vyhoreniu, únave, obmedzeniu času s rodinou a narušeniu prirodzených cyklov oddychu. Psychologička Gayatri Mehra priblížila ďalšie zdravotné riziká, medzi ktoré patrí srdcovo-cievne ochorenia, priberanie z dôvodu nezdravého stravovania a nepravidelných jedál, svalové a pohybové problémy spôsobené častým sedením, vyššia miera stresu, úzkosti, emocionálne vyčerpanie a problémy so spánkom. Pre tých, ktorí čelia vysokému pracovnému nasadeniu, odborníci ako Dr. Ankita Priydarshini z Thriving Minds a Dr. Samrat Shah z Bhatia Hospital odporúčajú: - Uprednostňovať starostlivosť o seba samého, napríklad pohyb, relax či kvalitný čas s rodinou a priateľmi. - Zabezpečiť si 7 až 8 hodín spánku denne. - Pravidelne si robiť krátke prestávky počas dňa. - Dbať na zdravé stravovanie, hydratáciu a aktívny životný štýl. - Určiť si zdravé hranice v práci, delegovať úlohy a jasne komunikovať svoje limity. - Chodiť na pravidelné prehliadky kvôli včasnému zachyteniu problémov. - Budovať si podporné vzťahy s priateľmi, rodinou alebo odborníkmi. Je dôležité vnímať svoje limity a klásť dôraz na vyvážený životný štýl kvôli dlhodobému zdraviu a udržateľnej produktivite. Psychiater Dr. Austin Fernandes z nemocnice Dr. LH Hiranandani odporúča '9-8-7' pravidlo: deväť hodín práca, osem hodín rekreácia alebo oddych, sedem hodín spánok. Zdôrazňuje však, že ide o všeobecné odporúčanie a každý by si ho mal prispôsobiť vlastným potrebám.

article_content: Tesco, the UK's largest supermarket, has sparked a price war by reducing the price of a four-pint carton of milk to £1. This move undercuts Sainsbury’s and Morrisons by 39p and matches Asda, aiming to win back shoppers who’ve shifted to discount retailers like Aldi and Lidl. The supermarket promoted its new pricing with the slogan 'Prices down and staying down' on its website. This milk discount is part of Tesco’s larger effort to make staple groceries more affordable, including other reductions on fruit and vegetables, with claimed overall savings of £200 million for customers. Rather than limited-time promotions, Tesco is shifting to permanent lower prices for essential items by accepting slimmer profit margins. The decision follows CEO Philip Clarke’s admission that Tesco hadn’t supported customers enough during tougher times. The company is also running other savings programs, like discounts on fuel for loyalty cardholders. Although Asda already sells four pints of milk for £1, Tesco’s move puts fresh pressure on supermarkets Sainsbury’s, Morrisons, and the Co-op to do the same. Chris Bush, Tesco’s UK managing director, emphasized that these cuts are designed to directly compete with budget stores such as Aldi and Lidl. The National Farmers’ Union (NFU), however, has voiced strong concerns. Dairy board chairman Mansel Raymond warns that aggressive price reductions like Tesco’s risk hurting the nation’s dairy farmers, whose incomes are already squeezed. Farmers worry this approach treats milk as a cheap product rather than a valued food. This is not the first time Tesco’s discounts have upset producers: a similar controversy erupted in 2008 when it slashed the price of chickens, leading farmers to accuse the chain of undervaluing ethical food production. Tesco insists its roughly 700 milk suppliers in the Tesco Sustainable Dairy Group (TSDG) are protected, since they receive a fair price based on their costs plus a premium. The retail price cuts, Tesco says, will not affect these payments. Tesco’s commercial director John Scouler affirms the supermarket’s commitment to paying farmers fairly and sourcing milk responsibly—stating that both customers and producers can trust the pricing.

Supermarket svoje nové ceny propagoval sloganom „Ceny dole a zostávajú dole“ na svojej webovej stránke. Tento zľavnený mliečny produkt je súčasťou širšieho úsilia Tesca sprístupniť základné potraviny, vrátane ďalších zliav na ovocie a zeleninu, pričom odhadované celkové úspory pre zákazníkov sú 200 miliónov libier. Národná poľnohospodárska únia (NFU) však vyjadrila obavy. Tesco však tvrdí, že jeho zhruba 700 dodávateľov mlieka združených v Tesco Sustainable Dairy Group (TSDG) je chránených, keďže dostávajú spravodlivú cenu podľa nákladov plus prémiu. article_content: Redseer Strategy Consultants reports that homegrown short-form video (SFV) platforms in India have more than 250 million users, with about 65% from tier-II cities and beyond. Around 40% of these users conduct online transactions on the platforms, providing considerable monetization opportunities. Features enabling monetization across e-commerce, online gaming, and OTT video streaming are increasingly popular. While global SFV platforms remain popular among urban users, Indian platforms have gained more traction in non-metro and semi-urban regions, thanks to diverse regional-language content produced by local creators. Redseer's studies show that about 45% of Indian SFV users are in semi-urban and rural areas, engaging with various internet platforms. Mukesh Kumar, associate partner at Redseer, states that the rising popularity of Indian SFV platforms advances digitization in India, driving value for platforms, brands, and end users through a data-informed and inclusive language approach. Growing disposable income among tier-II users boosts India's SFV landscape, offering many monetization possibilities. Innovations like live commerce and live gifting are promising methods for monetization. Research also reveals that approximately 64% of Indian SFV users are aged 25 or younger, with less than 3% being mature users. The rise of user-generated influencer platforms has fostered an ecosystem of about 3.5 million influencers — micro, macro, mega, and elite — who can earn over Rs 1.5-2 lakh a month via advertising and live commerce. Brands, especially in beauty, personal care, and fashion, are partnering with influencers to access wider audiences on Indian SFV platforms, notably in tier-2+ areas. Despite a funding slowdown in startups, advertising spend on SFV platforms is becoming more stable, with ongoing experimentation to find the most effective advertising models.

Asi 40 % týchto používateľov vykonáva na týchto platformách online transakcie, čo prináša významné možnosti monetizácie. Funkcie na zarábanie cez e-commerce, online hry a OTT video streaming sú čoraz populárnejšie. Výskumy Redseer ukazujú, že asi 45 % indických SFV používateľov pochádza z polomestských a vidieckych oblastí a využíva rôzne internetové platformy. Mukesh Kumar, partner spoločnosti Redseer, uvádza, že zvyšujúca sa popularita indických SFV platforiem posúva digitalizáciu v Indii a prináša hodnotu pre platformy, značky aj koncových používateľov vďaka dátovo riadenému a jazykovo inkluzívnemu prístupu. Rastúci disponibilný príjem medzi používateľmi z miest druhej úrovne rozširuje možnosti SFV platforiem v Indii a ponúka mnoho príležitostí na monetizáciu. Výskum tiež ukazuje, že približne 64 % používateľov indických SFV je mladších ako 25 rokov, menej než 3 % sú starší používatelia. Vzostup influencerov priniesol ekosystém asi 3,5 milióna influencerov – rozdelených na mikro, makro, mega a elitných – ktorí môžu mesačne zarobiť viac než 1,5 – 2 lakh rupií vďaka reklame a live commerce. Napriek útlmu vo financovaní startupov sú reklamné výdavky na SFV platformách stabilnejšie a prebiehajú pokusy o nájdenie najúčinnejších modelov reklamy.

article_content: Stuart Pearce may be entering the final weeks of his managerial stint at Nottingham Forest. After six consecutive weeks of defeats, rumors about the board considering his future are intensifying. Pearce’s team recently endured their fourth straight loss as Sheffield Wednesday scored twice in five minutes, stretching Forest’s winless run to eight games. During Saturday’s home defeat, Pearce was observed instructing his players, while a fan showed support with a flag for the under-pressure manager. Forest’s difficult spell includes a recent FA Cup loss at Rochdale and two defeats against Birmingham City. They have only won twice since September 17. There is growing talk that owner Fawaz Al-Hasawi is losing patience. Despite Pearce’s status as a club legend, his managerial tenure has struggled to deliver results. This role may be Pearce’s last major opportunity as a manager, and an early dismissal could close that chapter. Pearce said he believes in himself, emphasizing the need for unity at the club. Pearce has requested more time and support, expressing disappointment yet insisting he will remain resilient for his squad. While many fans still back the former player, the club’s leadership faces a tough decision and must address supporters’ concerns. article_content: Air New Zealand has removed an in-flight safety video that was criticized for 'sexualizing the female body.' The nearly four-minute video, featuring bikini-clad models, was pulled after an online petition accused it of being sexist. However, the airline insists its decision to discontinue the Sports Illustrated 50th anniversary safety video was unrelated to public pressure. The video, filmed in the Cook Islands, showed women in bikinis demonstrating safety procedures. Throughout the footage, models flicked their hair suggestively and were watched by Maori men. In one scene, the women looked at themselves in mirrors while wearing oxygen masks. A petition on change.org, signed by more than 7,000 people, argued the video made women uncomfortable, including female staff members. It stated, 'A safety video is intended to inform passengers about emergency procedures, not to objectify women.' One campaign supporter noted, 'Passengers are obliged to watch the video and cannot turn it off or shield their children from it. It objectifies women and reinforces stereotypes of sexual availability.' Despite these criticisms, an Air New Zealand spokesperson said the video's removal was due to scheduled programming changes. The Sports Illustrated video had reached the end of its planned run and was being phased out. On flights between Wellington and Auckland, passengers are now shown a previous safety video featuring Bear Grylls.

Letecká spoločnosť však trvá na tom, že ukončenie videoseriálu k 50. výročiu Sports Illustrated nesúviselo s verejným tlakom. Video natočené na Cookových ostrovoch ukazuje ženy v bikinách predvádzajúce bezpečnostné postupy. Modelky v ňom zvodne pohadzujú vlasmi a sledujú ich maorskí muži. Objektivizuje ženy a podporuje stereotypy sexuálnej dostupnosti.“ Napriek kritike hovorca Air New Zealand uviedol, že video bolo odstránené kvôli plánovanej rotácii programov. article_content: For decades, Yaffa Rubinstein has backed Democratic candidates and stood by President Biden, particularly in his approach to the conflict between Israel and Hamas. Still, she admits to feeling disheartened, recently holding a sign declaring herself a 'Pro-Israel Democrat' during a demonstration in Washington, D.C. Rubinstein, now 75 and originally from Israel, feels let down by anti-Israel sentiment she perceives among some Democrats. Despite prior activism for Syrian refugees and opposition to Donald Trump's 'Muslim ban,' she's increasingly uneasy with left-leaning criticism of Israel within her party. 'Where are the progressive Democrats now?' she wonders, remembering her willingness to stand up for refugees. Leib Kaminsky, a gay Jewish man aged 57, echoes Rubinstein's concerns. While he approves of Biden’s handling of the crisis, Kaminsky feels marginalized by sharp rhetoric from some progressives. Being part of the LGBTQ community makes it even tougher, he says, as he believes support for Jews has waned among certain allies. He recalls confrontations where people voiced support for Hamas, leaving him feeling misunderstood and alienated. Thousands came together at a pro-Israel rally on the National Mall on November 14. President Biden's response to the Israel-Hamas war has underscored deep divisions in the Democratic Party over Middle East policy. While Jewish Americans have long favored Democrats, recent events have exposed new rifts. Some Republicans, including Sam Markstein of the Republican Jewish Coalition, sense a chance to win over Jewish voters who have never before considered voting GOP. Markstein points to what he characterizes as a growing anti-Israel faction within the Democratic Party, and suggests this could lead to a shift in 2024. However, Halie Soifer of the Jewish Democratic Council of America disputes this idea, pointing to a new Jewish Electorate Institute poll showing 74% approval for Biden's handling of the crisis among Jewish voters. She dismisses claims of a major realignment as 'patently false,' noting that Jewish voter turnout is high, especially in critical swing states like Pennsylvania, Georgia, and Ohio. The poll also reveals generational differences: more than 80% of Jewish voters over 36 back Biden's policies concerning Israel, while support drops to just over half among younger Jewish voters. Still, some Jewish voices are deeply critical. Jay Saper from Jewish Voice for Peace, a group identifying as anti-Zionist, warns that young activists may withhold their votes from Biden unless he calls for a ceasefire. Muslim and Arab American leaders have made similar warnings, reacting to the ongoing violence that began with Hamas attacks killing at least 1,200 Israelis and leading, according to Palestinian sources, to over 11,000 deaths in Gaza. Veteran pollster Mark Mellman, who leads the Democratic Majority for Israel, is skeptical that Muslim American voters will shift to the GOP, especially with Trump—a proponent of the 'Muslim ban' and tough rhetoric on Palestinians—as the main Republican candidate. Rubinstein, attending the latest march, hopes for a two-state solution, and urges pro-Palestinian voters not to abandon Biden. 'If they don’t support Biden, who will win? Trump,’ she asks, underlining her concerns with potential Trump policies towards Palestinians. NPR’s Elena Moore contributed reporting.

Podobné varovania zaznievajú od moslimských a arabských lídrov v reakcii na pretrvávajúce násilie, ktoré začalo útokmi Hamasu so smrťou aspoň 1 200 Izraelčanov a podľa palestínskych zdrojov viedlo k viac než 11 000 úmrtiam v Gaze. Skúsený prieskumník Mark Mellman, líder Democratic Majority for Israel, však pochybuje, že by sa moslimskí Američania masovo priklonili k republikánom, najmä ak je Trump — tvorca „muslimského zákazu“ a ostrý kritik Palestínčanov — ich hlavný kandidát. Trump,“ hovorí, pričom zdôrazňuje svoje obavy zo spôsobu, akým by Trump pristupoval k Palestínčanom. Na správe sa podieľala Elena Moore z NPR.

Building credibility and demonstrating industry expertise are essential for growing a technology brand. Business-to-business (B2B) buyers often rely on third-party sources to inform their purchasing decisions, so establishing authority and visibility among your target audience is crucial. Public relations (PR) encompasses more than just positive media coverage; a comprehensive PR strategy can help generate leads, drive sales growth, and attract opportunities for funding or mergers and acquisitions.

An effective PR strategy for tech brands covers several key elements:

Thought Leadership: Position your executives or subject matter experts as reliable media contributors or interviewees. Speaking at industry events further enhances your brand’s reputation and can directly generate leads, particularly when media features link to your company’s website.

Industry Awards: Apply for relevant industry awards for your products, team, or overall business. Use specific examples and data to demonstrate excellence. Winning awards increases customer confidence and elevates team morale, supporting business growth.

Social Media Strategies: Leveraging platforms like LinkedIn helps B2B brands connect with their audience and foster relationships with stakeholders. Sharing personal leadership stories and team achievements—such as awards and media appearances—boosts engagement and strengthens your brand’s presence.

Analyst Relations: Industry analysts from firms such as Gartner and Forrester significantly shape B2B purchasing decisions. Building relationships through briefings or coordinator events like Analyst Days can lead to increased media coverage, sales opportunities, and investor interest.

Event Support: Dedicated PR support during industry events ensures your company connects with key reporters and analysts. A PR team can manage media and logistics, allowing company leaders to focus on building relationships and maximizing event value.

Brand Building: Stay relevant to the media even when there is no major announcement. Engage with key reporters, offer expert commentary, and schedule background conversations to maintain relationships and secure future coverage opportunities.

Funding and Exit Strategies: Develop targeted media outreach for funding announcements to attract investors and industry attention. For companies pursuing IPOs or acquisitions, connecting executives with high-profile reporters helps position your business as an industry leader and drives investor interest.

In summary, a robust PR strategy is vital for B2B tech companies seeking increased credibility and a competitive edge. Leveraging these core elements will help build trust in your brand and drive business growth.

article_content: New York State’s Attorney General has ordered Walmart, GNC, Target, and Walgreens to stop selling certain store-brand herbal supplements because they do not contain the herbs listed on the label. These items often consist mainly of fillers, and sometimes include potential allergens. The supplement industry has bigger problems, as many products make exaggerated claims about treating serious illnesses—all without scientific support. Some of these products are not only ineffective, but also pose real health threats. For example, certain green tea extract supplements have caused severe liver damage necessitating transplants, and reports of harm from supplements are increasing. Most dietary supplements lack rigorous scientific backing. Even when products are what they claim, robust evidence for their supposed benefits is scarce. However, the FTC has recently begun cracking down on misleading marketing. The agency reached settlements with NourishLife, which falsely claimed fish oil could help autistic children with speech development, and Pure Health, which misleadingly promoted green tea for weight loss on TV. Legal loopholes dating back to the 1994 Dietary Supplements Health and Education Act have left oversight to the FTC, as the FDA was stripped of most authority over supplements. Aggressive lobbying helped pass this law, making it hard to regulate the industry. Consumers face additional confusion from continually changing nutritional advice from government and health organizations. Diet guidelines have changed several times since the 1980s, and these frequent updates, along with numerous recommendations from professional groups, can overwhelm people and cause them to turn to supplements. Supplements are also not subject to the same conflict-of-interest rules as prescription drugs. Some individuals, like Lindsey Duncan, have falsely presented themselves as nutrition experts to promote their products, leading to legal action. The assumption that nutrients in supplement form are always safe is mistaken. Research has shown that some, such as beta carotene, vitamin E, and selenium, can actually increase the risk of cancers in large trials. Stronger laws and oversight are needed to protect consumers from unproven and potentially harmful supplements. In the meantime, individuals must be cautious when considering supplement use.
translated_content: Generálny prokurátor štátu New York nariadil spoločnostiam Walmart, GNC, Target a Walgreens, aby prestali predávať niektoré vlastné značky bylinných doplnkov, pretože v skutočnosti neobsahujú bylinky uvedené na obale. Tieto produkty často pozostávajú prevažne z plnidiel a niekedy môžu obsahovať aj potenciálne alergény. V odvetví výživových doplnkov však existujú vážnejšie problémy, keďže mnohé produkty uvádzajú prehnané tvrdenia o liečbe závažných ochorení – bez vedeckých dôkazov. Niektoré z nich sú nielen neúčinné, ale aj nebezpečné. Napríklad niektoré výťažky zo zeleného čaju spôsobili vážne poškodenie pečene, ktorého riešením bola transplantácia, a počet prípadov škodlivých účinkov doplnkov rastie. Väčšina výživových doplnkov nemá prísne vedecké opodstatnenie. Aj keď produkt skutočne obsahuje to, čo sľubuje, dôkazy o jeho účinkoch sú slabé. Federálna obchodná komisia (FTC) však v poslednom čase začala proti klamavým reklamám razantnejšie zasahovať. Dohodla sa na urovnaní so spoločnosťou NourishLife, ktorá nepravdivo tvrdila, že rybí olej môže zlepšiť rečový vývoj detí s autizmom, a s firmou Pure Health, ktorá zavádzajúco propagovala zelený čaj na chudnutie v televízii. Vďaka legislatívnej medzere spôsobenej zákonom o výživových doplnkoch z roku 1994 má dohľad dnes predovšetkým FTC, pretože FDA stratila väčšinu svojich právomocí. Silné lobovanie prijatie zákona presadilo a v súčasnosti je odvetvie ťažko regulovateľné. Spotrebitelia sú ešte viac zmätení neustálymi zmenami výživových odporúčaní zo strany štátnych inštitúcií a zdravotníkov. Stravovacie odporúčania sa zásadne menili od 80. rokov a časté aktualizácie spolu s množstvom odporúčaní od odborných spoločností ľudí zahlcujú a privádzajú ich k doplnkom. Doplnky tiež nepodliehajú rovnakým pravidlám konfliktu záujmov ako lieky na predpis. Niektorí jednotlivci, ako Lindsey Duncan, sa nepravdivo prezentovali ako výživoví experti kvôli propagácii svojich produktov, čo viedlo k právnym krokom. Predpoklad, že látky v doplnkoch sú vždy bezpečné len preto, že ide o 'živiny', je nesprávny. Výskum dokázal, že niektoré zložky ako beta-karotén, vitamín E a selén môžu vo veľkých štúdiách zvýšiť riziko výskytu určitých rakovín. Na ochranu spotrebiteľov pred neoverenými a potenciálne škodlivými doplnkami je potrebná prísnejšia legislatíva a dohľad. Kým sa tak stane, pri používaní doplnkov by mali byť ľudia opatrní.

article_content: A surfer has described being thrown into the air by a great white shark that attacked him from below while he was surfing with friends off South Australia's coast on Wednesday. Andrew 'Monkey' McLeod, a pharmacist, was with Tyrone Swan and Sam Jervis, catching waves 2km offshore at Elliston Bar when the incident occurred around 9:30am. McLeod recalled feeling a massive force and hearing a loud sound before being tossed into the air. The shark left two large bite marks and blood stains on his surfboard but did not injure him. 'Ty thinks the shark may have breached the surface because there was a huge splash,' McLeod told Adelaide Now. After climbing back onto his board, McLeod saw the shark's tail fin nearby, estimating the animal at around 15 feet long. The three friends swiftly regrouped, with Swan and Jervis waiting for McLeod before paddling together back to shore. Despite the close encounter, the trio say they intend to return to surfing, though perhaps not in the same area. Elliston is known for its striking coastline and high cliffs, but also for previous shark encounters. In 2000, 17-year-old surfer Jevan Wright was killed by a shark while surfing at nearby Blackfellows, Port Lincoln. While shark attacks in Australia are sometimes highlighted, they are relatively rare. The Australian Shark Attack File, maintained by researchers at Sydney's Taronga Conservation Society, records 892 shark attacks in Australia since 1791, with 217 fatalities.

Andrew 'Monkey' McLeod, farmaceut, bol spolu s Tyroneom Swanom a Samom Jervisom, keď chytili vlny 2 km od brehu na Elliston Bar v čase okolo 9:30. McLeod si spomína, že pocítil obrovskú silu a počul hlasný zvuk, než ho žralok vyhodil do vzduchu. Žralok zanechal na jeho surfovej doske dve veľké stopy po uhryznutí a škvrny od krvi, no McLeoda nezranil. 'Ty si myslí, že žralok mohol úplne vyskočiť nad hladinu, lebo tam bola obrovská špliechanica,' povedal McLeod pre Adelaide Now. Po tom, čo sa opäť dostal na svoju dosku, videl blízko žraločí chvost, pričom odhadol jeho dĺžku na asi 4,5 metra. Trojica kamarátov sa okamžite znovu spojila; Swan a Jervis počkali na McLeoda a potom spolu pádľovali späť na breh. Napriek tomuto zážitku plánujú opäť surfovať, hoci možno už nie v tejto oblasti. Elliston je známy svojím nádherným pobrežím a vysokými útesmi, no aj predchádzajúcimi stretmi so žralokmi. V roku 2000 tam žralok zabil 17-ročného surfera Jevana Wrighta na pláži Blackfellows pri Port Lincolne. Hoci sa o útokoch žralokov v Austrálii často píše, sú pomerne zriedkavé. Austrálsky záznam útokov žralokov, ktorý vedú výskumníci v Taronga Conservation Society v Sydney, eviduje od roku 1791 celkovo 892 útokov, z ktorých bolo 217 smrteľných.

article_content: Alfred Wells, 64, and his partner Patricia Marshall, 55, from West Boldon, South Tyneside, fraudulently claimed over £42,000 in benefits despite having won £250,000 on the lottery. Between 2008 and 2013, the couple falsely claimed pension credit, housing benefit, and council tax support—even though they had over £170,000 in savings. Wells won £250,000 in 2008 and also received a retirement lump sum of £38,000 from South Tyneside Council. Both Wells and Marshall lied about their savings, stating they only had between £700 and £800, to receive benefits. They were arrested in August last year and admitted to claiming benefits dishonestly. At Newcastle Crown Court, Wells pleaded guilty to two counts of benefit fraud, and Marshall to three counts. Each received an eight-month prison sentence, suspended for two years, and was ordered to complete 100 hours of unpaid work and pay £170 in prosecution costs. All the money claimed fraudulently has been repaid, including investigation costs. Marshall additionally claimed £591 in benefits between September and December 2008 by incorrectly stating she lived alone. The court heard that both defendants expressed deep regret for their actions and acknowledged their dishonesty. Wells’ defense mentioned his health challenges, including being in remission from throat cancer since 2010. Judge Debbie Sherwin acknowledged the couple's previous good character but emphasized the seriousness of their offenses.

V rokoch 2008 až 2013 pár nepravdivo žiadal o dôchodkové kredity, príspevok na bývanie a zníženie dane z nehnuteľnosti – aj keď mali na úsporách viac ako 170 000 libier. Každý dostal osem mesiacov väzenia s podmienečným odkladom na dva roky, musia odpracovať 100 hodín verejnoprospešných prác a zaplatiť 170 libier na súdnych nákladoch. Všetky protiprávne vyplatené peniaze boli vrátené vrátane nákladov na vyšetrovanie. article_content: Lee Ellis, a 39-year-old unemployed man from Castleford, stole roof tiles and lead flashing from the home of his former partner, Jill Slater, in the early morning hours. Slater was sleeping inside the house with their twin three-year-olds and her 15-year-old daughter when she was awakened by noises on the roof, eventually seeing Ellis as he climbed down. Police caught him nearby after a short pursuit. Significant damage was caused, resulting in Slater submitting a £3,500 insurance claim. In court, it was stated that both Slater and her daughter were frightened by the incident. Ellis' defense noted he had taken sleeping pills and had little memory of what occurred, linking his behavior to emotional turmoil following the breakup. Ellis admitted to the theft and received a 12-month community order, required to participate in 30 days of rehabilitation activities, and must pay £150 compensation to Slater, £85 in prosecution costs, and a £60 victim surcharge. He also received a 12-month restraining order, limiting contact with Slater to matters about their children and only through a third party.

Slaterová spala v dome s ich trojročnými dvojičkami a svojou 15-ročnou dcérou, keď ju zobudili podozrivé zvuky zo strechy a uvidela Ellisa, ako zlieza dolu. Polícia ho po krátkom prenasledovaní chytila neďaleko domu. Spôsobené škody boli značné, Slaterová preto podala poistnú žiadosť vo výške 3 500 libier. Na súde zaznelo, že incident Slaterovú aj jej dcéru vystrašil. Ellisova obhajoba uviedla, že užil tabletky na spanie a udalosti si pamätá len matne, pričom svoje správanie spájal so stresom po rozchode. Ellis sa ku krádeži priznal a dostal 12-mesačný komunitný trest, ktorý zahŕňa 30 dní rehabilitačných aktivít. Je povinný zaplatiť Slaterovej 150 libier ako náhradu škody, 85 libier na súdne trovy a 60 libier poplatok pre obeť. Navyše dostal 12-mesačný zákaz kontaktu so Slaterovou, okrem vecí týkajúcich sa detí, a to len prostredníctvom tretej osoby.

article_content: A fire broke out late Sunday night on Duval Street in Key West, destroying three local favorites—a crepe café, an art gallery, and a sign shop—and leading to temporary closures along the busy main street. Authorities say the blaze began at around 10:30 p.m. and was contained by 1 a.m. Monday, with two firefighters suffering minor injuries. The cause is still under investigation. Singer Jimmy Buffett’s Margaritaville and its retail store were among businesses closed during the incident, halting late-night activity. Waitress Patricija Hambrook described being unable to finish her shift as the fire spread. Both the restaurant and shop reopened on Monday. Firefighters stopped the fire from spreading to the historic San Carlos Theater, though it sustained a broken window and some water damage. According to theater administrator Alex Pascual, it is expected to reopen by Thursday for a planned concert. The San Carlos Theater, founded in 1871, is notable as the site of Cuban leader Jose Marti’s famous 1892 speech. Duval Street was initially closed to cars but reopened at 10 a.m. Monday, restoring normal activity. Business owners worried about lost traffic, but many were hopeful as tourists and cruise passengers continued to visit. City spokeswoman Alyson Crean reinforced that tourism in Key West remains strong with many visitors in town. Owners of the destroyed businesses, including La Creperie Cafe’s Yolande Findlay and Sylvie Lenouail—originally from Brittany, France—face a tough road ahead. The American Royal Art gallery and Montage sign shop were also lost to the fire.

Podľa úradov požiar začal okolo 22:30 a podarilo sa ho dostať pod kontrolu do pondelňajšej 1. hodiny, pričom dvaja hasiči utrpeli ľahké zranenia. Príčina požiaru je stále predmetom vyšetrovania. Medzi prevádzky, ktoré boli počas incidentu zatvorené, patrila aj reštaurácia Margaritaville speváka Jimmyho Buffetta s obchodom, čím sa prerušila nočná prevádzka. Čašníčka Patricija Hambrook opísala, že kvôli rozšíreniu požiaru nemohla dokončiť svoju smenu. Reštaurácia aj obchod opäť otvorili v pondelok. Hasičom sa podarilo zabrániť šíreniu požiaru na historické divadlo San Carlos, hoci to malo rozbité okno a utrpelo poškodenie vodou. Podľa správcu divadla Alexa Pascuala by malo byť znovu otvorené do štvrtka na plánovaný koncert. Divadlo San Carlos, založené v roku 1871, je známe ako miesto slávneho prejavu kubánskeho vodcu José Martího z roku 1892. Ulica Duval bola pôvodne uzavretá pre autá, no v pondelok o 10. hodine ráno sa opäť otvorila a priniesla návrat do bežného života. Majitelia podnikov sa obávali straty zákazníkov, no mnohí dúfali v pozitívny vývoj, keďže turisti a cestujúci z výletných lodí naďalej prichádzali. Mestská hovorkyňa Alyson Crean zdôraznila, že cestovný ruch v Key West zostáva silný, keďže v meste je mnoho návštevníkov. Majitelia zničených prevádzok, vrátane Yolande Findlay a Sylvie Lenouail z La Creperie Cafe – pôvodom z Bretónska vo Francúzsku – teraz čelí náročnému obdobiu. Ohňom zanikli aj galéria American Royal Art a obchod so značkami Montage.
