article_content: One summer morning in Vietnam's Mekong Delta, Le Thi Hong Mai saw her house and restaurant collapse into the river, a consequence of the worsening shoreline erosion. Across the region, this crisis—driven by sand mining and hydropower dams—puts the homes and livelihoods of hundreds of thousands at risk. Sand, vital for making concrete, is now the world's second most consumed natural resource after water. Global demand for sand has tripled over the past two decades, the UN reports. Vietnam’s Mekong Delta, known as the nation’s 'rice bowl,' faces losing its sand reserves within just over a decade. The effects are already devastating. For Mai, losing her home in Can Tho’s suburbs also meant losing her business. "I heard a bang, rushed out, and everything was gone," said the 46-year-old. Many in the region have experienced similar sudden loss as the land is swallowed by the river. For 20 years, sand dredging for Vietnam’s construction boom and reduced sediment from upstream dams have intensified erosion. By 2040, sediment could plummet by 97%, according to the Mekong River Commission. With less sand, rivers flow faster, severely eroding their banks. Between 2016 and August 2023, at least 750 km of riverbank and over 2,000 homes in the Delta slipped into the water, government data shows. Sand extraction continues day and night, yet authorities acknowledge the river system can no longer supply even half of what’s needed for crucial highway projects. Attempts to halt erosion, like multi-million-dollar embankments, have often failed—one $4.7 million barrier was destroyed three times. Alternatives such as importing sand remain debated, stalling badly needed construction. Although Vietnam banned sand exports in 2017, local usage still surpasses what the river naturally provides. At the current extraction pace, the WWF predicts there will be no sand left by 2035. With vital projects delayed and rural roads left submerged, the infrastructure impact is growing. In Hau Giang, Diep Thi Lua awoke to find her yard collapsing into the river. Her experience mirrors that of many in the region. Despite over $470 million spent on mitigation, the risk remains massive—between 20,000 and 500,000 households may need relocation, but funds fall short. As fear and uncertainty grip locals, Mai sums it up: "We just have to accept it."
translated_content: Jedného letného rána v delte Mekongu vo Vietname sa Le Thi Hong Mai pozerala, ako sa jej dom a reštaurácia zrútia do rieky – dôsledok narastajúcej erózie brehu. Táto kríza, ktorú vyvoláva ťažba piesku a vodné elektrárne, ohrozuje domovy a živobytie státisícov ľudí v regióne. Piesok, nevyhnutný na výrobu betónu, je po vode druhou najvyužívanejšou prírodnou surovinou na svete. Podľa OSN sa dopyt po piesku za uplynulé dve desaťročia strojnásobil. Deltu Mekongu, nazývanú „ryžová miska“ Vietnamu, môžu pieskové zásoby opustiť už v priebehu nasledujúcich rokov. Následky sú už dnes zničujúce. Pre Mai strata domu na predmestí mesta Can Tho znamenala aj koniec jej podnikania. „Počula som ranu, vybehla som a všetko bolo preč,“ opisuje 46-ročná žena. Mnohí v regióne zažívajú podobnú náhlu stratu, keď pôda mizne v rieke. Počas 20 rokov urýchľuje eróziu ťažba piesku pre stavebný boom a prítok sedimentov blokovaný priehradami. Komisia pre rieku Mekong odhaduje, že do roku 2040 môže množstvo sedimentov klesnúť až o 97 %. Pri menšom množstve piesku tečú rieky rýchlejšie a viac podmývajú brehy. Od roku 2016 do augusta 2023 spadlo podľa štátnych údajov do vody minimálne 750 km riečneho brehu a viac ako 2 000 domov. Piesok sa ťaží nepretržite, ale úrady priznávajú, že rieka už nestačí potrebám na výstavbu diaľnic. Opatrenia proti erózii, vrátane drahých hrádzí, často zlyhávajú – jedna z bariér v hodnote 4,7 milióna dolárov bola zničená až trikrát. Diskusie o alternatívach ako dovoz piesku výstavbu spomaľujú. Hoci Vietnam v roku 2017 zakázal vývoz piesku, domáca spotreba stále prevyšuje obnovu prírodných zásob. Podľa WWF pri súčasnej rýchlosti bude piesok vyčerpaný do roku 2035 a infraštruktúra je ohrozená – kľúčové projekty meškajú a cesty na vidieku zostávajú často pod vodou. V provincii Hau Giang sa Diep Thi Lua zobudila na to, že jej dvor padá do rieky. Podobné zážitky majú tisíce ľudí. Hoci štát investoval vyše 470 miliónov dolárov do protipovodňových projektov, riziko zostáva vysoké – presídlenie bude možno potrebné pre 20 000 až 500 000 domácností, peniaze však chýbajú. Strach a neistota v regióne narastá – Mai to vystihuje: „Musíme sa s tým zmieriť.“

article_content: Oprah Winfrey is aiming to reinvigorate viewership on her OWN network through a much-awaited interview with cyclist Lance Armstrong, whose career was marked by multiple Tour de France wins and controversy. Owing to Armstrong's extended and candid conversation, the interview will span two nights, deviating from the original single-episode plan. The network, which partners with Discovery Communications, is forecasting high ratings for the two-night event and is selling advertising spots at elevated rates, according to OWN president Erik Logan. This interview is significant, as Armstrong—who long denied doping allegations—finally admitted to using performance-enhancing drugs during his cycling career, a revelation confirmed by Winfrey following their meeting in Austin, Texas. Armstrong’s confession follows his removal from the record books and a comprehensive report by the U.S. Anti-Doping Agency. The forthcoming broadcast has attracted widespread attention from both viewers and advertisers, with many brands vying for limited commercial slots during the primetime airing. The strong interest has allowed OWN to secure above-average ad rates, especially from companies maintaining long-term or broader commitments to the channel. Regular sponsors include General Motors, Target, and Kellogg. Since its 2011 launch, OWN has seen improved primetime numbers, a trend attributed in part to Winfrey’s direct influence on programming. Notable previous interviews, including those with Whitney Houston’s daughter and Rihanna, have drawn large audiences, and media experts expect the Armstrong special to further raise the network’s profile. Off-screen, Armstrong visited the Livestrong Foundation to apologize for the impact of his scandal on the charity and its staff. While he stopped short of a direct confession in that setting, he expressed remorse and encouraged the foundation’s continued work for cancer patients. Travis Tygart, U.S. Anti-Doping Agency CEO, called the doping program run by Armstrong and his team the most advanced and successful in sports history. With Armstrong’s public admission set to air, OWN hopes it will not only boost its ratings but also leave a lasting effect on its reputation.
translated_content: Oprah Winfrey sa snaží zvýšiť sledovanosť svojej televíznej siete OWN významným rozhovorom s cyklistom Lanceom Armstrongom, ktorý bol známy svojimi víťazstvami na Tour de France aj kontroverziami. Keďže Armstrong poskytol otvorený a dlhý rozhovor, rozhovor bude rozdelený na dve časti namiesto pôvodne plánovanej jednej. OWN, ktorá spolupracuje s Discovery Communications, očakáva vysokú sledovanosť a podľa prezidenta OWN Erika Logana predáva reklamný priestor za prémiové ceny. Tento rozhovor je dôležitý, pretože Armstrong – ktorý roky popieral doping – po prvý raz otvorene priznal užívanie zakázaných látok. Toto priznanie potvrdila aj Winfrey po stretnutí dvojice v texaskom Austine. Priznanie nasleduje po tom, čo Armstrong prišiel o všetky titulky a po výstupe správy Americkej antidopingovej agentúry. Očakávaná relácia vyvoláva silný záujem divákov aj inzerentov, pričom mnohé značky súťažia o reklamný priestor v hlavnom vysielacom čase. OWN si tak môže dovoliť účtovať vyššie ceny, predovšetkým tým spoločnostiam, ktoré so stanicou dlhodobo spolupracujú. Medzi pravidelných inzerentov patria General Motors, Target a Kellogg. Od svojho vzniku v roku 2011 OWN zvýšila sledovanosť, čo sa pripisuje aj väčšiemu zapojeniu samotnej Winfrey do programu. Výrazné rozhovory s dcérou Whitney Houston alebo s Rihannou už v minulosti pritiahli milióny divákov. Mediálni odborníci očakávajú, že Armstrongova spoveď ešte viac zvýši popularitu stanice. Mimo kamier Armstrong navštívil nadáciu Livestrong, kde sa ospravedlnil zamestnancom za dopad škandálu. Síce priamo neuznal užívanie dopingu, vyjadril ľútosť a povzbudil nadáciu, aby naďalej pomáhali onkologickým pacientom. Travis Tygart, šéf Americkej antidopingovej agentúry, označil dopingový program Armstrongovho tímu za najsofistikovanejší a najúspešnejší v histórii športu. OWN dúfa, že Armstrongovo televízne priznanie prinesie vyššiu sledovanosť i lepšie meno stanici.

article_content: Hillary Clinton appeared on CNN’s town hall and delivered confident, clear views on key topics like gun control, marriage equality, and voting rights. She strongly supported LGBTQ+ rights and criticized attempts to limit voting access. Clinton injected some humor into the night by joking about never having tried marijuana, but much of her overall approach appeared cautious and predictable, even if she showed passion on certain subjects. Discussing immigration, Clinton’s answers were notably vague. She advocated for more executive power if Congress fails to pass reforms, but critics felt her response lacked substance. Clinton also voiced support for stricter border security and the repatriation of migrant children—a stance aligning partly with conservative perspectives, despite her empathetic tone toward immigrants. Addressing Benghazi, Clinton stuck to a well-rehearsed defense, refraining from directly challenging her detractors and noting that questions remain despite multiple investigations. The article’s author notes a personal bias, viewing Clinton as too moderate on economic issues and too interventionist in foreign affairs. There is concern that she may be overly aligned with Wall Street and remembers her initial support for the Iraq War. While acknowledging Clinton’s experienced track record, the author sees her as a symbol of establishment politics, lacking the inspired progressive leadership some desire. The author would choose her over conservative candidates, though without much excitement. Clinton presented herself as a pragmatic problem-solver rather than an inspirational orator, emphasizing resilience and tenacity. The author admits that Clinton’s experience and toughness could make her effective, but finds her style underwhelming. Given the unpredictable nature of modern media and politics, Clinton’s caution is likely an asset, reducing the risk of major blunders as other candidates might self-sabotage. This steadiness, though unexciting, might give her an edge. The most engaging aspects of the CNN town hall were the lively audience and interactive setup. Ultimately, while Clinton’s performance was solid and reliable, it left some viewers, including the article’s author, wanting more excitement—but reliability might be key to her potential electoral success.

article_content: The Beatles held the press launch for their classic album 'Sgt. Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band' at Brian Epstein's house on 24 Chapel Street, London, on May 19th, 1967. Pictured from left to right are Paul McCartney, Ringo Starr, John Lennon (1940–1980), and George Harrison (1943–2001). (Photo by John Downing/Getty Images) The Beatles remain the most successful band in UK history. Despite breaking up decades ago, they are still adored in their home country. The group is now poised to achieve an unexpected number one hit in the UK. According to the Official Charts Company, their latest single 'Now and Then' is set to top the UK singles chart. The country's equivalent of Billboard forecasts that the song will easily reach number one in the upcoming chart update. 'Now and Then' is already achieving strong sales and streams, significantly outselling the next four top songs combined. The new single was released midday on Thursday, November 2—near the end of the weekly tracking period. Because of intense activity in just a few hours, the song debuted just outside the top 40 this week. If 'Now and Then' reaches number one, it will become The Beatles' eighteenth UK chart-topper, further extending their record for most number one hits by a group. The only artist with more UK number one singles is Elvis Presley, who achieved 21 both during his life and posthumously.

Pepper's Lonely Hearts Club Band' v dome Briana Epsteina na Chapel Street 24 v Londýne 19. mája 1967. Na fotografii zľava doprava: Paul McCartney, Ringo Starr, John Lennon (1940–1980) a George Harrison (1943–2001). (Foto: John Downing/Getty Images) The Beatles zostávajú najúspešnejšou skupinou v histórii Spojeného kráľovstva. Napriek tomu, že sa pred desaťročiami rozpadli, vo svojej domovskej krajine sú stále nesmierne obľúbení. Teraz majú šancu dosiahnuť nečakaný hit číslo jedna v Británii. Podľa Oficiálnej hitparády (Official Charts Company) ich najnovší singel 'Now and Then' mieri na vrchol britskej singlovej hitparády. Britská obdoba Billboardu predpovedá, že skladba bez problémov ovládne nasledujúce vydanie rebríčka. 'Now and Then' už teraz boduje silnými predajmi a streammi a výrazne prekonáva ďalšie štyri najúspešnejšie skladby dokopy. Nový singel vyšiel vo štvrtok 2. novembra v poludnie — tesne pred koncom týždenného sledovania rebríčka. Vďaka výraznému záujmu počas pár hodín sa skladba tento týždeň objavila tesne mimo najlepšej štyridsiatky. Ak 'Now and Then' dosiahne prvé miesto, pôjde už o osemnásty britský hit číslo jedna The Beatles, čím ešte viac predĺžia svoj rekord medzi skupinami. Jediným umelcom s väčším počtom britských hitov číslo jedna je Elvis Presley, ktorý ich dosiahol 21 za svojho života aj po smrti.

article_content: Heather Mills has withdrawn her attempt to qualify for the British Paralympic skiing team following a dispute over her ski boot. Mills, who lost her left leg below the knee in 1993 after a road accident, was informed she must wear a cover over her boot and prosthetic leg to comply with international regulations. At age 45, she argued that the required cover would add unnecessary weight and cause intolerable pain. Earlier in the year, Mills won a World Cup silver medal and had hoped to compete for Britain at the Winter Paralympic Games in Sochi, Russia. Sylvana Mestre of the International Paralympic Committee (IPC) said Mills would be disqualified if she did not comply with the equipment regulations. A spokesman for Mills expressed disappointment, stating they were shocked that she faced disqualification for not wearing cosmetic, non-functional buckles on her ski boot. Her team stated that despite her hard work, injuries, and perseverance, she was forced to resign due to a bureaucratic decision they believe would cause her further pain and injury. During qualification, Mills faced challenges, including being ejected from her prosthetic leg during slalom training. She collaborated with the London Prosthetics Centre to design a new leg and boot to improve comfort, but wearing the required boot cover caused friction, inflammation, and blisters. Craig Spence from the IPC noted that while Mills’ previous prosthetic had been approved, her new boot design did not meet the regulations. He expressed regret, acknowledging Mills’ significant progress throughout the year.

Vo veku 45 rokov tvrdila, že požadovaný kryt by pridal zbytočnú váhu a spôsobil neznesiteľnú bolesť. Začiatkom tohto roka Mills získala striebornú medailu na Svetovom pohári a dúfala, že bude reprezentovať Britániu na Zimných paralympijských hrách v Soči v Rusku. Spolupracovala s London Prosthetics Centre na vývoji novej protézy a lyžiarky na zlepšenie komfortu, no povinný kryt spôsoboval trenie, zápal a pľuzgiere. Craig Spence z IPC poznamenal, že hoci Millsina predchádzajúca protéza bola schválená, nový dizajn lyžiarky nespĺňal predpisy. Vyjadril ľútosť a ocenil Millsin výrazný pokrok počas roka.

article_content: CAMPBELL COUNTY, Kentucky — Republicans hope to undermine Democratic Governor Andy Beshear’s re-election on Tuesday by associating him with President Joe Biden, who remains deeply unpopular in Kentucky. Despite Biden’s unpopularity—he lost the state by over 25 points three years ago—Beshear stands out as a bright spot for Democrats, giving the party some hope for local victories. Voters supporting both Beshear and his Republican challenger, Attorney General Daniel Cameron, told ABC News that Beshear’s reputation is strong enough to withstand attempts to link him to the White House. Steve Megerle, a lifelong Republican attorney from Fort Thomas, shared, 'Andy Beshear is a more liberal Democrat than most Kentucky Democrats, who are usually pretty conservative. Now, is he a clone of Joe Biden? No.' Megerle said he is considering voting for Beshear or leaving the governor's spot blank. At a Cameron campaign event in Richmond, Carol Taylor remarked, 'I probably don’t see Beshear as bad as Biden. I can't say anything good about [Biden].’ Beshear’s path to re-election is uncertain. He is a former state attorney general and the son of a former governor. In 2019, he narrowly defeated an unpopular Republican incumbent. In this predominantly conservative state, he must appeal to a broad range of conservative voters to win, with recent polls showing the race is neck-and-neck. Yet, interviews with more than 20 voters and campaign operatives from both parties suggest there is less animosity toward Beshear than is typical for a governor facing re-election. This could be significant for Democrats running down-ballot in 2024, as they look to distance themselves from Biden while still sharing the ticket with him. Experts point to Beshear’s decisive actions during floods and tornadoes in Kentucky, as well as his frequent travel to disaster sites and advocacy for economic development projects, as major advantages. Beshear also outpaces Cameron in fundraising and advertising. Some Republicans, however, continue to criticize Beshear for the state’s COVID-19 closures. Still, many voters praised his daily pandemic press conferences. Housewife Laura Taylor from Fort Thomas said, 'He was a super calming effect during the pandemic.' Supporter Adele Gormley added, 'He kept us alive during COVID.' Republican leaders have sought to link Beshear to Biden. Cameron said in an interview, 'Joe Biden was endorsed by Andy Beshear, and I can’t think of a bigger slap in the face to Kentuckians.' Some voters echo these concerns. Karson Carrier, a student at Eastern Kentucky University, said, 'I think his values are completely opposite of Kentuckians. I want to see him removed. He's just a puppet for Joe Biden.' Most voters interviewed still see Beshear as his own person. Megerle nicknamed him 'Andy dad jeans.' T.J. Litafik, a GOP strategist, said Beshear’s crisis responses 'put him in the light of a healer-in-chief, with great compassion.' Beshear himself told ABC News that he hasn’t spoken with Biden since last year’s flooding. 'He [Cameron] knows that if it’s me versus him, he can’t win. He’s trying to nationalize this race and trick people,' Beshear said at a campaign stop. The candidates have clashed over issues like abortion access and school choice vouchers. Some Republicans argue that Beshear's bipartisan support is unwarranted, particularly for his role in tax cuts and infrastructure efforts like the Brent Spence Bridge, which critics attribute to actions in Washington rather than in Frankfort. Republican state representative Kim Moser said, 'It’s disturbing to me to see him take credit for that. Unfortunately, not everyone follows policy and legislation as closely as my colleagues and I do.' Regardless of the outcome, experts suggest the Kentucky governor’s race could be an indicator for 2024, as the party winning the last six gubernatorial races has matched the winning presidential party the following year. Scott Jennings, a GOP strategist who has worked with Senate GOP Leader Mitch McConnell, said, 'There are going to be things to learn here whether it’s Cameron or Beshear.' Others caution against over-interpreting state results, especially since Republicans control the Legislature and can block certain policies. Kentucky GOP strategist Jake Cox argued, 'Andy Beshear’s a terrible example for national Democrats, because his positions don’t make him a moderate.' Still, Democrats are watching closely, looking to Beshear’s campaign tactics—particularly his fundraising strategies. At a local bar, Steve Megerle shared that he had received two pro-Cameron campaign flyers, compared to eight from Beshear’s campaign, demonstrating the governor’s significant outreach. While he says it takes a lot for him to consider voting for a Democrat, Megerle said, 'I think I’ll figure it out when I walk into the booth on Election Day.'

Napriek Bidenovej neobľúbenosti — v štáte prehral pred tromi rokmi o viac ako 25 bodov — Beshear vyniká ako nádejný kandidát demokratov a dáva strane šancu na miestny úspech. Voliči podporujúci Besheara aj jeho republikánskeho vyzývateľa, generálneho prokurátora Daniela Camerona, pre ABC News povedali, že Beshearova povesť je dostatočne silná, aby ustála pokusy spájať ho s Bielym domom. Steve Megerle, celoživotný republikánsky právnik z Fort Thomas, poznamenal: 'Andy Beshear je liberálnejší demokrat ako väčšina demokratov v Kentucky, ktorí sú obvykle dosť konzervatívni. Je to klon Joea Bidena? Nie.' Megerle uviedol, že zvažuje, či bude hlasovať za Besheara, alebo riadok pre guvernéra nechá prázdny. Na podujatí Cameronovej kampane v Richmonde Carol Taylor poznamenala: 'Pravdepodobne nevnímam Besheara tak zle ako Bidena. Nemôžem o [Bidenovi] povedať nič dobré.' Beshearova cesta k znovuzvoleniu je neistá. Je bývalým generálnym prokurátorom a synom bývalého guvernéra. V roku 2019 tesne porazil neobľúbeného republikánskeho úradujúceho. V prevažujúco konzervatívnom štáte musí na výhru osloviť široké spektrum konzervatívcov; aktuálne prieskumy ukazujú tesný súboj. Rozhovory s viac než 20 voličmi a kampaňovými pracovníkmi z oboch strán však naznačujú, že voči Beshearovi je menej nepriateľstva, než je pri voľbe guvernéra bežné. To by mohlo byť dôležité pre demokratov kandidujúcich v roku 2024, ktorí sa chcú dištancovať od Bidena, aj keď sú s ním na tej istej kandidačnej listine. Odborníci poukazujú na Beshearove rozhodné kroky počas záplav a tornád v Kentucky, ako aj na časté návštevy postihnutých miest a podporu ekonomického rozvoja ako výraznú výhodu. Beshear taktiež vedie pred Cameronom v získavaní a investovaní prostriedkov do kampane. Niektorí republikáni však kritizujú jeho rozhodnutia o zatváraní počas pandémie COVID-19. Mnohí voliči však vyzdvihli jeho každodenné tlačové brífingy. Gazdinka Laura Taylor z Fort Thomas povedala: 'Počas pandémie bol úžasne upokojujúci.' Podobne Adele Gormley dodala: 'Počas COVIDu nás udržal nažive.' Republikánski lídri sa snažia spájať Besheara s Bidenom. Cameron uviedol: 'Joe Bidena podporil Andy Beshear a nemôžem si predstaviť väčšiu urážku pre obyvateľov Kentucky.' Niektorí voliči tieto obavy zdieľajú. Karson Carrier, študent z Eastern Kentucky University, povedal: 'Jeho hodnoty sú úplne opačné ako hodnoty Kentuckyčanov. Chcem ho vidieť odvolaného. Je len bábkou Joea Bidena.' Väčšina opýtaných voličov však vníma Besheara ako samostatnú osobnosť. Megerle mu dal prezývku 'Andy v otcovských rifliach.' Stratéga GOP T.J. Litafik uviedol, že Beshearove zásahy počas kríz 'ho ukázali ako liečiteľa s veľkým súcitom.' Beshear pre ABC News povedal, že s Bidenom nehovoril od minuloročných záplav. 'Vie, že ak je to medzi mnou a ním, nemôže vyhrať. Snaží sa z tejto voľby urobiť národnú a oklamať ľudí,' povedal Beshear počas kampane. Kandidáti sa rozchádzajú v témach ako právo na interrupcie a poukážky na školné. Niektorí republikáni tvrdia, že Beshearova obľuba medzi všetkými voličmi je nezaslúžená, najmä pokiaľ ide o jeho úlohu pri daňových škrtoch a infraštruktúrnych projektoch typu Brent Spence Bridge, pričom kritici za zásadné kroky považujú skôr Washington ako Frankfort. Republikánska poslankyňa Kim Moser povedala: 'Znepokojuje ma, keď si prisvojuje zásluhy. Bohužiaľ, nie každý sleduje politiku a legislatívu tak pozorne ako ja a moji kolegovia.' Bez ohľadu na výsledok odborníci tvrdia, že voľby v Kentucky môžu byť ukazovateľom pre rok 2024, keďže víťaz posledných šiestich guvernérskych volieb v štáte zodpovedal víťazovi prezidentských volieb nasledujúci rok. Stratég GOP Scott Jennings, ktorý spolupracoval s lídrom senátnej republikánskej väčšiny Mitchom McConnellom, uviedol: 'Tu sa bude dať veľa naučiť bez ohľadu na to, či vyhrá Cameron alebo Beshear.' Iní však varujú pred preceňovaním výsledkov na štátnej úrovni, najmä keďže republikáni kontrolujú zákonodarný zbor a môžu blokovať určité politiky. Stratég Kentucky GOP Jake Cox je presvedčený: 'Andy Beshear je hrozný príklad pre národných demokratov, lebo jeho postoje z neho rozhodne nerobia umierneného.' Napriek tomu demokrati sledujú Beshearove kampanistické taktiky — najmä jeho prístup k získavaniu finančných prostriedkov. V miestnom bare Steve Megerle ukázal, že dostal dve letáky od Cameronovej kampane a osem od Besheara, čo poukazuje na rozsiahly záber guvernéra. Hoci hovorí, že len málokedy by volil demokrata, poznamenal: 'Rozhodnem sa, keď vo volebnej miestnosti vstúpim do kabínky.'

article_content: After a hot weekend for many, hopes were high for warm weather during the upcoming bank holiday. Unfortunately, forecasters predict heavy rain throughout the weekend. A period of low pressure is expected to sweep across Britain on Friday, potentially causing disruption for those heading to festivals, sports events, or holidays. On Monday, the River Irwell overflowed, resulting in flooding in Ramsbottom, East Lancashire. The Environment Agency had issued a flood alert along the Irwell, but some drivers in Ramsbottom were still caught unprepared. At times, umbrellas were no match for the rainfall. This unsettled weather will remind many of the Jubilee weekend in June, when street parties and celebrations were marred by rain. The Thames river pageant also faced heavy showers, drenching many spectators who had traveled to London. The prospect of another rainy bank holiday is especially disappointing after recent sunny spells. The Department of Health issued a heatwave alert for the south-east and east of England over the weekend, with temperatures reaching 32°C (90°F) in Cavendish, Suffolk. Meteogroup’s forecaster Paul Knightley explained that last week’s hot weather is being replaced by a series of low-pressure systems from the west. He warned that rain will affect most of England and Wales this weekend, with showers arriving in parts of south-west England and Wales on Friday, and the worst weather hitting southern England on Saturday. He said Sunday is likely to be the best day of the holiday, although Scotland’s temperatures may not exceed 15°C (59°F). Monday could see more wind and rain moving in from the south-west. 'It's certainly not looking good for the weekend. You could say it's typical bank holiday weather,' he noted. A car got stuck in floodwaters in St Helens, Merseyside, after heavy downpours caused flash flooding. Major events potentially affected include the rugby league Challenge Cup at Wembley, horse racing at Cheltenham, the Reading and Leeds music festivals, and the Notting Hill carnival. Some areas have already seen thunderstorms and flash flooding, with motorists in Ramsbottom, Lancashire, driving through deep water after intense rainfall. Yorkshire experienced particularly wet conditions, with 6.8mm of rain falling in a short period. Last weekend saw temperatures as high as 32°C (90°F), but over the bank holiday, temperatures are not expected to exceed 20°C (68°F). Travelers will also face higher petrol prices, which have increased by 6p per litre since the start of summer, according to the AA. Petrol prices, having dropped to 130.81p per litre by July, have climbed back up to just under 137p. Diesel went from 136.12p to 141.66p per litre. The AA reported that 46% of its members plan to travel over the bank holiday, with people in Northern Ireland and north-east England most likely to hit the road, while Scots are happiest to stay home. Among those driving, day trips are most popular (42%), followed by weekend getaways and then longer holidays. Trafficmaster identified the M3/M27/A31 to the Dorset coast, the M5 to south-west England, and the A303 through Hampshire, Wiltshire, and Somerset as likely hotspots for congestion.

article_content: Japanese Wagyu beef is famous worldwide for its unmistakable flavor, buttery texture, and premium reputation. While visitors often know it's pricey and delicious, many are surprised by what makes Wagyu stand apart. Wagyu, meaning 'Japanese cow', refers to four breeds: black, brown/red, shorthorn, and polled. Black cattle make up over 90% of Wagyu beef produced. Generations of careful breeding and strict record-keeping have given Wagyu its legendary status, earning it the nickname ‘caviar of beef’. Thanks in part to savvy marketing, Wagyu has become celebrated internationally, though this surge in popularity has also led to confusion, especially around Kobe beef. All Kobe beef is Wagyu—but only a small fraction of Wagyu is classified as Kobe, which makes Kobe beef especially rare. Wagyu quality begins with Japan’s historical isolation during the Edo period, keeping livestock genetics pure. After the Meiji era, breeding efforts intensified, always with flavor as the top goal. Wagyu is most notable for its marbling—the fine lines of fat that run through the meat. Cattle are typically raised for more than 30 months, enjoying a rich diet and a calm environment so their meat is especially tender and richly marbled. In comparison, American beef cattle are usually processed at about 22 months. Every Wagyu animal has a 10-digit code for easy tracking, overseen by Japan's National Livestock Breeding Center. The Japan Meat Grading Association uses a system rating both yield (A–C) and quality (1–5); A5 is the highest rating. Most top Wagyu falls into the A4–A5 range. Raising Wagyu requires time and care, resulting in higher prices—expect authentic Wagyu meals in Japan to range from ¥5,000 to ¥15,000 per person. Many opt for F1 beef (Wagyu crossed with another breed like Angus) for a more affordable yet tasty alternative. "Wagyu is seen as a special treat, typically for celebrations," explains Troy Lee, chef at Oak Door Steakhouse. Japanese butchers make use of nearly every part of the cow for quality cuts, unlike the select few parts often used in the U.S. Preparing Wagyu highlights its unique qualities. Best cooked medium-rare to medium, it shines in dishes like steaks, but also traditional hot pots—sukiyaki and shabu-shabu—or, less often, as tartar or sushi. Signature dipping sauces often use miso, sesame, or citrus flavors. Common myths suggest Wagyu cattle regularly get massages or drink beer, but in truth these practices are rare and not routine—used occasionally by some smaller farms, not the industry standard. Antibiotics are rarely used in Wagyu rearing, as the focus is on raising healthy, robust cattle naturally. Importantly, Wagyu’s fat is mainly monounsaturated, containing healthy Omega-3s that enhance umami flavor. Studies show it has up to 30% more unsaturated fat than Angus beef and is prized for its health benefits. The mix-up between Kobe and Wagyu is common, but only around 3,000 cattle annually are certified as Kobe beef. Kobe beef exports only began in 2012, making it extremely rare outside Japan. While famous regions like Matsusaka, Kobe, and Ohmi produce the most acclaimed Wagyu, other areas—like Kumamoto—offer varieties prized for their leanness. Only a handful of certified producers export authentic Wagyu outside Japan, so Japan remains the top destination for a true Wagyu experience.

Návštevníkov často prekvapí, čím je Wagyu výnimočné, aj keď vedia, že ide o drahú delikatesu. Wagyu, čo znamená 'japonská krava', zahŕňa štyri plemená: čierne, hnedé/červené, krátkorohé a bezrohé. Vyše 90 % Wagyu pochádza z čierneho dobytka. Generácie starostlivého šľachtenia a prísnej evidencie urobili z Wagyu legendu a získalo prezývku ‘kaviár medzi hovädzím’. Aj vďaka šikovnému marketingu sa Wagyu stalo svetovým pojmom, čo však vyvolalo zmätok, najmä okolo Kobe beef. Každé Kobe je Wagyu, ale len zlomok Wagyu má označenie Kobe – preto je Kobe výnimočne vzácne. Kvalita Wagyu sa začala už počas éry Edo, keď bolo Japonsko uzavreté a dobytok si zachoval čisté plemeno. Počas éry Meidži sa rozbehlo intenzívne šľachtenie, pričom hlavnou prioritou bola chuť. Najvýraznejšou črtou Wagyu je mramorovanie – jemné tukové žilky vyplňujúce mäso. Dobyto je chované viac než 30 mesiacov, s výdatnou stravou a pokojným prostredím, čo zaručuje mimoriadnu jemnosť a bohaté mramorovanie. Americký dobytok sa zvyčajne poráža okolo 22 mesiacov. Každý Wagyu má jedinečný 10-miestny kód dohľadania, ktorý spravuje Národné centrum pre šľachtenie dobytka v Japonsku. Asociácia pre hodnotenie mäsa používa systém, kde sa hodnotí výťažnosť (A–C) a kvalita (1–5); A5 je najvyššie hodnotenie. Väčšina kvalitného Wagyu dosahuje A4–A5. Chov Wagyu je časovo a finančne náročný, preto sú ceny vyššie – očakávajte autentické jedlo Wagyu v Japonsku od 5 000 do 15 000 jenov na osobu. Mnohí si volia F1 hovädzie (kríženec Wagyu s iným plemenom, napr. Angus) ako dostupnejšiu a stále chutnú možnosť. „Wagyu je špeciálna pochúťka, skôr na oslavy,“ hovorí šéfkuchár Troy Lee z Oak Door Steakhouse. Japonskí mäsiari využijú skoro každú časť kravy na kvalitné rezy, narozdiel od vybraných častí v USA. Príprava Wagyu zdôrazňuje jeho kvalitu. Najlepšie vynikne ako steak stredne prepečený, taktiež v tradičných horúcich jedlách – sukiyaki či shabu-shabu alebo, zriedkavšie, ako tatarák či sushi. Typické omáčky bývajú s misom, sezamom alebo citrusom. Mýty, že Wagyu dobytok masírujú alebo napájajú pivom, sú väčšinou len legendy a v skutočnosti sú tieto praktiky veľmi výnimočné – používajú ich len niektoré menšie farmy, určite nie štandardne. Antibiotiká sa pri chove Wagyu používajú minimálne, dôraz sa kladie na prirodzený odchov. Tuk v mäse Wagyu je najmä mononenasýtený a obsahuje zdravé omega-3, ktoré zvýrazňujú chuť umami. Štúdie ukazujú až o 30% viac nenasýteného tuku oproti hovädzine Angus. Zámena Kobe a Wagyu je bežná, no ročne je certifikovaných len asi 3 000 kráv na Kobe beef. Export Kobe začal až od roku 2012, preto je mimo Japonska veľmi vzácny. Oblasti ako Matsusaka, Kobe a Ohmi ponúkajú najslávnejšie Wagyu, no aj iné regióny (napr. Kumamoto) sú známe pre chudšiu verziu tohto mäsa. Len zopár certifikovaných producentov exportuje Wagyu mimo Japonska, takže najlepší zážitok si doprajete práve v Japonsku.

Maldives president-elect Mohamed Muizzu has reiterated his commitment to withdrawing Indian military personnel from the Maldives, stating this will happen through diplomatic negotiations. Muizzu, who will assume office next month, said ensuring the exit of Indian troops remains his main priority and he hopes it occurs during his first week in office. While he is widely regarded as more favorable towards China compared to his predecessor, Muizzu clarified in an interview with Al Jazeera that his administration will follow a strictly 'pro-Maldives' policy, prioritizing national security and Maldivian interests over alignment with any foreign power.

Muizzu shared that he has already engaged with the Indian High Commissioner during the presidential transition and emphasized the urgency of troop withdrawal. Indian officials, he said, responded positively and indicated willingness to cooperate. Muizzu acknowledged he does not know the exact number of Indian soldiers in the Maldives. He stressed the country's tradition of not hosting foreign troops and its relatively small defense forces, adding that foreign troops do not make the Maldives feel safer. The president-elect affirmed that any nation respecting the Maldives' position could be recognized as a friend. Muizzu defeated Ibrahim Solih in the presidential runoff; Solih was perceived as more closely aligned with India.

(Elsewhere, Indian telecom companies allege global tech firms like Microsoft and Amazon are avoiding regulatory routes and causing financial losses by sending business messages over WhatsApp. The Indian government has asked Apple to participate in a probe into alleged iPhone hacking attempts targeting opposition figures. Indian aviation authorities have permitted lessors to repossess planes and engines from the bankrupt airline Go First, affecting its chances of revival.)

Hoci je často označovaný za politika nakloneného Číne, Muizzu v rozhovore pre Al Jazeeru zdôraznil, že jeho zahraničná politika bude výhradne pro-maldívska – zameraná na národnú bezpečnosť a záujmy krajiny bez priliehania k niektorej mocnosti.

Millions of people around the globe commemorated 100 years of Scouting with ceremonies centered on peace and tolerance. From Bhutan to Ecuador, 28 million young scouts took part in various events. The largest gathering was a 12-day World Scout Jamboree in southern England, bringing together 40,000 scouts from many countries.

Brownsea Island, located off England’s southern coast and recognized as the birthplace of the movement, hosted 300 scouts from over 160 nations for an anniversary camp. Robert Baden-Powell, Scouting’s founder, created the movement after his military service, emphasizing values of trust, loyalty, and doing one’s best for boys and girls from age six.

Sunrise ceremonies saw scouts from countries like Lebanon, Rwanda, Nepal, Serbia, Libya, and Argentina waving their flags as they renewed their pledge to the movement. In Romania, scouts formed a human chain around the Parliament in Bucharest to symbolize youth involvement in their country’s future. Scouts in Namibia prepared breakfast over a campfire, while those in Malawi camped atop Mount Mulanje. Iconic sites such as the Taj Mahal, Eiffel Tower, and Sydney Opera House also featured sunrise celebrations.

At Brownsea Island, scouts heard a reading of Baden-Powell’s original speech, advocating global friendship and cooperation over division. Young participants, including Alistair from Manchester and Ana Mejia from Honduras, spoke about unity, peace, and the importance of mutual support among scouts worldwide. Baden-Powell’s book, ‘Scouting for Boys,’ remains among the best-selling books globally.

Najväčším podujatím bolo 12-dňové svetové skautské jamboree v južnom Anglicku s účasťou 40-tisíc skautov z mnohých krajín.

Ostrov Brownsea pri južnom pobreží Anglicka, známy ako rodisko skautingu, privítal na výročnom tábore 300 skautov zo viac ako 160 štátov. Zakladateľ hnutia Robert Baden-Powell vytvoril skauting po svojej vojenskej službe a zdôraznil hodnoty dôvery, lojality a snahy robiť všetko najlepšie, pre chlapcov aj dievčatá od šiestich rokov.

Počas ranných ceremónií skauti z Libanonu, Rwandy, Nepálu, Srbska, Líbye a Argentíny mávali svojimi vlajkami a obnovili svoj skautský sľub. V Rumunsku vytvorili skauti živú reťaz okolo parlamentu v Bukurešti, aby symbolizovali úlohu mládeže v budúcnosti krajiny. Skauti v Namíbii si pripravovali raňajky pri táborovom ohni, zatiaľ čo tí z Malawi táborili na hore Mulanje. Oslavy východu slnka sa konali aj na ikonických miestach, ako sú Tádž Mahál, Eiffelova veža či Opera v Sydney.

Na Brownsea Island si účastníci vypočuli pôvodný prejav Baden-Powella o priateľstve a spolupráci namiesto rozdeľovania. Mladí skauti, ako Alistair z Manchestru a Ana Mejia z Hondurasu, hovorili o jednote, mieri a potrebe vzájomnej podpory v rámci celosvetového skautského hnutia. Baden-Powellova kniha „Skauting pre chlapcov“ sa stále radí medzi najpredávanejšie publikácie sveta.

article_content: NEW DELHI: Following India's heartbreaking loss to Australia in the ICC ODI World Cup final, captain Rohit Sharma acknowledged that the team was 'not good enough on the day.' Since then, Sharma has kept a low profile in the media. A heartwarming video featuring Sharma's five-year-old daughter, Samaira, has recently gone viral on social media. The video, which is an older recording from a family trip to the UK during a period when Rohit had COVID-19, captures a candid moment. Samaira, along with her mother Ritika, was seen leaving a building and was approached by media personnel. Unfazed by the attention, Samaira graciously waved to the reporters. When asked about her father's whereabouts, she replied, 'He is in his room.' In response to whether her father was fine, she answered, 'He is almost positive... but in one month, he will laugh.' The adorable Samaira then ended the impromptu interview and left with her mother. Despite India's defeat in the final, Rohit Sharma's performance earned widespread praise. He was named the captain of the ICC's Team of the Tournament, with six Indian players, including Player of the Tournament Virat Kohli, featured in the XI. Rohit played fearlessly throughout the tournament, finishing as the second-highest run-scorer with 597 runs in 11 matches at an average of 54.27, including one century and three half-centuries. After the match, Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Indian team in the dressing room to console them following their loss.

Na sociálnych sieťach momentálne koluje dojemné video, v ktorom účinkuje Rohitova päťročná dcéra Samaira. Bol vymenovaný za kapitána ICC Tímu turnaja, v ktorom bolo zaradených šesť indických hráčov, vrátane hráča turnaja Virata Kohliho. Rohit hral počas turnaja odvážne a skončil ako druhý najlepší nadhadzovač so 597 bodmi v 11 zápasoch, s priemerom 54,27, vrátane jednej stovky a troch päťdesiatok. article_content: Four people were injured when a sudden gust of wind triggered a Dust Devil, causing marquees to lift and fly outside the Rose Bowl stadium in Pasadena, California, on Wednesday. Spectators ran for safety as metal structures were airborne and crashed back down repeatedly outside the stadium, just one day before the college football semi-final. Emergency responders treated the injured once the winds subsided. The National Weather Service has warned that the wind threat remains, with advisories in effect until 9 a.m. Thursday across the San Fernando Valley, Santa Clarita Valley, San Gabriel Valley, and Ventura County. Weather experts caution that these conditions could disrupt the Oregon vs. Florida State game on New Year’s Day. Dust Devils are strong whirlwinds that can reach up to 10 meters wide and 100 meters tall. Videos shared on social media show a large tent billowing into the air and crashing onto parked cars, illustrating the chaotic scene outside the Rose Bowl. The competing teams are vying for a place in the College Football Playoff Championship on January 12.

article_content: Gary Lewin, the England team physio, suffered a serious ankle injury while celebrating Daniel Sturridge’s goal during England’s World Cup match against Italy in Manaus, Brazil. Lewin dislocated his ankle, broke his tibia, and fractured his fibula after slipping on wet artificial turf near the dugout, reportedly sprayed by Brazilian grounds staff. His wife, Maggie Lewin, expressed disappointment over his early departure from the tournament and suggested the pitch conditions contributed to the incident. Lewin received immediate treatment from both FIFA officials and players before being stretchered off the field and later left the hospital to fly home. Photos showed him saying goodbye to training staff at the team hotel in Rio de Janeiro. The pitch in Manaus had previously been criticized for its condition, with visible issues during and after the match, including loose and painted turf. England team manager Roy Hodgson confirmed the nature of Lewin’s injuries, explaining that the team doctor was able to set his ankle temporarily at the side of the pitch. Players like Frank Lampard were quick to help Lewin after the incident. On the plane home, teammates lightheartedly remarked that Lewin, usually responsible for their well-being, needed care himself. Lewin’s daughter, Rebecca, confirmed he had left the hospital but admitted he was upset about missing the rest of the tournament. Former England captain Rio Ferdinand apologized on social media after initially making a joke about Lewin’s injury, later acknowledging its severity. Lewin had been England’s physio since 1996 and previously spent 22 years at Arsenal. His injury closely followed that of assistant coach Ray Lewington, who recently underwent emergency knee surgery.

article_content: A 19-year-old Army private was arrested Thursday, one day after airport screeners allegedly found a small quantity of C4 explosive in his checked luggage at Yuma International Airport in Arizona. Officials said there was no evidence to suggest he intended any harm with the explosive. According to the U.S. attorney's office, Private First Class Christopher Eric Wey was attempting to board a United Airlines flight to Los Angeles on Wednesday when Transportation Security Administration (TSA) screeners detected the explosive in his luggage. TSA personnel found half an ounce of C4 hidden in a tobacco can inside one of Wey’s bags. He was detained and interviewed by FBI agents. Wey has been charged with attempting to carry an explosive onto an aircraft and with transporting a stolen explosive. If convicted, he could face up to 10 years in prison and a $250,000 fine. Federal prosecutors allege that Wey stole the C4 while attending a recent explosives training course. Wey’s attorney from the federal defender's office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. TSA Administrator John Pistole praised the officers involved, stating, 'At airports across the country, TSA employees are on the frontlines every day, working to mitigate threats and keep the traveling public safe. With a concerted effort to find explosives, this incident demonstrates the abilities of our highly trained officers and advanced technology.' CNN’s Bill Mears contributed to this report.

Úrady uviedli, že neexistujú dôkazy o tom, že by mal v úmysle s výbušninou spôsobiť škodu. article_content: Members of the Writers Guild of America (WGA) have decisively ratified a new contract with the Alliance of Motion Picture and Television Producers (AMPTP), following an extended period of striking. The agreement was supported by 99% of voting members—8,435 in favor, 90 against. WGA West President Meredith Stiehm credited the union’s solidarity and the negotiating team’s efforts for securing contract terms that bring lasting changes across the industry. The AMPTP welcomed the agreement, noting it offers meaningful improvements for writers and marks an important step forward as work resumes across Hollywood. Effective from September 25, 2023, through May 1, 2026, the contract guarantees writers at least a 12% rise in minimum pay over three years, increases residual compensation for major streaming films by 26%, and for the first time, provides union members with confidential access to streaming audience data. The deal also addresses the use of artificial intelligence in writing. Studios cannot use AI to generate or revise scripts, nor can they compel writers to use AI; writers may choose to use AI if the studio approves. Studios remain permitted to train AI using existing scripts. The WGA has urged studios to negotiate a fair contract with SAG-AFTRA, whose 160,000 members—mostly actors—are continuing their own strike, focused partly on matters like streaming profits. During the writers' strike, SAG-AFTRA showed support by joining picket lines. With the new contract in place, prominent late-night shows such as 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!' and 'The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon' have resumed production. The writers’ dispute arose from shifts in the entertainment business, especially the transition to streaming, which has transformed how writers are paid and how their work is distributed.

Dohodu podporilo 99 % hlasujúcich členov – 8 435 za, 90 proti. Prezidentka WGA West Meredith Stiehm pripísala úspech solidarite v odboroch a úsiliu vyjednávacieho tímu za zabezpečenie zmluvných podmienok, ktoré prinášajú odvetviu trvalé zmeny. article_content: Japan has released approximately 11,500 tons of radioactive water from the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant into the Pacific Ocean. This emergency measure was taken to prevent more severe leaks following the recent earthquake and tsunami. According to Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO), most of the discharged water—about 10,000 tons—comes from the central waste treatment facility, which will soon store more highly radioactive water from reactor No. 2. Water from reactors Nos. 5 and 6, believed to be groundwater contamination, is also being released. Officials have described the discharge as 'unavoidable' to manage the increasing water volume and reduce risks. The highest radiation levels are found in water from reactor No. 6, but concerns mainly surround reactor No. 2, where radioactive water is leaking into the sea through a crack. Current efforts include trying to seal leaks, installing silt fences, and using dye tracers to monitor the spread of radioactive material. Experts assert that the enormous volume of the Pacific Ocean will dilute the released contaminants and that the environmental impact will be minimal. The released water equals about 3 million gallons, a negligible amount compared to the ocean’s size. Even so, authorities and scientists emphasize the importance of ongoing radiation monitoring, especially for seafood, to protect public health. The water being discharged contains iodine-131 at concentrations above food safety limits, but experts believe it will dilute to safe levels quickly. Attempts to stop leaks at reactor No. 2 have been difficult, and further direct discharges may be necessary while officials stabilize reactor units and deal with water buildup. Engineers have transitioned some reactor cooling systems from temporary diesel generators to a more stable external power supply. The Japanese government has insisted that it will not loosen food safety standards. However, it will lift some restrictions on crop sales in certain areas if repeated testing proves the products are safe.

Voda z reaktorov č. 5 a 6, ktorá sa považuje za znečistenú podzemnú vodu, je takisto vypúšťaná. Úrady označili vypúšťanie za „nevyhnutné“ na zvládnutie rastúceho objemu vody a zníženie rizík. Najvyššie úrovne radiácie boli zistené vo vode z reaktora č. 6, no hlavné obavy sa týkajú reaktora č. 2, kde rádioaktívna voda uniká do mora cez prasklinu. Uvoľnená voda predstavuje asi 3 milióny galónov, čo je v porovnaní s veľkosťou oceánu zanedbateľné množstvo. Vypúšťaná voda obsahuje jód-131 v koncentráciách nad povolené potravinové limity, no podľa odborníkov by sa mala rýchlo zriediť na bezpečné úrovne. Inžinieri presunuli viacero systémov chladenia z dočasných dieselových generátorov na stabilnejší externý zdroj energie. Japonská vláda trvá na tom, že štandardy pre bezpečnosť potravín nezníži. Opatrenia obmedzujúce predaj niektorých plodín v určitých oblastiach však môžu byť zrušené, ak opakované testy potvrdia ich bezpečnosť.

article_content: CHISINAU, Moldova — Moldovans participated in nationwide local elections on Sunday amid allegations from authorities that Russia is engaging in 'hybrid warfare' to disrupt the vote in this European Union candidate nation. While local elections in Moldova—a country of about 2.5 million people situated between Romania and Ukraine—typically receive limited international focus, ongoing claims of Russian interference have added a significant geopolitical dimension to this vote. On Sunday, voters chose nearly 900 mayors and 11,000 local councilors for four-year terms, including the pivotal role of Chisinau’s mayor. Approximately 1,500 national and international observers monitored the proceedings. After polls closed at 9 p.m. local time (1900 GMT; 2 p.m. EST), the Central Electoral Commission reported a nationwide turnout of 41%, similar to the figure from Moldova’s last local elections in 2019. Two days prior to the election, Prime Minister Dorin Recean announced a ban on candidates from the pro-Russia Chance Party, following a report by Moldova’s national intelligence agency alleging attempts by Russia to influence the electoral process via the party. This decision affected roughly 600 candidates. 'We are protecting the Republic of Moldova from a well-organized network of criminals. An organized criminal group is removed from the elections, not a political party,' Recean stated during a media briefing. The Intelligence and Security Service (SIS) alleged in its 32-page report that the Chance Party was funded with approximately 50 million euros ($53 million) in Russian money, facilitated by exiled Moldovan oligarch Ilan Shor, to destabilize the country and sway voters in Sunday’s election. Shor, who lives in Israel and was sentenced in absentia to 15 years in prison for fraud in April, denounced the ban in a Facebook post as an 'unprecedented, illegal, raiding power grab,' while providing a list of alternative endorsements. Addressing the party ban on Sunday, President Maia Sandu stated, 'Elections are about democracy and compliance with the law. Those who do not follow the law, bribe voters, or use illegal money do not meet democratic standards.' If no mayoral candidate secures at least 50% of the vote, a runoff will occur in two weeks between the two with the highest scores. At a polling station in Chisinau, retiree Anatol Mosanu said he voted for 'a better life, better roads ... for tomorrow to be better than today.' He also expressed hope that future generations would remain in Moldova, referencing high levels of youth emigration for better work opportunities abroad. Cristian Cantir, a Moldovan associate professor of international relations at Oakland University, remarked that while the election focuses on local issues, it has important geopolitical implications: 'Moldova remains very polarized geopolitically; the debate centers on pro-EU and anti-EU messaging.' He described the SIS report as 'pretty damning,' suggesting substantial evidence of Ilan Shor’s efforts with Russian support to undermine the electoral process. Recently, Moldovan authorities blocked numerous Russian media sites, including Russia Today, accusing them of running disinformation campaigns. Additional suspensions targeted local TV stations allegedly linked to Shor and another exiled oligarch, Vladimir Plahotniuc, citing their role in influencing the election and promoting pro-Russian narratives. Both Shor and Plahotniuc were sanctioned by the US and UK in 2022. Since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022, non-NATO member Moldova has endured ongoing challenges, including a severe energy crisis due to reduced Russian gas supplies, soaring inflation, and incidents of missile debris from the war in Ukraine falling onto Moldovan territory. Shor led the Russia-friendly Shor Party, declared unconstitutional in June after protests against the pro-Western government, which accused the party of attempting to destabilize the country. In February, President Sandu outlined an alleged Russian plot to topple Moldova’s government and derail its aim for EU integration—a claim Russia denied. Moldova, a former Soviet republic, was granted EU candidate status on June 23, 2022, alongside Ukraine. 'Russia has always sought to undermine democratic elections in Moldova and derail its European aspirations,' Cantir added. 'It remains to be seen how successful those efforts have been.'
translated_content: KIŠINEV, Moldavsko — Moldavci sa v nedeľu zúčastnili celoštátnych komunálnych volieb, ktoré sprevádzali obvinenia úradov, že Rusko sa snaží narušiť hlasovanie prostredníctvom „hybridnej vojny“ v tejto kandidátskej krajine EÚ. Zatiaľ čo miestne voľby v Moldavsku — krajine s približne 2,5 miliónmi obyvateľov medzi Rumunskom a Ukrajinou — zvyčajne nezískavajú veľký medzinárodný záujem, pretrvávajúce tvrdenia o ruskom zasahovaní dávajú tomuto hlasovaniu výrazný geopolitický rozmer. V nedeľu si voliči zvolili takmer 900 starostov a 11 000 miestnych poslancov na štyri roky, vrátane kľúčovej pozície starostu Kišineva. Na priebeh dohliadalo asi 1 500 národných a medzinárodných pozorovateľov. Po zatvorení volebných miestností o 21:00 miestneho času (19:00 GMT; 14:00 EST) Ústredná volebná komisia oznámila celonárodnú účasť 41 %, čo je podobné ako pri posledných komunálnych voľbách v roku 2019. Dva dni pred voľbami premiér Dorin Recean oznámil zákaz kandidátov z proruskej strany Šanca, po správe národnej spravodajskej agentúry, ktorá tvrdila, že Rusko sa prostredníctvom tejto strany snaží ovplyvniť volebný proces. Tento krok sa dotkol približne 600 kandidátov. „Chránime Moldavskú republiku pred dobre organizovanou sieťou zločincov. Z volieb je odstránená organizovaná zločinecká skupina, nie politická strana,“ povedal Recean na brífingu. Bezpečnostná a spravodajská služba (SIS) vo svojej 32-stranovej správe uviedla, že strana Šanca dostala približne 50 miliónov eur (53 miliónov dolárov) z ruských zdrojov, ktoré sprostredkoval exilový moldavský oligarcha Ilan Shor, s cieľom destabilizovať krajinu a ovplyvniť voličov. Shor, ktorý žije v Izraeli a bol v apríli odsúdený v neprítomnosti na 15 rokov väzenia za podvod, označil zákaz na Facebooku za „bezprecedentné, nelegálne uchopenie moci“ a zverejnil zoznam alternatívnych odporúčaní. K zákazu strany sa v nedeľu vyjadrila aj prezidentka Maia Sandu: „Voľby sú o demokracii a dodržiavaní zákona. Tí, ktorí zákony nedodržiavajú, podplácajú voličov alebo používajú nelegálne peniaze, nespĺňajú demokratické štandardy.“ Ak v starostovských voľbách nezíska žiadny kandidát aspoň 50 % hlasov, o dva týždne sa uskutoční druhé kolo medzi dvoma najúspešnejšími kandidátmi. Pri volebnej miestnosti v Kišineve dôchodca Anatol Mosanu povedal, že hlasoval pre „lepšiu budúcnosť, lepšie cesty ... aby zajtrajšok bol lepší ako dnešok“. Tiež vyjadril nádej, že ďalšie generácie zostanú v Moldavsku, pričom poukázal na vysokú mieru emigrácie mladých kvôli lepším pracovným príležitostiam v zahraničí. Cristian Cantir, moldavský docent medzinárodných vzťahov na Oakland University, uviedol, že hoci sú tieto voľby najmä o miestnych témach, majú dôležité geopolitické súvislosti: „Moldavsko zostáva geopoliticky veľmi polarizovanou krajinou; debata sa točí okolo pro-európskych a anti-európskych postojov.“ SIS správu označil za „dosť závažnú“, ktorú považuje za dôkaz, že Ilan Shor s ruskou podporou sa snaží narušiť volebný proces. Nedávno moldavské úrady zablokovali viacero ruských médií, vrátane Russia Today, ktoré obvinili zo šírenia dezinformačných kampaní. Dodatočné pozastavenia vysielania sa týkali miestnych televízií údajne spojených s Shorom a ďalším oligarchom v exile, Vladimirom Plahotniucom, ktoré mali ovplyvňovať voľby a presadzovať proruské naratívy. USA a Veľká Británia v roku 2022 uvalili na Shora a Plahotniuca sankcie. Od začiatku ruskej plnoformátovej invázie na Ukrajinu 24. februára 2022 čelí mimo-NATO Moldavsko pretrvávajúcim problémom vrátane vážnej energetickej krízy pre znížené dodávky plynu z Ruska, prudkému rastu inflácie a pádom častí rakiet z vojny na Ukrajine na svoje územie. Shor viedol proruskú stranu Šor, ktorú Ústavný súd v júni vyhlásil za protiústavnú po protestoch proti prozápadnej vláde, ktorá stranu obvinila z pokusu destabilizovať krajinu. Vo februári prezidentka Sandu predstavila údajný ruský plán na zvrhnutie moldavskej vlády a zmenu jej proeurópskeho smerovania — čo Moskva poprela. Moldavsko, bývalá sovietska republika, získalo štatút kandidáta na členstvo v EÚ 23. júna 2022 spolu s Ukrajinou. „Rusko sa vždy snažilo narúšať demokratické voľby v Moldavsku a zabrzdiť jeho európske ambície,“ dodal Cantir. „Zostáva zistiť, nakoľko v tom uspeli.“

Vaccine science is advancing rapidly, particularly since the COVID-19 pandemic, allowing scientists to create new, targeted vaccines like the latest shots for RSV. These new immunizations are especially important for protecting infants and older adults, but come with steep prices—about $300 per adult dose, and as much as $1,000 for a single monoclonal antibody shot for babies.

The high cost and limited availability have led to a shortage of RSV vaccines for American infants, prompting the CDC to tell doctors to prioritize the most vulnerable babies. This situation is forcing the U.S. to reconsider longstanding questions about vaccine pricing, broad access, and whether advertising influences who receives these vaccines. In the U.S., direct-to-consumer advertising is allowed, leading to increased demand, sometimes among people who may not truly need the shots. This puts more strain on public and private healthcare budgets.

By contrast, European countries negotiate vaccine prices and systematically prioritize those at highest risk, primarily infants. RSV typically causes mild illness, but it can lead to hospitalization or death in infants, people over 75, and individuals with serious medical conditions. In the U.S., about 2% of babies under one year require hospitalization for RSV, and the virus is responsible for up to 300 deaths annually in infants under six months. Early childhood RSV infection also increases the long-term risk of asthma.

Experts, such as Dr. Barney Graham, who helped develop the vaccine technology, emphasize that the greatest benefit is in vaccinating babies. European countries have focused their cost-effectiveness analyses on infants, concluding that high-cost vaccines often don’t justify wider use, and supportive care remains common unless prices drop.

Meanwhile, U.S. pharmaceutical companies first targeted the much larger market of older adults—likely influenced by marketing freedoms and potential profits—making the vaccine accessible in pharmacies. However, insurance coverage for adults is inconsistent since CDC recommendations for people aged 60-75 are conditional, not universal. Many children access vaccines through government programs, but adults may face high out-of-pocket costs if their insurance does not cover the new RSV shots.

Public health experts suggest that the U.S. should adopt stronger policies for vaccine distribution, drawing on successful COVID-19 bulk purchasing and focusing on making vaccines affordable and available to those at greatest risk. Otherwise, high vaccine costs could reduce the overall benefits, both for individuals and the healthcare system.

Vakcínová veda napreduje rýchlym tempom, najmä od pandémie COVID-19, čo vedcom umožňuje vyvíjať nové, cielené vakcíny, ako sú najnovšie očkovania proti RSV. Tieto nové vakcíny sú obzvlášť dôležité na ochranu dojčiat a starších dospelých, no majú vysokú cenu – približne 300 dolárov za dávku pre dospelých a až 1 000 dolárov za jednu dávku monoklonálnej protilátky pre bábätká.

Vysoká cena a obmedzená dostupnosť viedli v USA k nedostatku vakcín proti RSV pre dojčatá, preto CDC odporučilo lekárom dať prednosť tým najzraniteľnejším deťom. Táto situácia núti Spojené štáty prehodnotiť dlhodobé otázky ohľadom cien vakcín, dostupnosti a vplyvu reklamy na to, kto ich dostane. V USA je povolená priama reklama pacientom, čo zvyšuje dopyt – často aj medzi ľuďmi, pre ktorých vakcína nemusí byť určená. Tým sa ešte viac zaťažujú verejné aj súkromné zdravotnícke rozpočty.

Naopak, európske krajiny rokujú o cenách vakcín a systematicky uprednostňujú rizikové skupiny, najmä dojčatá. RSV zvyčajne spôsobuje mierne ochorenie, no môže viesť aj k hospitalizácii alebo úmrtiu u dojčiat, ľudí nad 75 rokov a osôb so závažnými zdravotnými problémami. V USA asi 2 % detí mladších ako jeden rok potrebujú pri RSV hospitalizáciu a vírus je príčinou až 300 úmrtí ročne u dojčiat mladších ako šesť mesiacov. RSV v ranom detstve tiež zvyšuje riziko astmy v budúcnosti.

Odborníci, ako je Dr. Barney Graham, ktorý sa podieľal na vývoji tejto vakcínovej technológie, zdôrazňujú, že najväčší prínos má očkovanie bábätiek. Európske štáty zameriavajú hodnotenia nákladovej efektívnosti najmä na dojčatá a často uzatvárajú, že drahé vakcíny neospravedlňujú širšie využitie, ak cena výrazne neklesne, a uprednostňujú skôr podpornú liečbu.

Medzitým americké farmaceutické spoločnosti najskôr zacielili na väčší trh starších dospelých – pravdepodobne ovplyvnené slobodnejšou reklamou a možnými ziskami – a umožnili dostupnosť vakcíny v lekárňach. Pokrytie očkovania pre dospelých je však rozdielne, keďže odporúčania CDC pre vek 60–75 rokov sú podmienené, nie všeobecné. Mnohé deti dostanú vakcíny cez štátne programy, ale dospelí môžu čeliť vysokým nákladom, ak ich poisťovňa nové očkovanie proti RSV neprepláca.

Verejní zdravotní experti odporúčajú, aby USA prijali lepšiu stratégiu distribúcie vakcín, inšpirovali sa úspešným hromadným nákupom počas pandémie a zabezpečili, že vakcíny budú cenovo dostupné a primárne určené tým, ktorí ich skutočne potrebujú. Inak môžu vysoké ceny vakcín oslabiť celkový prínos, či už pre jednotlivcov alebo pre celý systém zdravotnej starostlivosti.

As the world marks the 45th anniversary of the Apollo 11 moon landing, another significant milestone in space exploration recently passed with little notice. Nearly a century ago, Massachusetts-born Robert Hutchings Goddard received a groundbreaking patent for a liquid-fueled rocket. Although met with skepticism and even ridicule by journalists at the time, this patent laid the foundation for the Apollo missions and the dawn of the space age.

Dr. Goddard, recognized today as the father of modern rocket propulsion, was a modest innovator whose early achievements often went unrecognized. His interest in rocketry drew academic attention as early as 1907, when a smoke-filled powder rocket experiment at Worcester Polytechnic Institute piqued curiosity.

In 1914, Goddard secured two U.S. patents—one for a liquid-fueled rocket and another for a multi-stage solid-fuel rocket. By 1916, he had developed mathematical theories of rocket propulsion. Goddard outlined, as early as 1920, the idea that a rocket could reach the moon and carry a payload, sparking public debate and media controversy regarding its feasibility.

Journalists, including those at The New York Times, dismissed Goddard’s vision, claiming it contradicted the laws of physics. Despite this, Goddard pressed on, achieving the first successful test of a liquid-fueled rocket on March 16, 1926, in Auburn, Massachusetts—a milestone as significant as the Wright brothers’ first flight.

Throughout the 1920s and 1930s, Goddard made numerous advances: launching rockets in New Mexico, incorporating gyroscopes for stabilization, and pioneering guidance systems. His innovations paved the way for modern rocketry and space exploration.

As Apollo 11 approached the moon decades later, The New York Times retracted its earlier skepticism, acknowledging that rockets do indeed work in a vacuum.

Dr. Goddard’s legacy endures through achievements such as:
- Pioneering the feasibility of reaching high altitudes and the moon by rocket (1912).
- Demonstrating that rockets can operate in a vacuum.
- Developing and successfully launching the first liquid-fuel rocket (1926).
- Carrying scientific instruments aboard rockets (1929).
- Innovating guidance and control using vanes and gyro mechanisms (1932-1937).
- Securing U.S. patents for multi-stage rockets (1914).

As Dr. Goddard himself said: “It is difficult to say what is impossible, for the dream of yesterday is the hope of today and the reality of tomorrow.”

(Source: NASA)

Kým si svet pripomína 45. výročie pristátia Apolla 11 na Mesiaci, ďalší významný míľnik v oblasti kozmonautiky nedávno prešiel takmer bez povšimnutia. Pred takmer storočím získal Robert Hutchings Goddard z Massachusetts prelomový patent na raketu s kvapalinovým pohonom. Hoci bol vtedajšou tlačou prijatý so skepsou a dokonca posmechom, tento patent položil základy pre misie Apollo aj celú éru dobývania vesmíru.

Dr. Goddard, dnes uznávaný ako otec modernej raketovej techniky, bol skromný inovátor, ktorého rané zásluhy často ostávali bez povšimnutia. Jeho záujem o raketový pohon vzbudil odborný záujem už v roku 1907, keď na Worcester Polytechnic Institute odpálil práškovú raketu, ktorá zaplnila laboratórium dymom.

V roku 1914 získal Goddard dva americké patenty – na raketu s kvapalinovým pohonom a na viacstupňovú raketu na tuhé palivo. Do roku 1916 rozpracoval matematické teórie raketového pohonu. Už v roku 1920 načrtol myšlienku, že raketa by mohla dosiahnuť Mesiac a dopraviť tam náklad, čo vyvolalo verejnú diskusiu a kontroverziu v médiách ohľadom jej uskutočniteľnosti.

Novinári, vrátane The New York Times, Goddardove vízie odmietali a tvrdili, že odporujú fyzikálnym zákonom. Napriek tomu Goddard pokračoval a 16. marca 1926 v Auburne v Massachusetts úspešne odpálil prvú raketu s kvapalinovým pohonom – udalosť rovnako významnú ako prvý let bratov Wrightovcov.

Počas 20. a 30. rokov 20. storočia Goddard prichádzal s ďalšími inováciami: odpálil rakety v Novom Mexiku, použil gyroskopy na stabilizáciu a vyvíjal riadiace systémy. Jeho objavy pripravili cestu pre modernú raketovú techniku a kozmonautiku.

Keď sa Apollo 11 po desaťročiach blížilo k Mesiacu, The New York Times odvolali svoju skoršiu skepsu a uznali, že rakety v skutočnosti fungujú aj vo vákuu.

Dedičstvo Dr. Goddarda pretrváva jeho úspechmi ako:
- Priekopnícka dokaznosť, že rakety môžu dosiahnuť vysoké výšky a Mesiac (1912)
- Preukázanie, že rakety môžu fungovať vo vákuu
- Vývoj a úspešné odpálenie prvej rakety na kvapalné palivo (1926)
- Doprava vedeckých prístrojov na palube rakiet (1929)
- Inovácia v riadení pomocou klapiek a gyroskopických mechanizmov (1932-1937)
- Získanie amerických patentov na viacstupňové rakety (1914)

Ako sám Goddard povedal: „Je ťažké povedať, čo je nemožné, lebo sen včerajška je nádejou dneška a realitou zajtrajška.“

(Zdroj: NASA)

article_content: The Federal Government of Nigeria has reduced the fraud charges against former Central Bank Governor Godwin Emefiele from 20 counts to six. These charges stem from alleged procurement irregularities during his tenure. Originally, the government accused Emefiele and two co-defendants—CBN employee Sa’adatu Yaro and her company, April 1616 Investment Ltd.—of procurement fraud amounting to N6.9 billion. The amended charges, filed after Emefiele’s release by the Department of State Services and his subsequent re-arrest by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission on October 27, now focus only on Emefiele, with the alleged fraud amount reduced to N1.2 billion. The amended charge sheet, marked CR/577/2023 and reviewed by The Punch on Wednesday, accuses Emefiele of awarding contracts for the procurement of 43 vehicles between 2018 and 2020, allegedly to the benefit of Sa’adatu Yaro through her company. Specifically, Emefiele is accused of giving a corrupt advantage to Yaro by awarding a contract for 37 Toyota Hilux vehicles valued at N854.7 million, a Toyota Avalon for N99.9 million, and a Toyota Land Cruiser V8 for N73 million, all to April 1616 Investment Ltd., where Yaro is a director. Additional counts cite illegal procurement of another Toyota Land Cruiser V8 at N73.8 million and two Toyota Hilux Shell Specification vehicles at N44.2 million. Court hearings have been stalled twice, initially because the DSS failed to bring Emefiele to court and now due to a nationwide strike by the Nigeria Labour Congress and Trade Union Congress, following an attack on NLC President Joe Ajaero in Imo State. On Wednesday, Judiciary Staff Union of Nigeria members joined the strike, and courtrooms were empty of lawyers and litigants. Emefiele was scheduled to be arraigned but proceedings have been postponed due to these industrial actions.
translated_content: Federálna vláda Nigérie znížila počet obvinení z podvodu voči bývalému guvernérovi Centrálnej banky Godwinovi Emefielemu z 20 na šesť. Tieto obvinenia sa týkajú údajných nezrovnalostí pri verejnom obstarávaní počas jeho pôsobenia. Pôvodne vláda obvinila Emefieleho a dvoch ďalších – zamestnankyňu CBN Sa’adatu Yaro a jej spoločnosť April 1616 Investment Ltd. – z podvodu pri verejnom obstarávaní v hodnote 6,9 miliardy naira. Upravené obvinenia, podané po Emefieleho prepustení Štátnou bezpečnostnou službou a následnom zadržaní Komisiou pre hospodárske a finančné zločiny 27. októbra, sa teraz týkajú iba Emefieleho a suma údajného podvodu bola znížená na 1,2 miliardy naira. Nový spis obvinenia s označením CR/577/2023, ktorý v stredu preskúmal denník The Punch, obviňuje Emefieleho z udeľovania zákaziek na obstaranie 43 vozidiel medzi rokmi 2018 a 2020, údajne v prospech Sa’adatu Yaro prostredníctvom jej spoločnosti. Konkrétne je Emefiele obvinený z poskytnutia nečestnej výhody Yaro tým, že zadal zákazku na 37 vozidiel Toyota Hilux v hodnote 854,7 milióna naira, jedno vozidlo Toyota Avalon za 99,9 milióna naira a Toyota Land Cruiser V8 za 73 miliónov naira, všetko pre April 1616 Investment Ltd., kde je Yaro riaditeľkou. Ďalšie body obvinenia sa týkajú nelegálneho obstarania ďalšieho Land Cruiseru V8 za 73,8 milióna naira a dvoch vozidiel Toyota Hilux Shell Specification za 44,2 milióna naira. Súdne pojednávania boli dvakrát odložené, najprv preto, že DSS nepriniesla Emefieleho na súd, a teraz kvôli celoštátnemu štrajku Nigérijského odborového kongresu a Odborového kongresu, ku ktorému došlo po útoku na prezidenta NLC Joea Ajaera v štáte Imo. V stredu sa k štrajku pripojili aj členovia odborového zväzu súdnych zamestnancov Nigérie a súdne miestnosti boli bez právnikov a účastníkov konania. Emefiele mal byť postavený pred súd, ale konanie bolo kvôli týmto protestným akciám odložené.

article_content: This heartwarming moment shows a gentle Labrador named Himalaya befriending a young boy with Down syndrome, encouraging him to play. Herman, now five, from La Plata, Buenos Aires, was filmed as Himalaya approached him on the patio. The video, posted on YouTube by Herman's mother Ana, has touched many viewers. Herman usually shies away from physical contact due to his condition, but Himalaya patiently tries to engage him. In the video, the boy initially hesitates—moving away when Himalaya puts a gentle paw on his foot. The determined dog tries again, placing a paw on Herman's feet and gently resting her head in his lap. Over time, Herman slowly gains confidence, eventually touching Himalaya, stroking her snout, and examining her teeth. Although he continues to push Himalaya away, it becomes more playful, and by the end of the four-minute video, the pair sit side by side, content. Herman is believed to be interacting with his uncle's dog. Down syndrome is a genetic condition that often leads to some learning delays and distinctive physical traits. Ana wrote on YouTube that her son typically avoids contact, but Himalaya's persistent, gentle approach led to this touching exchange.
translated_content: Tento dojímavý moment zachytáva, ako jemný labrador menom Himalaya nadväzuje priateľstvo s malým chlapcom s Downovým syndrómom a povzbudzuje ho k hre. Hermana, ktorý má teraz päť rokov a pochádza z La Plata v Buenos Aires, natočili na videu, ako k nemu na terase pristupuje Himalaya. Video, ktoré zverejnila Hermanova mama Ana na YouTube, dojalo mnohých divákov. Herman sa kvôli svojmu zdravotnému stavu zvyčajne vyhýba fyzickému kontaktu, no Himalaya sa ho trpezlivo snaží zapojiť do hry. Vo videu chlapec spočiatku váha – keď mu Himalaya položí jemnú labku na nohu, ustúpi. Rozhodný pes to skúša znova, položí labku na Hermanove nohy a jemne si položí hlavu do jeho lona. article_content: At least three people died Monday on a dust-covered stretch of highway in Arizona when 19 vehicles collided due to poor visibility, according to a spokesman for the Arizona Department of Public Safety. Bart Graves reported that 12 others were injured—many seriously—during the dust storm-related series of crashes, which were flagged to CNN via Twitter. Six tractor-trailers, a motor home, and a dozen cars and trucks were involved in one of the pileups on Interstate 10 near Picacho Peak. One semi-truck had its front end crushed back to the windshield, and another trailer appeared to have a car lodged underneath. A pickup truck was found lying on its side ahead of the main cluster of wrecked vehicles. Authorities said at least two helicopter crews responded to assist the injured. Westbound traffic between mileposts 214 and 216 was detoured to a side road, and other drivers were advised to avoid the area, as the highway is expected to remain closed for some time.
