Playing through a dinosaur exhibit as a Hot Wheels monster truck, I realized this racing game was made for the five-year-old version of myself. Growing up, I owned countless Hot Wheels, a way my dad shared his love of cars with me. When I played Milestone's 2021 sleeper hit, Hot Wheels Unleashed, it brought back some childhood nostalgia—though not as much as with its improved sequel, Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged.

Hot Wheels Unleashed 2 isn’t the most complex or difficult racer. Its story mode isn’t very coherent, and the slot machine-like system for unlocking cars doesn’t feel right in a game for kids. However, a few new features make for a faster, more enjoyable racing experience for kids and adults alike.

Milestone’s Hot Wheels titles are straightforward arcade racers where boosting, drifting, and outdriving opponents are the main objectives. In this sequel, the familiar formula is offered in different modes, from standard three-lap races to Elimination mode, which removes the last-place players at intervals. Boosting and drifting remain essential and satisfying. Returning to the original after trying this sequel would be difficult, as Turbocharged improves on the original’s formula by letting players use the boost meter for new actions.

Now, you can use the boost meter to jump or quickly dash sideways. Jumps let you bypass large gaps, while lateral dashes can knock rivals off course, adding greater mobility and strategy. It’s easier to recover and get back on track without a full reset, even though vehicles are still fragile and easy to knock off the track. Moves like midair jumps or lateral dashes rely on boost energy, encouraging players to drift more and thoughtfully manage their boost meter.

This sequel isn’t just about recreating nostalgia. It's genuinely fun for kids, and even adults can enjoy the simple excitement of speedy racing. The game features new, outdoor-themed maps and more off-road segments, with imaginative settings such as backyards and dinosaur museums. A new Waypoint mode allows free exploration off-road, appealing especially to younger players who can explore at their own pace thanks to the enhanced movement mechanics.

The visuals are bright and playful, capturing the plastic look of Hot Wheels against realistic environments. Track and car editors return, offering robust options for creating and customizing your own Hot Wheels experiences. Although complex tools might be overwhelming for younger kids, access to community-made tracks and vehicles provides almost limitless content. Even without online features, the single-player experience is thorough.

Importantly, Hot Wheels Unleashed 2 features paid DLC but no real-money microtransactions at launch, unlike some competitors. Players can enjoy Quick Play, Time Attack, Drift Master, Elimination, and Waypoint as standalone or integrated into the Creature Rampage campaign. The campaign, aimed at children, centers on Hot Wheels racers teamed with a scientist and a robot to stop escaped monsters. While the comic-book cutscenes are simplistic and written for kids, they are easy to ignore in favor of the game's real strength: its racing challenges and objectives. Completing missions rewards customization items, experience, skill points, Hot Wheels Spin tokens, and currency. Skill points unlock special abilities, such as immunity to certain obstacles, and currency lets players buy new vehicles, including motorcycles, ATVs, and monster trucks. However, the slot machine mechanic for unlocking some rewards feels out of place in a kids’ game.

Nevertheless, even after peeling back all the progression layers, Hot Wheels Unleashed 2 still delivers an inherently fun racing experience, reigniting the joy of playing with Hot Wheels as a child. Although my own collection is packed away, playing Turbocharged made it feel like I was rediscovering that world all over again.

Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged was tested on PlayStation 5.

Pretekal som sa ako Hot Wheels monster truck cez dinosauriu výstavu a uvedomil som si, že táto hra je ako stvorená pre moje päťročné ja. Ako dieťa som mal hromadu Hot Wheels autíčok – bol to spôsob, ako mi otec ukazoval svoju vášeň pre autá. Keď som hral nenápadný hit od Milestone z roku 2021, Hot Wheels Unleashed, prišla na mňa nostalgia, aj keď najviac som ju precítil až pri pokračovaní Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged.

Hot Wheels Unleashed 2 nie je nijak extra zložitý alebo náročný pretekár. Príbehový režim je trochu chaotický a „výherný automat“ na autá podľa mňa do detskej hry nepatrí. Napriek tomu niekoľko noviniek hru robí rýchlejšou a zábavnejšou pre deti aj dospelých.

Hry od Milestone sú o jasnom arkádovom pretekaní – driftovať, boostovať a dostať sa na prvé miesto. Pokračovanie ponúka viacero režimov – od klasiky na tri kolá až po Elimination, kde poslední v poradí postupne vypadávajú. Stále je radosť boostovať aj driftovať. Prejsť späť na prvý diel by po Turbocharged asi už nešlo, keďže tu sa dá boost využiť aj na nové kúsky.

Boost teraz môžete použiť na skok alebo rýchly bočný úhyb. Skokom preskočíte veľké medzery, úhybom môžete zhodiť súpera či lepšie manévrovať. Návrat na trať bez resetu je jednoduchší, aj keď autíčka sú stále krehké. Nové pohyby si žiadajú boost, čo vás núti viac driftovať a manažovať si energiu.

Nejde však len o nostalgiu. Hra je naozaj zábavná pre deti aj (navždy mladých) dospelých. Pribudli outdoorové mapy aj offroad úseky, scény ako záhrada či dinosaurí múzeum rozvíjajú detskú predstavivosť. Režim Waypoint umožňuje voľnú jazdu po mape, čo je vyslovene super pre deti, ktoré chcú len objavovať.

Grafika je hravá, plastová, ale prostredia pôsobia realisticky. Editor tratí aj áut je späť, možnosti sú široké – mladších však môže tvorba odradiť, ale komunita pripravuje trať za tratí. Aj bez onlinu je singleplayer bohatý.

Hra má len platené DLC, žiadne mikrotransakcie za skutočné peniaze na začiatku, oproti niektorým konkurentom. Quick Play, Time Attack, Drift Master, Elimination a Waypoint si viete zahrať samostatne aj v rámci kampane Creature Rampage. Tá je určená hlavne pre deti – je o pretekároch, vedcovi a robotovi, ktorí musia zastaviť uniknuté monštrá. Komiksové scény veľmi pre dospelých nie sú, ale dajú sa odignorovať a sústrediť sa na výzvy. Za plnenie úloh získavate predmety na prispôsobenie, skúsenosti, skill pointy, tokeny Hot Wheels Spin a hernú menu. Skill pointy dajú špeciálne vlastnosti (imunita na prekážky), z meny kúpite nové vozidlá: motorky, štvorkolky, trucky. Automat na odmeny však v detskej hre stále pôsobí divne.

Napriek akýmkoľvek výhradám hra ponúka najmä čistú radosť z pretekania, akoby ste sa znova hrali s Hot Wheels autíčkami. Moja zbierka možno už leží v pivnici, ale Turbocharged mi ten pocit pripomenul.

article_content: Jason Aldean’s fifth album, 'Night Train', features 15 tracks that blend various musical styles, from hip-hop inspired tunes to traditional country anthems. The Georgia native has built his reputation on pushing the boundaries of country music, having found major success with his 2010 album 'My Kinda Party', which produced hits like the rap-infused 'Dirt Road Anthem' and a duet with Kelly Clarkson, 'Don't You Wanna Stay.' On 'Night Train,' Aldean continues to experiment, offering songs like '1994'—a lively tribute to '90s country artist Joe Diffie—and 'Black Tears,' a somber ballad about a woman struggling with pain. Collaborations feature artists such as Luke Bryan and Eric Church on the track 'The Only Way I Know.' The review notes Aldean’s particular strength when performing traditional country themes, where the urgency in his voice elevates each song. Tracks such as 'I Don't Do Lonely Well,' 'Staring at the Sun,' and 'Water Tower' showcase his ability to turn everyday stories into memorable music. In the emotional ballad 'Talk,' Aldean captures the power of a simple night out, making it feel epic. Overall, the album is praised for its ambition and range, highlighting Aldean’s knack for both innovation and classic storytelling.

Kim Jong-Un, North Korea's leader, reportedly ordered the execution of two high-ranking aides loyal to his uncle, Jang Song-Thaek, while under the influence of alcohol. This action followed the execution of Jang Song-Thaek on December 12, 2013, amid accusations of attempting to overthrow the government. According to media reports, the aides—Ri Ryong-ha and Jang Su-gil—both held senior roles in the ruling Workers’ Party and are believed to be among at least eight individuals close to Jang who were executed during a wider purge.

Following these events, North Korean authorities are reported to have detained hundreds of Jang’s relatives and associates, with indications that many were sent to political prison camps, consistent with the country’s practice of punishing families of alleged offenders. Even extended family members living outside the capital, Pyongyang, reportedly faced detention.

Jang Song-Thaek, once a prominent advisor and mentor to Kim Jong-Un and married to Kim’s aunt, Kim Kyong-Hui, faced multiple charges including abuse of power and actions counter to party ideology. Observers regarded his execution as the most significant political upheaval since Kim Jong-Un took power. Some analysts suggest that conflicts over lucrative business interests, specifically coal exports, may have contributed to Jang’s downfall.

While North Korean state media labeled Jang as corrupt and disloyal, outside intelligence experts and observers interpret the purge as an indication of deeper unrest within the regime.

article_content: Chelsea Football Club has recorded its first financial profit since Roman Abramovich took ownership nine years ago. The Russian billionaire purchased the Premier League side in 2003 and has heavily invested in top football talent each year, leading to substantial annual losses. For the fiscal year ending June 30, 2012, Chelsea posted a profit of £1.4 million ($2.2 million), reversing last year's loss of £67.7 million ($108 million). The club also reported a record turnover of £255.7 million ($407 million), making it the fifth largest among European clubs. This growth was driven by winning their first UEFA Champions League title and by making a profit of £28.8 million ($46 million) from player transfers. Notably, this was achieved despite several high-profile players leaving on free transfers and significant spending on new talent. In comparison, Arsenal, which maintains a more conservative transfer strategy, announced a profit of £30.6 million ($48 million) on a turnover of £243 million ($386 million). Additionally, Chelsea's debt position improved significantly after £166.6 million ($265 million) in loans from Abramovich were converted to equity, effectively making the club debt-free. The club is seeking to comply with UEFA's new Financial Fair Play rules, which require teams to be self-reliant by limiting owners' direct spending. Non-compliance could lead to exclusion from major European competitions. Ron Gourlay, Chelsea’s chief executive, emphasized the challenge of simultaneously securing on-field success and financial stability. He highlighted the club's all-around commitment to profitability and noted Chelsea’s historic achievement as the first London club to win the UEFA Champions League. Chelsea has also expanded its revenue streams, signing a global sponsorship deal with Russian energy giant Gazprom and taking full control of its digital media. Manager Roberto di Matteo expressed support for the club’s financial direction, stating that complying with Financial Fair Play puts Chelsea in a strong domestic and international position. The season's successes on the pitch have been overshadowed by a series of racism controversies, including a four-match ban for captain John Terry and ongoing investigations involving referee Mark Clattenburg and fan behavior at recent matches.

Klub zároveň oznámil rekordné tržby vo výške 255,7 milióna libier (407 miliónov dolárov), čím sa zaradil medzi päť najväčších klubov v Európe. Klub sa snaží dodržiavať nové pravidlá finančnej fair play od UEFA, ktoré vyžadujú samostatnosť klubov a obmedzovanie priameho financovania vlastníkom. Nedodržanie môže viesť k vylúčeniu z hlavných európskych súťaží. Generálny riaditeľ Chelsea Ron Gourlay zdôraznil výzvu spájať úspechy na ihrisku s finančnou stabilitou. Tréner Roberto di Matteo podporil finančný smer klubu a uviedol, že dodržiavanie pravidiel finančnej fair play dáva Chelsea silnú pozíciu doma aj na medzinárodnej scéne. Úspechy v tejto sezóne však zatienili viaceré rasistické aféry, vrátane štvormesačného zákazu kapitána Johna Terryho a prebiehajúcich vyšetrovaní v súvislosti s rozhodcom Markom Clattenburgom a správaním fanúšikov na nedávnych zápasoch.

article_content: Fort Hood, Texas, in many ways functions like a city, with up to 30,000 residents and facilities including malls, sports fields, subdivisions, and up to nine schools. However, it is distinct because it mainly serves as a transition point for troops deploying overseas or returning home. On Thursday, a shooting at Fort Hood left at least 13 people dead and 30 wounded, officials reported. The suspected gunman, Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan, age 39, was also wounded. Several victims were at the Readiness Center, a place soldiers visit both before deployment and after returning from service, according to Army Lt. Gen. Bob Cone. Lt. Gen. Russel Honore, who previously served at Fort Hood, stated that nearly eight years of war in Afghanistan and Iraq have increased strain on the armed forces. Many soldiers have been deployed multiple times, causing significant stress for them and their families. Honore noted that the Readiness Center's role includes helping soldiers readjust to civilian life and cope with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). The center also helps with tasks such as updating next of kin, checking immunization records, and preparing wills. Fort Hood is the largest U.S. military installation by area, home to 25,000 to 30,000 people daily, including military personnel and their families. The base provides support services ranging from assisting troops in finding employment or pursuing education to helping them manage combat-related conditions like PTSD. The Warrior Stress Reset Program, which lasts three weeks, offers counseling and treatment for war-related stress. U.S. Senator Kay Bailey Hutchison highlighted that Fort Hood's strong support system would help care for families affected by the incident. Major military units stationed at Fort Hood include the 1st Cavalry Division, elements of the 4th Infantry Division, the 3rd Armored Cavalry Regiment, and the 13th Corps Support Command. Fort Hood spans about 340 square miles and is located approximately 160 miles south of Dallas/Fort Worth. CNN's Barbara Starr, Adam Levine, Mike Mount, and Chris Lawrence contributed to this report.

article_content: Florida police were investigating reports of cats being found dead in a Port St. Lucie neighborhood when they discovered the culprit: a 12-foot long, 120-pound Burmese Python hiding in the brush. Neighbors said the snake had been preying on kittens in the area. Sergeant John Holman came across the large python and immediately called for backup. 'Once I saw the size of it, I called for a few more officers. I'm not going to do that by myself,' Holman told WPBF. Police told CBS 12 that the python belongs to a local resident who has not been publicly identified. Currently, no charges have been filed. Officers believe they have identified the snake's owner through state-issued permits and are continuing their investigation. Although Florida law generally prohibits owning pythons, Holman said one individual in the neighborhood holds a valid license and permission from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission to keep a python. Neighbor Denise Keel, who lives next to where the snake was found, said she was not surprised. 'I wondered what happened to all the little animals,' Keel remarked. 'Some neighbors used to keep snakes in aquariums, but they've since moved away.'
translated_content: Polícia na Floride vyšetrovala hlásenia o náleze mŕtvych mačiek v štvrti Port St. Lucie, keď objavila vinníka: barmského pytóna, dlhého 3,6 metra a vážiaceho 54 kilogramov, schovaného v kroví. Susedia uviedli, že had lovil mačiatka v okolí. Seržant John Holman natrafil na obrovského hada a okamžite privolal posily. "Keď som videl, aký je veľký, zavolal som si ešte niekoľko policajtov. To sám riešiť nebudem," povedal Holman pre WPBF. Polícia pre CBS 12 uviedla, že pytón patrí miestnemu obyvateľovi, ktorého meno zatiaľ nezverejnili. Momentálne zatiaľ neboli vznesené žiadne obvinenia. Policajti sa domnievajú, že majiteľa hada identifikovali cez štátne povolenia a vo vyšetrovaní pokračujú. Aj keď zákon na Floride všeobecne zakazuje vlastniť pytóny, Holman uviedol, že jeden z miestnych má platnú licenciu a povolenie od Floridskej komisie pre ochranu rýb a divočiny na chov pytóna. Susedka Denise Keel, ktorá býva vedľa pozemku, kde hada našli, povedala, že nebola prekvapená. „Premýšľala som, čo sa stalo všetkým tým malým zvieratkám,“ poznamenala Keel. „Niektorí susedia kedysi chovali hady v akváriách, ale už sa odsťahovali.“

article_content: Adefunke Adefule, founder of Adefunkeee Hair Brand, transitioned from telecommunications into hairstyling to support her family and pursue her own passions. She began with hairstyling on the side, but soon realized it was her true calling and invested herself fully in the business. Although she started with only modest savings, Adefule committed to growing her skills and business, which, over five years, enabled her to become a successful entrepreneur and a role model to others with big ambitions. She and her team keep their knowledge current by actively researching the latest styles and techniques using social media and online educational resources, both free and paid, practicing them to deliver top-tier service. Her salon’s clientele includes well-known Nigerian celebrities such as Mo Abudu, Funke Akindele, Sharon Ooja, Ayra Starr, Veekee James, Bisola Aiyeola, Idia Aisien, Dorothy Bancor, Lilian Afegbai, and Tomike Adeoye, among others. Key moments in her journey have included launching her brand, overcoming limited capital, moving into a bigger salon space after three years in business, and receiving a nomination for The Future Awards for Beauty in 2020, just a year after starting her company. Adefule faced significant obstacles, including a lack of startup funds, high operating costs, long working hours, and the business disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. She overcame these hurdles by saving diligently, communicating openly with clients about pricing, and amplifying her online presence. To manage exhausting work schedules, she put a booking system in place that protects her team from burnout and guarantees reliable, high-quality service for each client. She believes that adaptability, continuous learning, keeping up with trends, and prioritizing client care are crucial traits for a successful hairstylist. Adefule advises up-and-coming stylists to embrace ongoing education, persevere through setbacks, and invest in training because opportunities can arise unexpectedly. Outside of her business, she has developed a keen interest in medicine and biomedical sciences, aspiring to connect this knowledge with her experience in beauty. For relaxation, she travels, rests, works out to stay sharp, and enjoys spending time with family and friends.

article_content: Formula 1 legend Michael Schumacher is slowly regaining consciousness after a skiing accident that left him with severe brain injuries, according to recent updates. His 15-year-old son, Mick Schumacher, a promising kart-racing driver, has shared information about his father's progress. The 45-year-old Schumacher is being treated at home after spending six months in a medically-induced coma following his December 2013 accident in Meribel, France. Mick told French F1 commentator Jean-Louis Moncet that his father's recovery is advancing, but at a very slow pace. Moncet stated on Europe 1 radio, 'Schumi is waking up very slowly; very slowly. Although things are progressing slowly, he has his whole life ahead of him to recover.' Moncet also mentioned that the Go-Pro camera mount on Schumacher's helmet might have contributed to the severity of his brain injury during the accident, a detail reported in some outlets but not officially confirmed. Currently, Schumacher continues his recovery at his Swiss home in a specially designed medical suite, attended by a team of 15 medical professionals. He returned home two months ago after his discharge from a rehabilitation clinic in Lausanne, Switzerland. Updates on Schumacher's condition have been infrequent. Upon his return home, his manager Sabine Kehm stated that a 'long and difficult road' lies ahead. Jean Todt, former Ferrari chief and current FIA president, visited Schumacher last month and said: 'What's important is that he is alive and his family is with him. We are hopeful that things will improve. He needs time and privacy.' It is reported that Schumacher remains unable to move or speak, with monthly care costs for his specialized treatment estimated at around £100,000. His father, Rolf, is preparing to move into a new residence built on the grounds of the family’s £35 million mansion beside Lake Geneva. Meanwhile, Mick Schumacher is pursuing his motorsport career, having recently finished second in both the world championships in France and the German junior kart championships. He previously raced under his mother's maiden name, Betsch, but now competes as Mick Schumacher Jnr and has expressed his ambition to become a professional driver.

article_content: Bill and Sharon Kastrinos embody minimalism, living in a 154-square-foot home after moving from their previous 1,800-square-foot residence in Calistoga, California. The economic downturn prompted them to trade their spacious kitchen for a compact one. Although challenging at times, Sharon finds it liberating to be free from social pressures: 'There's a tremendous burden that's off your shoulders,' she notes. Bill adds, 'I don't think bigger is better,' contrasting their choice with the common preference for larger homes and cars. Once working in construction, Bill decided to adapt their lifestyle after the real estate market declined. Their tiny house features a sitting area, small kitchen, and bathroom on the main floor (98 square feet), with a 56-square-foot loft bedroom accessed by ladder. The home cost $15,000, and monthly utilities are only $15. They store extra clothes in their car and enjoy the simplicity. 'You can't have 100 pairs of shoes in the closet or 50 outfits,' Bill says. The couple now live on property owned by their daughter in California wine country, where the average home in 2007 cost $725,000. Maintaining their old home is costly, with $1,500 in mortgage payments and $160 in utilities each month, so they plan to sell it. Their tiny home is moveable, allowing them to relocate and connect to RV parks across the country. Inspired by the transition, Bill started building and selling tiny homes—selling eleven in six months, priced between $15,000 and $20,000. His clients include people on welfare and retirees on fixed incomes, and interest continues to grow. The Kastrinoses are among a growing movement toward smaller living. In Sebastopol, California, designer Jay Shafer also lives in and advocates for tiny homes. His designs, ranging from 65 to 774 square feet, often include interior wood paneling, stainless steel kitchens, and built-in bookcases. Shafer chose this lifestyle for both practical and political reasons, living on $15,000 a year and without rent or mortgage obligations, proving how little people actually need. Shafer finds fulfillment in designing small homes and gives away belongings he no longer needs. While married, his home is too small for two, so he is creating a nearby 280-square-foot dwelling for his spouse. He acknowledges tiny homes aren't suitable for everyone, particularly larger families, but says the lifestyle brings peace of mind and lets him save money while enjoying his work.
translated_content: Bill a Sharon Kastrinos sú príkladom minimalizmu – po presťahovaní z pôvodného domu s rozlohou 167 m² žijú teraz v dome o veľkosti len 14 m² v Calistoge v Kalifornii. Ekonomický pokles ich prinútil vymeniť priestrannú kuchyňu za maličkú. Aj keď občas čelia výzvam, Sharon sa cíti oslobodená od spoločenských tlakú: „Je to obrovská záťaž, ktorá vám spadne z pliec,“ poznamenáva. Bill dodáva: „Nemyslím si, že väčšie je lepšie,“ čím porovnáva ich výber s bežnou túžbou po veľkých domoch a autách. Keďže Bill predtým pracoval v stavebníctve, po páde realitného trhu sa rozhodol zmeniť spôsob života. Ich malý dom má obývačku, malú kuchynku a kúpeľňu na hlavnom poschodí (9 m²) a 5 m² veľkú spálňu v podkroví prístupnú po rebríku. Dom ich stál 15 000 dolárov a mesačné náklady na energie sú len 15 dolárov. Nadbytočné oblečenie uchovávajú v aute a užívajú si jednoduchosť. „Nemôžete mať sto párov topánok alebo päťdesiat outfitov v skrini,“ hovorí Bill. Manželia teraz žijú na pozemku dcéry v kalifornskej vinárskej oblasti, kde priemerný dom v roku 2007 stál 725 000 dolárov. Starý dom je drahý na údržbu – hypotéka 1 500 dolárov mesačne a energie 160 dolárov, preto ho plánujú predať. Ich malý dom je na kolesách, takže ho môžu presúvať a pripájať kdekoľvek v USA v karavanových parkoch. Bill sa inšpiroval touto zmenou a začal stavať a predávať malé domy – za šesť mesiacov predal jedenásť, v cenách 15 až 20 tisíc dolárov. Jeho klienti sú ľudia na sociálnych dávkach aj dôchodcovia s pevným príjmom a záujem stále rastie. Kastrinosovci sú súčasťou rastúceho hnutia zameraného na menšie bývanie. V meste Sebastopol v Kalifornii žije a navrhuje malé domy aj dizajnér Jay Shafer. Jeho domy s rozlohami od 6 do 72 m² často zahŕňajú drevené obloženie, kuchyne z nehrdzavejúcej ocele a vstavané knižnice. Shafer si tento štýl zvolil z praktických aj politických dôvodov – žije za 15 000 dolárov ročne bez nájmu alebo hypotéky a ukazuje, ako málo človek naozaj potrebuje. Shafer nachádza naplnenie v navrhovaní malých domov a nepotrebné veci daruje preč. Hoci je ženatý, jeho dom je pre dvoch príliš malý, a preto pre svoju manželku stavia domček s rozlohou 26 m². Priznáva, že tento spôsob života nie je pre každého, hlavne pre väčšie rodiny, no tvrdí, že prináša pokoj na duši a umožňuje mu šetriť peniaze a robiť, čo ho baví.

Interest in the NFL continues to rise in the United Kingdom, but the league still has some adjustments to make. The Atlanta Falcons recently released an infographic intended to inform fans about their trip to London for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions at Wembley Stadium. However, the graphic mistakenly placed London in eastern Spain and incorrectly stated that the team and staff would take three planes to reach London, when only two were used.

The infographic was initially shared on the Falcons' Twitter account but was quickly removed and replaced with accurate information. Despite the correction, the flawed graphic spread online and was met with a wave of humorous comments from followers. In preparation for the upcoming game, the Falcons trained at Arsenal's London Colney facility. Sunday's matchup marks the second of three NFL games at Wembley Stadium in 2014, following the Miami Dolphins' 38-14 victory over the Oakland Raiders in September. London will also host the Dallas Cowboys and Jacksonville Jaguars on November 9.

Notably, Falcons defensive end Cliff Matthews was seen high-fiving his teammates, and quarterback Matt Ryan observed during training as the team prepared for the Detroit Lions.

Infografika však omylom umiestnila Londýn do východného Španielska a nesprávne uviedla, že tím a personál poletia do Londýna tromi lietadlami, hoci v skutočnosti použili len dve.

Infografika bola pôvodne zverejnená na Twitter účte Falcons, ale rýchlo ju odstránili a nahradili správnymi informáciami. Aj napriek oprave sa chybná verzia rozšírila online a vyslúžila si množstvo vtipných komentárov od sledovateľov. Falcons sa pred nadchádzajúcim zápasom pripravovali v tréningovom areáli Arsenalu v London Colney. Nedeľný zápas je druhým z troch tohtoročných duelov NFL na štadióne Wembley. V septembri tu Miami Dolphins pohodlne zdolali Oakland Raiders 38:14. Londýn taktiež privíta Dallas Cowboys a Jacksonville Jaguars 9. novembra.

Zaujímavosťou je, že obránca Falcons Cliff Matthews si počas tréningu tľapol s viacerými spoluhráčmi a quarterback Matt Ryan pozorne sledoval prípravy tímu na duel s Detroit Lions.

Jonathan Gruber, an MIT economics professor known for helping craft the Affordable Care Act (ACA or 'Obamacare'), is facing renewed controversy as new video footage highlights his past statements. In a recently surfaced video, Gruber agrees that some states' rejection of Medicaid expansion under the federal healthcare law may have racial underpinnings. He sharply criticized these states for not accepting billions in federal funds, stating that their decisions were intended to 'punish poor people,' and described their actions as 'almost awesome in its evilness.'

This video is the latest in a series featuring candid remarks by Gruber about the ACA's legislative strategy. Previously, he admitted the law was written in a deliberately complex manner to avoid having the Congressional Budget Office classify the individual mandate as a tax, arguing that if it had been labeled as such, the bill would likely have failed. Gruber also noted that lack of transparency offered political benefit, attributing the bill's passage partly to what he called the 'stupidity of the American voter.'

Top Democrats, including President Barack Obama and House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi, have distanced themselves from Gruber in light of his remarks. Obama clarified that Gruber was never a White House staffer and publicly disagreed with Gruber's statements, while Pelosi denied knowing Gruber, despite evidence from past records and press conferences indicating her familiarity with him. Politifact, a fact-checking organization, found Pelosi's claim to be false.

While Gruber was not officially part of the White House staff, government records reveal he was paid close to $400,000 as a consultant by the Department of Health and Human Services during the ACA's development. His economic modeling was used to guide policy decisions and estimate the impact of health law proposals. The emergence of these videos continues to generate political fallout as Democratic leaders seek to minimize their ties to Gruber.

Jonathan Gruber, profesor ekonómie na MIT, ktorý stál za vznikom zákona o dostupnej zdravotnej starostlivosti (ACA alebo „Obamacare“), čelí ďalšej vlne kritiky po zverejnení nového videa. V tomto zázname Gruber súhlasí s názorom, že odmietnutie rozšírenia programu Medicaid v niektorých štátoch môže súvisieť s rasovým podtextom. Ostro upozornil na tieto štáty za to, že odmietli miliardy federálnych dolárov, pričom ich rozhodnutia označil za úmysel „potrestať chudobných“ a nazval ich konanie ako „takmer úžasné vo svojej zlobe“.

Toto video je najnovším prírastkom do série záberov, v ktorých Gruber otvorene diskutuje o stratégii prijatia ACA. Už predtým priznal, že zákon bol zámerne napísaný zložito, aby Kongresový rozpočtový úrad nepovažoval individuálny mandát za daň, pretože by tak návrh pravdepodobne neprešiel. Gruber tiež uviedol, že nedostatok transparentnosti bol politickou výhodou a úspech zákona pripísal aj „hlúposti amerického voliča“.

Poprední demokrati vrátane prezidenta Baracka Obamu a líderky demokratov v Snemovni reprezentantov Nancy Pelosi sa v reakcii na jeho výroky od Grubera dištancovali. Obama objasnil, že Gruber nebol zamestnancom Bieleho domu a verejne nesúhlasí s jeho výrokmi. Pelosi zas poprela, že by Grubera poznala, hoci záznamy a tlačové konferencie dokazujú opak. Faktografická stránka Politifact označila tvrdenie Pelosiovej za nepravdivé.

Gruber nikdy nebol oficiálnym členom Bieleho domu, no podľa záznamov získal ako konzultant od Ministerstva zdravotníctva a sociálnych služieb takmer 400 000 dolárov počas vzniku ACA. Jeho ekonomické modely slúžili pri rozhodovaní o politických opatreniach a určení dopadov zákona na zdravotníctvo. Nové videá naďalej vyvolávajú politické následky a demokrati sa snažia obmedziť svoju spojitosť s Gruberom.

article_content: A proposal to create Britain’s largest solar farm, which will cover 200 acres and supply electricity to about 11,000 homes, has been approved for southern Hampshire. The new facility will be situated between Waterlooville and Fareham, making it 50 acres larger than the current record-holder at Wymeswold Airfield in Leicestershire. The project, managed by Southwick Estate, will transform farmland that has been cultivated by the Cutler family for three generations. Despite this history, tenant farmer Neil Cutler has endorsed the plans and intends to work alongside the estate and solar companies, with the family receiving compensation for the land’s change of use. Winchester City Council’s Planning Development Control Committee approved the plans with a vote of nine to one. Councillor Therese Evans, the sole dissenter, expressed concern about setting a precedent for turning more farmland into solar sites, stressing the ongoing importance of agriculture even with the pursuit of renewable energy. Environmental groups are divided: the Campaign to Protect Rural England opposed the plan, whereas Friends of the Earth welcomed it as a positive step towards sustainable energy for the region. Public consultation in August showed that most feedback supported the project. Hive Energy and Welborne Solar are the companies developing the farm. They say the park is designed to be unobtrusive, to enhance biodiversity, and to deliver green power to the Portsmouth area for the next 25 years. Giles Redpath, CEO of Hive Energy, expressed enthusiasm over partnering with Southwick Estate to build what will be one of the UK’s key renewable energy sites.

Nové zariadenie bude umiestnené medzi Waterlooville a Farehamom, čím bude o 50 akrov väčšie ako doterajší rekordér vo Wymeswold Airfield v Leicestri. Projekt, ktorý vedie Southwick Estate, premení poľnohospodársku pôdu, ktorú tri generácie obrábala rodina Cutlerovcov. Napriek tejto histórii nájomca Neil Cutler plány podporuje a plánuje spolupracovať so Southwick Estate aj so solárnymi spoločnosťami; rodina bude za zmenu využitia pôdy odškodnená. Plán schválil výbor pre rozvojové plánovanie Winchester City Council v pomere deväť ku jednej. Radkyňa Therese Evans, jediná proti, vyjadrila obavy, že schválenie môže vytvoriť precedens pre ďalšie premieňanie poľnohospodárskej pôdy na solárne farmy, pričom zdôraznila dôležitosť poľnohospodárstva aj popri rozvoji obnoviteľnej energie. Názory environmentálnych skupín sú rozdelené: Campaign to Protect Rural England bola proti plánu, kým Friends of the Earth ho privítali ako pozitívny krok smerom k udržateľnej energii v regióne. Verejná konzultácia v auguste ukázala, že väčšina spätnej väzby projekt podporila. Solárne farmy rozvíjajú spoločnosti Hive Energy a Welborne Solar. Tie tvrdia, že park bude nenápadný, prispeje k ochrane biodiverzity a poskytne zelenú energiu pre oblasť Portsmouthu na najbližších 25 rokov. Generálny riaditeľ Hive Energy Giles Redpath vyjadril nadšenie zo spolupráce so Southwick Estate na jednom z najvýznamnejších projektov obnoviteľnej energie v krajine.

article_content: A spectacular overhead kick by Eduard Bello secured Venezuela a 1-1 draw against Brazil in their 2026 World Cup qualifier on Thursday. Meanwhile, Argentina moved to the top of the CONMEBOL standings by beating Paraguay 1-0 and maintaining their perfect record. After a goalless first half in Cuiaba, Brazil's Gabriel Magalhaes scored his first international goal in the 50th minute, heading in Neymar's corner at the near post. Brazil almost doubled their lead, but Vinicius Jr. had a goal ruled out for offside in the 71st minute. Venezuela capitalized on Brazil's missed chances late in the game as Bello connected with Jefferson Savarino's cross in the 85th minute with a brilliant overhead kick. The draw means Brazil, who will next face Uruguay in Montevideo, drop to second place after Argentina's victory in Buenos Aires. In Argentina, the hosts secured a narrow win thanks to an early volley from Nicolas Otamendi in the third minute—remarkably, only his fifth goal in over 100 appearances for Argentina. Lionel Messi, included in the squad despite recent injury, entered in the 53rd minute and nearly extended the lead, hitting the woodwork with a stoppage-time free kick. Argentina's next match is against Peru in Lima on October 17. Earlier, a late penalty by Darwin Nunez earned Uruguay a 2-2 draw away to Colombia in Barranquilla. James Rodriguez put Colombia ahead in the 35th minute, finishing Rafael Santos Borre's cross, but Uruguay equalized just after halftime through Mathias Olivera. Colombia reclaimed the lead five minutes later when Mateus Uribe finished another Borre delivery. The match dramatically shifted when Colombia's goalkeeper Camilo Vargas was sent off in the 87th minute after committing a foul on Maximiliano Araujo, conceding a penalty. Substitute goalkeeper Alvaro Montero couldn't stop Nunez's spot kick. Colombia and Uruguay now sit third and fourth in the standings, with Chile fifth following their 2-0 win over Peru.

Medzitým sa Argentína dostala na čelo tabuľky CONMEBOL po víťazstve 1:0 nad Paraguajom a udržala si stopercentnú bilanciu. Po bezgólovom prvom polčase v Cuiabe otvoril skóre Gabriel Magalhaes, ktorý v 50. minúte hlavou poslal do bránky roh od Neymara – bol to jeho prvý reprezentačný gól. Venezuela využila nepremenené šance Brazílie v závere zápasu, keď Bello napojil na center Jeffersona Savarina v 85. minúte úžasným akrobatickým kopom. Remíza znamená, že Brazília, ktorá najbližšie nastúpi proti Uruguaju v Montevideu, klesla na druhé miesto po výhre Argentíny v Buenos Aires. V Argentíne sa domáci tešili z tesného víťazstva vďaka rýchlej voleji Nicolasa Otamendiho v tretej minúte – čo bol len jeho piaty gól v viac než 100 štartoch za Argentínu. Lionel Messi, ktorý bol súčasťou nominácie napriek nedávnemu zraneniu, nastúpil v 53. minúte a bol blízko k zvýšeniu skóre, keď v nadstavenom čase trafil do žrde priamym kopom. Najbližšie hrá Argentína proti Peru v Lime 17. októbra. Skôr počas dňa vybojoval neskorou penaltou Darwin Núñez pre Uruguaj remízu 2:2 na pôde Kolumbie v Barranquille. James Rodríguez poslal Kolumbiu do vedenia v 35. minúte po centri Rafaela Santosa Borrého, no Uruguay krátko po prestávke vyrovnal zásluhou Mathiasa Oliveru. Kolumbia získala vedenie späť o päť minút neskôr, keď sa presadil Mateus Uribe po ďalšom centri od Borrého. Náhradný brankár Álvaro Montero nedokázal zastaviť penaltu Núñeza. Kolumbia a Uruguaj sú teraz tretí a štvrtí v tabuľke, pričom piate miesto patrí Čile po ich víťazstve 2:0 nad Peru.

article_content: You’ve been awake since 3 a.m. After making it through lengthy check-in and security lines, and seeing flight attendants who seem as tired as you, your 6 a.m. flight finally takes off. You think, "I'll recline my seat and get some sleep before we land," as the seatbelt sign turns off. But your seat won’t budge, no matter how hard you try. You’ve encountered the Knee Defender—a small pair of plastic clips invented in 2003 by Ira Goldman, who stands 6'3" tall. Annoyed by having his knees bumped by reclining seats, he created this device to attach to a lowered tray table and block the seat in front from reclining. This week, the Knee Defender made headlines after a dispute over its use forced United Flight 1462 from Newark to Denver to divert to Chicago’s O'Hare Airport. The altercation resulted in both passengers being removed from the flight, but the incident sparked huge interest and increased sales for the device—even crashing its website. Is the Knee Defender allowed? The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration has not banned it, as it poses no safety risk. However, most U.S. airlines, including United, prohibit its use. Similarly, Canadian airlines Air Canada and WestJet, as well as Australian carriers Qantas and Virgin, ban the device, citing safety and their own policies. A Virgin Australia Airlines spokesperson told CNN that using knee defenders breaches their conditions of carriage. Singapore Air said it addresses Knee Defender use case by case, though it has not received customer complaints. During the United inflight incident, a flight attendant reportedly told the man to remove the Knee Defender, but he refused. The female passenger then threw water in his face. Goldman insists that users should be considerate and offers a courtesy card to inform the passenger in front about the device and its purpose. The card also asks that, if the person wants to recline, they notify the user so adjustments can be made. The incident has reignited the debate about airplane etiquette. Some believe that if the seat design allows for reclining, passengers should be able to use this feature, or consider seat upgrades for more space. Others feel people must respect those behind them, especially in cramped cabins. The debate continues: Should airlines eliminate reclining seats? Or is finding a compromise the best solution? Share your thoughts in the comments.
translated_content: Si hore od 3.00 ráno. Po zdĺhavom čakaní na odbavenie a bezpečnostnej kontrole a pohľade na letušky, ktoré sú rovnako unavené ako ty, konečne o 6.00 štartuje tvoj let. Pomyslíš si: „Sklopím si sedadlo a trochu si pospím, kým pristaneme,“ keď sa vypne značka pripútania. Ale sedadlo sa ani nepohne, nech robíš čokoľvek. Narazil si na Knee Defender – malé plastové klipy, ktoré vynašiel v roku 2003 Ira Goldman, vysoký 191 cm. Už ho nebavilo, že ho ľudia sklápacími sedadlami udierajú do kolien, preto vymyslel zariadenie, ktoré sa pripevní na sklopený stolík a zabráni sklopeniu sedadla pred tebou. Tento týždeň sa Knee Defender ocitol v centre pozornosti po tom, čo hádka okolo jeho použitia prinútila let United 1462 z Newarku do Denveru odkloniť sa do Chicaga (O’Hare). Kvôli incidentu oboch cestujúcich z lietadla vylúčili, no zariadenie vzbudilo obrovský záujem a zvýšilo sa jeho predaj – až im padol web. Je Knee Defender povolený? Federálny úrad pre letectvo v USA ho nezakázal, keďže nepredstavuje bezpečnostné riziko. Väčšina amerických aerolínií, vrátane United, jeho používanie zakazuje. Podobne je to aj v Kanade (Air Canada a WestJet) či v Austrálii (Qantas a Virgin), kde sa odvolávajú na bezpečnostné pravidlá a vlastné zásady. Hovorkyňa Virgin Australia Airlines uviedla pre CNN, že používanie knee defenderu porušuje ich prepravné podmienky. Singapore Air rieši každý prípad zvlášť, no zatiaľ od zákazníkov nemali sťažnosti. Počas incidentu na palube United letu vraj letuška požiadala muža, aby Knee Defender odstránil, ale on odmietol. Cestujúca mu následne vyliala vodu do tváre. Goldman zdôrazňuje, že používatelia by mali brať ohľad na ostatných a poskytuje kartičku, ktorá má cestujúcim vpredu vysvetliť dôvod použitia zariadenia. Kartička tiež nabáda, aby v prípade záujmu o sklopenie predný cestujúci upozornil používateľa – ten sa potom môže prispôsobiť. Incident opäť rozpútal diskusiu o etikete na palube lietadla. Niektorí tvrdia, že ak je sedadlo možné sklápať, mali by cestujúci túto funkciu využívať – alebo si radšej priplatiť za viac miesta. Iní sú presvedčení, že ohľad na ostatných je v stiesnenom priestore nutnosťou. Debata pokračuje: Mali by aerolínie úplne zrušiť sklápacie sedadlá? Alebo je lepšie hľadať kompromis? Podeľ sa o svoj názor v komentároch.

article_content: On Saturday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that the government will extend the free ration scheme, PM Garib Kalyan Yojana (PMGKY), for another five years. The scheme is expected to benefit approximately 80 crore (800 million) poor citizens across India. The announcement was made during election rallies in Durg and Ratlam, ahead of state elections in five states this month. Congress general secretary Jairam Ramesh responded by claiming that the extension signals ongoing economic distress and widening inequality in the country. He asserted that most Indians’ incomes have not kept up with the rising prices of essential goods. Ramesh also criticized PM Modi, stating that Modi had previously opposed the National Food Security Act (NFSA), passed by Parliament in September 2013, when he was Gujarat’s chief minister. Ramesh further argued that PMGKY is essentially an extension of the NFSA, and noted that Modi has shifted his stance on welfare programs such as MGNREGA, which proved to be crucial during the pandemic. Separately, the government has banned 22 illegal betting and gambling apps, including Mahadev Book Online, which is linked to bribery allegations involving Chhattisgarh chief minister Bhupesh Baghel. Recent data indicate that employee productivity in major Indian companies has increased over the past five years. This improvement comes amid a continued debate on long work hours, with revenue per employee rising and staff costs remaining about 10% of total revenues.

Očakáva sa, že táto schéma pomôže približne 800 miliónom chudobných obyvateľov po celej Indii. Oznámenie zaznelo počas predvolebných zhromaždení v Durgu a Ratlame pred štátnymi voľbami v piatich štátoch tento mesiac. Generálny tajomník Kongresu Jairam Ramesh zareagoval tvrdením, že predĺženie znamená pretrvávajúcu ekonomickú núdzu a rastúcu nerovnosť v krajine. Tvrdil, že príjmy väčšiny Indov nerastú úmerne s rastúcimi cenami základných tovarov. Ramesh tiež kritizoval premiéra Modiho, že ako bývalý hlavný minister Gudžarátu odporoval Národnému zákonu o potravinovej bezpečnosti (NFSA), ktorý bol prijatý parlamentom v septembri 2013. Uviedol, že PMGKY je v podstate rozšírením NFSA a tiež spomenul, že Modi zmenil postoj aj k programom ako MGNREGA, ktorý bol počas pandémie kľúčový. Vláda zároveň zakázala 22 nelegálnych stávkových a hazardných aplikácií vrátane Mahadev Book Online, ktorý je spájaný s obvineniami z úplatkárstva voči hlavnému ministrovi štátu Čhattisgarh Bhupeshovi Baghelovi. Nedávne údaje ukazujú, že produktivita zamestnancov vo veľkých indických firmách za posledných päť rokov vzrástla. Tento trend prichádza uprostred diskusie o dlhých pracovných hodinách, pričom príjem na zamestnanca rastie a personálne náklady sa pohybujú okolo 10 % z celkových príjmov.

article_content: While blue and green hydrogen have captured much of the attention for clean energy solutions, a growing number of energy and technology companies are developing turquoise hydrogen, produced through methane pyrolysis. This process splits natural gas (methane) into hydrogen and solid carbon. The solid carbon, often called 'black gold,' can be processed into synthetic graphite, an increasingly valuable material essential to all electric vehicle (EV) batteries. According to industry expert Ashcroft, aligning industries around electric batteries and critical minerals like synthetic graphite is strategically important. He points out that methane pyrolysis is more water-efficient than traditional hydrogen production, noting that blue and green hydrogen each require around 10 kilograms of water per kilogram produced—a major concern in arid regions such as the U.S. desert Southwest and the Permian Basin. Asian countries such as Japan, Korea, and China are already pushing forward with methane pyrolysis technology, seeing its potential to diversify hydrogen production and capitalize on the solid carbon byproduct. In the U.S., demand for graphite is surging: in 2021, 95 companies consumed 45,000 tons of natural graphite (valued at $41 million), much of it imported from China. A single large EV battery plant can require over 35,000 tons of graphite each year. Natural graphite is cheaper to mine ($4,000-$7,000 per ton) compared to synthetic graphite (over $9,000 per ton), which makes up about 10% of a battery cell’s cost. North American battery makers, such as Novonix, are investing in domestic graphite production; Novonix is opening its Chattanooga, Tennessee plant in 2024 with help from a $150 million DOE grant. Nevertheless, China continues to dominate the graphite market, making up nearly 80% of world production. China’s recent export controls on battery grade graphite, as well as existing U.S. tariffs, highlight North America’s urgent need for local supply. Novonix, for example, plans to use petroleum coke from Phillips 66 for graphite production, with an eye to pivoting to alternatives like pyrolysis-derived carbon in the future. Globally, only a handful of companies are advancing methane pyrolysis, but investment is growing as the hydrogen market is predicted to expand from $170 billion today to over $300 billion by 2030. The market specifically for turquoise hydrogen, now small, may grow rapidly as companies and governments pursue net-zero goals. In the U.S., Monolith Nebraska LLC operates the only commercial methane pyrolysis plant, with the carbon byproduct being sold to tire manufacturers Michelin and Goodyear. California-based C-Zero is developing a similar process that requires less electricity and yields solid carbon and hydrogen. However, methane pyrolysis's efficiency is challenged by the fact that it uses roughly twice as much natural gas for the same energy output, and technical hurdles remain, especially if upstream methane emissions are not tightly controlled. Many oil and gas majors are quietly testing methane pyrolysis but have not incorporated it into core business, as monetizing carbon is unlikely to become central for large companies. Meanwhile, the Biden administration has invested billions into hydrogen and EV infrastructure separately but has not formally linked the two. Methane pyrolysis is not included in current federal clean hydrogen initiatives, pending further lifecycle emission analysis by the Department of Energy.
translated_content: Kým väčšina pozornosti sa sústreďuje na modrý a zelený vodík, čoraz viac energetických a technologických spoločností vyvíja tyrkysový vodík, vyrábaný pyrolýzou metánu. Tento proces rozdeľuje zemný plyn (metán) na vodík a tuhý uhlík. Tuhý uhlík, prezývaný aj „čierne zlato“, možno spracovať na syntetický grafit – čoraz cennejšiu surovinu, ktorá je zásadná pre všetky batérie elektrických vozidiel (EV). Podľa odborníka Ashcrofta je pre strategickú budúcnosť dôležité prepojiť priemysel okolo elektrických batérií a kritických minerálov, ako je syntetický grafit. Zdôrazňuje, že pyrolýza metánu je oveľa efektívnejšia z hľadiska spotreby vody – na výrobu jedného kilogramu modrého či zeleného vodíka je potrebných okolo 10 kg vody, čo je veľký problém v suchých oblastiach ako juhozápad USA či Permská panva. Ázijské krajiny ako Japonsko, Kórea a Čína už napredujú s technológiou pyrolýzy metánu, keďže v nej vidia možnosť diverzifikovať výrobu vodíka a využiť vedľajší produkt – tuhý uhlík. V USA dopyt po grafite rýchlo rastie: v roku 2021 spotrebovalo 95 spoločností 45 000 ton prírodného grafitu (v hodnote 41 miliónov dolárov), pričom väčšina bola dovezená z Číny. Jediný veľký závod na výrobu EV batérií dokáže spotrebovať ročne viac ako 35-tisíc ton grafitu. Prírodný grafit je lacnejší na ťažbu (4 000–7 000 dolárov za tonu), zatiaľ čo syntetický grafit stojí viac ako 9 000 dolárov za tonu – tvorí zhruba 10 % ceny samotného batériového článku. Severoamerickí výrobcovia batérií, ako Novonix, preto investujú do domácej produkcie grafitu; Novonix pripravuje otvorenie závodu v Chattanooga, Tennessee, v roku 2024 s podporou grantu DOE vo výške 150 miliónov dolárov. Napriek tomu však Čína stále dominuje trhu – má podiel takmer 80 % na svetovej produkcii grafitu. Nedávne čínske vývozné obmedzenia na batériový grafit a existujúce americké clá zdôrazňujú akútnu potrebu domácich zdrojov v Severnej Amerike. Novonix napríklad plánuje na výrobu grafitu použiť ropné koks od spoločnosti Phillips 66, no v budúcnosti zvažuje aj alternatívy ako uhlík z pyrolýzy. Celosvetovo len niekoľko firiem napreduje v pyrolýze metánu, no investície rastú, keďže trh s vodíkom má podľa prognóz narásť zo 170 miliárd dolárov na viac ako 300 miliárd do roku 2030. Trh s tyrkysovým vodíkom je zatiaľ malý, no môže rýchlo expandovať, ak firmy a vlády budú sledovať ciele uhlíkovej neutrality. V USA prevádzkuje spoločnosť Monolith Nebraska LLC jediný komerčný závod na pyrolýzu metánu, pričom vedľajší produkt – uhlík – predáva výrobcom pneumatík Michelin a Goodyear. Kalifornská firma C-Zero vyvíja zefektívnenú verziu tohto procesu s nižšou spotrebou elektriny, ktorá produkuje tuhý uhlík a vodík. Efektivitu pyrolýzy však znižuje fakt, že na rovnaké množstvo energie je potrebné asi dvojnásobné množstvo zemného plynu, pričom technické výzvy pretrvávajú najmä pri kontrole emisií metánu. Mnohé veľké ropné a plynárenské firmy zatiaľ pyrolýzu testujú len opatrne a nemajú ju ako jadro svojich biznisov, keďže monetizácia uhlíka pre nich pravdepodobne nie je strategická. Medzitým administratíva prezidenta Bidena investovala miliardy do infraštruktúry vodíka a elektromobilov, ale zatiaľ tieto dve oblasti oficiálne neprepojila. Tyrkysový vodík momentálne nie je súčasťou federálnych iniciatív na čistý vodík, kým Ministerstvo energetiky neuzavrie hodnotenie jeho vplyvu na životné prostredie.

article_content: Amazon is rolling out generative AI features for Alexa and Fire TV, with the goal of enhancing user interactions. Daniel Rausch, Vice President for Alexa and Fire TV at Amazon, recently discussed this technical leap and Amazon’s approach to making it happen. Rausch explained that generative AI signifies a major advance for Alexa, and Amazon is building on an existing base of over 500 million Alexa-compatible devices worldwide. He pointed out that adapting generative AI for a home assistant like Alexa is more complex than a browser chatbot, as home devices require tailored, contextual responses. Amazon created a custom large language model specifically for Alexa’s demands. This model is designed for voice interaction, fast response times, and access to live information—requirements that present unique challenges. For instance, Alexa can now deliver sports scores just moments after a game concludes, showcasing a commitment to timely, accurate information. Reliable performance is vital, especially when Alexa manages things like home security. Rausch recognized that AI errors—even minor ones—can have serious consequences in this setting. To prevent such risks, Amazon is working to ground Alexa’s responses with trusted data and back complex interactions with hundreds of APIs. Upcoming upgrades will let people talk to Alexa without always saying its name. Devices like the Echo Show 8 use on-device camera processing to detect when you’re looking at them, removing the need for a wake word. This Visual ID system is opt-in and processes everything locally, with settings that let users deactivate microphones for extra privacy. Protecting privacy and security remains central to Amazon’s design process. Rausch highlighted that features like hardware switches for muting microphones are built in from the start, giving users tangible control and building trust. Amazon is also bringing generative AI to other products, such as generating unique wallpapers for Fire TV. Rausch described Amazon’s broader goal as making Alexa a form of ambient intelligence—quietly at work in the background, accessible when needed, and unobtrusive the rest of the time. Integrating generative AI is seen as the key to realizing this vision further.
translated_content: Amazon spúšťa generatívnu umelú inteligenciu pre Alexu a Fire TV, aby zdokonalil spôsob, akým ľudia so zariadeniami komunikujú. Daniel Rausch, viceprezident pre Alexu a Fire TV, nedávno hovoril o tejto technologickej inovácii a o tom, ako ju Amazon uvádza do praxe. Rausch vysvetlil, že generatívna AI je pre Alexu veľkým krokom vpred a Amazon nadväzuje na základňu viac ako 500 miliónov zariadení s podporou Alexa po celom svete. Upozornil, že nasadenie generatívnej AI do domáceho asistenta, ako je Alexa, je zložitejšie než u obyčajných chatbotov, pretože domáce zariadenia potrebujú presnejšie a osobnejšie odpovede. Amazon vyvinul vlastný veľký jazykový model šitý na mieru pre Alexu. Tento model vyhovuje hlasovým príkazom, je rýchly a dokáže pracovať s aktuálnymi informáciami, čo so sebou prináša jedinečné technické výzvy. Napríklad Alexa dnes zvláda oznámiť športové výsledky už krátko po zápase, čím dokazuje dôraz na rýchlosť a presnosť. Spoľahlivosť je nevyhnutná, najmä keď Alexa ovláda domáce bezpečnostné prvky. Rausch si uvedomuje, že aj malé zlyhanie AI môže mať vážne následky. Preto Amazon dôsledne dbá na to, aby odpovede Alexy boli podložené overenými údajmi a mnohé úlohy sú podporované stoviek API. Nové vylepšenia umožnia ovládať Alexu pohľadom bez vyslovenia jej mena. Napríklad na Echo Show 8 funguje rozpoznávanie prítomnosti užívateľa prostredníctvom kamery priamo v zariadení, pričom všetky dáta sú spracovávané iba lokálne. Používatelia si môžu aktivovať Visual ID a kedykoľvek vypnúť mikrofóny pre lepšie súkromie. Ochrana súkromia a bezpečnosti je stále prioritou. Rausch upozorňuje, že hardvérové vypínače mikrofónu sú implementované už od začiatku, čo posilňuje dôveru zákazníkov. Amazon plánuje generatívnu AI nasadiť aj do ďalších produktov, ako je napríklad tvorba originálnych tapiet na Fire TV. Konečnou víziou je podľa Rauscha to, aby sa Alexa stala nenápadnou inteligenciou, ktorá je pripravená pomôcť v pozadí domácnosti a v pravý čas nenápadne zasiahnuť. Práve generatívna AI má tento cieľ naplniť.

article_content: Home Secretary Theresa May sparked surprise today after delivering harsh criticisms of the police at the Police Federation's annual conference in Bournemouth. She accused some officers of showing 'contempt' toward the public, citing the treatment of abuse and domestic violence victims. May announced the government would withdraw all public funding for the Police Federation, claiming the organization holds reserves worth tens of millions of pounds. Her remarks came after a fourth police officer was dismissed in connection with the Downing Street 'plebgate' incident, involving former Chief Whip Andrew Mitchell. In that event, Mitchell allegedly used insulting language after being denied permission to cycle through Downing Street gates in September 2012, though he denied certain claims about his words. PC Susan Johnson of the diplomatic protection group was dismissed for gross misconduct, while PC Gillian Weatherley was previously sacked for links to press leaks during the scandal. A total of four officers have now been dismissed, with one further gross misconduct case ongoing. May told the Federation that it was time to 'face up to reality' and embrace necessary reforms. She criticized officers under investigation who decline to answer questions and blamed the Federation for encouraging this behavior, which she said is at odds with the principles of public service. She highlighted other troubling incidents, such as officers recorded making derogatory remarks about a domestic violence victim, and concerns about the use of stop and search. May emphasized that such attitudes betray the public's trust. According to her, a third of the public do not trust officers to tell the truth. During the Q&A, some officers expressed feeling personally attacked by May's remarks but acknowledged the need for change. Outgoing Federation chair Steve Williams also voiced concerns about falling officer numbers due to budget cuts. May announced that not only would Federation funding be eliminated from August, but also that membership would no longer be automatic—officers will instead have to opt in. Funds previously allocated to the Federation will be redirected to Police First, a program to recruit talented university graduates. She warned that if the Federation does not implement recommended reforms, including those proposed by Sir David Normington, the government would act through legislation. May stated she prefers voluntary change but will not hesitate to impose new rules if needed. The Federation, representing 126,000 officers in England and Wales, has faced public criticism following a series of scandals. An independent review said it lost the trust of officers after controversial campaigns and the mishandling of government disputes. Investigations uncovered secret accounts holding millions and excessive expense claims. The wider police service is also under scrutiny over incidents including the Hillsborough disaster and the Stephen Lawrence murder investigation, along with allegations of cover-ups and manipulation of crime statistics.

May oznámila, že vláda stiahne všetko verejné financovanie Policejnej federácie, keďže organizácia má v rezervách desiatky miliónov libier. Jej prejav zaznel po tom, čo bol v súvislosti s kauzou "plebgate" v Downing Street – zahŕňajúcou bývalého šéfa poslaneckého klubu Andrewa Mitchella – prepustený štvrtý policajt. Mitchell mal údajne použiť urážlivý jazyk, keď mu v septembri 2012 nebolo dovolené prejsť bránou v Downing Street na bicykli, on však niektoré tvrdenia poprel. Policajtka Susan Johnson z ochrannej jednotky bola prepustená pre závažné porušenie služobných povinností, zatiaľ čo policajtka Gillian Weatherley bola už skôr prepustená pre únik informácií do médií v rámci tejto kauzy. Celkovo boli v súvislosti so škandálom prepustení štyria policajti, ďalší jeden prípad závažného pochybenia ešte prebieha. May povedala federácii, že je načase "postaviť sa realite" a prijať potrebné reformy. Kritizovala policajtov vyšetrovaných v prípade pochybení, ktorí odmietajú odpovedať na otázky, pričom federáciu obvinila z podporovania takéhoto správania, ktoré je podľa nej v rozpore s princípmi verejnej služby. Spomenula aj ďalšie problematické prípady, napríklad policajtov zaznamenaných pri hanlivých poznámkach smerom k obeti domáceho násilia, či kontroverzie ohľadom stopovania a prehliadok. May zdôraznila, že takýto prístup podrýva dôveru verejnosti. Podľa nej tretina verejnosti neverí, že policajti hovoria pravdu. Počas diskusie niektorí policajti vyjadrili pocit, že ich May osobne napadla, no priznali potrebu zmien. Odchádzajúci predseda federácie Steve Williams zároveň upozornil na klesajúci počet policajtov v dôsledku škrtov v rozpočte. May oznámila, že nielenže bude financovanie federácie ukončené od augusta, ale členstvo už nebude automatické – policajti sa budú musieť prihlásiť dobrovoľne. Prostriedky, ktoré federácia doteraz dostávala, budú presmerované na program Police First, ktorý má prilákať nadaných absolventov vysokých škôl. Varovala, že ak federácia nezavedie odporúčané reformy vrátane návrhov sira Davida Normingtona, vláda pristúpi k legislatívnym zásahom. May zdôraznila, že preferuje dobrovoľné zmeny, ale v prípade potreby neváha zaviesť nové pravidlá. Federácia zastupujúca 126 000 policajtov v Anglicku a vo Walese čelila v posledných mesiacoch verejnej kritike a škandálom. Nezávislá revízia uviedla, že po kontroverzných kampaniach a spore s vládou stratila dôveru radových policajtov. Kontroly odhalili tajné účty s miliónmi a nadštandardné výdavky. Celé policajné zložky sú pod dozorom verejnosti v súvislosti s prípadmi ako tragédia v Hillsborough alebo vražda Stephena Lawrencea, ako aj kvôli obvineniam z utajovania informácií a manipulácie so štatistikami trestnej činnosti.

article_content: Karva Chauth has become one of the biggest single-day sales occasions for companies selling makeup, jewellery, and salon services in India. According to Vineeta Singh, CEO of Sugar Cosmetics, the company sold products worth ₹4 crore on the day before Karva Chauth and ₹75 crore in October. She shared a photo from a shop in Ludhiana packed with women shopping for makeup. Popularized by Bollywood movies and celebrities, Karva Chauth now draws shoppers from across the country, not just the north. Social media, Bollywood, and aggressive marketing have made the festival a national event. High-end salon packages for Karva Chauth can cost between ₹30,000 and ₹3 lakh per session, often including spa treatments, hair coloring and styling, facials, makeup, mehndi, saree draping, and jewellery selection. Despite gold prices exceeding Rs 61,000 per 10 gm, jewellery sales surged 20-25% in the two weeks leading up to Karva Chauth (November 1, 2023), boosting expectations for strong Dhanteras and Diwali sales. Popular jewellery items included bangles, pendant and earring sets, and mangalsutras, noted Suvaknar Sen, MD of Senco Gold & Diamonds. The company, endorsed by actor Kiara Advani, saw a 25% increase in gold and lightweight diamond jewellery sales compared to last year. Executives say younger and more progressive couples are now celebrating Karva Chauth, with many men fasting alongside their wives, challenging the festival's previous 'regressive' image. Sandeep Goyal, chairman of Rediffusion, predicts more brands will target the festival next year. Lotus Herbals chairman Nitin Passi reported that Lip Lacquer sales rose 40% from last year in the two weeks before Karva Chauth. He said festival sales are driving demand for the upcoming wedding season, with CAIT projecting a record 3.5 million weddings generating around ₹4.25 lakh crore in business this year. Malabar Gold & Diamonds also reported strong Karva Chauth sales and ran campaigns featuring actors Alia Bhatt and Anil Kapoor. Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra launched special Karva Chauth promotions for their fashion and beauty products. Former VLCC MD Sandeep Ahuja noted that social media has helped local and regional festivals attract pan-India consumer engagement and aggressive marketing. He observed a boost in beauty, white goods, and shopping festivals as a result. Other news included telcos accusing tech companies of bypassing legal routes for business messaging, government requesting Apple's participation in an iPhone hacking investigation, and the DGCA informing Go First lessors they can repossess leased aircraft and engines.

article_content: Amid rising international concern over claims that Syrian President Bashar al-Assad has used chemical weapons, his wife, Asma al-Assad, has largely stayed out of the public spotlight. According to Andrew Tabler of the Washington Institute for Near East Policy, Asma is in Damascus and continues to support her husband. Recent Instagram posts from the presidential family feature the couple at community events—showing images of Asma comforting children and speaking with local women—deliberately projecting a compassionate and supportive image while omitting any display of the ongoing war. These carefully managed photos have appeared following Bashar al-Assad’s decision to join Instagram, expanding his social media presence beyond Facebook and YouTube. Despite a civil war that the United Nations reports has led to over 100,000 deaths, the regime’s online profile presents a narrative of normalcy and civic engagement, with posts highlighting the Assads at formal events, religious observances like Ramadan, and various ceremonies—avoiding references to violence. The public reaction online is split. Supporters from Syria and abroad post encouraging messages—such as ‘God bless you’ and ‘We want you to win this war’—while critics accuse the account of glossing over the harsh realities of the conflict. There are also recurring comments that highlight a perceived disconnect between the family’s luxury lifestyle and the suffering within Syria, referencing Asma’s fashion choices and rumored shopping habits. Asma once had a reputation as a modern, reform-minded first lady invested in children’s issues, a narrative highlighted in a 2011 Vogue article. However, as the war progressed, her image suffered: the Vogue profile was widely criticized as insensitive, and soon after, the European Union levied sanctions against Asma and her relatives. Further controversy arose from leaked emails that exposed expensive purchases by Asma, such as jewelry and art, at a time of national crisis. Her ongoing public silence in the face of allegations of regime-led violence—despite her previous advocacy for children—has increased international criticism. So far, little is publicly documented about her day-to-day actions aside from orchestrated public appearances. Discussions continue online, with supporters and detractors debating whether the Assad family's social media is genuine or a calculated form of propaganda.

Podľa Andrewa Tablera z Washington Institute for Near East Policy sa Asma zdržiava v Damasku a naďalej podporuje svojho muža. Najnovšie fotografie na Instagrame prezidentskej rodiny zobrazujú pár na komunitných podujatiach—Asma utešuje deti a rozpráva sa s miestnymi ženami—čím zámerne prezentuje obraz súcitnej a podporujúcej prvej dámy, no vojnová realita chýba. Tieto starostlivo manažované snímky sa objavili po tom, čo sa Bašár al-Asad pripojil na Instagram, čím rozšíril svoje pôsobenie na sociálnych sieťach popri Facebooku a YouTube. Napriek občianskej vojne, ktorá podľa OSN priniesla viac než 100 000 obetí, profil režimu sa zameriava na obraz pokojného každodenného života a občianskej angažovanosti, zvýrazňujúc účasť Asadovcov na oficiálnych akciách, ramadánových slávnostiach a rôznych ceremoniách—pričom sa vyhýba zmienkam o násilí. Často sa objavujú aj narážky na odtrhnutosť životného štýlu rodiny od utrpenia bežných Sýrčanov, s poznámkami o Asminej móde a údajných nákupoch. Jej pretrvávajúce ticho k obviňovaniam z násilností režimu, napriek predchádzajúcej angažovanosti za deti, ešte viac zintenzívnilo medzinárodnú kritiku. O jej bežnom živote je verejne známe len málo, okrem pripravených vystúpení. Online diskusie pokračujú, pričom podporovatelia aj kritici polemizujú, či je obraz rodiny Asadových autentický alebo ide o propagandu.

article_content: BBC Director-General Tony Hall is facing criticism for awarding a £600,000 contract to McKinsey & Company for an internal review led by his former Royal Opera House colleague, Suzanne Heywood. The two-month project aims to streamline the BBC’s internal structure. Heywood, who is also a director at the Royal Opera House, has previously worked with Hall, raising concerns about possible favoritism in the selection process. Labour MP Margaret Hodge and Conservative MP Conor Burns have both demanded more transparency. Hodge has questioned the process behind McKinsey being chosen over other firms and warned that the public accounts committee may launch an inquiry if the BBC doesn’t provide sufficient answers. Burns has requested that all documents related to the contract be published to prove that it was awarded on merit rather than personal connections. The controversy is part of wider criticisms regarding the BBC’s use of expensive consultants and the appointment of executives without publicly advertising the roles. Recent senior hires like Anne Bulford and James Purnell, who had prior ties to Hall, were brought on board in similar ways. The BBC has defended its actions, stating McKinsey was selected after a competitive tender process involving four shortlisted companies. The final decision was made by a committee that included Hall. The scrutiny reflects ongoing concerns about the BBC’s financial management. Some MPs recently compared its oversight to 'corporate fraud and cronyism.' Despite these criticisms, the BBC maintains that the contract and appointments were based on merit and organizational needs.

Dvojmesačný projekt má zjednodušiť vnútornú štruktúru BBC. Heywood, ktorá je tiež riaditeľkou Royal Opera House, už s Hallom spolupracovala, čo vyvoláva podozrenia z možného zvýhodňovania pri výbere. Labouristická poslankyňa Margaret Hodge a konzervatívny poslanec Conor Burns požadujú väčšiu transparentnosť. Hodge spochybnila proces, ktorým McKinsey vyhrala zákazku pred inými spoločnosťami, a varuje, že verejný účtovný výbor môže začať vyšetrovanie, ak BBC neposkytne uspokojivé odpovede. Burns žiada zverejnenie všetkých dokumentov súvisiacich so zmluvou, aby bolo jasné, že bola pridelená na základe zásluh, nie osobných vzťahov. Kontroverzia je súčasťou širšej kritiky týkajúcej sa nákladných konzultačných služieb a neoznamovaných manažérskych menovaní v BBC. Nedávne vymenovania ako Anne Bulford a James Purnell, ktorí mali predchádzajúce pracovné vzťahy s Hallom, prebehli podobným spôsobom. BBC tvrdí, že spoločnosť McKinsey bola vybraná po súťažnom výberovom konaní so štyrmi spoločnosťami, pričom konečné rozhodnutie spravil výbor vrátane Halla. Táto zvýšená kontrola odráža pretrvávajúce obavy z finančného riadenia v BBC. Niektorí poslanci nedávno prirovnali dohľad nad televíziou k 'korporátnemu podvodu a klientelizmu.' BBC však trvá na tom, že zmluvy a menovania boli rozhodnuté na základe zásluh a potrieb organizácie.

article_content: A private security guard opened fire inside a Russian Orthodox cathedral on Sakhalin Island, resulting in the deaths of a nun and a churchgoer and injuring six others. The shooting occurred on Sunday at the Cathedral of the Resurrection of Christ in Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, as Russian security forces remained on high alert due to concerns over possible attacks during the Winter Olympics in Sochi, although officials say there is no connection to the Games. The federal Investigative Committee reported that the gunman was apprehended at the scene. He had previously worked as a security guard in Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk, which is about 4,130 miles from Moscow. Authorities have not disclosed a motive for the attack. The incident comes just six days after a school shooting in Moscow by a teenager, an event that has sparked calls for stricter laws concerning gun ownership in Russia. Most of those wounded in Sunday’s attack suffered gunshot wounds to their legs and are not in life-threatening condition, according to statements by Archbishop Tikhon, regional leader of the Russian Orthodox Church. He also mentioned that a prayer service for the victims would be held at the cathedral, and that the affected part of the church would be cleansed and blessed. The Investigative Committee has stated that psychiatrists will assess the mental health of the suspect. Although mass shootings are rare in Russia, recent violent incidents have prompted heightened attention from both authorities and state media.

Úrady zatiaľ nezverejnili motív útoku. Incident prišiel len šesť dní po tom, čo moskovský tínedžer spáchal streľbu na škole, čo vyvolalo výzvy na sprísnenie zákonov týkajúcich sa vlastníctva zbraní v Rusku. Väčšina zranených pri nedeľňajšom útoku utrpela strelné zranenia dolných končatín a nie sú v ohrození života, uviedol arcibiskup Tichon, regionálny vodca ruskej pravoslávnej cirkvi. Ten tiež oznámil, že za obete sa v katedrále uskutoční modlitebná omša a postihnutú časť kostola očistia a požehnajú. Vyšetrovací výbor uviedol, že duševný stav podozrivého posúdia psychiatri. Hoci sú masové streľby v Rusku zriedkavé, v poslednom čase zvýšené násilné činy povzbudili úradníkov a štátne médiá k väčšej pozornosti.

Police in British Columbia have charged a motorcyclist after he allegedly recorded himself reaching speeds of at least 186 mph (299 km/h) on a busy highway. With assistance from public tips, the Saanich Police Department, located on Vancouver Island, identified the suspect as 25-year-old Randy George Scott of Victoria. Scott remains at large as police continue their efforts to locate him. The online video depicting the high-speed ride has nearly a million views.

"We have a dedicated group of traffic safety officers, and this is a dramatic example of obviously dangerous driving," Sgt. Dean Jantzen told CNN. The footage shows a motorcyclist weaving between cars, reportedly hitting a top speed of 299 kilometers per hour. Authorities believe he may have been going even faster, based on sounds captured in the video. The posted speed limit on that stretch is 50 mph.

The incident occurred April 6 on a congested section of the Trans-Canada Highway in Saanich, an area generally not known for such extreme reckless driving. Police state that if Scott is convicted, he could face up to five years in jail. Scott, who reportedly has previous encounters with law enforcement, has been added to the Saanich Police Department's 'Most Wanted' fugitive list, and officials are urging him to surrender.

The full video is available at http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ylDA3UV2eXc.
