article_content: Water sustains all life on Earth, but only about 1% of it is fresh water available to people, plants, and land animals. The remaining water is trapped in oceans, polar ice, or rocks. As climate change intensifies, how this limited freshwater is distributed around the world becomes crucial. Recent research published in Science demonstrates that from 2001 to 2020, the southern hemisphere saw a more pronounced drying trend than the northern hemisphere. Researchers link this mainly to the El Niño climate cycle, a period when the eastern Pacific Ocean warms up more than usual. The researchers used satellite imagery and river and stream flow measurements to study water availability, which they define as the difference between water gained from rainfall and water lost through evaporation and plants. Though the southern hemisphere covers just a quarter of the Earth’s land area (excluding Antarctica), it has a significant impact on the planet’s water resources. The study observed marked declines in water in South America, much of Africa, and central and northwestern Australia, while some southern regions of South America experienced increases. Conversely, the northern hemisphere’s water resources appeared stable overall, despite regional changes. This is largely credited to extensive human management—such as irrigation and damming—especially since about 90% of people live on this side of the globe. These findings are important because changes in southern hemisphere water availability can send shockwaves worldwide. For instance, the Amazon rainforest in South America isn’t just a center for biodiversity and home to many Indigenous peoples—it acts as a vital regulator for the climate. Less rain could mean less forest cover, greater wildfire risks, and massive releases of stored carbon, which would have far-reaching environmental consequences. Furthermore, South America supplies a substantial share of global soybeans, coffee, sugar, meat, and fruits. Water shortages threaten food production and may disrupt global food supplies. Africa, which has many different climates and economic situations, faces mounting difficulties as droughts reduce essential crops like cassava and threaten exports such as coffee and cocoa. With ongoing increases in food prices and limited resources to adjust, the region risks escalating poverty and hunger. Similarly, Australia’s vast northwestern and central areas may face hotter, drier years, pushing temperatures above 35°C for much of the year by 2100 if emissions don’t drop. These changes will affect wildlife, local climates (including in Australia’s cities), and health, all due to drying landscapes. While individual regional changes are hard to predict, this research shows a clear overall shift: southern hemisphere drying is increasing, especially during El Niño events. This brings new challenges for ecosystems, food systems, and populations globally. Ultimately, even though the southern hemisphere has much water, shifts there affect everyone on the planet.
translated_content: Voda je základom všetkého života na Zemi, no iba približne 1 % z nej tvorí sladká voda dostupná pre ľudí, rastliny a suchozemské zvieratá. Zvyšok je uzavretý v oceánoch, polárnych ľadovcoch alebo v horninách. S narastajúcimi klimatickými zmenami je čoraz dôležitejšie, ako sa toto obmedzené množstvo sladkej vody rozdeľuje po svete. Nedávna štúdia publikovaná v časopise Science ukázala, že v rokoch 2001 až 2020 zaznamenala južná pologuľa výraznejšie vysychanie ako severná. Vedci to pripísali hlavne klimatickému javu El Niño, keď je východný Tichý oceán teplejší ako zvyčajne. Výskum využil satelitné snímky a merania tokov riek a potokov na sledovanie dostupnosti vody, teda rozdielu medzi vodou získanou z dažďa a vodou, ktorá sa stratí odparovaním či cez rastliny. Aj keď južná pologuľa (bez Antarktídy) tvorí iba štvrtinu pevniny Zeme, má výrazný vplyv na svetové vodné zdroje. Vedci zaznamenali citeľný pokles vody v Južnej Amerike, vo väčšine Afriky a v centrálnej a severozápadnej Austrálii, pričom niektoré južné časti Južnej Ameriky naopak zaznamenali rast. Zdroje vody na severnej pologuli zostali naopak celkovo stabilné – do veľkej miery vďaka intenzívnemu ľudskému zásahu (zavlažovanie, priehrady), keďže na severe žije až 90 % obyvateľov sveta. Tieto poznatky sú zásadné, lebo zmeny v zásobách vody na juhu môžu ovplyvniť celý svet. Napríklad Amazonský prales v Južnej Amerike nie je len domovom veľkej biodiverzity a pôvodných obyvateľov, ale je aj dôležitým regulátorom klímy. Menej dažďa môže znamenať menej lesa, väčšie riziko požiarov a masívne uvoľňovanie uhlíka, s veľkými dôsledkami pre životné prostredie. Južná Amerika navyše zásobuje svet sójou, kávou, cukrom, mäsom aj ovocím. Nedostatok vody môže ohroziť produkciu a narušiť zásobovanie potravinami na celom svete. Afrika s rozmanitým podnebím a ekonomikou čelí čoraz väčším výzvam. Suchá znižujú úrody plodín ako maniok a ohrozujú export kávy či kakaa. S rastúcimi cenami potravín a obmedzenými možnosťami adaptácie sa v regióne zvyšuje riziko chudoby a hladu. Aj rozsiahle oblasti severozápadnej a strednej Austrálie môžu očakávať suchšie a teplejšie podmienky – ak emisie zostanú vysoké, do roku 2100 môžu počas veľkej časti roka dosahovať teploty nad 35 °C. To ovplyvní faunu, miestnu klímu (vrátane veľkých miest) aj ľudské zdravie. Hoci miestne zmeny je ťažké presne predpovedať, štúdia jasne ukazuje celkový trend – suchosť na južnej pologuli rastie, najmä počas El Niño. To predstavuje nové výzvy pre ekosystémy, potravinové systémy i obyvateľov na celom svete. Aj keď južná pologuľa má obrovské vodné zásoby, to, čo sa deje tam, ovplyvňuje nás všetkých.

Chicago Cubs icon Ernie Banks died at 83, his family confirmed, following a heart attack Friday at Northwestern Memorial Hospital. Family attorney Mark Bogen announced the news, while Banks' wife declined further comment.

Banks dedicated all 19 seasons of his Major League Baseball career to the Cubs, becoming renowned for both his impressive skills and his relentless positivity. He recorded 512 home runs, claimed two National League MVP awards, and earned 11 All-Star selections. Despite never reaching the postseason, Banks' upbeat spirit and loyalty made him a treasured figure in Chicago.

Cities and fans across the country are paying tribute. The Cubs will move his statue from Wrigley Field to Daley Plaza temporarily for public honor. Banks’ memorable quote—'It's a great day for baseball. Let's play two!'—remains a rallying cry at Wrigley.

Banks, who entered the Hall of Fame in 1977 and was named to the All-Century Team in 1999, often outshone his team’s losing records with an infectious smile and optimistic outlook. Actor Bill Murray even honored him by naming his son Homer Banks Murray. The Cubs retired his number 14 jersey, which continues to hang at Wrigley Field.

After starting in the Negro Leagues with the Kansas City Monarchs, Banks joined the Cubs in 1953. His shift to a lighter bat in 1955 resulted in a dramatic increase in home runs, setting a grand slam record that year. His stellar 1958 season (batting .313, 47 homers, 129 RBIs) earned him his first MVP, and he repeated the feat the next year, making him the first National League player to win consecutive MVPs.

A talented both at shortstop and first base, Banks won a Gold Glove award in 1960 and was the eighth MLB player to notch 500 career home runs. He retired in 1971, holding numerous Cubs records and leaving a legacy as one of Chicago's most beloved athletes.

Born and raised in Dallas, Texas, Banks was inspired by his father and began his career in the Negro Leagues before joining the Cubs following military service. His positivity, athletic achievement, and connection to fans live on through the title 'Mr. Cub.'

article_content: Small, round tar balls thought to be left over from the Gulf of Mexico oil spill have started showing up along the shores of Louisiana's Lake Pontchartrain, according to the Lake Pontchartrain Basin Foundation. The affected area stretches for about five miles near Slidell, northeast of New Orleans. Anne Rheams, executive director of the foundation, estimated the amount of oil in the lake at under 100 barrels and mentioned there wasn't a strong smell. 'They're mostly silver dollar-sized, sometimes a bit larger, scattered at intervals instead of forming dense patches,' Rheams explained. 'We’re grateful it's not worse.' By Monday evening, crews had collected over 1,000 pounds of these tar balls, which will be tested to confirm if they've come from the well that's been leaking since April. Tar balls had also been found earlier in Rigolets Pass, a channel connecting Lake Pontchartrain with Mississippi Sound. Authorities have been using booms, barges, and skimmers to shield the lake, but big waves and strong winds have complicated these efforts. Rheams pointed out that the presence of tar balls signals the possibility of further oil intrusion. In response, the state has banned fishing in part of the southern lake, although, as of Monday, there were no visible effects on wildlife. The Coast Guard has issued a warning that shifting weather could push more oil toward Louisiana and Mississippi's coasts, and recent bad weather has hindered cleanup operations. Rheams expects these challenging conditions to persist for at least a few more days. Federal agencies estimate that between 35,000 and 60,000 barrels of oil have been spilling into the Gulf daily since the April 20 Deepwater Horizon rig explosion and sinking off Louisiana. Despite numerous attempts, the leak remains uncapped, and the spread of oil has reached as far as central Florida's Panhandle.

Zasiahnutý úsek má asi päť míľ v blízkosti mesta Slidell, severovýchodne od New Orleans. Výkonná riaditeľka nadácie Anne Rheams odhadla množstvo ropy v jazere na menej ako 100 barelov a spomenula, že nie je cítiť výrazný zápach. „Väčšinou majú veľkosť striebornej mince, niekedy sú o niečo väčšie a sú rozptýlené s medzerami, nevytvárajú husté zhluky,“ vysvetlila Rheams. „Sme vďační, že situácia nie je horšia.“ Do pondelkového večera pracovné tímy odstránili vyše 1 000 libier týchto dechtových hrudiek, ktoré sa budú testovať na potvrdenie, či pochádzajú z vrtu unikajúceho od apríla. Únik sa stále nepodarilo zastaviť a ropná škvrna už zasiahla aj strednú časť floridského Panhandlu.

article_content: El Niño is an irregular but powerful weather phenomenon in the Pacific Ocean that can lead to global disruptions. During El Niño events, warm surface waters usually pushed westward toward Indonesia and eastern Australia move back east, a shift that can cause significant climate impacts worldwide. Physicist Armin Bunde of Justus Liebig University Giessen, together with Josef Ludescher and John Schellnhuber from the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, have developed—for the first time—a highly accurate method to predict both the occurrence and type of an upcoming El Niño about a year in advance. Their findings were published in npj Climate and Atmospheric Science. There are two main forms of El Niño: Central Pacific El Niño, where the warming remains in the central Pacific, and Eastern Pacific El Niño, where the warming extends to the eastern Pacific—leading to much more severe consequences. The Eastern Pacific El Niño often causes extreme droughts, heavy rainfall, flooding, and disrupts marine life, especially off the coasts of Peru and Chile as fish migrate to cooler waters. The new predictive method uses decades of water temperature data from the Western and Central Pacific dating back to 1950. While previous models could only forecast the timing of El Niño about a year ahead, the new approach can also determine which type will occur, helping to assess potential hazards. According to Josef Ludescher, lead author of the study, their method correctly predicts the type of El Niño with an 86% success rate. If the forecast indicates a Central Pacific El Niño, communities can be somewhat reassured, but caution is necessary if an Eastern Pacific El Niño is predicted. The improvement in lead time and accuracy is crucial for implementing early adaptation measures and potentially averting disasters. Armin Bunde highlights that this early warning system outperforms even the latest Earth system models in both advance warning and accuracy. The team successfully predicted the current year’s Eastern Pacific El Niño as early as December 2022, demonstrating the system’s effectiveness.
translated_content: El Niño je nepravidelný, ale silný poveternostný jav v Tichom oceáne, ktorý môže spôsobiť globálne narušenia. Počas udalostí El Niño sa teplé povrchové vody, ktoré sú zvyčajne hnane na západ smerom k Indonézii a východnej Austrálii, presúvajú späť na východ, čo môže mať významné klimatické dopady na celom svete. Fyzik Armin Bunde z Univerzity Justusa Liebiga v Giessene spolu s Josefom Ludescherom a Johnom Schellnhuberom z Potsdamského inštitútu pre výskum klimatických dopadov vyvinuli po prvýkrát vysoko presnú metódu na predpovedanie nielen výskytu, ale aj typu nadchádzajúceho El Niño asi rok vopred. Ich zistenia boli publikované v časopise npj Climate and Atmospheric Science. Existujú dva hlavné typy El Niño: Centrálne tichomorské El Niño, kde sa otepľovanie udržiava v strednej oblasti Tichého oceánu, a Východné tichomorské El Niño, kde sa otepľovanie presúva do východnej časti oceánu – čo vedie k oveľa závažnejším dôsledkom. Východné tichomorské El Niño často spôsobuje extrémne suchá, silné dažde, záplavy a narúša morský život najmä pri pobreží Peru a Čile, keď sa ryby sťahujú do chladnejších vôd. Nová predikčná metóda využíva desaťročia údajov o teplotách vody zo západného a stredného Tichého oceánu od roku 1950. Zatiaľ čo predchádzajúce modely dokázali predpovedať iba načasovanie El Niño asi rok vopred, nový prístup umožňuje určiť aj typ udalosti a pomáha tak vyhodnotiť potenciálne nebezpečenstvá. Podľa Josefa Ludeschera, hlavného autora štúdie, ich metóda dokáže správne predpovedať typ El Niño s úspešnosťou 86 %. Ak predpoveď ukazuje na centrálne tichomorské El Niño, komunity môžu byť do určitej miery pokojné, no pri východnom tichomorskom El Niño je potrebná zvýšená opatrnosť. Vylepšený predstih a presnosť sú kľúčové pre včasné prijatie adaptačných opatrení a možnosť odvrátiť katastrofy. Armin Bunde zdôrazňuje, že tento systém včasného varovania prekonáva aj najnovšie modely Zeme v predstihu aj presnosti. Tím úspešne predpovedal tohtoročné východné tichomorské El Niño už v decembri 2022, čím preukázali efektivitu systému.

A senior IT technician at Switzerland’s Federal Intelligence Service (NDB) is suspected of stealing extensive amounts of classified data, including sensitive details shared between British (MI6), Swiss, and American (CIA) intelligence services. Security officials have warned that this breach might threaten ongoing counter-terrorism operations.

The unnamed technician allegedly copied hundreds of thousands of secret documents onto portable drives and smuggled them out in a backpack. Swiss authorities believe he intended to sell the information and have warned both MI6 and the CIA about the compromise. 

Having worked at the NDB for roughly eight years and possessing broad administrative access, the technician reportedly became dissatisfied when his recommendations for IT system management were disregarded. After ceasing to report for work earlier in the year, his activities were discovered following concerns from the Swiss bank UBS about a suspicious account setup traced back to him. He was arrested last summer, and authorities seized the storage devices before any confirmed sale. However, investigators cannot be certain that no data was leaked prior to his arrest.

The incident has sparked scrutiny of the NDB, particularly regarding the agency’s close integration of human resources and IT divisions, which complicates oversight. The Swiss parliament is also conducting its own investigation, and its report is expected next spring. There are ongoing worries about the NDB's limited investigative capabilities compared to other intelligence agencies. The breach comes at a time when Switzerland’s reputation for discretion and confidentiality is already under pressure from financial data leaks. 

UK and US agencies have not publicly commented, but sources emphasize that identifying British operatives would present the highest danger—though there is no current evidence this has occurred.

Bezpečnostní predstavitelia varujú, že tento únik by mohol ohroziť prebiehajúce protiteroristické operácie.

Neznámy technik údajne skopíroval státisíce tajných dokumentov na prenosné disky a vyniesol ich v batohu. Švajčiarske úrady sa domnievajú, že ich zamýšľal predať a o možnom riziku informovali MI6 aj CIA.

Technik pracoval v NDB približne osem rokov a mal široké administrátorské oprávnenia. Údajne sa stal nespokojný po tom, čo jeho rady týkajúce sa riadenia IT neboli rešpektované. Keď prestal v priebehu roka chodiť do práce, jeho podozrivú činnosť odhalila švajčiarska banka UBS, ktorá upozornila na pokus založiť podozrivý účet spätý s ním. Technik bol zatknutý minulé leto a úrady zaistili úložné zariadenia ešte pred akýmkoľvek potvrdeným predajom údajov. Vyšetrovatelia si však nie sú istí, či pred zatknutím neunikli niektoré informácie.

Tento prípad podnietil kritiku NDB, najmä kvôli prepojeniu personálneho oddelenia s IT, čo komplikuje vnútorný dohľad. Parlament tiež vedie vlastné vyšetrovanie a jeho záver by mal byť známy na jar budúceho roka. Stále sú obavy z obmedzených vyšetrovacích právomocí NDB v porovnaní s inými agentúrami. Únik nastal v čase, keď je povesť Švajčiarska v oblasti diskrétnosti oslabená kvôli finančným škandálom.

Britské a americké úrady sa verejne k prípadu nevyjadrili, no podľa zdrojov by najväčšou hrozbou bolo prezradenie britských agentov – na to však zatiaľ nie je žiadny dôkaz.

article_content: Selhurst Park has been the backdrop for some of the Premier League’s most dramatic moments. Last season, the stadium saw Luis Suarez reduced to tears and John Terry left curled up on the pitch—testaments to Crystal Palace’s knack for upsetting title contenders and securing their own league survival. Ahead of a crucial match in March last season, many Chelsea players didn’t even know where Crystal Palace was, only to discover the impact of their visit. Palace are determined to use their formidable home advantage again this year to make waves in the Premier League. During their previous encounter, John Terry’s own goal handed all three points to Palace, a moment still remembered vividly by their supporters. Mourinho, frustrated after the loss, noted that his players lacked “balls,” simply writing the word on a piece of paper when asked what went wrong. Chelsea entered that match on a strong run, with Mourinho’s managerial acumen expected to secure another title. But Tony Pulis’s Palace, showing resilience and spirit, clinched a 1-0 victory. The defeat derailed Chelsea’s campaign, with fans fondly recalling Terry’s reaction in the penalty area. The difficulty in finding Selhurst Park became a running joke among the Chelsea squad, some of whom were unaware that it was just under 10 miles from Stamford Bridge. This season, Chelsea have started powerfully, recording six wins and a draw from seven matches, led by top scorer Diego Costa. Under new manager Neil Warnock, Palace refuses to be overrun. Warnock stated, “It has got to be a super-human effort,” emphasizing the need for commitment and passion to challenge Mourinho’s team. Selhurst Park saw another momentous night when league-leading Liverpool visited with two games left in the season. Down three goals, Palace mounted an incredible comeback to draw 3-3—a night dubbed ‘Crystanbul’. The result left Liverpool’s Suarez devastated and signaled the end of their title hopes. Warnock describes Selhurst Park as special, intimidating, and unique—an old-fashioned ground packed with over 26,000 passionate fans. The challenging logistics and unchanged character create an atmosphere few away managers relish. Mourinho, having previously quipped that his players hadn’t heard of Palace before, will no doubt ensure his team is better prepared for their next encounter. A brief club history: Crystal Palace was founded in 1905, first reached the First Division in 1969, and adopted their red and blue stripes under Malcolm Allison in 1973, changing their nickname from the Glaziers to the Eagles. Their highest league finish was third in 1990-91, when they also won the Zenith Data Systems Trophy at Wembley, and they reached their only FA Cup final the previous season. Palace holds the record for most points in a Premier League relegation (49 points in 1992-93) and was one of four teams relegated from the top flight in 1994-95. Twelve players have been capped for England while at Palace, most recently Wilfried Zaha in 2012.

article_content: At the All Things Digital Conference on Tuesday night, Apple CEO Tim Cook offered more than routine answers to questions from Walt Mossberg and Kara Swisher—he also hinted at possible directions for Apple's product lineup. While Cook reiterated positive points about the iPad, iPhone, and iPod, he also provided noteworthy details, particularly about Siri. Cook acknowledged that Siri, Apple's virtual assistant, needs improvement. He said, 'There's more that Siri can do, and we have a lot of people working on this. I think you will be really pleased with some of the things you'll see over the coming months. We have some cool ideas about what Siri can do.' Apple appears committed to evolving Siri out of its current 'beta' status. While most iPhone 4S users report being satisfied with Siri, there have been complaints and a class-action lawsuit regarding how Siri was advertised. Enhancements are expected in Siri's understanding of user queries, with better follow-up questions and integration with more databases, potentially including services like OpenTable for reservations and the ability to post to Twitter and Facebook. There is speculation that Apple may eventually open Siri to third-party apps. On the topic of wearable technology, Cook stated, 'I have on a Nike Fuel Band. I think there are some cool things that can be done. I think it is an interesting area. The question is, Can it change somebody's behavior? The book hasn't been written on that yet.' Currently, Apple promotes the iPod nano as a watch replacement but does not plan to release its own wearable devices soon. Instead, Apple benefits from third-party wearables that integrate with its devices via iOS apps. Regarding Facebook, Cook signaled a stronger partnership, hinting at future collaboration and possible deeper Facebook integration in iOS. Apple remains highly interested in the TV field, particularly through its Apple TV set-top box, but has not confirmed plans for a standalone TV set. Cook said, 'This is an area of intense interest for us. We are going to keep pulling the string and see where this takes us.' Cook also emphasized Apple's intention to increase product secrecy following previous leaks, while maintaining transparency in areas like supplier responsibility and environmental issues. On the topic of Ping, Apple’s music-focused social network, Cook admitted it may not have resonated with users and hinted that its future is uncertain. The article is based on Tim Cook's remarks and provides analysis of their potential implications for Apple's future.

Hoci Cook zopakoval pozitíva o iPade, iPhone a iPode, poskytol aj zaujímavé podrobnosti, najmä o Siri. Cook uznal, že Siri, hlasová asistentka od Apple, si vyžaduje vylepšenie. Hoci väčšina používateľov iPhonu 4S je so Siri spokojná, objavili sa aj sťažnosti a hromadná žaloba týkajúca sa spôsobu, akým bola Siri propagovaná. Očakávajú sa vylepšenia vo vnímaní požiadaviek používateľov, lepšie doplňujúce otázky a integrácia do viacerých databáz, ako napríklad OpenTable na rezervácie či možnosť zverejňovať príspevky na Twitter a Facebook. Špekuluje sa, že Apple môže v budúcnosti sprístupniť Siri aj pre aplikácie tretích strán. K nositeľnej technológii Cook uviedol: „Mám na sebe Nike Fuel Band. Myslím, že sa dajú robiť zaujímavé veci. Je to zaujímavá oblasť. Otázka je, či môže niekomu zmeniť správanie? Táto kniha ešte nebola napísaná.“ V súčasnosti Apple propaguje iPod nano ako náhradu hodiniek, no vlastné nositeľné zariadenia zatiaľ neplánuje vydať. Namiesto toho ťaží z nositeľných doplnkov tretích strán, ktoré sa integrujú cez aplikácie na iOS. Apple má naďalej výrazný záujem o segment televízorov, najmä prostredníctvom zariadenia Apple TV, no zatiaľ nepotvrdil plány na vlastné televízne zariadenie. Cook povedal: „Je to oblasť nášho intenzívneho záujmu. Budeme za tým ďalej ísť a uvidíme, kam nás to zavedie.“ Cook tiež zdôraznil zámer Apple zvýšiť utajenie vývoja nových produktov po predchádzajúcich únikoch, pričom si chce zachovať transparentnosť v otázkach zodpovednosti dodávateľov a životného prostredia. Pokiaľ ide o Ping, hudobnú sociálnu sieť od Apple, Cook priznal, že sa u používateľov neujala, a naznačil neistú budúcnosť tejto služby. Článok vychádza z vyjadrení Tima Cooka a analyzuje ich možné dôsledky pre budúcnosť Apple.

article_content: Aristo Lizica, a 59-year-old resident of public housing on Manhattan's Upper West Side, understands the harms of smoking indoors. "When you smoke inside, it harms everyone," he says. Lizica admits he wants to quit smoking because he knows it's bad for his health, yet struggles to do so. To help people like Lizica and his neighbors, federal housing officials are encouraging public housing to become smoke-free. They argue that smoking bans—partial or full—would reduce secondhand smoke between apartments, lower the risk of cigarette-related fires, and help smokers quit. "We see it as a win-win for both residents and housing authorities," says Donna White, spokesperson for the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). In 2009, HUD highlighted the risks of indoor smoking for the nation’s 2.1 million public housing residents, urging local housing authorities to adopt smoke-free policies. However, these policies remain voluntary, and only about 4% of local authorities have implemented them so far. "Change is hard," adds White. Public health experts are renewing calls for bans. In a paper published in the New England Journal of Medicine, Harvard University researchers and attorneys argue that the health and safety benefits of smoking bans in public housing outweigh the loss of some personal freedoms. They suggest that such policies could help many smokers quit. "That could be the single greatest health benefit," says lead author Dr. Jonathan Winickoff, of Harvard Medical School. While the exact number of smokers in public housing is unknown, roughly 30% of Americans living below the poverty line smoke—over 1.5 times the rate of those above it. Despite the benefits, not all residents support smoking bans. Esther Matos, a 29-year-old resident, says, "I do want to quit, but at the end of the day, we shouldn't care what others do. Don't bother me, and I won't bother them." Non-smoker and cancer survivor Lizzie Middleton, 65, agrees: "People still pay rent and bills and buy their own cigarettes. They have the right to smoke in their own home." HUD officials and Harvard researchers counter that smokers can harm their neighbors through secondhand and third-hand smoke—harmful especially to children, pregnant women, people with chronic illnesses, and the elderly, groups overrepresented in public housing. These groups may face increased health risks, including sudden infant death syndrome, asthma, heart attacks, and cancer. Dr. Winickoff notes that tobacco smoke lingers for weeks or months in apartment buildings, traveling through vents, cracks, and elevators. Smoking bans could reduce overall smoking rates and discourage youth from starting, says Dr. Michelle Mello, co-author and professor at the Harvard School of Public Health. Enforcing these bans poses challenges. Dr. Mello suggests regulation similar to existing rules for drugs and alcohol, but penalties like eviction may be hard to implement. While larger cities like Boston, Seattle, and Denver have started smoke-free policies, most participating cities are small with fewer housing projects. One success is Milford, Connecticut, where the public housing authority passed a non-smoking ordinance covering all 465 units. Executive Director Anthony Vasiliou reports broad support, including a resident who thanked him for providing extra motivation to quit. "Believe it or not, even some smokers want smoke-free housing," says Dr. Winickoff.

Aby pomohli ľuďom ako Lizica a jeho susedom, federálni úradníci podporujú zákaz fajčenia vo verejnom bývaní. Tvrdia, že čiastočné alebo úplné zákazy fajčenia by znížili pasívne fajčenie medzi bytmi, znížili riziko požiarov spôsobených cigaretami a pomohli by fajčiarom prestať. "Vnímame to ako výhru pre obyvateľov aj bytové úrady," hovorí Donna White, hovorkyňa Ministerstva bývania a rozvoja miest (HUD). V roku 2009 HUD upozornil na riziká fajčenia v interiéri pre 2,1 milióna obyvateľov verejného bývania v krajine a vyzval miestne bytové úrady, aby prijali politiku zákazu fajčenia. Tieto politiky sú však dobrovoľné a zatiaľ ich zaviedli len asi 4% miestnych úradov. "Zmena je ťažká," dodáva White. Odborníci na verejné zdravie opäť volajú po zákaze. V článku publikovanom v New England Journal of Medicine výskumníci a právnici z Harvardovej univerzity tvrdia, že zdravotné a bezpečnostné prínosy zákazu fajčenia vo verejnom bývaní prevažujú nad stratou niektorých osobných slobôd. Navrhujú, že podobné politiky by mohli pomôcť mnohým fajčiarom prestať. "To by mohol byť najväčší zdravotný prínos," hovorí hlavný autor Dr. Jonathan Winickoff z Harvard Medical School. Presný počet fajčiarov vo verejnom bývaní nie je známy, ale približne 30% Američanov žijúcich pod hranicou chudoby fajčí—viac ako 1,5-krát častejšie než tí, ktorí sú nad ňou. Napriek benefitom nie všetci obyvatelia podporujú zákaz fajčenia. Esther Matos, 29-ročná obyvateľka, hovorí: "Chcem prestať, ale na konci dňa by sme sa nemali starať o to, čo robia iní. Nech ma nikto neotravuje a ani ja nebudem obťažovať ostatných." Nefajčiarka a preživšia rakoviny Lizzie Middleton (65) súhlasí: "Ľudia stále platia nájomné a účty a kupujú si vlastné cigarety. Majú právo fajčiť vo svojom vlastnom dome." Úradníci HUD a harvardskí výskumníci kontrujú tým, že fajčiari môžu poškodzovať svojich susedov prostredníctvom pasívneho a treťotriedneho dymu—čo je obzvlášť škodlivé pre deti, tehotné ženy, chronicky chorých a starších ľudí, ktorých je vo verejnom bývaní nadpriemerne veľa. Tieto skupiny môžu čeliť zvýšenému zdravotnému riziku, vrátane syndrómu náhleho úmrtia dojčiat, astmy, infarktu a rakoviny. Dr. Winickoff poznamenáva, že tabakový dym môže zostávať v bytových domoch celé týždne alebo mesiace a šíriť sa cez vetracie šachty, praskliny a výťahy. Zákazy fajčenia môžu znížiť celkovú mieru fajčenia a odradiť mládež od začiatku, hovorí Dr. Michelle Mello, spoluautorka a profesorka na Harvard School of Public Health. Presadenie týchto zákazov je výzvou. Dr. Mello navrhuje regulácie podobné súčasným pravidlám pre drogy a alkohol, ale sankcie ako vysťahovanie je ťažké uplatniť. Zatiaľ čo väčšie mestá ako Boston, Seattle a Denver zaviedli bezdymové politiky, väčšina zapojených miest je malých s menej verejnými bytmi. Jedným z úspechov je mesto Milford v Connecticute, kde bytový úrad schválil ne-fajčiarsku vyhlášku pre všetkých 465 bytových jednotiek. Výkonný riaditeľ Anthony Vasiliou hlási širokú podporu, vrátane obyvateľky, ktorá mu poďakovala za ďalšiu motiváciu prestať. "Verte alebo nie, aj niektorí fajčiari chcú bývať bez dymu," hovorí Dr. Winickoff.

Mary Blilie had only been at Big Sky Resort in Montana for a day, but she had already taken more photos of her children than she had in a long time. At Big Sky and Moonlight Basin, skiing enthusiasts say waiting in line for three minutes is considered lengthy. Blilie, now an engineer from Minneapolis, grew up skiing here every winter. After a 17-year break, she was determined to pass on those joyful memories to her own two children, as well as her nieces and nephews, all of whom joined the family trip.

While the resort has introduced new lifts and base village buildings this season, Blilie remarks that its laid-back atmosphere remains intact. “No one gets too bothered about anything,” she explains. The skiing conditions are excellent, with approximately 400 inches of snowfall annually.

Big Sky (www.bigskyresort.com) and neighboring Moonlight Basin (www.moonlightbasin.com) together promote themselves as offering the 'biggest skiing in America,' with 5,512 acres linked by the Big Sky Resort-Moonlight Basin Interconnect. The combined area offers a diversity of terrain suitable for every type of skier or snowboarder: challenging steeps and deep powder for the adventurous, long and empty groomed runs for those seeking solitude, and wide, gentle slopes for beginners.

Sandy Itkoff from Los Angeles, a guest at Moonlight Basin, noted, “My son doesn’t want to leave.” Visitors of all ages are universally impressed by the dramatic landscape, including expansive mountains, snow-covered forests, and endless vistas. According to Moonlight ski instructor Jim Ackerman, the abundance of fresh powder often covers animal tracks that would otherwise be visible in the wooded areas.

Fans of the resorts appreciate the consistently short lift lines and the small class sizes in the children’s ski schools. The new Dakota lift, scheduled to open soon at Big Sky, will make even more terrain easily accessible. Another advantage, parents say, is the lack of worry about aggressive skiers endangering children on crowded slopes, coupled with the friendly demeanor of both guests and staff. Grandmother Ellen Lord recounted how Big Sky employees quickly provided replacement clothing for her family after their luggage was lost. The free après-ski kids club at Big Sky is also popular with parents, giving them the chance to enjoy a break.

Skiing here is reported to be cost-effective: children aged 10 and under ski free, while adult lift tickets are priced lower than at many major resorts ($51 a day at Moonlight Basin and $75 at Big Sky, compared with $87 at Aspen). Junior tickets are also offered at reduced rates. There is no pressure to wear fashionable clothing, either on or off the slopes. Cecile George, visiting from Memphis, remarked that she wore the same pair of jeans throughout her ski week without any judgment.

Big Sky and Moonlight Basin are located about an hour's drive from Bozeman and Yellowstone National Park. Together, they offer more ski terrain than Vail but attract less than half the number of skiers. Locals joke that the ratio of acres to skiers favors plenty of space for everyone, which means that even during peak times, it’s possible to find empty runs and fresh powder. Other winter activities are available as well, such as backcountry skiing and ice climbing with Montana Alpine Guides (www.montanaalpineguides.com).

According to Jim Caccavo, a visitor from San Diego, reaching the resorts requires an extra flight, but the experience is well worth it. Jeremy Collis, director of Moonlight Basin’s ski school, refers to the destination as a 'secret club.' The school has grown to 47 instructors, twice the size it was the previous year, allowing them to keep class sizes small: five children or fewer for grade-schoolers, and three or fewer for preschoolers. Such personalized attention is uncommon at large ski resorts, especially during holiday periods.

Christine Baker, who heads Big Sky’s children’s program, also guarantees small classes and emphasizes the value of a 'family feeling.' Many instructors grew up skiing at Big Sky, contributing to a sense of community.

The resort areas are described as quiet, with few restaurants in the Big Sky base area and just one at Moonlight Basin—the remainder necessitating a drive. Most guests opt to ski during the day, then relax by the fire, enjoy simple meals, watch movies, or play games together at night. The author and her family experienced both a ski-in/ski-out cabin at Big Sky (highlighted by a private hot tub) and a ski house at Moonlight Basin, enjoying cozy evenings and traditional activities.

Collis, a father of two, observed, 'This brings back the feeling of old-fashioned ski vacations when you made your own fun.' Highlights for the author’s family included a spa visit, a snowcat ride to a backcountry yurt for a special dinner, and time spent unwinding in the hot tub surrounded by snowy forest. With limited distractions and spotty internet, visitors relish the opportunity for a genuine family escape.

For more advice on family travel, visit www.takingthekids.com, where Eileen Ogintz welcomes reader questions and comments.

Big Sky (www.bigskyresort.com) a susedný Moonlight Basin (www.moonlightbasin.com) sa prezentujú ako „najväčšie lyžovanie v Amerike“ s 5 512 akrami terénu, ktoré sú prepojené systémom Big Sky Resort-Moonlight Basin Interconnect. Územie ponúka rôznorodý terén pre každého lyžiara a snowboardistu: strmé svahy a hlboký prašan pre dobrodruhov, dlhé prázdne zjazdovky pre milovníkov samoty a široké mierne svahy pre začiatočníkov.

Sandy Itkoffová z Los Angeles, hosťka Moonlight Basin, poznamenala: „Môj syn odtiaľ nechce ísť preč.“ Návštevníci všetkých vekov obdivujú dramatickú scenériu – rozľahlé hory, snehové lesy a nekonečné výhľady. Inštruktor Jim Ackerman z Moonlight tvrdí, že množstvo čerstvého prašanu často prikryje aj stopy lesnej zveri.

Obľuba rezortov plynie z krátkych čakaní na vleky a malých skupín v detských lyžiarskych školách. Nový vlek Dakota, ktorý má v Big Sky čoskoro otvoriť, poskytne prístup k ďalšiemu terénu. Ďalším plusom podľa rodičov je, že sa netreba báť agresívnych lyžiarov ohrozujúcich deti na preplnených svahoch a oceňujú priateľské správanie hostí a personálu. Babička Ellen Lord ocenila, že jej po strate batožiny zamestnanci Big Sky rýchlo poskytli náhradné oblečenie pre rodinu. Obľúbený je i bezplatný detský klub po lyžovaní, ktorý rodičom umožní oddych.

Lyžovanie je cenovo prístupné: deti do 10 rokov lyžujú zadarmo, dospelí platia menej než vo veľkých strediskách (51 USD/deň v Moonlight Basin, 75 USD v Big Sky, kým v Aspene je to 87 USD) a juniorské lístky sú ešte lacnejšie. Nie je tlak na módny odev. Cecile Georgeová z Memphisu vraví, že celý týždeň mala tie isté rifle a nikto to neriešil.

Big Sky a Moonlight Basin sú hodinu jazdy autom od Bozemanu a od Yellowstonského národného parku. Ponúkajú viac zjazdoviek než Vail, no menej než polovičný počet lyžiarov. Miestni žartujú, že majú takmer dvojnásobný počet akrov na jedného lyžiara, nakoľko milujú svoj osobný priestor. Aj počas najvyťaženejších dní môžete nájsť prázdne svahy s čerstvým snehom. K dispozícii sú tiež iné zimné aktivity, ako skialpinizmus či lezenie po ľade s Montana Alpine Guides (www.montanaalpineguides.com).

Jim Caccavo zo San Diega tvrdí, že dostať sa sem síce znamená let navrch, no zážitok stojí za to. Jeremy Collis, riaditeľ lyžiarskej školy Moonlight Basin, nazýva stredisko „tajný klub“. Škola má už 47 inštruktorov, dvakrát viac než vlani, takže môžu držať malé skupiny: maximálne päť detí na základnej škole a tri v predškolskej. Takýto prístup je jedinečný vo veľkých strediskách počas sviatkov.

Christine Bakerová, vedúca detského programu v Big Sky, taktiež zaručuje malé skupiny a zdôrazňuje prínos „rodinnej atmosféry“. Viacerí inštruktori vyrástli priamo na svahoch Big Sky, čo posilňuje komunitného ducha.

V strediskách je pokoj – v základni Big Sky je len zopár reštaurácií a v Moonlight Basin len jedna, za ďalšími treba cestovať autom. Väčšina hostí prelyžuje deň a večer si užíva pohodu pri krbe, jednoduché jedlá, filmy alebo spoločenské hry. Autorka so svojou rodinou bývala v chate priamo na svahu s vlastnou vírivkou v Big Sky aj v dome v Moonlight Basin a vychutnávali si domácky večer.

Collis, otec dvoch detí, vraví: „Vracia to pocit staromódnych lyžovačiek, keď si zábavu musíte robiť sami.“ Pre autorkinu rodinu boli zažitkami aj spa, nočný výlet snežným pásovým vozidlom do yurty na výbornú večeru či relax vo vírivke uprostred zasnežených stromov. S obmedzeným internetom a bez rušivých vplyvov si hostia naplno vychutnávajú rodinný oddych.

Viac rád k rodinnému cestovaniu nájdete na www.takingthekids.com, kde Eileen Ogintz rada odpovie na vaše otázky a komentáre.
post_content: Dreaming of a chill ski getaway? Big Sky & Moonlight Basin in Montana offer massive runs, tiny lift lines, and a cozy family vibe. Kids ski free, epic powder, and zero pressure to dress up. #MontanaMagic #FamilySkiTrip

article_content: Kai-Fu Lee, former leader of Google China, is now focused on advancing innovation through his enterprise, Innovation Works. Boasting a background with Apple, Microsoft, and Google, Lee is regarded as an influential figure among China’s new generation of tech enthusiasts. Although his career is impressive, some investors are uncertain about Lee’s impact, as he lacks first-hand experience in founding start-ups. This skepticism centers on whether a seasoned manager can successfully guide fledgling companies in China’s highly competitive and sometimes opaque market. Operating from a location near Google’s local office, Innovation Works aims to empower Chinese tech talent by offering mentorship, funding, and guidance to up-and-coming businesses. The company has processed thousands of résumés and business plans, raised close to $115 million, and currently incubates twelve start-ups in areas such as mobile internet, e-commerce, and cloud computing. Projects include Tapas, an Android-based system tailored for Chinese mobile users. Taiwan-born and educated in the United States, Lee stresses the importance of creativity and critical thinking in education, rather than simple rote learning. Through books and regular university lectures, he has taken on the role of mentor to many young people. While critics argue that strict ethical standards might put Innovation Works at a financial disadvantage compared to less scrupulous competitors, Lee maintains that developing principled, capable entrepreneurs is the greater good. He acknowledges success may not be immediate or spectacular, but believes the personal growth of those involved will be the company's true legacy.
translated_content: Kai-Fu Lee, bývalý šéf Google China, sa teraz zameriava na podporu inovácií prostredníctvom svojej firmy Innovation Works. Vďaka skúsenostiam z Apple, Microsoft a Google je Lee významnou osobnosťou medzi čínskymi technologickými nadšencami. Aj keď je jeho kariéra pôsobivá, niektorí investori pochybujú o jeho vplyve, keďže Lee zatiaľ nikdy neviedol vlastný start-up. Otázkou je, či dokáže skúsený manažér pomôcť mladým firmám uspieť v tvrdom a zložitom čínskom podnikateľskom prostredí. Innovation Works, sídliaca blízko čínskej kancelárie Google, ponúka mladým firmám mentorstvo, kapitál i podporu. Doposiaľ spracovali tisíce životopisov a podnikateľských zámerov, získali takmer 115 miliónov dolárov a inkubujú dvanásť start-upov z oblasti mobilného internetu, e-commerce a cloud computingu. Medzi ich projekty patrí napríklad Android systém Tapas prispôsobený pre čínskych používateľov. Lee, pôvodom z Taiwanu a vzdelaný v USA, zdôrazňuje dôležitosť kreativity a kritického myslenia vo vzdelávaní namiesto pasívneho memorovania. Svojimi knihami a pravidelnými prednáškami na univerzitách už inšpiroval množstvo mladých ľudí. Aj keď niektorí tvrdia, že poctivá hra môže Innovation Works odsunúť za konkurenciu, Lee verí, že rozvíjanie schopných a morálnych podnikateľov má väčší význam. Uznáva, že úspech nemusí prísť rýchlo alebo výrazne, no verí, že skutočné dedičstvo spoločnosti sa ukáže v osobnom raste jej členov.

article_content: The organisers of the Turnip Prize have announced their finalists for the competition's 25th year. The Turnip Prize, a humorous imitation of the esteemed Turner Prize, celebrates artwork intentionally made with minimal effort and low cost. Entries showing excessive effort or artistic skill are immediately disqualified. This year, the contest received 193 entries from around the globe. The award ceremony will take place on December 5 at The New Inn in Wedmore, Somerset. Submissions were accepted from November 1 to November 21. A separate exhibition featuring 16 former winners and notable participants is also being held at The New Inn. The Turnip Prize began in 1999 as a playful response to Tracey Emin's My Bed, which was shortlisted for the Turner Prize that year. Competition winners receive a turnip mounted on a wooden base.
translated_content: Organizátori ceny Turnip Prize oznámili finalistov už 25. ročníka tejto súťaže. Turnip Prize je vtipná napodobenina prestížnej Turner Prize a oslavuje umelecké diela, ktoré sú zámerne vytvorené s minimálnym úsilím a nízkymi nákladmi. Prihlášky prejavujúce príliš veľa úsilia alebo umeleckých schopností sú okamžite diskvalifikované. Tento rok súťaž prijala 193 príspevkov z celého sveta. Slávnostné odovzdávanie cien sa uskutoční 5. decembra v The New Inn v meste Wedmore v grófstve Somerset. Prihlášky boli akceptované od 1. do 21. novembra. V The New Inn prebieha aj samostatná výstava 16 bývalých víťazov a významných účastníkov. Turnip Prize vznikla v roku 1999 ako žartovná reakcia na dielo „My Bed“ od Tracey Emin, ktoré bolo v tom roku nominované na Turner Prize. Víťazi súťaže získavajú repu pripevnenú na drevenom podstavci.

SEOUL: North Korea appears to be preparing for its third attempt this year to launch a reconnaissance satellite, a move likely to spark further controversy similar to its previous weapons tests. Earlier attempts on May 31—the country's first such launch since 2016—and on August 24 both ended in failure when the new Chollima-1 rockets crashed into the sea.

North Korea has informed Japan that it plans to launch a satellite between Wednesday and December 1. This announcement has drawn criticism from Japan and South Korea, who argue that such an action would violate a United Nations ban on Pyongyang's missile development.

**North Korea's Space Ambitions**

Since 1998, North Korea has launched six satellites, with only two reportedly reaching orbit successfully. The most recent of these was in 2016. While international observers noted that one satellite seemed to be under control, debate continues over whether it ever transmitted any data. Experts believe North Korea used a three-stage rocket booster, similar to the Unha-3 in previous launches, and that a new, larger launch pad was recently built.

A senior official from North Korea's space agency stated after the last launch that more advanced satellites were planned by 2020, and ultimately, that the country aimed to "plant the flag of (North Korea) on the moon." During a party congress in January 2021, Kim Jong-un outlined goals including the development of military reconnaissance satellites.

Analysts say the Chollima-1 rocket seems to be a new design, likely using the dual-nozzle liquid-fueled engines developed for North Korea’s Hwasong-15 ICBM. South Korea has recovered parts of the Chollima-1, including some satellite debris, but has not disclosed full findings. Seoul has assessed the satellite as having limited military utility.

In September, Kim Jong-un toured Russia's modern space launch center, where President Vladimir Putin pledged support for North Korea's satellite efforts. South Korean officials suggested that the upcoming launch may receive some technical help from Russia.

**Dual-Use Technology Concerns**

The United States and its allies view North Korea's satellite tests as clear breaches of United Nations Security Council resolutions that prohibit technology related to ballistic missile development. North Korea maintains that its space program and defense activities are sovereign rights.

At the time of the 2016 space launch, North Korea had not yet developed an intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM). The satellite launch was condemned by the U.S. and South Korea as a disguised test for missile technology capable of reaching the continental United States.

Since 2016, North Korea has developed and tested three types of ICBMs and appears determined to put operational satellites into orbit. Analysts state that this would improve North Korea’s intelligence capabilities and demonstrate its technological progress in space, matching other regional powers. Such satellites could enable Pyongyang to better monitor South Korea and Japan or conduct battle damage assessments in the event of conflict, according to Ankit Panda of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace.

Panda also notes that, conversely, North Korean satellites could help verify that the United States and its allies are not planning attacks, which might reduce tensions and promote stability in the region.

SOUL: Zdá sa, že Severná Kórea sa pripravuje na svoj tretí pokus tento rok o vypustenie prieskumného satelitu – krok, ktorý pravdepodobne vyvolá ďalšiu polemiku podobnú jej predchádzajúcim zbrojným testom. Predchádzajúce pokusy 31. mája – prvé takéto odpalovanie od roku 2016 – a 24. augusta skončili neúspechom, keď nové rakety Chollima-1 spadli do mora.

Severná Kórea informovala Japonsko, že plánuje vypustenie satelitu v období medzi stredou a 1. decembrom. Táto správa vyvolala kritiku zo strany Japonska a Južnej Kórey, ktoré tvrdia, že tento krok by porušil zákaz OSN týkajúci sa vývoja rakiet v Pchjongjangu.

**Vesmírne ambície Severnej Kórey**

Od roku 1998 Severná Kórea vypustila šesť satelitov, pričom úspešne sa na obežnú dráhu dostali len dva. Posledný z nich bol v roku 2016. Medzinárodní pozorovatelia zaznamenali, že jeden zo satelitov sa zdal byť pod kontrolou, avšak stále prebieha debata, či vysielal nejaké údaje. Odborníci sa domnievajú, že Severná Kórea použila trojstupňový raketový nosič podobný Unha-3 z predchádzajúcich štartov a že bol postavený nový väčší štartovací komplex.

Popredný predstaviteľ severokórejskej kozmickej agentúry po poslednom štarte uviedol, že do roku 2020 plánujú vypustiť pokročilejšie satelity, pričom konečným cieľom je „zasadiť vlajku (Severnej Kórey) na Mesiaci“. Počas zjazdu strany v januári 2021 Kim Čong-un predstavil ciele vrátane vývoja vojenských prieskumných satelitov.

Analytici tvrdia, že raketa Chollima-1 je nový typ a pravdepodobne využíva dvojtryskové kvapalné motory vyvinuté pre severokórejský ICBM Hwasong-15. Južná Kórea získala časti Chollimy-1 vrátane trosiek satelitu, ale podrobné výsledky nezverejnila. Soul vyhodnotil satelit ako vojensky málo hodnotný.

V septembri Kim Čong-un navštívil ruské moderné vesmírne stredisko, kde prezident Vladimir Putin prisľúbil podporu severokórejskému satelitnému programu. Podľa juhokórejských predstaviteľov môže nadchádzajúci štart zahŕňať aj technickú pomoc z Ruska.

**Obavy z dvojitého využitia technológií**

Spojené štáty a ich spojenci považujú satelitné testy Severnej Kórey za jasné porušenie rezolúcií Bezpečnostnej rady OSN, ktoré zakazujú vývoj technológií použiteľných v balistických raketových programoch. Severná Kórea tvrdí, že jej vesmírny program a obranné aktivity sú jej zvrchovaným právom.

V čase štartu satelitu v roku 2016 Severná Kórea ešte nevyvinula medzikontinentálnu balistickú raketu (ICBM). Vypustenie satelitu odsúdili USA a Južná Kórea ako zamaskovaný test technológie rakiet schopných zasiahnuť pevninské Spojené štáty.

Od roku 2016 Severná Kórea vyvinula a otestovala tri typy ICBM a zjavne sa snaží umiestniť funkčné satelity na obežnú dráhu. Podľa analytikov by to zlepšilo spravodajské schopnosti Severnej Kórey a ukázalo jej technologický pokrok vo vesmíre na úrovni ostatných regionálnych mocností. Takéto satelity by umožnili Pchjongjangu lepšie monitorovať Južnú Kóreu a Japonsko alebo hodnotiť škody v prípade konfliktu, tvrdí Ankit Panda z Carnegieho nadácie pre medzinárodný mier.

Panda zároveň poukazuje, že na druhej strane by vlastné satelity umožnili Severnej Kórei overiť, či sa USA a ich spojenci nechystajú na útok, čo by mohlo zmierniť napätie a prispieť k stabilite v regióne.

article_content: WWE Raw on November 20, 2023, acted as the final build before Survivor Series: WarGames 2023, with strong hints at Randy Orton returning to team up with Cody Rhodes, Jey Uso, Sami Zayn, and Seth Rollins. The team needed to choose a fifth member by night's end, and Cody Rhodes suggested he would reach out to an old friend, using phrases like “legacy,” “apex predator,” and “hearing voices in his head” — all references associated with Orton. The episode featured a singles match to decide which team would have the advantage in the WarGames match at Survivor Series. Drew McIntyre addressed his recent actions, clarifying he did not join the Judgment Day, but is currently teaming with them. This alliance has created tension within the Judgment Day faction, particularly between Rhea Ripley and Damian Priest. Other featured matches included Nia Jax vs. Raquel Rodriguez, where Rodriguez played the underdog but ultimately lost. Becky Lynch continued her rivalry with Xia Li, securing a victory. Johnny Gargano defeated Ludwig Kaiser after interference from Giovanni Vinci. Tegan Nox and Ivy Nile won a women’s Tag Team Fatal 4-Way match, potentially setting them up as new contenders. Drama unfolded between The Miz and GUNTHER during a face-off segment, highlighting the ongoing debate between entertainment and pure wrestling in WWE. Shinsuke Nakamura defeated Chad Gable in a match with low crowd engagement. In the main event, Drew McIntyre defeated Jey Uso, further cementing his heel persona. Despite constant hints, Randy Orton did not appear live, but the episode concluded with hopes high for his imminent return at WarGames. Notable moments included a lively crowd in Michigan and commentary discussing potential shifts in storylines, as well as WWE Raw drawing 1.467 million viewers in the previous week.

Drew McIntyre objasnil svoje posledné kroky a zdôraznil, že nie je členom Judgment Day, ale v súčasnosti s nimi spolupracuje. Ďalšie dôležité zápasy zahŕňali Niu Jax proti Raquel Rodriguez, kde Rodriguez hrala outsiderku, no nakoniec prehrala. Becky Lynch porazila Xiu Li a pokračovala vo svojej rivalite. article_content: A cheetah cub that was abandoned by his mother at birth has survived thanks to quick action by keepers at Wildlife Safari in Oregon. Born on May 8, the unnamed cub marks the 174th cheetah birth at the park since its breeding program began in 1972. Shortly after birth, his mother Moya refused to care for him, not even removing the birth sac—leaving the cub in danger of dying within minutes. Zookeepers promptly intervened, freeing him from the sac, but discovered he wasn't breathing. Staff acted quickly to simulate his breathing, and thankfully, the cub responded. He was then placed in an incubator at the park's animal hospital. Once healthy enough, he will be transferred to another Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA) accredited facility, where he'll join the Cheetah Ambassador Program. This initiative educates children and visitors at AZA zoos and schools through activities and meet-and-greet events with the animals. Cheetahs are the fastest land mammals, capable of reaching speeds of up to 70 miles per hour in short bursts. However, they are endangered, with fewer than 10,000 remaining in Africa—around 3,000 of which live in Namibia, the country with the largest cheetah population. The species is threatened by habitat loss, poaching, and hunting from farmers seeking to protect their livestock. According to Wildlife Safari, cheetahs typically live six to eight years in the wild and up to 10 to 15 years in captivity.
translated_content: Gepardie mláďa, ktoré jeho matka po narodení opustila, prežilo vďaka pohotovému zásahu ošetrovateľov vo Wildlife Safari v Oregone. Narodené 8. mája, toto bezmenné mláďa je už 174. gepardím prírastkom v parku od začiatku chovného programu v roku 1972. Krátko po narodení sa oň matka Moya odmietla postarať a neodstránila ani pôrodný vak – čo ho vystavilo vážnemu ohrozeniu života v priebehu pár minút. Ošetrovateľom sa podarilo mláďa vyslobodiť, no zistili, že nedýcha. Okamžite začali simulovať dýchanie, našťastie mláďa zareagovalo. Následne ho umiestnili do inkubátora v zvieracej nemocnici parku. Keď bude dostatočne silné, presunú ho do iného zariadenia akreditovaného Asociáciou zoologických záhrad a akvárií (AZA), kde sa zapojí do programu Gepardieho ambasádora. Tento program vzdeláva deti a návštevníkov v AZA zoologických záhradách a školách zážitkovými aktivitami a stretnutiami so zvieratami. Gepardy sú najrýchlejšími suchozemskými cicavcami, ktoré dokážu dosiahnuť rýchlosť až 113 km/h pri krátkych šprintoch. Sú však ohrozené, keďže v Afrike ich ostalo menej ako 10 000 – pričom v Namíbii žije najväčšia populácia, približne 3 000 jedincov. Tento druh ohrozuje úbytok prirodzeného prostredia, pytliactvo a poľovníctvo zo strany farmárov, ktorí chránia svoj dobytok. Podľa Wildlife Safari sa gepardy vo voľnej prírode dožívajú 6 až 8 rokov, v zajatí 10 až 15 rokov.
post_content: A cheetah cub in Oregon survived against the odds after being abandoned at birth! This little speedster got a new lease on life with help from zoo staff and will become an ambassador for his kind. 🐆 #CheetahSurvivor #AnimalRescue #WildlifeSafari

article_content: A new book, 'When One Is Expecting: A Posh Person's Guide To Pregnancy And Parenting,' offers humorous advice on pregnancy and parenting in the style of Pippa Middleton. The book, written by the creator of the @pippatips Twitter account, contains witty and satirical tips such as 'avoid toxic things during pregnancy' and 'don't do anything that makes you feel faint.' Like Pippa Middleton's book 'Celebrate!', this title includes eye-catching illustrations, though none feature the anonymous author. The creator of @pippatips hinted in an interview with MailOnline that they might reveal their identity in the future, saying, 'I’m sure my ghostwriters will want some attention at some point.' Discussing the origin of the book, the author said, 'A publisher made a pleasing financial offer, so after a few moments of hard thought, the idea for When One Is Expecting just popped into my head.' When asked about a favorite tip, the author jokingly mentioned horse racing but added that naming suggestions would be particularly helpful to expectant parents. The author explained the research process, noting, 'Most of the tips were thoroughly researched. For example, a friend didn’t put a nappy on her child and the cream Axminster carpet got awfully messy.' When asked where facts were sourced, the author replied, 'There’s all sorts of useful information you can get off the Internet by using Google. Here’s a Pippa Tip: Safesearch is useful to avoid seeing unwanted images during research.' The author also offered advice to Pippa Middleton about her new role as a Vanity Fair contributing editor: 'If she can find compelling topics and write in a way that entertains Vanity Fair’s readers, she’ll do well. I also advised her to steer clear of tongue-in-cheek writing—no one wants to bite their tongue.' The book’s light-hearted advice targets non-royal mothers, but there is speculation about whether the Duchess of Cambridge will read it as she prepares for the birth of her first child. @pippatips joked, 'The Duchess is now a member of the Royal Family. I’m fairly sure she has a butler or maid who will read it to her.' 'When One Is Expecting: A Posh Person's Guide To Pregnancy And Parenting' is published by Icon Books, priced at £9.99, and available from Amazon.

Tyler Blackett was sent off as Manchester United Under 21s battled to a 1-1 draw against Sunderland, keeping them at the top of the league. Blackett received a red card early in the second half for pushing Sunderland's Martin Smith in the face during a tussle for the ball as Andreas Pereira was preparing to take a free kick. United also lost striker James Wilson, who was forced off in the first half after suffering a dead leg from a challenge.

Blackett challenged Sunderland's George Honeyman for the ball at the Stadium of Light, but just eight minutes into the second half, he was sent off. Pereira gave United the lead with less than 20 minutes played, but Sunderland equalized through Mikael Mandron, who found the net on 34 minutes, firing through a crowded area past United keeper Joel Pereira. Despite United's efforts to respond quickly, their task became harder when Wilson was replaced late in the first half due to his injury.

The draw was enough to keep United at the top of the table, but the loss of Wilson and Blackett’s red card made it a challenging night on a wet and windy Wearside.

article_content: Rev. William Effiok, former Director of Food Registration and Regulatory Affairs at Nigeria's National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC), has encouraged members of the Premium Breadmakers Association of Nigeria (PBAN) to adhere to regulatory standards, stating it will lead to better business prospects in 2024. Effiok delivered this message on Sunday in Lagos at PBAN’s 2023 Day Out event, which united key stakeholders in Nigeria’s baking industry to address ongoing sector challenges, especially those intensified by the country’s economic downturn. Effiok stressed that compliance with regulations ensures product quality and safeguards consumers’ health, warning that allowing unregulated practices could harm responsible PBAN members. 'Breadmakers need proper structures to curb unwholesome practices,' he said, speaking on 'Overcoming Business Challenges in the Baking Industry Under Harsh Economic Realities.' NAFDAC’s Director of Food Safety and Applied Nutrition, Mrs. Eva Edwards, reaffirmed the agency’s dedication to upholding standards and the quality of its regulated products. She described the current business environment as challenging, mentioning factors such as the removal of fuel subsidies, exchange rate fluctuations, and infrastructure issues, all of which threaten business sustainability. Mrs. Edwards reminded producers of NAFDAC-regulated products that safety, standards, and quality are non-negotiable, despite any obstacles. She also noted that NAFDAC, led by Director General Prof. Mojisola Adeyeye, has introduced various interventions to alleviate burdens on industry stakeholders. In his opening remarks, PBAN President Engr. Emmanuel Onuorah highlighted the immense difficulties facing Nigerian breadmakers, including falling production capacity and shrinking profit margins. He explained that many bakeries are struggling to stay afloat, with costs often exceeding revenue, and some are forced to shut down if unable to inject new capital. Onuorah emphasized the purpose of the gathering was to engage regulators and industry experts to collectively identify and address the pressing technical and commercial challenges facing the breadmaking industry.

Effiok to povedal v nedeľu v Lagose na podujatí PBAN 2023 Day Out, kde sa stretli kľúčoví aktéri nigérijského pekárenského priemyslu, aby riešili pretrvávajúce problémy v sektore, najmä tie, ktoré zhoršuje ekonomický pokles v krajine. Effiok zdôraznil, že dodržiavanie predpisov zabezpečuje kvalitu výrobkov a chráni zdravie spotrebiteľov, pričom varoval, že tolerovanie neregulovaných praktík by mohlo poškodiť zodpovedných členov PBAN. 'Pekári musia zaviesť riadne štruktúry na obmedzenie nekalých praktík,' povedal na tému 'Prekonávanie obchodných výziev v pekárenskom priemysle počas ťažkých hospodárskych podmienok.' Opísala aktuálne podnikateľské prostredie ako náročné, pričom spomenula zrušenie dotácií na pohonné hmoty, kolísanie výmenných kurzov a infraštruktúrne problémy, ktoré ohrozujú udržateľnosť podnikania. Vysvetlil, že mnohé pekárne bojujú o prežitie, keďže náklady často prevyšujú príjmy, a niektoré musia zatvoriť, ak nemôžu do podnikania pridať nové finančné prostriedky. article_content: On Sunday, New Yorkers witnessed a preview of the future as Joby Aviation and Volocopter, two leading eVTOL (electric vertical takeoff and landing) companies, conducted crewed demonstration flights in the city. Billed as the world’s largest and first public event of its kind, the showcase featured multiple eVTOL aircraft operating in a busy urban environment. Mayor Eric Adams attended the event at Manhattan’s Downtown Heliport, where both companies flew their fully electric aircraft. Mayor Adams announced that the city intends to electrify the Downtown Heliport, enabling cleaner and quieter flights for tourist trips, airport transfers, and freight deliveries. He stated, “Today, we are taking sustainability to the sky and our streets by electrifying our heliport infrastructure. Our vision for the Downtown Manhattan Heliport is to create the world’s first facility equipped for electric-powered aircraft, turning this public asset into a hub for sustainable transportation and local deliveries.” Adams added that the initiative would address persistent helicopter noise, reduce truck traffic, and make city streets safer. However, a timeline for the upgraded facility was not provided, as significant infrastructure changes and regulatory approvals are still required. Joby Aviation, based in California and supported by companies such as Toyota, Intel, and Delta Air Lines, has been developing its electric aircraft for over a decade. The company shared images of its New York demonstration flights on social media, emphasizing New York’s leadership in clean and quiet air travel. In addition to environmental benefits, eVTOL aircraft produce significantly less noise than traditional helicopters, making them well-suited for urban use. Joby’s vehicle can carry five people and reach speeds up to 200 mph, while Volocopter’s aircraft accommodates two passengers with a top speed of 62 mph.
translated_content: V nedeľu mali Newyorčania možnosť nahliadnuť do budúcnosti, keď Joby Aviation a Volocopter, dve popredné spoločnosti v oblasti eVTOL (elektrických lietadiel s vertikálnym štartom a pristátím), uskutočnili v meste pilotované ukážkové lety. Podujatie bolo označené za najväčšiu a prvú verejnú prezentáciu viacerých eVTOL lietadiel v mestskom prostredí. Primátor Eric Adams sa zúčastnil podujatia na heliporte v centre Manhattanu, kde obidve spoločnosti predviedli svoje plne elektrické lietadlá. Primátor Adams oznámil, že mesto plánuje elektrifikovať Downtown Heliport a tým umožní ekologickejšie a tichšie lety pre turistov, transfery na letiská aj doručovanie tovaru. Vyhlásil: „Dnes prinášame udržateľnosť do neba aj na naše ulice elektrifikovaním infraštruktúry heliportu. Naša vízia pre Downtown Manhattan Heliport je vytvoriť prvé zariadenie na svete vybavené infraštruktúrou pre elektricky poháňané lietadlá a zmeniť tento verejný majetok na centrum udržateľnej dopravy a miestnych doručovacích služieb.“ Adams dodal, že tento krok má pomôcť odstrániť pretrvávajúci problém s hlukom vrtuľníkov, znížiť kamiónovú dopravu a zvýšiť bezpečnosť na uliciach. Konkrétny termín modernizácie zatiaľ nebol určený, keďže si to vyžaduje rozsiahle úpravy infraštruktúry a získanie regulačných povolení. Joby Aviation so sídlom v Kalifornii, podporovaná spoločnosťami ako Toyota, Intel a Delta Air Lines, vyvíja svoje elektrické lietadlo už viac než desať rokov. Spoločnosť zverejnila obrázky z testovacích letov v New Yorku na sociálnych sieťach a zdôraznila vedúcu pozíciu mesta v oblasti čistej a tichej leteckej dopravy. Okrem environmentálnych výhod majú eVTOL lietadlá oveľa nižšiu hlučnosť ako tradičné vrtuľníky, vďaka čomu sú vhodnejšie do mestského prostredia. Lietadlo spoločnosti Joby má kapacitu päť osôb a dosahuje až 322 km/h, Volocopter prepraví dvoch pasažierov s maximálnou rýchlosťou 100 km/h.

article_content: A Pentagon report released Friday reveals that Rear Admiral John Stufflebeem, a former Navy staff director, maintained a sexual relationship in the White House in 1990 with a federal employee, falsely claiming he was a widower. Stufflebeem was demoted and dismissed from his post following the investigation. The report details that Stufflebeem initially denied the affair and claimed to not remember the woman’s name, but investigators concluded he had lied. Jane Doe, the federal worker involved, confirmed the affair and said she believed he was unmarried based on his claims. Her account was corroborated by both her supervisor and Stufflebeem’s superiors, who contradicted Stufflebeem’s account. The Defense Department’s inspector general found Jane Doe’s testimony credible and consistent. Stufflebeem was convicted on April 18 of making false official statements to investigators. After his disciplinary hearing, known as an admiral’s mast, he requested retirement. Jane Doe stated that their affair began overseas in 1989 and lasted about eight months during a time when Stufflebeem held high-profile naval assignments. She said she broke off contact after learning he was married, confronting him at her home. While Stufflebeem claimed he only shared personal issues with Jane Doe, the report noted inconsistencies between his feelings of guilt and his denial of a physical relationship. The investigation was reopened following an anonymous tip containing detailed information, despite a prior tip in 1999 that lacked specifics. Stufflebeem criticized the investigation and its process, insisting his integrity was being unfairly questioned. However, after Jane Doe agreed to testify, she confirmed multiple sexual encounters throughout the relationship. Stufflebeem was previously recognized for his media presence during the Afghanistan war and served in several major command roles for the Navy and NATO.

London police are calling on the public to help identify a couple whose wedding pictures were found on a stolen iPod Nano. The white music player was recovered after a burglary in Hillingdon earlier this year, but detectives have not been able to find the owners or trace the device to its home. Officers hope to return these cherished photographs to the couple, as the device holds precious memories from their wedding day.

The collection of photos includes black-and-white images of the couple during their vows, a shot of the bride with nine women believed to be her bridesmaids, and group photos of the wedding party outside a sunny country house. Authorities think the theft may have happened in Hillingdon or surrounding areas, such as Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire, Buckinghamshire, or the Thames Valley. Other valuable items, including expensive jewelry, were also recovered and could belong to the same victims.

If you recognize these pictures or had an iPod Nano with similar photos stolen, contact Detective Sergeant Charlie Cairns at 0208 246 1417, or reach out to Crimestoppers anonymously at 0800 555 111.

article_content: Pranav Mehta, who resides in Gujarat, one of India's wealthier states, has always benefited from steady electricity—unlike thousands of villages nearby that deal with unreliable or nonexistent supply. India's surging economy and population mean the country will need to generate at least 700,000 more megawatts of power by 2030. Much of this expansion is planned via massive coal power plants, but Mehta sees a different path. Mehta is India director at Space Island Group, a California company backing a bold concept: huge solar satellites stationed 22,000 miles above Earth. These would beam solar power down to receivers on the ground, supplying electricity to communities day and night, as the satellites aren't blocked by Earth’s shadow. This space-based system could deliver constant, renewable energy—something that's hard for ground-based solar to achieve. First envisioned in 1968 by scientist Peter Glaser, space solar power was analyzed by NASA and the U.S. Department of Energy in the 1970s. Despite the idea being feasible, the astronomical price tag—nearly $1 trillion—put it on hold, according to former NASA expert John Mankins. Renewed efforts in the 1990s also halted. Lately, rising oil costs, growing climate risks, and resource concerns are reviving interest in space solar power. In 2007, the U.S. Pentagon released a report encouraging government investment, highlighting that a single kilometer-wide section of orbit gets nearly as much solar energy yearly as all Earth’s known oil reserves. The report proposes uses from disaster recovery to powering U.S. military operations and delivering energy to developing nations. Governments worldwide are exploring the approach: Russia, China, India, the EU, and especially Japan—investing millions in research and on the brink of a demonstration test. Nonetheless, huge challenges loom: launching and building massive orbital platforms needs much cheaper and more dependable access to space, plus robots that can assemble the structures high above Earth. The required funding still reaches into the billions. Enthusiasts like Charles Miller of the Space Frontier Foundation think operational stations might emerge within a decade if action is taken soon. Despite the complexity and expense, advocates argue space solar power could transform the energy sector and earn global leadership for whichever country pioneers it.

India s jej rýchlo rastúcou ekonomikou a populáciou bude do roku 2030 potrebovať vyrobiť aspoň o 700 000 megawattov viac elektriny. Väčšina tejto expanzie je plánovaná cez obrovské uhoľné elektrárne, no Mehta vidí iné riešenie. Mehta je indickým riaditeľom spoločnosti Space Island Group z Kalifornie, ktorá podporuje ambiciózny koncept: obrovské slnečné satelity umiestnené 22 000 míľ nad Zemou. Tie by prenášali slnečnú energiu na pozemné prijímače a dodávali elektrinu komunitám deň aj noc, keďže satelity nezatieni zemský tieň. Tento vesmírny systém by mohol poskytovať nepretržitú, obnoviteľnú energiu – čo je pre pozemnú solárnu energiu náročné dosiahnuť. Myšlienku vesmírnej solárnej energie prvýkrát predstavil vedec Peter Glaser v roku 1968. NASA a americké Ministerstvo energetiky ju skúmali v 70. rokoch, no aj keď bola technicky uskutočniteľná, pre obrovské náklady – takmer 1 bilión dolárov – bola podľa bývalého špecialistu NASA Johna Mankinsa odložená. Oživenie snahy v 90. rokoch sa takisto zastavilo. V posledných rokoch ožíva záujem najmä kvôli rastúcim cenám ropy, klimatickým rizikám a obavám o zdroje. V roku 2007 Pentagon vydal správu, v ktorej odporučil vládnu podporu; podľa nej prijme jediný kilometer široký pás orbity za rok takmer toľko slnečnej energie, koľko je v súčasnosti známe zásoby ropy na Zemi. Správa navrhuje využitie systému na pomoc pri katastrofách, vojenské operácie i zásobovanie rozvojových krajín energiou. Vesmírnu solárnu energiu skúmajú vlády po celom svete: Rusko, Čína, India, EÚ a najmä Japonsko – to investovalo milióny do výskumu a už pripravuje demonštráciu v malom meradle. Pred systémom však ešte stoja veľké výzvy: vynesenie a výstavba obrovských platforiem na orbite vyžaduje omnoho lacnejší a spoľahlivejší prístup do vesmíru a tiež pokročilú robotiku pre montáž. Potrebné finančné prostriedky stále presahujú miliardy dolárov. Nadšenci ako Charles Miller zo Space Frontier Foundation si myslia, že funkčné stanice by sme mohli vidieť už do desiatich rokov, ak začneme konať. Napriek zložitosti a nákladom obhajcovia tvrdia, že vesmírna solárna energia by mohla premeniť energetický sektor a zabezpečiť globálne líderstvo tej krajine, ktorá ju ako prvá rozvinie.

Six Flags and Cedar Fair, two of the biggest amusement park companies in the U.S. and Canada, are merging in a landmark $8 billion transaction. The combined business will operate a total of 27 theme parks and 15 water parks located throughout the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. This move is aimed at smoothing out seasonal visitor patterns, improving operational efficiency, and increasing investment in their attractions.

Cedar Fair heads up parks such as Knott's Berry Farm in California, Schlitterbahn in Texas, Canada's Wonderland in Ontario, and their flagship Cedar Point in Ohio. Six Flags primarily runs about 20 parks across the U.S., as well as two in Mexico and one in Canada, all under its brand.

After the merger, the new company will keep the Six Flags name, but its shares will be traded using Cedar Fair’s ticker symbol, FUN. The firms expect the merger will bring $200 million in annual cost savings—mainly from reductions in administrative and operational spending—and anticipate $3.4 billion in yearly revenues.

Shareholders of Cedar Fair will get one share in the new company for every share they own today; Six Flags shareholders receive 0.58 shares for each of their existing shares. The merger comes as amusement park operators face slower consumer spending, climate impacts, and heightened competition from SeaWorld, Universal Studios, and Disney, the latter of which is planning a $60 billion investment in its own parks.

Amusement park attendance has generally declined since the pandemic, with factors like extreme weather, changing travel trends, and political tensions—especially in Florida—affecting recent visitor numbers and wait times.

1. Where does Six Flags operate? It runs 27 parks across the U.S., Mexico, and Canada.
2. Where are Cedar Fair’s parks? They are in Missouri, Texas, South Carolina, Pennsylvania, Ohio, California, Virginia, Minnesota, Michigan, and Toronto, Canada. The company is headquartered in Sandusky, Ohio.
