article_content: Thai Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin declared on Thursday that the country’s economy is in a “crisis,” underscoring the need to move forward with his contentious 500 billion baht ($14.23 billion) digital handouts policy. Speaking at a forum, Srettha said the economy is struggling, with foreign tourist arrivals falling short of targets. He plans to prioritize attracting foreign investment and addressing the nation’s household debt, announcing that a plan to tackle debt will be unveiled on December 12. These comments follow recent data from the state planning agency, which showed that Thailand’s economy grew just 1.5% year-on-year in the July-September quarter—the slowest pace so far this year—due to weak exports and modest government spending. From January 1 to November 19, Thailand welcomed 23.85 million foreign tourists who spent a total of 1 trillion baht. The government aims for 28 million tourist arrivals by year’s end, still below the pre-pandemic record of almost 40 million in 2019, when visitors spent 1.91 trillion baht. Srettha’s “digital wallet” initiative would distribute 10,000 baht to 50 million Thais in 2024 for use within their local communities. The plan has drawn criticism from economists and former central bankers who warn it could threaten financial discipline. Government officials in recent weeks have echoed Srettha’s concerns about the crisis, arguing that aggressive policy measures are necessary. Srettha, a real estate tycoon new to politics, seeks to achieve an average annual economic growth rate of 5% over the next four years in Southeast Asia’s second-largest economy, which averaged just 1.9% growth over the past decade—lagging behind regional peers. Speaking at the same forum, Bank of Thailand Governor Sethaput Suthiwartnarueput emphasized the importance of flexibility in fiscal and monetary policy to ensure resilience as the economy grows. “Elements of resiliency include stability, strong balance sheets, and a range of fiscal and monetary policy options,” he said. In September, the Bank of Thailand (BOT) unexpectedly raised its key interest rate by a quarter point to 2.50%—the highest in a decade—citing expectations that growth and inflation would pick up in 2024. The next policy review is scheduled for November 29.
translated_content: Thajský premiér Srettha Thavisin vo štvrtok vyhlásil, že ekonomika krajiny je v „kríze“ a zdôraznil potrebu pokračovať v jeho kontroverznom pláne digitálnych príspevkov vo výške 500 miliárd bahtov (14,23 miliardy dolárov). Na fóre Srettha uviedol, že ekonomika zápasí a počet zahraničných turistov nedosahuje stanovené ciele. Plánuje dať prioritu prilákaniu zahraničných investícií a riešeniu domáceho dlhu, pričom oznámil, že plán na riešenie dlhu bude zverejnený 12. decembra. Tieto komentáre nadväzujú na nedávne údaje od štátnej plánovacej agentúry, podľa ktorých ekonomika Thajska v treťom štvrťroku medziročne vzrástla len o 1,5 % – ide o najpomalšie tempo v tomto roku – a to v dôsledku slabého exportu a obmedzených vládnych výdavkov. Od 1. januára do 19. novembra privítalo Thajsko 23,85 milióna zahraničných turistov, ktorí utratili spolu 1 bilión bahtov. Vláda si do konca roka stanovuje cieľ 28 miliónov návštevníkov, čo je však stále menej ako predpandemický rekord takmer 40 miliónov v roku 2019, keď turisti minuli 1,91 bilióna bahtov. Sretthova iniciatíva „digitálna peňaženka“ by v roku 2024 rozdelila 10 000 bahtov pre 50 miliónov Thajčanov na použitie vo svojich komunitách. Plán čelí kritike ekonómov a bývalých centrálnych bankárov, ktorí varujú, že by mohol ohroziť finančnú disciplínu. Vládni predstavitelia v posledných týždňoch podporujú Sretthove obavy z krízy a tvrdia, že sú potrebné rázne politické opatrenia. Srettha, realitný magnát a nováčik v politike, sa snaží dosiahnuť priemerný medziročný ekonomický rast 5 % počas najbližších štyroch rokov v druhej najväčšej ekonomike juhovýchodnej Ázie, ktorá za posledné desaťročie rástla v priemere len o 1,9 %, čím zaostáva za regionálnymi susedmi. Na tom istom fóre guvernér Bank of Thailand Sethaput Suthiwartnarueput zdôraznil dôležitosť flexibility vo fiškálnej a menovej politike, aby sa zaistila odolnosť počas rastu ekonomiky. „Elementy odolnosti zahŕňajú stabilitu, silné rozvahy a škálu možností fiškálnej a menovej politiky,“ uviedol. V septembri Bank of Thailand (BOT) neočakávane zvýšila svoju kľúčovú úrokovú sadzbu o štvrť bodu na 2,50 % – najvyššie za desať rokov – s tým, že rast a inflácia by sa mali v roku 2024 zrýchliť. Najbližšie prehodnotenie politiky je naplánované na 29. novembra.

The British government has issued a global alert to airlines, instructing them not to allow CIA whistleblower Edward Snowden to board any flights to the UK. The alert warns that Snowden—a former US intelligence contractor who leaked details of the controversial Prism surveillance program—is highly likely to be refused entry, marking a significant escalation in Britain’s involvement in the ongoing intelligence leaks scandal. The warning, reportedly sent by the Home Office and dated Monday, was shared with airlines worldwide, according to the Associated Press. While the document appears genuine, the Home Office declined to comment on its authenticity.

Edward Snowden, 29, formerly worked as a technical assistant for the CIA and claims that the UK’s GCHQ intelligence agency compiled dossiers on UK citizens using data from the US Prism program. Gathering information in this manner would be illegal for British security services if done directly, but it is alleged that GCHQ received data from Prism since 2010. Snowden’s disclosures, which he made with a thumb drive at an NSA facility in Hawaii, revealed the extent of US and UK surveillance operations and sparked global controversy.

The National Security Agency and the FBI are said to have access to data from major internet companies, including Google, Facebook, Microsoft, and Skype. The British government’s alert to airlines warns that Snowden is likely to be refused entry and notes that carriers could face costs related to his detention and removal if they transport him to the UK. Airlines, including Bangkok Airways, confirmed receiving the notice through Thailand’s airport authorities. The letter reportedly features Snowden’s photograph and personal details and was not intended for public distribution.

The UK government is eager to avoid a repeat of previous embarrassments, such as when WikiLeaks founder Julian Assange sought refuge in the Ecuadorian Embassy in London to avoid extradition. While Foreign Secretary William Hague repeatedly declined to comment on Snowden’s case, the government’s actions demonstrate a firm stance against allowing Snowden to enter the UK. A Home Office spokesperson stated that the department does not routinely comment on individual cases.

Varovanie upozorňuje, že Snowden — bývalý americký spravodajský kontraktor, ktorý zverejnil informácie o kontroverznom sledovacom programe Prism — bude s najväčšou pravdepodobnosťou odmietnutý pri vstupe do krajiny, čo predstavuje významnú eskaláciu zapojenia Británie do prebiehajúceho škandálu okolo úniku tajných informácií. Varovanie, údajne zaslané Ministerstvom vnútra a datované na pondelok, bolo podľa agentúry Associated Press rozoslané leteckým spoločnostiam po celom svete. Hoci dokument vyzerá autenticky, ministerstvo vnútra odmietlo potvrdiť jeho pravosť.

Edward Snowden, 29-ročný, bol pôvodne technickým asistentom CIA a tvrdí, že britská spravodajská agentúra GCHQ zostavovala záznamy o britských občanoch na základe údajov z amerického programu Prism. Zhromažďovanie informácií týmto spôsobom by bolo pre britské bezpečnostné služby nelegálne, ak by ho vykonávali priamo, no údajne GCHQ prijíma údaje z Prism už od roku 2010. Snowdenove zverejnenia, ktoré získal pomocou USB kľúča na zariadení NSA na Havaji, odhalili rozsah amerických a britských sledovacích operácií a vyvolali celosvetovú diskusiu.

Americká Národná bezpečnostná agentúra (NSA) a FBI majú údajne prístup k údajom veľkých internetových spoločností vrátane Google, Facebooku, Microsoftu a Skype. Britská vládna výstraha leteckým spoločnostiam upozorňuje, že Snowdenovi pravdepodobne nebude umožnený vstup a pripomína, že dopravcovia by v prípade prepravy mohli znášať náklady spojené s jeho zadržaním a vyhostením. Letecké spoločnosti, ako Bangkok Airways, potvrdili prijatie oznámenia prostredníctvom thajských letiskových orgánov. Britská vláda sa snaží zabrániť ďalším nepríjemnostiam, podobným prípadu zakladateľa WikiLeaks Juliana Assangea, ktorý našiel útočisko na ekvádorskom veľvyslanectve v Londýne pri úteku pred vydaním. Zatiaľ čo minister zahraničných vecí William Hague opakovane odmietal komentovať Snowdenovu situáciu, kroky vlády naznačujú pevný postoj proti jeho príchodu do Británie. Hovorca ministerstva vnútra uviedol, že rezort sa k individuálnym prípadom bežne nevyjadruje.

A New York firefighter, Taylor Murphy, was acquitted of felony strangulation and witness-tampering charges following a dispute with his ex-girlfriend, Claudia Charriez, in a Manhattan hotel. The jury dropped the most serious charges, which could have resulted in a seven-year prison sentence. However, Murphy was found guilty of contempt for repeatedly contacting Charriez—over 1,000 times in five months—despite a protection order. He was also convicted of misdemeanor assault and criminal mischief for damaging Charriez's phone.

Charriez, a transgender model and former America’s Next Top Model contestant, had accused Murphy of attacking her during an altercation in August of the previous year. Murphy, 29, could face up to four years in prison and lose his job because of these convictions. He is currently in a relationship with Wanda Batista, also a transgender woman, and revealed feeling ostracized at his workplace since the trial, experiencing harassment and contemplating suicide as a result of public scrutiny.

Murphy's defense argued that the altercation was a result of a lovers' dispute and suggested Charriez was motivated by jealousy over his new relationship. Charriez admitted on the witness stand to sending Murphy a series of emotional messages after the incident and acknowledged inconsistencies in her police report. The trial shed light on the personal and emotional turmoil experienced by both parties.

article_content: Electric lights, including those used in laptops, smartphones, and tablets, play a significant role in disrupting people's sleep, a leading expert has warned. According to Professor Charles Czeisler, a Harvard sleep medicine specialist writing in Nature, artificial light interferes with the body's circadian clock, impacts brain chemicals, and encourages people to consume stimulants like caffeine to stay awake longer. Czeisler called for more behavioral and technical research to address the negative effects of artificial light on modern sleep habits. He stated that illuminated screens can affect the circadian clock, which regulates sleep, even more powerfully than any medication. Reduced sleep duration has been linked to increased public health risks, including obesity, diabetes, heart disease, depression, and stroke in adults, as well as concentration issues in children. While all artificial light can impact circadian rhythms, night-time exposure to LED lights from devices is typically more disruptive than standard bulbs. 'There are many reasons people in our 24/7 society don’t get enough sleep, such as early work or school schedules and caffeine-rich diets,' he wrote, 'but one often overlooked cause is the widespread use of electric light.' 'Without electric light, few would use caffeine to stay up late. Light impacts our circadian rhythms more strongly than any drug.' Between 1950 and 2000, people in the UK quadrupled their use of artificial light, which paralleled a rise in sleep deficiency. Artificial light inhibits the brain’s sleep-promoting neurons and the release of melatonin, while activating alertness-inducing neurons. This delays the body's natural 'second wind,' which previously occurred before sunset. Czeisler observed that many now check emails, do homework, or watch TV around midnight, rarely realizing it's the middle of the night. A study found that 30% of working adults and 44% of night shift workers in the US average less than six hours of sleep per night, compared with under 3% of adults fifty years ago. Globally, children now sleep 1.2 hours less on school nights than a century ago. 'Technology has effectively decoupled us from the natural 24-hour day,' Czeisler said, 'prompting later bedtimes and increased morning caffeine use, ultimately reducing sleep.'

Czeisler vyzýva na ďalší výskum behaviorálnych a technických riešení na zmiernenie negatívnych účinkov umelého svetla na naše spánkové zvyky. Tvrdí, že podsvietené obrazovky môžu ovplyvniť cirkadiánne hodiny, ktoré regulujú spánok, ešte silnejšie než akýkoľvek liek. Hoci všetky umelé svetlá môžu narušiť cirkadiánne rytmy, nočné používanie LED svetiel zo zariadení je väčšinou rušivejšie ako bežné žiarovky. „Existuje mnoho dôvodov, prečo ľudia v našej 24/7 spoločnosti nemajú dostatok spánku, od skorých pracovných alebo školských začiatkov až po jedlá a nápoje s vysokým obsahom kofeínu,“ napísal, „no podceňovaným dôvodom je rozšírené využívanie elektrického svetla.“ „Bez elektrického svetla by len málokto užíval kofeín na bdelosť do neskorých nočných hodín. To oddiaľuje „druhý dych“ tela, ktorý pred vznikom elektrického svetla prichádzal pred západom slnka. Czeisler konštatuje, že dnes mnohí ľudia čítajú maily, pripravujú úlohy alebo pozerajú TV ešte aj o polnoci, často bez uvedomenia, že je hlboká noc. Celosvetovo spia deti počas školských nocí v priemere o 1,2 hodiny menej než pred sto rokmi. „Technológia nás v podstate odpojila od prirodzeného 24-hodinového cyklu,“ hovorí Czeisler, „čo vedie k neskorším spánkom a vyššej konzumácii kofeínu ráno, čím sa skracuje spánok.“

article_content: MAYWOOD, Ill. – Former NFL player Sergio Brown, accused of killing his mother, allegedly purchased a one-way ticket to Cancun, Mexico after being the last person seen with her before her death last month, according to a prosecutor. Brown, facing charges of first-degree murder and concealing a homicide, appeared in court Wednesday for a detention hearing before Cook County Judge Teresa Molina-Gonzalez, who denied his request for pretrial release. He will remain in custody until his next court appearance, scheduled for November 22. Myrtle Brown, 73, was discovered dead on September 16 near a creek in Maywood, about 12 miles west of Chicago. The medical examiner determined her death was a homicide caused by an assault. Brown, 35, had lived with his mother in Maywood. On October 7, Brown was deported from Mexico and returned to Illinois the following day, according to local news reports. During Wednesday’s hearing, Brown, dressed in a gray sweatshirt and red basketball shorts with his wrists handcuffed, spoke only when addressed by the judge and showed no visible emotion, the Chicago Sun-Times reported. Prosecutor Jose Villarreal told the court that Brown was observed burning fabric the night of his mother’s death on September 14, and that he flew to Cancun the next day. Credit card activity suggested that Brown had rented two homes in Colombia before his deportation. Investigators found that both Brown's and his mother's cellphones were in close proximity at the estimated time of her death. Additionally, DNA samples found under Myrtle Brown’s fingernails matched a toothbrush from Sergio Brown’s bedroom, Villarreal said. Public defender Robert Fox challenged the prosecution’s case, stating that no one witnessed the crime and all evidence was circumstantial. Assistant public defender Charnelle Dunlap said her office was not prepared to comment further at this time. Sergio Brown attended Proviso East High School in Maywood and played college football at the University of Notre Dame. He entered the NFL in 2010 as an undrafted free agent with the New England Patriots, and later played for the Indianapolis Colts, Atlanta Falcons, Jacksonville Jaguars, and Buffalo Bills through 2016.

Brown, ktorý čelí obvineniam z vraždy prvého stupňa a ukrývania vraždy, sa v stredu zúčastnil na vypočutí o zadržaní pred sudkyňou okresu Cook Teresou Molina-Gonzalezovou, ktorá mu zamietla predprocesné prepustenie. Vo väzbe zostane až do ďalšieho pojednávania stanoveného na 22. novembra. Myrtle Brownová, 73, bola nájdená 16. septembra mŕtva pri potoku v Maywoode, približne 20 kilometrov západne od Chicaga. Súdny lekár určil, že zomrela následkom útoku, pričom spôsob smrti bola vražda. Brown, 35, žil so svojou matkou v Maywoode. Podľa miestnych médií bol Brown 7. októbra deportovaný z Mexika a nasledujúci deň privezený späť do Illinois. Počas súdneho pojednávania mal Brown na sebe sivú mikinu a červené basketbalové šortky s rukami spútanými v putách. Počas procesu prehovoril len, keď ho sudkyňa oslovila, a neprejavil žiadne viditeľné emócie, informoval Chicago Sun-Times. Prokurátor Jose Villarreal na súde uviedol, že Browna videli v osudnú noc 14. septembra páliť látku a na druhý deň odletel do Cancúnu. Podľa údajov z jeho kreditnej karty si Brown prenajal dva domy v Kolumbii predtým, ako bol deportovaný. Vyšetrovatelia zistili, že mobilné telefóny Browna a jeho matky sa v odhadovanom čase jej smrti nachádzali v blízkosti toho istého miesta. Sergio Brown navštevoval strednú školu Proviso East v Maywoode a hral univerzitný futbal za University of Notre Dame. V roku 2010 vstúpil do NFL ako nedraftovaný voľný hráč v tíme New England Patriots a neskôr pôsobil v Indianapolis Colts, Atlanta Falcons, Jacksonville Jaguars a Buffalo Bills do roku 2016.

article_content: Paul Merson, the former England footballer and current Sky Sports pundit, was seen leaving Warwick Hospital with visible injuries after being involved in a car accident. Merson said he was fortunate to be alive following a high-speed crash on the M40 motorway in the early hours of Wednesday. Merson, who has previously struggled with gambling, drug, and alcohol addiction, was arrested on suspicion of drink-driving and is now at the center of a police investigation. He sustained cuts to his head after his black Mercedes SUV collided with a Ministry of Defence lorry. The accident happened shortly after Merson left a Children in Need charity gala in Battersea, South London, returning home to Sutton Coldfield. At approximately 3:12am, his car crashed into the central reservation and then struck the lorry. He stated to officers that he had fallen asleep at the wheel. Merson, 43, was treated at Warwick Hospital for facial injuries and provided a blood sample as part of the police investigation. If tests confirm excess alcohol, he could face prosecution. Merson was released from the hospital after six hours and photographed with blood on his shirt and stitches on his forehead. The lorry's driver was treated for whiplash. Police confirmed that the crash took place between junctions 14 and 15 of the northbound M40. Merson, who played 21 times for England and won two league titles with Arsenal, has publicly spoken about his long battles with addiction issues. In his memoir, 'How Not To Be A Professional Footballer,' he revealed significant financial losses due to gambling. Police continue to investigate the crash as Merson recovers at home.

article_content: Former UK Prime Minister David Cameron made a surprise return to high office on Monday, appointed as Foreign Secretary in a significant reshuffle of the Conservative government. This shakeup also saw the dismissal of Suella Braverman as Home Secretary. Braverman, known for her firm stance on law and order, was criticized for accusing police of being too lenient with pro-Palestinian protesters. She was replaced by James Cleverly, who previously served as Foreign Secretary. Prime Minister Rishi Sunak is seeking to revitalize the Conservative Party, which has governed for 13 years but now trails Labour by 15 to 20 points in the polls, amid criticism over the economy, high inflation, health system strain, and public sector strikes. Cameron, who led the UK from 2010 to 2016 and called the Brexit referendum, had been out of frontline politics for seven years. He was appointed to the unelected House of Lords to serve as Foreign Secretary, making him the first former Prime Minister in decades to return to the Cabinet and the first Conservative Foreign Secretary to serve from the Lords since the 1980s. Cameron stated that Britain faces major international challenges—including the war in Ukraine and the Middle East crisis—and said he hoped his experience would help the government address them. His foreign policy record includes support for NATO’s intervention in Libya in 2011, a failed attempt to gain parliamentary approval for military action in Syria, and advocating a closer relationship with China before ties deteriorated. He is especially known for calling the 2016 EU referendum, which led to Brexit and his resignation. Bronwen Maddox of Chatham House praised Cameron’s experience but noted his controversial legacy. Sunak's reshuffle, including Cameron’s return and Braverman’s removal, is expected to deepen divisions within the Conservative Party. MP Jacob Rees-Mogg criticized Braverman’s dismissal, claiming she understood Conservative voters’ concerns. Braverman, a 43-year-old lawyer and strong opponent of high migration, became a prominent figure in the party’s populist wing. She recently accused police of treating pro-Palestinian and Black Lives Matter protests more leniently than right-wing demonstrations, publishing an article in The Times without Prime Ministerial approval. This weekend, police scuffled with far-right protesters during a large pro-Palestinian march in London. Critics argue Braverman’s statements inflamed tensions. As Home Secretary, she backed the government’s stalled plan to send asylum-seekers to Rwanda, which awaits a Supreme Court ruling. Some believe Braverman is positioning herself for future party leadership if the Conservatives lose the next general election. Cameron’s return is divisive given his record—he led years of austerity following the 2008 financial crisis and became embroiled in a lobbying scandal post-premiership. Political scientist Tim Bale described the appointment as a sign of government desperation.
translated_content: Bývalý britský premiér David Cameron sa v pondelok prekvapivo vrátil do vysokej politiky, keď bol vymenovaný za ministra zahraničných vecí v rámci významnej reorganizácie konzervatívnej vlády. Táto zmena priniesla aj odvolanie Suelly Bravermanovej z postu ministerky vnútra. Bravermanová, známa svojím tvrdým postojom v otázkach poriadku, bola kritizovaná za to, že obvinila políciu z prílišnej tolerantnosti voči propalestínskym protestujúcim. Na jej miesto nastúpil James Cleverly, doterajší minister zahraničných vecí. Premiér Rishi Sunak sa snaží oživiť Konzervatívnu stranu, ktorá je pri moci už 13 rokov, no v prieskumoch zaostáva za labouristami o 15 až 20 percentuálnych bodov, najmä pre kritiku ekonomickej stagnácie, vysokej inflácie, problémov v zdravotníctve a štrajkov verejného sektora. Cameron, ktorý viedol Spojené kráľovstvo v rokoch 2010 až 2016 a vypísal referendum o Brexite, bol sedem rokov mimo vrcholovej politiky. Na post ministra zahraničia bol vymenovaný vďaka tomu, že bol uvedený do nevolenej Snemovne lordov, čo z neho robí prvého bývalého premiéra po desaťročiach, ktorý sa vrátil do vlády, a prvého konzervatívneho ministra zahraničia v Lordoch od 80. rokov. Cameron uviedol, že Británia čelí viacerým významným medzinárodným výzvam – vrátane vojny na Ukrajine a krízy na Blízkom východe – a dúfa, že jeho skúsenosti pomôžu vláde ich zvládnuť. Jeho zahraničnopolitická minulosť zahŕňa podporu zásahu NATO v Líbyi v roku 2011, neúspešnú snahu získať schválenie parlamentu pre akciu v Sýrii a podporovanie užších vzťahov s Čínou, ktoré sa neskôr zhoršili. Najviac sa s ním spája vyhlásenie referenda o členstve v EÚ v roku 2016, čo viedlo k Brexitu a jeho demisii. Bronwen Maddoxová z Chatham House ocenila Cameronove skúsenosti, poukázala však aj na jeho kontroverzné dedičstvo. Sunakove nedávne zmeny, vrátane návratu Camerona a odvolania Bravermanovej, pravdepodobne prehĺbia roztržky v Konzervatívnej strane. Poslanec Jacob Rees-Mogg kritizoval odvolanie Bravermanovej so slovami, že podľa neho rozumela voličom konzervatívcov. Bravermanová, 43-ročná právnička a vyhranená odporkyňa vysokej migrácie, sa stala výraznou osobnosťou populistického krídla strany. Nedávno obvinila políciu z uprednostňovania propalestínskych a Black Lives Matter protestov pred pravicovými demonštráciami, pričom článok v The Times zverejnila bez schválenia premiérovou kanceláriou. Cez víkend sa polícia dostala do potýčok s krajne pravicovými protestujúcimi počas veľkého propalestínskeho pochodu v Londýne. Kritici tvrdia, že výroky Bravermanovej zvýšili napätie. Ako ministerka vnútra podporovala vládny pozastavený plán na posielanie žiadateľov o azyl do Rwandy, o ktorom má rozhodnúť Najvyšší súd. Niektorí sa domnievajú, že Bravermanová sa pripravuje na budúce vedenie strany, ak konzervatívci prehrajú nasledujúce voľby. Cameronov návrat vyvoláva rozdelené reakcie – viedol roky úsporných opatrení po finančnej kríze v roku 2008 a po odchode z premiérskeho postu sa zaplietol do lobistického škandálu. Politológ Tim Bale označil túto nomináciu za znak zúfalstva vlády.

article_content: Tripoli, Libya – The alleys and archways along Rashid Street in central Tripoli were shrouded in darkness this weekend, as the city faced widespread electricity shortages. After sunset, one corner cafe was illuminated only by two candles, lighting the faces of men breaking their Ramadan fast at a few tables. Down the empty, dark streets, residents walked quietly; some played music from parked cars, while others sat in doorways, their presence visible only by the glow of cigarettes. "It's a disaster. My father's neighborhood hasn’t had electricity for five days straight," said a Libyan man who wished to remain unnamed for fear of government reprisal. He explained he had evacuated his family to Egypt but stayed behind to watch over their home. Many Tripoli residents have been shocked by the rapid decline in power supply over the last two weeks. Some complain that water pumps have stopped, leaving them without both water and electricity. This week, a pro-Gadhafi talk show on state TV discussed the blackouts, blaming NATO and rebel attacks on power stations. At a recent government press conference, frustrations mounted as a local pressed Deputy Foreign Minister Khaled Kaim on why some neighborhoods had power while others didn’t. Kaim accused NATO warplanes and rebels of targeting power stations and infrastructure. A NATO spokesperson denied these accusations, stating in an email to CNN that there is no evidence linking NATO to damage of Libya’s power lines. Libya, under an international blockade, is experiencing prolonged fuel shortages. Lines for gas stretch for days, and prices have surged. "One liter of petrol, 4 dinars!" a taxi driver shouted Saturday, referring to a significant price increase in a country used to cheap, subsidized fuel. Before protests began in February, Libya was a major oil exporter, but now exports have drastically fallen. Hopes for relief faded when rebels reportedly seized the fuel tanker Cartagena near Malta, with the Tripoli regime calling it international piracy and alleging NATO involvement. According to video from Reuters and reports from Petroleum Economist, the Cartagena, owned by Libya’s state shipping company GNMTC, was taken to Benghazi. Officials from Malta and NATO denied that the tanker was within Malta’s waters or that NATO escorted it to Benghazi. In Tripoli’s Ghot al-Shaal district, shops struggled to operate amid blackout and heat. "We’ve had no power all day; how can we work like this?" an angry merchant complained. Ridha Abdullah, a children’s shop owner, said outages began weeks ago and hoped for resolution if NATO withdrew. While some residents voiced support for Gadhafi or opposition to foreign media, others discreetly expressed dissent, believing the government was not truthful and expressing hope for change. Some business owners chose to close early and escape the stifling city heat.
translated_content: Tripolis, Líbya – Uličky a oblúky na ulici Rashid v centre Tripolisu sa tento víkend ponorili do tmy, keďže mesto čelí rozsiahlym výpadkom elektriny. Po západe slnka svietili v jednej kaviarni len dve sviečky, ich svetlo osvetľovalo tváre mužov pri niekoľkých stoloch počas prerušovania ramadánskeho pôstu. Po prázdnych tmavých uliciach kráčali obyvatelia potichu – niektorí púšťali hudbu z odstavených áut, iní sedeli v dverách, prezrádzaní len žiariacou cigaretou. "Je to katastrofa. Štvrť môjho otca nemala elektrinu už päť dní v kuse," povedal jeden muž z Líbye, ktorý chcel zostať v anonymite zo strachu pred odvetou vlády. Vysvetlil, že svoju rodinu evakuoval do Egypta, ale sám zostal, aby dohliadal na dom. Mnohí obyvatelia Tripolisu sú šokovaní rýchlym úpadkom dodávok elektriny za posledné dva týždne. Niektorí sa sťažujú, že vodné čerpadlá prestali fungovať, takže zostali bez vody aj svetla. Tento týždeň sa v pro-Gaddáfíovskej diskusnej relácii v štátnej televízii riešili výpadky prúdu, pričom vina bola pripísaná útokom NATO a povstalcom na elektrárne. Na nedávnej tlačovej konferencii vlády vyjadril miestny obyvateľ frustráciu, keď sa pýtal zástupcu ministra zahraničných vecí Khaleda Kaima, prečo majú niektoré štvrte elektrinu a iné nie. Kaim obvinil lietadlá NATO a povstalcov z útokov na elektrárne a infraštruktúru. Hovorca NATO tieto obvinenia poprel a v e-maile pre CNN uviedol, že neexistuje dôkaz o spojitosti medzi poškodením elektrických vedení v Líbyi a zásahmi NATO. Líbya, ktorá je pod medzinárodnou blokádou, zápasí s dlhotrvajúcim nedostatkom pohonných hmôt. Ľudia čakajú na čerpacích staniciach dni v radoch a ceny prudko vzrástli. "Liter benzínu, 4 dináre!" kričal v sobotu taxikár, čím poukazoval na výrazné zdraženie v krajine zvyknutej na lacné dotované palivá. Pred februárovými protestmi bola Líbya veľkým exportérom ropy, teraz však vývoz prudko klesol. Nádeje na úľavu zhasli, keď povstalci údajne zhabali tanker Cartagena pri Malte; režim v Tripolise to označil za medzinárodné pirátstvo a tvrdí, že do toho bolo zapojené aj NATO. Podľa videí agentúry Reuters a správ od Petroleum Economist bol tanker Cartagena, patriaci štátnej spoločnosti GNMTC, prepravený do Bengházi. Zástupcovia Malty a NATO popreli, že by bol tanker v maltských vodách alebo že by ho NATO sprevádzalo do Bengházi. V štvrti Ghot al-Shaal v Tripolise mali obchody problém fungovať pre výpadky prúdu a horúčavu. "Nemáme elektrinu celý deň, ako máme takto pracovať?" sťažoval sa nahnevaný obchodník. Ridha Abdullah, majiteľ obchodu s detským oblečením, uviedol, že výpadky začali pred niekoľkými týždňami a dúfa v riešenie, ak by NATO odišlo. Kým niektorí obyvatelia vyslovujú podporu Gaddáfímu alebo odpor voči zahraničným médiám, iní diskrétne vyjadrujú nesúhlas, tvrdia, že vláda nehovorí pravdu a dúfajú v zmenu. Niektorí podnikatelia radšej zavreli svoje prevádzky skôr a unikli sparnému mestu.

article_content: A judge ruled Monday that University of North Carolina graduate student Tailei Qi, charged with killing his faculty adviser, is unfit for trial after two mental health evaluations. Qi, 34, is accused of fatally shooting associate professor Zijie Yan inside a science building at UNC’s Chapel Hill campus on August 28. Qi is being held without bond on charges of first-degree murder and possession of a firearm on educational property. Judge Alyson Grine stated that two separate evaluations determined Qi likely suffers from untreated schizophrenia. Grine noted that Qi displayed delusions, auditory hallucinations, self-harm, and fragmented thought processes that hindered communication. Due to his severe mental illness, Qi is unable to comprehend his situation, assist in his defense, or understand court proceedings, even with an interpreter. The court ordered that Qi be committed to Central Regional Hospital in Butner for psychological treatment, with mandatory notification to prosecutors if his condition improves. Qi’s arrest followed an hours-long campus lockdown and police search that left students and faculty frightened at the start of the fall semester. Chapel Hill police apprehended Qi without incident in a residential area near campus within two hours of the shooting, according to UNC Police Chief Brian James. Two weeks later, campus was locked down again after police received a report of someone brandishing a weapon in the student union. An autopsy revealed that Yan was shot multiple times in his Caudill Labs office; police found nine 9mm shell casings but have not recovered the firearm. Authorities have not disclosed how Qi, who was in the U.S. on a student visa and could not legally purchase a weapon, obtained the gun. Yan was an associate professor in the Department of Applied Physical Sciences at UNC since July 2019 and led the Yan Research Group, which Qi joined in 2022. Students held a candlelight vigil and rallied for gun control following Yan’s death. Hannah Schoenbaum is a member of the Associated Press/Report for America Statehouse News Initiative. Report for America is a nonprofit program placing journalists in local newsrooms.

Qi (34) je obvinený zo smrteľnej streľby na docenta Zijieho Yana v budove prírodovednej fakulty kampusu UNC v Chapel Hill 28. augusta. Qi je zadržaný bez možnosti prepustenia na kauciu, pričom čelí obvineniam z vraždy prvého stupňa a držania strelnej zbrane na školskom pozemku. Sudkyňa Alyson Grine uviedla, že dve nezávislé vyšetrenia dospeli k záveru, že Qi pravdepodobne trpí neliečenou schizofréniou. Grine poznamenala, že Qi prejavoval bludy, sluchové halucinácie, sebapoškodzovanie a roztrieštené myslenie, ktoré sťažovalo komunikáciu. Pre svoju závažnú duševnú chorobu nie je Qi schopný pochopiť svoju situáciu, pomôcť pri svojej obhajobe, ani rozumieť súdnemu konaniu, a to ani s tlmočníkom. Súd nariadil, aby bol Qi umiestnený na psychiatrické liečenie do Centrálnej regionálnej nemocnice v Butneri, pričom prokurátori musia byť informovaní, ak sa jeho stav zlepší. Qiho zatknutie nasledovalo po niekoľkohodinovom uzatvorení kampusu a policajnom pátraní, ktoré vyvolali strach medzi študentmi a pedagógmi na začiatku semestra. Polícia z Chapel Hill zadržala Qiho bez odporu v rezidenčnej štvrti blízko kampusu do dvoch hodín od incidentu, uviedol šéf univerzitnej polície Brian James. O dva týždne neskôr bol kampus opäť uzatvorený po tom, čo polícia prijala oznámenie o osobe, ktorá má zbraň v študentskom centre. Pitva ukázala, že Yan bol vo svojej kancelárii v Caudill Labs zastrelený viackrát; polícia našla deväť nábojníc kalibru 9 mm, no zbraň sa nenašla. Úrady zatiaľ neuviedli, ako Qi — ktorý bol v USA na študentské vízum a nemohol legálne kúpiť zbraň — získal strelnú zbraň. Yan bol docentom na Katedre aplikovaných fyzikálnych vied UNC od júla 2019 a viedol Yan Research Group, ku ktorej sa Qi pripojil v roku 2022. Študenti po Yanovej smrti usporiadali pietnu spomienku so sviečkami a vyzývali na prísnejšie zákony o zbraniach. article_content:
Wells Fargo has sounded the alarm that continued high interest rates from the Federal Reserve could trigger a housing market slump reminiscent of the 1980s recession. The Fed plans to keep borrowing costs elevated well into 2024 to curb inflation, and Wells Fargo believes this will inhibit both new home construction and market activity.

Economists Charlie Dougherty and Patrick Barley explained that the positive trend in the housing sector seen earlier in 2023 has reversed due to rising mortgage rates. Even if interest rates eventually fall, Wells Fargo says they will likely remain higher than what recent buyers have become accustomed to. This persistent trend is expected to dampen buyer demand, slow new housing construction, and discourage homeowners with low-rate mortgages from selling their homes.

Freddie Mac data indicates that the average 30-year fixed mortgage has surged from below 4% to nearly 8% since March 2022, when the Fed started tightening monetary policy. These increased costs have led to fewer new homes being built and have encouraged existing homeowners to stay put, straining the already limited supply of houses. Just 1% of Americans sold their homes in the first half of 2023, according to Redfin.

Wells Fargo draws a parallel with the 1980s, when aggressive Fed policies drove mortgage rates up to 19%, prompting desperate appeals from the housing industry. More recently, the National Association of Realtors, Mortgage Bankers Association, and National Association of Homebuilders sent a letter to Fed Chair Jerome Powell urging a halt to interest rate hikes—a repeat of past pleas.

Dougherty and Barley stress that as mortgage rates have exceeded 7% and the Fed maintains tight policy, key measures such as home sales, loan applications, and builder confidence have all declined.

Wells Fargo varuje, že pretrvávajúce vysoké úrokové sadzby od Federálneho rezervného systému môžu spôsobiť prepad trhu s nehnuteľnosťami podobný recesii z 80. rokov. Fed plánuje držať vysokú cenu úverov až do roku 2024 v snahe brzdiť infláciu, čo podľa Wells Fargo oslabí výstavbu nových domov a celkovú aktivitu na trhu.

Ekonómovia Charlie Dougherty a Patrick Barley uvádzajú, že pozitívny trend na trhu s bývaním v prvej polovici 2023 sa zvrátil následkom rastu hypotekárnych sadzieb. Aj v prípade, že sadzby časom klesnú, podľa Wells Fargo zostanú zrejme vyššie ako boli v posledných rokoch bežné. Tieto podmienky môžu potlačiť dopyt, obmedziť výstavbu a odradiť majiteľov s nízkymi hypotékami od predaja.

Dáta Freddie Mac ukazujú, že priemerná 30-ročná fixná hypotéka stúpla od marca 2022 z menej ako 4 % na takmer 8 %. Vyššie náklady brzdia výstavbu a spôsobujú, že ľudia zostávajú v existujúcich domoch, čím sa trh ďalej napevno zväzuje. Podľa Redfinu iba 1 % Američanov predalo nehnuteľnosť v prvej polovici 2023.

Wells Fargo pripomína krízu z 80. rokov, kedy Fed viedol prudké zvyšovanie poplatkov a hypotekárne úroky atakovali až 19 %. Vtedy aj teraz žiadajú stavitelia, realitní makléri a hypotekárni bankári Fed o zastavenie zvyšovania sadzieb – nedávno aj prostredníctvom listu adresovaného šéfovi Fedu Jeromeovi Powellovi.

Dougherty a Barley zdôrazňujú, že s úrokmi nad 7 % a trvajúcou prísnosťou Fedu výrazne klesajú predaje domov, žiadosti o hypotéky aj dôvera staviteľov.

article_content: Stuart Lancaster has vowed that England will give everything they have in pursuit of making the nation proud during the 2015 Rugby World Cup. The campaign for rugby's top honor will start a year from now, when the host nation faces Fiji at Twickenham—a match they hope will be the first of seven leading to captain Chris Robshaw lifting the Webb Ellis trophy. While reigning champions New Zealand enter as the clear favorites, Lancaster is firm that England will put in maximum effort to challenge for the title. Speaking to England Rugby TV, he said, 'We'll do our best to make sure we deliver, and deliver in a way that will make the country proud.' Lancaster highlighted the powerful motivation the team draws from having the country behind them, stating, 'The support people have for sporting events in this country now is better than anyone's in the world.' He stressed that the team's performances at the World Cup could have a significant impact on national morale, potentially inspiring even more people to take up rugby. England has not won the World Cup since defeating then-hosts Australia in 2003 and is aiming to repeat that success. Lancaster emphasized, 'For seven weeks of our lives we will put everything aside and stay completely focused on one goal: winning the World Cup.' 'There will be challenges along the way, but when we kick off on September 18, 2015, I'm confident no stone will have been left unturned. We'll ensure we are ready to deliver.' England has twelve matches before facing Fiji to prepare and put themselves in the best position possible, hoping to emulate Martin Johnson's 2003 champions. Lancaster says he has worked hard to instill a deep sense of national pride and purpose among his players. 'We've put a lot of emphasis on what it means to be English,' he commented. 'To be an England player, you have to have character and a strong sense of purpose. You can never back down and must always perform under pressure. The level of commitment needed goes above and beyond what most would expect.' Lancaster added, 'Alongside that, you need world-class players who can produce the moments that set them apart.'

Zatiaľ čo obhajca titulu Nový Zéland je jasným favoritom, Lancaster trvá na tom, že Angličania urobia maximum, aby ich vyzvali. Lancaster zdôraznil silnú motiváciu, ktorú tím čerpá zo silnej podpory domáceho publika, keď povedal: 'Podpora, ktorú ľudia v tejto krajine dávajú športovým udalostiam, je teraz lepšia než kdekoľvek inde na svete.' Anglicko naposledy vyhralo majstrovstvá v roku 2003, keď porazilo vtedajšieho hostiteľa Austráliu, a teraz sa snaží tento úspech zopakovať. Lancaster dodal: 'Okrem toho potrebujete aj svetových hráčov, ktorí vedia ukázať tie výnimočné momenty.'

article_content: Russian President Vladimir Putin is reportedly considering reviving an old agreement with Iran that could see the transfer of advanced missile systems and the construction of a second nuclear reactor. The proposal will likely be on the agenda when Putin and Iran’s President Hassan Rowhani meet for the first time on Friday. If completed, the deal would provide Iran with five S-300 surface-to-air missile systems—capable of bringing down aircraft and guided missiles—worth about $800 million. This renewed offer, as reported by the Russian newspaper Kommersant and sourced from the Kremlin, also involves Russia aiding Iran in expanding the Bushehr nuclear plant with a second reactor. However, the proposed arms delivery is conditional: Iran would need to drop a $4 billion lawsuit against Russia that it filed in an international court in Geneva after a previously canceled arms agreement. Putin’s spokesperson, Dmitry Peskov, told Kommersant that the upcoming summit in Bishkek will focus on nuclear cooperation and military-technical ties between the nations. The suggested renewal of the weapons deal is expected to anger both the U.S. and Israel, who, through intense diplomacy, persuaded then-president Dmitry Medvedev to halt the original transaction in 2010. This development comes at a sensitive time, as Russia has just eased tensions with the U.S. following discussions about the crisis in Syria during the recent G20 summit in Moscow. Iran remains a steadfast supporter of Syrian President Bashar Al Assad, echoing Russia’s call for diplomatic solutions and dismissing military intervention, while its Qods force commander, Qassem Soleimani, has vowed unwavering support for Syria. Should Russia move forward with building a new reactor at Bushehr, it is likely to face criticism from the international community. Iran’s only functioning nuclear facility, built by Russia, became operational in 2011 despite incidents such as the Stuxnet cyberattack. Despite Tehran’s claims that its nuclear pursuits are purely for energy production, skepticism from Western nations persists.

Tento návrh by mal byť témou prvého stretnutia Putina s iránskym prezidentom Hassanom Rowhanim, ktoré sa uskutoční v piatok. Ak dôjde k uzavretiu dohody, Irán by získal päť protileteckých raketových systémov S-300 – schopných zostreliť lietadlá aj navádzané rakety – v hodnote približne 800 miliónov dolárov. Ako uvádza ruský denník Kommersant s odvolaním sa na Kremeľ, súčasťou obnoveného návrhu je aj ruská pomoc pri rozšírení jadrovej elektrárne v Bušehri o druhý reaktor. Dodávka zbraní je však podmienená: Irán by musel stiahnuť svoju žalobu vo výške 4 miliárd dolárov, ktorú voči Rusku podal na medzinárodnom súde v Ženeve po zrušení predchádzajúcej zbrojnej dohody. Putinov hovorca Dmitrij Peskov pre Kommersant uviedol, že pripravovaný summit v Biškeku sa bude zaoberať jadrovou spoluprácou a vojensko-technickými vzťahmi medzi oboma krajinami. Očakáva sa, že obnovenie zbrojárskej dohody pobúri Spojené štáty a Izrael, ktoré v roku 2010 intenzívnou diplomaciou presvedčili vtedajšieho prezidenta Dmitrija Medvedeva, aby pôvodnú dohodu zastavil. Tento krok prichádza v citlivom období – Rusko nedávno upokojilo napätie so Spojenými štátmi po diskusiách o sýrskej kríze na G20 v Moskve. Irán zostáva pevným spojencom sýrskeho prezidenta Baššára Al Asada, opakuje ruské výzvy na diplomatické riešenia a odmieta vojenský zásah, pričom veliteľ jeho jednotky Kuds, Qassem Soleimani, prisľúbil Sýrii neochvejnú podporu. Ak Rusko pristúpi k výstavbe nového reaktora v Bušehri, pravdepodobne čelí medzinárodnej kritike. Jediná iránska funkčná jadrová elektráreň, ktorú postavilo Rusko, začala fungovať v roku 2011 napriek incidentom, ako bol kybernetický útok Stuxnet. Napriek tvrdeniam Teheránu, že jadrový program slúži len na výrobu energie, západné krajiny zostávajú nedôverčivé.

article_content: Former Super Eagles midfielder Dimeji Lawal has expressed confidence that Nigeria's national team has the potential to win the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) in Ivory Coast. Speaking as a special guest at an ex-University of Ibadan FA virtual interactive program, Lawal shared his views on the team's prospects. Nigeria's Super Eagles have been drawn in Group A alongside hosts Ivory Coast, Equatorial Guinea, and Guinea-Bissau for the 36th edition of AFCON, which took place between January 13 and February 11, 2024, across five cities. In their quest for a fourth AFCON title, the Eagles will face Equatorial Guinea in their opening match on January 13 in Abidjan. Lawal, a U-17 and U-20 World Cup silver medallist and former Real Madrid B player, stated, “Nigeria will be the team to beat at the next CAF Nations Cup. I have no doubt about that. We have a generation of young African talents excelling in various top European clubs. They are young and gaining experience playing with and against top players every week.” He added, “Despite the wealth of talent within the Super Eagles, these players have yet to win significant trophies for the country, although some enjoy success with their clubs. I believe this will motivate them to make their mark as the new stars of Nigerian football.” With just 71 days before the tournament, Lawal cautioned against further experimentation with the squad. He said, “My advice to the technical crew is simple: the time for trials should be over. We've had enough testing. Now is the moment to build a solid team with cohesion and understanding. Right now, it feels like we don't have a stable squad, which isn't ideal for our football.” Lawal also emphasized the importance of having a consistent starting eleven, noting, “I know the first 11 of Germany, England, Spain, Netherlands, and France—unless there are injuries or other unforeseen issues. Our coaching staff keeps searching for new players born abroad every day, but that has to stop. The focus should be on building team chemistry.”

Ako špeciálny hosť na virtuálnom interaktívnom programe bývalých členov FA Univerzity v Ibadan Lawal predniesol svoj pohľad na šance tímu. Nigérijský tím Super Eagles bol vylosovaný do skupiny A spolu s domácim Pobrežím Slonoviny, Rovníkovou Guineou a Guineou-Bissau v rámci 36. ročníka AFCON, ktorý sa konal od 13. januára do 11. februára 2024 v piatich mestách. V snahe získať svoj štvrtý titul z AFCON odohrajú Orly svoj úvodný zápas proti Rovníkovej Guinei 13. januára v Abidjane. Lawal, strieborný medailista z MS do 17 a do 20 rokov a bývalý hráč Real Madrid B, uviedol: „Nigéria bude tímom, ktorý bude na ďalšom pohári CAF potrebné poraziť. O tom vôbec nepochybujem. Máme generáciu mladých afrických talentov, ktorí sa presadzujú v najlepších európskych kluboch. Sú mladí a pravidelne hrávajú proti špičkovým hráčom.” Dodal: „Napriek veľkému talentu v Super Eagles títo hráči zatiaľ nevyhrali pre krajinu žiadne významné trofeje, hoci sú úspešní v kluboch. Myslím si, že to ich bude motivovať presadiť sa ako nové hviezdy nigérijského futbalu.” Len 71 dní pred turnajom Lawal varoval pred ďalším experimentovaním so zostavou. Povedal: „Moja rada pre realizačný tím je jednoduchá: čas na skúšanie skončil. Testov sme mali dosť. Teraz je čas vybudovať pevnú zostavu so súhrou a porozumením. Náš realizačný tím hľadá stále nových hráčov narodených v zahraničí, no s tým by sa malo prestať. Dôraz má byť na budovaní tímovej chémie.”

Dana Carvey, celebrated for his work on Saturday Night Live, has announced the passing of his son Dex Carvey, 32, from an accidental drug overdose. In a heartfelt statement posted on Instagram, Dana and his wife, Paula Zwagerman, called the event a 'terrible tragedy' that occurred on Wednesday night and said, 'We will miss him forever.' Dana also posted a photo of himself and Dex working together, describing those moments as 'a joy.'

Dex was talented in many areas, including music, art, filmmaking, and comedy, and he pursued these interests passionately. He appeared alongside his father in several TV series, such as The Funster and Beyond the Comics, and opened Dana's 2016 TV comedy special, 'Straight White Male, 60.'

Dex is survived by his younger brother, Thomas, 30, and his girlfriend, Kaylee. The Carvey family described Dex as someone who 'made everything fun' and deeply loved his family, friends, and girlfriend. Dana shared that Dex's handmade birthday cards are treasured keepsakes.

The family offered support in their statement to anyone struggling with addiction, writing, 'You are in our hearts and prayers.'

Fans and public figures responded with heartfelt messages on social media, expressing sympathy for the family's loss and recognizing Dex's vibrant legacy. Dana Carvey remains recognized for his Emmy-winning work on Saturday Night Live in 1993.

V dojímavom vyhlásení na Instagrame spolu s manželkou Paulou Zwagerman nazvali túto udalosť „strašnou tragédiou“, ktorá sa odohrala v stredu večer, a dodali: „Navždy nám bude chýbať.“ Dana zverejnil aj ich spoločnú fotografiu z pracovného prostredia a tieto chvíle opísal ako „radosť“.

Dexa prežil jeho mladší brat Thomas (30) a priateľka Kaylee. Rodina Dexa opísala ako človeka, ktorý „zo všetkého robil zábavu“ a hlboko miloval svoju rodinu, priateľov i priateľku. Dana tiež zdôraznil, že Dexove ručne robené narodeninové pohľadnice zostanú vzácnou pamiatkou.

article_content: Britain's most famous warship, HMS Victory, is set to undergo a major, multi-million pound restoration to preserve it for future generations. First launched in 1765, HMS Victory gained fame as Admiral Lord Nelson's flagship during the Battle of Trafalgar in 1805—a decisive victory for the British over French and Spanish forces, which further established Britain's naval dominance in the 18th century. A total of £50 million has been allocated to refit HMS Victory. The upcoming maintenance will be the largest ever undertaken for a historic warship and will involve building a new dry dock cradle and ensuring her top deck is watertight. Andrew Baines, curator at the National Museum of the Royal Navy and project director for HMS Victory, described the restoration as possibly the last opportunity to truly save the ship and preserve important historic material. The need for restoration became clear after a £550,000 survey provided conservationists with detailed 3D images, revealing that Victory's keel had dropped by about half a centimetre annually due to water damage. The previous major conservation project began in 1955 and wasn't finished until 2002. In 2012, £50 million was set aside for the HMS Victory Preservation Trust, with funding split equally between the Sir Donald Gosling Foundation and the Ministry of Defence. During the Battle of Trafalgar, HMS Victory led 27 British ships against 33 French and Spanish vessels. The Franco-Spanish fleet lost 22 ships, while the British did not lose a single ship. The battle is often seen as confirmation of Britain's naval supremacy, in part due to Nelson's innovative tactics. During the battle, Lord Nelson divided his smaller force into two columns and attacked the larger enemy fleet. This led to a decisive victory, with Admiral Villeneuve, commander of the Franco-Spanish fleet, captured along with his ship Bucentaure. Although Nelson secured one of Britain's greatest naval victories, he was fatally wounded by a French marksman on Victory's deck. His body was returned to England and he was given a state funeral, solidifying his status as a national hero. Numerous monuments, including Nelson's Column in Trafalgar Square, honor his memory. HMS Victory has been in dry dock since 1922 and has welcomed over 25 million visitors. Portsmouth Historic Dockyard aims to keep Victory open to the public, unlike the Mary Rose, which is closed off. Launched in 1765 at a cost of £63,176—comparable to the cost of building a modern aircraft carrier—Victory was constructed from 6,000 trees, mostly oak, representing around 100 acres of woodland. She carries 37 sails on three masts, with a total sail area of 6,510 square yards, and could reach speeds of up to 11 knots (12 mph). Victory's battle history includes action at the First and Second Battles of Ushant, the Battle of Cape St Vincent, and service as a hospital ship. She is best known for her crucial role in the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar, leading to a British victory but resulting in Nelson's death. In 1903, Victory was accidentally rammed and damaged by HMS Neptune, with repairs completed in 1928. She was also damaged during a bombing raid in 1941, which led to another lengthy restoration from 1955 to 2002. The ship came under the National Museum of the Royal Navy in 2012 and currently serves as the flagship of the Second Sea Lord, remaining the oldest naval ship still in commission and is, in theory, able to sail if required.
translated_content: Najznámejšia britská vojnová loď HMS Victory sa chystá na veľkú, viacmiliónovú obnovu, aby bola zachovaná pre budúce generácie. HMS Victory bola spustená na vodu v roku 1765 a stala sa známou ako vlajková loď admirála lorda Nelsona v bitke pri Trafalgare v roku 1805 – rozhodujúcom víťazstve Britov nad francúzskymi a španielskymi silami, čo ešte viac upevnilo britskú námornú dominanciu v 18. storočí. Na rekonštrukciu HMS Victory bolo vyčlenených celkom 50 miliónov libier. Nadchádzajúca údržba bude najväčšou, aká bola kedy vykonaná na historickej vojnovej lodi, a bude zahŕňať výstavbu nového suchého doku a zaistenie, aby horná paluba bola vodotesná. Andrew Baines, kurátor v Národnom múzeu kráľovského námorníctva a projektový riaditeľ lode HMS Victory, označil rekonštrukciu za možno poslednú šancu skutočne loď zachrániť a uchovať dôležité historické pozostatky. Potreba obnovy sa ukázala po prieskume v hodnote 550 000 libier, ktorý poskytol konzervátorom podrobné 3D snímky a odhalil, že kýl lode Victory klesal približne o pol centimetra ročne kvôli poškodeniu vodou. Predchádzajúci veľký projekt konzervácie začal v roku 1955 a skončil až v roku 2002. V roku 2012 bolo na fond HMS Victory Preservation Trust vyčlenených 50 miliónov libier, pričom financovanie bolo rozdelené rovným dielom medzi nadáciu Sir Donald Gosling Foundation a Ministerstvo obrany. Počas bitky pri Trafalgare viedla HMS Victory 27 britských lodí proti 33 francúzskym a španielskym plavidlám. Francúzsko-španielska flotila stratila 22 lodí, kým Briti neprišli ani o jednu. Táto bitka je často vnímaná ako potvrdenie britskej námornej nadvlády, čiastočne vďaka Nelsonovej inovatívnej taktike. Počas bitky rozdelil lord Nelson svoju menšiu silu do dvoch kolón a zaútočil na väčšiu nepriateľskú flotilu. To viedlo k rozhodujúcemu víťazstvu, pričom admirál Villeneuve, veliteľ francúzsko-španielskej flotily, bol zajatý spolu so svojou loďou Bucentaure. Aj keď Nelson dosiahol jedno z najväčších britských námorných víťazstiev, bol smrteľne zranený francúzskym strelcom na palube Victory. Jeho telo bolo prevezené späť do Anglicka, kde mu vystrojili štátny pohreb, čím sa stal národným hrdinom. Na jeho počesť vzniklo mnoho pamätníkov, vrátane Nelsonovho stĺpa na Trafalgarskom námestí. HMS Victory je v suchom doku od roku 1922 a privítala už viac ako 25 miliónov návštevníkov. Portsmouth Historic Dockyard má za cieľ ponechať Victory prístupnú verejnosti na rozdiel od lode Mary Rose, ktorá je uzavretá. Loď bola spustená na vodu v roku 1765 za cenu 63 176 libier – podobnú sume, akú dnes stojí stavba modernej lietadlovej lode. Victory bola postavená zo 6 000 stromov, prevažne duba, čo predstavuje asi 100 akrov lesa. Nesie 37 plachiet na troch stožiaroch s celkovou plochou 6 510 štvorcových yardov a mohla dosiahnuť rýchlosť až 11 uzlov (12 míľ za hodinu). Vojnová história lode Victory zahŕňa nasadenie v prvej a druhej bitke pri Ushante, v bitke pri Cape St Vincent a tiež službu ako nemocničná loď. Najviac ju však preslávila rozhodujúca úloha v bitke pri Trafalgare v roku 1805, ktorá znamenala britské víťazstvo a zároveň Nelsonovu smrť. V roku 1903 bola Victory náhodne nabúraná a poškodená loďou HMS Neptune, pričom opravy boli dokončené v roku 1928. Bola poškodená aj počas bombardovania v roku 1941, kvôli čomu bola zahájená ďalšia rozsiahla rekonštrukcia, ktorá sa natiahla od roku 1955 do 2002. V roku 2012 bola loď pridelená Národnému múzeu kráľovského námorníctva a v súčasnosti je vlajkovou loďou Second Sea Lorda. Stále je najstaršou vojenskou loďou v aktívnej službe a v teórii by mohla vyplávať, keby bolo treba.

article_content: Ceredigion County Council has agreed to provide up to £150,000 to support filming the second series of the BBC police drama 'Hinterland' in the town of Aberystwyth, despite recent budget cuts including the removal of funding for CCTV cameras. Earlier this month, it was announced that the council was cutting all funding for surveillance cameras as part of efforts to save £9.6 million. The council stated that it would only provide the funding for 'Hinterland' if an application for a European Grant to support the production is rejected. The first series of 'Hinterland', starring Richard Harrington as DCI Tom Mathias, was filmed in Aberystwyth in 2013. According to a study by ARAD Research, the series brought economic benefits to the local area, estimated at just over £1 million. An English-language version of the crime drama was broadcast on the BBC, while a Welsh-language version aired on SC4, together attracting approximately 500,000 viewers. Residents and representatives from the Taxpayers Alliance have criticized the council’s decision, calling it 'totally inappropriate' in light of recent public service cuts. Other recently announced cuts include a £150,000 reduction to CCTV, the cancellation of £44,000 in funding for a local swimming pool, an £80,000 reduction to road gritting services, and the closure of two libraries. The council, however, maintains that underwriting the filming of 'Hinterland' will provide substantial economic gains and help support the local economy. A spokesperson noted that if the European Grant is fully approved, the council’s promised funding will not be required.
translated_content: Rada okresu Ceredigion súhlasila s poskytnutím až 150 000 libier na podporu natáčania druhej série policajnej drámy BBC 'Hinterland' v meste Aberystwyth, napriek nedávnym rozpočtovým škrtom vrátane zrušenia financovania kamerového systému. Začiatkom tohto mesiaca bolo oznámené, že rada ruší všetko financovanie monitorovacích kamier v rámci snahy ušetriť 9,6 milióna libier. Rada uviedla, že financovanie 'Hinterlandu' poskytne len v prípade, že žiadosť o európsky grant na podporu produkcie bude zamietnutá. Prvá séria 'Hinterland', v ktorej hlavnú úlohu DCI Toma Mathiasa stvárnil Richard Harrington, sa natáčala v Aberystwyth v roku 2013. Podľa štúdie od ARAD Research vtedy séria priniesla miestnej oblasti ekonomické výhody odhadované na viac ako 1 milión libier. Anglickú verziu kriminálneho seriálu vysielala BBC, zatiaľ čo welšská verzia išla na SC4; spolu ich sledovalo približne 500 000 divákov. Obyvatelia a zástupcovia organizácie Taxpayers Alliance rozhodnutie rady kritizovali a označili ho za 'úplne nevhodné' vzhľadom na nedávne škrty vo verejných službách. Ďalšie nedávno oznámené škrty zahŕňajú zníženie rozpočtu na kamerový systém o 150 000 libier, zrušenie 44 000 libier na miestny plavecký bazén, zníženie 80 000 libier na zimnú údržbu ciest a zatvorenie dvoch knižníc. Rada však trvá na tom, že podporenie natáčania 'Hinterlandu' prinesie významné ekonomické výhody a pomôže miestnej ekonomike. Hovorca rady uviedol, že ak bude európsky grant schválený v plnom rozsahu, financie prisľúbené radou nebudú potrebné.

article_content: The potential impact of climate change on London's future is a topic of significant debate. While some experts predict minimal effects, others foresee scenes of devastation. Now, artists have envisioned how London’s landmarks might appear in a hundred years or more. Their images feature soldiers riding camels at Horse Guards Parade, futuristic flying cars over the City, a giant lily pond at Piccadilly Circus, and the Houses of Parliament marooned in water. Depending on the scenario, global warming could ravage London in different ways—either flooding parts of the city or transforming it into a desert-like wasteland. Some illustrations show Piccadilly Circus underwater with wind turbines generating power, while others suggest a much hotter London, complete with camels at Horse Guards Parade. In one image, London appears more high-tech than ever, filled with skyscrapers, hovering cars, and zeppelins. The dense cityscape is lit with an electric glow, with little sign of nature visible. These realistic mock-ups were created by the future forecasting company GMJ and consider approved planning applications across London. A survey commissioned by The View from The Shard found that about five million Londoners believe the capital will eventually be flooded. Some think Westminster could end up partially underwater, resembling Venice, with politicians possibly commuting by boat. The same survey shows that 29% of Britons (and 38% of Londoners) think the city will be unrecognizable by 2030, and 20% of Londoners believe London would be better off as its own country. While new skyscrapers are planned—including Canaletto and 52 Lime Street—80% of respondents are concerned about shrinking green spaces, and 60% want to see more bicycles instead of futuristic cars. Predictions for 2030 also include free Wi-Fi everywhere and a move away from paper money towards mobile payments. At The Shard, an exhibition allows visitors to look into the future using interactive 'tellscopes.' These devices juxtapose images from the Museum of London’s archive, spanning Roman times to the present, and with projections for 2030. A series of upcoming events called ‘London As I See It’ will feature experts from architecture, engineering, and literature discussing how London might look in 30 years. Clive Stephens, CEO of The View from The Shard, said there's no better place to consider the city's future than from such a high vantage point. GMJ emphasizes that its initiative aims to engage the public and developers in shaping the next evolution of London's skyline. The ‘Future View from The Shard Report’ explores topics from transport to climate change, architecture, and politics. Results indicate a desire for more green spaces, greater cycling infrastructure, and public curiosity about technological change. Controversially, over five million people in the UK believe the monarchy will not exist in 15 years, and one in ten think London could become waterlogged like Venice. One artist’s rendition shows Westminster partially underwater, as seen from Waterloo Bridge in 2030.

article_content: Taylor Farms Retail, which is based in California, has issued a voluntary recall for more than 3,200 cases of its packaged salad blends due to possible salmonella contamination. This action comes after the Washington State Department of Agriculture detected salmonella in a random sample of packaged spinach during routine testing. The Food and Drug Administration reports that so far, no illnesses have been linked to these salads. The affected products were shipped to retail stores across several U.S. states, including Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Kentucky, Missouri, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Washington, and Puerto Rico. The recall covers brands such as Fresh Selections, H-E-B, Marketside, and Taylor Farms, with 'best by' dates from October 18 to October 21. Salmonella infections can seriously impact health, especially in young children, older adults, or those with weakened immune systems. Symptoms generally include fever, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and sometimes bloody diarrhea. In rare instances, salmonella can spread into the bloodstream and cause further, more dangerous complications.

Podľa Správy pre potraviny a liečivá zatiaľ neboli zaznamenané žiadne ochorenia spojené s týmito šalátmi. Dotknuté výrobky boli distribuované do obchodov v štátoch Arizona, Kalifornia, Colorado, Florida, Kentucky, Missouri, Nové Mexiko, New York, Severná Karolína, Oregon, Južná Karolína, Texas, Virgínia, Washington a Portoriko. Stiahnutie sa týka značiek Fresh Selections, H-E-B, Marketside a Taylor Farms s dátumom spotreby od 18. do 21. októbra. Infekcia salmonelou môže byť obzvlášť nebezpečná pre malé deti, starších ľudí alebo osoby s oslabenou imunitou. Medzi príznaky patrí horúčka, nevoľnosť, vracanie, bolesti brucha a v niektorých prípadoch krvavá hnačka. V zriedkavých situáciách sa môže infekcia rozšíriť do krvi a spôsobiť vážne komplikácie.

article_content: Bob Odenkirk, best known for his roles in television and comedy, joined forces with his daughter Erin to publish their long-awaited project, 'Zilot & Other Important Rhymes.' The idea traces back to lighthearted poems they wrote together when she and her brother were children. Odenkirk once thought these poems would only be published later in his life, but the COVID-19 lockdown of 2020 brought the family together and gave them the chance to bring the book to fruition. During remote studies at Pratt Institute, Erin transformed her bedroom into a workspace covered with her father's poems, drawing inspiration for whimsical illustrations. Both Odenkirk and Erin fondly recall their teamwork, though they acknowledge facing some creative disagreements along the way. Ultimately, working together made their bond even stronger. The book’s title, inspired by a childhood word invented by Erin’s brother meaning 'fort,' reflects the poetry’s spirit. The content isn’t afraid to tackle subjects like bacteria and climate change, echoing Odenkirk’s belief in challenging young readers with advanced words and ideas so they can learn and grow without worrying about mistakes. Odenkirk is not only recognized for dramatic performances in ‘Breaking Bad’ and ‘Better Call Saul’ but also for his comedy writing and acting on shows like ‘Saturday Night Live.’ He’s been an active Writers Guild of America member for decades, participating in recent industry strikes for fair worker treatment. While Odenkirk encourages his kids to follow creative paths, he notes the unpredictability of artistic careers. Erin, now working as an artist in Brooklyn after graduating, appreciates her father’s support but admits that growing up amid strong creative opinions sometimes made carving out her own artistic identity challenging. Odenkirk believes that children raised in creative environments, especially in Hollywood, tend to develop a realistic understanding of both the rewards and difficulties of the industry.

Myšlienka na túto knihu vznikla už v detstve jeho detí, keď spolu písali hravé básne. Odenkirk si pôvodne myslel, že ich vydá až neskôr v živote, no lockdown počas pandémie COVID-19 v roku 2020 ich priviedol pod jednu strechu a umožnil im knihu dokončiť. Počas dištančného štúdia na Pratt Institute Erin premenila svoju izbu na pracovný priestor s básňami od otca, ktoré ju inšpirovali k tvorbe hravých ilustrácií. Obaja s láskou spomínajú na spoločnú prácu, aj keď priznávajú, že sa pri tvorbe občas pohádali. Napokon spoločná práca ich vzťah ešte viac utužila. Odenkirk je známy nielen dramatickými úlohami v seriáloch 'Breaking Bad' a 'Better Call Saul', ale aj komediálnou tvorbou a herectvom v reláciách ako ‘Saturday Night Live.’ Je dlhoročným členom Cechu amerických scenáristov (WGA) a zapojil sa do nedávnych štrajkov za spravodlivé podmienky v priemysle. Aj keď Odenkirk podporuje svoje deti v ich umeleckých ambíciách, otvorene pripúšťa, že je to náročná cesta. Odenkirk verí, že deti vyrastajúce v tvorivom prostredí – najmä v Hollywoode – majú realistickejší pohľad na plusy aj mínusy umeleckej kariéry.

article_content:
Former cycling champion Lance Armstrong has been seen in public for the first time following his widely viewed confession about using performance-enhancing drugs, which he gave in an interview with Oprah Winfrey last week. Armstrong, 41, was spotted in Hawaii at an airport, accompanied by his girlfriend Anna Hansen, 31, and their two young children, Maxwell, 3, and Olivia, 2. Trying to maintain a low profile, Armstrong wore sunglasses and a baseball cap as he boarded a private plane, while Hansen appeared relaxed and smiling. The family is believed to have been staying in a private home in Kona, Hawaii, amid growing scrutiny over Armstrong’s history with doping.

Armstrong was stripped of his seven Tour de France titles after admitting to using banned substances during each of his victories from 1999 to 2005. He stated in his television interview that his drug use ceased after his final win in 2005. However, the head of the World Anti-Doping Agency, John Fahey, disputed this claim, citing evidence from the U.S. Anti-Doping Agency suggesting Armstrong continued to dope beyond 2005.

During the interview, Armstrong expressed regret, acknowledging that his repeated denials contributed to a false narrative around his career. "I didn't invent the culture, but I didn't try to stop the culture and that's my mistake. The sport is now paying the price for that, and I am sorry," he said.

In the aftermath of his admission, two California men, Rob Stutzman and Jonathan Wheeler, have filed a lawsuit against Armstrong and his publishers, Penguin and Random House. They claim Armstrong's bestselling memoirs, 'It's Not About the Bike' and 'Every Second Counts,' were sold as non-fiction but are now known to contain falsehoods due to his confession. They are seeking damages for what they describe as deceptive advertising and fraud. Legal experts suggest the publishers may try to dismiss the case, referencing a similar lawsuit involving another author.

Additionally, a library in Sydney, Australia, humorously relocated Armstrong’s books to the fiction section following the scandal. The head librarian clarified this act was a joke initiated by a staff member, not an official library statement. Armstrong currently faces various legal battles, including cases from SCA Promotions and The Sunday Times, seeking the return of financial bonuses and damages.

Armstrong’s situation has led to continued debate over the legacy of his cycling achievements and the broader culture of doping in professional sports.

Armstronga (41) videli na letisku na Havaji spolu s priateľkou Annou Hansenovou (31) a ich dvoma malými deťmi, Maxwellom (3) a Oliviou (2). Armstronga zbavili siedmich titulov Tour de France po tom, čo priznal užívanie zakázaných látok počas všetkých svojich víťazstiev v rokoch 1999 – 2005. V televíznom rozhovore tvrdil, že prestal s dopingom po poslednom víťazstve v roku 2005, no šéf Svetovej antidopingovej agentúry John Fahey tento výrok spochybnil s odvolaním sa na dôkazy Americkej antidopingovej agentúry, ktoré naznačujú, že s dopingom pokračoval aj po roku 2005.

V rozhovore Armstrong vyjadril ľútosť a priznal, že jeho opakované popierania prispeli k nepravdivému obrazu jeho kariéry. „Nevymyslel som túto kultúru, ale nesnažil som sa ju zastaviť, a to bola moja chyba. Šport za to platí a je mi to ľúto,“ uviedol.

Po jeho priznaní zažalovali dvaja Kalifornčania Rob Stutzman a Jonathan Wheeler Armstronga a jeho vydavateľstvá Penguin a Random House. Tvrdia, že Armstrongove bestsellerové memoáre „Nie je to o bicykli“ a „Každá sekunda sa počíta“ boli predávané ako literatúra faktu, no po priznaní je jasné, že obsahujú nepravdivé informácie. Žiadajú kompenzácie za klamlivú reklamu a podvod. Právni experti očakávajú, že vydavateľstvá sa budú snažiť žalobu zamietnuť s odvolaním na podobný predchádzajúci prípad.

Navyše, knižnica v Sydney v Austrálii žartovne presunula Armstrongove knihy do sekcie beletrie. Hlavná knihovníčka vysvetlila, že to bol vtip jednej zamestnankyne a nejde o oficiálne stanovisko knižnice. Armstrong v súčasnosti čelí viacerým súdnym sporom, vrátane prípadov od SCA Promotions a The Sunday Times, ktorí žiadajú vrátenie finančných odmien a odškodné.

Prípad Armstrong opakovane otvára diskusie o dedičstve jeho cyklistických úspechov a širšom probléme dopingu v profesionálnom športe.

Elon Musk stated that Starlink satellite internet may be made available to aid organizations in Gaza, after a large-scale communications blackout there late Friday. The blackout followed intense Israeli bombardments and ground operations in the region, which led to internet and cellular service failures. As a result, emergency services like the 101 hotline could not be reached, making it impossible for ambulances to respond, and many journalists and aid workers lost contact, according to reports from outlets such as The Guardian.

Israel's communications minister, Shlomo Karhi, publicly opposed Musk’s offer, arguing that providing Starlink could benefit Hamas and warning that Israel would take action against such plans. Karhi suggested that any aid should be made conditional on the release of Israeli hostages.

Democratic Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez criticized the loss of telecommunications in Gaza, labeling it as 'unacceptable.' Musk subsequently clarified that Starlink would assist internationally recognized aid organizations in the region. However, there is currently no official evidence that Starlink services or hardware have reached Gaza, as noted by The Wall Street Journal.

TechCrunch has reported prior discussions between Israeli officials and SpaceX about possible use of Starlink in areas bordering conflict zones. Musk’s handling of Starlink during the war in Ukraine has previously led to debate, especially following allegations that he blocked internet access during a Ukrainian military operation in Crimea.

Mark Regev, a senior advisor to the Israeli prime minister, explained to BBC Radio 4 that cutting off enemy communications is standard procedure during military campaigns. He emphasized that a full briefing from Israel’s military was necessary to explain the current situation in Gaza.

Elon Musk uviedol, že satelitný internet Starlink by mohol byť poskytnutý humanitárnym organizáciám v Gaze po rozsiahlej výluke komunikácie v oblasti v piatok večer. K výpadku došlo po intenzívnom bombardovaní a pozemných operáciách izraelskej armády, čo viedlo k výpadkom internetu a mobilných služieb. Výsledkom bolo, že tiesňové linky ako 101 neboli dostupné, sanitky nemohli reagovať a mnohí novinári a pracovníci humanitárnej pomoci stratili kontakt, ako uviedli médiá vrátane The Guardian.

Izraelský minister komunikácií Shlomo Karhi verejne odmietol Muskovo ponuku, tvrdil, že poskytovanie Starlinku by mohlo prospieť Hamasu a varoval, že Izrael bude proti takýmto plánom konať. Karhi navrhol, že akákoľvek pomoc by mala byť podmienená prepustením izraelských rukojemníkov.

Demokratická kongresmanka Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez kritizovala stratu telekomunikačných služieb v Gaze a označila ju za 'neprijateľnú.' Musk následne upresnil, že Starlink bude podporovať medzinárodne uznávané humanitárne organizácie v regióne. Momentálne však neexistuje žiadny oficiálny dôkaz, že by služby alebo zariadenia Starlinku boli už v Gaze, ako poznamenal The Wall Street Journal.

Podľa TechCrunch už prebiehali predchádzajúce rokovania medzi izraelskými predstaviteľmi a SpaceX o možnom využití Starlinku v oblastiach susediacich s konfliktnými zónami. Muskovo riadenie služby Starlink počas vojny na Ukrajine v minulosti vyvolalo diskusie, najmä po obvineniach, že počas ukrajinskej vojenskej operácie na Kryme zablokoval prístup k internetu.

Mark Regev, hlavný poradca izraelského premiéra, v BBC Radio 4 vysvetlil, že prerušenie komunikácie protivníka je bežná prax počas vojenských kampaní. Zdôraznil, že je potrebné počkať na oficiálne stanovisko izraelskej armády, ktorá má objasniť aktuálny stav v Gaze.

article_content: Ola Brunkert, a percussionist who played with the iconic Swedish pop group ABBA, has died in an accident at his residence in Mallorca, Spain. Authorities revealed that Brunkert was discovered Sunday evening at his home in the town of Arta. Investigators believe he stumbled into a glass wall separating his kitchen and garden, which shattered and resulted in a fatal wound to his neck. Brunkert was found in his garden and it is thought he died from blood loss. The official cause of death will be determined after an autopsy. Born in Sweden in 1946, Brunkert contributed drums to ABBA’s very first single, 'People Need Love.' Although he wasn’t among the group’s four main members who appeared on album covers—Anni-Frid Lyngstad, Bjorn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson, and Agnetha Faltskog—Brunkert was a vital part of their sound. He toured the world with the band in the late 1970s, and alongside bass player Rutger Gunnarsson, is believed to have performed on every ABBA album. During the 1970s, Brunkert was known as one of Sweden’s busiest session musicians.

Podľa úradov bol Brunkert nájdený v nedeľu večer vo svojom dome v meste Arta. Vyšetrovatelia predpokladajú, že spadol do sklenenej steny oddeľujúcej kuchyňu od záhrady, ktorá sa rozbila a smrteľne ho porezala na krku. Brunkerta našli v záhrade a predpokladá sa, že zomrel na vykrvácanie. Oficiálna príčina smrti bude stanovená po pitve. Brunkert, narodený vo Švédsku v roku 1946, prispel hrou na bicie k prvej nahrávke skupiny ABBA, 'People Need Love.' Aj keď nepatril medzi štyroch hlavných členov skupiny — Anni-Frid Lyngstad, Bjorn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson a Agnetha Faltskog — bol neoddeliteľnou súčasťou kapely. V 70. rokoch absolvoval turné s ABBou po celom svete. Spolu s basgitaristom Rutgerom Gunnarssonom je pravdepodobne jediným hudobníkom, ktorý účinkoval na každom albume skupiny. V 70. rokoch patril medzi najvyťaženejších švédskych štúdiových hudobníkov.
