article_content: A few days ahead of Chhattisgarh's second phase of assembly voting, Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma publicly hailed Prime Minister Narendra Modi, describing him as not just India's leader, but 'the most popular leader globally.' During a rally in Gariaband, Sarma pointed out that Modi is shown great respect wherever he travels, including in the US. He credited Modi’s worldwide popularity to his reputation for fulfilling promises, noting the widespread use of the slogan, 'If Modi is there, it’s possible.' Sarma claimed that this message is heard all across India. The Chhattisgarh elections are being held in two stages: the first, involving 20 seats, finished on November 7, with the remaining 70 seats to be contested on November 17.

article_content: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh on Sunday alleged that the Covid-19 lockdown was delayed to facilitate the fall of the Kamal Nath-led Congress government in Madhya Pradesh. The state government collapsed in March 2020 after a rebellion by several MLAs loyal to Jyotiraditya Scindia, paving the way for Shivraj Singh Chouhan of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) to return as Chief Minister. The nationwide lockdown was imposed by the central government in late March 2020. Ramesh claimed at a press conference that the delay allowed for political maneuvering, calling it a conspiracy to unseat the Congress government. He accused some party members of betrayal, stating, 'There is no dearth of traitors.' Ramesh asserted that people in Madhya Pradesh are dissatisfied with the BJP's governance. With Assembly polls scheduled for November 17, he expressed confidence that Congress will return to power. Congress has announced 12 'guarantees' for the Madhya Pradesh elections, including an LPG cylinder at Rs 500, Rs 1,500 per month for women, loan waivers for farmers up to Rs 2 lakh, restoration of the old pension scheme for government employees, minimum support price (MSP) for farmers, stipends for unemployed youth, and scholarships for students. He pointed out that similar promises were fulfilled by the Congress government in Karnataka. Ramesh criticized Prime Minister Narendra Modi for previously labeling such welfare measures as 'freebies' but now adopting similar schemes. Regarding the opposition INDIA bloc, Ramesh emphasized that the alliance, comprising over 25 parties, is focused on next year’s general elections. He acknowledged differences within the bloc but said consensus would be achieved. He credited Rahul Gandhi’s Bharat Jodo Yatra with transforming Indian politics and attributed Congress's success in Karnataka to the campaign, hoping for similar results in upcoming state elections. Responding to questions about the Congress government in Himachal Pradesh, which the BJP accused of failing to fulfill promises, Ramesh said the government managed severe floods effectively. He criticized BJP leaders JP Nadda and Anurag Thakur for not advocating that the floods be declared a national disaster by the central government. On allegations concerning Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel in the Mahadev app investigation by federal agencies, Ramesh deflected by highlighting alleged corruption in the Mahakal Lok Corridor project in Ujjain, which the Congress claims suffered from poor construction. Ramesh argued that the Congress is confronting not only the BJP but also central investigative agencies, alleging these are being misused against opposition parties. He stated that Baghel had requested a ban on the Mahadev betting app and the arrest of those involved three months prior, but claimed the central government had not taken action.

Štátna vláda padla v marci 2020 po vzbure viacerých poslancov verných Jyotiradityovi Scindiovi, čo otvorilo cestu na návrat Shivraja Singha Chouhana z Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) na post hlavného ministra. Celoštátny lockdown bol centrálnou vládou zavedený koncom marca 2020. Ramesh na tlačovej konferencii tvrdil, že toto oneskorenie umožnilo politické manévrovanie, pričom to označil za sprisahanie s cieľom zosadiť vládu Kongresu. Tiež obvinil niektorých členov strany zo zrady slovami: „Nechýba tu zradcov.“ Ramesh uviedol, že obyvatelia Madhya Pradéš sú nespokojní so správou BJP. S blížiacimi sa voľbami do snemovne 17. novembra vyjadril presvedčenie, že Kongres sa vráti k moci. Kongres predstavil 12 „záruk“ pre voľby v Madhya Pradéši vrátane LPG fľaše za 500 Rs, 1 500 Rs mesačne pre ženy, odpustenie úverov farmárom do 2 lakh Rs, obnovenie starého dôchodkového systému pre štátnych zamestnancov, minimálnej výkupnej ceny (MSP) pre farmárov, príspevkov pre nezamestnaných mladých ľudí a štipendií pre žiakov. Uviedol, že podobné sľuby boli splnené kongresovou vládou v Karnátake. Ramesh kritizoval premiéra Narendru Modiho za to, že takéto sociálne opatrenia predtým nazýval „darčeky zdarma“, no teraz zavádza podobné schémy. Pokiaľ ide o opozičný blok INDIA, Ramesh zdôraznil, že aliancia, ktorú tvorí viac ako 25 strán, sa sústredí na budúcoročné parlamentné voľby. Pripustil rozdiely v rámci bloku, no povedal, že sa dosiahne konsenzus. Ramesh pripísal Bharat Jodo Yatra pod vedením Rahula Gandhiho zásluhy za transformáciu indickej politiky a pripísal úspech Kongresu v Karnátake tejto kampani. Dúfa v podobné výsledky aj v nadchádzajúcich štátnych voľbách. V reakcii na otázky týkajúce sa vlády Kongresu v Himáčalpradéši, ktorú BJP obvinila z nesplnenia sľubov, Ramesh uviedol, že vláda zvládla silné záplavy efektívne. Kritizoval lídrov BJP JP Naddau a Anuraga Thakura za to, že sa nezasadzovali o vyhlásenie záplav za národnú katastrofu centrálnou vládou. K obvineniam týkajúcim sa hlavného ministra Chhattisgarhu Bhupesha Baghela v súvislosti s vyšetrovaním aplikácie Mahadev federálnymi orgánmi Ramesh poukázal na údajné korupčné problémy v projekte Mahakal Lok Corridor v Ujjainu, o ktorom Kongres tvrdí, že bol zle zrealizovaný. Ramesh uviedol, že Kongres čelí nielen BJP, ale aj centrálnym vyšetrovacím agentúram, pričom tvrdil, že sú zneužívané proti opozičným stranám. Uviedol, že Baghel požiadal o zákaz aplikácie Mahadev a zatknutie zodpovedných už pred tromi mesiacmi, no podľa neho centrála nekonala.

article_content: Tesla has initiated legal action against Sweden’s Transport Agency and the postal service PostNord after a workers' strike disrupted the delivery of license plates for the automaker’s new vehicles. On November 20, PostNord employees at the state-owned company stopped distributing the plates as part of industrial action. According to the Swedish business paper Dagens Industri, Tesla filed separate lawsuits against both entities. This dispute is rooted in efforts by IF Metall, Sweden’s largest industrial union, which is pressing for a collective bargaining agreement for Tesla’s mechanics. The union began striking on October 27 by halting maintenance on Tesla vehicles, and other unions — including dockworkers, electricians, and cleaners — have since joined in solidarity. Tesla maintains it does not sign collective agreements, arguing its Swedish workers already receive equal or better conditions than the union’s terms. IF Metall, on the other hand, says such agreements are fundamental to Sweden’s labor system and critical for ensuring fair workplace standards. In legal filings, Tesla argued that denying alternative ways to access or deliver license plates amounts to unique and unfair treatment by Swedish authorities, potentially affecting many Swedish consumers who have purchased new Tesla cars. Tesla delivered over 9,000 electric vehicles in Sweden in 2022. The Swedish Transport Agency has confirmed receipt of Tesla’s lawsuit, explaining it disputes Tesla’s claim but will respond once the full complaint is reviewed. PostNord has also declared its neutrality in the labor conflict and said it would issue further comment after reviewing the lawsuit. Seko, the union representing PostNord workers, suggested a resolution lies in Tesla signing the collective agreement with IF Metall. The union interprets the lawsuits as signals that Tesla could not circumvent the union-backed job actions. As of now, Tesla has not provided further comment.
translated_content: Tesla podnikla právne kroky proti švédskej Dopravnej agentúre a poštovej službe PostNord po tom, ako štrajk zamestnancov narušil doručovanie evidenčných tabuliek pre nové vozidlá výrobcu. Dňa 20. novembra zamestnanci štátom vlastnenej spoločnosti PostNord prestali s distribúciou tabuliek v rámci priemyselného konfliktu. Podľa švédskeho ekonomického denníka Dagens Industri podala Tesla samostatné žaloby proti obom subjektom. Tento spor má korene v iniciatíve IF Metall, najväčšieho priemyselného odboru vo Švédsku, ktorý žiada kolektívnu zmluvu pre mechanikov Tesly. Odbory začali štrajkovať 27. októbra zastavením údržby vozidiel Tesla a ďalšie odbory — vrátane dokárov, elektrikárov a upratovačov — sa k nim pridali v solidarity. Tesla tvrdí, že nepodpisuje kolektívne zmluvy, keďže jej švédski zamestnanci už majú rovnaké alebo lepšie podmienky ako požadujú odbory. IF Metall naopak považuje kolektívne zmluvy za základ švédskeho pracovného trhu a kľúčové pre spravodlivé pracovné podmienky. Vo svojich právnych podaniach Tesla argumentuje, že odmietnutie alternatív pri prebraní alebo doručení tabuliek predstavuje unikátne a neférové zaobchádzanie zo strany švédskych úradov, čo môže ovplyvniť mnohých zákazníkov, ktorí si kúpili nové autá. V roku 2022 dodala Tesla vo Švédsku viac ako 9 000 elektromobilov. Švédska dopravná agentúra potvrdila prijatie žaloby zo strany Tesly a uviedla, že s tvrdeniami nesúhlasí, avšak vyjadrí sa podrobne až po preštudovaní celého spisu. PostNord potvrdil svoju neutralitu v spore a vyjadrí sa neskôr po prečítaní žaloby. Seko, odborový zväz pracovníkov PostNord, uviedol, že riešením je podpísanie kolektívnej zmluvy Teslou s IF Metall. Odbory vnímajú žaloby ako znak, že Tesla nemohla obísť ich opatrenia. Tesla sa zatiaľ verejne nevyjadrila.

article_content: Queens Park Rangers marked their return to the Premier League in dramatic fashion, defeating Derby County 1-0 in the Championship play-off final at Wembley. The decisive moment arrived in the final minute, when Bobby Zamora took advantage of a mistake by Derby defender Richard Keogh to clinch victory. Despite being reduced to ten men after midfielder Gary O'Neil was sent off for a foul on Johnny Russell with half an hour to play, QPR's resilience kept the game level until Zamora's winner set off jubilant celebrations among players and fans. Manager Harry Redknapp and his squad celebrated the accomplishment by taking photos in the Wembley dressing room with the play-off trophy. Players such as Armand Traore, Shaun Wright-Phillips, Matt Phillips, Joey Barton, Aaron Hughes, Kevin Doyle, and Charlie Austin shared their excitement, with Austin posting a snapshot of himself and the trophy on Twitter. Among the most memorable moments from the festivities was Kevin Doyle, celebrating in his underwear alongside Aaron Hughes, and Joey Barton embracing Wright-Phillips. Striker Charlie Austin, who joined QPR from Burnley at the start of the season, played a key role in the club's successful push to reclaim a spot in England’s top tier. The match was defined by determination and team spirit, culminating in Zamora's late heroics that secured QPR’s place back in the Premier League and brought ecstatic scenes both on the pitch and in the dressing room.

article_content: In a first for American reality TV, The X Factor revealed the complete rankings of contestants based on public votes. The unexpected disclosure surprised both viewers and participants, especially as 37-year-old road worker Tate Stevens emerged as the top choice among voters. Jason Brock, known for his flamboyant performances, was eliminated after receiving the fewest votes. He narrowly missed staying in the competition, falling just behind CeCe Frey. Both Jason and CeCe had to sing for survival after landing in the bottom two, but when the judges couldn't agree on who to send home, the decision went to the public vote. As a result, Jason was sent home. CeCe Frey, despite being unpopular with voters, was saved by the public, moving forward in the competition. The show also featured a performance by British boy band One Direction, adding excitement to the night. Another twist occurred when Diamond White was brought back as a finalist after previously being eliminated, creating a top 13 instead of 12. The episode highlighted unprecedented transparency, with America's voting results for the contestants revealed for the first time. This provided the judges—Simon Cowell, Demi Lovato, LA Reid, and Britney Spears—direct feedback on how their acts were performing. Other contestants advancing included Carly Rose Sonenclar (runner-up in votes), Beatrice Miller, Arin Ray, Vino Alan, Jennel Garcia, Paige Thomas, Emblem3, Fifth Harmony, and Lyric145. The show was hosted by Mario Lopez and Khloe Kardashian Odom. Jason Brock thanked his supporters, expressing pride in representing the LGBTQ community and Japan, and received praise from his mentor LA Reid as he exited the competition.

article_content:
Pranjali Awasthi, currently 16, began exploring computer science at an early age, a path inspired by her engineer father who advocated for STEM education. By age seven, she was already coding, and when her family moved from India to Florida at 11, she immersed herself in computer science courses and competitive mathematics. At 13, she secured an internship at Florida International University's research labs, focusing on machine learning, all while attending high school online during the pandemic and dedicating up to 20 hours a week to her research tasks.

Her experience with the complexities of data extraction in academic research led her to consider how artificial intelligence could streamline the process. When OpenAI launched ChatGPT-3 beta, Pranjali recognized its potential to revolutionize research workflows, inspiring her to found Delv.AI—an AI-based startup aimed at simplifying data extraction and eliminating information silos.

In 2021, she took part in Miami Hack Week, where she met Lucy Guo and Dave Fontenot, the founders of the HF0 live-in accelerator program. Pranjali joined HF0’s 12-week residency in San Francisco and Miami, with her parents’ backing, putting high school on hold. During this period, she launched Delv.AI’s beta on Product Hunt on her 15th birthday, where it was voted the third most popular product of the day.

Delv.AI seeks to address the growing challenge of sifting through vast amounts of digital information, helping researchers locate specific, pertinent data using AI tools. After concluding her HF0 residency with a Demo Day presentation, Pranjali secured investments from On Deck and Village Global, which funded her first engineering hire and the development of a minimum viable product. Continued recognition and networking enabled her to raise a total of $450,000 from diverse investors, and Delv.AI is now valued at around $12 million.

Despite her entrepreneurial focus, Pranjali’s parents emphasized the importance of academics. They agreed she would finish her high school credits online, which she completed in June 2023, though she remains open to possibly attending college in the future to study business-related subjects. 

Pranjali’s routines involve daily exercise, leading virtual team meetings, coding, managing operational logistics, and overseeing recruitment, including hiring engineers abroad. She is the youngest on her team and prioritizes clear communication and collaborative work. In addition to handling HR and operations, she has recently expanded her staff to include customer service support, reflecting Delv.AI’s ongoing scaling efforts. Evenings are dedicated to administrative work, hobbies, and family time.

Pranjali notes both the obstacles and advantages of being a young founder: while some people initially underestimate her, many offer support. She maintains focus by setting specific goals and limiting distractions from news and social media. As the technology landscape rapidly shifts—especially with AI’s increasing dominance—she is committed to refining Delv.AI’s product with user input and attracting further investment to support ongoing growth.

Pranjali Awasthi, dnes 16-ročná, sa venovala informatike už ako dieťa, inšpirovaná otcom inžinierom, ktorý podporoval vzdelávanie v oblasti STEM. Programovať začala v siedmich, a po presťahovaní z Indie na Floridu v jedenástich rokov sa aktívne venovala predmetom z informatiky aj súťažnej matematike. Ako trinásťročná začala stáž v laboratóriu Florida International University na výskume strojového učenia, pričom strednú školu študovala online počas pandémie a výskumu venovala až dvadsať hodín týždenne.

Zložitosť extrahovania dát vo výskume ju priviedla k myšlienke, že umelá inteligencia by mohla tento proces zjednodušiť. Po vydaní beta verzie ChatGPT-3 od OpenAI rozpoznala jej potenciál zmeniť vedeckú prácu, čo ju viedlo k založeniu Delv.AI – startupu zameraného na jednoduchšiu prácu s dátami a prelamovanie informačných bariér.

V roku 2021 sa zúčastnila Miami Hack Week, kde stretla Lucy Guo a Davea Fontenota, zakladateľov akcelerátora HF0. Pranjali sa zapojila do 12-týždňovej rezidencie v San Franciscu a Miami s podporou rodičov, ktorí súhlasili s dočasným prerušením školy. Počas neho spustila beta verziu Delv.AI na Product Hunte v deň svojich 15. narodenín. Produkt sa stal tretím najpopulárnejším toho dňa.

Delv.AI sa zameriava na rastúci problém vyhľadávania relevantných informácií z obrovského množstva dát, pričom výskumníkom pomáha AI nástrojmi nachádzať presne to, čo potrebujú. Po skončení rezidencie a prezentovaní na Demo Day získala Pranjali investície od On Deck a Village Global. Tie jej umožnili najať prvého inžiniera a vybudovať základnú verziu produktu. Jej úspechy a vytvorené kontakty jej pomohli získať od investorov doposiaľ 450 000 dolárov, pričom Delv.AI je dnes ohodnotená na približne 12 miliónov dolárov.

Aj keď sa venuje podnikaniu, rodičia trvali na vzdelaní, takže v júni 2023 dokončila stredoškolské kredity online. V budúcnosti uvažuje o vysokej škole, najmä v oblasti biznisu.

Pranjalin denný režim zahŕňa ranný beh, vedenie tímových videoporád, programovanie, riadenie prevádzky a nábor nových členov vrátane zahraničných inžinierov. Ako najmladšia v tíme dbá na jasnú komunikáciu a spoluprácu. Okrem HR a operatívy rozšírila tím o podporu zákazníckych služieb – to všetko súvisí s rozširovaním firmy. Večery venuje administratíve, hre na hudobný nástroj, badmintonu a rodine.

Pranjali vníma prekážky aj výhody, ktoré prináša jej vek – niektorí ju podceňujú, no viacerí jej radi pomôžu. Drží sa jasných cieľov, neabsorbuje všetko z médií, sústredí sa a nebojí sa odsledovať rušivé účty. Scéna okolo technológií sa rýchlo mení a AI je čoraz silnejšia; Pranjali sa tak sústredí na vylepšovanie Delv.AI podľa spätnej väzby používateľov a plánuje získať ďalšie investície na rast firmy.

article_content: Three-year-old Vittoria Cerioli, daughter of Italian Member of the European Parliament (MEP) Licia Ronzulli, has accompanied her mother to work since she was six weeks old. Recently, Vittoria became more involved during a European Parliament session in Strasbourg, joining her mother in voting by raising her arm. At this month's session in eastern France, Vittoria attended proceedings with her favorite toy, a Teletubby named Po, while debates focused on the long-term EU budget and investment programs. Licia Ronzulli, 38, from Lombardy, Italy, managed her parliamentary duties with confidence, carrying her daughter, addressing parliament, and checking her Blackberry. Ronzulli has taken advantage of the European Parliament's family-friendly policy since September 2010, which permits mothers to bring their children to work. She has described this as a maternal act rather than a political statement, emphasizing that not all women have this possibility and highlighting the need for broader support. Vittoria was born on 10 August 2010. Licia Ronzulli was elected in 2009 and is a member of the People of Freedom (Popolo della Libertà) party. Vittoria's father, Renato Cerioli, is also a party member. The family are close friends with Silvio Berlusconi, who was a witness at their wedding. Ronzulli is a member of the environment, health, and food safety commission in Strasbourg. She previously worked as a nurse in Milan and Bangladesh, became a hospital director, and later entered politics. The European Parliament's supportive policies have allowed Vittoria to attend several sessions, including marking International Women's Day.

Nedávno sa Vittoria aktívnejšie zapojila počas zasadnutia Európskeho parlamentu v Štrasburgu, kde sa k mame pripojila pri hlasovaní zdvihnutím ruky. Na tohtomesačnom zasadnutí vo východnom Francúzsku sa Vittoria zúčastnila zasadnutia so svojou obľúbenou hračkou Teletubbym menom Po, pričom sa diskutovalo o dlhodobom rozpočte EÚ a investičných programoch. Licia Ronzulli, 38-ročná z Lombardie v Taliansku, s istotou zvládala svoje parlamentné povinnosti – niesla dcéru, vystúpila v parlamente a kontrolovala Blackberry. Ronzulli využíva rodinne priaznivú politiku Európskeho parlamentu od septembra 2010, ktorá umožňuje matkám priniesť deti do práce. Sama to vníma ako materský čin, nie politické gesto, a zdôrazňuje, že nie všetky ženy majú túto možnosť. Vyzdvihuje potrebu širšej podpory. Vittoria sa narodila 10. augusta 2010. Licia Ronzulli bola zvolená v roku 2009 a je členkou strany Popolo della Libertà (Ľud slobody). Vittoriin otec, Renato Cerioli, je tiež členom tejto strany. Rodina je blízkymi priateľmi Silvia Berlusconiho, ktorý bol svedkom na ich svadbe. Ronzulli je členkou komisie pre životné prostredie, zdravie a bezpečnosť potravín v Štrasburgu. Predtým pracovala ako zdravotná sestra v Miláne a Bangladéši, neskôr sa stala riaditeľkou nemocnice a nakoniec vstúpila do politiky. Podporné nastavenie parlamentu umožnilo Vittorii zúčastniť sa viacerých zasadnutí, vrátane Medzinárodného dňa žien.

article_content: The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) said Friday it will re-test all radiation-emitting full-body scanners after an internal review revealed calculation errors, missing information, and paperwork discrepancies from contractors who assess the machines' radiation levels. This announcement follows Homeland Security Secretary Janet Napolitano’s recent assurances to a Senate committee that scanners are safe, citing independent studies that found their radiation level is about the same as two minutes spent flying. While the TSA maintains these are mainly record-keeping issues rather than safety concerns, Senator Susan Collins of Maine criticized the agency, noting that over a quarter of the reviewed reports had significant errors, including major mistakes in radiation emission data. She questioned whether travelers and airport staff can trust the data supporting these scanners’ safety. As a result, the TSA committed to re-testing all ‘backscatter’ scanners by the end of March, retraining contractors, boosting oversight, and asking the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH) to refresh its 2008 scanner report. In response to public concern, the TSA has already started to publish raw radiation test data on its website and promised ongoing transparency with future reports. The internal review covered reports from the last two years at 15 airports and noted calculation errors, missing background radiation readings, and absent supplementary information; the TSA claims these do not affect safety standards. Spokesman Nicholas Kimball reiterated that repeated independent tests validate scanner safety but acknowledged data reporting practices need improvement. Privacy advocate Marc Rotenberg argued these findings provide more reason to pause scanner use. A House oversight subcommittee is set to hold a hearing on the TSA’s body scanner oversight soon.
translated_content: Americký Úrad pre bezpečnosť dopravy (TSA) v piatok oznámil, že opätovne skontroluje všetky celotelové skenery vyžarujúce radiáciu po tom, čo interný audit odhalil chyby vo výpočtoch, chýbajúce údaje a nezrovnalosti v dokumentácii od externých dodávateľov, ktorí preverujú úroveň radiácie v týchto zariadeniach. Toto rozhodnutie prišlo krátko po tom, čo ministerka pre vnútornú bezpečnosť Janet Napolitanová v Senáte uistila, že skenery sú bezpečné a podľa nezávislých štúdií je úroveň radiácie asi rovnaká, akú človek dostane za dve minúty letu lietadlom. Hoci TSA tvrdí, že väčšina problémov sú len administratívne pochybenia a nie otázky bezpečnosti, senátorka Susan Collinsová z Maine kritizovala úrad s tým, že vyše štvrtiny kontrolovaných správ obsahovalo vážne chyby, vrátane nesprávnych údajov o radiácii. Pochybovala, či cestujúci a zamestnanci letísk môžu takýmto údajom veriť. TSA preto prisľúbil, že všetky „backscatter“ skenery pretestuje do konca marca, preškolí dodávateľov, zintenzívni dohľad a požiada Národný inštitút pre bezpečnosť a ochranu zdravia pri práci (NIOSH), aby aktualizoval správu z roku 2008. V reakcii na obavy verejnosti už TSA začal zverejňovať surové údaje z meraní radiácie na svojom webe a zaväzuje sa zverejňovať aj všetky ďalšie kontroly. Vnútorná revízia sa týkala správ z posledných dvoch rokov z 15 letísk a zistila chyby vo výpočtoch, chýbajúce merania pozadia a chýbajúce doplňujúce informácie; TSA tvrdí, že to bezpečnostné štandardy neohrozuje. Hovorca Nicholas Kimball zopakoval, že nezávislé testy potvrdili bezpečnosť týchto zariadení, no uznal, že treba zlepšiť vedenie dokumentácie. Ochranca súkromia Marc Rotenberg tvrdí, že tieto poznatky sú ďalším dôvodom na pozastavenie používania skenerov. Podvýbor Snemovne bude čoskoro riešiť dohľad nad celotelovými skenermi TSA.

A Jewish school in Montreal's Côte-des-Neiges neighborhood was struck by gunfire early Sunday morning—the second such incident involving the same school within a week, according to police. The building was empty at the time, and no injuries were reported, said Montreal Police Department spokesperson Caroline Chevrefils to ABC News. The shooting occurred around 5 a.m. local time, prompting multiple 911 calls. A witness told police they saw a car speeding away from the scene after shots were fired.

Police have not officially named the school, but Chevrefils confirmed that it was the same Jewish school targeted on Thursday. Canadian broadcaster CTV News has identified the school as Yeshiva Gedola.

Karina Gould, a member of Canada's Parliament, expressed her horror on social media, stating, "Thank goodness no one was harmed, but this threatening antisemitic violence cannot go on."

Chevrefils said the attack is being investigated as a hate incident. Police are appealing to the public to share any security footage capturing the shooting. Earlier that week, another Jewish school in Montreal was also damaged by gunfire, Chevrefils added. No arrests have been made.

Chevrefils also noted that reports of hate crimes in Montreal have surged since October 7—the day Hamas launched a deadly attack on Israel, resulting in over 1,200 Israeli deaths and more than 200 hostages. Retaliatory strikes by Israel have since killed over 11,000 people in Gaza. Since October 7, Montreal police have investigated 98 hate-related incidents: 73 targeting Jewish people and institutions, and 25 targeting the Arab-Muslim community.

Michael Mostyn, CEO of Jewish advocacy group B'nai Brith Canada, called the situation "mind-boggling" and urged police to ensure the Jewish community's safety.

Montreal Mayor Valerie Plante condemned the shootings in a news conference, affirming, "The Jewish community in Montreal is currently under attack. There is no reason that justifies shooting at an elementary school, at our communities. An antisemitic act like this has no place in Montreal."

Židovská škola v montrealskej štvrti Côte-des-Neiges bola v nedeľu skoro ráno zasiahnutá streľbou—ide už o druhý takýto incident v priebehu jedného týždňa, uviedla polícia. Budova bola v tom čase prázdna a nikto nebol zranený, informovala pre ABC News hovorkyňa montrealskej polície Caroline Chevrefils. K streľbe došlo okolo 5. hodiny ráno miestneho času a prijali viacero hovorov na linku 911. Svedok polícii povedal, že po výstreloch videl auto rýchlo odchádzať z miesta činu.

Polícia oficiálne neuviedla názov školy, no Chevrefils potvrdila, že ide o tú istú židovskú školu, na ktorú sa strieľalo aj vo štvrtok. Kanadská televízia CTV News školu identifikovala ako Yeshiva Gedola.

Členka kanadského parlamentu Karina Gould na sociálnych sieťach vyjadrila svoje zdesenie slovami: „Našťastie nikto nebol zranený, ale táto hroziaca antisemitská násilnosť nemôže pokračovať.“

Chevrefils uviedla, že útok vyšetrujú ako nenávistný incident. Polícia žiada verejnosť o zdieľanie akýchkoľvek bezpečnostných záznamov zachytávajúcich streľbu. Skôr v tom týždni bola streľbou poškodená aj ďalšia židovská škola v Montreale, dodala Chevrefils. Zatiaľ nikoho nezadržali.

Chevrefils tiež uviedla, že počet nahlásených nenávistných trestných činov v Montreale prudko narástol od 7. októbra – dňa, keď Hamas spustil smrteľný útok na Izrael, pri ktorom zahynulo viac ako 1 200 Izraelčanov a viac ako 200 bolo vzatých ako rukojemníci. V odvetných útokoch Izraela na Gazu od tej doby zahynulo viac ako 11 000 ľudí. Od 7. októbra montrealská polícia vyšetrovala 98 nenávistných incidentov: 73 smerovalo proti židovským osobám a inštitúciám a 25 proti arabsko-moslimskej komunite.

Michael Mostyn, výkonný riaditeľ židovskej obhajcovskej skupiny B'nai Brith Canada, nazval situáciu „nepochopiteľnou“ a vyzval políciu, aby posilnila bezpečnosť židovskej komunity.

Primátorka Montrealu Valerie Plante streľbu ostro odsúdila na tlačovej konferencii a povedala: „Židovská komunita v Montreale je v súčasnosti pod útokom. Neexistuje žiadny dôvod, ktorý by ospravedlnil streľbu na základnú školu alebo na naše komunity. Takýto antisemitský čin nemá v Montreale miesto.“

article_content: Chennai: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin has requested Minister of External Affairs S Jaishankar to help secure the release of 12 Tamil fishermen reportedly detained by the Maldivian Coast Guard. According to a letter sent by Stalin, the fishermen left Tharuvaikulam Fish Landing Centre in Thoothukudi District on October 10, 2023, in a mechanized fishing boat (registration IND-TN-12-MM-6376). They were allegedly apprehended by the Maldives Coast Guard on October 23 near Thinadhoo Island. CM Stalin urged the External Affairs Ministry to discuss the matter with Maldivian authorities through appropriate diplomatic channels to ensure the early release of both the fishermen and their fishing boat. Earlier, Tamil Nadu BJP President K Annamalai also wrote to the EAM, requesting intervention for the fishermen, who were arrested for allegedly straying into Maldivian territorial waters while fishing in the southern Arabian Sea. The Maldivian Navy arrested all 12 fishermen and seized the barge, informing the fishing community in Tharuvaikulam about the incident. The Barge Owners Association and the arrested fishermen’s families have called on both the central and state governments to take immediate action for the fishermen’s release.

Podľa listu, ktorý Stalin zaslal, rybári vyplávali 10. októbra 2023 z pristávacieho centra Tharuvaikulam v okrese Thoothukudi na mechanizovanej rybárskej lodi (registračné číslo IND-TN-12-MM-6376). Maldivské námorníctvo všetkých 12 rybárov zatklo a zhabalo ich loď, pričom o incidente informovalo rybársku komunitu v Tharuvaikulame. Združenie majiteľov lodí a rodiny zatknutých rybárov vyzvali centrálnu aj štátnu vládu, aby podnikli okamžité kroky na ich prepustenie.

article_content: Residents of Rocky River, a suburb of Cleveland, awoke to find mayflies coating cars, buildings, and parking lots. Commonly called Canadian soldiers, these harmless insects only stick around for a few days, but their massive presence is hard to ignore. Experts say these annual mayfly swarms, which occur along Lake Erie’s shores in June, are a sign that the lake is healthy. Cities such as Cleveland, Sandusky, Port Clinton, and parts of Toledo often see these black swarms each summer. Mayflies can be irritating, as they attach to clothing and sometimes get into hair, but they’re an important food source for birds and fish. People are advised not to kill them since they give off a strong fishy odor when crushed. According to Don Schloesser from the Great Lakes Science Center, the number of mayflies can change from year to year, often influenced by harsh winters or events like algae blooms. To manage the influx, cities like Port Clinton are reducing streetlight use, while some business owners use leaf blowers to clear sidewalks. While adult mayflies live just a day or two, their overall life cycle spans two years—beginning as eggs on the water, developing into larvae in the mud, and later flying out as adults. This year, the swarms are less dense compared to the past, says Blanca Stransky of Perry’s Victory & International Peace Memorial on South Bass Island.
translated_content: Obyvatelia štvrte Rocky River pri Clevelande sa zobudili do rána, keď boli autá, budovy aj parkoviská zahalené rojom májok. Tento neškodný hmyz, známy aj ako kanadskí vojaci, zostáva len pár dní, ale ich obrovský počet neunikne pozornosti. Odborníci tvrdia, že každoročné rojenie májok, ktoré prichádza v júni na brehy Erijského jazera, je znakom jeho zdravia. Takéto tmavé roje obťažujú v lete aj mestá ako Cleveland, Sandusky, Port Clinton či časti Toleda. Májky vedia byť otravné — zachytávajú sa na oblečení a neraz končia aj vo vlasoch – no pre vtáky a ryby sú významným zdrojom potravy. Nemalo by sa ich zabíjať, pretože pri rozdrvení vydávajú silný rybací zápach. Don Schloesser z Great Lakes Science Center poukazuje na každoročné výkyvy ich počtu, pričom vplyv majú tvrdá zima aj premnoženie rias. Proti rojom sa v mestách ako Port Clinton bojuje aj vypínaním verejného osvetlenia či použitím fukárov na čistenie chodníkov. Dospelé májky prežijú iba deň–dva, no ich životný cyklus je až dvojročný — od vajíčka na hladine, po larvu v bahne až po dospelého jedinca. Tento rok sú však roje slabšie než po minulé roky, upozorňuje Blanca Stransky z pamätníka Perry’s Victory & International Peace Memorial na ostrove South Bass Island.

article_content: United States Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen has urged China to prevent its firms from supplying Russia with equipment used in the war in Ukraine. Yellen stressed the importance of maintaining 'healthy economic relations' between China and the US, and called on Beijing to take steps against Chinese companies assisting Russia. She clarified that Washington does not seek to decouple the US and Chinese economies, as this would harm both countries and destabilize the global economy. However, the Biden administration will not hesitate to take unilateral action against Chinese firms supplying defense equipment to Moscow. Yellen told reporters after a two-day meeting with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng in San Francisco that the Treasury has observed evidence of Chinese firms and banks helping facilitate the flow of equipment to Russia, warning they could face significant consequences. She expressed concern that, despite existing sanctions, critical equipment for Russia's military effort is evading restrictions and being sent to Russia. Yellen emphasized she was not accusing the Chinese government of direct involvement. Yellen also accepted an invitation from He to visit China next year as part of regular ongoing contact between economic leaders. The meeting took place ahead of planned talks between President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping, who will visit San Francisco for the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. US-China relations sharply declined under former President Donald Trump, who implemented tariffs and sanctions against Chinese businesses to promote US manufacturing and address alleged human rights abuses. Tensions have persisted under President Biden, though recent diplomatic efforts include high-level visits and discussions on cooperation in areas like climate change and the global economy. In January, Yellen met face-to-face with former Chinese Vice Premier Liu He for the first time, and in July, she visited China to discuss economic policies and global challenges.

Yellenová zdôraznila dôležitosť udržiavania 'zdravých ekonomických vzťahov' medzi Čínou a USA a vyzvala Peking, aby podnikol kroky voči čínskym spoločnostiam, ktoré pomáhajú Rusku. Upresnila, že Washington sa nesnaží oddeliť americkú a čínsku ekonomiku, keďže by to poškodilo obe krajiny a destabilizovalo svetovú ekonomiku. Administratíva prezidenta Bidena však neváha podniknúť jednostranné kroky voči čínskym firmám, ktoré dodávajú obranné vybavenie Moskve. Yellenová novinárom po dvojdňovom stretnutí s čínskym vicepremiérom He Lifengom v San Franciscu povedala, že ministerstvo financií zaznamenalo dôkazy o tom, že čínske firmy a banky pomáhajú sprostredkúvať tok zariadení do Ruska, pričom varovala, že im môžu hroziť vážne následky. Vyjadrila znepokojenie nad tým, že napriek platným sankciám sa kritické vybavenie pre ruské vojenské úsilie obchádza obmedzenia a je zasielané do Ruska. Yellenová zdôraznila, že neobviňuje čínsku vládu z priamej účasti. Yellenová tiež prijala pozvanie od He na návštevu Číny budúci rok v rámci pravidelného kontaktu medzi ekonomickými lídrami. Stretnutie sa uskutočnilo pred plánovanými rozhovormi medzi prezidentom Bidenom a čínskym prezidentom Si Ťin-pchingom, ktorí sa zúčastnia summitu Hospodárskej spolupráce ázijsko-tichomorského regiónu v San Franciscu. Vzťahy medzi USA a Čínou sa prudko zhoršili za bývalého prezidenta Donalda Trumpa, ktorý zaviedol clá a sankcie proti čínskym firmám na podporu americkej výroby a ako reakciu na údajné porušovanie ľudských práv. Napätie pretrváva aj za prezidenta Bidena, hoci v posledných mesiacoch došlo k diplomatickým snahám, ktoré zahŕňajú vysoké návštevy a diskusie o spolupráci v oblastiach ako klimatická zmena a globálna ekonomika. Brazilian football legend Ronaldo is confident that Neymar will soon be seen as the best player in the world. According to Ronaldo, Neymar has revitalized the Brazilian national team and is narrowing the gap with global stars Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. In an interview with Folha de Sao Paulo, Ronaldo remarked that Neymar is on the brink of becoming football’s number one. Playing for Barcelona, Neymar has been expected to lead Brazil back to the top of world football.

Ronaldo also said that although Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are currently the best, Neymar’s move to Europe has enhanced his abilities. He observed that Brazil does not have as many top-level players at the moment, increasing expectations on Neymar, unlike past eras when the team featured multiple stars. Ronaldo noted that former players like Ronaldinho, Kaka, and Robinho did not fully realize their potential to guide the national team, leaving Neymar with the task of stepping up.

Following their disappointing World Cup on home soil, Brazil has experienced a turnaround under coach Dunga, winning six games in a row. When asked about Dunga’s appointment, Ronaldo stated he was not involved in the decision and could not offer direct judgment. He recognized that the painful 7-1 defeat to Germany at the 2014 World Cup still affects Brazilians but prefers to focus on the joyful memory of beating Germany in the 2002 World Cup final.

article_content: Norwegian Deputy Foreign Minister Andreas Motzfeldt Kravik praised the bilateral relationship between Norway and India during his visit to New Delhi, emphasizing India’s vital role in tackling major global challenges. Kravik described India, the world’s largest democracy, as 'fundamental' to progress on critical issues such as combating climate change, promoting multilateralism, and finding solutions grounded in international law. He highlighted that it is 'impossible' to find global solutions to international problems without India's participation. In an interview with ANI, Kravik reiterated that Norway considers India a vital partner committed to engagement on numerous fronts. Reflecting on recent meetings, Kravik noted that both countries are equally dedicated to building strong, resilient partnerships and finding solutions together. He pointed to the India-Nordic summit as a testament to the strength of government-to-government cooperation and a valuable forum that brings together representatives from business, science, and government to collaborate on new ideas. Kravik announced that the Norwegian Foreign Minister has invited Indian External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar to Oslo, with hopes of hosting the Indian Prime Minister at the next Nordic-India summit scheduled after summer or in the fall. Discussing economic and political ties, Kravik described the Indian market as important for both economic and political reasons, expressing Norway’s commitment to deepening engagement. He characterized India as a 'bridge builder' paving the way for a more prosperous, multilateral, and law-based future. Kravik also noted the growing Indian presence in Norway, saying that approximately 25,000 Indians, especially in the IT sector, contribute significantly to the Norwegian economy. He emphasized Norway’s efforts to attract more Indians and Indian companies, citing summits and partnerships as effective avenues for fostering greater collaboration.

Kravik označil Indiu, najväčšiu demokraciu na svete, za „kľúčovú“ pre pokrok v zásadných otázkach, ako je boj proti klimatickým zmenám, podpora multilateralizmu a hľadanie riešení založených na medzinárodnom práve. Zdôraznil, že bez účasti Indie je „nemožné“ nájsť globálne riešenia medzinárodných problémov. V rozhovore pre agentúru ANI Kravik zopakoval, že Nórsko považuje Indiu za dôležitého partnera, ktorý je odhodlaný zapájať sa do spolupráce v rôznych oblastiach. Kravik v súvislosti s nedávnymi stretnutiami poznamenal, že obe krajiny sú rovnako oddané budovaniu silných a odolných partnerstiev a spoločnému hľadaniu riešení. Ako dôkaz sily medzištátnej spolupráce vyzdvihol summit India-Nordic, ktorý je cenným fórom spájajúcim zástupcov biznisu, vedy a vlád za účelom hľadania nových nápadov. Kravik oznámil, že nórska ministerka zahraničných vecí pozvala indického ministra zahraničných vecí S. Jaishankara do Osla a vyjadril nádej, že indický premiér sa zúčastní na budúcom summite Nordic-India, ktorý je naplánovaný po lete alebo na jeseň. Pri diskusii o ekonomických a politických vzťahoch Kravik označil indický trh za dôležitý nielen z ekonomického, ale aj politického hľadiska a zdôraznil záväzok Nórska prehlbovať spoluprácu. Indiu označil za „staviteľa mostov“, ktorý otvára cestu k prosperujúcejšej budúcnosti založenej na multilateralizme a právnych normách. Kravik tiež poukázal na rastúcu prítomnosť Indov v Nórsku a uviedol, že približne 25 000 Indov, najmä v IT sektore, významne prispieva k nórskemu hospodárstvu. Zdôraznil snahu Nórska prilákať viac Indov a indických spoločností a zdôraznil, že summity a partnerstvá sú účinnými nástrojmi na prehlbovanie tejto spolupráce.

article_content: Amber Vinson, a nurse at Texas Health Presbyterian Hospital in Dallas, contracted Ebola after caring for Thomas Eric Duncan, the first person diagnosed with the virus in the U.S. After traveling between Dallas and Ohio while unknowingly infected, Vinson and her family faced public claims of carelessness, which they firmly deny. The family sought legal representation from Billy Martin, a well-known attorney, to address these allegations. Vinson's family issued a statement asserting that Amber was vigilant in monitoring for symptoms and complied fully with CDC guidelines. They criticized media suggestions that she disregarded protocols as harmful and incorrect. The CDC verified that Vinson checked her symptoms multiple times and received authorization to fly home. Due to her visit to Ohio to prepare for her wedding, more than 150 people are now under monitoring, with three in quarantine, though none have shown symptoms thus far. Ohio Governor John Kasich has implemented stricter monitoring and quarantine measures in response, including a 21-day quarantine for individuals who had direct contact with someone diagnosed with Ebola. The updated rules also restrict the travel of those with potential exposure. Managing medical waste from Ebola patients has generated significant concern, with several states refusing to process contaminated materials. The CDC has stated that incineration and chemical treatment are effective in eliminating the virus. Vinson is being treated at Emory University Hospital in Atlanta, according to her family, who describe her as a dedicated and compassionate nurse. Nina Pham, another nurse from Dallas, is also currently being treated for Ebola.
translated_content: Amber Vinson, zdravotná sestra z Texas Health Presbyterian Hospital v Dallase, sa nakazila ebolou po tom, čo sa starala o Thomasa Erica Duncana, prvého človeka diagnostikovaného s týmto vírusom v USA. Po tom, čo cestovala medzi Dallasom a Ohiom, keď o svojej nákaze netušila, čelili ona aj jej rodina verejným obvineniam z nedbanlivosti, ktoré rozhodne popierajú. Rodina si na svoju obranu najala známeho právnika Billyho Martina. Rodina Vinsonovej vo vyhlásení uviedla, že Amber dôsledne sledovala príznaky a plne dodržiavala pokyny CDC. Kritizovali tvrdenia médií, že protokoly ignorovala, ako škodlivé a nepravdivé. CDC potvrdil, že Vinsonová opakovane kontrolovala symptómy a získala povolenie na let domov. Kvôli jej návšteve Ohia v rámci plánovania svadby je teraz viac ako 150 ľudí pod dohľadom, traja sú v karanténe, avšak doteraz sa u nikoho príznaky neobjavili. Guvernér Ohia John Kasich prijal prísnejšie opatrenia na monitorovanie a karanténu, vrátane 21-dňovej izolácie pre osoby, ktoré boli v priamom kontakte s nakazeným ebolou. Najnovšie pravidlá taktiež obmedzujú cestovanie ľudí, ktorí mohli byť vystavení vírusu. Likvidácia zdravotníckeho odpadu od pacientov s ebolou sa stala diskutovanou témou, pričom viaceré štáty odmietli tieto materiály spracovávať. CDC uviedlo, že spaľovanie a chemická úprava sú účinné na zničenie vírusu. Vinsonová je v súčasnosti liečená na špecializovanom oddelení v Emory University Hospital v Atlante. Jej rodina ju opisuje ako oddanú a súcitnú sestru. Ďalšia sestra z Dallasu, Nina Pham, sa tiež momentálne lieči na ebolu.

article_content: For over a decade, families with young children have been swimming in the disused Blue Lagoon quarry at Harpur Hill, near Buxton in Derbyshire, attracted by its bright turquoise water. Despite its inviting appearance, the water is nearly as toxic as bleach, with a pH level of 11.3, posing severe health risks including fungal infections, skin problems, and stomach issues. In an effort to prevent people from swimming in the hazardous quarry, the local council has dyed the water black. Warning signs around the area point out not only the dangerous chemical composition of the water but also physical threats like submerged car parts, dead animals, excrement, and other rubbish. Nonetheless, these warnings often go ignored, especially during warm weather. Local business owner Rachel Thomas observed that dyeing the lagoon black already seems to have discouraged visitors. According to Ms. Thomas, while the water was visually appealing, it was extremely dangerous. The lagoon's blue color came from nearby limestone rocks that leach calcite crystals into the water, while the dangerously high alkaline levels result from calcium oxide, a by-product left from quarrying. Because the land is privately owned, the council cannot enforce trespassing laws or drain the contaminated water. A High Peak Borough Council spokesperson warned that the pool is full of vehicle parts and rubbish, and that the water is extremely cold, further increasing the risks.

Napriek lákavému vzhľadu je voda takmer rovnako toxická ako bielidlo, s hodnotou pH 11,3, čo predstavuje vážne zdravotné riziká, vrátane plesňových infekcií, kožných problémov a žalúdočných ťažkostí. Aby zabránili ľuďom kúpať sa v nebezpečnom lome, miestna samospráva zafarbila vodu na čierno. Upozornenia v okolí informujú nielen o nebezpečnom chemickom zložení vody, ale aj o fyzických hrozbách, ako sú potopené časti áut, mŕtve zvieratá, exkrementy a iný odpad. Napriek tomu ľudia tieto varovania často ignorujú, najmä počas teplého počasia. Majiteľka miestneho podniku Rachel Thomasová si všimla, že zafarbenie lagúny na čierno už zrejme odradilo návštevníkov. Podľa nej bola voda vizuálne príťažlivá, no extrémne nebezpečná. Modrú farbu lagúny spôsobujú okolité vápencové skaly, ktoré do vody uvoľňujú kalcitové kryštály, pričom nebezpečne vysoká zásaditosť vznikla vďaka oxidom vápenatým, vedľajšiemu produktu ťažby. Keďže pozemok je v súkromnom vlastníctve, samospráva nemôže vynucovať zákazy vstupu ani vypustiť kontaminovanú vodu. Hovorkyňa rady High Peak Borough upozornila, že bazén je plný automobilových dielov a odpadu a že voda je extrémne studená, čo ešte zvyšuje riziká.

With the help of intermediaries, Iranian women's rights activist Narges Mohammadi was able to send a letter to CNN from inside Tehran’s Evin Prison. Mohammadi and her family believe she may face further punishment for speaking out again, but they say this has not deterred her and it will not stop her from raising her voice. On Friday, Mohammadi was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for “her fight against the oppression of women in Iran and her fight to promote human rights and freedom for all.”

In her letter to CNN, sent prior to learning of the prize, Mohammadi condemned the compulsory hijab, a requirement imposed on Iranian women by the Islamic Republic for over four decades. She also openly discussed the issue of sexual abuse experienced by women inside Iranian prisons. The Iranian government has denied widespread allegations of such assaults against detainees, including those documented by a detailed CNN investigation last year, calling them “false” and “baseless.”

Here are excerpts from her letter (edited for length):

Mohammadi writes that her letter may be long and disturbing and could be seen as a challenge or “feminist protest” with a radical tone. But it is, above all, a protest based on human rights, ethics, and feminism, against the persistent “violence and sexual harassment of women” by a government that, she argues, uses religion to further illegitimate power. Her protest, she says, goes beyond merely condemning violations of rights—it seeks to expose government deceit and control over all aspects of individual and social life, especially through restrictive laws targeting women.

She emphasizes that her words come not from a free feminist in a democratic society, but from an imprisoned woman, who, since the age of six, has lived “under the authority and oppression” of an ideological, patriarchal, and tyrannical military regime—deprived of freedom, youth, femininity, and motherhood.

According to Mohammadi, after gaining power, religious authorities in Iran used women as “pawns” to showcase male-dominated control, dressing half the population in “mandatory hijab,” including veils, chadors, manteaus, or dark-colored trousers. This, she says, became a symbol differentiating Islamic and Western societies, ‘showcasing’ control and subjugation. The hijab, she argues, was enforced not from private belief, but from government order, aiming to train societal submission and normalize surrender to oppression—not through overt violence, but social pressure.

The government justified these rules by claiming to protect women's dignity, chastity, and safety, and the well-being of society. Iranian women, she writes, have been forced for 44 years to wear head coverings and restrictive clothing, facing psychological pressures to comply with the hijab for the supposed benefit of societal values.

Mohammadi asserts that women subjected to sexual harassment are left feeling angry, fearful, and insecure. When women's identities are both suppressed and violated under the guise of ideology and religion, they feel doubly deceived by the government. She refuses to compare individual cases of assault, noting that the trauma often leaves deep, lasting scars. She also describes the intense anxiety and psychological harm caused by arrests and detentions, particularly when sexual harassment occurs during custody, interrogations, or transfers.

Such actions, in Mohammadi’s words, send a message that even supposed religious and moral limits will not restrain government agents from suppressing dissent. She calls compulsory hijab a deceptive scheme and a tool for reinforcing government power, and says the assault on protesting women exposes the government’s manipulative nature both to Iranians and the world.

Mohammadi concludes by reaffirming the strength and resilience of Iranian women, stating they have drawn power from decades of resistance. Iranian women, she writes, should be recognized not just as victims, but as leaders of change. She expresses her belief that their courage, unity, and struggle will ultimately help shape the future and determine their rights.

Narges Mohammadi, Evin Prison, July 2023
translated_content:
Za pomoci sprostredkovateľov sa iránskej aktivistke za práva žien Narges Mohammadi podarilo poslať list CNN z vnútra teheránskeho väzenia Evin. Mohammadi a jej rodina sa obávajú, že môže čeliť ďalšiemu trestu za to, že opäť prehovorila, no tvrdia, že ju to neodradí a nebude ju to zdržovať v dvíhaní svojho hlasu. V piatok bola Mohammadi ocenená Nobelovou cenou za mier za „boj proti útlaku žien v Iráne a za presadzovanie ľudských práv a slobody pre všetkých.“

Vo svojom liste CNN, ktorý poslala ešte pred tým, ako o ocenení vedela, Mohammadi odsúdila povinný hidžáb – požiadavku, ktorú Islamská republika kladie na iránske ženy už viac ako štyri desaťročia. Otvorene tiež hovorila o sexeálnom zneužívaní žien vo väzniciach v Iráne. Iránska vláda tieto rozšírené obvinenia voči väzneným ženám, vrátane tých, ktoré minulý rok zdokumentovalo CNN v podrobnej reportáži, označila za „falošné“ a „nepodložené“.

Prinášame skrátené úryvky z jej listu:

Mohammadi píše, že jej list je možno dlhý a jeho obsah znepokojujúci, niektorí ho môžu vnímať ako výzvu alebo „feministický protest“ s radikálnym tónom. Predovšetkým je to však protest zakorenený v ľudských právach, etike a feminizme proti neutíchajúcemu „násiliu a sexuálnemu obťažovaniu žien“ zo strany vlády, ktorá podľa nej zneužíva náboženstvo na presadzovanie nelegitímnej moci. Jej protest, podľa jej slov, nekončí iba odsúdením porušovaní práv, ale snaží sa odhaliť vládne prekrúcanie a kontrolu vo všetkých aspektoch individuálneho a spoločenského života, najmä cez reštriktívne zákony zamerané proti ženám.

Zdôrazňuje, že tieto slová nepíše slobodná feministka v demokratickej krajine, ale žena vo väzení, ktorá žije „pod autoritou a útlakom“ ideologicky, patriarchálne a tyransky založeného režimu už od šiestich rokov – ukrátená o slobodu, mladosť, ženskosť a materstvo.

Podľa Mohammadi po nástupe k moci použili náboženské autority v Iráne ženy ako „pešiakov“ na ukazovanie mužskej nadvlády, polovicu populácie obliekli do „povinného hidžábu“ – závojov, čádorov, manteau alebo tmavých nohavíc. To sa podľa nej stalo symbolom odlišnosti islamskej a západnej spoločnosti, demonštráciou kontroly a podriadenosti. Hidžáb nebol podľa nej výsledkom osobného presvedčenia, ale nariadenia vlády – snaha vychovávať poslušnosť a normalize podriadenosť voči útlaku, nie násilím, ale spoločenským tlakom.

Vláda svoje pravidlá podľa nej odôvodňovala ochranou dôstojnosti, cudnosti a bezpečnosti žien i blaha spoločnosti. Iránske ženy sú 44 rokov nútené nosiť prikrývky hlavy a obmedzujúce oblečenie, pričom čelia psychickému tlaku, aby dodržiavali povinný hidžáb pre „spoločenské dobro“.

Mohammadi tvrdí, že ženy po prežití sexuálneho obťažovania zostávajú plné hnevu, strachu a neistoty. Keď je ich identita zároveň potláčaná aj zneužitá v mene ideológie a náboženstva, cítia sa dvakrát zradené vládou. Odmieta porovnávať jednotlivé prípady obťažovania a zdôrazňuje, že následky zanechajú hlboké a trvalé stopy. Opisuje aj intenzívnu úzkosť a psychickú ujmu zo zadržania, najmä ak dochádza k sexuálnemu obťažovaniu počas väznenia či transportov.

Takéto činy podľa Mohammadi vysielajú jasnú správu, že ani domnelé náboženské a morálne hranice nebránia vládnym agentom v potlačení odporu. Povinný hidžáb nazýva klamlivým nástrojom na upevňovanie moci vlády a útoky na protestujúce ženy vníma ako dôkaz manipulatívnosti režimu pred Iráncami i svetom.

Na záver listu Mohammadi opätovne potvrdzuje silu a odolnosť iránskych žien, ktoré podľa nej čerpajú silu z desaťročí odporu. Mali by byť vnímané nielen ako obete, ale ako hybateľky zmien. Verí, že odvaha, jednota a boj žien napokon pomôžu formovať budúcnosť a určia ich práva.

Narges Mohammadi, väzenie Evin, júl 2023

article_content: Melynda Moon, a 23-year-old model from Guelph, Ontario, decided to embrace her fascination with elves by undergoing surgery to give her ears a pointed, elfin appearance. Spending £250 on the procedure, Moon had a two-hour operation in which the tops of her ear cartilage were trimmed and reshaped into triangular tips, echoing the look of elves depicted in fantasy films like The Lord of the Rings. Driven by her belief that she's spiritually connected to mythical beings—and even a former fairy—Moon saw the modification as a way to express her affinity for fantasy. Before the surgery, she would use makeup, hair dye, and digital edits to create an elven look, but longed for a more permanent transformation. In addition to her pointed ears, Moon has a subdermal implant of the Triforce symbol from The Legend of Zelda in her hand, further showing her commitment to the fantasy world. Despite some discomfort and swelling after the operation, she describes the outcome as entirely worthwhile, relishing her new, distinctive appearance. Friends sometimes joke that Moon helps monitor children’s Christmas behavior, playing on her unusual looks to reinforce stories about Santa’s elves. Moon has enjoyed a fascination with mythical beings since she was young, drawn to the elegance and whimsical nature of elves. article_content: Former RAF pilot Alistair Mathie, 67, was tragically killed when he accidentally walked into the spinning propeller of a Piper J3C-65 Cub aircraft. The accident occurred on January 28 at Priory Farm airstrip in Norfolk, shortly after Mathie, serving as a flying instructor, landed the plane during a flight lesson. According to an Air Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB) report, Mathie was wearing his headset at the time and may not have been able to hear the engine running, which contributed to his momentary lapse in concentration. The AAIB report also noted that the wind from the stationary aircraft's engine was not particularly strong, and Mathie may not have felt it. Moreover, the colored tips of the propeller blades may not have been visible, making the rotating blades harder to see. A post-mortem confirmed that Mathie, from Burgate, Norfolk, died instantly from a severe head injury and had no medical conditions that could have contributed to the incident. Mathie was widely respected in the aviation community and recognized as an expert. Tributes poured in from around the world, with colleagues describing him as 'the best of the best.' His wife, Dorothy—also a pilot—was taught to fly by Mathie, and the couple kept their own Auster plane on their farm. Although the AAIB did not recommend specific changes to safety protocols, the Light Aircraft Association (LAA), which had qualified Mathie as a coach, intends to expand its training to better address the dangers of propellers when boarding or leaving aircraft. The report also highlighted the value of some pilots’ practice of following a path along the edge of the wing to avoid contact with the spinning propeller. While shutting off the engine between flights was considered, this presents other risks, especially as the Piper Cub's engine requires hand starting, which can be hazardous if the engine is hot. Friends and associates expressed shock and sadness at Mathie's death. Peter Gill, secretary of the International Auster Club, praised Mathie as a highly skilled pilot and a popular figure worldwide, noting that tributes arrived from across the globe. Fellow former RAF officer Al Couts described Mathie as a mentor and a true gentleman. Robert Sage, who owns Priory Farm airstrip, recalled Mathie as a selfless and experienced pilot. Statistics reveal that since 1991, there have been 15 accidents in the UK involving light aircraft and propellers. Of these, ten occurred while hand-starting engines, and five when individuals were struck by rotating propellers.

K nehode došlo 28. januára na letisku Priory Farm v Norfolku krátko potom, ako Mathie, ktorý pôsobil ako inštruktor, pristál počas leteckej lekcie. Podľa správy Úradu pre vyšetrovanie leteckých nehôd (AAIB) mal Mathie v čase nehody na sebe slúchadlá a mohol preto nepočut’ bežiaci motor, čo prispelo k jeho krátkodobej strate koncentrácie. Správa AAIB tiež uviedla, že vietor z motora stojaceho lietadla nebol zvlášť silný, takže ho Mathie nemusel cítiť. Okrem toho farebné konce vrtule mohli byť neviditeľné, takže rotujúce listy boli ťažšie rozpoznateľné. Pitva potvrdila, že Mathie z Burgate v Norfolku zomrel okamžite na následky vážneho poranenia hlavy a nemal žiadne zdravotné ťažkosti, ktoré by k incidentu prispeli. Mathie bol v leteckej komunite veľmi uznávaný a bol považovaný za odborníka. Pocty prichádzali z celého sveta, pričom kolegovia ho opisovali ako „najlepšieho z najlepších“. Jeho manželka Dorothy — tiež pilotka — sa lietať naučila práve od Mathieho a spolu mali na farme vlastné lietadlo značky Auster. Hoci AAIB neodporučil konkrétne zmeny v bezpečnostných opatreniach, Asociácia ľahkých lietadiel (LAA), ktorá Mathieho kvalifikovala ako trénera, plánuje rozšíriť svoje školenia a lepšie upozorňovať na riziká vrtúľ pri nastupovaní alebo vystupovaní z lietadla. Správa tiež vyzdvihla hodnotu zaužívaného postupu niektorých pilotov ísť po hrane krídla, aby sa vyhli kontaktu s rotujúcou vrtuľou. Zvážilo sa aj vypínanie motora medzi letmi, no to predstavuje iné riziká, keďže motor Piper Cubu sa musí naštartovať ručne, čo môže byť nebezpečné, najmä ak je motor horúci. Priatelia a známi vyjadrili šok a smútok z Mathieho smrti. Peter Gill, tajomník International Auster Club, vyzdvihol Mathieho ako veľmi zručného pilota a obľúbenú osobnosť po celom svete, pričom pocty prišli z rôznych krajín. Bývalý dôstojník RAF Al Couts označil Mathieho za mentora a skutočného gentlemana. Robert Sage, majiteľ letiska Priory Farm, si Mathieho zapamätal ako nezištného a skúseného pilota. Štatistiky ukazujú, že od roku 1991 došlo v Spojenom kráľovstve k 15 nehodám s ľahkými lietadlami a vrtuľami. Z toho desať nastalo pri ručnom štartovaní motora a päť, keď osoby zasiahla rotujúca vrtuľa.

article_content: Mhairi Murdoch, a 29-year-old woman from Aberdeen, was shocked to give birth to a baby girl on Boxing Day, having experienced no clear signs of pregnancy. She spent Christmas feeling bloated and unwell, attributing her symptoms to an upset stomach. Late on December 26th, while having a glass of orange juice before bed, she was overtaken by severe stomach pain. Her husband Russell, 33, rushed to her aid after hearing her screams, discovering her on the kitchen floor. Just ten minutes later, with help from Russell and their son Callum, Mhairi delivered a healthy 7 lbs 6 oz daughter, Casey, in a breech birth at home. Mhairi explained that she had no typical pregnancy signs—regular periods, continued contraceptive injections, no notable weight gain, and her clothes still fit normally. She had previously given birth three times, so she quickly realized what was happening despite her surprise. After the delivery, Mhairi and Casey were taken to Aberdeen Maternity Hospital, where both were confirmed healthy and discharged home the following Sunday. Doctors suggested that the baby's breech position could have masked fetal movements during the pregnancy. Friends and family rallied together to help the surprised parents gather essentials for Casey. Mhairi described the experience as a huge shock but said they wouldn't change the outcome, even though it is not something she wishes to experience again.

Počas Vianoc sa cítila nafúknutá a bolo jej zle, symptómy pripisovala podráždenému žalúdku. Neskoro 26. decembra, keď si chcela dať pohár pomarančového džúsu pred spaním, zasiahla ju náhla prudká bolesť brucha. Jej manžel Russell, 33, jej okamžite pribehla na pomoc po tom, čo začul jej krik, a našiel ju na kuchynskej podlahe. Už o desať minút neskôr s pomocou Russella a ich syna Calluma Mhairi porodila zdravú dcéru Casey, vážiacu 3,35 kg, v polohe koncom panvovým doma. Mhairi vysvetlila, že nemala žiadne typické príznaky tehotenstva—pravidelnú menštruáciu, pokračujúce antikoncepčné injekcie, žiadne výrazné priberanie a stále sa jej zmestilo oblečenie. Keďže už predtým porodila trikrát, rýchlo si uvedomila, čo sa deje, aj keď bola veľmi prekvapená. Po pôrode boli Mhairi a Casey prevezené do Aberdeen Maternity Hospital, kde potvrdili, že sú obe zdravé, a domov ich prepustili nasledujúcu nedeľu. Lekári uviedli, že poloha bábätka mohla spôsobiť, že počas tehotenstva necítila pohyby. Priatelia a rodina sa spojili, aby pomohli prekvapenej rodine zabezpečiť potrebné veci pre Casey. Mhairi opísala tento zážitok ako veľký šok, ale povedala, že by nič nemenila, hoci by takúto skúsenosť už nechcela zažiť znova.

After an extensive investigation into his erratic behavior, Brazilian authorities recently arrested Regivaldo Pereira Galvão, who is accused of ordering the 2005 murder of Sister Dorothy Stang, a 73-year-old American nun and missionary. Sister Dorothy was known for her work in the Amazon’s Para state, promoting sustainable farming and defending the rights of landless peasants through the Project for Sustainable Development (PDS), a land reform initiative praised by Brazilian officials.

Authorities say Galvão was seen at 'Lot 55', a disputed 7,400-acre plot in the Amazon, allegedly pressuring local peasants to surrender property rights. On Friday, police arrested him on charges of land fraud and slavery; he also faces a conspiracy to murder charge related to Stang’s death. Before she was killed, Sister Dorothy supported efforts to give poor settlers access to public land and opposed deforestation. According to prosecutor Felicio Pontes, the PDS project has successfully helped over 300 families earn a sustainable living.

A documentary, 'They Killed Sister Dorothy', narrated by Martin Sheen, has received international recognition for its investigation into Stang’s life and murder, and has provided interviews used as evidence in the case. Beyond Galvão, five individuals were prosecuted for involvement in the murder: four were convicted and one acquitted. Stang was shot near Lot 55 while working with local communities. Prosecutors claim Galvão forged land titles and seized public land unlawfully under Brazil’s land reform program.

Galvão maintains his innocence, denying any illegal actions or involvement in Stang’s death and stating he is 'deeply sorry' for the tragedy. However, authorities and Stang’s colleagues assert his key role in illegal land grabbing and in organizing violence. Elizabeth Dowyer, a fellow nun and land reform advocate, expressed relief at the latest arrest, underscoring Galvão’s suspected involvement in slavery and land fraud. Dowyer also shared that Stang believed in the potential for redemption, even praying for her killers before her death.

Land reform remains a contentious issue in Brazil, as vast agricultural areas are controlled by a small number of wealthy landowners, fueling social tensions and violence according to the Landless Peasant Movement.

Note: Galvão was previously detained for a year after Stang's death and released by Brazil's high court in 2006, pending trial. He continues to deny any involvement.
translated_content:
Po rozsiahlej investigácii jeho nevyspytateľného správania brazílske úrady nedávno zadržali Regivalda Pereiru Galvãa, ktorý je obvinený z objednania vraždy sestry Dorothy Stangovej v roku 2005, 73-ročnej americkej misionárky. Sestra Dorothy sa preslávila prácou v štáte Pará v Amazónii, kde presadzovala udržateľné poľnohospodárstvo a chránila práva bezzemkov prostredníctvom Projektu udržateľného rozvoja (PDS), ktorému vyjadrili uznanie aj brazílski predstavitelia.

Úrady informovali, že Galvão bol videný na „Lote 55“, spornom 7 400-akrovom pozemku v Amazónii, kde údajne tlačil na miestnych roľníkov, aby sa vzdali vlastníckych práv. Polícia ho v piatok zatkla za pozemkové podvody a otroctvo; čelí aj obvineniu zo sprisahania za účelom vraždy v súvislosti s úmrtím Stangovej. Pred smrťou sestra Dorothy pomáhala chudobným osadníkom získať prístup k verejnej pôde a bojovala proti odlesňovaniu. Podľa prokurátora Felícia Pontesa projekt PDS pomohol viac než 300 rodinám získať udržateľné živobytie.

Dokument „Zabili sestru Dorothy“ s komentárom Martina Sheena získal medzinárodné uznanie za vyšetrovanie života a vraždy Stangovej a poskytol rozhovory využité ako dôkazy v prípade. Okrem Galvãa čelilo obvineniu z vraždy ďalších päť osôb: štyri boli odsúdené, jedna bola oslobodená. Stangová bola zastrelená pri Lote 55, keď pracovala s miestnou komunitou. Prokurátori tvrdia, že Galvão sfalšoval listy vlastníctva a nezákonne zabral verejnú pôdu v rámci brazílskeho pozemkového reformného programu.

Galvão trvá na svojej nevine, odmieta akékoľvek nezákonné konanie či účasť na vražde Stangovej a tvrdí, že je „hlboko zarmútený“ touto tragédiou. Úrady aj spolupracovníčky Stangovej však poukazujú na jeho kľúčovú úlohu pri nelegálnom zaberaní pôdy a organizovaní násilia. Rehoľníčka Elizabeth Dowyerová, ktorá tiež podporovala pozemkovú reformu, vyjadrila po zadržaní úľavu a zdôraznila, že Galvão je podozrivý aj z otroctva a podvodov. Tiež uviedla, že Stangová verila v možnosť zmeny a pred smrťou sa za svojich vrahov modlila.

Pozemková reforma je v Brazílii stále citlivou témou, keďže rozľahlé poľnohospodárske pozemky ovládajú len niektorí bohatí vlastníci, čo podľa Hnutia bezemkov prispieva k sociálnemu napätiu a násiliu.

Poznámka: Galvão bol po smrti Stangovej rok vo väzbe a v roku 2006 ho prepustil brazílsky najvyšší súd, pričom na súd stále čaká. Vinu stále odmieta.

article_content: Jay Beatty, a 10-year-old Celtic superfan with Down's Syndrome, has been nominated for the SPFL Goal of the Month for January after participating in a half-time penalty shootout challenge. Jay, from Armagh, became a fan favorite when former Celtic striker Georgios Samaras brought him onto the pitch during last year's title-winning celebrations. A video of Jay joining in Celtic’s lap of honour was broadcast live on Sky Sports and has since gone viral with over two million views on YouTube. On January 19, Jay celebrated by scoring in a half-time penalty challenge during Celtic’s 2-0 victory over Hamilton. He received a warm welcome from both sets of supporters. Jay was also presented with a ‘Sports Human Feat’ award on behalf of Georgios Samaras at the Grand Gala of El Mundo Deportivo. Affectionately known as ‘Wee Jay’, he met players and took part in the half-time shootout, celebrating joyfully in front of Celtic fans. Hamilton even included Jay's goal in their final score announcement on Twitter, making it 3-0 for Celtic. Jay received the ball from Hamilton Vice-Chairman Ronnie MacDonald and made new friends during the shootout event. After leaving Celtic, Samaras, now playing at Al Hilal in Saudi Arabia, expressed his admiration for Jay, inviting him to the World Cup in Brazil. Samaras described Jay as a source of incredible strength and mutual affection. Jay's goal, reportedly leading public votes, is competing against professional footballers such as David Goodwillie, Gary Mackay-Steven, and Mikael Lustig for the SPFL Goal of the Month award. Jay has developed a close relationship with Samaras and has trained with Celtic. Former manager Neil Lennon presented Jay with a medal after last season’s title win, and Jay proudly showed it off with his father during the celebrations.

Od oboch táborov fanúšikov dostal srdečné privítanie. Jayovi bola tiež udelená cena „Sports Human Feat“ v mene Georgiosa Samarasa na Galavečere El Mundo Deportivo. Známemu ako ‚Wee Jay‘, sa podarilo stretnúť hráčov a zúčastniť sa polčasovej penalty, po ktorej radostne oslavoval pred fanúšikmi Celticu. Hamilton dokonca zahrnul Jayov gól do svojho oznámenia konečného skóre na Twitteri, čím spravili z výsledku 3:0 pre Celtic. Jay dostal loptu od podpredsedu Hamiltonu Ronnieho MacDonalda a počas súťaže získal nových priateľov. Po odchode z Celticu Samaras, ktorý momentálne hrá v Al Hilal v Saudskej Arábii, vyjadril Jayovi svoj obdiv a pozval ho na majstrovstvá sveta do Brazílie. Jayov gól, ktorý podľa správ vedie v hlasovaní verejnosti, súťaží so známymi futbalistami ako David Goodwillie, Gary Mackay-Steven a Mikael Lustig o cenu SPFL Gól mesiaca. article_content: In response to the recent surge in violence between Israel and Hamas, China has called for an immediate ceasefire and reiterated its backing for an independent Palestinian state. In a Sunday statement from its foreign ministry, China stressed that the renewed conflict reveals the urgent necessity to revive long-stalled peace discussions. China reaffirmed its commitment to a two-state solution, describing it as the key path to resolving the ongoing conflict. The fresh round of escalation began when Hamas launched a surprise assault on Israel, firing thousands of rockets and sending fighters into southern areas. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu responded by declaring the nation 'at war.' The combined fatalities from the attacks and Israel’s subsequent airstrikes in Gaza have exceeded 1,100, with many Israelis reportedly taken hostage by Hamas. Negotiations for peace between Israel and the Palestinians have been idle since 2014. According to the United Nations, last year was among the deadliest in recent times. China expressed deep concern about the growing violence and called for urgent international engagement on the Palestinian issue. The foreign ministry confirmed China’s intention to keep working with the international community for peace. The conflict has also affected Chinese nationals. The Israeli embassy in Beijing reported that a Chinese-Israeli woman was taken hostage by Hamas. Additionally, a Chinese worker in southern Israel was hospitalized after being wounded by stray gunfire, as stated by the Global Times. Israel’s embassy thanked supportive countries, expressing hopes that China would stand in solidarity with Israel during this difficult period. Chinese President Xi Jinping, who recently suggested holding an international peace conference on the Israeli-Palestinian issue, offered to take an active part in facilitating peace talks. Xi has also promoted granting Palestine full membership in the United Nations, especially during meetings with Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas in Beijing. While President Xi has not yet commented publicly on the latest violence, China’s diplomatic involvement in the Middle East has grown. Earlier this year, Beijing assisted in renewing dialogue between Iran and Saudi Arabia, and recently hosted Syrian President Bashar Al-Assad on his first trip to China in almost 20 years.
